WITH metrics AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        NTILE(4) OVER (PARTITION BY status ORDER BY cost, id) cost_bucket,
        LEAD(cost, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY carrier ORDER BY shipped_date, id) next_cost
    FROM shipments
),
filtered AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        carrier,
        shipped_date,
        delivered_date,
        next_cost,
        INITCAP(TRIM(carrier)) carrier_title
    FROM metrics
    WHERE order_id IS NOT NULL
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM filtered
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY carrier ORDER BY shipped_date, id) = 1
),
remaining_keys AS (
    SELECT id, carrier
    FROM ranked
    EXCEPT
    SELECT id, carrier
    FROM shipments
    WHERE delivered_date > '2025-01-28'
),
verified AS (
    SELECT s.*
    FROM ranked s
    INNER JOIN remaining_keys k ON s.id = k.id AND s.carrier = k.carrier
)
SELECT
    carrier,
    MAX(next_cost) AS max_next_cost,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN carrier = 'UPS' THEN 1 END) AS ups_count,
    PERCENTILE_APPROX(next_cost, ARRAY(0.25, 0.5, 0.75)) AS next_cost_quartiles,
    ROUND(SUM(next_cost) / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN carrier = 'DHL' THEN 1 END), 0), 2) AS next_cost_per_dhl,
    ROUND(AVG(next_cost), 2) AS avg_next_cost
FROM verified
GROUP BY 1

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("status").orderBy("cost", "id")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("carrier").orderBy("shipped_date", "id")

metrics = (
    df_shipments
    .select(
        "*",
        F.ntile(4).over(w).alias("cost_bucket"),
        F.lead("cost", 1).over(w2).alias("next_cost"),
    )
)

filtered = (
    metrics
    .filter(F.col("order_id").isNotNull())
    .select(
        "id",
        "carrier",
        "shipped_date",
        "delivered_date",
        "next_cost",
        F.initcap(F.trim("carrier")).alias("carrier_title"),
    )
)

ranked = (
    filtered
    .withColumn("latest_rank", F.row_number().over(w2))
    .filter(F.col("latest_rank") == 1)
    .drop("latest_rank")
)

remaining_keys = (
    ranked
    .select("id", "carrier")
    .subtract(
        df_shipments
        .filter(F.col("delivered_date") > "2025-01-28")
        .select("id", "carrier")
    )
)

verified = (
    ranked
    .alias("s")
    .join(remaining_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.id") == F.col("k.id")) & (F.col("s.carrier") == F.col("k.carrier")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

result = (
    verified
    .groupBy("carrier")
    .agg(
        F.max("next_cost").alias("max_next_cost"),
        F.count(F.when(F.col("carrier") == "UPS", 1)).alias("ups_count"),
        F.percentile_approx("next_cost", [0.25, 0.5, 0.75]).alias("next_cost_quartiles"),
        F.round(F.sum("next_cost") / F.nullif(F.count(F.when(F.col("carrier") == "DHL", 1)), F.lit(0)), 2).alias("next_cost_per_dhl"),
        F.round(F.avg("next_cost"), 2).alias("avg_next_cost"),
    )
)

with valid as (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    select
        id,
        customer_id,
        plan,
        start_date,
        end_date,
        monthly_fee,
        add_months(end_date, 12) as end_date_plus_months
    from subscriptions
    where customer_id is not null
),
deduped as (
    -- Deduplicate with ROW_NUMBER
    select *, row_number() over (partition by customer_id order by start_date desc nulls last, id asc) as rn
    from valid
    qualify rn = 1
),
deduped_subscriptions as (
    -- Deduplicate with ROW_NUMBER
    select *, row_number() over (partition by customer_id, plan order by end_date_plus_months desc nulls first, id asc) as row_num
    from deduped
    qualify row_num = 1
),
enriched as (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    select
        *,
        row_number() over (partition by customer_id order by end_date desc, id asc) as row_seq,
        lag(monthly_fee, 2) over (partition by customer_id order by rn asc, id asc) as prev_monthly_fee
    from deduped_subscriptions
)
-- Native SQL UNPIVOT (wide to long)
select *
from (
    select
        id,
        plan,
        prev_monthly_fee,
        monthly_fee
    from enriched
) src
unpivot (
    metric_value for metric_name in (prev_monthly_fee, monthly_fee as MONTHLY_FEE)
);

from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("customer_id").orderBy(F.col("start_date").desc_nulls_last(), "id")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("customer_id", "plan").orderBy(F.col("end_date_plus_months").desc_nulls_first(), "id")
w3 = Window.partitionBy("customer_id").orderBy(F.col("end_date").desc(), "id")
w4 = Window.partitionBy("customer_id").orderBy("rn", "id")

valid = (
    df_subscriptions
    .filter(F.col("customer_id").isNotNull())
    .select(
        "id",
        "customer_id",
        "plan",
        "start_date",
        "end_date",
        "monthly_fee",
        F.add_months("end_date", 12).alias("end_date_plus_months"),
    )
)

deduped = (
    valid
    .withColumn("rn", F.row_number().over(w))
    .filter(F.col("rn") == 1)
)

deduped_subscriptions = (
    deduped
    .withColumn("row_num", F.row_number().over(w2))
    .filter(F.col("row_num") == 1)
)

enriched = (
    deduped_subscriptions
    .select(
        "*",
        F.row_number().over(w3).alias("row_seq"),
        F.lag("monthly_fee", 2).over(w4).alias("prev_monthly_fee"),
    )
)

result = (
    enriched
    .select("id", "plan", "prev_monthly_fee", F.col("monthly_fee").alias("MONTHLY_FEE"))
    .unpivot(
        ["id", "plan"],
        ["prev_monthly_fee", "MONTHLY_FEE"],
        "metric_name",
        "metric_value",
    )
    .filter(F.col("metric_value").isNotNull())
)

WITH filtered AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT
        *,
        COALESCE(budget, 0) AS budget_filled,
        COALESCE(dept_name, 'NONE') AS dept_name_filled
    FROM departments
    WHERE budget BETWEEN 1413000 AND 3366000
),
not_flagged AS (
    -- Anti-join via a correlated subquery
    SELECT s.*
    FROM filtered s
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM employees c
            WHERE c.dept_id = s.id
              AND c.job_title IN ('Designer', 'Analyst')
        )
),
cleaned AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT
        id,
        dept_name,
        location,
        dept_name_filled,
        GREATEST(budget_filled, budget) AS greatest_budget_filled_budget,
        TRIM(location) AS clean_location
    FROM not_flagged
    WHERE budget BETWEEN 1312000 AND 3987000
),
cleaned_departments AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        *,
        CAST(greatest_budget_filled_budget AS INT) AS greatest_budget_filled_budget_int,
        CONCAT_WS(',', location, dept_name) AS location_dept_name_key,
        COALESCE(location, 'N/A') AS location_clean
    FROM cleaned
    WHERE location IS NOT NULL
)
-- Native SQL PIVOT
SELECT *
FROM (
    SELECT
        dept_name,
        location,
        greatest_budget_filled_budget
    FROM cleaned_departments
) src
PIVOT (
    SUM(greatest_budget_filled_budget)
    FOR location IN ('London' AS london, 'Bangkok' AS bangkok)
)

from pyspark.sql import functions as F

filtered = (
    df_departments
    .filter(F.col("budget").between(1413000, 3366000))
    .withColumn("budget_filled", F.coalesce("budget", F.lit(0)))
    .withColumn("dept_name_filled", F.coalesce("dept_name", F.lit("NONE")))
)

not_flagged = (
    filtered
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_employees.alias("c"), (F.col("c.dept_id") == F.col("s.id")) & (F.col("c.job_title").isin(["Designer", "Analyst"])), "left_anti")
)

cleaned = (
    not_flagged
    .filter(F.col("budget").between(1312000, 3987000))
    .select(
        "id",
        "dept_name",
        "location",
        "dept_name_filled",
        F.greatest("budget_filled", "budget").alias("greatest_budget_filled_budget"),
        F.trim("location").alias("clean_location"),
    )
)

cleaned_departments = (
    cleaned
    .filter(F.col("location").isNotNull())
    .select(
        "*",
        F.col("greatest_budget_filled_budget").cast("int").alias("greatest_budget_filled_budget_int"),
        F.concat_ws(",", "location", "dept_name").alias("location_dept_name_key"),
        F.coalesce("location", F.lit("N/A")).alias("location_clean"),
    )
)

result = (
    cleaned_departments
    .groupBy("dept_name")
    .pivot("location", ["London", "Bangkok"])
    .agg(F.sum("greatest_budget_filled_budget"))
    .select(
        "dept_name",
        F.col("London").alias("london"),
        F.col("Bangkok").alias("bangkok"),
    )
)

WITH base AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        id,
        order_date,
        status,
        channel,
        discount,
        shipping_fee,
        COALESCE(discount, 0) AS discount_filled
    FROM orders
    WHERE order_date >= TO_DATE('2023-08-03')
)
-- Aggregate with conditional metrics
SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('WEEK', order_date) AS week_start,
    DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', order_date) AS activity_month,
    STDDEV_SAMP(shipping_fee) AS shipping_fee_stddev,
    STDDEV_SAMP(discount) AS discount_stddev,
    STDDEV_SAMP(discount) AS discount_stddev_2,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE channel = 'store') AS store_rows,
    PERCENTILE_APPROX(shipping_fee, 0.95) AS shipping_fee_p95
FROM base
GROUP BY ROLLUP (DATE_TRUNC('WEEK', order_date), DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', order_date))
HAVING PERCENTILE_APPROX(shipping_fee, 0.95) > 0
ORDER BY store_rows

    df_orders
    .filter(F.col("order_date") >= F.to_date(F.lit("2023-08-03")))

        "id",
        "order_date",
        "status",
        "channel",
        "discount",
        "shipping_fee",
        F.coalesce("discount", F.lit(0)).alias("discount_filled"),
    )

        F.count(F.when(F.col("channel") == "store", 1)).alias("store_rows"),
        F.percentile_approx("shipping_fee", 0.95).alias("shipping_fee_p95"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("shipping_fee_p95") > 0)
    .orderBy("store_rows")
)

WITH cleaned AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        *,
        CASE WHEN budget >= 3908000 THEN 'High' WHEN budget >= 675000 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END AS budget_level,
        CONCAT_WS('/', location, dept_name) AS location_dept_name_key,
        COALESCE(dept_name, 'DIRECT') AS dept_name_clean
    FROM departments
    WHERE location IS NOT NULL
),
with_windows AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        *,
        LEAD(budget, 1, 0) OVER (PARTITION BY dept_name ORDER BY budget, id) AS next_budget,
        LAG(budget, 1, 0) OVER (PARTITION BY location ORDER BY budget, id) AS prev_budget
    FROM cleaned
),
not_flagged AS (
    -- Anti-join via a correlated subquery
    SELECT s.*
    FROM with_windows s
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM employees c
            WHERE c.dept_id = s.id
              AND c.salary < 84000
        )
)
SELECT
    id,
    dept_name,
    budget,
    budget_level,
    location_dept_name_key,
    dept_name_clean,
    prev_budget
FROM not_flagged
ORDER BY budget NULLS FIRST, prev_budget DESC;

with lines as (
    select
        id,
        coupon_codes,
        line.product_id,
        line.price
    from carts
    lateral view outer explode(items) li as line
),
metrics as (
    select
        *,
        dense_rank() over w_grp as price_dense_rank,
        dense_rank() over (order by product_id desc nulls last) as product_id_dense_rank
    from lines
    window w_grp as (order by price nulls last)
),
base as (
    select
        id,
        coupon_codes,
        product_id,
        price,
        product_id_dense_rank,
        round(price_dense_rank / price, 2) as price_dense_rank_per_price,
        case when product_id_dense_rank >= 8 then 'High' when product_id_dense_rank >= 3 then 'Medium' else 'Low' end as product_id_dense_rank_band
    from metrics
    where array_contains(coupon_codes, 'SPRING10')
),
filtered as (
    select
        id,
        coupon_codes,
        product_id,
        product_id_dense_rank,
        price_dense_rank_per_price,
        price_dense_rank_per_price * price as price_dense_rank_per_price_times_price
    from base
    where price <= 200
)
select
    id,
    product_id,
    product_id_dense_rank
from filtered
order by product_id_dense_rank desc nulls last

    base

        "price_dense_rank_per_price",

    )
)

    filtered
    .select("id", "product_id", "product_id_dense_rank")
    .orderBy(F.col("product_id_dense_rank").desc_nulls_last())

WITH filtered AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        QUARTER(paid_at) AS paid_at_quarter,
        CAST(paid_at AS DATE) AS paid_at_day,
        COALESCE(method, 'OTHER') AS method_filled
    FROM payments
    WHERE order_id IS NOT NULL
),
scored AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        order_id,
        method,
        amount,
        paid_at,
        status,
        paid_at_quarter,
        paid_at_day,
        method_filled,
        COUNT(paid_at_quarter) OVER (PARTITION BY method) AS method_count_paid_at_quarter,
        FIRST_VALUE(paid_at_quarter) IGNORE NULLS OVER (PARTITION BY order_id ORDER BY paid_at_day, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS first_known_paid_at_quarter,
        SUM(paid_at_quarter) OVER (PARTITION BY method ORDER BY CAST(paid_at AS BIGINT) RANGE BETWEEN 604800 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS paid_at_quarter_sum_7d,
        AVG(paid_at_quarter) OVER (ORDER BY paid_at, id ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS paid_at_quarter_avg_3
    FROM filtered
),
joined AS (
    SELECT
        src.*,
        o.order_date,
        o.status AS order_status
    FROM scored src
    INNER JOIN orders o
        ON src.order_id = o.id
)
SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('WEEK', order_date) AS week_start,
    CASE WHEN first_known_paid_at_quarter >= 80 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END AS first_known_paid_at_quarter_tier,
    SUM(CASE WHEN order_status = 'RETURNED' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS returned_amount,
    AVG(method_count_paid_at_quarter) AS avg_method_count_paid_at_quarter,
    ROUND(AVG(paid_at_quarter_sum_7d), 2) AS avg_paid_at_quarter_sum_7d
FROM joined
GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((DATE_TRUNC('WEEK', order_date), CASE WHEN first_known_paid_at_quarter >= 80 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END), (DATE_TRUNC('WEEK', order_date)))
ORDER BY avg_paid_at_quarter_sum_7d DESC NULLS LAST
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("method")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("order_id").orderBy("paid_at_day", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w3 = Window.partitionBy("method").orderBy(F.col("paid_at").cast("bigint")).rangeBetween(-604800, Window.currentRow)
w4 = Window.orderBy("paid_at", "id").rowsBetween(-3, Window.currentRow)

filtered = (
    df_payments
    .filter(F.col("order_id").isNotNull())
    .select(
        "*",
        F.quarter("paid_at").alias("paid_at_quarter"),
        F.col("paid_at").cast("date").alias("paid_at_day"),
        F.coalesce("method", F.lit("OTHER")).alias("method_filled"),
    )
)

scored = (
    filtered
    .select(
        "*",
        F.count("paid_at_quarter").over(w).alias("method_count_paid_at_quarter"),
        F.first("paid_at_quarter", ignorenulls=True).over(w2).alias("first_known_paid_at_quarter"),
        F.sum("paid_at_quarter").over(w3).alias("paid_at_quarter_sum_7d"),
        F.avg("paid_at_quarter").over(w4).alias("paid_at_quarter_avg_3"),
    )
)

joined = (
    scored
    .alias("src")
    .join(df_orders.alias("o"), F.col("src.order_id") == F.col("o.id"), "inner")
    .select("src.*", F.col("o.order_date"), F.col("o.status").alias("order_status"))
)

result = (
    joined
    .withColumn("week_start", F.date_trunc("WEEK", "order_date"))
    .withColumn("first_known_paid_at_quarter_tier", F.when(F.col("first_known_paid_at_quarter") >= 80, "LARGE").otherwise("SMALL"))
    .groupingSets(
        [["week_start", "first_known_paid_at_quarter_tier"], ["week_start"]],
        "week_start",
        "first_known_paid_at_quarter_tier",
    )
    .agg(
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("order_status") == "RETURNED", F.col("amount")).otherwise(0)).alias("returned_amount"),
        F.avg("method_count_paid_at_quarter").alias("avg_method_count_paid_at_quarter"),
        F.round(F.avg("paid_at_quarter_sum_7d"), 2).alias("avg_paid_at_quarter_sum_7d"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("avg_paid_at_quarter_sum_7d").desc_nulls_last())
)

WITH valid AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        id,
        store_name,
        city,
        region,
        opened_date,
        ROUND(sqft, 1) AS sqft_rounded,
        COALESCE(region, 'unassigned') AS region_filled
    FROM stores
    WHERE opened_date > TO_DATE('2023-04-19')
      AND region IS NOT NULL
      AND sqft BETWEEN 9700 AND 15409
),
with_windows AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        *,
        NTILE(3) OVER (ORDER BY sqft_rounded, id) AS sqft_rounded_bucket,
        LAG(sqft_rounded, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY city ORDER BY opened_date, id) AS prev_sqft_rounded,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY region ORDER BY sqft_rounded DESC) AS sqft_rounded_dense_rank,
        LEAD(sqft_rounded, 2) OVER (ORDER BY sqft_rounded, id) AS next_sqft_rounded
    FROM valid
),
with_last AS (
    -- Latest matching inventory per row (LATERAL ... LIMIT 1)
    SELECT
        s.*,
        x.quantity,
        x.inventory_last_restock
    FROM with_windows s
    JOIN LATERAL (
            SELECT c.quantity, c.last_restock AS inventory_last_restock
            FROM inventory c
            WHERE c.store_id = s.id
            ORDER BY c.last_restock DESC, c.id DESC
            LIMIT 1
        ) x ON TRUE
),
latest AS (
    -- Keep one row per key (latest first)
    SELECT *
    FROM with_last
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY city ORDER BY next_sqft_rounded DESC, id) = 1
)
SELECT
    id,
    store_name,
    city,
    region,
    opened_date,
    sqft_rounded,
    prev_sqft_rounded,
    quantity,
    inventory_last_restock,
    CASE WHEN city RLIKE '^(Berlin|Bangkok)$' THEN 'GROUP_B' ELSE 'EXTENDED' END AS city_zone
FROM latest
ORDER BY prev_sqft_rounded DESC NULLS FIRST
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.orderBy("sqft_rounded", "id")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("city").orderBy("opened_date", "id")
w3 = Window.partitionBy("region").orderBy(F.col("sqft_rounded").desc())
w4 = Window.partitionBy(F.col("s.id")).orderBy(F.col("c.last_restock").desc(), F.col("c.id").desc())
w5 = Window.partitionBy("city").orderBy(F.col("next_sqft_rounded").desc(), "id")

valid = (
    df_stores
    .filter((F.col("opened_date") > F.to_date(F.lit("2023-04-19"))) & F.col("region").isNotNull() & F.col("sqft").between(9700, 15409))
    .select(
        "id",
        "store_name",
        "city",
        "region",
        "opened_date",
        F.round("sqft", 1).alias("sqft_rounded"),
        F.coalesce("region", F.lit("unassigned")).alias("region_filled"),
    )
)

with_windows = (
    valid
    .withColumn("sqft_rounded_bucket", F.ntile(3).over(w))
    .withColumn("prev_sqft_rounded", F.lag("sqft_rounded", 1).over(w2))
    .withColumn("sqft_rounded_dense_rank", F.dense_rank().over(w3))
    .withColumn("next_sqft_rounded", F.lead("sqft_rounded", 2).over(w))
)

with_last = (
    with_windows
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_inventory.alias("c"), (F.col("c.store_id") == F.col("s.id")), "inner")
    .withColumn("rn", F.row_number().over(w4))
    .filter(F.col("rn") == 1)
    .select(
        "s.*",
        F.col("c.quantity"),
        F.col("c.last_restock").alias("inventory_last_restock"),
    )
)

latest = (
    with_last
    .withColumn("rn", F.row_number().over(w5))
    .filter(F.col("rn") == 1)
    .drop("rn")
)

result = (
    latest
    .select(
        "id",
        "store_name",
        "city",
        "region",
        "opened_date",
        "sqft_rounded",
        "prev_sqft_rounded",
        "quantity",
        "inventory_last_restock",
        F.when(F.col("city").rlike("^(Berlin|Bangkok)$"), "GROUP_B").otherwise("EXTENDED").alias("city_zone"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("prev_sqft_rounded").desc_nulls_first())
)

sql: WITH valid AS (SELECT *, CASE WHEN browser IN ('Safari', 'Firefox') THEN 'Core' ELSE 'Other' END AS browser_group, COALESCE(country, 'UNKNOWN') AS country_filled FROM sessions WHERE started_at >= DATE '2023-05-27'), with_gaps AS (SELECT *, CASE WHEN started_at - LAG(started_at) OVER (PARTITION BY browser ORDER BY started_at ASC, id ASC) > INTERVAL '30' DAY THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS session_start_flag FROM valid), sessionized AS (SELECT *, SUM(session_start_flag) OVER (PARTITION BY browser ORDER BY started_at ASC, id ASC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_no FROM with_gaps), deduped AS (SELECT *, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY started_at DESC NULLS LAST) AS latest_rank FROM sessionized QUALIFY latest_rank = 1) SELECT id, device, browser, started_at, country, country_filled, latest_rank, CASE WHEN device RLIKE '^(mobile|tablet)$' THEN 'OTHER_ZONE' WHEN device RLIKE '^(desktop)$' THEN 'GROUP_B' ELSE 'CORE' END AS device_zone FROM deduped;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("browser").orderBy("started_at", "id")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("browser").orderBy("started_at", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w3 = Window.partitionBy("customer_id").orderBy(F.col("started_at").desc_nulls_last())

valid = (
    df_sessions
    .filter(F.col("started_at") >= F.lit("2023-05-27").cast("date"))
    .select(

        F.when(F.col("browser").isin(["Safari", "Firefox"]), "Core").otherwise("Other").alias("browser_group"),
        F.coalesce("country", F.lit("UNKNOWN")).alias("country_filled"),
    )

    valid
    .withColumn("session_start_flag", F.when(F.col("started_at") - F.lag("started_at").over(w) > F.expr("INTERVAL 30 DAYS"), 1).otherwise(0))
)

sessionized = with_gaps.withColumn("session_no", F.sum("session_start_flag").over(w2))

deduped = (
    sessionized
    .withColumn("latest_rank", F.rank().over(w3))
    .filter(F.col("latest_rank") == 1)
)

result = (
    deduped
    .select(

        "device",
        "browser",
        "started_at",
        "country",
        "country_filled",
        "latest_rank",
        F.when(F.col("device").rlike("^(mobile|tablet)$"), "OTHER_ZONE").when(F.col("device").rlike("^(desktop)$"), "GROUP_B").otherwise("CORE").alias("device_zone"),

with base as (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    select
        id,
        customer_id,
        plan,
        start_date,
        end_date,
        status,
        case when status = 'EXPIRED' then 1 else 0 end as is_expired,
        length(status) as status_length
    from subscriptions
    where start_date >= to_date('2023-05-01')
      and customer_id is not null
      and start_date between '2025-01-01' and '2025-03-20'
),
ranked as (
    -- Keep one row per key (latest first)
    select *
    from base
    qualify rank() over (partition by status order by start_date desc) = 1
),
cleaned as (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    select
        *,
        lower(plan) as plan_lower,
        dayofweek(start_date) as start_date_dayofweek
    from ranked
    where end_date >= '2023-10-29'
),
with_windows as (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    select
        *,
        lag(status_length, 1) over (partition by status order by start_date, id) as prev_status_length,
        last_value(start_date_dayofweek) ignore nulls over (partition by plan order by start_date_dayofweek, id rows between unbounded preceding and current row) as last_known_start_date_dayofweek,
        dense_rank() over (partition by status order by is_expired desc nulls first) as is_expired_dense_rank
    from cleaned
),
deduped as (
    -- Keep one row per key (latest first)
    select *
    from with_windows
    qualify row_number() over (partition by plan order by is_expired nulls last, id) = 1
),
deduped_subscriptions as (
    -- Deduplicate with ROW_NUMBER
    select *, rank() over (partition by status order by last_known_start_date_dayofweek desc nulls last) as rn
    from deduped
    qualify rn = 1
)

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("status").orderBy(F.col("start_date").desc())
w2 = Window.partitionBy("status").orderBy("start_date", "id")
w3 = Window.partitionBy("plan").orderBy("start_date_dayofweek", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w4 = Window.partitionBy("status").orderBy(F.col("is_expired").desc_nulls_first())
w5 = Window.partitionBy("plan").orderBy(F.col("is_expired").asc_nulls_last(), "id")
w6 = Window.partitionBy("status").orderBy(F.col("last_known_start_date_dayofweek").desc_nulls_last())

base = (
    df_subscriptions
    .filter((F.col("start_date") >= F.to_date(F.lit("2023-05-01"))) & F.col("customer_id").isNotNull() & F.col("start_date").between("2025-01-01", "2025-03-20"))
    .select(
        "id",
        "customer_id",
        "plan",
        "start_date",
        "end_date",
        "status",
        F.when(F.col("status") == "EXPIRED", 1).otherwise(0).alias("is_expired"),
        F.length("status").alias("status_length"),
    )
)

ranked = (
    base
    .withColumn("dedup_rank", F.rank().over(w))
    .filter(F.col("dedup_rank") == 1)
    .drop("dedup_rank")
)

cleaned = (
    ranked
    .filter(F.col("end_date") >= "2023-10-29")
    .withColumn("plan_lower", F.lower("plan"))
    .withColumn("start_date_dayofweek", F.dayofweek("start_date"))
)

with_windows = (
    cleaned
    .withColumn("prev_status_length", F.lag("status_length", 1).over(w2))
    .withColumn("last_known_start_date_dayofweek", F.last("start_date_dayofweek", ignorenulls=True).over(w3))
    .withColumn("is_expired_dense_rank", F.dense_rank().over(w4))
)

deduped = (
    with_windows
    .withColumn("latest_rank", F.row_number().over(w5))
    .filter(F.col("latest_rank") == 1)
    .drop("latest_rank")
)

deduped_subscriptions = (
    deduped
    .withColumn("rn", F.rank().over(w6))
    .filter(F.col("rn") == 1)
)

result = (
    deduped_subscriptions
    .groupBy("plan")
    .pivot("status", ["ACTIVE", "EXPIRED", "CANCELLED"])
    .agg(F.max("is_expired").alias("amount"), F.count(F.lit(1)).alias("n"))
    .select(
        "plan",
        F.col("ACTIVE_amount").alias("active_amount"),
        F.col("ACTIVE_n").alias("active_n"),
        F.col("EXPIRED_amount").alias("expired_amount"),
        F.col("EXPIRED_n").alias("expired_n"),
        F.col("CANCELLED_amount").alias("cancelled_amount"),
        F.col("CANCELLED_n").alias("cancelled_n"),
    )
)

WITH metrics AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        order_id,
        product_id,
        quantity,
        unit_price,
        NTILE(4) OVER (PARTITION BY order_id ORDER BY quantity, id) AS quantity_bucket,
        LAST_VALUE(quantity, TRUE) OVER (ORDER BY quantity, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS last_known_quantity
    FROM order_items
),
enriched AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        order_id,
        product_id,
        quantity,
        unit_price,
        quantity_bucket,
        last_known_quantity,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY product_id, order_id ORDER BY quantity_bucket DESC NULLS LAST) AS quantity_bucket_dense_rank,
        LAST_VALUE(last_known_quantity) IGNORE NULLS OVER (ORDER BY quantity_bucket, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS last_known_last_known_quantity,
        SUM(quantity_bucket) OVER w_part AS running_quantity_bucket,
        SUM(quantity) OVER (PARTITION BY order_id, product_id) AS order_id_sum_quantity,
        CORR(quantity, unit_price) OVER w_running AS corr_quantity_unit_price
    FROM metrics
    WINDOW w_part AS (ORDER BY quantity, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), w_running AS (PARTITION BY order_id)
),
enriched_order_items AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        MAX(last_known_quantity) OVER (PARTITION BY order_id) AS order_id_max_last_known_quantity,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY quantity DESC, id) AS seq_no,
        MIN(order_id_sum_quantity) OVER (PARTITION BY order_id) AS order_id_min_order_id_sum_quantity,
        NTILE(4) OVER (PARTITION BY order_id ORDER BY order_id_sum_quantity, id) AS order_id_sum_quantity_bucket,
        COUNT(quantity_bucket_dense_rank) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id, order_id) AS product_id_count_quantity_bucket_dense_rank
    FROM enriched
),
filtered AS (
    SELECT *, CAST(order_id_sum_quantity AS STRING) AS order_id_sum_quantity_num
    FROM enriched_order_items
    WHERE product_id IS NOT NULL
),
grouped AS (
    SELECT
        product_id,
        CASE WHEN product_id_count_quantity_bucket_dense_rank >= 13 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END AS product_id_count_quantity_bucket_dense_rank_tier,
        CASE WHEN quantity_bucket_dense_rank >= 9 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END AS quantity_bucket_dense_rank_tier,
        PERCENTILE_APPROX(last_known_last_known_quantity, ARRAY(0.25, 0.5, 0.75)) AS last_known_last_known_quantity_quartiles,
        BIT_AND(quantity) AS quantity_bit_and,
        GROUPING_ID() AS gid
    FROM filtered
    GROUP BY CUBE (product_id, CASE WHEN product_id_count_quantity_bucket_dense_rank >= 13 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END, CASE WHEN quantity_bucket_dense_rank >= 9 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END)
    HAVING quantity_bit_and > 1
)
SELECT
    product_id,
    product_id_count_quantity_bucket_dense_rank_tier,
    quantity_bucket_dense_rank_tier,
    last_known_last_known_quantity_quartiles,
    quantity_bit_and,
    gid
FROM grouped
ORDER BY quantity_bit_and, gid
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("order_id").orderBy("quantity", "id")
w2 = Window.orderBy("quantity", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w3 = Window.partitionBy("product_id", "order_id").orderBy(F.col("quantity_bucket").desc_nulls_last())
w4 = Window.orderBy("quantity_bucket", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w5 = Window.partitionBy("order_id", "product_id")
w_running = Window.partitionBy("order_id")
w7 = Window.partitionBy("product_id").orderBy(F.col("quantity").desc(), "id")
w8 = Window.partitionBy("order_id").orderBy("order_id_sum_quantity", "id")
w9 = Window.partitionBy("product_id", "order_id")

metrics = (
    df_order_items
    .select(
        "*",
        F.ntile(4).over(w).alias("quantity_bucket"),
        F.last("quantity", ignorenulls=True).over(w2).alias("last_known_quantity"),
    )
)

enriched = (
    metrics
    .withColumn("quantity_bucket_dense_rank", F.dense_rank().over(w3))
    .withColumn("last_known_last_known_quantity", F.last("last_known_quantity", ignorenulls=True).over(w4))
    .withColumn("running_quantity_bucket", F.sum("quantity_bucket").over(w2))
    .withColumn("order_id_sum_quantity", F.sum("quantity").over(w5))
    .withColumn("corr_quantity_unit_price", F.corr("quantity", "unit_price").over(w_running))
)

enriched_order_items = (
    enriched
    .select(
        "*",
        F.max("last_known_quantity").over(w_running).alias("order_id_max_last_known_quantity"),
        F.row_number().over(w7).alias("seq_no"),
        F.min("order_id_sum_quantity").over(w_running).alias("order_id_min_order_id_sum_quantity"),
        F.ntile(4).over(w8).alias("order_id_sum_quantity_bucket"),
        F.count("quantity_bucket_dense_rank").over(w9).alias("product_id_count_quantity_bucket_dense_rank"),
    )
)

filtered = (
    enriched_order_items
    .filter(F.col("product_id").isNotNull())
    .withColumn("order_id_sum_quantity_num", F.col("order_id_sum_quantity").cast("string"))
)

grouped = (
    filtered
    .withColumn("product_id_count_quantity_bucket_dense_rank_tier", F.when(F.col("product_id_count_quantity_bucket_dense_rank") >= 13, "PREMIUM").otherwise("STANDARD"))
    .withColumn("quantity_bucket_dense_rank_tier", F.when(F.col("quantity_bucket_dense_rank") >= 9, "HIGH").otherwise("LOW"))
    .cube(
        "product_id",
        "product_id_count_quantity_bucket_dense_rank_tier",
        "quantity_bucket_dense_rank_tier",
    )
    .agg(
        F.percentile_approx("last_known_last_known_quantity", [0.25, 0.5, 0.75]).alias("last_known_last_known_quantity_quartiles"),
        F.bit_and("quantity").alias("quantity_bit_and"),
        F.grouping_id().alias("gid"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("quantity_bit_and") > 1)
)

result = (
    grouped
    .select(
        "product_id",
        "product_id_count_quantity_bucket_dense_rank_tier",
        "quantity_bucket_dense_rank_tier",
        "last_known_last_known_quantity_quartiles",
        "quantity_bit_and",
        "gid",
    )
    .orderBy("quantity_bit_and", "gid")
)

WITH cleaned AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT
        *,
        TRIM(location) AS clean_location,
        COALESCE(location, 'NONE') AS location_clean
    FROM departments
    WHERE location IS NOT NULL
),
eligible AS (
    -- Anti-join via a correlated subquery
    SELECT s.*
    FROM cleaned s
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM employees ch
            WHERE ch.dept_id = s.id
              AND ch.manager_id IN (20, 31)
        )
),
metrics AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        *,
        LAG(budget, 2) OVER w_ordered AS prev_budget,
        LAST_VALUE(budget) IGNORE NULLS OVER (PARTITION BY dept_name ORDER BY budget, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS last_known_budget,
        LAST_VALUE(budget) IGNORE NULLS OVER w_grp AS last_known_budget_2
    FROM eligible
    WINDOW w_ordered AS (PARTITION BY location ORDER BY budget, id), w_grp AS (PARTITION BY location ORDER BY budget, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)
)
-- Native SQL PIVOT
SELECT *
FROM (
    SELECT
        location,
        dept_name,
        last_known_budget
    FROM metrics
) src
PIVOT (
    AVG(last_known_budget) AS value_sum,
    COUNT(1) AS n
    FOR dept_name IN ('Engineering', 'Marketing')
);
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w_ordered = Window.partitionBy("location").orderBy("budget", "id")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("dept_name").orderBy("budget", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w_grp = Window.partitionBy("location").orderBy("budget", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)

cleaned = (
    df_departments
    .filter(F.col("location").isNotNull())
    .select(
        "*",
        F.trim("location").alias("clean_location"),
        F.coalesce("location", F.lit("NONE")).alias("location_clean"),
    )
)

eligible = (
    cleaned
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_employees.alias("ch"), (F.col("ch.dept_id") == F.col("s.id")) & (F.col("ch.manager_id").isin([20, 31])), "left_anti")
)

metrics = (
    eligible
    .withColumn("prev_budget", F.lag("budget", 2).over(w_ordered))
    .withColumn("last_known_budget", F.last("budget", ignorenulls=True).over(w2))
    .withColumn("last_known_budget_2", F.last("budget", ignorenulls=True).over(w_grp))
)

result = (
    metrics
    .groupBy("location")
    .pivot("dept_name", ["Engineering", "Marketing"])
    .agg(F.avg("last_known_budget").alias("value_sum"), F.count(F.lit(1)).alias("n"))
)

    FROM ranked
),

        FROM enriched

    WHERE rank_in_group = 1

w3 = Window.orderBy("unit_price", "id").rowsBetween(-5, Window.currentRow)

        delivered_date,
        cost,
        SUBSTRING(status, 1, 2) AS status_prefix,
        COALESCE(carrier, 'OTHER') AS carrier_filled

base AS (

      AND carrier IS NOT NULL

metrics AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        carrier,
        delivered_date,
        cost,
        status_prefix,
        carrier_filled,
        cost_scaled,
        cost_rounded,
        carrier_clean,
        AVG(cost) OVER (PARTITION BY carrier ORDER BY cost_rounded ASC, id ASC ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cost_avg_2,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY carrier ORDER BY cost_rounded ASC NULLS FIRST) AS cost_rounded_rank,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY carrier ORDER BY delivered_date ASC, id ASC) AS row_seq,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY carrier ORDER BY cost ASC, id ASC) AS seq_no,
        FIRST_VALUE(cost_rounded) IGNORE NULLS OVER (PARTITION BY carrier ORDER BY cost_rounded ASC, id ASC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS first_known_cost_rounded
    FROM base
),
deduped AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM metrics
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY carrier ORDER BY cost_avg_2 DESC, id ASC) = 1
)
SELECT
    id,
    delivered_date,
    cost,
    status_prefix,
    cost_scaled,
    cost_rounded,
    carrier_clean,
    cost_avg_2
FROM deduped
ORDER BY cost DESC NULLS LAST;

w5 = Window.partitionBy("carrier").orderBy("cost_rounded", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)

WITH filtered AS (

    WHERE store_id = 1

    FROM deduped
    GROUP BY CASE WHEN quantity >= 194 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END, DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', last_restock), DATE_TRUNC('QUARTER', last_restock)

WITH filtered AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN unit_price >= 360 THEN 'High' WHEN unit_price >= 140 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END AS unit_price_band
    FROM order_items
    WHERE quantity <= 6
),
enriched AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        id,
        order_id,
        product_id,
        quantity,
        unit_price,
        unit_price_band,
        SUM(quantity) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY quantity, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_quantity,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER w_recent AS unit_price_dense_rank
    FROM filtered
    WINDOW w_recent AS (PARTITION BY order_id ORDER BY unit_price DESC)
),
cleaned AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT *, CAST(unit_price AS INT) AS unit_price_int
    FROM enriched
    WHERE unit_price_dense_rank <= 7
),
filtered_order_items AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT
        *,
        CASE WHEN unit_price_dense_rank >= 8 THEN 'High' WHEN unit_price_dense_rank >= 3 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END AS unit_price_dense_rank_tier,
        unit_price_int * quantity AS unit_price_int_times_quantity
    FROM cleaned
    WHERE product_id IS NOT NULL
)
-- Grouped metrics
SELECT
    product_id,
    ROUND(AVG(unit_price_int_times_quantity), 2) AS avg_unit_price_int_times_quantity,
    SUM(unit_price_int_times_quantity) AS total_unit_price_int_times_quantity,
    ROUND(AVG(unit_price_dense_rank), 2) AS avg_unit_price_dense_rank,
    SUM(unit_price_int_times_quantity) AS total_unit_price_int_times_quantity_2
FROM filtered_order_items
GROUP BY product_id
ORDER BY total_unit_price_int_times_quantity_2 DESC;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("product_id").orderBy("quantity", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w_recent = Window.partitionBy("order_id").orderBy(F.col("unit_price").desc())

filtered = (
    df_order_items
    .filter(F.col("quantity") <= 6)
    .select(
        "*",
        F.when(F.col("unit_price") >= 360, "High").when(F.col("unit_price") >= 140, "Medium").otherwise("Low").alias("unit_price_band"),
    )
)

enriched = (
    filtered
    .withColumn("cumulative_quantity", F.sum("quantity").over(w))
    .withColumn("unit_price_dense_rank", F.dense_rank().over(w_recent))
)

cleaned = (
    enriched
    .filter(F.col("unit_price_dense_rank") <= 7)
    .withColumn("unit_price_int", F.col("unit_price").cast("int"))
)

filtered_order_items = (
    cleaned
    .filter(F.col("product_id").isNotNull())
    .withColumn("unit_price_dense_rank_tier", F.when(F.col("unit_price_dense_rank") >= 8, "High").when(F.col("unit_price_dense_rank") >= 3, "Medium").otherwise("Low"))
    .withColumn("unit_price_int_times_quantity", (F.col("unit_price_int") * F.col("quantity")))
)

result = (
    filtered_order_items
    .groupBy("product_id")
    .agg(
        F.round(F.avg("unit_price_int_times_quantity"), 2).alias("avg_unit_price_int_times_quantity"),
        F.sum("unit_price_int_times_quantity").alias("total_unit_price_int_times_quantity"),
        F.round(F.avg("unit_price_dense_rank"), 2).alias("avg_unit_price_dense_rank"),
        F.sum("unit_price_int_times_quantity").alias("total_unit_price_int_times_quantity_2"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("total_unit_price_int_times_quantity_2").desc())
)

sql: WITH filtered AS (SELECT id, order_id, method, amount, paid_at, status, ROUND(amount, 2) AS amount_rounded FROM payments WHERE paid_at > TIMESTAMP '2024-03-04 14:00:00'), flagged AS (SELECT *, CASE WHEN LAG(paid_at) OVER (PARTITION BY status ORDER BY paid_at ASC, id ASC) IS NULL OR paid_at > LAG(paid_at) OVER (PARTITION BY status ORDER BY paid_at ASC, id ASC) + INTERVAL 7 DAYS THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS session_start_flag FROM filtered), islands AS (SELECT *, SUM(session_start_flag) OVER (PARTITION BY status ORDER BY paid_at ASC, id ASC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS burst_id FROM flagged) SELECT status, MIN(paid_at) AS first_paid_at, APPROX_PERCENTILE(burst_id, ARRAY(0.25, 0.5, 0.75)) AS burst_id_quartiles, SUM(amount) AS total_amount FROM islands GROUP BY CUBE (status) ORDER BY total_amount ASC NULLS LAST;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("status").orderBy("paid_at", "id")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("status").orderBy("paid_at", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)

filtered = (
    df_payments
    .filter(F.col("paid_at") > F.lit("2024-03-04 14:00:00").cast("timestamp"))
    .select(
        "id",
        "order_id",
        "method",
        "amount",
        "paid_at",
        "status",
        F.round("amount", 2).alias("amount_rounded"),
    )
)

flagged = (
    filtered
    .withColumn("session_start_flag", F.when(F.lag("paid_at").over(w).isNull() | (F.col("paid_at") > F.lag("paid_at").over(w) + F.expr("INTERVAL 7 DAYS")), 1).otherwise(0))
)

islands = flagged.withColumn("burst_id", F.sum("session_start_flag").over(w2))

    .cube("status")

WITH flattened AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        plan,
        effective_from,
        currency,
        EXPLODE(tier_prices) AS tier_value
    FROM price_tiers
),
filtered AS (
    SELECT *, ADD_MONTHS(effective_from, 6) AS effective_from_plus_months
    FROM flattened
    WHERE plan = 'starter'
),
filtered_price_tiers AS (
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN currency IN ('USD', 'EUR') THEN 'Group A' ELSE 'Other' END AS currency_group
    FROM filtered
    WHERE effective_from > TO_DATE('2024-06-09')
)
SELECT
    CASE WHEN tier_value >= 61 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END AS tier_value_tier,
    DATE_TRUNC('WEEK', effective_from_plus_months) AS week_start,
    COUNT_IF(plan = 'starter') AS starter_events,
    SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_SET(plan)) AS plan_list,
    COUNT(*) AS cnt,
    ROUND(AVG(tier_value), 2) AS avg_tier_value,
    COUNT(DISTINCT plan) AS distinct_plans,
    COUNT(*) AS event_count
FROM filtered_price_tiers
GROUP BY ROLLUP (CASE WHEN tier_value >= 61 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END, DATE_TRUNC('WEEK', effective_from_plus_months))
ORDER BY distinct_plans DESC NULLS LAST
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

flattened = (
    df_price_tiers
    .select(
        "id",
        "plan",
        "effective_from",
        "currency",
        F.explode("tier_prices").alias("tier_value"),
    )
)

filtered = (
    flattened
    .filter(F.col("plan") == "starter")
    .select("*", F.add_months("effective_from", 6).alias("effective_from_plus_months"))
)

filtered_price_tiers = (
    filtered
    .filter(F.col("effective_from") > F.to_date(F.lit("2024-06-09")))
    .select(
        "*",
        F.when(F.col("currency").isin(["USD", "EUR"]), "Group A").otherwise("Other").alias("currency_group"),
    )
)

result = (
    filtered_price_tiers
    .rollup(
        F.when(F.col("tier_value") >= 61, "HIGH").otherwise("LOW").alias("tier_value_tier"),
        F.date_trunc("WEEK", "effective_from_plus_months").alias("week_start"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.count_if(F.col("plan") == "starter").alias("starter_events"),
        F.sort_array(F.collect_set("plan")).alias("plan_list"),
        F.count("*").alias("cnt"),
        F.round(F.avg("tier_value"), 2).alias("avg_tier_value"),
        F.countDistinct("plan").alias("distinct_plans"),
        F.count("*").alias("event_count"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("distinct_plans").desc_nulls_last())
)

sql:
WITH with_windows AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        *,
        LEAD(quantity, 1, 0) OVER (ORDER BY last_restock, id) AS next_quantity,
        MAX(quantity) OVER (PARTITION BY store_id) AS store_id_max_quantity
    FROM inventory
),
base AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        id,
        store_id,
        product_id,
        quantity,
        last_restock,
        next_quantity,
        store_id_max_quantity,
        DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', last_restock) AS last_restock_period
    FROM with_windows
    WHERE last_restock <= '2025-08-24'
),
remaining_keys AS (
    -- Set difference on keys
    SELECT product_id, store_id
    FROM base
    EXCEPT
    SELECT product_id, store_id
    FROM inventory
    WHERE quantity > 149
),
kept_rows AS (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    SELECT s.*
    FROM base s
    JOIN remaining_keys k ON s.product_id = k.product_id AND s.store_id = k.store_id
),
cleaned AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT *, store_id_max_quantity * quantity AS store_id_max_quantity_times_quantity
    FROM kept_rows
    WHERE quantity <= 162
)
SELECT
    s.id,
    s.product_id,
    s.last_restock,
    s.next_quantity,
    s.store_id_max_quantity,
    s.last_restock_period,
    (SELECT MIN(t2.quantity) FROM inventory t2 WHERE t2.product_id = s.product_id) AS min_inventory_quantity
FROM cleaned s
ORDER BY min_inventory_quantity NULLS FIRST
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.orderBy("last_restock", "id")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("store_id")
quantity_by_product_id = df_inventory.groupBy("product_id").agg(F.min("quantity").alias("min_inventory_quantity"))

with_windows = (
    df_inventory
    .withColumn("next_quantity", F.lead("quantity", 1, 0).over(w))
    .withColumn("store_id_max_quantity", F.max("quantity").over(w2))
)

base = (
    with_windows
    .filter(F.col("last_restock") <= "2025-08-24")
    .select(
        "id",
        "store_id",
        "product_id",
        "quantity",
        "last_restock",
        "next_quantity",
        "store_id_max_quantity",
        F.date_trunc("YEAR", "last_restock").alias("last_restock_period"),
    )
)

remaining_keys = (
    base
    .select("product_id", "store_id")
    .subtract(
        df_inventory
        .filter(F.col("quantity") > 149)
        .select("product_id", "store_id")
    )
)

kept_rows = (
    base
    .alias("s")
    .join(remaining_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.product_id") == F.col("k.product_id")) & (F.col("s.store_id") == F.col("k.store_id")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

cleaned = (
    kept_rows
    .filter(F.col("quantity") <= 162)
    .withColumn("store_id_max_quantity_times_quantity", (F.col("store_id_max_quantity") * F.col("quantity")))
)

result = (
    cleaned
    .join(quantity_by_product_id, on="product_id", how="left")
    .select(
        "id",
        "product_id",
        "last_restock",
        "next_quantity",
        "store_id_max_quantity",
        "last_restock_period",
        F.col("min_inventory_quantity"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("min_inventory_quantity").asc_nulls_first())
)

WITH valid AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        id,
        store_id,
        product_id,
        quantity,
        last_restock,
        COALESCE(quantity, 0) AS quantity_filled
    FROM inventory
    WHERE last_restock >= DATE '2024-04-16'
      AND last_restock BETWEEN '2023-07-01' AND '2023-11-01'
),
enriched AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        id,
        store_id,
        product_id,
        quantity,
        last_restock,
        quantity_filled,
        LAST_VALUE(quantity, TRUE) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY quantity_filled, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS last_known_quantity,
        NTILE(10) OVER (ORDER BY quantity_filled, id) AS quantity_filled_bucket
    FROM valid
),
with_dims AS (
    -- Attach stores attributes
    SELECT s.*, b.store_name
    FROM enriched s
    LEFT JOIN stores b
        ON s.store_id = b.id
),
remaining_keys AS (
    -- Set difference on keys
    SELECT store_id, id
    FROM with_dims
    EXCEPT ALL
    SELECT store_id, id
    FROM inventory
    WHERE store_id IN (1, 4)
),
kept_rows AS (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    SELECT s.*
    FROM with_dims s
    JOIN remaining_keys k ON s.store_id = k.store_id AND s.id = k.id
),
joined AS (
    -- Attach stores attributes
    SELECT
        a.*,
        b.sqft,
        b.opened_date,
        b.city
    FROM kept_rows a
    LEFT JOIN stores b
        ON a.store_id = b.id
)
-- Grouped metrics
SELECT
    CASE WHEN quantity_filled >= 78 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END AS quantity_filled_tier,
    CASE WHEN quantity_filled_bucket >= 6 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END AS quantity_filled_bucket_tier,
    ROUND(SUM(quantity) / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN city = 'Singapore' THEN 1 END), 0), 2) AS quantity_per_singapore,
    SIZE(COLLECT_SET(city)) AS num_cities,
    SUM(CASE WHEN city = 'Tokyo' THEN quantity_filled ELSE 0 END) AS tokyo_quantity_filled
FROM joined
GROUP BY 1, 2

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("product_id").orderBy("quantity_filled", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w2 = Window.orderBy("quantity_filled", "id")

valid = (
    df_inventory
    .filter((F.col("last_restock") >= F.lit("2024-04-16").cast("date")) & F.col("last_restock").between("2023-07-01", "2023-11-01"))
    .select(
        "id",
        "store_id",
        "product_id",
        "quantity",
        "last_restock",
        F.coalesce("quantity", F.lit(0)).alias("quantity_filled"),
    )
)

enriched = (
    valid
    .withColumn("last_known_quantity", F.last("quantity", ignorenulls=True).over(w))
    .withColumn("quantity_filled_bucket", F.ntile(10).over(w2))
)

with_dims = (
    enriched
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_stores.alias("b"), F.col("s.store_id") == F.col("b.id"), "left")
    .select("s.*", F.col("b.store_name"))
)

remaining_keys = (
    with_dims
    .select("store_id", "id")
    .exceptAll(
        df_inventory
        .filter(F.col("store_id").isin([1, 4]))
        .select("store_id", "id")
    )
)

kept_rows = (
    with_dims
    .alias("s")
    .join(remaining_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.store_id") == F.col("k.store_id")) & (F.col("s.id") == F.col("k.id")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

joined = (
    kept_rows
    .alias("a")
    .join(df_stores.alias("b"), F.col("a.store_id") == F.col("b.id"), "left")
    .select("a.*", F.col("b.sqft"), F.col("b.opened_date"), F.col("b.city"))
)

result = (
    joined
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("quantity_filled") >= 78, "LARGE").otherwise("SMALL").alias("quantity_filled_tier"),
        F.when(F.col("quantity_filled_bucket") >= 6, "LARGE").otherwise("SMALL").alias("quantity_filled_bucket_tier"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.round(F.sum("quantity") / F.nullif(F.count(F.when(F.col("city") == "Singapore", 1)), F.lit(0)), 2).alias("quantity_per_singapore"),
        F.size(F.collect_set("city")).alias("num_cities"),
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("city") == "Tokyo", F.col("quantity_filled")).otherwise(0)).alias("tokyo_quantity_filled"),
    )
)

WITH base AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        order_id,
        amount,
        paid_at,
        UPPER(status) AS status_upper,
        MONTH(paid_at) AS paid_at_month,
        COALESCE(method, 'OTHER') AS method_filled
    FROM payments
    WHERE paid_at > TO_DATE('2023-06-03')
),
scored AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER w_grp AS seq_no,
        LEAD(paid_at_month, 1, 0) OVER (PARTITION BY order_id ORDER BY amount ASC, id ASC) AS next_paid_at_month,
        STDDEV_SAMP(paid_at_month) OVER w_part AS order_id_stddev_samp_paid_at_month
    FROM base
    WINDOW w_grp AS (PARTITION BY order_id ORDER BY paid_at DESC, id ASC), w_part AS (PARTITION BY order_id)
),
flagged AS (
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN LAG(paid_at) OVER (PARTITION BY order_id ORDER BY paid_at ASC, id ASC) IS NULL
                 OR paid_at > LAG(paid_at) OVER (PARTITION BY order_id ORDER BY paid_at ASC, id ASC) + INTERVAL 14 DAYS THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS new_group_flag
    FROM scored
),
sessionized AS (
    SELECT *, SUM(new_group_flag) OVER (PARTITION BY order_id ORDER BY paid_at ASC, id ASC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS burst_id
    FROM flagged
),
stats AS (
    SELECT
        CASE WHEN seq_no >= 9 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END AS seq_no_tier,
        DATE_TRUNC('QUARTER', paid_at) AS quarter_start,
        PERCENTILE_APPROX(next_paid_at_month, ARRAY(0.25, 0.5, 0.75)) AS next_paid_at_month_quartiles,
        ROUND(AVG(seq_no), 2) AS avg_seq_no,
        ROUND(AVG(next_paid_at_month), 2) AS avg_next_paid_at_month,
        PERCENTILE_APPROX(order_id_stddev_samp_paid_at_month, 0.5) AS order_id_stddev_samp_paid_at_month_p50,
        (UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MAX(paid_at)) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MIN(paid_at))) / 60 AS span_minutes
    FROM sessionized
    GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT
    seq_no_tier,
    quarter_start,
    avg_seq_no,
    avg_next_paid_at_month,
    order_id_stddev_samp_paid_at_month_p50,
    span_minutes
FROM stats;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w_grp = Window.partitionBy("order_id").orderBy(F.col("paid_at").desc(), "id")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("order_id").orderBy("amount", "id")
w_part = Window.partitionBy("order_id")
w4 = Window.partitionBy("order_id").orderBy("paid_at", "id")
w5 = Window.partitionBy("order_id").orderBy("paid_at", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)

base = (
    df_payments
    .filter(F.col("paid_at") > F.to_date(F.lit("2023-06-03")))
    .select(
        "id",
        "order_id",
        "amount",
        "paid_at",
        F.upper("status").alias("status_upper"),
        F.month("paid_at").alias("paid_at_month"),
        F.coalesce("method", F.lit("OTHER")).alias("method_filled"),
    )
)

scored = (
    base
    .withColumn("seq_no", F.row_number().over(w_grp))
    .withColumn("next_paid_at_month", F.lead("paid_at_month", 1, 0).over(w2))
    .withColumn("order_id_stddev_samp_paid_at_month", F.stddev_samp("paid_at_month").over(w_part))
)

flagged = (
    scored
    .withColumn("new_group_flag", F.when(F.lag("paid_at").over(w4).isNull() | (F.col("paid_at") > F.lag("paid_at").over(w4) + F.expr("INTERVAL 14 DAYS")), 1).otherwise(0))
)

sessionized = flagged.withColumn("burst_id", F.sum("new_group_flag").over(w5))

stats = (
    sessionized
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("seq_no") >= 9, "LARGE").otherwise("SMALL").alias("seq_no_tier"),
        F.date_trunc("QUARTER", "paid_at").alias("quarter_start"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.percentile_approx("next_paid_at_month", [0.25, 0.5, 0.75]).alias("next_paid_at_month_quartiles"),
        F.round(F.avg("seq_no"), 2).alias("avg_seq_no"),
        F.round(F.avg("next_paid_at_month"), 2).alias("avg_next_paid_at_month"),
        F.percentile_approx("order_id_stddev_samp_paid_at_month", 0.5).alias("order_id_stddev_samp_paid_at_month_p50"),
        ((F.unix_timestamp(F.max("paid_at")) - F.unix_timestamp(F.min("paid_at"))) / 60).alias("span_minutes"),
    )
)

result = (
    stats
    .select(
        "seq_no_tier",
        "quarter_start",
        "avg_seq_no",
        "avg_next_paid_at_month",
        "order_id_stddev_samp_paid_at_month_p50",
        "span_minutes",
    )
)

WITH filtered AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT
        id,
        account_id,
        txn_type,
        amount,
        txn_time,
        is_flagged,
        ROUND(amount, 2) amount_rounded,
        DATE_FORMAT(txn_time, 'MMM yyyy') txn_time_label
    FROM transactions
    WHERE merchant IS NOT NULL
      AND is_flagged
),
with_windows AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        id,
        account_id,
        txn_type,
        amount,
        txn_time,
        is_flagged,
        amount_rounded,
        txn_time_label,
        AVG(amount) OVER (PARTITION BY txn_type ORDER BY CAST(txn_time AS BIGINT) RANGE BETWEEN 604800 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) amount_avg_7d,
        LAST_VALUE(amount_rounded) IGNORE NULLS OVER (PARTITION BY txn_type ORDER BY amount_rounded, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) last_known_amount_rounded
    FROM filtered
),
joined AS (
    -- Attach accounts attributes
    SELECT
        e.*,
        p.account_type,
        p.status,
        p.balance
    FROM with_windows e
    LEFT JOIN accounts p
        ON e.account_id = p.id
),
filtered_transactions AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT
        *,
        LEAST(amount_avg_7d, amount_rounded) least_amount_avg_7d_amount_rounded,
        ROUND(balance * 0.85, 2) adjusted_balance
    FROM joined
    WHERE txn_time > DATE '2024-01-13'
      AND amount_avg_7d < 1379
),
scored AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        *,
        AVG(balance) OVER (PARTITION BY account_type ORDER BY amount_avg_7d, id ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) balance_avg_6,
        LEAD(amount_avg_7d, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY txn_type ORDER BY last_known_amount_rounded, id) next_amount_avg_7d,
        SUM(amount_rounded) OVER w_running running_amount_rounded,
        SUM(amount_avg_7d) OVER (PARTITION BY txn_type, account_type) txn_type_sum_amount_avg_7d,
        NTILE(4) OVER w_grp adjusted_balance_bucket
    FROM filtered_transactions
    WINDOW w_running AS (PARTITION BY status ORDER BY amount_rounded, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), w_grp AS (PARTITION BY account_id, status ORDER BY adjusted_balance, id)
),
enriched AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        *,
        NTILE(4) OVER (PARTITION BY account_id ORDER BY balance_avg_6 DESC, id) balance_avg_6_bucket,
        PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY account_id ORDER BY amount_avg_7d DESC NULLS LAST) amount_avg_7d_percent_rank
    FROM scored
),
gaps AS (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > interval)
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN LAG(txn_time) OVER (PARTITION BY account_id ORDER BY txn_time, id) IS NULL
                 OR txn_time > LAG(txn_time) OVER (PARTITION BY account_id ORDER BY txn_time, id) + INTERVAL '30' DAY THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_new_session
    FROM enriched
),
sessions_transactions AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(is_new_session) OVER (PARTITION BY account_id ORDER BY txn_time, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS island_id
    FROM gaps
),
pivoted AS (
    -- Native SQL PIVOT
    SELECT *
    FROM (
        SELECT
            account_type,
            txn_type,
            balance
        FROM sessions_transactions
    ) src
    PIVOT (
        SUM(balance) AS amount,
        COUNT(1) AS cnt
        FOR txn_type IN ('FEE', 'CREDIT')
    )
)
SELECT
    account_type,
    FEE_amount,
    CREDIT_amount,
    CREDIT_cnt,
    CASE WHEN account_type RLIKE '^(SAVINGS|CREDIT)$' THEN 'EXTENDED' ELSE 'CORE' END AS account_type_zone
FROM pivoted

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("txn_type").orderBy(F.col("txn_time").cast("bigint")).rangeBetween(-604800, Window.currentRow)
w2 = Window.partitionBy("txn_type").orderBy("amount_rounded", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w3 = Window.partitionBy("account_type").orderBy("amount_avg_7d", "id").rowsBetween(-6, Window.currentRow)
w4 = Window.partitionBy("txn_type").orderBy("last_known_amount_rounded", "id")
w_running = Window.partitionBy("status").orderBy("amount_rounded", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w6 = Window.partitionBy("txn_type", "account_type")
w_grp = Window.partitionBy("account_id", "status").orderBy("adjusted_balance", "id")
w8 = Window.partitionBy("account_id").orderBy(F.col("balance_avg_6").desc(), "id")
w9 = Window.partitionBy("account_id").orderBy(F.col("amount_avg_7d").desc_nulls_last())
w10 = Window.partitionBy("account_id").orderBy("txn_time", "id")
w11 = Window.partitionBy("account_id").orderBy("txn_time", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)

filtered = (
    df_transactions
    .filter(F.col("merchant").isNotNull() & F.col("is_flagged"))
    .select(
        "id",
        "account_id",
        "txn_type",
        "amount",
        "txn_time",
        "is_flagged",
        F.round("amount", 2).alias("amount_rounded"),
        F.date_format("txn_time", "MMM yyyy").alias("txn_time_label"),
    )
)

with_windows = (
    filtered
    .withColumn("amount_avg_7d", F.avg("amount").over(w))
    .withColumn("last_known_amount_rounded", F.last("amount_rounded", ignorenulls=True).over(w2))
)

joined = (
    with_windows
    .alias("e")
    .join(df_accounts.alias("p"), F.col("e.account_id") == F.col("p.id"), "left")
    .select("e.*", F.col("p.account_type"), F.col("p.status"), F.col("p.balance"))
)

filtered_transactions = (
    joined
    .filter((F.col("txn_time") > F.lit("2024-01-13").cast("date")) & (F.col("amount_avg_7d") < 1379))
    .select(
        "*",
        F.least("amount_avg_7d", "amount_rounded").alias("least_amount_avg_7d_amount_rounded"),
        F.round((F.col("balance") * 0.85), 2).alias("adjusted_balance"),
    )
)

scored = (
    filtered_transactions
    .select(
        "*",
        F.avg("balance").over(w3).alias("balance_avg_6"),
        F.lead("amount_avg_7d", 1).over(w4).alias("next_amount_avg_7d"),
        F.sum("amount_rounded").over(w_running).alias("running_amount_rounded"),
        F.sum("amount_avg_7d").over(w6).alias("txn_type_sum_amount_avg_7d"),
        F.ntile(4).over(w_grp).alias("adjusted_balance_bucket"),
    )
)

enriched = (
    scored
    .withColumn("balance_avg_6_bucket", F.ntile(4).over(w8))
    .withColumn("amount_avg_7d_percent_rank", F.percent_rank().over(w9))
)

gaps = (
    enriched
    .withColumn("is_new_session", F.when(F.lag("txn_time").over(w10).isNull() | (F.col("txn_time") > F.lag("txn_time").over(w10) + F.expr("INTERVAL 30 DAYS")), 1).otherwise(0))
)

sessions_transactions = gaps.withColumn("island_id", F.sum("is_new_session").over(w11))

pivoted = (
    sessions_transactions
    .groupBy("account_type")
    .pivot("txn_type", ["FEE", "CREDIT"])
    .agg(F.sum("balance").alias("amount"), F.count(F.lit(1)).alias("cnt"))
)

result = (
    pivoted
    .select(
        "account_type",
        "FEE_amount",
        "CREDIT_amount",
        "CREDIT_cnt",
        F.when(F.col("account_type").rlike("^(SAVINGS|CREDIT)$"), "EXTENDED").otherwise("CORE").alias("account_type_zone"),
    )
)

SELECT
    status,
    DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', order_date) AS activity_month,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'RETURNED') AS returned_rows,
    MIN(discount) AS min_discount,
    COUNT(*) AS cnt,

    ROUND(SUM(amount) / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN channel = 'store' THEN 1 END), 0), 2) AS amount_per_store,
    GROUPING(status) AS grouping_id
FROM orders
GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((status, DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', order_date)), (status))
HAVING returned_rows >= 1
ORDER BY returned_rows NULLS LAST;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

result = (
    df_orders
    .withColumn("activity_month", F.date_trunc("MONTH", "order_date"))
    .groupingSets(
        [["status", "activity_month"], ["status"]],
        "status",
        "activity_month",
    )
    .agg(
        F.count(F.when(F.col("status") == "RETURNED", 1)).alias("returned_rows"),
        F.min("discount").alias("min_discount"),
        F.count("*").alias("cnt"),
        F.countDistinct("customer_id").alias("distinct_customer_ids"),
        F.round(F.sum("amount") / F.nullif(F.count(F.when(F.col("channel") == "store", 1)), F.lit(0)), 2).alias("amount_per_store"),
        F.grouping("status").alias("grouping_id"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("returned_rows") >= 1)
    .orderBy(F.col("returned_rows").asc_nulls_last())
)

WITH cleaned AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        COALESCE(name, 'unassigned') AS name_filled,
        COALESCE(segment, 'N/A') AS segment_clean
    FROM customers
    WHERE signup_date > DATE '2023-04-02'
      AND segment IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT s.*, x.opened_date
FROM cleaned s
JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT c.opened_date
        FROM accounts c
        WHERE c.customer_id = s.id
        ORDER BY c.balance DESC, c.id DESC
        LIMIT 1
    ) x ON TRUE;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy(F.col("s.id")).orderBy(F.col("c.balance").desc(), F.col("c.id").desc())

cleaned = (
    df_customers
    .filter((F.col("signup_date") > F.lit("2023-04-02").cast("date")) & F.col("segment").isNotNull())
    .select(
        "*",
        F.coalesce("name", F.lit("unassigned")).alias("name_filled"),
        F.coalesce("segment", F.lit("N/A")).alias("segment_clean"),
    )
)

result = (
    cleaned
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_accounts.alias("c"), (F.col("c.customer_id") == F.col("s.id")), "inner")
    .withColumn("rn", F.row_number().over(w))
    .filter(F.col("rn") == 1)
    .select("s.*", F.col("c.opened_date"))
)

with cleaned as (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    select
        id,
        customer_id,
        account_type,
        opened_date,
        status,
        coalesce(status, 'Unknown') as status_filled
    from accounts
    where opened_date > date '2024-02-02'
      and status is not null
)
-- Latest matching transaction per row (LATERAL ... LIMIT 1)
select s.*, top1.merchant
from cleaned s
join lateral (
        select c.merchant
        from transactions c
        where c.account_id = s.id
          and c.txn_time <= s.opened_date
        order by c.txn_time desc, c.id desc
        limit 1
    ) top1 on true;

sql:
WITH ranked AS (
    -- Keep one row per key (latest first)
    SELECT *
    FROM (
        SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY channel ORDER BY starts_on DESC, id) AS latest_rank
        FROM promotions
    ) x
    WHERE latest_rank = 1
),
ranked_promotions AS (
    -- QUALIFY-style window filter
    SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY promo_code ORDER BY ends_on, id) AS latest_rank_2
    FROM ranked
    QUALIFY latest_rank_2 = 1
),
metrics AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        *,
        LEAD(discount_pct, 2) OVER (ORDER BY starts_on, id) next_discount_pct,
        NTILE(3) OVER (PARTITION BY promo_code, channel ORDER BY discount_pct, id) discount_pct_bucket,
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY discount_pct) discount_pct_rank,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY channel ORDER BY discount_pct DESC) discount_pct_dense_rank,
        LAG(discount_pct, 2, 0) OVER (PARTITION BY promo_code, channel ORDER BY latest_rank, id) prev_discount_pct
    FROM ranked_promotions
),
deduped AS (
    -- Deduplicate with ROW_NUMBER
    SELECT *
    FROM (
        SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY promo_code, channel ORDER BY discount_pct, id) AS row_num
        FROM metrics
    ) t
    WHERE row_num = 1
),
metrics_promotions AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        id,
        channel,
        promo_code,
        starts_on,
        ends_on,
        discount_pct,
        latest_rank,
        latest_rank_2,
        next_discount_pct,
        discount_pct_bucket,
        discount_pct_rank,
        discount_pct_dense_rank,
        prev_discount_pct,
        row_num,
        COUNT(prev_discount_pct) OVER (PARTITION BY channel) channel_count_prev_discount_pct,
        SUM(discount_pct) OVER (PARTITION BY channel ORDER BY discount_pct, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) running_discount_pct,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY discount_pct DESC, id) seq_no
    FROM deduped
)
SELECT
    id,
    channel,
    promo_code,
    latest_rank_2,
    discount_pct_rank,
    discount_pct_dense_rank,
    prev_discount_pct,
    row_num,
    channel_count_prev_discount_pct
FROM metrics_promotions
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("channel").orderBy(F.col("starts_on").desc(), "id")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("promo_code").orderBy("ends_on", "id")
w3 = Window.orderBy("starts_on", "id")
w4 = Window.partitionBy("promo_code", "channel").orderBy("discount_pct", "id")
w5 = Window.orderBy("discount_pct")
w6 = Window.partitionBy("channel").orderBy(F.col("discount_pct").desc())
w7 = Window.partitionBy("promo_code", "channel").orderBy("latest_rank", "id")
w8 = Window.partitionBy("channel")
w9 = Window.partitionBy("channel").orderBy("discount_pct", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w10 = Window.orderBy(F.col("discount_pct").desc(), "id")

ranked = (
    df_promotions
    .withColumn("latest_rank", F.row_number().over(w))
    .filter(F.col("latest_rank") == 1)
)

ranked_promotions = (
    ranked
    .withColumn("latest_rank_2", F.row_number().over(w2))
    .filter(F.col("latest_rank_2") == 1)
)

metrics = (
    ranked_promotions
    .withColumn("next_discount_pct", F.lead("discount_pct", 2).over(w3))
    .withColumn("discount_pct_bucket", F.ntile(3).over(w4))
    .withColumn("discount_pct_rank", F.rank().over(w5))
    .withColumn("discount_pct_dense_rank", F.dense_rank().over(w6))
    .withColumn("prev_discount_pct", F.lag("discount_pct", 2, 0).over(w7))
)

deduped = (
    metrics
    .withColumn("row_num", F.row_number().over(w4))
    .filter(F.col("row_num") == 1)
)

metrics_promotions = (
    deduped
    .select(
        "*",
        F.count("prev_discount_pct").over(w8).alias("channel_count_prev_discount_pct"),
        F.sum("discount_pct").over(w9).alias("running_discount_pct"),
        F.row_number().over(w10).alias("seq_no"),
    )
)

result = (
    metrics_promotions
    .select(
        "id",
        "channel",
        "promo_code",
        "latest_rank_2",
        "discount_pct_rank",
        "discount_pct_dense_rank",
        "prev_discount_pct",
        "row_num",
        "channel_count_prev_discount_pct",
    )
)

sql:
with base as (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    select
        id,
        customer_id,
        balance,
        opened_date,
        status,
        trim(account_type) as clean_account_type,
        coalesce(status, 'UNKNOWN') as resolved_status
    from accounts
    where opened_date >= date '2023-08-20'
      and month(opened_date) in (2, 9, 12)
),
metrics as (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    select
        *,
        percent_rank() over (partition by customer_id, status order by balance desc nulls last) as balance_percent_rank,
        sum(balance) over w_recent as running_balance,
        count(balance) over (partition by customer_id) as customer_id_count_balance,
        row_number() over (partition by status order by opened_date desc, id) as row_seq,
        row_number() over w_part as seq_no
    from base
    window w_recent as (partition by status order by balance, id rows between unbounded preceding and current row), w_part as (partition by customer_id order by balance, id)
),
enriched as (
    -- Attach customers attributes
    select
        src.*,
        d.city,
        d.credit_limit,
        d.signup_date
    from metrics src
    inner join customers d
        on src.customer_id = d.id
),
ranked as (
    -- QUALIFY-style window filter
    select *, row_number() over (partition by city, status order by signup_date nulls last, id) as row_num
    from enriched
    qualify row_num = 1
),
totals as (
    -- Aggregate with conditional metrics
    select
        case when customer_id_count_balance >= 16 then 'LARGE' else 'SMALL' end as customer_id_count_balance_tier,
        city,
        round(sum(balance_percent_rank) / nullif(count(case when status = 'CLOSED' then 1 end), 0), 2) as balance_percent_rank_per_closed,
        count_if(city = 'Tokyo') as tokyo_events,
        count(*) as cnt,

with filtered as (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    select
        *,
        upper(merchant) as merchant_upper,
        ceil(amount) as amount_whole
    from transactions
    where txn_time > timestamp '2023-10-14 03:00:00'
      and merchant in ('Lazada', '7-Eleven')
),
ranked as (
    -- QUALIFY-style window filter
    select *
    from filtered
    qualify row_number() over (partition by account_id, merchant order by amount_whole asc nulls first, id asc) = 1
),
with_gaps as (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > interval)
    select *, case when lag(txn_time) over (partition by merchant order by txn_time asc, id asc) is null
                 or txn_time > lag(txn_time) over (partition by merchant order by txn_time asc, id asc) + interval 7 days then 1 else 0 end as is_new_burst
    from ranked
),
sessionized as (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    select *, sum(is_new_burst) over (partition by merchant order by txn_time asc, id asc rows between unbounded preceding and current row) as session_id
    from with_gaps
),
enriched as (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    select
        *,
        rank() over (partition by account_id order by session_id desc) as session_id_rank,
        first_value(amount, true) over (partition by account_id order by is_new_burst asc, id asc rows between unbounded preceding and current row) as first_known_amount,
        sum(is_new_burst) over w_part as running_is_new_burst
    from sessionized
    window w_part as (partition by merchant order by amount asc, id asc rows between unbounded preceding and current row)
),
metrics as (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    select
        id,
        account_id,
        txn_type,
        amount,
        txn_time,
        merchant,
        is_flagged,
        merchant_upper,
        amount_whole,
        is_new_burst,
        session_id,
        session_id_rank,
        first_known_amount,
        running_is_new_burst,
        lag(amount, 1) over (partition by txn_type order by first_known_amount asc, id asc) as prev_amount,
        avg(session_id_rank) over (partition by account_id order by cast(txn_time as bigint) asc range between 2592000 preceding and current row) as session_id_rank_avg_30d,
        lag(amount_whole, 1) over (partition by merchant order by first_known_amount asc, id asc) as prev_amount_whole
    from enriched
),
valid as (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    select
        id,
        txn_type,
        amount,
        merchant,
        is_flagged,
        merchant_upper,
        amount_whole,
        is_new_burst,
        session_id,
        first_known_amount,
        prev_amount,
        session_id_rank_avg_30d,
        amount - prev_amount_whole as amount_minus_prev_amount_whole,
        coalesce(merchant, 'N/A') as merchant_filled
    from metrics
    where txn_time > date '2024-04-01'
      and merchant is not null
),
base as (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    select *, round(amount_minus_prev_amount_whole, 2) as amount_minus_prev_amount_whole_rounded
    from valid
    where merchant is not null
)
select
    id,
    txn_type,
    amount,
    is_flagged,
    merchant_upper,
    amount_whole,
    session_id,
    first_known_amount,
    prev_amount,
    case when txn_type rlike '^(DEBIT|REFUND)$' then 'CORE' else 'EXTENDED' end as txn_type_zone
from base
order by amount_whole asc nulls last, txn_type desc

w8 = Window.partitionBy("account_id").orderBy(F.col("txn_time").cast("bigint")).rangeBetween(-2592000, Window.currentRow)

    )

)

        e.*,

        p.name,

    FROM accounts e

FROM (
    SELECT
        id,
        status,
        balance,
        credit_limit
    FROM kept
) src
UNPIVOT INCLUDE NULLS (
    metric_value FOR metric_name IN (balance, credit_limit AS CREDIT_LIMIT_VAL)
)

WITH remaining_keys AS (
    -- Set intersection on keys
    SELECT product_id
    FROM inventory
    INTERSECT
    SELECT product_id
    FROM inventory
    WHERE product_id = 9
),
verified AS (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    SELECT s.*
    FROM inventory s
    INNER JOIN remaining_keys k ON s.product_id = k.product_id
)
-- Aggregate with conditional metrics
SELECT
    product_id,
    store_id,
    DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', last_restock) AS activity_month,
    COUNT(DISTINCT store_id) AS distinct_store_ids,
    BIT_OR(quantity) AS quantity_bit_or,
    GROUPING(product_id) AS gid
FROM verified
GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((product_id, store_id, DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', last_restock)), (product_id, store_id), ())
ORDER BY activity_month NULLS LAST;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

remaining_keys = (
    df_inventory
    .select("product_id")
    .intersect(
        df_inventory
        .filter(F.col("product_id") == 9)
        .select("product_id")
    )
)

verified = (
    df_inventory
    .alias("s")
    .join(remaining_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.product_id") == F.col("k.product_id")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

result = (
    verified
    .withColumn("activity_month", F.date_trunc("MONTH", "last_restock"))
    .groupingSets(
        [["product_id", "store_id", "activity_month"], ["product_id", "store_id"], []],
        "product_id",
        "store_id",
        "activity_month",
    )
    .agg(
        F.countDistinct("store_id").alias("distinct_store_ids"),
        F.bit_or("quantity").alias("quantity_bit_or"),
        F.grouping("product_id").alias("gid"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("activity_month").asc_nulls_last())
)
