with valid as (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    select
        *,
        date_sub(order_date, 41) as order_date_minus_41d,
        case when channel in ('web', 'partner') then 'Core' else 'Other' end as channel_group,
        coalesce(channel, 'UNKNOWN') as channel_clean
    from orders
    where order_date > to_date('2023-04-06')
),
metrics as (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    select
        *,
        sum(amount) over w_ordered as cumulative_amount,
        row_number() over (partition by store_id order by order_date_minus_41d, id) as event_seq,
        first_value(discount) ignore nulls over (partition by status order by amount, id rows between unbounded preceding and current row) as first_known_discount,
        row_number() over (partition by status order by amount desc, id) as row_seq
    from valid
    window w_ordered as (partition by status order by order_date_minus_41d, id rows between unbounded preceding and current row)
),
with_dims as (
    -- Attach customers attributes
    select
        src.*,
        c.country,
        c.credit_limit
    from metrics src
    left join customers c
        on src.customer_id = c.id
),
kept as (
    -- Semi-join via a correlated subquery
    select s.*
    from with_dims s
    where exists (
            select 1
            from shipments ch
            where ch.order_id = s.id
              and ch.shipped_date < '2024-03-01'
        )
),
with_windows as (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    select
        *,
        sum(discount) over (order by shipping_fee, id rows between unbounded preceding and current row) as running_discount,
        lead(first_known_discount, 1, 0) over (order by order_date_minus_41d, id) as next_first_known_discount,
        first_value(discount, true) over (partition by channel order by credit_limit, id rows between unbounded preceding and current row) as first_known_discount_2,
        lag(amount, 1) over (partition by status order by cumulative_amount, id) as prev_amount,
        sum(event_seq) over (partition by customer_id, status order by cumulative_amount, id rows between unbounded preceding and current row) as running_event_seq
    from kept
),
totals as (
    -- Grouped metrics
    select
        date_trunc('month', order_date) as activity_month,
        count(case when status = 'RETURNED' then 1 end) as returned_count,
        count(case when status = 'PENDING' then 1 end) as pending_count,
        sum(prev_amount) filter (where channel = 'partner') as partner_total_prev_amount,
        grouping(date_trunc('month', order_date)) as gid
    from with_windows
    group by cube (date_trunc('month', order_date))
)
select
    activity_month,
    returned_count,
    partner_total_prev_amount
from totals
order by activity_month
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w_ordered = Window.partitionBy("status").orderBy("order_date_minus_41d", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w2 = Window.partitionBy("store_id").orderBy("order_date_minus_41d", "id")
w3 = Window.partitionBy("status").orderBy("amount", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w4 = Window.partitionBy("status").orderBy(F.col("amount").desc(), "id")
w5 = Window.orderBy("shipping_fee", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w6 = Window.orderBy("order_date_minus_41d", "id")
w7 = Window.partitionBy("channel").orderBy("credit_limit", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w8 = Window.partitionBy("status").orderBy("cumulative_amount", "id")
w9 = Window.partitionBy("customer_id", "status").orderBy("cumulative_amount", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)

valid = (
    df_orders
    .filter(F.col("order_date") > F.to_date(F.lit("2023-04-06")))
    .select(
        "*",
        F.date_sub("order_date", 41).alias("order_date_minus_41d"),
        F.when(F.col("channel").isin(["web", "partner"]), "Core").otherwise("Other").alias("channel_group"),
        F.coalesce("channel", F.lit("UNKNOWN")).alias("channel_clean"),
    )
)

metrics = (
    valid
    .select(
        "*",
        F.sum("amount").over(w_ordered).alias("cumulative_amount"),
        F.row_number().over(w2).alias("event_seq"),
        F.first("discount", ignorenulls=True).over(w3).alias("first_known_discount"),
        F.row_number().over(w4).alias("row_seq"),
    )
)

with_dims = (
    metrics
    .alias("src")
    .join(df_customers.alias("c"), F.col("src.customer_id") == F.col("c.id"), "left")
    .select("src.*", F.col("c.country"), F.col("c.credit_limit"))
)

kept = (
    with_dims
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_shipments.alias("ch"), (F.col("ch.order_id") == F.col("s.id")) & (F.col("ch.shipped_date") < "2024-03-01"), "left_semi")
)

with_windows = (
    kept
    .select(
        "*",
        F.sum("discount").over(w5).alias("running_discount"),
        F.lead("first_known_discount", 1, 0).over(w6).alias("next_first_known_discount"),
        F.first("discount", ignorenulls=True).over(w7).alias("first_known_discount_2"),
        F.lag("amount", 1).over(w8).alias("prev_amount"),
        F.sum("event_seq").over(w9).alias("running_event_seq"),
    )
)

totals = (
    with_windows
    .withColumn("activity_month", F.date_trunc("month", "order_date"))
    .cube("activity_month")
    .agg(
        F.count(F.when(F.col("status") == "RETURNED", 1)).alias("returned_count"),
        F.count(F.when(F.col("status") == "PENDING", 1)).alias("pending_count"),
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("channel") == "partner", F.col("prev_amount"))).alias("partner_total_prev_amount"),
        F.grouping("activity_month").alias("gid"),
    )
)

result = (
    totals
    .select("activity_month", "returned_count", "partner_total_prev_amount")
    .orderBy("activity_month")
)

WITH base AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        account_id,
        txn_type,
        amount,
        merchant,
        is_flagged,
        COALESCE(amount, 0) AS amount_filled,
        CASE WHEN is_flagged THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS is_flagged_label,
        COALESCE(merchant, 'N/A') AS resolved_merchant
    FROM transactions
    WHERE merchant IS NOT NULL
      AND txn_time >= '2024-02-25'
),
enriched AS (
    SELECT
        s.*,
        p.account_type,
        p.status,
        p.opened_date
    FROM base s
    LEFT JOIN accounts p
        ON s.account_id = p.id
),
scored AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        NTILE(10) OVER (PARTITION BY account_type ORDER BY amount DESC, id) AS amount_bucket,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY account_id, account_type ORDER BY amount_filled DESC, id) AS row_seq,
        AVG(amount) OVER (PARTITION BY account_id) AS account_id_avg_amount,
        AVG(amount) OVER (PARTITION BY account_id, txn_type ORDER BY amount, id ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS amount_avg_3
    FROM enriched
)
SELECT *
FROM (
    SELECT
        merchant,
        txn_type,
        row_seq
    FROM scored
) src
PIVOT (
    SUM(row_seq) AS total
    FOR txn_type IN ('DEBIT' AS debit, 'CREDIT' AS credit)
);
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("account_type").orderBy(F.col("amount").desc(), "id")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("account_id", "account_type").orderBy(F.col("amount_filled").desc(), "id")
w3 = Window.partitionBy("account_id")
w4 = Window.partitionBy("account_id", "txn_type").orderBy("amount", "id").rowsBetween(-3, Window.currentRow)

base = (
    df_transactions
    .filter(F.col("merchant").isNotNull() & (F.col("txn_time") >= "2024-02-25"))
    .select(
        "id",
        "account_id",
        "txn_type",
        "amount",
        "merchant",
        "is_flagged",
        F.coalesce("amount", F.lit(0)).alias("amount_filled"),
        F.when(F.col("is_flagged"), "Yes").otherwise("No").alias("is_flagged_label"),
        F.coalesce("merchant", F.lit("N/A")).alias("resolved_merchant"),
    )
)

enriched = (
    base
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_accounts.alias("p"), F.col("s.account_id") == F.col("p.id"), "left")
    .select("s.*", F.col("p.account_type"), F.col("p.status"), F.col("p.opened_date"))
)

scored = (
    enriched
    .withColumn("amount_bucket", F.ntile(10).over(w))
    .withColumn("row_seq", F.row_number().over(w2))
    .withColumn("account_id_avg_amount", F.avg("amount").over(w3))
    .withColumn("amount_avg_3", F.avg("amount").over(w4))
)

result = (
    scored
    .groupBy("merchant")
    .pivot("txn_type", ["DEBIT", "CREDIT"])
    .agg(F.sum("row_seq").alias("total"))
    .select("merchant", F.col("DEBIT").alias("debit"), F.col("CREDIT").alias("credit"))
)

    from filtered

    select *, case when prev_paid_at is null or paid_at > prev_paid_at + interval '30' day then 1 else 0 end as is_new_session
    from prev_events
),

    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    select *, sum(is_new_session) over (partition by order_id order by paid_at, id rows between unbounded preceding and current row) as burst_id
    from flagged

    from sessionized s

),
with_gaps as (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > interval)
    select *, case when paid_at - lag(paid_at) over (partition by order_id order by paid_at, id) > interval '30' day then 1 else 0 end as new_group_flag
    from with_dims
),
sessionized_payments as (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    select *, sum(new_group_flag) over (partition by order_id order by paid_at, id rows between unbounded preceding and current row) as burst_id_2
    from with_gaps
),
deduped as (
    -- Deduplicate with ROW_NUMBER
    select *
    from (

with ranked as (
    -- QUALIFY-style window filter
    select *
    from promotions
    qualify row_number() over (partition by promo_code order by starts_on desc, id asc) = 1
),
ranked_promotions as (
    -- Deduplicate with ROW_NUMBER
    select *, row_number() over (partition by promo_code order by ends_on desc, id asc) as rn
    from ranked
    qualify rn = 1
),
base as (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    select
        *,
        ceil(rn) as rn_whole,
        coalesce(channel, 'N/A') as resolved_channel
    from ranked_promotions
    where channel is not null
),
scored as (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    select
        *,
        row_number() over (partition by channel order by rn desc, id asc) as row_seq,
        lead(rn_whole, 1) over (partition by promo_code order by starts_on asc, id asc) as next_rn_whole,
        sum(discount_pct) over (partition by promo_code order by rn_whole asc, id asc rows between unbounded preceding and current row) as running_discount_pct
    from base
),
matched_keys as (
    -- Set difference on keys
    select channel, promo_code
    from scored
    except all
    select channel, promo_code
    from promotions
    where starts_on >= '2024-03-10'
),
reconciled as (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    select s.*
    from scored s
    inner join matched_keys k on s.channel = k.channel and s.promo_code = k.promo_code
),
attributed as (
    -- Non-equi join on a validity window
    select
        e.*,
        pr.id as promo_id,
        pr.promo_code as promotion_promo_code,
        pr.discount_pct as promotion_discount_pct
    from reconciled e
    inner join promotions pr
        on e.channel <=> pr.channel
       and e.starts_on between pr.starts_on and pr.ends_on
),
summary as (
    -- Multi-level aggregation
    select
        case when rn_whole >= 67 then 'PREMIUM' else 'STANDARD' end as rn_whole_tier,
        case when next_rn_whole >= 79 then 'PREMIUM' else 'STANDARD' end as next_rn_whole_tier,
        case when row_seq >= 9 then 'PREMIUM' else 'STANDARD' end as row_seq_tier,
        count(*) filter (where channel = 'mobile') as mobile_rows,
        count(*) filter (where promotion_promo_code = 'SPRING10') as spring10_rows,
        sum(promotion_discount_pct) as total_promotion_discount_pct,
        sum(promotion_discount_pct) filter (where promo_code = 'BUNDLE') as bundle_total_promotion_discount_pct
    from attributed
    group by cube (case when rn_whole >= 67 then 'PREMIUM' else 'STANDARD' end, case when next_rn_whole >= 79 then 'PREMIUM' else 'STANDARD' end, case when row_seq >= 9 then 'PREMIUM' else 'STANDARD' end)
)
select
    rn_whole_tier,
    next_rn_whole_tier,
    row_seq_tier,
    mobile_rows,
    spring10_rows,
    total_promotion_discount_pct,
    bundle_total_promotion_discount_pct
from summary
order by spring10_rows asc nulls first;

WITH cleaned AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        channel,
        promo_code,
        ends_on,
        discount_pct,
        TRIM(channel) AS clean_channel,
        ROUND(discount_pct, 1) AS discount_pct_rounded,
        COALESCE(channel, 'NONE') AS channel_filled
    FROM promotions
    WHERE ends_on > DATE '2024-03-26'
)
SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', ends_on) AS activity_month,
    promo_code,
    PERCENTILE_APPROX(discount_pct_rounded, 0.95) AS discount_pct_rounded_p95,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE channel = 'partner') AS partner_rows,
    STDDEV_SAMP(discount_pct) AS discount_pct_stddev,
    PERCENTILE_APPROX(discount_pct, ARRAY(0.25, 0.5, 0.75)) AS discount_pct_quartiles,
    COUNT(DISTINCT promo_code) AS distinct_promo_codes,
    GROUPING(DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', ends_on)) AS grouping_level
FROM cleaned
GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', ends_on), promo_code), (DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', ends_on)), ())
HAVING discount_pct_stddev >= 0
ORDER BY discount_pct_stddev DESC NULLS LAST
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

cleaned = (
    df_promotions
    .filter(F.col("ends_on") > F.lit("2024-03-26").cast("date"))
    .select(
        "id",
        "channel",
        "promo_code",
        "ends_on",
        "discount_pct",
        F.trim("channel").alias("clean_channel"),
        F.round("discount_pct", 1).alias("discount_pct_rounded"),
        F.coalesce("channel", F.lit("NONE")).alias("channel_filled"),
    )
)

result = (
    cleaned
    .withColumn("activity_month", F.date_trunc("MONTH", "ends_on"))
    .groupingSets(
        [["activity_month", "promo_code"], ["activity_month"], []],
        "activity_month",
        "promo_code",
    )
    .agg(
        F.percentile_approx("discount_pct_rounded", 0.95).alias("discount_pct_rounded_p95"),
        F.count(F.when(F.col("channel") == "partner", 1)).alias("partner_rows"),
        F.stddev_samp("discount_pct").alias("discount_pct_stddev"),
        F.percentile_approx("discount_pct", [0.25, 0.5, 0.75]).alias("discount_pct_quartiles"),
        F.countDistinct("promo_code").alias("distinct_promo_codes"),
        F.grouping("activity_month").alias("grouping_level"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("discount_pct_stddev") >= 0)
    .orderBy(F.col("discount_pct_stddev").desc_nulls_last())
)

WITH parsed AS (

    SELECT
        id,

        ZIP_WITH(tier_prices, discounts, (p, d) -> ROUND(p * (1 - d), 2)) AS net_prices,
        ELEMENT_AT(tier_prices, 1) AS entry_price
    FROM price_tiers
    WHERE MONTH(effective_from) IN (1, 4, 8)
)
-- Window metrics over several different partitions
SELECT
    *,
    LAG(entry_price, 2) OVER w_hist AS prev_entry_price,
    SUM(avg_tier_price) OVER (PARTITION BY plan ORDER BY avg_tier_price, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_avg_tier_price
FROM parsed
WINDOW w_hist AS (PARTITION BY plan ORDER BY effective_from, id)

WITH exploded AS (
    -- Unnest the array into one row per element
    SELECT
        id,
        host,
        log_ts,
        level,
        status_code,
        k,
        v
    FROM app_logs
    LATERAL VIEW OUTER EXPLODE(context) x AS k, v
),
with_windows AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        *,
        MAX(status_code) OVER (ORDER BY CAST(log_ts AS BIGINT) RANGE BETWEEN 3600 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS status_code_max_1h,
        SUM(status_code) OVER (PARTITION BY host ORDER BY CAST(log_ts AS BIGINT) RANGE BETWEEN 900 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS status_code_sum_15m,
        COUNT(status_code) OVER (PARTITION BY k ORDER BY CAST(log_ts AS BIGINT) RANGE BETWEEN 3600 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS status_code_count_1h
    FROM exploded
),
metrics AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        *,
        STDDEV_SAMP(status_code) OVER (PARTITION BY level) AS level_stddev_samp_status_code,
        SUM(status_code_max_1h) OVER (ORDER BY CAST(log_ts AS BIGINT) RANGE BETWEEN 7200 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS status_code_max_1h_sum_2h
    FROM with_windows
),
enriched AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        id,
        host,
        log_ts,
        level,
        status_code,
        k,
        v,
        status_code_max_1h,
        status_code_sum_15m,
        status_code_count_1h,
        level_stddev_samp_status_code,
        status_code_max_1h_sum_2h,
        AVG(level_stddev_samp_status_code) OVER (PARTITION BY level, k ORDER BY CAST(log_ts AS BIGINT) RANGE BETWEEN 900 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS level_stddev_samp_status_code_avg_15m,
        STDDEV_SAMP(status_code_count_1h) OVER (PARTITION BY host) AS host_stddev_samp_status_code_count_1h,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY k ORDER BY status_code_max_1h DESC NULLS FIRST) AS status_code_max_1h_dense_rank
    FROM metrics
)
-- Aggregate with conditional metrics
SELECT
    CASE WHEN level_stddev_samp_status_code_avg_15m >= 469 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END AS level_stddev_samp_status_code_avg_15m_tier,
    level,
    DATE_TRUNC('HOUR', log_ts) AS hour_window,
    SIZE(COLLECT_SET(host)) AS num_hosts,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE k = 'version') AS version_rows,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE k = 'region') AS region_rows,
    (UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MAX(log_ts)) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MIN(log_ts))) / 60 AS duration_min,
    COUNT_IF(host = 'h1') AS h1_events,
    MAX(log_ts) AS ended_at,
    PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY CASE WHEN level_stddev_samp_status_code_avg_15m >= 469 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END ORDER BY SIZE(COLLECT_SET(host)) DESC) AS num_hosts_percent_rank
FROM enriched
GROUP BY CASE WHEN level_stddev_samp_status_code_avg_15m >= 469 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END, level, DATE_TRUNC('HOUR', log_ts)
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.orderBy(F.col("log_ts").cast("bigint")).rangeBetween(-3600, Window.currentRow)
w2 = Window.partitionBy("host").orderBy(F.col("log_ts").cast("bigint")).rangeBetween(-900, Window.currentRow)
w3 = Window.partitionBy("k").orderBy(F.col("log_ts").cast("bigint")).rangeBetween(-3600, Window.currentRow)
w4 = Window.partitionBy("level")
w5 = Window.orderBy(F.col("log_ts").cast("bigint")).rangeBetween(-7200, Window.currentRow)
w6 = Window.partitionBy("level", "k").orderBy(F.col("log_ts").cast("bigint")).rangeBetween(-900, Window.currentRow)
w7 = Window.partitionBy("host")
w8 = Window.partitionBy("k").orderBy(F.col("status_code_max_1h").desc_nulls_first())
w9 = Window.partitionBy("level_stddev_samp_status_code_avg_15m_tier").orderBy(F.col("num_hosts").desc())

exploded = (
    df_app_logs
    .select(
        "id",
        "host",
        "log_ts",
        "level",
        "status_code",
        F.explode_outer("context").alias("k", "v"),
    )
)

with_windows = (
    exploded
    .select(
        "*",
        F.max("status_code").over(w).alias("status_code_max_1h"),
        F.sum("status_code").over(w2).alias("status_code_sum_15m"),
        F.count("status_code").over(w3).alias("status_code_count_1h"),
    )
)

metrics = (
    with_windows
    .withColumn("level_stddev_samp_status_code", F.stddev_samp("status_code").over(w4))
    .withColumn("status_code_max_1h_sum_2h", F.sum("status_code_max_1h").over(w5))
)

enriched = (
    metrics
    .withColumn("level_stddev_samp_status_code_avg_15m", F.avg("level_stddev_samp_status_code").over(w6))
    .withColumn("host_stddev_samp_status_code_count_1h", F.stddev_samp("status_code_count_1h").over(w7))
    .withColumn("status_code_max_1h_dense_rank", F.dense_rank().over(w8))
)

result = (
    enriched
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("level_stddev_samp_status_code_avg_15m") >= 469, "LARGE").otherwise("SMALL").alias("level_stddev_samp_status_code_avg_15m_tier"),
        "level",
        F.date_trunc("HOUR", "log_ts").alias("hour_window"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.size(F.collect_set("host")).alias("num_hosts"),
        F.count(F.when(F.col("k") == "version", 1)).alias("version_rows"),
        F.count(F.when(F.col("k") == "region", 1)).alias("region_rows"),
        ((F.unix_timestamp(F.max("log_ts")) - F.unix_timestamp(F.min("log_ts"))) / 60).alias("duration_min"),
        F.count_if(F.col("host") == "h1").alias("h1_events"),
        F.max("log_ts").alias("ended_at"),
    )
    .withColumn("num_hosts_percent_rank", F.percent_rank().over(w9))
)

WITH lines AS (
    -- Unnest the array into one row per element
    SELECT
        id,
        customer_id,
        k,
        attr_value
    FROM carts
    LATERAL VIEW OUTER EXPLODE(attributes) t AS k, attr_value
),
joined AS (
    -- Attach customers attributes
    SELECT e.*, d.country
    FROM lines e
    LEFT JOIN customers d
        ON e.customer_id = d.id
),
cleaned AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT *, LOWER(k) AS k_lower
    FROM joined
    WHERE country IS NOT NULL
),
valid AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT
        *,
        LOWER(k) AS k_lower_2,
        TRIM(k) AS clean_k,
        COALESCE(k, 'DIRECT') AS k_clean
    FROM cleaned
    WHERE customer_id = 22
),
filtered AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT *, CONCAT(country, ' - ', k) AS country_k
    FROM valid
    WHERE customer_id IS NULL
),
with_dims AS (
    -- Attach customers attributes
    SELECT
        a.*,
        p.age,
        p.credit_limit,
        p.name
    FROM filtered a
    LEFT JOIN customers p
        ON a.customer_id = p.id
),
matched_keys AS (
    -- Set difference on keys
    SELECT customer_id
    FROM with_dims
    EXCEPT DISTINCT
    SELECT customer_id
    FROM carts
    WHERE ARRAY_CONTAINS(coupon_codes, 'SPRING10')
),
reconciled AS (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    SELECT s.*
    FROM with_dims s
    INNER JOIN matched_keys k ON s.customer_id = k.customer_id
),
pivoted AS (
    -- Native SQL PIVOT
    SELECT *
    FROM (
        SELECT
            customer_id,
            k,
            credit_limit
        FROM reconciled
    ) src
    PIVOT (
        MAX(credit_limit)
        FOR k IN ('device', 'gift')
    )
)
SELECT
    s.customer_id,
    s.device,
    s.gift,
    (SELECT AVG(o2.shipping_fee) FROM orders o2 WHERE o2.customer_id = s.customer_id) AS avg_order_shipping_fee
FROM pivoted s
ORDER BY customer_id ASC;

from pyspark.sql import functions as F

shipping_fee_by_customer_id = df_orders.groupBy("customer_id").agg(F.avg("shipping_fee").alias("avg_order_shipping_fee"))

lines = (
    df_carts
    .select("id", "customer_id", F.explode_outer("attributes").alias("k", "attr_value"))
)

joined = (
    lines
    .alias("e")
    .join(df_customers.alias("d"), F.col("e.customer_id") == F.col("d.id"), "left")
    .select("e.*", F.col("d.country"))
)

cleaned = (
    joined
    .filter(F.col("country").isNotNull())
    .withColumn("k_lower", F.lower("k"))
)

valid = (
    cleaned
    .filter(F.col("customer_id") == 22)
    .withColumn("k_lower_2", F.lower("k"))
    .withColumn("clean_k", F.trim("k"))
    .withColumn("k_clean", F.coalesce("k", F.lit("DIRECT")))
)

filtered = (
    valid
    .filter(F.col("customer_id").isNull())
    .withColumn("country_k", F.concat("country", F.lit(" - "), "k"))
)

with_dims = (
    filtered
    .alias("a")
    .join(df_customers.alias("p"), F.col("a.customer_id") == F.col("p.id"), "left")
    .select("a.*", F.col("p.age"), F.col("p.credit_limit"), F.col("p.name"))
)

matched_keys = (
    with_dims
    .select("customer_id")
    .subtract(
        df_carts
        .filter(F.array_contains("coupon_codes", "SPRING10"))
        .select("customer_id")
    )
)

reconciled = (
    with_dims
    .alias("s")
    .join(matched_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.customer_id") == F.col("k.customer_id")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

pivoted = (
    reconciled
    .groupBy("customer_id")
    .pivot("k", ["device", "gift"])
    .agg(F.max("credit_limit"))
)

result = (
    pivoted
    .join(shipping_fee_by_customer_id, on="customer_id", how="left")
    .select("customer_id", "device", "gift", F.col("avg_order_shipping_fee"))
    .orderBy("customer_id")
)

WITH latest AS (
    -- Keep one row per key (latest first)
    SELECT *
    FROM (
        SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY device_code ORDER BY status_bits, id) AS latest_rank
        FROM device_readings
    ) t
    WHERE latest_rank = 1
),
metrics AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        *,
        SUM(pressure) OVER (PARTITION BY device_code ORDER BY reading_ts, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_pressure,
        AVG(humidity) OVER (PARTITION BY device_code ORDER BY reading_ts, id ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS humidity_avg_2_prior,
        AVG(pressure) OVER (ORDER BY humidity, id ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS pressure_avg_3_prior
    FROM latest
),
valid AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT *, pressure_avg_3_prior * running_pressure AS pressure_avg_3_prior_times_running_pressure
    FROM metrics
    WHERE reading_ts > DATE '2025-09-01'
),
metrics_device_readings AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        id,
        device_code,
        reading_ts,
        temp_c,
        humidity,
        pressure,
        status_bits,
        firmware,
        latest_rank,
        running_pressure,
        humidity_avg_2_prior,
        pressure_avg_3_prior,
        pressure_avg_3_prior_times_running_pressure,
        NTILE(4) OVER (PARTITION BY device_code ORDER BY temp_c DESC, id) AS temp_c_bucket,
        RANK() OVER w_hist AS pressure_avg_3_prior_rank,
        SUM(humidity) OVER w_grp AS device_code_sum_humidity,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY device_code ORDER BY running_pressure DESC NULLS FIRST) AS running_pressure_rank
    FROM valid
    WINDOW w_hist AS (PARTITION BY device_code ORDER BY pressure_avg_3_prior DESC NULLS FIRST), w_grp AS (PARTITION BY device_code)
),
kept_keys AS (
    -- Set difference on keys
    SELECT id
    FROM metrics_device_readings
    EXCEPT
    SELECT id
    FROM device_readings
    WHERE status_bits <= 10
),
verified AS (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    SELECT s.*
    FROM metrics_device_readings s
    INNER JOIN kept_keys k ON s.id = k.id
),
enriched AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        *,
        SUM(status_bits) OVER w_recent AS device_code_sum_status_bits,
        ROUND(pressure_avg_3_prior_rank / SUM(pressure_avg_3_prior_rank) OVER (PARTITION BY device_code), 4) AS pressure_avg_3_prior_rank_share,
        PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY device_code ORDER BY pressure_avg_3_prior_rank) AS pressure_avg_3_prior_rank_percent_rank
    FROM verified
    WINDOW w_recent AS (PARTITION BY device_code)
),
grouped AS (
    -- Aggregate with conditional metrics
    SELECT
        device_code,
        DATE_TRUNC('HOUR', reading_ts) AS hour_window,
        COUNT(*) AS cnt,
        BIT_AND(status_bits) AS status_bits_bit_and,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN device_code = 'DV-04' THEN 1 END) AS dv_04_count,
        COUNT_IF(device_code = 'DV-03') AS dv_03_events,
        PERCENTILE_APPROX(pressure_avg_3_prior_rank_share, ARRAY(0.25, 0.5, 0.75)) AS pressure_avg_3_prior_rank_share_quartiles
    FROM enriched
    GROUP BY device_code, DATE_TRUNC('HOUR', reading_ts)
    HAVING BIT_AND(status_bits) < 1
)
SELECT
    device_code,
    hour_window,
    dv_04_count,
    pressure_avg_3_prior_rank_share_quartiles
FROM grouped
ORDER BY device_code DESC;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("device_code").orderBy("status_bits", "id")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("device_code").orderBy("reading_ts", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w3 = Window.partitionBy("device_code").orderBy("reading_ts", "id").rowsBetween(-2, -1)
w4 = Window.orderBy("humidity", "id").rowsBetween(-3, -1)
w5 = Window.partitionBy("device_code").orderBy(F.col("temp_c").desc(), "id")
w_hist = Window.partitionBy("device_code").orderBy(F.col("pressure_avg_3_prior").desc_nulls_first())
w_grp = Window.partitionBy("device_code")
w8 = Window.partitionBy("device_code").orderBy(F.col("running_pressure").desc_nulls_first())
w9 = Window.partitionBy("device_code").orderBy("pressure_avg_3_prior_rank")

latest = (
    df_device_readings
    .withColumn("latest_rank", F.row_number().over(w))
    .filter(F.col("latest_rank") == 1)
)

metrics = (
    latest
    .withColumn("running_pressure", F.sum("pressure").over(w2))
    .withColumn("humidity_avg_2_prior", F.avg("humidity").over(w3))
    .withColumn("pressure_avg_3_prior", F.avg("pressure").over(w4))
)

valid = (
    metrics
    .filter(F.col("reading_ts") > F.lit("2025-09-01").cast("date"))
    .withColumn("pressure_avg_3_prior_times_running_pressure", (F.col("pressure_avg_3_prior") * F.col("running_pressure")))
)

metrics_device_readings = (
    valid
    .select(
        "*",
        F.ntile(4).over(w5).alias("temp_c_bucket"),
        F.rank().over(w_hist).alias("pressure_avg_3_prior_rank"),
        F.sum("humidity").over(w_grp).alias("device_code_sum_humidity"),
        F.rank().over(w8).alias("running_pressure_rank"),
    )
)

kept_keys = (
    metrics_device_readings
    .select("id")
    .subtract(
        df_device_readings
        .filter(F.col("status_bits") <= 10)
        .select("id")
    )
)

verified = (
    metrics_device_readings
    .alias("s")
    .join(kept_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.id") == F.col("k.id")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

enriched = (
    verified
    .withColumn("device_code_sum_status_bits", F.sum("status_bits").over(w_grp))
    .withColumn("pressure_avg_3_prior_rank_share", F.round((F.col("pressure_avg_3_prior_rank") / F.sum("pressure_avg_3_prior_rank").over(w_grp)), 4))
    .withColumn("pressure_avg_3_prior_rank_percent_rank", F.percent_rank().over(w9))
)

grouped = (
    enriched
    .groupBy("device_code", F.date_trunc("HOUR", "reading_ts").alias("hour_window"))
    .agg(
        F.count("*").alias("cnt"),
        F.bit_and("status_bits").alias("status_bits_bit_and"),
        F.count(F.when(F.col("device_code") == "DV-04", 1)).alias("dv_04_count"),
        F.count_if(F.col("device_code") == "DV-03").alias("dv_03_events"),
        F.percentile_approx("pressure_avg_3_prior_rank_share", [0.25, 0.5, 0.75]).alias("pressure_avg_3_prior_rank_share_quartiles"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("status_bits_bit_and") < 1)
)

result = (
    grouped
    .select(
        "device_code",
        "hour_window",
        "dv_04_count",
        "pressure_avg_3_prior_rank_share_quartiles",
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("device_code").desc())
)

WITH scored AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        id,
        store_id,
        product_id,
        sale_date,
        units,
        revenue,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY sale_date DESC, id) AS seq_no,
        NTILE(4) OVER w_part AS units_bucket,
        LAG(revenue, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY sale_date, id) AS prev_revenue,
        PERCENT_RANK() OVER w_running AS units_percent_rank
    FROM store_sales
    WINDOW w_part AS (PARTITION BY store_id ORDER BY units DESC, id), w_running AS (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY units DESC NULLS FIRST)
),
metrics AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        *,
        AVG(units_percent_rank) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY seq_no, id ROWS BETWEEN 5 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS units_percent_rank_avg_5,
        LAST_VALUE(revenue, TRUE) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY prev_revenue, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS last_known_revenue,
        NTILE(4) OVER (PARTITION BY store_id ORDER BY units_percent_rank DESC, id) AS units_percent_rank_bucket
    FROM scored
),
latest AS (
    -- Keep one row per key (latest first)
    SELECT *
    FROM (
        SELECT *, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY product_id, store_id ORDER BY revenue NULLS FIRST) AS rank_in_group
        FROM metrics
    ) t
    WHERE rank_in_group = 1
),
with_windows AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        *,
        NTILE(10) OVER (PARTITION BY store_id ORDER BY prev_revenue DESC, id) AS prev_revenue_bucket,
        LAG(units_bucket, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY rank_in_group, id) AS prev_units_bucket,
        COUNT(units_percent_rank_bucket) OVER (PARTITION BY store_id, product_id) AS store_id_count_units_percent_rank_bucket,
        SUM(prev_revenue) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY seq_no, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_prev_revenue
    FROM latest
),
enriched AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        *,
        LAG(units_percent_rank_avg_5, 1) OVER (ORDER BY last_known_revenue, id) AS prev_units_percent_rank_avg_5,
        ROUND(store_id_count_units_percent_rank_bucket / SUM(store_id_count_units_percent_rank_bucket) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id, store_id), 4) AS store_id_count_units_percent_rank_bucket_share
    FROM with_windows
)
-- Aggregate with conditional metrics
SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', sale_date) AS activity_month,
    SUM(units) AS total_units,
    ROUND(AVG(store_id_count_units_percent_rank_bucket), 2) AS avg_store_id_count_units_percent_rank_bucket,
    COUNT(*) AS cnt
FROM enriched
GROUP BY activity_month
ORDER BY cnt NULLS FIRST;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("product_id").orderBy(F.col("sale_date").desc(), "id")
w_part = Window.partitionBy("store_id").orderBy(F.col("units").desc(), "id")
w3 = Window.partitionBy("product_id").orderBy("sale_date", "id")
w_running = Window.partitionBy("product_id").orderBy(F.col("units").desc_nulls_first())
w5 = Window.partitionBy("product_id").orderBy("seq_no", "id").rowsBetween(-5, Window.currentRow)
w6 = Window.partitionBy("product_id").orderBy("prev_revenue", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w7 = Window.partitionBy("store_id").orderBy(F.col("units_percent_rank").desc(), "id")
w8 = Window.partitionBy("product_id", "store_id").orderBy(F.col("revenue").asc_nulls_first())
w9 = Window.partitionBy("store_id").orderBy(F.col("prev_revenue").desc(), "id")
w10 = Window.partitionBy("product_id").orderBy("rank_in_group", "id")
w11 = Window.partitionBy("store_id", "product_id")
w12 = Window.partitionBy("product_id").orderBy("seq_no", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w13 = Window.orderBy("last_known_revenue", "id")
w14 = Window.partitionBy("product_id", "store_id")

scored = (
    df_store_sales
    .withColumn("seq_no", F.row_number().over(w))
    .withColumn("units_bucket", F.ntile(4).over(w_part))
    .withColumn("prev_revenue", F.lag("revenue", 1).over(w3))
    .withColumn("units_percent_rank", F.percent_rank().over(w_running))
)

metrics = (
    scored
    .withColumn("units_percent_rank_avg_5", F.avg("units_percent_rank").over(w5))
    .withColumn("last_known_revenue", F.last("revenue", ignorenulls=True).over(w6))
    .withColumn("units_percent_rank_bucket", F.ntile(4).over(w7))
)

latest = (
    metrics
    .withColumn("rank_in_group", F.rank().over(w8))
    .filter(F.col("rank_in_group") == 1)
)

with_windows = (
    latest
    .select(
        "*",
        F.ntile(10).over(w9).alias("prev_revenue_bucket"),
        F.lag("units_bucket", 1).over(w10).alias("prev_units_bucket"),
        F.count("units_percent_rank_bucket").over(w11).alias("store_id_count_units_percent_rank_bucket"),
        F.sum("prev_revenue").over(w12).alias("running_prev_revenue"),
    )
)

enriched = (
    with_windows
    .select(
        "*",
        F.lag("units_percent_rank_avg_5", 1).over(w13).alias("prev_units_percent_rank_avg_5"),
        F.round((F.col("store_id_count_units_percent_rank_bucket") / F.sum("store_id_count_units_percent_rank_bucket").over(w14)), 4).alias("store_id_count_units_percent_rank_bucket_share"),
    )
)

result = (
    enriched
    .groupBy(F.date_trunc("MONTH", "sale_date").alias("activity_month"))
    .agg(
        F.sum("units").alias("total_units"),
        F.round(F.avg("store_id_count_units_percent_rank_bucket"), 2).alias("avg_store_id_count_units_percent_rank_bucket"),
        F.count("*").alias("cnt"),
    )

WITH unpacked AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        plan,
        effective_from,
        ELEMENT_AT(tier_prices, 1) AS entry_price,
        ARRAY_MIN(tier_prices) AS lowest_price,
        TRANSFORM(tier_prices, (p, i) -> ROUND(p * tier_limits[i], 2)) AS tier_revenue_caps,
        SLICE(tier_limits, 1, 2) AS first_two_limits,
        ZIP_WITH(tier_prices, discounts, (p, d) -> ROUND(p * (1 - d), 2)) AS net_prices
    FROM price_tiers
    WHERE plan <> 'basic'
)
SELECT
    id,
    plan,
    effective_from,
    entry_price,
    lowest_price,
    tier_revenue_caps,
    first_two_limits,
    net_prices,
    SUM(lowest_price) OVER w_recent AS cumulative_lowest_price,
    LAST_VALUE(entry_price) IGNORE NULLS OVER w_recent AS last_known_entry_price,
    MIN(entry_price) OVER (PARTITION BY plan) AS plan_min_entry_price,
    NTILE(10) OVER (PARTITION BY plan ORDER BY entry_price, id) AS entry_price_bucket
FROM unpacked
WINDOW w_recent AS (PARTITION BY plan ORDER BY lowest_price, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW);
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w_recent = Window.partitionBy("plan").orderBy("lowest_price", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w2 = Window.partitionBy("plan")
w3 = Window.partitionBy("plan").orderBy("entry_price", "id")

unpacked = (
    df_price_tiers
    .filter(F.col("plan") != "basic")
    .select(
        "id",
        "plan",
        "effective_from",
        F.element_at("tier_prices", 1).alias("entry_price"),
        F.array_min("tier_prices").alias("lowest_price"),
        F.transform("tier_prices", lambda p, i: F.round(p * F.col("tier_limits")[i], 2)).alias("tier_revenue_caps"),
        F.slice("tier_limits", 1, 2).alias("first_two_limits"),
        F.zip_with("tier_prices", "discounts", lambda p, d: F.round(p * (1 - d), 2)).alias("net_prices"),
    )
)

result = (
    unpacked
    .withColumn("cumulative_lowest_price", F.sum("lowest_price").over(w_recent))
    .withColumn("last_known_entry_price", F.last("entry_price", ignorenulls=True).over(w_recent))
    .withColumn("plan_min_entry_price", F.min("entry_price").over(w2))
    .withColumn("entry_price_bucket", F.ntile(10).over(w3))
)

sql:
WITH flattened AS (
    -- Unnest the array into one row per element
    SELECT
        id,
        customer_id,
        created_at,
        tag
    FROM carts
    LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(coupon_codes) x AS tag
),
with_dims AS (
    -- Attach customers attributes
    SELECT
        s.*,
        b.city,
        b.email
    FROM flattened s
    LEFT JOIN customers b
        ON s.customer_id = b.id
),
joined AS (
    -- Attach customers attributes
    SELECT
        a.*,
        p.signup_date,
        p.email AS customer_email,
        p.name
    FROM with_dims a
    LEFT JOIN customers p
        ON a.customer_id = p.id
),
enriched AS (
    -- Attach customers attributes
    SELECT a.*, c.country
    FROM joined a
    LEFT JOIN customers c
        ON a.customer_id = c.id
)
-- Multi-level aggregation
SELECT
    tag,
    DATE_TRUNC('DAY', created_at) AS activity_day,
    SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_SET(city)) AS city_list,
    MIN(created_at) AS first_seen,
    COUNT(*) AS cnt,
    SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_SET(country)) AS country_list
FROM enriched
GROUP BY ROLLUP (tag, DATE_TRUNC('DAY', created_at))
HAVING cnt < 1
ORDER BY activity_day DESC;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

flattened = (
    df_carts
    .select("id", "customer_id", "created_at", F.explode("coupon_codes").alias("tag"))
)

with_dims = (
    flattened
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_customers.alias("b"), F.col("s.customer_id") == F.col("b.id"), "left")
    .select("s.*", F.col("b.city"), F.col("b.email"))
)

joined = (
    with_dims
    .alias("a")
    .join(df_customers.alias("p"), F.col("a.customer_id") == F.col("p.id"), "left")
    .select(
        "a.*",
        F.col("p.signup_date"),
        F.col("p.email").alias("customer_email"),
        F.col("p.name"),
    )
)

enriched = (
    joined
    .alias("a")
    .join(df_customers.alias("c"), F.col("a.customer_id") == F.col("c.id"), "left")
    .select("a.*", F.col("c.country"))
)

result = (
    enriched
    .rollup("tag", F.date_trunc("DAY", "created_at").alias("activity_day"))
    .agg(
        F.sort_array(F.collect_set("city")).alias("city_list"),
        F.min("created_at").alias("first_seen"),
        F.count("*").alias("cnt"),
        F.sort_array(F.collect_set("country")).alias("country_list"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("cnt") < 1)
    .orderBy(F.col("activity_day").desc())
)

sql:
WITH with_gaps AS (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > interval)
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN LAG(paid_at) OVER (PARTITION BY method ORDER BY paid_at, id) IS NULL
                 OR paid_at > LAG(paid_at) OVER (PARTITION BY method ORDER BY paid_at, id) + INTERVAL '30' DAY THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_new_burst
    FROM payments
),
sessionized AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(is_new_burst) OVER (PARTITION BY method ORDER BY paid_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_no
    FROM with_gaps
)
-- Grouped metrics
SELECT
    CASE WHEN is_new_burst >= 1 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END AS is_new_burst_tier,
    ROUND(SUM(is_new_burst) / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'FAILED' THEN 1 END), 0), 2) AS is_new_burst_per_failed,
    SUM(CASE WHEN method = 'promptpay' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS promptpay_amount,
    SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_SET(method)) AS method_list,
    MIN(paid_at) AS started_at,
    COUNT_IF(status = 'REFUNDED') AS refunded_events,
    MAX(paid_at) AS ended_at
FROM sessionized
GROUP BY ROLLUP (CASE WHEN is_new_burst >= 1 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END)
HAVING refunded_events < 1
ORDER BY refunded_events DESC;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("method").orderBy("paid_at", "id")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("method").orderBy("paid_at", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)

with_gaps = (
    df_payments
    .withColumn("is_new_burst", F.when(F.lag("paid_at").over(w).isNull() | (F.col("paid_at") > F.lag("paid_at").over(w) + F.expr("INTERVAL 30 DAYS")), 1).otherwise(0))
)

sessionized = with_gaps.withColumn("session_no", F.sum("is_new_burst").over(w2))

result = (
    sessionized
    .rollup(
        F.when(F.col("is_new_burst") >= 1, "HIGH").otherwise("LOW").alias("is_new_burst_tier"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.round(F.sum("is_new_burst") / F.nullif(F.count(F.when(F.col("status") == "FAILED", 1)), F.lit(0)), 2).alias("is_new_burst_per_failed"),
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("method") == "promptpay", F.col("amount")).otherwise(0)).alias("promptpay_amount"),
        F.sort_array(F.collect_set("method")).alias("method_list"),
        F.min("paid_at").alias("started_at"),
        F.count_if(F.col("status") == "REFUNDED").alias("refunded_events"),
        F.max("paid_at").alias("ended_at"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("refunded_events") < 1)
    .orderBy(F.col("refunded_events").desc())
)

sql:
WITH cleaned AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT
        *,
        CASE WHEN cost >= 90 THEN 'High' WHEN cost >= 47 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END AS cost_level,
        COALESCE(carrier, 'DIRECT') AS carrier_filled
    FROM shipments
    WHERE order_id IS NOT NULL
),
enriched AS (
    -- Attach orders attributes
    SELECT
        e.*,
        p.shipping_fee,
        p.status AS order_status
    FROM cleaned e
    INNER JOIN orders p
        ON e.order_id = p.id
),
enriched_shipments AS (
    -- Attach orders attributes
    SELECT src.*, o.channel
    FROM enriched src
    LEFT JOIN orders o
        ON src.order_id = o.id
),
base AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT
        *,
        DATE_TRUNC('year', shipped_date) AS shipped_date_period,
        shipping_fee * cost AS shipping_fee_times_cost
    FROM enriched_shipments
    WHERE shipped_date >= DATE '2023-04-30'
      AND carrier IS NOT NULL
),
grouped AS (
    -- Aggregate with conditional metrics
    SELECT
        CASE WHEN shipping_fee_times_cost >= 71 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END AS shipping_fee_times_cost_tier,
        AVG(shipping_fee) AS avg_shipping_fee,
        PERCENTILE_APPROX(cost, 0.95) AS cost_p95,
        SIZE(COLLECT_SET(channel)) AS num_channels,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE channel = 'partner') AS partner_rows,
        (UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MAX(shipped_date_period)) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MIN(shipped_date_period))) / 60 AS span_minutes
    FROM base
    GROUP BY shipping_fee_times_cost_tier
    HAVING num_channels >= 1
)
SELECT
    shipping_fee_times_cost_tier,
    avg_shipping_fee,
    cost_p95,
    num_channels,
    span_minutes
FROM grouped
ORDER BY span_minutes DESC NULLS FIRST;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

cleaned = (
    df_shipments
    .filter(F.col("order_id").isNotNull())
    .select(
        "*",
        F.when(F.col("cost") >= 90, "High").when(F.col("cost") >= 47, "Medium").otherwise("Low").alias("cost_level"),
        F.coalesce("carrier", F.lit("DIRECT")).alias("carrier_filled"),
    )
)

enriched = (
    cleaned
    .alias("e")
    .join(df_orders.alias("p"), F.col("e.order_id") == F.col("p.id"), "inner")
    .select("e.*", F.col("p.shipping_fee"), F.col("p.status").alias("order_status"))
)

enriched_shipments = (
    enriched
    .alias("src")
    .join(df_orders.alias("o"), F.col("src.order_id") == F.col("o.id"), "left")
    .select("src.*", F.col("o.channel"))
)

base = (
    enriched_shipments
    .filter((F.col("shipped_date") >= F.lit("2023-04-30").cast("date")) & F.col("carrier").isNotNull())
    .withColumn("shipped_date_period", F.date_trunc("year", "shipped_date"))
    .withColumn("shipping_fee_times_cost", (F.col("shipping_fee") * F.col("cost")))
)

grouped = (
    base
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("shipping_fee_times_cost") >= 71, "PREMIUM").otherwise("STANDARD").alias("shipping_fee_times_cost_tier"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.avg("shipping_fee").alias("avg_shipping_fee"),
        F.percentile_approx("cost", 0.95).alias("cost_p95"),
        F.size(F.collect_set("channel")).alias("num_channels"),
        F.count(F.when(F.col("channel") == "partner", 1)).alias("partner_rows"),
        ((F.unix_timestamp(F.max("shipped_date_period")) - F.unix_timestamp(F.min("shipped_date_period"))) / 60).alias("span_minutes"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("num_channels") >= 1)
)

result = (
    grouped
    .select(
        "shipping_fee_times_cost_tier",
        "avg_shipping_fee",
        "cost_p95",
        "num_channels",
        "span_minutes",
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("span_minutes").desc_nulls_first())
)

WITH cleaned AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT *, FLOOR(monthly_fee) AS monthly_fee_whole
    FROM subscriptions
    WHERE customer_id IS NOT NULL
      AND plan IN ('basic', 'enterprise')
),
with_window AS (
    -- Non-equi join on a validity window
    SELECT
        e.*,
        sub.id AS subscription_id,
        sub.plan AS subscription_plan,
        sub.monthly_fee AS subscription_monthly_fee
    FROM cleaned e
    INNER JOIN subscriptions sub
        ON e.customer_id = sub.customer_id
       AND e.end_date >= sub.start_date
       AND e.end_date < sub.end_date + INTERVAL 7 DAYS
),
joined AS (
    -- Attach customers attributes
    SELECT
        s.*,
        b.age,
        b.segment,
        b.country
    FROM with_window s
    INNER JOIN customers b
        ON s.customer_id = b.id
)
SELECT
    id,
    customer_id,
    plan,
    start_date,
    end_date,
    monthly_fee,
    status,
    monthly_fee_whole,
    subscription_id,
    CASE WHEN status RLIKE '^(CANCELLED|PAUSED)$' THEN 'OTHER_ZONE' ELSE 'GROUP_A' END AS status_zone
FROM joined
ORDER BY monthly_fee_whole;

cleaned = (
    df_subscriptions
    .filter(F.col("customer_id").isNotNull() & F.col("plan").isin(["basic", "enterprise"]))
    .select("*", F.floor("monthly_fee").alias("monthly_fee_whole"))
)

with_window = (
    cleaned
    .alias("e")
    .join(df_subscriptions.alias("sub"), (F.col("e.customer_id") == F.col("sub.customer_id")) & (F.col("e.end_date") >= F.col("sub.start_date")) & (F.col("e.end_date") < F.col("sub.end_date") + F.expr("INTERVAL 7 DAYS")), "inner")
    .select(
        "e.*",
        F.col("sub.id").alias("subscription_id"),
        F.col("sub.plan").alias("subscription_plan"),
        F.col("sub.monthly_fee").alias("subscription_monthly_fee"),
    )
)

joined = (
    with_window
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_customers.alias("b"), F.col("s.customer_id") == F.col("b.id"), "inner")
    .select("s.*", F.col("b.age"), F.col("b.segment"), F.col("b.country"))
)

    .select(
        "id",
        "customer_id",
        "plan",
        "start_date",

        "monthly_fee_whole",
        "subscription_id",
        F.when(F.col("status").rlike("^(CANCELLED|PAUSED)$"), "OTHER_ZONE").otherwise("GROUP_A").alias("status_zone"),
    )

)

WITH base AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM employees
    WHERE is_remote = TRUE AND dept_id IN (15, 17, 38, 40) AND manager_id IN (4, 12, 33)
),
summary AS (
    SELECT
        level,
        manager_id,
        ROUND((100 * SUM(CASE WHEN level = 'L5' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) / COUNT(*), 1) AS pct_l5,
        ROUND(STDDEV(salary), 2) AS stddev_salary
    FROM base
    GROUP BY level, manager_id
)
SELECT
    level,
    manager_id,
    pct_l5,
    stddev_salary
FROM summary
WHERE pct_l5 > 53;

WITH unpacked AS (
    -- Semi-structured parsing
    SELECT
        id,
        service,
        latency_ms,
        status_code,
        payload_json,
        context,
        FROM_JSON(payload_json, 'STRUCT<user: STRUCT<id: INT, tier: STRING>, duration: DOUBLE, retries: INT, tags: ARRAY<STRING>>').retries AS retry_count,
        GET_JSON_OBJECT(payload_json, '$.user.tier') AS user_tier,
        GET_JSON_OBJECT(payload_json, '$.user.id') AS user_id
    FROM app_logs
)
-- Multi-level aggregation
SELECT
    CASE WHEN latency_ms >= 2484 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END AS latency_ms_tier,
    service,
    PERCENTILE_APPROX(retry_count, 0.5) AS retry_count_p50,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN service = 'auth' THEN 1 END) AS auth_count,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN service = 'search' THEN 1 END) AS search_count,
    GROUPING(CASE WHEN latency_ms >= 2484 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END) AS grouping_id
FROM unpacked
GROUP BY ROLLUP (CASE WHEN latency_ms >= 2484 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END, service)
HAVING PERCENTILE_APPROX(retry_count, 0.5) >= 0
ORDER BY latency_ms_tier DESC;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

unpacked = (
    df_app_logs
    .select(
        "id",
        "service",
        "latency_ms",
        "status_code",
        "payload_json",
        "context",
        F.from_json("payload_json", "STRUCT<user: STRUCT<id: INT, tier: STRING>, duration: DOUBLE, retries: INT, tags: ARRAY<STRING>>")["retries"].alias("retry_count"),
        F.get_json_object("payload_json", "$.user.tier").alias("user_tier"),
        F.get_json_object("payload_json", "$.user.id").alias("user_id"),
    )
)

result = (
    unpacked
    .withColumn("latency_ms_tier", F.when(F.col("latency_ms") >= 2484, "LARGE").otherwise("SMALL"))
    .rollup("latency_ms_tier", "service")
    .agg(
        F.percentile_approx("retry_count", 0.5).alias("retry_count_p50"),
        F.count(F.when(F.col("service") == "auth", 1)).alias("auth_count"),
        F.count(F.when(F.col("service") == "search", 1)).alias("search_count"),
        F.grouping("latency_ms_tier").alias("grouping_id"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("retry_count_p50") >= 0)
    .orderBy(F.col("latency_ms_tier").desc())
)

WITH flattened AS (
    -- Unnest the array into one row per element
    SELECT id, EXPLODE(discounts) AS tier_value
    FROM price_tiers
),
cleaned AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT *, ROUND(tier_value * 1.1, 2) AS adjusted_tier_value
    FROM flattened
    WHERE tier_value < 41
),
enriched AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        id,
        tier_value,
        adjusted_tier_value,
        PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY tier_value) AS tier_value_percent_rank,
        PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY adjusted_tier_value DESC NULLS FIRST) AS adjusted_tier_value_percent_rank,
        PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY tier_value DESC NULLS FIRST) AS tier_value_percent_rank_2
    FROM cleaned
),
filtered AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT
        *,
        CAST(tier_value AS INT) AS tier_value_int,
        adjusted_tier_value / NULLIF(tier_value_percent_rank, 0) AS adjusted_tier_value_per_tier_value_percent_rank
    FROM enriched
    WHERE tier_value_percent_rank_2 > 0.74
),
valid AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT *, adjusted_tier_value - adjusted_tier_value_per_tier_value_percent_rank AS adjusted_tier_value_minus_adjusted_tier_value_per_tier_value_percent_rank
    FROM filtered
    WHERE adjusted_tier_value_percent_rank > 0.56
),
cleaned_price_tiers AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT
        id,
        tier_value,
        tier_value_percent_rank,
        adjusted_tier_value_percent_rank,
        tier_value_percent_rank_2,
        tier_value_int,
        adjusted_tier_value_per_tier_value_percent_rank,
        adjusted_tier_value_minus_adjusted_tier_value_per_tier_value_percent_rank,
        ROUND(adjusted_tier_value_percent_rank, 0) AS adjusted_tier_value_percent_rank_rounded
    FROM valid
    WHERE adjusted_tier_value IS NOT NULL
),
enriched_price_tiers AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        *,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER w_grp AS adjusted_tier_value_percent_rank_dense_rank,
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY adjusted_tier_value_per_tier_value_percent_rank DESC NULLS LAST) AS adjusted_tier_value_per_tier_value_percent_rank_rank,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER w_part AS adjusted_tier_value_per_tier_value_percent_rank_dense_rank,
        PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY adjusted_tier_value_per_tier_value_percent_rank DESC NULLS FIRST) AS adjusted_tier_value_per_tier_value_percent_rank_percent_rank
    FROM cleaned_price_tiers
    WINDOW w_grp AS (ORDER BY adjusted_tier_value_percent_rank), w_part AS (ORDER BY adjusted_tier_value_per_tier_value_percent_rank DESC)
)
SELECT
    id,
    tier_value,
    tier_value_percent_rank,
    adjusted_tier_value_percent_rank,
    tier_value_percent_rank_2,
    tier_value_int,
    adjusted_tier_value_per_tier_value_percent_rank,
    adjusted_tier_value_minus_adjusted_tier_value_per_tier_value_percent_rank,
    adjusted_tier_value_percent_rank_rounded
FROM enriched_price_tiers
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.orderBy("tier_value")
w2 = Window.orderBy(F.col("adjusted_tier_value").desc_nulls_first())
w3 = Window.orderBy(F.col("tier_value").desc_nulls_first())
w_grp = Window.orderBy("adjusted_tier_value_percent_rank")
w5 = Window.orderBy(F.col("adjusted_tier_value_per_tier_value_percent_rank").desc_nulls_last())
w_part = Window.orderBy(F.col("adjusted_tier_value_per_tier_value_percent_rank").desc())
w7 = Window.orderBy(F.col("adjusted_tier_value_per_tier_value_percent_rank").desc_nulls_first())

flattened = df_price_tiers.select("id", F.explode("discounts").alias("tier_value"))

cleaned = (
    flattened
    .filter(F.col("tier_value") < 41)
    .select("*", F.round((F.col("tier_value") * 1.1), 2).alias("adjusted_tier_value"))
)

enriched = (
    cleaned
    .withColumn("tier_value_percent_rank", F.percent_rank().over(w))
    .withColumn("adjusted_tier_value_percent_rank", F.percent_rank().over(w2))
    .withColumn("tier_value_percent_rank_2", F.percent_rank().over(w3))
)

filtered = (
    enriched
    .filter(F.col("tier_value_percent_rank_2") > 0.74)
    .withColumn("tier_value_int", F.col("tier_value").cast("int"))
    .withColumn("adjusted_tier_value_per_tier_value_percent_rank", (F.col("adjusted_tier_value") / F.nullif("tier_value_percent_rank", F.lit(0))))
)

valid = (
    filtered
    .filter(F.col("adjusted_tier_value_percent_rank") > 0.56)
    .withColumn("adjusted_tier_value_minus_adjusted_tier_value_per_tier_value_percent_rank", (F.col("adjusted_tier_value") - F.col("adjusted_tier_value_per_tier_value_percent_rank")))
)

cleaned_price_tiers = (
    valid
    .filter(F.col("adjusted_tier_value").isNotNull())
    .select(
        "id",
        "tier_value",
        "tier_value_percent_rank",
        "adjusted_tier_value_percent_rank",
        "tier_value_percent_rank_2",
        "tier_value_int",
        "adjusted_tier_value_per_tier_value_percent_rank",
        "adjusted_tier_value_minus_adjusted_tier_value_per_tier_value_percent_rank",
        F.round("adjusted_tier_value_percent_rank", 0).alias("adjusted_tier_value_percent_rank_rounded"),
    )
)

enriched_price_tiers = (
    cleaned_price_tiers
    .select(
        "*",
        F.dense_rank().over(w_grp).alias("adjusted_tier_value_percent_rank_dense_rank"),
        F.rank().over(w5).alias("adjusted_tier_value_per_tier_value_percent_rank_rank"),
        F.dense_rank().over(w_part).alias("adjusted_tier_value_per_tier_value_percent_rank_dense_rank"),
        F.percent_rank().over(w7).alias("adjusted_tier_value_per_tier_value_percent_rank_percent_rank"),
    )
)

result = (
    enriched_price_tiers
    .select(
        "id",
        "tier_value",
        "tier_value_percent_rank",
        "adjusted_tier_value_percent_rank",
        "tier_value_percent_rank_2",
        "tier_value_int",
        "adjusted_tier_value_per_tier_value_percent_rank",
        "adjusted_tier_value_minus_adjusted_tier_value_per_tier_value_percent_rank",
        "adjusted_tier_value_percent_rank_rounded",
    )
)

WITH enriched AS (
    SELECT s.*, b.store_name
    FROM store_sales s
    LEFT JOIN stores b
        ON s.store_id = b.id
),
base AS (
    SELECT *, revenue * units AS revenue_per_unit
    FROM enriched
    WHERE YEAR(sale_date) >= 2025
),
with_dims AS (
    SELECT
        src.*,
        d.brand,
        d.price
    FROM base src
    INNER JOIN products d
        ON src.product_id = d.id
),
with_windows AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        store_id,
        product_id,
        sale_date,
        units,
        revenue,
        store_name,
        revenue_per_unit,
        brand,
        price,
        SUM(units) OVER w_recent AS product_id_sum_units,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER w_recent_2 AS row_seq
    FROM with_dims
    WINDOW w_recent AS (PARTITION BY product_id, store_id), w_recent_2 AS (PARTITION BY store_id ORDER BY revenue_per_unit DESC, id)
)
SELECT
    s.id,
    s.store_id,
    s.units,
    s.store_name,
    s.revenue_per_unit,
    s.brand,
    s.price,
    s.row_seq,
    (SELECT AVG(x.revenue) FROM store_sales x WHERE x.store_id = s.store_id) AS avg_store_sale_revenue
FROM with_windows s
ORDER BY id DESC
LIMIT 10;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w_recent = Window.partitionBy("product_id", "store_id")

with remaining_keys as (
    select store_id
    from store_sales
    intersect
    select store_id
    from store_sales
    where revenue <= 1900
),
verified as (
    select s.*
    from store_sales s
    join remaining_keys k on s.store_id = k.store_id
)
select
    date_trunc('month', sale_date) as activity_month,
    date_trunc('quarter', sale_date) as quarter_start,
    date_trunc('week', sale_date) as week_start,
    approx_percentile(revenue, 0.95) as revenue_p95,
    round(avg(revenue), 2) as avg_revenue,
    approx_percentile(revenue, array(0.25, 0.5, 0.75)) as revenue_quartiles,
    count(distinct store_id) as distinct_store_ids,
    count(*) as event_count,
    round(avg(units), 2) as avg_units,
    grouping_id() as grouping_level
from verified
group by rollup (date_trunc('month', sale_date), date_trunc('quarter', sale_date), date_trunc('week', sale_date))
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

remaining_keys = (
    df_store_sales
    .select("store_id")
    .intersect(
        df_store_sales
        .filter(F.col("revenue") <= 1900)
        .select("store_id")
    )
)

verified = (
    df_store_sales
    .alias("s")
    .join(remaining_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.store_id") == F.col("k.store_id")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

result = (
    verified
    .withColumn("activity_month", F.date_trunc("month", "sale_date"))
    .withColumn("quarter_start", F.date_trunc("quarter", "sale_date"))
    .withColumn("week_start", F.date_trunc("week", "sale_date"))
    .rollup("activity_month", "quarter_start", "week_start")
    .agg(
        F.percentile_approx("revenue", 0.95).alias("revenue_p95"),
        F.round(F.avg("revenue"), 2).alias("avg_revenue"),
        F.percentile_approx("revenue", [0.25, 0.5, 0.75]).alias("revenue_quartiles"),
        F.countDistinct("store_id").alias("distinct_store_ids"),
        F.count("*").alias("event_count"),
        F.round(F.avg("units"), 2).alias("avg_units"),
        F.grouping_id().alias("grouping_level"),
    )
)

with flattened as (
    select
        id,
        service,
        host,
        latency_ms,
        k,
        attr_value
    from app_logs
    lateral view outer explode(context) x as k, attr_value
),
enriched as (
    select
        id,
        service,
        host,
        latency_ms,
        k,
        attr_value,
        dense_rank() over (order by latency_ms desc nulls last) as latency_ms_dense_rank,
        percent_rank() over (order by latency_ms desc nulls last) as latency_ms_percent_rank
    from flattened
),
filtered as (
    select
        id,
        service,
        host,
        latency_ms,
        k,
        latency_ms_dense_rank,
        latency_ms_percent_rank,
        greatest(latency_ms_percent_rank, latency_ms) as greatest_latency_ms_percent_rank_latency_ms,
        lower(service) as service_lower
    from enriched
    where k is not null
),
metrics as (
    select
        id,
        service,
        host,
        latency_ms,
        k,
        latency_ms_dense_rank,
        latency_ms_percent_rank,
        greatest_latency_ms_percent_rank_latency_ms,
        service_lower,
        rank() over (partition by host order by latency_ms_percent_rank) as latency_ms_percent_rank_rank,
        rank() over (partition by k order by greatest_latency_ms_percent_rank_latency_ms) as greatest_latency_ms_percent_rank_latency_ms_rank
    from filtered
),
summary as (
    select
        case when latency_ms_dense_rank >= 8 then 'LARGE' else 'SMALL' end as latency_ms_dense_rank_tier,
        approx_percentile(greatest_latency_ms_percent_rank_latency_ms_rank, 0.95) as greatest_latency_ms_percent_rank_latency_ms_rank_p95,
        percentile_approx(latency_ms_percent_rank_rank, 0.5) as latency_ms_percent_rank_rank_p50,
        avg(greatest_latency_ms_percent_rank_latency_ms) filter (where service = 'checkout') as checkout_avg_greatest_latency_ms_percent_rank_latency_ms
    from metrics
    group by cube (case when latency_ms_dense_rank >= 8 then 'LARGE' else 'SMALL' end)
)
select
    latency_ms_dense_rank_tier,
    greatest_latency_ms_percent_rank_latency_ms_rank_p95,
    latency_ms_percent_rank_rank_p50
from summary
order by latency_ms_dense_rank_tier;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.orderBy(F.col("latency_ms").desc_nulls_last())
w2 = Window.partitionBy("host").orderBy("latency_ms_percent_rank")
w3 = Window.partitionBy("k").orderBy("greatest_latency_ms_percent_rank_latency_ms")

flattened = (
    df_app_logs
    .select(
        "id",
        "service",
        "host",
        "latency_ms",
        F.explode_outer("context").alias("k", "attr_value"),
    )
)

enriched = (
    flattened
    .select(
        "*",
        F.dense_rank().over(w).alias("latency_ms_dense_rank"),
        F.percent_rank().over(w).alias("latency_ms_percent_rank"),
    )
)

filtered = (
    enriched
    .filter(F.col("k").isNotNull())
    .select(
        "id",
        "service",
        "host",
        "latency_ms",
        "k",
        "latency_ms_dense_rank",
        "latency_ms_percent_rank",
        F.greatest("latency_ms_percent_rank", "latency_ms").alias("greatest_latency_ms_percent_rank_latency_ms"),
        F.lower("service").alias("service_lower"),
    )
)

metrics = (
    filtered
    .select(
        "*",
        F.rank().over(w2).alias("latency_ms_percent_rank_rank"),
        F.rank().over(w3).alias("greatest_latency_ms_percent_rank_latency_ms_rank"),
    )
)

summary = (
    metrics
    .cube(
        F.when(F.col("latency_ms_dense_rank") >= 8, "LARGE").otherwise("SMALL").alias("latency_ms_dense_rank_tier"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.percentile_approx("greatest_latency_ms_percent_rank_latency_ms_rank", 0.95).alias("greatest_latency_ms_percent_rank_latency_ms_rank_p95"),
        F.percentile_approx("latency_ms_percent_rank_rank", 0.5).alias("latency_ms_percent_rank_rank_p50"),
        F.avg(F.when(F.col("service") == "checkout", F.col("greatest_latency_ms_percent_rank_latency_ms"))).alias("checkout_avg_greatest_latency_ms_percent_rank_latency_ms"),
    )
)

result = (
    summary
    .select(
        "latency_ms_dense_rank_tier",
        "greatest_latency_ms_percent_rank_latency_ms_rank_p95",
        "latency_ms_percent_rank_rank_p50",
    )
    .orderBy("latency_ms_dense_rank_tier")
)

sql:
with lines as (
    -- Unnest the array into one row per element
    select
        id,
        host,
        level,
        latency_ms,
        status_code,
        k,
        v
    from app_logs
    lateral view explode(context) li as k, v
),
ranked as (
    -- Deduplicate with ROW_NUMBER
    select *, rank() over (partition by k order by status_code desc) as rank_in_group
    from lines
    qualify rank_in_group = 1
),
ranked_app_logs as (
    -- QUALIFY-style window filter
    select *, row_number() over (partition by k order by latency_ms desc, id, k) as rank_in_group_2
    from ranked
    qualify rank_in_group_2 = 1
)
-- Aggregate with conditional metrics
select
    host,
    bit_and(status_code) as status_code_bit_and,
    max(status_code) filter (where host = 'h3') as h3_max_status_code,
    count(*) filter (where host = 'h3') as h3_rows,
    count_if(level = 'WARN') as warn_events,
    count(*) as cnt
from ranked_app_logs
group by host
order by host desc nulls first;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("k").orderBy(F.col("status_code").desc())
w2 = Window.partitionBy("k").orderBy(F.col("latency_ms").desc(), "id", "k")

lines = (
    df_app_logs
    .select(
        "id",
        "host",
        "level",
        "latency_ms",
        "status_code",
        F.explode("context").alias("k", "v"),
    )
)

ranked = (
    lines
    .withColumn("rank_in_group", F.rank().over(w))
    .filter(F.col("rank_in_group") == 1)
)

ranked_app_logs = (
    ranked
    .withColumn("rank_in_group_2", F.row_number().over(w2))
    .filter(F.col("rank_in_group_2") == 1)
)

result = (
    ranked_app_logs
    .groupBy("host")
    .agg(
        F.bit_and("status_code").alias("status_code_bit_and"),
        F.max(F.when(F.col("host") == "h3", F.col("status_code"))).alias("h3_max_status_code"),
        F.count(F.when(F.col("host") == "h3", 1)).alias("h3_rows"),
        F.count_if(F.col("level") == "WARN").alias("warn_events"),
        F.count("*").alias("cnt"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("host").desc_nulls_first())
)

sql:
with enriched as (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    select
        id,
        order_id,
        product_id,
        quantity,
        unit_price,
        ntile(5) over (order by quantity desc, id) as quantity_bucket,
        row_number() over (order by unit_price desc, id) as row_seq,
        first_value(unit_price) ignore nulls over (partition by product_id, order_id order by quantity, id rows between unbounded preceding and current row) as first_known_unit_price
    from order_items
)
-- Multi-level aggregation
select
    case when row_seq >= 9 then 'LARGE' else 'SMALL' end as row_seq_tier,
    order_id,
    sum(quantity) as total_quantity,
    round(avg(quantity_bucket), 2) as avg_quantity_bucket,
    dense_rank() over (partition by case when row_seq >= 9 then 'LARGE' else 'SMALL' end order by round(avg(quantity_bucket), 2) desc) as avg_quantity_bucket_dense_rank
from enriched
group by case when row_seq >= 9 then 'LARGE' else 'SMALL' end, order_id;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.orderBy(F.col("quantity").desc(), "id")
w2 = Window.orderBy(F.col("unit_price").desc(), "id")
w3 = Window.partitionBy("product_id", "order_id").orderBy("quantity", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w4 = Window.partitionBy("row_seq_tier").orderBy(F.col("avg_quantity_bucket").desc())

enriched = (
    df_order_items
    .select(
        "*",
        F.ntile(5).over(w).alias("quantity_bucket"),
        F.row_number().over(w2).alias("row_seq"),
        F.first("unit_price", ignorenulls=True).over(w3).alias("first_known_unit_price"),
    )
)

result = (
    enriched
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("row_seq") >= 9, "LARGE").otherwise("SMALL").alias("row_seq_tier"),
        "order_id",
    )
    .agg(
        F.sum("quantity").alias("total_quantity"),
        F.round(F.avg("quantity_bucket"), 2).alias("avg_quantity_bucket"),
    )
    .withColumn("avg_quantity_bucket_dense_rank", F.dense_rank().over(w4))
)

WITH valid AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        id,
        category,
        brand,
        cost,
        stock_qty,
        tags,
        supplier_id,
        COALESCE(cost, 0) AS cost_filled,
        COALESCE(brand, 'NONE') AS resolved_brand
    FROM products
    WHERE launch_date > TO_DATE('2023-11-06')
),
enriched AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        id,
        category,
        brand,
        cost,
        stock_qty,
        tags,
        supplier_id,
        cost_filled,
        resolved_brand,
        LAG(cost_filled, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY category ORDER BY cost_filled ASC, id ASC) AS prev_cost_filled,
        LEAD(cost, 1, 0) OVER (PARTITION BY supplier_id, brand ORDER BY cost ASC, id ASC) AS next_cost,
        SUM(stock_qty) OVER w_part AS cumulative_stock_qty,
        FIRST_VALUE(brand, TRUE) OVER w_grp AS first_known_brand
    FROM valid
    WINDOW w_part AS (PARTITION BY category ORDER BY stock_qty ASC, id ASC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), w_grp AS (PARTITION BY brand ORDER BY cost ASC, id ASC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)
),
matched_keys AS (
    -- Set difference on keys
    SELECT brand, id
    FROM enriched
    EXCEPT ALL
    SELECT brand, id
    FROM products
    WHERE UPPER(product_name) LIKE '%MAR%'
),
verified AS (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    SELECT s.*
    FROM enriched s
    JOIN matched_keys k ON s.brand = k.brand AND s.id = k.id
),
with_windows AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        *,
        STDDEV_SAMP(cost_filled) OVER (PARTITION BY supplier_id, brand) AS supplier_id_stddev_samp_cost_filled,
        SUM(cost) OVER (PARTITION BY supplier_id, brand) AS supplier_id_sum_cost,
        PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY supplier_id ORDER BY prev_cost_filled DESC) AS prev_cost_filled_percent_rank,
        CUME_DIST() OVER (ORDER BY cost_filled DESC) AS cost_filled_cume_dist
    FROM verified
),
enriched_products AS (
    -- Attach suppliers attributes
    SELECT
        e.*,
        s.country,
        s.city
    FROM with_windows e
    JOIN suppliers s
        ON e.supplier_id = s.id
)
-- Native SQL UNPIVOT (wide to long)
SELECT *
FROM (
    SELECT
        category,
        cost_filled_cume_dist,
        cost_filled
    FROM enriched_products
) src
UNPIVOT (
    metric_value FOR measure IN (cost_filled_cume_dist AS COST_FILLED_CUME_DIST, cost_filled AS COST_FILLED)
)

from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("category").orderBy("cost_filled", "id")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("supplier_id", "brand").orderBy("cost", "id")
w_part = Window.partitionBy("category").orderBy("stock_qty", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w_grp = Window.partitionBy("brand").orderBy("cost", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w5 = Window.partitionBy("supplier_id", "brand")
w6 = Window.partitionBy("supplier_id").orderBy(F.col("prev_cost_filled").desc())
w7 = Window.orderBy(F.col("cost_filled").desc())

valid = (
    df_products
    .filter(F.col("launch_date") > F.to_date(F.lit("2023-11-06")))
    .select(
        "id",
        "category",
        "brand",
        "cost",
        "stock_qty",
        "tags",
        "supplier_id",
        F.coalesce("cost", F.lit(0)).alias("cost_filled"),
        F.coalesce("brand", F.lit("NONE")).alias("resolved_brand"),
    )
)

enriched = (
    valid
    .withColumn("prev_cost_filled", F.lag("cost_filled", 1).over(w))
    .withColumn("next_cost", F.lead("cost", 1, 0).over(w2))
    .withColumn("cumulative_stock_qty", F.sum("stock_qty").over(w_part))
    .withColumn("first_known_brand", F.first("brand", ignorenulls=True).over(w_grp))
)

matched_keys = (
    enriched
    .select("brand", "id")
    .exceptAll(
        df_products
        .filter(F.upper("product_name").like("%MAR%"))
        .select("brand", "id")
    )
)

verified = (
    enriched
    .alias("s")
    .join(matched_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.brand") == F.col("k.brand")) & (F.col("s.id") == F.col("k.id")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

with_windows = (
    verified
    .select(
        "*",
        F.stddev_samp("cost_filled").over(w5).alias("supplier_id_stddev_samp_cost_filled"),
        F.sum("cost").over(w5).alias("supplier_id_sum_cost"),
        F.percent_rank().over(w6).alias("prev_cost_filled_percent_rank"),
        F.cume_dist().over(w7).alias("cost_filled_cume_dist"),
    )
)

enriched_products = (
    with_windows
    .alias("e")
    .join(df_suppliers.alias("s"), F.col("e.supplier_id") == F.col("s.id"), "inner")
    .select("e.*", F.col("s.country"), F.col("s.city"))
)

result = (
    enriched_products
    .select(
        "category",
        F.col("cost_filled_cume_dist").alias("COST_FILLED_CUME_DIST"),
        F.col("cost_filled").alias("COST_FILLED"),
    )
    .unpivot(
        ["category"],
        ["COST_FILLED_CUME_DIST", "COST_FILLED"],
        "measure",
        "metric_value",
    )
    .filter(F.col("metric_value").isNotNull())
)

with filtered as (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    select
        id,
        order_id,
        product_id,
        quantity,
        greatest(quantity, unit_price) as greatest_quantity_unit_price
    from order_items
    where unit_price < 260
),
latest as (
    -- Deduplicate with ROW_NUMBER
    select *
    from filtered
    qualify row_number() over (partition by order_id order by quantity desc, id) = 1
),
base as (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    select
        id,
        order_id,
        product_id,
        quantity,
        greatest_quantity_unit_price,
        quantity + greatest_quantity_unit_price as quantity_plus_greatest_quantity_unit_price,
        coalesce(quantity, 0) as quantity_filled
    from latest
    where order_id in (2, 18, 30)
),
enriched as (
    -- Attach products attributes
    select e.*, b.stock_qty
    from base e
    inner join products b
        on e.product_id = b.id
),
with_windows as (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    select
        id,
        order_id,
        product_id,
        quantity,
        greatest_quantity_unit_price,
        quantity_plus_greatest_quantity_unit_price,
        quantity_filled,
        stock_qty,
        first_value(quantity_filled) ignore nulls over (partition by order_id order by stock_qty, id rows between unbounded preceding and current row) as first_known_quantity_filled,
        last_value(quantity, true) over (partition by product_id order by quantity_plus_greatest_quantity_unit_price, id rows between unbounded preceding and current row) as last_known_quantity,
        lead(greatest_quantity_unit_price, 1) over (partition by order_id order by stock_qty, id) as next_greatest_quantity_unit_price,
        ntile(5) over (partition by product_id order by quantity_plus_greatest_quantity_unit_price desc, id) as quantity_plus_greatest_quantity_unit_price_bucket,
        count(quantity) over (partition by order_id) as order_id_count_quantity
    from enriched
),
enriched_order_items as (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    select
        id,
        order_id,
        product_id,
        quantity,
        greatest_quantity_unit_price,
        quantity_plus_greatest_quantity_unit_price,
        quantity_filled,
        stock_qty,
        first_known_quantity_filled,
        last_known_quantity,
        next_greatest_quantity_unit_price,
        quantity_plus_greatest_quantity_unit_price_bucket,
        order_id_count_quantity,
        avg(last_known_quantity) over w_recent as last_known_quantity_avg_6,
        sum(stock_qty) over (partition by order_id, product_id order by quantity_filled, id rows between unbounded preceding and current row) as cumulative_stock_qty,
        ntile(5) over (partition by product_id, order_id order by first_known_quantity_filled desc, id) as first_known_quantity_filled_bucket
    from with_windows
    window w_recent as (partition by product_id order by next_greatest_quantity_unit_price, id rows between 6 preceding and current row)
)
select
    s.id,
    s.order_id,
    s.product_id,
    s.greatest_quantity_unit_price,
    s.stock_qty,
    s.first_known_quantity_filled,
    s.last_known_quantity,
    s.next_greatest_quantity_unit_price,
    s.order_id_count_quantity,
    (select min(x.units) from store_sales x where x.product_id = s.product_id) as min_store_sale_units
from enriched_order_items s
order by min_store_sale_units desc;

w8 = Window.partitionBy("order_id", "product_id").orderBy("quantity_filled", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
