with filtered as (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    select *, cast(duration_sec as double) as duration_sec_str
    from web_events
    where page is not null
),
gaps as (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > interval)
    select *, case when lag(event_time) over (partition by page order by event_time, id) is null
                 or event_time > lag(event_time) over (partition by page order by event_time, id) + interval 7 days then 1 else 0 end as session_start_flag
    from filtered
),
islands as (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    select *, sum(session_start_flag) over (partition by page order by event_time, id rows between unbounded preceding and current row) as island_id
    from gaps
),
with_gaps as (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > interval)
    select *, case when event_time - lag(event_time) over (partition by page order by event_time, id) > interval '14' day then 1 else 0 end as is_new_burst
    from islands
),
sessions_web_events as (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    select *, sum(is_new_burst) over (partition by page order by event_time, id rows between unbounded preceding and current row) as burst_id
    from with_gaps
),
cleaned as (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    select
        *,
        burst_id + duration_sec as burst_id_plus_duration_sec,
        island_id - is_new_burst as island_id_minus_is_new_burst
    from sessions_web_events
    where page is not null
),
with_windows as (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    select
        id,
        session_id,
        event_type,
        page,
        event_time,
        duration_sec,
        duration_sec_str,
        session_start_flag,
        island_id,
        is_new_burst,
        burst_id,
        burst_id_plus_duration_sec,
        island_id_minus_is_new_burst,
        ntile(5) over (partition by event_type order by duration_sec, id) as duration_sec_bucket,
        lag(burst_id, 2) over (partition by page, session_id order by duration_sec, id) as prev_burst_id,
        sum(is_new_burst) over (partition by event_type order by burst_id_plus_duration_sec, id rows between unbounded preceding and current row) as running_is_new_burst
    from cleaned
),
with_gaps_2 as (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > interval)
    select *, case when event_time - lag(event_time) over (partition by page order by event_time, id) > interval 90 days then 1 else 0 end as is_new_burst_2
    from with_windows
),
sessions_web_events_2 as (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    select *, sum(is_new_burst_2) over (partition by page order by event_time, id rows between unbounded preceding and current row) as session_id_2
    from with_gaps_2
)
select
    s.id,
    s.session_id,
    s.event_type,
    s.event_time,
    s.duration_sec_str,
    s.island_id,
    s.is_new_burst,
    s.burst_id_plus_duration_sec,
    s.island_id_minus_is_new_burst,
    (select sum(w2.duration_sec) from web_events w2 where w2.session_id = s.session_id) as sum_web_event_duration_sec
from sessions_web_events_2 s
order by session_id

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("page").orderBy("event_time", "id")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("page").orderBy("event_time", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w3 = Window.partitionBy("event_type").orderBy("duration_sec", "id")
w4 = Window.partitionBy("page", "session_id").orderBy("duration_sec", "id")
w5 = Window.partitionBy("event_type").orderBy("burst_id_plus_duration_sec", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
duration_sec_by_session_id = df_web_events.groupBy("session_id").agg(F.sum("duration_sec").alias("sum_web_event_duration_sec"))

filtered = (
    df_web_events
    .filter(F.col("page").isNotNull())
    .select("*", F.col("duration_sec").cast("double").alias("duration_sec_str"))
)

gaps = (
    filtered
    .withColumn("session_start_flag", F.when(F.lag("event_time").over(w).isNull() | (F.col("event_time") > F.lag("event_time").over(w) + F.expr("INTERVAL 7 DAYS")), 1).otherwise(0))
)

islands = gaps.withColumn("island_id", F.sum("session_start_flag").over(w2))

with_gaps = (
    islands
    .withColumn("is_new_burst", F.when(F.col("event_time") - F.lag("event_time").over(w) > F.expr("INTERVAL 14 DAYS"), 1).otherwise(0))
)

sessions_web_events = with_gaps.withColumn("burst_id", F.sum("is_new_burst").over(w2))

cleaned = (
    sessions_web_events
    .filter(F.col("page").isNotNull())
    .select(
        "*",
        (F.col("burst_id") + F.col("duration_sec")).alias("burst_id_plus_duration_sec"),
        (F.col("island_id") - F.col("is_new_burst")).alias("island_id_minus_is_new_burst"),
    )
)

with_windows = (
    cleaned
    .withColumn("duration_sec_bucket", F.ntile(5).over(w3))
    .withColumn("prev_burst_id", F.lag("burst_id", 2).over(w4))
    .withColumn("running_is_new_burst", F.sum("is_new_burst").over(w5))
)

with_gaps_2 = (
    with_windows
    .withColumn("is_new_burst_2", F.when(F.col("event_time") - F.lag("event_time").over(w) > F.expr("INTERVAL 90 DAYS"), 1).otherwise(0))
)

sessions_web_events_2 = with_gaps_2.withColumn("session_id_2", F.sum("is_new_burst_2").over(w2))

result = (
    sessions_web_events_2
    .join(duration_sec_by_session_id, on="session_id", how="left")
    .select(
        "id",
        "session_id",
        "event_type",
        "event_time",
        "duration_sec_str",
        "island_id",
        "is_new_burst",
        "burst_id_plus_duration_sec",
        "island_id_minus_is_new_burst",
        F.col("sum_web_event_duration_sec"),
    )
    .orderBy("session_id")
)

WITH valid_customers AS (
    SELECT *, age + credit_limit AS age_plus_credit_limit
    FROM customers
    WHERE age = 40 AND name LIKE 'Ka%' AND UPPER(TRIM(email)) = 'IVY@GMAIL.COM'
),
Summary AS (
    SELECT DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', signup_date) AS signup_month, COUNT(credit_limit) AS credit_limit_count, SUM(age_plus_credit_limit) AS total_age_plus_credit_limit
    FROM valid_customers
    GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', signup_date)
)
SELECT signup_month, credit_limit_count, total_age_plus_credit_limit
FROM Summary
WHERE credit_limit_count < 6
ORDER BY signup_month
LIMIT 20;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

valid_customers = (
    df_customers
    .filter((F.col("age") == 40) & F.col("name").like("Ka%") & (F.upper(F.trim("email")) == "IVY@GMAIL.COM"))
    .withColumn("age_plus_credit_limit", (F.col("age") + F.col("credit_limit")))
)

summary = (
    valid_customers
    .groupBy(F.date_trunc("MONTH", "signup_date").alias("signup_month"))
    .agg(
        F.count("credit_limit").alias("credit_limit_count"),
        F.sum("age_plus_credit_limit").alias("total_age_plus_credit_limit"),
    )
)

result = (
    summary
    .filter(F.col("credit_limit_count") < 6)
    .select("signup_month", "credit_limit_count", "total_age_plus_credit_limit")
    .orderBy("signup_month")
    .limit(20)
)

sql: WITH matched_keys AS (SELECT region, id FROM stores INTERSECT SELECT region, id FROM stores WHERE region = 'South'), kept_rows AS (SELECT s.* FROM stores s INNER JOIN matched_keys k ON s.region = k.region AND s.id = k.id) SELECT DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', opened_date) AS activity_month, region, COUNT(DISTINCT region) AS distinct_regions, SUM(CASE WHEN region = 'North' THEN sqft ELSE 0 END) AS north_sqft, ROUND(SUM(sqft) / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN city = 'Bangkok' THEN 1 END), 0), 2) AS sqft_per_bangkok, APPROX_PERCENTILE(sqft, 0.95) AS sqft_p95, ROUND(AVG(sqft), 2) AS avg_sqft FROM kept_rows GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', opened_date), region;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

matched_keys = (
    df_stores
    .select("region", "id")
    .intersect(
        df_stores
        .filter(F.col("region") == "South")
        .select("region", "id")
    )
)

kept_rows = (
    df_stores
    .alias("s")
    .join(matched_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.region") == F.col("k.region")) & (F.col("s.id") == F.col("k.id")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

result = (
    kept_rows
    .groupBy(F.date_trunc("MONTH", "opened_date").alias("activity_month"), "region")
    .agg(
        F.countDistinct("region").alias("distinct_regions"),
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("region") == "North", F.col("sqft")).otherwise(0)).alias("north_sqft"),
        F.round(F.sum("sqft") / F.nullif(F.count(F.when(F.col("city") == "Bangkok", 1)), F.lit(0)), 2).alias("sqft_per_bangkok"),
        F.percentile_approx("sqft", 0.95).alias("sqft_p95"),
        F.round(F.avg("sqft"), 2).alias("avg_sqft"),
    )
)

with flattened as (
    -- Unnest the array into one row per element
    select
        id,
        coupon_codes,
        attr_key,
        value
    from carts
    lateral view outer explode(attributes) x as attr_key, value
),
cleaned as (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    select *, size(coupon_codes) as coupon_codes_count
    from flattened
    where attr_key is not null
),
valid as (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    select
        id,
        value,
        coupon_codes_count,
        round(coupon_codes_count, 1) as coupon_codes_count_rounded
    from cleaned
    where attr_key is not null
),
enriched as (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    select
        *,
        rank() over (order by coupon_codes_count desc nulls first) as coupon_codes_count_rank,
        cume_dist() over (order by coupon_codes_count_rounded desc) as coupon_codes_count_rounded_cume_dist,
        dense_rank() over (order by coupon_codes_count desc nulls last) as coupon_codes_count_dense_rank
    from valid
),
enriched_carts as (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    select
        *,
        cume_dist() over (order by coupon_codes_count_rank desc nulls last) as coupon_codes_count_rank_cume_dist,
        cume_dist() over (order by coupon_codes_count_dense_rank nulls first) as coupon_codes_count_dense_rank_cume_dist,
        rank() over (order by coupon_codes_count_rounded_cume_dist desc) as coupon_codes_count_rounded_cume_dist_rank
    from enriched
)
-- Aggregate with conditional metrics
select
    case when coupon_codes_count_rounded >= 86 then 'LARGE' else 'SMALL' end as coupon_codes_count_rounded_tier,
    min(coupon_codes_count_dense_rank_cume_dist) as min_coupon_codes_count_dense_rank_cume_dist,
    percentile_approx(coupon_codes_count_dense_rank, array(0.25, 0.5, 0.75)) as coupon_codes_count_dense_rank_quartiles,
    max(coupon_codes_count_rounded) as max_coupon_codes_count_rounded,
    count(*) as row_count
from enriched_carts
group by case when coupon_codes_count_rounded >= 86 then 'LARGE' else 'SMALL' end
order by min_coupon_codes_count_dense_rank_cume_dist desc
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.orderBy(F.col("coupon_codes_count").desc_nulls_first())
w2 = Window.orderBy(F.col("coupon_codes_count_rounded").desc())
w3 = Window.orderBy(F.col("coupon_codes_count").desc_nulls_last())
w4 = Window.orderBy(F.col("coupon_codes_count_rank").desc_nulls_last())
w5 = Window.orderBy(F.col("coupon_codes_count_dense_rank").asc_nulls_first())
w6 = Window.orderBy(F.col("coupon_codes_count_rounded_cume_dist").desc())

flattened = (
    df_carts
    .select(
        "id",
        "coupon_codes",
        F.explode_outer("attributes").alias("attr_key", "value"),
    )
)

cleaned = (
    flattened
    .filter(F.col("attr_key").isNotNull())
    .withColumn("coupon_codes_count", F.size("coupon_codes"))
)

valid = (
    cleaned
    .filter(F.col("attr_key").isNotNull())
    .select(
        "id",
        "value",
        "coupon_codes_count",
        F.round("coupon_codes_count", 1).alias("coupon_codes_count_rounded"),
    )
)

enriched = (
    valid
    .select(
        "*",
        F.rank().over(w).alias("coupon_codes_count_rank"),
        F.cume_dist().over(w2).alias("coupon_codes_count_rounded_cume_dist"),
        F.dense_rank().over(w3).alias("coupon_codes_count_dense_rank"),
    )
)

enriched_carts = (
    enriched
    .select(
        "*",
        F.cume_dist().over(w4).alias("coupon_codes_count_rank_cume_dist"),
        F.cume_dist().over(w5).alias("coupon_codes_count_dense_rank_cume_dist"),
        F.rank().over(w6).alias("coupon_codes_count_rounded_cume_dist_rank"),
    )
)

result = (
    enriched_carts
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("coupon_codes_count_rounded") >= 86, "LARGE").otherwise("SMALL").alias("coupon_codes_count_rounded_tier"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.min("coupon_codes_count_dense_rank_cume_dist").alias("min_coupon_codes_count_dense_rank_cume_dist"),
        F.percentile_approx("coupon_codes_count_dense_rank", [0.25, 0.5, 0.75]).alias("coupon_codes_count_dense_rank_quartiles"),
        F.max("coupon_codes_count_rounded").alias("max_coupon_codes_count_rounded"),
        F.count("*").alias("row_count"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("min_coupon_codes_count_dense_rank_cume_dist").desc())
)

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w_grp = Window.partitionBy("level", "attr_key").orderBy(F.col("latency_ms").desc())
w2 = Window.orderBy("log_ts", "id", "attr_key").rowsBetween(-2, Window.currentRow)
w3 = Window.partitionBy("service").orderBy(F.col("latency_ms").asc_nulls_first())
w4 = Window.partitionBy("attr_key").orderBy("log_ts", "id", "attr_key")
w5 = Window.partitionBy("attr_key").orderBy("log_ts", "id", "attr_key").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w6 = Window.partitionBy("level").orderBy("latency_ms_dense_rank", "id", "attr_key")
w_running = Window.partitionBy("attr_key", "level").orderBy("session_id", "id", "attr_key").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w8 = Window.partitionBy("service").orderBy("latency_ms_dense_rank")

flattened = (
    df_app_logs
    .select(
        "id",
        "service",
        "log_ts",
        "level",
        "latency_ms",
        F.explode("context").alias("attr_key", "attr_value"),
    )
)

enriched = (
    flattened
    .withColumn("latency_ms_cume_dist", F.cume_dist().over(w_grp))
    .withColumn("latency_ms_avg_2", F.avg("latency_ms").over(w2))
    .withColumn("latency_ms_dense_rank", F.dense_rank().over(w3))
)

gaps = (
    enriched
    .withColumn("is_new_session", F.when(F.lag("log_ts").over(w4).isNull() | (F.col("log_ts") > F.lag("log_ts").over(w4) + F.expr("INTERVAL 45 MINUTES")), 1).otherwise(0))
)

sessions_app_logs = gaps.withColumn("session_id", F.sum("is_new_session").over(w5))

enriched_app_logs = (
    sessions_app_logs
    .withColumn("prev_latency_ms", F.lag("latency_ms", 1).over(w6))
    .withColumn("last_known_attr_key", F.last("attr_key", ignorenulls=True).over(w_running))
)

deduped = (
    enriched_app_logs
    .withColumn("latest_rank", F.rank().over(w8))
    .filter(F.col("latest_rank") == 1)
)

result = (
    deduped
    .rollup("level")
    .agg(
        F.min("log_ts").alias("started_at"),
        F.count(F.when(F.col("service") == "billing", 1)).alias("billing_rows"),
        F.grouping_id().alias("grouping_id"),
    )
)

    CASE WHEN latency_ms >= 2505 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END AS latency_ms_tier,

WITH latest AS (
    SELECT *, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY dept_name ORDER BY budget DESC) AS latest_rank
    FROM departments
    QUALIFY latest_rank = 1
),
scored AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY location ORDER BY budget NULLS FIRST) AS budget_percent_rank,
        NTILE(4) OVER (PARTITION BY dept_name ORDER BY budget DESC, id) AS budget_bucket
    FROM latest
),
matched_keys AS (
    SELECT dept_name
    FROM scored
    EXCEPT ALL
    SELECT dept_name
    FROM departments
    WHERE budget < 1177000
),
verified AS (
    SELECT s.*
    FROM scored s
    JOIN matched_keys k ON s.dept_name = k.dept_name
),
base AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        dept_name,
        location,
        budget_percent_rank,
        budget_bucket,
        CASE WHEN budget_percent_rank >= 0.63 THEN 'High' WHEN budget_percent_rank >= 0.16 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END AS budget_percent_rank_tier
    FROM verified
    WHERE budget_bucket >= 4
),
not_flagged AS (
    SELECT s.*
    FROM base s
    WHERE EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM employees c
            WHERE c.dept_id = s.id
              AND c.manager_id = 26
        )
),
scored_departments AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        AVG(budget_bucket) OVER (PARTITION BY location) AS location_avg_budget_bucket,
        SUM(budget_bucket) OVER (PARTITION BY location) AS location_sum_budget_bucket,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY budget_bucket DESC NULLS FIRST) AS budget_bucket_dense_rank
    FROM not_flagged
),
cleaned AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        location,
        location_avg_budget_bucket,
        location_sum_budget_bucket,
        budget_bucket_dense_rank,
        CONCAT_WS(',', location, dept_name) AS location_dept_name_key,
        LOWER(location) AS location_lower
    FROM scored_departments
    WHERE location_avg_budget_bucket BETWEEN 3 AND 5
),
daily AS (
    SELECT
        CASE WHEN location_avg_budget_bucket >= 7 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END AS location_avg_budget_bucket_tier,
        CASE WHEN budget_bucket_dense_rank >= 7 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END AS budget_bucket_dense_rank_tier,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE location = 'Chiang Mai') AS chiang_mai_rows,
        ROUND(SUM(location_sum_budget_bucket) / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN location = 'Singapore' THEN 1 END), 0), 2) AS location_sum_budget_bucket_per_singapore,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE location = 'Bangkok') AS bangkok_rows
    FROM cleaned
    GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((CASE WHEN location_avg_budget_bucket >= 7 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END, CASE WHEN budget_bucket_dense_rank >= 7 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END), (CASE WHEN location_avg_budget_bucket >= 7 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END))
)
SELECT
    budget_bucket_dense_rank_tier,
    location_sum_budget_bucket_per_singapore,
    bangkok_rows
FROM daily;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("dept_name").orderBy(F.col("budget").desc())
w2 = Window.partitionBy("location").orderBy(F.col("budget").asc_nulls_first())
w3 = Window.partitionBy("dept_name").orderBy(F.col("budget").desc(), "id")
w4 = Window.partitionBy("location")
w5 = Window.orderBy(F.col("budget_bucket").desc_nulls_first())

latest = (
    df_departments
    .withColumn("latest_rank", F.rank().over(w))
    .filter(F.col("latest_rank") == 1)
)

scored = (
    latest
    .select(
        "*",
        F.percent_rank().over(w2).alias("budget_percent_rank"),
        F.ntile(4).over(w3).alias("budget_bucket"),
    )
)

matched_keys = (
    scored
    .select("dept_name")
    .exceptAll(
        df_departments
        .filter(F.col("budget") < 1177000)
        .select("dept_name")
    )
)

verified = (
    scored
    .alias("s")
    .join(matched_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.dept_name") == F.col("k.dept_name")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

base = (
    verified
    .filter(F.col("budget_bucket") >= 4)
    .select(
        "id",
        "dept_name",
        "location",
        "budget_percent_rank",
        "budget_bucket",
        F.when(F.col("budget_percent_rank") >= 0.63, "High").when(F.col("budget_percent_rank") >= 0.16, "Medium").otherwise("Low").alias("budget_percent_rank_tier"),
    )
)

not_flagged = (
    base
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_employees.alias("c"), (F.col("c.dept_id") == F.col("s.id")) & (F.col("c.manager_id") == 26), "left_semi")
)

scored_departments = (
    not_flagged
    .select(
        "*",
        F.avg("budget_bucket").over(w4).alias("location_avg_budget_bucket"),
        F.sum("budget_bucket").over(w4).alias("location_sum_budget_bucket"),
        F.dense_rank().over(w5).alias("budget_bucket_dense_rank"),
    )
)

cleaned = (
    scored_departments
    .filter(F.col("location_avg_budget_bucket").between(3, 5))
    .select(
        "id",
        "location",
        "location_avg_budget_bucket",
        "location_sum_budget_bucket",
        "budget_bucket_dense_rank",
        F.concat_ws(",", "location", "dept_name").alias("location_dept_name_key"),
        F.lower("location").alias("location_lower"),
    )
)

daily = (
    cleaned
    .withColumn("location_avg_budget_bucket_tier", F.when(F.col("location_avg_budget_bucket") >= 7, "LARGE").otherwise("SMALL"))
    .withColumn("budget_bucket_dense_rank_tier", F.when(F.col("budget_bucket_dense_rank") >= 7, "PREMIUM").otherwise("STANDARD"))
    .groupingSets(
        [["location_avg_budget_bucket_tier", "budget_bucket_dense_rank_tier"], ["location_avg_budget_bucket_tier"]],
        "location_avg_budget_bucket_tier",
        "budget_bucket_dense_rank_tier",
    )
    .agg(
        F.count(F.when(F.col("location") == "Chiang Mai", 1)).alias("chiang_mai_rows"),
        F.round(F.sum("location_sum_budget_bucket") / F.nullif(F.count(F.when(F.col("location") == "Singapore", 1)), F.lit(0)), 2).alias("location_sum_budget_bucket_per_singapore"),
        F.count(F.when(F.col("location") == "Bangkok", 1)).alias("bangkok_rows"),
    )
)

result = (
    daily
    .select(
        "budget_bucket_dense_rank_tier",
        "location_sum_budget_bucket_per_singapore",
        "bangkok_rows",
    )
)

WITH base AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT
        id,
        customer_id,
        balance,
        opened_date,
        status,
        LOWER(account_type) AS account_type_lower
    FROM accounts
    WHERE balance < 33000
),
deduped AS (
    -- QUALIFY-style window filter
    SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id, status ORDER BY opened_date NULLS FIRST, id) AS dedup_rank
    FROM base
    QUALIFY dedup_rank = 1
),
not_flagged AS (
    -- Semi-join via a correlated subquery
    SELECT s.*
    FROM deduped s
    WHERE EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM transactions c
            WHERE c.account_id = s.id
              AND c.txn_time < s.opened_date
        )
),
enriched AS (
    -- Attach customers attributes
    SELECT src.*, b.signup_date
    FROM not_flagged src
    LEFT JOIN customers b
        ON src.customer_id = b.id
)
-- Grouped metrics
SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', signup_date) AS year_start,
    DATE_TRUNC('QUARTER', opened_date) AS quarter_start,
    COUNT_IF(status = 'CLOSED') AS closed_events,
    COUNT_IF(status = 'FROZEN') AS frozen_events,
    SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_SET(status)) AS status_list,
    COUNT_IF(status = 'OPEN') AS open_events
FROM enriched
GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', signup_date), DATE_TRUNC('QUARTER', opened_date);

base = (
    df_accounts
    .filter(F.col("balance") < 33000)
    .select(
        "id",
        "customer_id",
        "balance",
        "opened_date",
        "status",
        F.lower("account_type").alias("account_type_lower"),
    )
)

deduped = (
    base
    .withColumn("dedup_rank", F.row_number().over(w))
    .filter(F.col("dedup_rank") == 1)
)

not_flagged = (
    deduped
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_transactions.alias("c"), (F.col("c.account_id") == F.col("s.id")) & (F.col("c.txn_time") < F.col("s.opened_date")), "left_semi")
)

    not_flagged
    .alias("src")
    .join(df_customers.alias("b"), F.col("src.customer_id") == F.col("b.id"), "left")
    .select("src.*", F.col("b.signup_date"))
)

result = (
    enriched
    .groupBy(
        F.date_trunc("YEAR", "signup_date").alias("year_start"),
        F.date_trunc("QUARTER", "opened_date").alias("quarter_start"),

        F.sort_array(F.collect_set("status")).alias("status_list"),
        F.count_if(F.col("status") == "OPEN").alias("open_events"),
    )
)

sql: with unpacked as (select id, plan, currency, tier_prices, discounts, zip_with(tier_prices, discounts, (p, d) -> round(p * (1 - d), 2)) as net_prices, element_at(tier_prices, 1) as entry_price, transform(tier_prices, (p, i) -> round(p * tier_limits[i], 2)) as tier_revenue_caps, slice(tier_limits, 1, 2) as first_two_limits, aggregate(tier_prices, 0D, (acc, p) -> acc + p, acc -> round(acc / size(tier_prices), 2)) as avg_tier_price from price_tiers where plan in ('basic', 'pro', 'starter')) select case when avg_tier_price >= 27 then 'PREMIUM' else 'STANDARD' end as avg_tier_price_tier, plan, round(sum(avg_tier_price) / nullif(count(case when currency = 'EUR' then 1 end), 0), 2) as avg_tier_price_per_eur, count(distinct plan) as distinct_plans from unpacked group by cube (case when avg_tier_price >= 27 then 'PREMIUM' else 'STANDARD' end, plan) having distinct_plans > 1 order by avg_tier_price_per_eur desc;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

unpacked = (
    df_price_tiers
    .filter(F.col("plan").isin(["basic", "pro", "starter"]))
    .select(
        "id",
        "plan",
        "currency",
        "tier_prices",
        "discounts",
        F.zip_with("tier_prices", "discounts", lambda p, d: F.round(p * (1 - d), 2)).alias("net_prices"),
        F.element_at("tier_prices", 1).alias("entry_price"),
        F.transform("tier_prices", lambda p, i: F.round(p * F.col("tier_limits")[i], 2)).alias("tier_revenue_caps"),
        F.slice("tier_limits", 1, 2).alias("first_two_limits"),
        F.aggregate("tier_prices", F.lit(0.0), lambda acc, p: acc + p, lambda acc: F.round(acc / F.size("tier_prices"), 2)).alias("avg_tier_price"),
    )
)

result = (
    unpacked
    .cube(
        F.when(F.col("avg_tier_price") >= 27, "PREMIUM").otherwise("STANDARD").alias("avg_tier_price_tier"),
        "plan",
    )
    .agg(
        F.round(F.sum("avg_tier_price") / F.nullif(F.count(F.when(F.col("currency") == "EUR", 1)), F.lit(0)), 2).alias("avg_tier_price_per_eur"),
        F.countDistinct("plan").alias("distinct_plans"),

WITH flattened AS (

    SELECT
        id,
        plan,
        effective_from,
        currency,
        EXPLODE_OUTER(discounts) AS element
    FROM price_tiers
),
with_windows AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        *,
        COUNT(element) OVER (PARTITION BY plan) plan_count_element,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY plan ORDER BY element) element_rank,
        PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY element DESC) element_percent_rank,
        PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY plan ORDER BY element DESC NULLS LAST) element_percent_rank_2,
        SUM(element) OVER (PARTITION BY currency) currency_sum_element
    FROM flattened
),
cleaned AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        id,
        effective_from,
        currency,
        element,
        plan_count_element,
        element_rank,
        element_percent_rank,
        currency_sum_element,
        CASE WHEN element_percent_rank >= 0.78 THEN 'High' WHEN element_percent_rank >= 0.26 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END element_percent_rank_band,
        element_percent_rank_2 * element_percent_rank element_percent_rank_2_times_element_percent_rank
    FROM with_windows
    WHERE element_percent_rank_2 <= 0.29
),
enriched AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        id,
        effective_from,
        currency,
        element,
        plan_count_element,
        element_rank,
        element_percent_rank,
        currency_sum_element,
        element_percent_rank_band,
        element_percent_rank_2_times_element_percent_rank,
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY element_percent_rank_2_times_element_percent_rank DESC NULLS FIRST) element_percent_rank_2_times_element_percent_rank_rank,
        PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY element DESC) element_percent_rank_2
    FROM cleaned
),
grouped AS (
    -- Multi-level aggregation
    SELECT
        CASE WHEN currency_sum_element >= 324 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END AS currency_sum_element_tier,
        CASE WHEN element_percent_rank_2_times_element_percent_rank >= 79 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END AS element_percent_rank_2_times_element_percent_rank_tier,
        ROUND(SUM(element_percent_rank_2_times_element_percent_rank) / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN currency = 'USD' THEN 1 END), 0), 2) AS element_percent_rank_2_times_element_percent_rank_per_usd,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE currency = 'USD') AS usd_rows,
        SUM(CASE WHEN currency = 'USD' THEN currency_sum_element ELSE 0 END) AS usd_currency_sum_element,
        ROUND(SUM(element) / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN currency = 'THB' THEN 1 END), 0), 2) AS element_per_thb,
        AVG(currency_sum_element) FILTER (WHERE currency = 'USD') AS usd_avg_currency_sum_element,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE currency = 'THB') AS thb_rows
    FROM enriched
    GROUP BY CASE WHEN currency_sum_element >= 324 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END, CASE WHEN element_percent_rank_2_times_element_percent_rank >= 79 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END
    HAVING usd_rows < 1
)
SELECT
    currency_sum_element_tier,
    element_percent_rank_2_times_element_percent_rank_tier,
    element_percent_rank_2_times_element_percent_rank_per_usd,
    usd_rows,
    usd_currency_sum_element,
    element_per_thb,
    usd_avg_currency_sum_element,
    thb_rows
FROM grouped
ORDER BY thb_rows DESC

w3 = Window.orderBy(F.col("element").desc())

    .withColumn("element_rank", F.rank().over(w2))
    .withColumn("element_percent_rank", F.percent_rank().over(w3))

    .filter(F.col("usd_rows") < 1)

    FROM accounts

    COUNT(DISTINCT id) AS distinct_ids,
    PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY CASE WHEN balance >= 79000 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END ORDER BY SIZE(COLLECT_SET(status)) DESC) AS num_status_percent_rank
FROM kept_rows
GROUP BY balance_tier, year_start
HAVING COUNT_IF(account_type = 'SAVINGS') < 1
ORDER BY max_balance NULLS LAST;

with with_window as (
    -- Non-equi join on a validity window
    select
        e.*,
        sub.id as subscription_id,
        sub.plan,
        sub.monthly_fee
    from orders e
    left join subscriptions sub
        on e.customer_id = sub.customer_id
       and e.order_date between sub.start_date and sub.end_date
),
eligible as (
    -- Semi-join via a correlated subquery
    select s.*
    from with_window s
    where exists (
            select 1
            from payments x
            where x.order_id = s.id
              and x.paid_at <= s.order_date
        )
),
latest_match as (
    -- Latest matching order_item per row (LATERAL ... LIMIT 1)
    select
        s.*,
        x.order_item_unit_price,
        x.order_item_quantity
    from eligible s
    left join lateral (
            select c.unit_price as order_item_unit_price, c.quantity as order_item_quantity
            from order_items c
            where c.order_id = s.id
            order by c.quantity desc, c.id desc
            limit 1
        ) x on true
),
latest as (
    -- Keep one row per key (latest first)
    select *
    from latest_match
    qualify row_number() over (partition by status order by discount desc nulls last, id, subscription_id) = 1
),
with_latest as (
    -- Latest matching order_item per row (LATERAL ... LIMIT 1)
    select s.*, latest.order_item_unit_price_2
    from latest s
    join lateral (
            select c.unit_price as order_item_unit_price_2
            from order_items c
            where c.order_id = s.id
            order by c.unit_price desc, c.id desc
            limit 1
        ) latest on true
)
-- Multi-level aggregation
select
    case when monthly_fee >= 222 then 'PREMIUM' else 'STANDARD' end as monthly_fee_tier,
    stddev_samp(discount) as discount_stddev,
    sort_array(collect_set(plan)) as plan_list,
    count_if(channel = 'store') as store_events
from with_latest
group by case when monthly_fee >= 222 then 'PREMIUM' else 'STANDARD' end
order by store_events desc nulls last

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy(F.col("s.id"), F.col("s.subscription_id")).orderBy(F.col("c.quantity").desc(), F.col("c.id").desc())
w2 = Window.partitionBy("status").orderBy(F.col("discount").desc_nulls_last(), "id", "subscription_id")
w3 = Window.partitionBy(F.col("s.id"), F.col("s.subscription_id")).orderBy(F.col("c.unit_price").desc(), F.col("c.id").desc())

with_window = (
    df_orders
    .alias("e")
    .join(df_subscriptions.alias("sub"), (F.col("e.customer_id") == F.col("sub.customer_id")) & F.col("e.order_date").between(F.col("sub.start_date"), F.col("sub.end_date")), "left")
    .select(
        "e.*",
        F.col("sub.id").alias("subscription_id"),
        F.col("sub.plan"),
        F.col("sub.monthly_fee"),
    )
)

eligible = (
    with_window
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_payments.alias("x"), (F.col("x.order_id") == F.col("s.id")) & (F.col("x.paid_at") <= F.col("s.order_date")), "left_semi")
)

latest_match = (
    eligible
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_order_items.alias("c"), (F.col("c.order_id") == F.col("s.id")), "left")
    .withColumn("rn", F.row_number().over(w))
    .filter(F.col("rn") == 1)
    .select(
        "s.*",
        F.col("c.unit_price").alias("order_item_unit_price"),
        F.col("c.quantity").alias("order_item_quantity"),
    )
)

latest = (
    latest_match
    .withColumn("latest_rank", F.row_number().over(w2))
    .filter(F.col("latest_rank") == 1)
    .drop("latest_rank")
)

with_latest = (
    latest
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_order_items.alias("c"), (F.col("c.order_id") == F.col("s.id")), "inner")
    .withColumn("rn", F.row_number().over(w3))
    .filter(F.col("rn") == 1)
    .select("s.*", F.col("c.unit_price").alias("order_item_unit_price_2"))
)

result = (
    with_latest
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("monthly_fee") >= 222, "PREMIUM").otherwise("STANDARD").alias("monthly_fee_tier"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.stddev_samp("discount").alias("discount_stddev"),
        F.sort_array(F.collect_set("plan")).alias("plan_list"),
        F.count_if(F.col("channel") == "store").alias("store_events"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("store_events").desc_nulls_last())
)

code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

parsed = (
    df_price_tiers
    .select(
        "id",
        "tier_limits",
        "tier_prices",
        F.aggregate("tier_prices", F.lit(0.0), lambda acc, p: acc + p, lambda acc: F.round(acc / F.size("tier_prices"), 2)).alias("avg_tier_price"),
        F.slice("tier_limits", 1, 2).alias("first_two_limits"),
        F.transform("tier_prices", lambda p, i: F.round(p * F.col("tier_limits")[i], 2)).alias("tier_revenue_caps"),
        F.array_min("tier_prices").alias("lowest_price"),
    )
)

result = (
    parsed
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("lowest_price") >= 28, "HIGH").otherwise("LOW").alias("lowest_price_tier"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.countDistinct("id").alias("distinct_ids"),
        F.count("*").alias("num_rows"),
        F.count("*").alias("event_count"),
        F.round(F.avg("lowest_price"), 2).alias("avg_lowest_price"),
        F.percentile_approx("lowest_price", 0.9).alias("lowest_price_p90"),
        F.max("avg_tier_price").alias("max_avg_tier_price"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("num_rows") >= 1)
    .orderBy(F.col("lowest_price_p90").asc_nulls_last())
)

sql: WITH cleaned AS (SELECT id, customer_id, device, browser, started_at, country, CONCAT(country, '/', device) AS country_device, COALESCE(browser, 'N/A') AS resolved_browser FROM sessions WHERE customer_id IS NOT NULL AND country IN ('SG', 'UK', 'JP')), valid AS (SELECT id, customer_id, device, browser, country, country_device, resolved_browser, INITCAP(TRIM(country)) AS country_title FROM cleaned WHERE device IN ('desktop', 'tablet', 'mobile')), cleaned_sessions AS (SELECT id, customer_id, device, browser, country_device, resolved_browser, country_title, LENGTH(browser) AS browser_length, CONCAT(browser, '/', country) AS browser_country FROM valid WHERE browser IS NOT NULL AND device = 'tablet'), kept_keys AS (SELECT id, customer_id FROM cleaned_sessions INTERSECT SELECT id, customer_id FROM sessions WHERE browser = 'Edge'), verified AS (SELECT s.* FROM cleaned_sessions s INNER JOIN kept_keys k ON s.id = k.id AND s.customer_id = k.customer_id), eligible AS (SELECT s.* FROM verified s WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM web_events x WHERE x.session_id = s.id AND x.duration_sec BETWEEN 174 AND 202)), enriched AS (SELECT s.*, p.segment, p.city FROM eligible s INNER JOIN customers p ON s.customer_id = p.id) SELECT CASE WHEN browser_length >= 73 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END AS browser_length_tier, ROUND(SUM(browser_length) / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN city = 'London' THEN 1 END), 0), 2) AS browser_length_per_london, ROUND(AVG(browser_length), 2) AS avg_browser_length, ROUND(SUM(browser_length) / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN device = 'desktop' THEN 1 END), 0), 2) AS browser_length_per_desktop, SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_SET(segment)) AS segment_list, PERCENTILE_APPROX(browser_length, 0.95) AS browser_length_p95 FROM enriched GROUP BY CASE WHEN browser_length >= 73 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END ORDER BY browser_length_per_london DESC NULLS LAST
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

cleaned = (
    df_sessions
    .filter(F.col("customer_id").isNotNull() & F.col("country").isin(["SG", "UK", "JP"]))
    .select(
        "id",
        "customer_id",
        "device",
        "browser",
        "started_at",
        "country",
        F.concat("country", F.lit("/"), "device").alias("country_device"),
        F.coalesce("browser", F.lit("N/A")).alias("resolved_browser"),
    )
)

valid = (
    cleaned
    .filter(F.col("device").isin(["desktop", "tablet", "mobile"]))
    .select(
        "id",
        "customer_id",
        "device",
        "browser",
        "country",
        "country_device",
        "resolved_browser",
        F.initcap(F.trim("country")).alias("country_title"),
    )
)

cleaned_sessions = (
    valid
    .filter(F.col("browser").isNotNull() & (F.col("device") == "tablet"))
    .select(
        "id",
        "customer_id",
        "device",
        "browser",
        "country_device",
        "resolved_browser",
        "country_title",
        F.length("browser").alias("browser_length"),
        F.concat("browser", F.lit("/"), "country").alias("browser_country"),
    )
)

kept_keys = (
    cleaned_sessions
    .select("id", "customer_id")
    .intersect(
        df_sessions
        .filter(F.col("browser") == "Edge")
        .select("id", "customer_id")
    )
)

verified = (
    cleaned_sessions
    .alias("s")
    .join(kept_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.id") == F.col("k.id")) & (F.col("s.customer_id") == F.col("k.customer_id")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

eligible = (
    verified
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_web_events.alias("x"), (F.col("x.session_id") == F.col("s.id")) & (F.col("x.duration_sec").between(174, 202)), "left_anti")
)

enriched = (
    eligible
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_customers.alias("p"), F.col("s.customer_id") == F.col("p.id"), "inner")
    .select("s.*", F.col("p.segment"), F.col("p.city"))
)

result = (
    enriched
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("browser_length") >= 73, "LARGE").otherwise("SMALL").alias("browser_length_tier"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.round(F.sum("browser_length") / F.nullif(F.count(F.when(F.col("city") == "London", 1)), F.lit(0)), 2).alias("browser_length_per_london"),
        F.round(F.avg("browser_length"), 2).alias("avg_browser_length"),
        F.round(F.sum("browser_length") / F.nullif(F.count(F.when(F.col("device") == "desktop", 1)), F.lit(0)), 2).alias("browser_length_per_desktop"),
        F.sort_array(F.collect_set("segment")).alias("segment_list"),
        F.percentile_approx("browser_length", 0.95).alias("browser_length_p95"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("browser_length_per_london").desc_nulls_last())
)

        starts_on,

        discount_pct,
        CONCAT_WS('-', channel, promo_code) AS channel_promo_code_key,

    FROM promotions
    WHERE channel IS NOT NULL
      AND promo_code IN ('SPRING10', 'VIP', 'BUNDLE')
),
ranked AS (
    -- QUALIFY-style window filter
    SELECT *
    FROM (
        SELECT *, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY channel ORDER BY ends_on DESC) AS rn
        FROM filtered
    ) x
    WHERE rn = 1
),
base AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT
        *,
        DAYOFWEEK(ends_on) AS ends_on_dayofweek,
        COALESCE(channel, 'N/A') AS channel_clean
    FROM ranked
    WHERE ends_on >= DATE '2023-11-17'
      AND rn <= 1
),
filtered_promotions AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT
        *,
        LOWER(channel) AS channel_lower,
        COALESCE(channel, 'N/A') AS resolved_channel
    FROM base
    WHERE ends_on_dayofweek < 69
)
-- Native SQL PIVOT
SELECT *
FROM (
    SELECT
        channel,
        promo_code,
        discount_pct
    FROM filtered_promotions
) src
PIVOT (
    SUM(discount_pct)
    FOR promo_code IN ('SPRING10', 'BUNDLE')
);

from pyspark.sql.window import Window

FROM lines

WITH valid AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT *, COALESCE(method, 'unassigned') AS method_filled
    FROM payments
    WHERE order_id IS NOT NULL
),
with_windows AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        id,
        order_id,
        method,
        amount,
        paid_at,
        status,
        method_filled,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY paid_at DESC, id) AS seq_no,
        MAX(amount) OVER (ORDER BY CAST(paid_at AS BIGINT) RANGE BETWEEN 2592000 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS amount_max_30d,
        AVG(amount) OVER (PARTITION BY status ORDER BY amount, id ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS amount_avg_6,
        LAST_VALUE(amount, TRUE) OVER (PARTITION BY method ORDER BY paid_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS last_known_amount
    FROM valid
),
ranked AS (
    -- Deduplicate with ROW_NUMBER
    SELECT *
    FROM (
        SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY method ORDER BY last_known_amount DESC, id) AS rn
        FROM with_windows
    ) ranked
    WHERE rn = 1
)
SELECT
    s.id,
    s.order_id,
    s.amount,
    s.paid_at,
    s.status,
    s.method_filled,
    s.seq_no,
    s.amount_max_30d,
    s.amount_avg_6,
    (SELECT SUM(s2.cost) FROM shipments s2 WHERE s2.order_id = s.order_id) AS sum_shipment_cost
FROM ranked s
ORDER BY seq_no NULLS FIRST, amount_max_30d

from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w4 = Window.partitionBy("method").orderBy("paid_at", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w5 = Window.partitionBy("method").orderBy(F.col("last_known_amount").desc(), "id")

    .withColumn("last_known_amount", F.last("amount", ignorenulls=True).over(w4))

    .withColumn("rn", F.row_number().over(w5))

    FROM customers
    QUALIFY row_num = 1

with_windows AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        NTILE(10) OVER (PARTITION BY segment ORDER BY credit_limit, id) credit_limit_bucket,

        NTILE(3) OVER (PARTITION BY segment, country ORDER BY credit_limit, id) credit_limit_bucket_2,

        credit_limit,
        age,

        CUME_DIST() OVER (PARTITION BY city, country ORDER BY corr_age_credit_limit DESC) corr_age_credit_limit_cume_dist,
        ROUND(credit_limit_bucket / SUM(credit_limit_bucket) OVER (PARTITION BY country), 4) credit_limit_bucket_share
    FROM with_windows

    BIT_AND(age) AS age_bit_and,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN country = 'UK' THEN 1 END) AS uk_count,
    ROUND(SUM(credit_limit_bucket) / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN city = 'Singapore' THEN 1 END), 0), 2) AS credit_limit_bucket_per_singapore

WITH cleaned AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT
        id,
        order_id,
        method,
        amount,
        status,
        CASE WHEN amount >= 1230 THEN 'High' WHEN amount >= 560 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END AS amount_level,
        COALESCE(method, 'OTHER') AS method_clean
    FROM payments
    WHERE paid_at > DATE '2024-04-11'
      AND paid_at < '2024-03-01'
)
-- Native SQL PIVOT
SELECT *
FROM (
    SELECT
        order_id,
        status,
        amount
    FROM cleaned
) src
PIVOT (
    AVG(amount) AS value_sum,
    COUNT(1) AS cnt
    FOR status IN ('FAILED' AS failed, 'REFUNDED' AS refunded)
);

from pyspark.sql import functions as F

cleaned = (
    df_payments
    .filter((F.col("paid_at") > F.lit("2024-04-11").cast("date")) & (F.col("paid_at") < "2024-03-01"))
    .select(
        "id",
        "order_id",
        "method",
        "amount",
        "status",
        F.when(F.col("amount") >= 1230, "High").when(F.col("amount") >= 560, "Medium").otherwise("Low").alias("amount_level"),
        F.coalesce("method", F.lit("OTHER")).alias("method_clean"),
    )
)

result = (
    cleaned
    .groupBy("order_id")
    .pivot("status", ["FAILED", "REFUNDED"])
    .agg(F.avg("amount").alias("value_sum"), F.count(F.lit(1)).alias("cnt"))
    .select(
        "order_id",
        F.col("FAILED_value_sum").alias("failed_value_sum"),
        F.col("FAILED_cnt").alias("failed_cnt"),
        F.col("REFUNDED_value_sum").alias("refunded_value_sum"),
        F.col("REFUNDED_cnt").alias("refunded_cnt"),
    )
)

WITH filtered AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        *,
        DATEDIFF(shipped_date, delivered_date) AS days_delivered_date_to_shipped_date,
        CONCAT(status, ' - ', carrier) AS status_carrier
    FROM shipments
    WHERE delivered_date > TO_DATE('2023-08-21')
      AND status IN ('RETURNED', 'LOST')
),
with_dims AS (
    -- Attach orders attributes
    SELECT
        a.*,
        o.order_date,
        o.shipping_fee,
        o.discount
    FROM filtered a
    LEFT JOIN orders o
        ON a.order_id = o.id
),
scored AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        id,
        order_id,
        carrier,
        shipped_date,
        delivered_date,
        cost,
        status,
        days_delivered_date_to_shipped_date,
        status_carrier,
        order_date,
        shipping_fee,
        discount,
        AVG(discount) OVER (ORDER BY order_date, id ROWS BETWEEN 5 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS discount_avg_5,
        LAST_VALUE(cost, TRUE) OVER (PARTITION BY order_id ORDER BY discount, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS last_known_cost,
        SUM(discount) OVER w_ordered AS running_discount,
        SUM(discount) OVER (ORDER BY shipped_date, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_discount
    FROM with_dims
    WINDOW w_ordered AS (PARTITION BY status ORDER BY days_delivered_date_to_shipped_date, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)
),
enriched AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        *,
        AVG(running_discount) OVER w_grp AS running_discount_avg_6,
        SUM(cumulative_discount) OVER w_ordered AS cumulative_cumulative_discount
    FROM scored
    WINDOW w_grp AS (PARTITION BY carrier ORDER BY discount, id ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), w_ordered AS (ORDER BY delivered_date, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)
),
deduped AS (
    -- Keep one row per key (latest first)
    SELECT *
    FROM (
        SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY status ORDER BY discount_avg_5 DESC, id) AS dedup_rank
        FROM enriched
    ) ranked
    WHERE dedup_rank = 1
),
matched_keys AS (
    -- Set difference on keys
    SELECT status
    FROM deduped
    EXCEPT ALL
    SELECT status
    FROM shipments
    WHERE carrier IN ('UPS', 'FedEx', 'Kerry')
),
verified AS (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    SELECT s.*
    FROM deduped s
    INNER JOIN matched_keys k ON s.status = k.status
),
scored_shipments AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        id,
        order_id,
        carrier,
        shipped_date,
        delivered_date,
        cost,
        status,
        days_delivered_date_to_shipped_date,
        status_carrier,
        order_date,
        shipping_fee,
        discount,
        discount_avg_5,
        last_known_cost,
        running_discount,
        cumulative_discount,
        running_discount_avg_6,
        cumulative_cumulative_discount,
        dedup_rank,
        MIN(discount) OVER (PARTITION BY carrier) AS carrier_min_discount,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY order_id, status ORDER BY cost DESC NULLS LAST) AS cost_rank
    FROM verified
)
SELECT
    s.id,
    s.order_id,
    s.status,
    s.days_delivered_date_to_shipped_date,
    s.status_carrier,
    s.order_date,
    s.shipping_fee,
    s.last_known_cost,
    s.running_discount,
    (SELECT MIN(t2.unit_price) FROM order_items t2 WHERE t2.order_id = s.order_id) AS min_order_item_unit_price
FROM scored_shipments s
ORDER BY running_discount DESC

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.orderBy("order_date", "id").rowsBetween(-5, Window.currentRow)
w2 = Window.partitionBy("order_id").orderBy("discount", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w_ordered = Window.partitionBy("status").orderBy("days_delivered_date_to_shipped_date", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w4 = Window.orderBy("shipped_date", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w_grp = Window.partitionBy("carrier").orderBy("discount", "id").rowsBetween(-6, Window.currentRow)
w6 = Window.orderBy("delivered_date", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w7 = Window.partitionBy("status").orderBy(F.col("discount_avg_5").desc(), "id")
w8 = Window.partitionBy("carrier")
w9 = Window.partitionBy("order_id", "status").orderBy(F.col("cost").desc_nulls_last())
unit_price_by_order_id = df_order_items.groupBy("order_id").agg(F.min("unit_price").alias("min_order_item_unit_price"))

filtered = (
    df_shipments
    .filter((F.col("delivered_date") > F.to_date(F.lit("2023-08-21"))) & F.col("status").isin(["RETURNED", "LOST"]))
    .withColumn("days_delivered_date_to_shipped_date", F.datediff("shipped_date", "delivered_date"))
    .withColumn("status_carrier", F.concat("status", F.lit(" - "), "carrier"))
)

with_dims = (
    filtered
    .alias("a")
    .join(df_orders.alias("o"), F.col("a.order_id") == F.col("o.id"), "left")
    .select("a.*", F.col("o.order_date"), F.col("o.shipping_fee"), F.col("o.discount"))
)

scored = (
    with_dims
    .select(
        "*",
        F.avg("discount").over(w).alias("discount_avg_5"),
        F.last("cost", ignorenulls=True).over(w2).alias("last_known_cost"),
        F.sum("discount").over(w_ordered).alias("running_discount"),
        F.sum("discount").over(w4).alias("cumulative_discount"),
    )
)

enriched = (
    scored
    .withColumn("running_discount_avg_6", F.avg("running_discount").over(w_grp))
    .withColumn("cumulative_cumulative_discount", F.sum("cumulative_discount").over(w6))
)

deduped = (
    enriched
    .withColumn("dedup_rank", F.row_number().over(w7))
    .filter(F.col("dedup_rank") == 1)
)

matched_keys = (
    deduped
    .select("status")
    .exceptAll(
        df_shipments
        .filter(F.col("carrier").isin(["UPS", "FedEx", "Kerry"]))
        .select("status")
    )
)

verified = (
    deduped
    .alias("s")
    .join(matched_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.status") == F.col("k.status")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

scored_shipments = (
    verified
    .select(
        "*",
        F.min("discount").over(w8).alias("carrier_min_discount"),
        F.rank().over(w9).alias("cost_rank"),
    )
)

result = (
    scored_shipments
    .join(unit_price_by_order_id, on="order_id", how="left")
    .select(
        "id",
        "order_id",
        "status",
        "days_delivered_date_to_shipped_date",
        "status_carrier",
        "order_date",
        "shipping_fee",
        "last_known_cost",
        "running_discount",
        F.col("min_order_item_unit_price"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("running_discount").desc())
)

    FROM payments
    WHERE order_id IS NOT NULL

enriched AS (

        b.discount,
        b.shipping_fee

SELECT *
FROM (
    SELECT
        id,
        method,
        shipping_fee,
        discount
    FROM enriched
) src
UNPIVOT INCLUDE NULLS (
    value FOR measure IN (shipping_fee, discount)
);

    FROM products
    EXCEPT ALL
    SELECT supplier_id, category
    FROM products
    WHERE YEAR(launch_date) >= 2023
),
verified AS (

    INNER JOIN matched_keys k ON s.supplier_id = k.supplier_id AND s.category = k.category

SELECT
    supplier_id,
    category,
    ROUND(SUM(cost) / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN brand = 'Globex' THEN 1 END), 0), 2) AS cost_per_globex,
    COUNT(DISTINCT category) AS distinct_categories,
    STDDEV_SAMP(stock_qty) AS stock_qty_stddev,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN brand = 'Initech' THEN 1 END) AS initech_count
FROM verified

with valid as (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    select
        id,
        order_id,
        shipped_date,
        delivered_date,
        cost,
        status,
        round(cost * 0.9, 2) as cost_adjusted
    from shipments
    where order_id is not null
      and delivered_date between '2024-09-19' and '2025-01-11'

with_windows as (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    select
        id,
        order_id,
        shipped_date,
        delivered_date,
        cost,
        status,
        cost_adjusted,
        ntile(5) over (partition by order_id order by cost desc, id) as cost_bucket,
        row_number() over (partition by order_id order by delivered_date desc, id) as seq_no,
        row_number() over (partition by order_id order by delivered_date, id) as seq_no_2
    from valid
),
deduped as (
    -- QUALIFY-style window filter
    select *, row_number() over (partition by status, order_id order by seq_no_2 desc nulls last, id) as dedup_rank
    from with_windows
    qualify dedup_rank = 1
)
select
    s.id,
    s.order_id,
    s.shipped_date,
    s.delivered_date,
    s.cost_adjusted,
    s.seq_no,
    s.seq_no_2,

from deduped s

w4 = Window.partitionBy("status", "order_id").orderBy(F.col("seq_no_2").desc_nulls_last(), "id")

with filtered as (
    select
        *,
        round(amount * 1.15, 2) as amount_scaled,
        concat_ws('-', method, status) as method_status_key
    from payments
    where paid_at >= timestamp '2023-05-16 09:00:00'
),
joined as (
    select a.*, b.discount
    from filtered a
    inner join orders b
        on a.order_id = b.id
),
remaining_keys as (
    select order_id, id
    from joined
    except all
    select order_id, id
    from payments
    where order_id in (3, 9, 21, 37)
),
reconciled as (
    select s.*
    from joined s
    inner join remaining_keys k on s.order_id = k.order_id and s.id = k.id
),
scored as (
    select
        *,
        dense_rank() over (partition by order_id order by amount_scaled nulls first) as amount_scaled_dense_rank,
        avg(discount) over (partition by method order by cast(paid_at as bigint) range between 2592000 preceding and current row) as discount_avg_30d,
        count(amount) over (order by cast(paid_at as bigint) range between 604800 preceding and current row) as amount_count_7d
    from reconciled
),
metrics as (
    select
        id,
        order_id,
        method,
        amount,
        paid_at,
        status,
        amount_scaled,
        method_status_key,
        discount,
        amount_scaled_dense_rank,
        discount_avg_30d,
        amount_count_7d,
        sum(amount_scaled_dense_rank) over (partition by status) as status_sum_amount_scaled_dense_rank,
        round(amount_scaled_dense_rank / sum(amount_scaled_dense_rank) over (partition by order_id), 4) as amount_scaled_dense_rank_share,
        round(amount / sum(amount) over (partition by status), 4) as amount_share,
        avg(amount_count_7d) over w_hist as amount_count_7d_avg_90d,
        sum(amount_scaled) over (partition by status, order_id) as status_sum_amount_scaled
    from scored
    window w_hist as (partition by method order by cast(paid_at as bigint) range between 7776000 preceding and current row)
),
enriched as (
    select
        id,
        order_id,
        method,
        amount,
        paid_at,
        status,
        amount_scaled,
        method_status_key,
        discount,
        amount_scaled_dense_rank,
        discount_avg_30d,
        amount_count_7d,
        status_sum_amount_scaled_dense_rank,
        amount_scaled_dense_rank_share,
        amount_share,
        amount_count_7d_avg_90d,
        status_sum_amount_scaled,
        sum(amount) over (partition by status, order_id) as status_sum_amount,
        avg(status_sum_amount_scaled_dense_rank) over (partition by status, method order by cast(paid_at as bigint) range between 604800 preceding and current row) as status_sum_amount_scaled_dense_rank_avg_7d
    from metrics
),
valid as (
    select
        id,
        order_id,
        amount,
        paid_at,
        status,
        method_status_key,
        discount,
        amount_scaled_dense_rank,
        discount_avg_30d,
        amount_count_7d,
        amount_share,
        status_sum_amount_scaled,
        status_sum_amount,
        status_sum_amount_scaled_dense_rank_avg_7d,
        cast(status_sum_amount_scaled as string) as status_sum_amount_scaled_num,
        case when status_sum_amount >= 6270 then 'High' when status_sum_amount >= 2876 then 'Medium' else 'Low' end as status_sum_amount_band,
        coalesce(method, 'UNKNOWN') as method_filled
    from enriched
    where paid_at >= timestamp '2024-01-08 23:00:00'
      and method is not null
)
select
    case when amount >= 1330 then 'LARGE' else 'SMALL' end as amount_tier,
    status,
    case when status_sum_amount >= 6413 then 'PREMIUM' else 'STANDARD' end as status_sum_amount_tier,
    round(avg(status_sum_amount_scaled_dense_rank_avg_7d), 2) as avg_status_sum_amount_scaled_dense_rank_avg_7d,
    min(paid_at) as started_at,
    min(paid_at) as started_at_2,
    sum(case when status = 'FAILED' then status_sum_amount else 0 end) as failed_status_sum_amount,
    size(collect_set(status)) as num_status,
    count(case when status = 'SUCCESS' then 1 end) as success_count
from valid
group by amount_tier, status, status_sum_amount_tier
order by status

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("order_id").orderBy(F.col("amount_scaled").asc_nulls_first())
w2 = Window.partitionBy("method").orderBy(F.col("paid_at").cast("bigint")).rangeBetween(-2592000, Window.currentRow)
w3 = Window.orderBy(F.col("paid_at").cast("bigint")).rangeBetween(-604800, Window.currentRow)
w4 = Window.partitionBy("status")
w5 = Window.partitionBy("order_id")
w_hist = Window.partitionBy("method").orderBy(F.col("paid_at").cast("bigint")).rangeBetween(-7776000, Window.currentRow)
w7 = Window.partitionBy("status", "order_id")
w8 = Window.partitionBy("status", "method").orderBy(F.col("paid_at").cast("bigint")).rangeBetween(-604800, Window.currentRow)

filtered = (
    df_payments
    .filter(F.col("paid_at") >= F.lit("2023-05-16 09:00:00").cast("timestamp"))
    .withColumn("amount_scaled", F.round((F.col("amount") * 1.15), 2))
    .withColumn("method_status_key", F.concat_ws("-", "method", "status"))
)

joined = (
    filtered
    .alias("a")
    .join(df_orders.alias("b"), F.col("a.order_id") == F.col("b.id"), "inner")
    .select("a.*", F.col("b.discount"))
)

remaining_keys = (
    joined
    .select("order_id", "id")
    .exceptAll(
        df_payments
        .filter(F.col("order_id").isin([3, 9, 21, 37]))
        .select("order_id", "id")
    )
)

reconciled = (
    joined
    .alias("s")
    .join(remaining_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.order_id") == F.col("k.order_id")) & (F.col("s.id") == F.col("k.id")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

scored = (
    reconciled
    .select(
        "*",
        F.dense_rank().over(w).alias("amount_scaled_dense_rank"),
        F.avg("discount").over(w2).alias("discount_avg_30d"),
        F.count("amount").over(w3).alias("amount_count_7d"),
    )
)

metrics = (
    scored
    .withColumn("status_sum_amount_scaled_dense_rank", F.sum("amount_scaled_dense_rank").over(w4))
    .withColumn("amount_scaled_dense_rank_share", F.round((F.col("amount_scaled_dense_rank") / F.sum("amount_scaled_dense_rank").over(w5)), 4))
    .withColumn("amount_share", F.round((F.col("amount") / F.sum("amount").over(w4)), 4))
    .withColumn("amount_count_7d_avg_90d", F.avg("amount_count_7d").over(w_hist))
    .withColumn("status_sum_amount_scaled", F.sum("amount_scaled").over(w7))
)

enriched = (
    metrics
    .select(
        "*",
        F.sum("amount").over(w7).alias("status_sum_amount"),
        F.avg("status_sum_amount_scaled_dense_rank").over(w8).alias("status_sum_amount_scaled_dense_rank_avg_7d"),
    )
)

valid = (
    enriched
    .filter((F.col("paid_at") >= F.lit("2024-01-08 23:00:00").cast("timestamp")) & F.col("method").isNotNull())
    .select(
        "id",
        "order_id",
        "amount",
        "paid_at",
        "status",
        "method_status_key",
        "discount",
        "amount_scaled_dense_rank",
        "discount_avg_30d",
        "amount_count_7d",
        "amount_share",
        "status_sum_amount_scaled",
        "status_sum_amount",
        "status_sum_amount_scaled_dense_rank_avg_7d",
        F.col("status_sum_amount_scaled").cast("string").alias("status_sum_amount_scaled_num"),
        F.when(F.col("status_sum_amount") >= 6270, "High").when(F.col("status_sum_amount") >= 2876, "Medium").otherwise("Low").alias("status_sum_amount_band"),
        F.coalesce("method", F.lit("UNKNOWN")).alias("method_filled"),
    )
)

result = (
    valid
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("amount") >= 1330, "LARGE").otherwise("SMALL").alias("amount_tier"),
        "status",
        F.when(F.col("status_sum_amount") >= 6413, "PREMIUM").otherwise("STANDARD").alias("status_sum_amount_tier"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.round(F.avg("status_sum_amount_scaled_dense_rank_avg_7d"), 2).alias("avg_status_sum_amount_scaled_dense_rank_avg_7d"),
        F.min("paid_at").alias("started_at"),
        F.min("paid_at").alias("started_at_2"),
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("status") == "FAILED", F.col("status_sum_amount")).otherwise(0)).alias("failed_status_sum_amount"),
        F.size(F.collect_set("status")).alias("num_status"),
        F.count(F.when(F.col("status") == "SUCCESS", 1)).alias("success_count"),
    )
    .orderBy("status")
)

WITH valid AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT
        id,
        store_id,
        product_id,
        sale_date,
        units,
        revenue,
        YEAR(sale_date) AS sale_date_year
    FROM store_sales
    WHERE units < 25
),
deduped AS (
    -- Deduplicate with ROW_NUMBER
    SELECT *
    FROM (
        SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY store_id, product_id ORDER BY sale_date_year DESC NULLS LAST, id) AS rn
        FROM valid
    ) x
    WHERE rn = 1
),
valid_store_sales AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT *, ROUND(revenue, 1) AS revenue_rounded
    FROM deduped
    WHERE sale_date >= TO_DATE('2023-10-09')
      AND units = 37
),
deduped_store_sales AS (
    -- QUALIFY-style window filter
    SELECT *, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY revenue_rounded DESC NULLS LAST) AS dedup_rank
    FROM valid_store_sales
    QUALIFY dedup_rank = 1
),
kept_keys AS (
    -- Set difference on keys
    SELECT product_id, id
    FROM deduped_store_sales
    EXCEPT ALL
    SELECT product_id, id
    FROM store_sales
    WHERE units IS NULL
),
reconciled AS (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    SELECT s.*
    FROM deduped_store_sales s
    INNER JOIN kept_keys k ON s.product_id = k.product_id AND s.id = k.id
),
scored AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        id,
        store_id,
        product_id,
        sale_date,
        units,
        revenue,
        sale_date_year,
        rn,
        revenue_rounded,
        dedup_rank,
        STDDEV_SAMP(sale_date_year) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id) AS product_id_stddev_samp_sale_date_year,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY revenue NULLS LAST) AS revenue_rank,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY units DESC) AS units_rank,
        MIN(sale_date_year) OVER (PARTITION BY store_id) AS store_id_min_sale_date_year
    FROM reconciled
),
metrics AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        id,
        store_id,
        product_id,
        sale_date,
        units,
        revenue,
        sale_date_year,
        rn,
        revenue_rounded,
        dedup_rank,
        product_id_stddev_samp_sale_date_year,
        revenue_rank,
        units_rank,
        store_id_min_sale_date_year,
        ROUND(units / SUM(units) OVER (PARTITION BY store_id), 4) AS units_share,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY revenue_rank DESC NULLS FIRST) AS revenue_rank_rank
    FROM scored
)
-- Multi-level aggregation
SELECT
    product_id,
    DATE_TRUNC('WEEK', sale_date) AS week_start,
    DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', sale_date) AS year_start,
    PERCENTILE_APPROX(revenue_rank_rank, ARRAY(0.25, 0.5, 0.75)) AS revenue_rank_rank_quartiles,
    MIN(store_id_min_sale_date_year) AS min_store_id_min_sale_date_year,
    BIT_OR(units) AS units_bit_or
FROM metrics
GROUP BY product_id, DATE_TRUNC('WEEK', sale_date), DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', sale_date)
HAVING BIT_OR(units) < 1
ORDER BY year_start
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("store_id", "product_id").orderBy(F.col("sale_date_year").desc_nulls_last(), "id")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("product_id").orderBy(F.col("revenue_rounded").desc_nulls_last())
w3 = Window.partitionBy("product_id")
w4 = Window.partitionBy("product_id").orderBy(F.col("revenue").asc_nulls_last())
w5 = Window.partitionBy("product_id").orderBy(F.col("units").desc())
w6 = Window.partitionBy("store_id")
w7 = Window.partitionBy("product_id").orderBy(F.col("revenue_rank").desc_nulls_first())

valid = (
    df_store_sales
    .filter(F.col("units") < 25)
    .select(
        "id",
        "store_id",
        "product_id",
        "sale_date",
        "units",
        "revenue",
        F.year("sale_date").alias("sale_date_year"),
    )
)

deduped = (
    valid
    .withColumn("rn", F.row_number().over(w))
    .filter(F.col("rn") == 1)
)

valid_store_sales = (
    deduped
    .filter((F.col("sale_date") >= F.to_date(F.lit("2023-10-09"))) & (F.col("units") == 37))
    .withColumn("revenue_rounded", F.round("revenue", 1))
)

deduped_store_sales = (
    valid_store_sales
    .withColumn("dedup_rank", F.rank().over(w2))
    .filter(F.col("dedup_rank") == 1)
)

kept_keys = (
    deduped_store_sales
    .select("product_id", "id")
    .exceptAll(
        df_store_sales
        .filter(F.col("units").isNull())
        .select("product_id", "id")
    )
)

reconciled = (
    deduped_store_sales
    .alias("s")
    .join(kept_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.product_id") == F.col("k.product_id")) & (F.col("s.id") == F.col("k.id")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

scored = (
    reconciled
    .select(
        "*",
        F.stddev_samp("sale_date_year").over(w3).alias("product_id_stddev_samp_sale_date_year"),
        F.rank().over(w4).alias("revenue_rank"),
        F.rank().over(w5).alias("units_rank"),
        F.min("sale_date_year").over(w6).alias("store_id_min_sale_date_year"),
    )
)

metrics = (
    scored
    .withColumn("units_share", F.round((F.col("units") / F.sum("units").over(w6)), 4))
    .withColumn("revenue_rank_rank", F.rank().over(w7))
)

result = (
    metrics
    .groupBy(
        "product_id",
        F.date_trunc("WEEK", "sale_date").alias("week_start"),
        F.date_trunc("YEAR", "sale_date").alias("year_start"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.percentile_approx("revenue_rank_rank", [0.25, 0.5, 0.75]).alias("revenue_rank_rank_quartiles"),
        F.min("store_id_min_sale_date_year").alias("min_store_id_min_sale_date_year"),
        F.bit_or("units").alias("units_bit_or"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("units_bit_or") < 1)
    .orderBy("year_start")
)

WITH cleaned AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        id,
        category,
        brand,
        price,
        stock_qty,
        tags,
        supplier_id,
        CASE WHEN brand IN ('Umbrella', 'Initech') THEN 'Priority' ELSE 'Other' END AS brand_group,
        COALESCE(brand, 'N/A') AS resolved_brand
    FROM products
    WHERE launch_date >= TO_DATE('2023-11-09')
      AND supplier_id IS NOT NULL
),
scored AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        id,
        category,
        brand,
        price,
        stock_qty,
        tags,
        supplier_id,
        brand_group,
        resolved_brand,
        LAG(stock_qty, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY brand, category ORDER BY stock_qty, id) AS prev_stock_qty,
        ROUND(price / SUM(price) OVER (PARTITION BY brand), 4) AS price_share
    FROM cleaned
),
eligible AS (
    -- Anti-join via a correlated subquery
    SELECT s.*
    FROM scored s
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM store_sales ch
            WHERE ch.product_id = s.id
              AND ch.units BETWEEN 15 AND 16
        )
),
scored_products AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        *,
        AVG(stock_qty) OVER w_ordered AS stock_qty_avg_3_prior,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY category ORDER BY price_share DESC, id) AS event_seq
    FROM eligible
    WINDOW w_ordered AS (PARTITION BY supplier_id, category ORDER BY price_share, id ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING)
),
enriched AS (
    -- Attach suppliers attributes
    SELECT
        e.*,
        d.city,
        d.supplier_name
    FROM scored_products e
    JOIN suppliers d
        ON e.supplier_id = d.id
),
joined AS (
    -- Attach suppliers attributes
    SELECT a.*, p.supplier_name AS supplier_supplier_name
    FROM enriched a
    JOIN suppliers p
        ON a.supplier_id = p.id
),
totals AS (
    -- Grouped metrics
    SELECT
        CASE WHEN prev_stock_qty >= 306 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END AS prev_stock_qty_tier,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN city = 'New York' THEN 1 END) AS new_york_count,
        APPROX_PERCENTILE(prev_stock_qty, 0.9) AS prev_stock_qty_p90
    FROM joined
    GROUP BY CASE WHEN prev_stock_qty >= 306 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END
)
SELECT prev_stock_qty_tier, new_york_count
FROM totals
ORDER BY new_york_count DESC NULLS LAST;

WITH with_prev AS (
    -- Previous event time per key
    SELECT *, LAG(paid_at) OVER (PARTITION BY status ORDER BY paid_at, id) AS prev_paid_at
    FROM payments
),
with_gaps AS (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN prev_paid_at IS NULL OR paid_at > prev_paid_at + INTERVAL '60' DAY THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_new_session
    FROM with_prev
),
islands AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(is_new_session) OVER (PARTITION BY status ORDER BY paid_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS island_id
    FROM with_gaps
)
-- Multi-level aggregation
SELECT
    order_id,
    CASE WHEN is_new_session >= 1 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END AS is_new_session_tier,
    status,
    APPROX_PERCENTILE(amount, 0.95) AS amount_p95,
    MAX(paid_at) AS last_seen,
    PERCENTILE_APPROX(amount, 0.9) AS amount_p90,
    PERCENTILE_APPROX(is_new_session, ARRAY(0.25, 0.5, 0.75)) AS is_new_session_quartiles,
    AVG(island_id) FILTER (WHERE method = 'paypal') AS paypal_avg_island_id
FROM islands
GROUP BY ROLLUP (order_id, CASE WHEN is_new_session >= 1 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END, status)
ORDER BY is_new_session_tier DESC NULLS FIRST;

from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("status").orderBy("paid_at", "id")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("status").orderBy("paid_at", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)

with_prev = df_payments.withColumn("prev_paid_at", F.lag("paid_at").over(w))

with_gaps = (
    with_prev
    .withColumn("is_new_session", F.when(F.col("prev_paid_at").isNull() | (F.col("paid_at") > F.col("prev_paid_at") + F.expr("INTERVAL 60 DAYS")), 1).otherwise(0))
)

islands = with_gaps.withColumn("island_id", F.sum("is_new_session").over(w2))

result = (
    islands
    .rollup(
        "order_id",
        F.when(F.col("is_new_session") >= 1, "LARGE").otherwise("SMALL").alias("is_new_session_tier"),
        "status",
    )
    .agg(
        F.percentile_approx("amount", 0.95).alias("amount_p95"),
        F.max("paid_at").alias("last_seen"),
        F.percentile_approx("amount", 0.9).alias("amount_p90"),
        F.percentile_approx("is_new_session", [0.25, 0.5, 0.75]).alias("is_new_session_quartiles"),
        F.avg(F.when(F.col("method") == "paypal", F.col("island_id"))).alias("paypal_avg_island_id"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("is_new_session_tier").desc_nulls_first())
)

        FROM device_readings

valid AS (

    FROM valid

cleaned AS (

with_windows AS (

        MAX(device_code_sum_pressure) OVER (ORDER BY CAST(reading_ts AS BIGINT) RANGE BETWEEN 900 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS device_code_sum_pressure_max_15m

    device_code,
    reading_ts,
    temp_c,
    humidity,
    pressure,
    firmware,

WITH joined AS (
    -- Attach customers attributes
    SELECT
        s.*,
        b.credit_limit,
        b.segment,
        b.country
    FROM subscriptions s
    LEFT JOIN customers b
        ON s.customer_id = b.id
),
ranked AS (
    -- Deduplicate with ROW_NUMBER
    SELECT *
    FROM (
        SELECT *, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY country ORDER BY credit_limit DESC) AS rank_in_group
        FROM joined
    ) ranked
    WHERE rank_in_group = 1
),
joined_subscriptions AS (
    -- Attach customers attributes
    SELECT e.*, d.credit_limit AS customer_credit_limit
    FROM ranked e
    LEFT JOIN customers d
        ON e.customer_id = d.id
),
latest AS (
    -- QUALIFY-style window filter
    SELECT *
    FROM joined_subscriptions
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY country, customer_id ORDER BY start_date DESC NULLS FIRST, id ASC) = 1
),
base AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT
        id,
        start_date,
        end_date,
        status,
        segment,
        country,
        customer_credit_limit,
        DATEDIFF(CURRENT_DATE(), start_date) AS days_since_start_date
    FROM latest
    WHERE plan IN ('premium', 'basic', 'enterprise')
),
metrics AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        *,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY days_since_start_date DESC NULLS LAST) AS days_since_start_date_dense_rank,
        FIRST_VALUE(segment, TRUE) OVER (PARTITION BY country ORDER BY days_since_start_date ASC, id ASC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS first_known_segment,
        NTILE(3) OVER (PARTITION BY status ORDER BY days_since_start_date DESC, id ASC) AS days_since_start_date_bucket,
        LAST_VALUE(segment) IGNORE NULLS OVER (PARTITION BY status ORDER BY end_date ASC, id ASC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS last_known_segment,
        LAG(days_since_start_date, 2) OVER w_recent AS prev_days_since_start_date
    FROM base
    WINDOW w_recent AS (PARTITION BY segment ORDER BY customer_credit_limit ASC, id ASC)
),
stats AS (
    -- Multi-level aggregation
    SELECT
        status,
        DATE_TRUNC('WEEK', end_date) AS week_start,
        CASE WHEN days_since_start_date_bucket >= 7 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END AS days_since_start_date_bucket_tier,
        ROUND(AVG(days_since_start_date_dense_rank), 2) AS avg_days_since_start_date_dense_rank,
        APPROX_PERCENTILE(days_since_start_date_dense_rank, 0.5) AS days_since_start_date_dense_rank_p50,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'PAUSED') AS paused_rows,
        SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'EXPIRED' THEN prev_days_since_start_date ELSE 0 END) AS expired_prev_days_since_start_date,
        PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY status ORDER BY APPROX_PERCENTILE(days_since_start_date_dense_rank, 0.5) DESC) AS days_since_start_date_dense_rank_p50_percent_rank
    FROM metrics
    GROUP BY status, DATE_TRUNC('WEEK', end_date), CASE WHEN days_since_start_date_bucket >= 7 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END
)
SELECT
    status,
    week_start,
    days_since_start_date_bucket_tier,
    avg_days_since_start_date_dense_rank,
    days_since_start_date_dense_rank_p50,
    expired_prev_days_since_start_date
FROM stats
ORDER BY days_since_start_date_dense_rank_p50 ASC;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("country").orderBy(F.col("credit_limit").desc())
w2 = Window.partitionBy("country", "customer_id").orderBy(F.col("start_date").desc_nulls_first(), "id")
w3 = Window.orderBy(F.col("days_since_start_date").desc_nulls_last())
w4 = Window.partitionBy("country").orderBy("days_since_start_date", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w5 = Window.partitionBy("status").orderBy(F.col("days_since_start_date").desc(), "id")
w6 = Window.partitionBy("status").orderBy("end_date", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w_recent = Window.partitionBy("segment").orderBy("customer_credit_limit", "id")
w8 = Window.partitionBy("status").orderBy(F.col("days_since_start_date_dense_rank_p50").desc())

joined = (
    df_subscriptions
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_customers.alias("b"), F.col("s.customer_id") == F.col("b.id"), "left")
    .select("s.*", F.col("b.credit_limit"), F.col("b.segment"), F.col("b.country"))
)

ranked = (
    joined
    .withColumn("rank_in_group", F.rank().over(w))
    .filter(F.col("rank_in_group") == 1)
)

joined_subscriptions = (
    ranked
    .alias("e")
    .join(df_customers.alias("d"), F.col("e.customer_id") == F.col("d.id"), "left")
    .select("e.*", F.col("d.credit_limit").alias("customer_credit_limit"))
)

latest = (
    joined_subscriptions
    .withColumn("rn", F.row_number().over(w2))
    .filter(F.col("rn") == 1)
    .drop("rn")
)

base = (
    latest
    .filter(F.col("plan").isin(["premium", "basic", "enterprise"]))
    .select(
        "id",
        "start_date",
        "end_date",
        "status",
        "segment",
        "country",
        "customer_credit_limit",
        F.datediff(F.current_date(), "start_date").alias("days_since_start_date"),
    )
)

metrics = (
    base
    .withColumn("days_since_start_date_dense_rank", F.dense_rank().over(w3))
    .withColumn("first_known_segment", F.first("segment", ignorenulls=True).over(w4))
    .withColumn("days_since_start_date_bucket", F.ntile(3).over(w5))
    .withColumn("last_known_segment", F.last("segment", ignorenulls=True).over(w6))
    .withColumn("prev_days_since_start_date", F.lag("days_since_start_date", 2).over(w_recent))
)

stats = (
    metrics
    .groupBy(
        "status",
        F.date_trunc("WEEK", "end_date").alias("week_start"),
        F.when(F.col("days_since_start_date_bucket") >= 7, "HIGH").otherwise("LOW").alias("days_since_start_date_bucket_tier"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.round(F.avg("days_since_start_date_dense_rank"), 2).alias("avg_days_since_start_date_dense_rank"),
        F.percentile_approx("days_since_start_date_dense_rank", 0.5).alias("days_since_start_date_dense_rank_p50"),
        F.count(F.when(F.col("status") == "PAUSED", 1)).alias("paused_rows"),
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("status") == "EXPIRED", F.col("prev_days_since_start_date")).otherwise(0)).alias("expired_prev_days_since_start_date"),
    )
    .withColumn("days_since_start_date_dense_rank_p50_percent_rank", F.percent_rank().over(w8))
)

result = (
    stats
    .select(
        "status",
        "week_start",
        "days_since_start_date_bucket_tier",
        "avg_days_since_start_date_dense_rank",
        "days_since_start_date_dense_rank_p50",
        "expired_prev_days_since_start_date",
    )
    .orderBy("days_since_start_date_dense_rank_p50")
)
