WITH cleaned AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT
        id,
        channel,
        starts_on,
        ends_on,
        discount_pct,
        DATE_TRUNC('month', starts_on) starts_on_period,
        LAST_DAY(ends_on) ends_on_month_end,
        COALESCE(channel, 'OTHER') resolved_channel
    FROM promotions
    WHERE starts_on >= '2025-07-31'
),
deduped AS (
    -- Deduplicate with ROW_NUMBER
    SELECT *
    FROM (
        SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY channel ORDER BY ends_on_month_end DESC, id) AS dedup_rank
        FROM cleaned
    ) t
    WHERE dedup_rank = 1
),
metrics AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        *,
        MAX(discount_pct) OVER (ORDER BY CAST(starts_on_period AS BIGINT) RANGE BETWEEN 7776000 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) discount_pct_max_90d,
        AVG(discount_pct) OVER (PARTITION BY channel ORDER BY ends_on, id ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) discount_pct_avg_2_prior,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY channel ORDER BY discount_pct) discount_pct_rank,
        LEAD(discount_pct, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY channel ORDER BY discount_pct, id) next_discount_pct
    FROM deduped
),
scored AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        id,
        channel,
        starts_on,
        ends_on,
        discount_pct,
        starts_on_period,
        ends_on_month_end,
        resolved_channel,
        dedup_rank,
        discount_pct_max_90d,
        discount_pct_avg_2_prior,
        discount_pct_rank,
        next_discount_pct,
        LAG(discount_pct, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY channel ORDER BY dedup_rank, id) prev_discount_pct,
        COUNT(discount_pct_rank) OVER (PARTITION BY channel ORDER BY CAST(starts_on_period AS BIGINT) RANGE BETWEEN 7776000 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) discount_pct_rank_count_90d
    FROM metrics
)
-- Running and moving aggregates
SELECT
    *,
    ROUND(discount_pct_max_90d / SUM(discount_pct_max_90d) OVER (PARTITION BY channel), 4) discount_pct_max_90d_share,
    SUM(discount_pct) OVER (PARTITION BY channel) channel_sum_discount_pct,
    AVG(discount_pct_avg_2_prior) OVER (PARTITION BY channel ORDER BY discount_pct, id ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) discount_pct_avg_2_prior_avg_2_prior
FROM scored;

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("channel").orderBy(F.col("ends_on_month_end").desc(), "id")
w2 = Window.orderBy(F.col("starts_on_period").cast("bigint")).rangeBetween(-7776000, Window.currentRow)
w3 = Window.partitionBy("channel").orderBy("ends_on", "id").rowsBetween(-2, -1)
w4 = Window.partitionBy("channel").orderBy("discount_pct")
w5 = Window.partitionBy("channel").orderBy("discount_pct", "id")
w6 = Window.partitionBy("channel").orderBy("dedup_rank", "id")
w7 = Window.partitionBy("channel").orderBy(F.col("starts_on_period").cast("bigint")).rangeBetween(-7776000, Window.currentRow)
w8 = Window.partitionBy("channel")
w9 = Window.partitionBy("channel").orderBy("discount_pct", "id").rowsBetween(-2, -1)

cleaned = (
    df_promotions
    .filter(F.col("starts_on") >= "2025-07-31")
    .select(
        "id",
        "channel",
        "starts_on",
        "ends_on",
        "discount_pct",
        F.date_trunc("month", "starts_on").alias("starts_on_period"),
        F.last_day("ends_on").alias("ends_on_month_end"),
        F.coalesce("channel", F.lit("OTHER")).alias("resolved_channel"),
    )
)

deduped = (
    cleaned
    .withColumn("dedup_rank", F.row_number().over(w))
    .filter(F.col("dedup_rank") == 1)
)

metrics = (
    deduped
    .select(
        "*",
        F.max("discount_pct").over(w2).alias("discount_pct_max_90d"),
        F.avg("discount_pct").over(w3).alias("discount_pct_avg_2_prior"),
        F.rank().over(w4).alias("discount_pct_rank"),
        F.lead("discount_pct", 1).over(w5).alias("next_discount_pct"),
    )
)

scored = (
    metrics
    .select(
        "*",
        F.lag("discount_pct", 1).over(w6).alias("prev_discount_pct"),
        F.count("discount_pct_rank").over(w7).alias("discount_pct_rank_count_90d"),
    )
)

result = (
    scored
    .select(
        "*",
        F.round((F.col("discount_pct_max_90d") / F.sum("discount_pct_max_90d").over(w8)), 4).alias("discount_pct_max_90d_share"),
        F.sum("discount_pct").over(w8).alias("channel_sum_discount_pct"),
        F.avg("discount_pct_avg_2_prior").over(w9).alias("discount_pct_avg_2_prior_avg_2_prior"),
    )
)

with base as (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    select
        id,
        balance,
        opened_date,
        status,
        trim(account_type) clean_account_type,
        coalesce(status, 'N/A') status_clean
    from accounts
    where opened_date > date '2024-02-20'
      and customer_id is not null
),
ranked as (
    -- Deduplicate with ROW_NUMBER
    select *, row_number() over (partition by status order by opened_date desc, id) as rn
    from base
    qualify rn = 1
),
metrics as (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    select
        id,
        balance,
        opened_date,
        status,
        clean_account_type,
        status_clean,
        rn,
        avg(balance) over w_recent balance_avg_5_prior,
        first_value(status, true) over w_ordered first_known_status
    from ranked
    window w_recent as (order by opened_date, id rows between 5 preceding and 1 preceding), w_ordered as (partition by status order by balance, id rows between unbounded preceding and current row)
),
latest as (
    -- Deduplicate with ROW_NUMBER
    select *
    from (
        select *, row_number() over (partition by status order by opened_date, id) as rank_in_group
        from metrics
    ) x
    where rank_in_group = 1
)
select
    id,
    clean_account_type,
    status_clean,
    balance_avg_5_prior,
    first_known_status,
    rank_in_group
from latest
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("status").orderBy(F.col("opened_date").desc(), "id")
w_recent = Window.orderBy("opened_date", "id").rowsBetween(-5, -1)
w_ordered = Window.partitionBy("status").orderBy("balance", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w4 = Window.partitionBy("status").orderBy("opened_date", "id")

base = (
    df_accounts
    .filter((F.col("opened_date") > F.lit("2024-02-20").cast("date")) & F.col("customer_id").isNotNull())
    .select(
        "id",
        "balance",
        "opened_date",
        "status",
        F.trim("account_type").alias("clean_account_type"),
        F.coalesce("status", F.lit("N/A")).alias("status_clean"),
    )
)

ranked = (
    base
    .withColumn("rn", F.row_number().over(w))
    .filter(F.col("rn") == 1)
)

metrics = (
    ranked
    .withColumn("balance_avg_5_prior", F.avg("balance").over(w_recent))
    .withColumn("first_known_status", F.first("status", ignorenulls=True).over(w_ordered))
)

latest = (
    metrics
    .withColumn("rank_in_group", F.row_number().over(w4))
    .filter(F.col("rank_in_group") == 1)
)

result = (
    latest
    .select(
        "id",
        "clean_account_type",
        "status_clean",
        "balance_avg_5_prior",
        "first_known_status",
        "rank_in_group",
    )
)

WITH valid AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        id,
        full_name,
        dept_id,
        manager_id,
        job_title,
        level,
        TRIM(level) AS clean_level
    FROM employees
    WHERE manager_id = 34
),
cleaned AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        *,
        LOWER(full_name) AS full_name_lower,
        UPPER(full_name) AS full_name_upper
    FROM valid
    WHERE level IS NOT NULL
),
with_dims AS (
    -- Attach employees attributes
    SELECT
        e.*,
        d.hire_date,
        d.full_name AS employee_full_name,
        d.email
    FROM cleaned e
    INNER JOIN employees d
        ON e.manager_id = d.id
),
enriched AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        *,
        LAST_VALUE(level) IGNORE NULLS OVER (ORDER BY hire_date, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS last_known_level,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY hire_date, id) AS event_seq
    FROM with_dims
)
-- Multi-level aggregation
SELECT
    manager_id,
    SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_SET(level)) AS level_list,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN job_title = 'Intern' THEN 1 END) AS intern_count,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE job_title = 'Manager') AS manager_rows,
    COUNT(*) AS row_count,
    SIZE(COLLECT_SET(level)) AS num_levels
FROM enriched
GROUP BY manager_id
HAVING COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE job_title = 'Manager') > 1;

WITH base AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        DATE_FORMAT(opened_date, 'yyyy-MM-dd') AS opened_date_label,
        FLOOR(sqft) AS sqft_whole
    FROM stores
    WHERE region IS NOT NULL
      AND region = 'East'
),
scored AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        store_name,
        city,
        region,
        opened_date,
        sqft,
        opened_date_label,
        sqft_whole,
        LEAD(sqft, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY city ORDER BY sqft_whole, id) AS next_sqft,
        NTILE(5) OVER (PARTITION BY region, city ORDER BY sqft_whole, id) AS sqft_whole_bucket,
        AVG(sqft_whole) OVER (ORDER BY sqft_whole, id ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS sqft_whole_avg_6
    FROM base
),
deduped AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM (
        SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY city ORDER BY next_sqft DESC NULLS FIRST, id) AS rn
        FROM scored
    ) x
    WHERE rn = 1
),
deduped_stores AS (
    SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY city ORDER BY next_sqft DESC NULLS LAST, id) AS dedup_rank
    FROM deduped
    QUALIFY dedup_rank = 1
),
with_windows AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        store_name,
        city,
        region,
        opened_date,
        sqft,
        opened_date_label,
        sqft_whole,
        next_sqft,
        sqft_whole_bucket,
        sqft_whole_avg_6,
        rn,
        dedup_rank,
        FIRST_VALUE(sqft_whole) IGNORE NULLS OVER (PARTITION BY city ORDER BY rn, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS first_known_sqft_whole,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY region, city ORDER BY next_sqft DESC, id) AS event_seq,
        CUME_DIST() OVER (PARTITION BY city ORDER BY next_sqft DESC NULLS LAST) AS next_sqft_cume_dist
    FROM deduped_stores
),
matched_keys AS (
    SELECT id, city
    FROM with_windows
    EXCEPT ALL
    SELECT id, city
    FROM stores
    WHERE MONTH(opened_date) IN (1, 3, 7)
),
kept_rows AS (
    SELECT s.*
    FROM with_windows s
    JOIN matched_keys k ON s.id = k.id AND s.city = k.city
),
filtered AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        ROUND(event_seq, 0) AS event_seq_rounded,
        YEAR(opened_date) AS opened_date_year,
        COALESCE(region, 'UNKNOWN') AS region_clean
    FROM kept_rows
    WHERE opened_date > TO_DATE('2024-03-09')
),
summary AS (
    SELECT
        DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', opened_date) AS activity_month,
        city,
        COUNT(*) AS row_count,
        SUM(CASE WHEN region = 'East' THEN next_sqft ELSE 0 END) AS east_next_sqft,
        COUNT(*) AS cnt,
        MIN(sqft_whole) AS min_sqft_whole,
        COUNT_IF(region = 'North') AS north_events
    FROM filtered
    GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', opened_date), city
    HAVING min_sqft_whole > 0
)
SELECT
    activity_month,
    city,
    row_count,
    east_next_sqft,
    cnt,
    min_sqft_whole,
    north_events
FROM summary
ORDER BY cnt DESC
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("city").orderBy("sqft_whole", "id")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("region", "city").orderBy("sqft_whole", "id")
w3 = Window.orderBy("sqft_whole", "id").rowsBetween(-6, Window.currentRow)
w4 = Window.partitionBy("city").orderBy(F.col("next_sqft").desc_nulls_first(), "id")
w5 = Window.partitionBy("city").orderBy(F.col("next_sqft").desc_nulls_last(), "id")
w6 = Window.partitionBy("city").orderBy("rn", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w7 = Window.partitionBy("region", "city").orderBy(F.col("next_sqft").desc(), "id")
w8 = Window.partitionBy("city").orderBy(F.col("next_sqft").desc_nulls_last())

base = (
    df_stores
    .filter(F.col("region").isNotNull() & (F.col("region") == "East"))
    .select(
        "*",
        F.date_format("opened_date", "yyyy-MM-dd").alias("opened_date_label"),
        F.floor("sqft").alias("sqft_whole"),
    )
)

scored = (
    base
    .withColumn("next_sqft", F.lead("sqft", 1).over(w))
    .withColumn("sqft_whole_bucket", F.ntile(5).over(w2))
    .withColumn("sqft_whole_avg_6", F.avg("sqft_whole").over(w3))
)

deduped = (
    scored
    .withColumn("rn", F.row_number().over(w4))
    .filter(F.col("rn") == 1)
)

deduped_stores = (
    deduped
    .withColumn("dedup_rank", F.row_number().over(w5))
    .filter(F.col("dedup_rank") == 1)
)

with_windows = (
    deduped_stores
    .select(
        "*",
        F.first("sqft_whole", ignorenulls=True).over(w6).alias("first_known_sqft_whole"),
        F.row_number().over(w7).alias("event_seq"),
        F.cume_dist().over(w8).alias("next_sqft_cume_dist"),
    )
)

matched_keys = (
    with_windows
    .select("id", "city")
    .exceptAll(
        df_stores
        .filter(F.month("opened_date").isin([1, 3, 7]))
        .select("id", "city")
    )
)

kept_rows = (
    with_windows
    .alias("s")
    .join(matched_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.id") == F.col("k.id")) & (F.col("s.city") == F.col("k.city")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

filtered = (
    kept_rows
    .filter(F.col("opened_date") > F.to_date(F.lit("2024-03-09")))
    .select(
        "*",
        F.round("event_seq", 0).alias("event_seq_rounded"),
        F.year("opened_date").alias("opened_date_year"),
        F.coalesce("region", F.lit("UNKNOWN")).alias("region_clean"),
    )
)

summary = (
    filtered
    .groupBy(F.date_trunc("MONTH", "opened_date").alias("activity_month"), "city")
    .agg(
        F.count("*").alias("row_count"),
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("region") == "East", F.col("next_sqft")).otherwise(0)).alias("east_next_sqft"),
        F.count("*").alias("cnt"),
        F.min("sqft_whole").alias("min_sqft_whole"),
        F.count_if(F.col("region") == "North").alias("north_events"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("min_sqft_whole") > 0)
)

result = (
    summary
    .select(
        "activity_month",
        "city",
        "row_count",
        "east_next_sqft",
        "cnt",
        "min_sqft_whole",
        "north_events",
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("cnt").desc())
)

WITH with_dims AS (
    SELECT
        a.*,
        b.city,
        b.sqft,
        b.opened_date
    FROM store_sales a
    LEFT JOIN stores b
        ON a.store_id = b.id
),
enriched AS (

    FROM with_dims e

metrics AS (

        product_id,

        units,
        revenue,
        city,
        sqft,
        opened_date,
        launch_date,
        LEAD(sqft, 2) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id, store_id ORDER BY revenue, id) AS next_sqft,
        NTILE(3) OVER (PARTITION BY store_id ORDER BY revenue, id) AS revenue_bucket,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY city ORDER BY units, id) AS seq_no
    FROM enriched
),
totals AS (
    SELECT
        CASE WHEN revenue >= 3700 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END AS revenue_tier,
        SIZE(COLLECT_SET(city)) AS num_cities,
        SUM(CASE WHEN city = 'Tokyo' THEN next_sqft ELSE 0 END) AS tokyo_next_sqft,
        COUNT(DISTINCT city) AS distinct_cities,
        SUM(CASE WHEN city = 'Singapore' THEN sqft ELSE 0 END) AS singapore_sqft,
        ROUND(SUM(revenue_bucket) / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN city = 'New York' THEN 1 END), 0), 2) AS revenue_bucket_per_new_york,
        PERCENTILE_APPROX(sqft, ARRAY(0.25, 0.5, 0.75)) AS sqft_quartiles
    FROM metrics
    GROUP BY revenue_tier
)
SELECT
    revenue_tier,
    tokyo_next_sqft,
    distinct_cities,
    revenue_bucket_per_new_york
FROM totals
ORDER BY distinct_cities DESC;

from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("product_id", "store_id").orderBy("revenue", "id")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("store_id").orderBy("revenue", "id")

    .join(df_stores.alias("b"), F.col("a.store_id") == F.col("b.id"), "left")
    .select("a.*", F.col("b.city"), F.col("b.sqft"), F.col("b.opened_date"))
)

    with_dims
    .alias("e")
    .join(df_products.alias("b"), F.col("e.product_id") == F.col("b.id"), "left")
    .select("e.*", F.col("b.launch_date"))
)

with enriched as (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    select
        *,
        lead(budget, 1) over (partition by dept_name order by budget, id) as next_budget,
        ntile(4) over (partition by location, dept_name order by budget desc, id) as budget_bucket,
        avg(budget) over (order by budget, id rows between 3 preceding and 1 preceding) as budget_avg_3_prior,
        lead(budget, 2) over w_ordered as next_budget_2,
        max(budget) over w_running as dept_name_max_budget
    from departments
    window w_ordered as (partition by location order by budget, id), w_running as (partition by dept_name)
),
scored as (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    select
        *,
        round(next_budget_2 / sum(next_budget_2) over (partition by location), 4) as next_budget_2_share,
        avg(next_budget_2) over (partition by dept_name, location order by next_budget_2, id rows between 5 preceding and 1 preceding) as next_budget_2_avg_5_prior,
        percent_rank() over (partition by dept_name order by dept_name_max_budget nulls first) as dept_name_max_budget_percent_rank
    from enriched
),
ranked as (
    -- Keep one row per key (latest first)
    select *
    from scored
    qualify row_number() over (partition by location order by budget desc, id) = 1
)
-- Native SQL PIVOT
select *
from (
    select
        location,
        dept_name,
        budget_avg_3_prior
    from ranked
) src
pivot (
    avg(budget_avg_3_prior) as value_sum,
    count(1) as n
    for dept_name in ('Marketing' as marketing, 'Finance' as finance, 'Legal' as legal)
);

w_running = Window.partitionBy("dept_name")
w6 = Window.partitionBy("location")
w7 = Window.partitionBy("dept_name", "location").orderBy("next_budget_2", "id").rowsBetween(-5, -1)
w8 = Window.partitionBy("dept_name").orderBy(F.col("dept_name_max_budget").asc_nulls_first())

        F.ntile(4).over(w2).alias("budget_bucket"),
        F.avg("budget").over(w3).alias("budget_avg_3_prior"),
        F.lead("budget", 2).over(w_ordered).alias("next_budget_2"),

      AND page IS NOT NULL
),
scored AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        *,
        SUM(days_since_event_time) OVER (PARTITION BY event_type ORDER BY CAST(event_time AS BIGINT) RANGE BETWEEN 604800 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) days_since_event_time_sum_7d,
        SUM(duration_sec) OVER w_recent cumulative_duration_sec,
        NTILE(4) OVER w_recent_2 duration_sec_bucket
    FROM cleaned
    WINDOW w_recent AS (ORDER BY duration_sec, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), w_recent_2 AS (ORDER BY duration_sec DESC, id)

base_web_events AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT
        id,
        session_id,

        page_clean,

        days_since_event_time,

        days_since_event_time_sum_7d,
        cumulative_duration_sec,
        duration_sec_bucket,
        COALESCE(duration_sec_bucket, 0) duration_sec_bucket_filled,
        DATE_TRUNC('month', event_time) event_time_period,
        COALESCE(page, 'DIRECT') resolved_page
    FROM scored
    WHERE event_time > TIMESTAMP '2023-07-27 15:00:00'
)
-- Multi-level aggregation
SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', event_time_period) AS year_start,
    DATE_TRUNC('QUARTER', event_time_period) AS quarter_start,
    DATE_TRUNC('WEEK', event_time_period) AS week_start,
    COUNT(DISTINCT event_type) AS distinct_event_types,
    SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_SET(event_type)) AS event_type_list,
    COUNT_IF(event_type = 'page_view') AS page_view_events
FROM base_web_events
GROUP BY year_start, quarter_start, week_start;

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("event_type").orderBy(F.col("event_time").cast("bigint")).rangeBetween(-604800, Window.currentRow)
w_recent = Window.orderBy("duration_sec", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w_recent_2 = Window.orderBy(F.col("duration_sec").desc(), "id")

base = (
    df_web_events
    .filter((F.col("event_time") >= F.lit("2023-12-24").cast("date")) & F.col("page").isNotNull())
    .select(

        F.ceil("duration_sec").alias("duration_sec_whole"),
        F.coalesce("page", F.lit("OTHER")).alias("page_clean"),
    )
)

cleaned = (
    base
    .filter((F.col("event_time") > F.to_timestamp(F.lit("2023-09-12 15:00:00"))) & F.col("page").isNotNull())
    .withColumn("page_upper", F.upper("page"))
    .withColumn("days_since_event_time", F.datediff(F.current_date(), "event_time"))
    .withColumn("page_clean_2", F.coalesce("page", F.lit("NONE")))
)

scored = (
    cleaned
    .select(
        "*",
        F.sum("days_since_event_time").over(w).alias("days_since_event_time_sum_7d"),
        F.sum("duration_sec").over(w_recent).alias("cumulative_duration_sec"),
        F.ntile(4).over(w_recent_2).alias("duration_sec_bucket"),
    )
)

base_web_events = (
    scored
    .filter(F.col("event_time") > F.lit("2023-07-27 15:00:00").cast("timestamp"))
    .select(
        "id",
        "session_id",
        "event_type",
        "page",
        "duration_sec",
        "duration_sec_whole",
        "page_clean",
        "page_upper",
        "days_since_event_time",
        "page_clean_2",
        "days_since_event_time_sum_7d",
        "cumulative_duration_sec",
        "duration_sec_bucket",
        F.coalesce("duration_sec_bucket", F.lit(0)).alias("duration_sec_bucket_filled"),
        F.date_trunc("month", "event_time").alias("event_time_period"),
        F.coalesce("page", F.lit("DIRECT")).alias("resolved_page"),
    )
)

result = (
    base_web_events
    .groupBy(

        F.sort_array(F.collect_set("event_type")).alias("event_type_list"),
        F.count_if(F.col("event_type") == "page_view").alias("page_view_events"),

WITH attributed AS (
    -- Non-equi join on a validity window
    SELECT
        src.*,
        sub.id AS subscription_id,
        sub.plan,
        sub.monthly_fee
    FROM accounts src
    LEFT JOIN subscriptions sub
        ON src.customer_id = sub.customer_id
       AND src.opened_date >= sub.start_date
       AND src.opened_date <= DATE_ADD(sub.end_date, 10)
),
deduped AS (
    -- Keep one row per key (latest first)
    SELECT *, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY account_type ORDER BY monthly_fee DESC NULLS FIRST) AS latest_rank
    FROM attributed
    QUALIFY latest_rank = 1
),
eligible AS (
    -- Semi-join via a correlated subquery
    SELECT s.*
    FROM deduped s
    WHERE EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM transactions ch
            WHERE ch.account_id = s.id
              AND ch.txn_time >= '2025-08-25'
        )
),
with_windows AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        *,
        LAG(monthly_fee, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY account_type ORDER BY latest_rank ASC, id ASC, subscription_id ASC) AS prev_monthly_fee,
        LEAD(monthly_fee, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY account_type ORDER BY opened_date ASC, id ASC, subscription_id ASC) AS next_monthly_fee
    FROM eligible
),
attributed_accounts AS (
    -- Non-equi join on a validity window
    SELECT
        src.*,
        sub.id AS subscription_id_2,
        sub.plan AS subscription_plan,
        sub.monthly_fee AS subscription_monthly_fee
    FROM with_windows src
    LEFT JOIN subscriptions sub
        ON src.customer_id = sub.customer_id
       AND src.opened_date >= sub.start_date
       AND src.opened_date < sub.end_date + INTERVAL 14 DAYS
),
latest AS (
    -- Deduplicate with ROW_NUMBER
    SELECT *
    FROM (
        SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY subscription_plan ORDER BY monthly_fee DESC, id ASC, subscription_id ASC, subscription_id_2 ASC) AS rank_in_group
        FROM attributed_accounts
    ) t
    WHERE rank_in_group = 1
),
wide AS (
    -- Native SQL PIVOT
    SELECT *
    FROM (
        SELECT
            status,
            account_type,
            subscription_id
        FROM latest
    ) src
    PIVOT (
        SUM(subscription_id) AS total
        FOR account_type IN ('LOAN', 'SAVINGS', 'CHECKING')
    )
)
SELECT
    status,
    LOAN,
    SAVINGS,
    CHECKING,
    CASE WHEN status RLIKE '^(OPEN|FROZEN)$' THEN 'GROUP_B' ELSE 'EXTENDED' END AS status_zone
FROM wide
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("account_type").orderBy(F.col("monthly_fee").desc_nulls_first())
w2 = Window.partitionBy("account_type").orderBy("latest_rank", "id", "subscription_id")
w3 = Window.partitionBy("account_type").orderBy("opened_date", "id", "subscription_id")
w4 = Window.partitionBy("subscription_plan").orderBy(F.col("monthly_fee").desc(), "id", "subscription_id", "subscription_id_2")

attributed = (
    df_accounts
    .alias("src")
    .join(df_subscriptions.alias("sub"), (F.col("src.customer_id") == F.col("sub.customer_id")) & (F.col("src.opened_date") >= F.col("sub.start_date")) & (F.col("src.opened_date") <= F.date_add(F.col("sub.end_date"), 10)), "left")
    .select(
        "src.*",
        F.col("sub.id").alias("subscription_id"),
        F.col("sub.plan"),
        F.col("sub.monthly_fee"),
    )
)

deduped = (
    attributed
    .withColumn("latest_rank", F.rank().over(w))
    .filter(F.col("latest_rank") == 1)
)

eligible = (
    deduped
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_transactions.alias("ch"), (F.col("ch.account_id") == F.col("s.id")) & (F.col("ch.txn_time") >= "2025-08-25"), "left_semi")
)

with_windows = (
    eligible
    .select(
        "*",
        F.lag("monthly_fee", 1).over(w2).alias("prev_monthly_fee"),
        F.lead("monthly_fee", 1).over(w3).alias("next_monthly_fee"),
    )
)

attributed_accounts = (
    with_windows
    .alias("src")
    .join(df_subscriptions.alias("sub"), (F.col("src.customer_id") == F.col("sub.customer_id")) & (F.col("src.opened_date") >= F.col("sub.start_date")) & (F.col("src.opened_date") < F.col("sub.end_date") + F.expr("INTERVAL 14 DAYS")), "left")
    .select(
        "src.*",
        F.col("sub.id").alias("subscription_id_2"),
        F.col("sub.plan").alias("subscription_plan"),
        F.col("sub.monthly_fee").alias("subscription_monthly_fee"),
    )
)

latest = (
    attributed_accounts
    .withColumn("rank_in_group", F.row_number().over(w4))
    .filter(F.col("rank_in_group") == 1)
)

wide = (
    latest
    .groupBy("status")
    .pivot("account_type", ["LOAN", "SAVINGS", "CHECKING"])
    .agg(F.sum("subscription_id").alias("total"))
)

result = (
    wide
    .select(
        "status",
        "LOAN",
        "SAVINGS",
        "CHECKING",
        F.when(F.col("status").rlike("^(OPEN|FROZEN)$"), "GROUP_B").otherwise("EXTENDED").alias("status_zone"),
    )
)

WITH kept_keys AS (
    -- Set difference on keys
    SELECT id
    FROM customers
    EXCEPT ALL
    SELECT id
    FROM customers
    WHERE name LIKE 'He%'
),
verified AS (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    SELECT s.*
    FROM customers s
    INNER JOIN kept_keys k ON s.id = k.id
),
scored AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        *,
        CORR(credit_limit, age) OVER (PARTITION BY city) AS corr_credit_limit_age,
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY credit_limit DESC NULLS LAST) AS credit_limit_rank,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY segment ORDER BY credit_limit DESC NULLS FIRST) AS credit_limit_dense_rank
    FROM verified
),
with_windows AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        id,
        name,
        email,
        country,
        city,
        segment,
        signup_date,
        is_active,
        credit_limit,
        age,
        corr_credit_limit_age,
        credit_limit_rank,
        credit_limit_dense_rank,
        COUNT(corr_credit_limit_age) OVER (PARTITION BY country) AS country_count_corr_credit_limit_age,
        MIN(corr_credit_limit_age) OVER (PARTITION BY segment) AS segment_min_corr_credit_limit_age
    FROM scored
),
eligible AS (
    -- Anti-join via a correlated subquery
    SELECT s.*
    FROM with_windows s
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM sessions x
            WHERE x.customer_id = s.id
              AND x.country = 'US'
        )
),
valid AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT
        *,
        INITCAP(TRIM(country)) AS country_title,
        COALESCE(city, 'N/A') AS city_clean
    FROM eligible
    WHERE signup_date > DATE '2023-05-13'
      AND city IS NOT NULL
),
kept AS (
    -- Anti-join via a correlated subquery
    SELECT s.*
    FROM valid s
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM sessions x
            WHERE x.customer_id = s.id
              AND x.country IN ('DE', 'UK', 'JP')
        )
),
daily AS (
    -- Multi-level aggregation
    SELECT
        DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', signup_date) AS year_start,
        DATE_TRUNC('WEEK', signup_date) AS week_start,
        MAX(country_count_corr_credit_limit_age) FILTER (WHERE segment = 'SMB') AS smb_max_country_count_corr_credit_limit_age,
        AVG(credit_limit_rank) FILTER (WHERE country = 'UK') AS uk_avg_credit_limit_rank,
        COUNT(DISTINCT city) AS distinct_cities,
        SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_SET(segment)) AS segment_list
    FROM kept
    GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', signup_date), DATE_TRUNC('WEEK', signup_date)
)
SELECT
    year_start,
    week_start,
    smb_max_country_count_corr_credit_limit_age,
    uk_avg_credit_limit_rank,
    distinct_cities,
    segment_list
FROM daily

    .select("id")
    .exceptAll(

verified = (

    .alias("s")
    .join(kept_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.id") == F.col("k.id")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

scored = (
    verified
    .select(
        "*",
        F.corr("credit_limit", "age").over(w).alias("corr_credit_limit_age"),
        F.rank().over(w2).alias("credit_limit_rank"),
        F.dense_rank().over(w3).alias("credit_limit_dense_rank"),
    )
)

with_windows = (
    scored
    .select(
        "*",
        F.count("corr_credit_limit_age").over(w4).alias("country_count_corr_credit_limit_age"),
        F.min("corr_credit_limit_age").over(w5).alias("segment_min_corr_credit_limit_age"),
    )
)

eligible = (

daily = (

    .groupBy(

        F.avg(F.when(F.col("country") == "UK", F.col("credit_limit_rank"))).alias("uk_avg_credit_limit_rank"),
        F.countDistinct("city").alias("distinct_cities"),

    )

WITH with_gaps AS (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > interval)
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN LAG(paid_at) OVER (PARTITION BY method ORDER BY paid_at, id) IS NULL
                 OR paid_at > LAG(paid_at) OVER (PARTITION BY method ORDER BY paid_at, id) + INTERVAL '90' DAY THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_new_burst
    FROM payments
),
islands AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(is_new_burst) OVER (PARTITION BY method ORDER BY paid_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_no
    FROM with_gaps
),
metrics AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        *,
        NTILE(3) OVER (PARTITION BY method, order_id ORDER BY is_new_burst, id) AS is_new_burst_bucket,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY order_id, status ORDER BY session_no DESC, id) AS event_seq,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY status ORDER BY is_new_burst NULLS FIRST) AS is_new_burst_rank,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY paid_at, id) AS row_seq,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY paid_at DESC, id) AS row_seq_2
    FROM islands
),
ranked AS (
    -- Keep one row per key (latest first)
    SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY order_id, method ORDER BY is_new_burst_rank DESC NULLS FIRST, id) AS row_num
    FROM metrics
    QUALIFY row_num = 1
),
with_windows AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        id,
        order_id,
        method,
        amount,
        paid_at,
        status,
        is_new_burst,
        session_no,
        is_new_burst_bucket,
        event_seq,
        is_new_burst_rank,
        row_seq,
        row_seq_2,
        row_num,
        AVG(row_seq) OVER (ORDER BY amount, id ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS row_seq_avg_3_prior,
        SUM(row_seq) OVER (ORDER BY paid_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_row_seq,
        MAX(is_new_burst) OVER (PARTITION BY method ORDER BY CAST(paid_at AS BIGINT) RANGE BETWEEN 604800 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS is_new_burst_max_7d
    FROM ranked
)
SELECT
    id,
    amount,
    paid_at,
    status,
    is_new_burst,
    session_no,
    is_new_burst_rank,
    row_seq,
    row_seq_2,
    CASE WHEN status RLIKE '^(REFUNDED|FAILED)$' THEN 'EXTENDED' WHEN status RLIKE '^(SUCCESS)$' THEN 'PRIORITY' ELSE 'OTHER_ZONE' END AS status_zone
FROM with_windows
ORDER BY is_new_burst_rank NULLS FIRST;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("method").orderBy("paid_at", "id")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("method").orderBy("paid_at", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w3 = Window.partitionBy("method", "order_id").orderBy("is_new_burst", "id")
w4 = Window.partitionBy("order_id", "status").orderBy(F.col("session_no").desc(), "id")
w5 = Window.partitionBy("status").orderBy(F.col("is_new_burst").asc_nulls_first())
w6 = Window.orderBy("paid_at", "id")
w7 = Window.orderBy(F.col("paid_at").desc(), "id")
w8 = Window.partitionBy("order_id", "method").orderBy(F.col("is_new_burst_rank").desc_nulls_first(), "id")
w9 = Window.orderBy("amount", "id").rowsBetween(-3, -1)
w10 = Window.orderBy("paid_at", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w11 = Window.partitionBy("method").orderBy(F.col("paid_at").cast("bigint")).rangeBetween(-604800, Window.currentRow)

with_gaps = (
    df_payments
    .withColumn("is_new_burst", F.when(F.lag("paid_at").over(w).isNull() | (F.col("paid_at") > F.lag("paid_at").over(w) + F.expr("INTERVAL 90 DAYS")), 1).otherwise(0))
)

islands = with_gaps.withColumn("session_no", F.sum("is_new_burst").over(w2))

metrics = (
    islands
    .select(
        "*",
        F.ntile(3).over(w3).alias("is_new_burst_bucket"),
        F.row_number().over(w4).alias("event_seq"),
        F.rank().over(w5).alias("is_new_burst_rank"),
        F.row_number().over(w6).alias("row_seq"),
        F.row_number().over(w7).alias("row_seq_2"),
    )
)

ranked = (
    metrics
    .withColumn("row_num", F.row_number().over(w8))
    .filter(F.col("row_num") == 1)
)

with_windows = (
    ranked
    .select(
        "*",
        F.avg("row_seq").over(w9).alias("row_seq_avg_3_prior"),
        F.sum("row_seq").over(w10).alias("running_row_seq"),
        F.max("is_new_burst").over(w11).alias("is_new_burst_max_7d"),
    )
)

result = (
    with_windows
    .select(
        "id",
        "amount",
        "paid_at",
        "status",
        "is_new_burst",
        "session_no",
        "is_new_burst_rank",
        "row_seq",
        "row_seq_2",
        F.when(F.col("status").rlike("^(REFUNDED|FAILED)$"), "EXTENDED").when(F.col("status").rlike("^(SUCCESS)$"), "PRIORITY").otherwise("OTHER_ZONE").alias("status_zone"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("is_new_burst_rank").asc_nulls_first())
)

WITH base AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT *, CONCAT_WS('-', country, browser) AS country_browser_key
    FROM sessions
    WHERE started_at > TIMESTAMP '2023-07-19 10:00:00'
),
valid AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT
        id,
        device,
        started_at,
        country_browser_key,
        DATEDIFF(CURRENT_DATE(), started_at) AS days_since_started_at
    FROM base
    WHERE started_at > TIMESTAMP '2024-02-12 21:00:00'
      AND device IN ('desktop', 'tablet', 'mobile')
),
metrics AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        *,
        SUM(days_since_started_at) OVER (PARTITION BY device ORDER BY CAST(started_at AS BIGINT) RANGE BETWEEN 7776000 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS days_since_started_at_sum_90d,
        LEAD(days_since_started_at, 1) OVER w_grp AS next_days_since_started_at,
        COUNT(days_since_started_at) OVER (ORDER BY CAST(started_at AS BIGINT) RANGE BETWEEN 604800 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS days_since_started_at_count_7d,
        NTILE(5) OVER (PARTITION BY device ORDER BY days_since_started_at, id) AS days_since_started_at_bucket
    FROM valid
    WINDOW w_grp AS (PARTITION BY device ORDER BY started_at, id)
),
latest_match AS (
    -- Latest matching web_event per row (LATERAL ... LIMIT 1)
    SELECT s.*, x.event_type
    FROM metrics s
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
            SELECT c.event_type
            FROM web_events c
            WHERE c.session_id = s.id
            ORDER BY c.duration_sec DESC, c.id DESC
            LIMIT 1
        ) x ON TRUE
),
metrics_sessions AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        *,
        COUNT(days_since_started_at_sum_90d) OVER (PARTITION BY device ORDER BY CAST(started_at AS BIGINT) RANGE BETWEEN 604800 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS days_since_started_at_sum_90d_count_7d,
        LEAD(days_since_started_at_count_7d, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY device ORDER BY days_since_started_at_count_7d, id) AS next_days_since_started_at_count_7d,
        SUM(days_since_started_at_sum_90d) OVER (ORDER BY next_days_since_started_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_days_since_started_at_sum_90d
    FROM latest_match
),
prev_events AS (
    -- Previous event time per key
    SELECT *, LAG(started_at) OVER (PARTITION BY event_type ORDER BY started_at, id) AS prev_started_at
    FROM metrics_sessions
),
with_gaps AS (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN prev_started_at IS NULL OR started_at > prev_started_at + INTERVAL 60 DAYS THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_new_session
    FROM prev_events
),
sessions_sessions AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(is_new_session) OVER (PARTITION BY event_type ORDER BY started_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS island_id
    FROM with_gaps
),
with_windows AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        *,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY days_since_started_at_sum_90d DESC) AS days_since_started_at_sum_90d_dense_rank,
        MAX(running_days_since_started_at_sum_90d) OVER (PARTITION BY event_type ORDER BY CAST(prev_started_at AS BIGINT) RANGE BETWEEN 604800 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_days_since_started_at_sum_90d_max_7d
    FROM sessions_sessions
)
SELECT
    id,
    device,
    country_browser_key,
    days_since_started_at,
    days_since_started_at_sum_90d,
    next_days_since_started_at,
    days_since_started_at_count_7d,
    days_since_started_at_bucket,
    days_since_started_at_sum_90d_count_7d,
    CASE WHEN device RLIKE '^(tablet|desktop)$' THEN 'EXTENDED' WHEN device RLIKE '^(mobile)$' THEN 'CORE' ELSE 'GROUP_A' END AS device_zone
FROM with_windows
ORDER BY device_zone DESC NULLS LAST;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("device").orderBy(F.col("started_at").cast("bigint")).rangeBetween(-7776000, Window.currentRow)
w_grp = Window.partitionBy("device").orderBy("started_at", "id")
w3 = Window.orderBy(F.col("started_at").cast("bigint")).rangeBetween(-604800, Window.currentRow)
w4 = Window.partitionBy("device").orderBy("days_since_started_at", "id")
w5 = Window.partitionBy(F.col("s.id")).orderBy(F.col("c.duration_sec").desc(), F.col("c.id").desc())
w6 = Window.partitionBy("device").orderBy(F.col("started_at").cast("bigint")).rangeBetween(-604800, Window.currentRow)
w7 = Window.partitionBy("device").orderBy("days_since_started_at_count_7d", "id")
w8 = Window.orderBy("next_days_since_started_at", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w9 = Window.partitionBy("event_type").orderBy("started_at", "id")
w10 = Window.partitionBy("event_type").orderBy("started_at", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w11 = Window.orderBy(F.col("days_since_started_at_sum_90d").desc())
w12 = Window.partitionBy("event_type").orderBy(F.col("prev_started_at").cast("bigint")).rangeBetween(-604800, Window.currentRow)

base = (
    df_sessions
    .filter(F.col("started_at") > F.lit("2023-07-19 10:00:00").cast("timestamp"))
    .withColumn("country_browser_key", F.concat_ws("-", "country", "browser"))
)

valid = (
    base
    .filter((F.col("started_at") > F.lit("2024-02-12 21:00:00").cast("timestamp")) & F.col("device").isin(["desktop", "tablet", "mobile"]))
    .select(
        "id",
        "device",
        "started_at",
        "country_browser_key",
        F.datediff(F.current_date(), "started_at").alias("days_since_started_at"),
    )
)

metrics = (
    valid
    .select(
        "*",
        F.sum("days_since_started_at").over(w).alias("days_since_started_at_sum_90d"),
        F.lead("days_since_started_at", 1).over(w_grp).alias("next_days_since_started_at"),
        F.count("days_since_started_at").over(w3).alias("days_since_started_at_count_7d"),
        F.ntile(5).over(w4).alias("days_since_started_at_bucket"),
    )
)

latest_match = (
    metrics
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_web_events.alias("c"), (F.col("c.session_id") == F.col("s.id")), "left")
    .withColumn("rn", F.row_number().over(w5))
    .filter(F.col("rn") == 1)
    .select("s.*", F.col("c.event_type"))
)

metrics_sessions = (
    latest_match
    .withColumn("days_since_started_at_sum_90d_count_7d", F.count("days_since_started_at_sum_90d").over(w6))
    .withColumn("next_days_since_started_at_count_7d", F.lead("days_since_started_at_count_7d", 1).over(w7))
    .withColumn("running_days_since_started_at_sum_90d", F.sum("days_since_started_at_sum_90d").over(w8))
)

prev_events = metrics_sessions.withColumn("prev_started_at", F.lag("started_at").over(w9))

with_gaps = (
    prev_events
    .withColumn("is_new_session", F.when(F.col("prev_started_at").isNull() | (F.col("started_at") > F.col("prev_started_at") + F.expr("INTERVAL 60 DAYS")), 1).otherwise(0))
)

sessions_sessions = with_gaps.withColumn("island_id", F.sum("is_new_session").over(w10))

with_windows = (
    sessions_sessions
    .withColumn("days_since_started_at_sum_90d_dense_rank", F.dense_rank().over(w11))
    .withColumn("running_days_since_started_at_sum_90d_max_7d", F.max("running_days_since_started_at_sum_90d").over(w12))
)

result = (
    with_windows
    .select(
        "id",
        "device",
        "country_browser_key",
        "days_since_started_at",
        "days_since_started_at_sum_90d",
        "next_days_since_started_at",
        "days_since_started_at_count_7d",
        "days_since_started_at_bucket",
        "days_since_started_at_sum_90d_count_7d",
        F.when(F.col("device").rlike("^(tablet|desktop)$"), "EXTENDED").when(F.col("device").rlike("^(mobile)$"), "CORE").otherwise("GROUP_A").alias("device_zone"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("device_zone").desc_nulls_last())
)

sql:
WITH lines AS (
    -- Unnest the array into one row per element
    SELECT
        id,
        service,
        host,
        log_ts,
        level,
        latency_ms,
        status_code,
        key,
        value
    FROM app_logs
    LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(context) t AS key, value
),
unpacked AS (
    -- Struct fields, map lookups and JSON extraction
    SELECT
        id,
        service,
        host,
        level,
        status_code,
        key,
        value,
        SHIFTRIGHT(status_code, 2) AS status_code_high,
        CAST((status_code & 2) != 0 AS INT) AS is_flagged
    FROM lines
),
latest AS (
    -- Deduplicate with ROW_NUMBER
    SELECT *
    FROM (
        SELECT *, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY level ORDER BY is_flagged DESC NULLS LAST) AS latest_rank
        FROM unpacked
    ) x
    WHERE latest_rank = 1
),
enriched AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        *,
        NTILE(4) OVER (PARTITION BY host ORDER BY status_code_high DESC, id, key) AS status_code_high_bucket,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY service ORDER BY is_flagged DESC NULLS LAST) AS is_flagged_dense_rank,
        CUME_DIST() OVER (PARTITION BY host ORDER BY is_flagged NULLS FIRST) AS is_flagged_cume_dist,
        LEAD(status_code, 1) OVER w_part AS next_status_code
    FROM latest
    WINDOW w_part AS (ORDER BY latest_rank, id, key)
)
-- Aggregate with conditional metrics
SELECT
    CASE WHEN is_flagged_cume_dist >= 0.74 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END AS is_flagged_cume_dist_tier,
    CASE WHEN is_flagged >= 1 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END AS is_flagged_tier,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE host = 'h1') AS h1_rows,
    SUM(CASE WHEN service = 'auth' THEN status_code_high ELSE 0 END) AS auth_status_code_high,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN key = 'region' THEN 1 END) AS region_count,
    MAX(next_status_code) AS max_next_status_code
FROM enriched
GROUP BY CASE WHEN is_flagged_cume_dist >= 0.74 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END, CASE WHEN is_flagged >= 1 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END
ORDER BY is_flagged_cume_dist_tier;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("level").orderBy(F.col("is_flagged").desc_nulls_last())
w2 = Window.partitionBy("host").orderBy(F.col("status_code_high").desc(), "id", "key")
w3 = Window.partitionBy("service").orderBy(F.col("is_flagged").desc_nulls_last())
w4 = Window.partitionBy("host").orderBy(F.col("is_flagged").asc_nulls_first())
w_part = Window.orderBy("latest_rank", "id", "key")

lines = (
    df_app_logs
    .select(
        "id",
        "service",
        "host",
        "log_ts",
        "level",
        "latency_ms",
        "status_code",
        F.explode("context").alias("key", "value"),
    )
)

unpacked = (
    lines
    .select(
        "id",
        "service",
        "host",
        "level",
        "status_code",
        "key",
        "value",
        F.shiftright("status_code", 2).alias("status_code_high"),
        (F.col("status_code").bitwiseAND(2) != 0).cast("int").alias("is_flagged"),
    )
)

latest = (
    unpacked
    .withColumn("latest_rank", F.rank().over(w))
    .filter(F.col("latest_rank") == 1)
)

enriched = (
    latest
    .withColumn("status_code_high_bucket", F.ntile(4).over(w2))
    .withColumn("is_flagged_dense_rank", F.dense_rank().over(w3))
    .withColumn("is_flagged_cume_dist", F.cume_dist().over(w4))
    .withColumn("next_status_code", F.lead("status_code", 1).over(w_part))
)

result = (
    enriched
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("is_flagged_cume_dist") >= 0.74, "LARGE").otherwise("SMALL").alias("is_flagged_cume_dist_tier"),
        F.when(F.col("is_flagged") >= 1, "HIGH").otherwise("LOW").alias("is_flagged_tier"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.count(F.when(F.col("host") == "h1", 1)).alias("h1_rows"),
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("service") == "auth", F.col("status_code_high")).otherwise(0)).alias("auth_status_code_high"),
        F.count(F.when(F.col("key") == "region", 1)).alias("region_count"),
        F.max("next_status_code").alias("max_next_status_code"),
    )
    .orderBy("is_flagged_cume_dist_tier")
)

with flattened as (
    -- Unnest the array into one row per element
    select
        id,
        plan,
        effective_from,
        currency,
        element
    from price_tiers
    lateral view outer explode(tier_prices) li as element
),
valid as (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    select
        id,
        plan,
        effective_from,
        element,
        concat(plan, ' - ', currency) as plan_currency
    from flattened
    where effective_from >= date '2024-07-22'
      and currency = 'USD'
),
scored as (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    select
        id,
        plan,
        effective_from,
        element,
        plan_currency,
        percent_rank() over (partition by plan order by element desc nulls last) as element_percent_rank,
        dense_rank() over (order by element desc nulls first) as element_dense_rank,
        rank() over (partition by plan order by element desc) as element_rank
    from valid
),
base as (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    select *, lower(plan) as plan_lower
    from scored
    where element between 38 and 61
),
valid_price_tiers as (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    select
        *,
        coalesce(element_rank, 0) as element_rank_filled,
        round(element_percent_rank * 0.9, 2) as element_percent_rank_adjusted
    from base
    where effective_from >= date '2024-05-29'
      and element_percent_rank >= 0.68
),
cleaned as (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    select *, round(element_percent_rank_adjusted * 100, 2) as element_percent_rank_adjusted_scaled
    from valid_price_tiers
    where element_dense_rank between 4 and 7
),
cleaned_price_tiers as (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns

        *,
        NTILE(5) OVER (ORDER BY age DESC, id) AS age_bucket,
        LAG(age, 1, 0) OVER (PARTITION BY country ORDER BY signup_date, id) AS prev_age,
        LEAD(credit_limit, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY city ORDER BY credit_limit, id) AS next_credit_limit
    FROM customers
),
base AS (
    SELECT *, TRIM(segment) AS clean_segment
    FROM scored
    WHERE signup_date > DATE '2023-09-27'
),
with_windows AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        LAST_VALUE(credit_limit) IGNORE NULLS OVER (PARTITION BY city ORDER BY prev_age, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS last_known_credit_limit,
        AVG(age_bucket) OVER (PARTITION BY city ORDER BY prev_age, id ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS age_bucket_avg_6,
        FIRST_VALUE(age, TRUE) OVER (PARTITION BY segment ORDER BY signup_date, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS first_known_age,
        LAG(prev_age, 1) OVER (ORDER BY age, id) AS prev_prev_age,
        SUM(next_credit_limit) OVER (ORDER BY prev_age, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_next_credit_limit
    FROM base
),
metrics AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        LAG(prev_prev_age, 1) OVER w_part AS prev_prev_prev_age,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY segment ORDER BY prev_age DESC NULLS LAST) AS prev_age_rank,
        ROUND(prev_prev_age / SUM(prev_prev_age) OVER (PARTITION BY country), 4) AS prev_prev_age_share

WITH filtered AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT *, CEIL(quantity) AS quantity_whole
    FROM inventory
    WHERE last_restock >= DATE '2024-03-26'
      AND product_id IN (5, 7, 8, 9)
),
enriched AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        *,
        SUM(quantity_whole) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY last_restock, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_quantity_whole,
        LAST_VALUE(quantity, TRUE) OVER (PARTITION BY store_id, product_id ORDER BY last_restock, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS last_known_quantity,
        LAG(quantity, 2, 0) OVER (PARTITION BY store_id ORDER BY quantity, id) AS prev_quantity
    FROM filtered
),
matched_keys AS (
    -- Set intersection on keys
    SELECT id, product_id
    FROM enriched
    INTERSECT
    SELECT id, product_id
    FROM inventory
    WHERE store_id IN (1, 3, 4, 5)
),
reconciled AS (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    SELECT s.*
    FROM enriched s
    INNER JOIN matched_keys k ON s.id = k.id AND s.product_id = k.product_id
),
stats AS (
    -- Aggregate with conditional metrics
    SELECT
        DATE_TRUNC('QUARTER', last_restock) AS quarter_start,
        BIT_OR(quantity) AS quantity_bit_or,
        PERCENTILE_APPROX(quantity, ARRAY(0.25, 0.5, 0.75)) AS quantity_quartiles,
        PERCENTILE_APPROX(last_known_quantity, 0.9) AS last_known_quantity_p90,
        MAX(quantity_whole) AS max_quantity_whole,
        COUNT(DISTINCT id) AS distinct_ids,
        PERCENTILE_APPROX(quantity_whole, ARRAY(0.25, 0.5, 0.75)) AS quantity_whole_quartiles
    FROM reconciled
    GROUP BY quarter_start
)
SELECT
    quarter_start,
    quantity_bit_or,
    quantity_quartiles,
    last_known_quantity_p90,
    max_quantity_whole,
    distinct_ids
FROM stats
ORDER BY quantity_bit_or DESC

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("product_id").orderBy("last_restock", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w2 = Window.partitionBy("store_id", "product_id").orderBy("last_restock", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w3 = Window.partitionBy("store_id").orderBy("quantity", "id")

filtered = (
    df_inventory
    .filter((F.col("last_restock") >= F.lit("2024-03-26").cast("date")) & F.col("product_id").isin([5, 7, 8, 9]))
    .select("*", F.ceil("quantity").alias("quantity_whole"))
)

enriched = (
    filtered
    .select(
        "*",
        F.sum("quantity_whole").over(w).alias("cumulative_quantity_whole"),
        F.last("quantity", ignorenulls=True).over(w2).alias("last_known_quantity"),
        F.lag("quantity", 2, 0).over(w3).alias("prev_quantity"),
    )
)

matched_keys = (
    enriched
    .select("id", "product_id")
    .intersect(
        df_inventory
        .filter(F.col("store_id").isin([1, 3, 4, 5]))
        .select("id", "product_id")
    )
)

reconciled = (
    enriched
    .alias("s")
    .join(matched_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.id") == F.col("k.id")) & (F.col("s.product_id") == F.col("k.product_id")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

stats = (
    reconciled
    .groupBy(F.date_trunc("QUARTER", "last_restock").alias("quarter_start"))
    .agg(
        F.bit_or("quantity").alias("quantity_bit_or"),
        F.percentile_approx("quantity", [0.25, 0.5, 0.75]).alias("quantity_quartiles"),
        F.percentile_approx("last_known_quantity", 0.9).alias("last_known_quantity_p90"),
        F.max("quantity_whole").alias("max_quantity_whole"),
        F.countDistinct("id").alias("distinct_ids"),
        F.percentile_approx("quantity_whole", [0.25, 0.5, 0.75]).alias("quantity_whole_quartiles"),
    )
)

result = (
    stats
    .select(
        "quarter_start",
        "quantity_bit_or",
        "quantity_quartiles",
        "last_known_quantity_p90",
        "max_quantity_whole",
        "distinct_ids",
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("quantity_bit_or").desc())
)

with exploded as (
    -- Unnest the array into one row per element
    select
        id,
        latency_ms,
        status_code,
        attr_key,
        value
    from app_logs
    lateral view explode(context) t as attr_key, value
),
deduped as (
    -- Keep one row per key (latest first)
    select *
    from (
        select *, row_number() over (partition by attr_key order by status_code desc, id, attr_key) as rn
        from exploded
    ) t
    where rn = 1
),
scored as (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    select
        *,
        corr(latency_ms, status_code) over (partition by attr_key) as corr_latency_ms_status_code,
        lead(status_code, 1) over w_grp as next_status_code,
        ntile(10) over (order by latency_ms desc, id, attr_key) as latency_ms_bucket,
        last_value(attr_key, true) over (partition by attr_key order by latency_ms, id, attr_key rows between unbounded preceding and current row) as last_known_attr_key,
        first_value(latency_ms) ignore nulls over (order by rn, id, attr_key rows between unbounded preceding and current row) as first_known_latency_ms
    from deduped
    window w_grp as (partition by attr_key order by status_code, id, attr_key)
),
scored_app_logs as (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    select
        *,
        corr(latency_ms, status_code) over (partition by attr_key) as corr_latency_ms_status_code_2,
        lead(next_status_code, 1) over w_ordered as next_next_status_code,
        cume_dist() over w_hist as first_known_latency_ms_cume_dist
    from scored
    window w_ordered as (partition by attr_key order by corr_latency_ms_status_code, id, attr_key), w_hist as (partition by attr_key order by first_known_latency_ms desc nulls last)
)
select
    id,
    attr_key,
    value,
    rn,
    next_status_code,
    last_known_attr_key,
    first_known_latency_ms,
    corr_latency_ms_status_code_2,
    next_next_status_code,
    case when attr_key rlike '^(region|version)$' then 'PRIORITY' else 'CORE' end as attr_key_zone
from scored_app_logs
order by next_status_code nulls first;

    from sessions

    where country = 'US'

reconciled as (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    select s.*
    from sessions s
    inner join matched_keys k on s.id = k.id
),
kept as (
    -- Anti-join via a correlated subquery
    select s.*
    from reconciled s
    where not exists (
            select 1
            from web_events ch
            where ch.session_id = s.id
              and ch.event_time >= s.started_at
        )
),
enriched as (
    -- Attach customers attributes
    select
        s.*,
        d.age,
        d.segment,
        d.city
    from kept s
    left join customers d
        on s.customer_id = d.id
),
with_dims as (
    -- Attach customers attributes
    select
        a.*,
        p.country as customer_country,
        p.name,
        p.age as customer_age
    from enriched a
    left join customers p
        on a.customer_id = p.id
),
summary as (
    -- Aggregate with conditional metrics
    select
        case when age >= 65 then 'HIGH' else 'LOW' end as age_tier,
        browser,
        date_trunc('week', started_at) as week_start,
        approx_percentile(age, 0.9) as age_p90,
        count_if(country = 'US') as us_events
    from with_dims
    group by cube (case when age >= 65 then 'HIGH' else 'LOW' end, browser, date_trunc('week', started_at))
)

    age_tier,
    week_start,
    us_events
from summary
order by week_start, age_tier desc;

    FROM joined

        PERCENTILE_APPROX(budget, 0.5) AS budget_p50,
        COUNT(DISTINCT location) AS distinct_locations,
        AVG(salary_avg_6_prior) AS avg_salary_avg_6_prior,
        ROUND(AVG(budget_share), 2) AS avg_budget_share,
        COUNT(*) AS num_rows
    FROM with_windows
    GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT

    avg_salary_avg_6_prior,
    num_rows

with unpacked as (
    -- Semi-structured parsing
    select
        id,
        created_at,
        coupon_codes,
        items,
        transform(
            filter(items, item -> item.promo is not null),
            item -> struct(item.product_id as pid, round(item.price * 0.9, 2) as discounted_price)
        ) as promo_lines,
        ship_to.country as ship_country,
        array_contains(map_keys(attributes), 'device') as has_device
    from carts
    where array_contains(coupon_codes, 'BUNDLE')
)
-- Grouped metrics
select
    ship_country,
    max(created_at) as ended_at,
    sort_array(collect_set(ship_country)) as ship_country_list,
    count(case when ship_country = 'SG' then 1 end) as sg_count,
    sort_array(collect_set(ship_country)) as ship_country_list_2
from unpacked
group by ship_country
having sg_count > 1;

from pyspark.sql import functions as F

unpacked = (
    df_carts
    .filter(F.array_contains("coupon_codes", "BUNDLE"))
    .select(
        "id",
        "created_at",
        "coupon_codes",
        "items",
        F.transform(
            F.filter("items", lambda item: item["promo"].isNotNull()),
            lambda item: F.struct(item["product_id"].alias("pid"), F.round(item["price"] * 0.9, 2).alias("discounted_price")),
        ).alias("promo_lines"),
        F.col("ship_to.country").alias("ship_country"),
        F.array_contains(F.map_keys("attributes"), "device").alias("has_device"),
    )
)

result = (
    unpacked
    .groupBy("ship_country")
    .agg(
        F.max("created_at").alias("ended_at"),

        F.count(F.when(F.col("ship_country") == "SG", 1)).alias("sg_count"),
        F.sort_array(F.collect_set("ship_country")).alias("ship_country_list_2"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("sg_count") > 1)
)

sql: SELECT CASE WHEN cost >= 77 THEN 'high' WHEN cost >= 44 THEN 'mid' ELSE 'low' END AS cost_bucket, CASE WHEN YEAR(shipped_date) < 2024 THEN 'before_2024' WHEN YEAR(shipped_date) = 2024 THEN '2024' ELSE 'after_2024' END AS shipped_cohort, carrier, ROUND(STDDEV(cost), 2) AS stddev_cost, COUNT(cost) AS cost_count FROM shipments WHERE delivered_date >= '2025-10-01' AND status = 'IN_TRANSIT' AND carrier != 'UPS' GROUP BY CASE WHEN cost >= 77 THEN 'high' WHEN cost >= 44 THEN 'mid' ELSE 'low' END, CASE WHEN YEAR(shipped_date) < 2024 THEN 'before_2024' WHEN YEAR(shipped_date) = 2024 THEN '2024' ELSE 'after_2024' END, carrier HAVING stddev_cost > 60 ORDER BY stddev_cost, cost_bucket, shipped_cohort, carrier LIMIT 3

WITH cleaned AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT *, CAST(amount AS INT) AS amount_int
    FROM payments
    WHERE paid_at > DATE '2023-11-30'
),
valid AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        id,
        order_id,
        method,
        amount,
        paid_at,
        status,
        amount_int,
        SUBSTRING(method, 1, 2) AS method_prefix,
        COALESCE(method, 'N/A') AS method_clean
    FROM cleaned
    WHERE paid_at >= DATE '2024-01-26'
),
enriched AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        *,
        SUM(amount_int) OVER (ORDER BY CAST(paid_at AS BIGINT) RANGE BETWEEN 2592000 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS amount_int_sum_30d,
        SUM(amount_int) OVER (PARTITION BY order_id, status ORDER BY paid_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_amount_int,
        AVG(amount) OVER (ORDER BY amount, id ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS amount_avg_3,
        FIRST_VALUE(method) IGNORE NULLS OVER (ORDER BY amount, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS first_known_method,
        NTILE(5) OVER (PARTITION BY order_id, method ORDER BY amount, id) AS amount_bucket
    FROM valid
),
with_gaps AS (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > interval)
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN paid_at - LAG(paid_at) OVER (PARTITION BY status ORDER BY paid_at, id) > INTERVAL '14' DAY THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS new_group_flag
    FROM enriched
),
sessionized AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(new_group_flag) OVER (PARTITION BY status ORDER BY paid_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS burst_id
    FROM with_gaps
)
-- Window metrics over several different partitions
SELECT
    id,
    order_id,
    method,
    amount,
    paid_at,
    status,
    amount_int,
    method_prefix,
    method_clean,
    amount_int_sum_30d,
    running_amount_int,
    amount_avg_3,
    first_known_method,
    amount_bucket,
    new_group_flag,
    burst_id,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY status ORDER BY amount_bucket, id) AS seq_no,
    MAX(amount_bucket) OVER w_running AS amount_bucket_max_90d
FROM sessionized
WINDOW w_running AS (ORDER BY CAST(paid_at AS BIGINT) RANGE BETWEEN 7776000 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW);
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.orderBy(F.col("paid_at").cast("bigint")).rangeBetween(-2592000, Window.currentRow)
w2 = Window.partitionBy("order_id", "status").orderBy("paid_at", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w3 = Window.orderBy("amount", "id").rowsBetween(-3, Window.currentRow)
w4 = Window.orderBy("amount", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w5 = Window.partitionBy("order_id", "method").orderBy("amount", "id")
w6 = Window.partitionBy("status").orderBy("paid_at", "id")
w7 = Window.partitionBy("status").orderBy("paid_at", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w8 = Window.partitionBy("status").orderBy("amount_bucket", "id")
w_running = Window.orderBy(F.col("paid_at").cast("bigint")).rangeBetween(-7776000, Window.currentRow)

cleaned = (
    df_payments
    .filter(F.col("paid_at") > F.lit("2023-11-30").cast("date"))
    .select("*", F.col("amount").cast("int").alias("amount_int"))
)

valid = (
    cleaned
    .filter(F.col("paid_at") >= F.lit("2024-01-26").cast("date"))
    .select(
        "id",
        "order_id",
        "method",
        "amount",
        "paid_at",
        "status",
        "amount_int",
        F.substring("method", 1, 2).alias("method_prefix"),
        F.coalesce("method", F.lit("N/A")).alias("method_clean"),
    )
)

enriched = (
    valid
    .select(
        "*",
        F.sum("amount_int").over(w).alias("amount_int_sum_30d"),
        F.sum("amount_int").over(w2).alias("running_amount_int"),
        F.avg("amount").over(w3).alias("amount_avg_3"),
        F.first("method", ignorenulls=True).over(w4).alias("first_known_method"),
        F.ntile(5).over(w5).alias("amount_bucket"),
    )
)

with_gaps = (
    enriched
    .withColumn("new_group_flag", F.when(F.col("paid_at") - F.lag("paid_at").over(w6) > F.expr("INTERVAL 14 DAYS"), 1).otherwise(0))
)

sessionized = with_gaps.withColumn("burst_id", F.sum("new_group_flag").over(w7))

result = (
    sessionized
    .select(
        "*",
        F.row_number().over(w8).alias("seq_no"),
        F.max("amount_bucket").over(w_running).alias("amount_bucket_max_90d"),
    )
)

WITH valid AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT
        id,
        customer_id,
        start_date,
        monthly_fee,
        status,
        ROUND(monthly_fee, 2) AS monthly_fee_rounded
    FROM subscriptions
    WHERE customer_id IS NOT NULL
),
with_windows AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        *,
        LEAD(monthly_fee, 2, 0) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY start_date, id) AS next_monthly_fee,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER w_part AS row_seq,
        LAG(monthly_fee, 2) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id, status ORDER BY monthly_fee_rounded, id) AS prev_monthly_fee
    FROM valid
    WINDOW w_part AS (ORDER BY start_date DESC, id)
),
matched AS (
    -- Non-equi join on a validity window
    SELECT
        s.*,
        sub.id AS subscription_id,
        sub.plan,
        sub.monthly_fee AS subscription_monthly_fee
    FROM with_windows s
    JOIN subscriptions sub
        ON s.customer_id = sub.customer_id
       AND s.start_date BETWEEN sub.start_date AND sub.end_date
),
with_dims AS (
    -- Attach customers attributes
    SELECT
        e.*,
        b.country,
        b.name
    FROM matched e
    LEFT JOIN customers b
        ON e.customer_id = b.id
)
-- Native SQL PIVOT
SELECT *
FROM (
    SELECT
        customer_id,
        plan,
        monthly_fee
    FROM with_dims
) src
PIVOT (
    MAX(monthly_fee)
    FOR plan IN ('basic' AS basic, 'enterprise' AS enterprise)
)

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("customer_id").orderBy("start_date", "id")
w_part = Window.orderBy(F.col("start_date").desc(), "id")
w3 = Window.partitionBy("customer_id", "status").orderBy("monthly_fee_rounded", "id")

valid = (
    df_subscriptions
    .filter(F.col("customer_id").isNotNull())
    .select(
        "id",
        "customer_id",
        "start_date",
        "monthly_fee",
        "status",
        F.round("monthly_fee", 2).alias("monthly_fee_rounded"),
    )
)

with_windows = (
    valid
    .select(
        "*",
        F.lead("monthly_fee", 2, 0).over(w).alias("next_monthly_fee"),
        F.row_number().over(w_part).alias("row_seq"),
        F.lag("monthly_fee", 2).over(w3).alias("prev_monthly_fee"),
    )
)

matched = (
    with_windows
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_subscriptions.alias("sub"), (F.col("s.customer_id") == F.col("sub.customer_id")) & F.col("s.start_date").between(F.col("sub.start_date"), F.col("sub.end_date")), "inner")
    .select(
        "s.*",
        F.col("sub.id").alias("subscription_id"),
        F.col("sub.plan"),
        F.col("sub.monthly_fee").alias("subscription_monthly_fee"),
    )
)

with_dims = (
    matched
    .alias("e")
    .join(df_customers.alias("b"), F.col("e.customer_id") == F.col("b.id"), "left")
    .select("e.*", F.col("b.country"), F.col("b.name"))
)

result = (
    with_dims
    .groupBy("customer_id")
    .pivot("plan", ["basic", "enterprise"])
    .agg(F.max("monthly_fee"))
)

WITH filtered AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        id,
        device_code,
        temp_c,
        humidity,
        pressure,
        status_bits,
        firmware,
        DATEDIFF(CURRENT_DATE(), reading_ts) AS days_since_reading_ts
    FROM device_readings
    WHERE reading_ts >= TO_TIMESTAMP('2025-09-01 02:00:00')
),
valid AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        id,
        device_code,
        temp_c,
        humidity,
        status_bits,
        firmware,
        days_since_reading_ts,
        ROUND(pressure / humidity, 2) AS pressure_per_humidity
    FROM filtered
    WHERE pressure < 1013
),
latest AS (
    -- Deduplicate with ROW_NUMBER
    SELECT *
    FROM (
        SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY device_code ORDER BY pressure_per_humidity DESC NULLS FIRST, id) AS row_num
        FROM valid
    ) x
    WHERE row_num = 1
),
valid_device_readings AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        id,
        device_code,
        temp_c,
        humidity,
        status_bits,
        firmware,
        row_num,
        status_bits + days_since_reading_ts AS status_bits_plus_days_since_reading_ts
    FROM latest
    WHERE firmware = '2.0.1'
),
kept_keys AS (
    -- Set intersection on keys
    SELECT id, device_code
    FROM valid_device_readings
    INTERSECT ALL
    SELECT id, device_code
    FROM device_readings
    WHERE reading_ts >= '2025-02-05'
),
kept_rows AS (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    SELECT s.*
    FROM valid_device_readings s
    INNER JOIN kept_keys k ON s.id = k.id AND s.device_code = k.device_code
)
-- Native SQL UNPIVOT (wide to long)
SELECT *
FROM (
    SELECT
        device_code,
        temp_c,
        status_bits_plus_days_since_reading_ts,
        humidity
    FROM kept_rows
) src
UNPIVOT (
    val FOR metric_name IN (temp_c, status_bits_plus_days_since_reading_ts AS STATUS_BITS_PLUS_DAYS_SINCE_READING_TS, humidity)
)

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("device_code").orderBy(F.col("pressure_per_humidity").desc_nulls_first(), "id")

filtered = (
    df_device_readings
    .filter(F.col("reading_ts") >= F.to_timestamp(F.lit("2025-09-01 02:00:00")))
    .select(
        "id",
        "device_code",
        "temp_c",
        "humidity",
        "pressure",
        "status_bits",
        "firmware",
        F.datediff(F.current_date(), "reading_ts").alias("days_since_reading_ts"),
    )
)

valid = (
    filtered
    .filter(F.col("pressure") < 1013)
    .select(
        "id",
        "device_code",
        "temp_c",
        "humidity",
        "status_bits",
        "firmware",
        "days_since_reading_ts",
        F.round((F.col("pressure") / F.col("humidity")), 2).alias("pressure_per_humidity"),
    )
)

latest = (
    valid
    .withColumn("row_num", F.row_number().over(w))
    .filter(F.col("row_num") == 1)
)

valid_device_readings = (
    latest
    .filter(F.col("firmware") == "2.0.1")
    .select(
        "id",
        "device_code",
        "temp_c",
        "humidity",
        "status_bits",
        "firmware",
        "row_num",
        (F.col("status_bits") + F.col("days_since_reading_ts")).alias("status_bits_plus_days_since_reading_ts"),
    )
)

kept_keys = (
    valid_device_readings
    .select("id", "device_code")
    .intersectAll(
        df_device_readings
        .filter(F.col("reading_ts") >= "2025-02-05")
        .select("id", "device_code")
    )
)

kept_rows = (
    valid_device_readings
    .alias("s")
    .join(kept_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.id") == F.col("k.id")) & (F.col("s.device_code") == F.col("k.device_code")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

result = (
    kept_rows
    .select(
        "device_code",
        "temp_c",
        F.col("status_bits_plus_days_since_reading_ts").alias("STATUS_BITS_PLUS_DAYS_SINCE_READING_TS"),
        "humidity",
    )
    .unpivot(
        ["device_code"],
        ["temp_c", "STATUS_BITS_PLUS_DAYS_SINCE_READING_TS", "humidity"],
        "metric_name",
        "val",
    )
    .filter(F.col("val").isNotNull())
)

with filtered as (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    select
        *,
        case when country in ('SG', 'US') then 'Core' else 'Other' end as country_group,
        coalesce(browser, 'NONE') as browser_clean
    from sessions
    where to_date(started_at) < '2024-08-01'
),
metrics as (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    select
        *,
        first_value(browser) ignore nulls over (partition by country order by started_at, id rows between unbounded preceding and current row) as first_known_browser,
        row_number() over (order by started_at, id) as event_seq
    from filtered
),
with_gaps as (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > interval)
    select *, case when lag(started_at) over (partition by country order by started_at, id) is null
                 or started_at > lag(started_at) over (partition by country order by started_at, id) + interval 90 days then 1 else 0 end as is_new_burst
    from metrics
),
islands as (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    select *, sum(is_new_burst) over (partition by country order by started_at, id rows between unbounded preceding and current row) as island_id
    from with_gaps
),
matched_keys as (
    -- Set intersection on keys
    select device, country
    from islands
    intersect all
    select device, country
    from sessions
    where country in ('TH', 'US', 'DE')
),
kept_rows as (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    select s.*
    from islands s
    join matched_keys k on s.device = k.device and s.country = k.country
),
valid as (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    select *, case when device = 'tablet' then 1 else 0 end as is_tablet
    from kept_rows
    where started_at >= date '2023-12-08'
      and browser is not null
)
-- Aggregate with conditional metrics
select
    browser,
    round(sum(island_id) / nullif(count(case when browser = 'Safari' then 1 end), 0), 2) as island_id_per_safari,
    sum(case when browser = 'Chrome' then is_new_burst else 0 end) as chrome_is_new_burst,
    approx_percentile(is_new_burst, array(0.25, 0.5, 0.75)) as is_new_burst_quartiles
from valid
group by rollup (browser)
having sum(case when browser = 'Chrome' then is_new_burst else 0 end) > 0
order by browser nulls last;

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("country").orderBy("started_at", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w2 = Window.orderBy("started_at", "id")
w3 = Window.partitionBy("country").orderBy("started_at", "id")

filtered = (
    df_sessions
    .filter(F.to_date("started_at") < "2024-08-01")
    .select(
        "*",
        F.when(F.col("country").isin(["SG", "US"]), "Core").otherwise("Other").alias("country_group"),
        F.coalesce("browser", F.lit("NONE")).alias("browser_clean"),
    )
)

metrics = (
    filtered
    .select(
        "*",
        F.first("browser", ignorenulls=True).over(w).alias("first_known_browser"),
        F.row_number().over(w2).alias("event_seq"),
    )
)

with_gaps = (
    metrics
    .withColumn("is_new_burst", F.when(F.lag("started_at").over(w3).isNull() | (F.col("started_at") > F.lag("started_at").over(w3) + F.expr("INTERVAL 90 DAYS")), 1).otherwise(0))
)

islands = with_gaps.withColumn("island_id", F.sum("is_new_burst").over(w))

matched_keys = (
    islands
    .select("device", "country")
    .intersectAll(
        df_sessions
        .filter(F.col("country").isin(["TH", "US", "DE"]))
        .select("device", "country")
    )
)

kept_rows = (
    islands
    .alias("s")
    .join(matched_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.device") == F.col("k.device")) & (F.col("s.country") == F.col("k.country")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

valid = (
    kept_rows
    .filter((F.col("started_at") >= F.lit("2023-12-08").cast("date")) & F.col("browser").isNotNull())
    .withColumn("is_tablet", F.when(F.col("device") == "tablet", 1).otherwise(0))
)

result = (
    valid
    .rollup("browser")
    .agg(
        F.round(F.sum("island_id") / F.nullif(F.count(F.when(F.col("browser") == "Safari", 1)), F.lit(0)), 2).alias("island_id_per_safari"),
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("browser") == "Chrome", F.col("is_new_burst")).otherwise(0)).alias("chrome_is_new_burst"),
        F.percentile_approx("is_new_burst", [0.25, 0.5, 0.75]).alias("is_new_burst_quartiles"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("chrome_is_new_burst") > 0)
    .orderBy(F.col("browser").asc_nulls_last())
)
