WITH filtered AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT
        id,
        store_name,
        city,
        region,
        sqft,
        LAST_DAY(opened_date) AS opened_date_month_end
    FROM stores
    WHERE region IS NOT NULL
),
kept_keys AS (
    -- Set difference on keys
    SELECT region, id
    FROM filtered
    EXCEPT ALL
    SELECT region, id
    FROM stores
    WHERE sqft >= 8251
),
kept_rows AS (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    SELECT s.*
    FROM filtered s
    INNER JOIN kept_keys k ON s.region = k.region AND s.id = k.id
),
scored AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        *,
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY sqft DESC NULLS FIRST) AS sqft_rank,
        ROUND(sqft / SUM(sqft) OVER (PARTITION BY region), 4) AS sqft_share,
        COUNT(sqft) OVER (PARTITION BY city, region) AS city_count_sqft,
        COUNT(sqft) OVER (PARTITION BY region) AS region_count_sqft
    FROM kept_rows
),
eligible AS (
    -- Semi-join via a correlated subquery
    SELECT s.*
    FROM scored s
    WHERE EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM orders x
            WHERE x.store_id = s.id
              AND x.customer_id IS NULL
        )
)
-- Running and moving aggregates
SELECT
    id,
    store_name,
    city,
    region,
    sqft,
    opened_date_month_end,
    sqft_rank,
    sqft_share,
    city_count_sqft,
    region_count_sqft,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY city, region ORDER BY sqft NULLS LAST) AS sqft_dense_rank,
    CUME_DIST() OVER (PARTITION BY region ORDER BY city_count_sqft DESC) AS city_count_sqft_cume_dist,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY city_count_sqft NULLS FIRST) AS city_count_sqft_dense_rank,
    PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY city, region ORDER BY sqft NULLS LAST) AS sqft_percent_rank,
    MIN(sqft_share) OVER (PARTITION BY city) AS city_min_sqft_share
FROM eligible
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.orderBy(F.col("sqft").desc_nulls_first())
w2 = Window.partitionBy("region")
w3 = Window.partitionBy("city", "region")
w4 = Window.partitionBy("city", "region").orderBy(F.col("sqft").asc_nulls_last())
w5 = Window.partitionBy("region").orderBy(F.col("city_count_sqft").desc())
w6 = Window.orderBy(F.col("city_count_sqft").asc_nulls_first())
w7 = Window.partitionBy("city")

filtered = (
    df_stores
    .filter(F.col("region").isNotNull())
    .select(
        "id",
        "store_name",
        "city",
        "region",
        "sqft",
        F.last_day("opened_date").alias("opened_date_month_end"),
    )
)

kept_keys = (
    filtered
    .select("region", "id")
    .exceptAll(
        df_stores
        .filter(F.col("sqft") >= 8251)
        .select("region", "id")
    )
)

kept_rows = (
    filtered
    .alias("s")
    .join(kept_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.region") == F.col("k.region")) & (F.col("s.id") == F.col("k.id")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

scored = (
    kept_rows
    .withColumn("sqft_rank", F.rank().over(w))
    .withColumn("sqft_share", F.round((F.col("sqft") / F.sum("sqft").over(w2)), 4))
    .withColumn("city_count_sqft", F.count("sqft").over(w3))
    .withColumn("region_count_sqft", F.count("sqft").over(w2))
)

eligible = (
    scored
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_orders.alias("x"), (F.col("x.store_id") == F.col("s.id")) & (F.col("x.customer_id").isNull()), "left_semi")
)

result = (
    eligible
    .withColumn("sqft_dense_rank", F.dense_rank().over(w4))

    select *
    from products
    qualify rank() over (partition by brand order by launch_date desc nulls first) = 1

remaining_keys as (
    -- Set difference on keys
    select category
    from latest
    except distinct
    select category
    from products
    where cost between 370 and 540
),
reconciled as (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    select s.*
    from latest s
    join remaining_keys k on s.category = k.category

metrics as (

    from reconciled
),
remaining_keys_2 as (
    -- Set difference on keys
    select id, category
    from metrics
    except
    select id, category
    from products
    where brand != 'Globex'
),
verified as (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    select s.*
    from metrics s
    join remaining_keys_2 k on s.id = k.id and s.category = k.category

WITH deduped AS (
    -- Deduplicate with ROW_NUMBER
    SELECT *
    FROM (
        SELECT *, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY city ORDER BY rating DESC) AS rank_in_group
        FROM suppliers
    ) ranked
    WHERE rank_in_group = 1
),
latest AS (
    -- Keep one row per key (latest first)
    SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY city ORDER BY rating DESC, id ASC) AS latest_rank
    FROM deduped
    QUALIFY latest_rank = 1
),
cleaned AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT
        id,
        country,
        city,
        rating,
        latest_rank,
        CASE WHEN city = 'Singapore' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END is_singapore
    FROM latest
    WHERE city IS NOT NULL
),
ranked AS (
    -- Keep one row per key (latest first)
    SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY country ORDER BY rating DESC NULLS LAST, id ASC) AS latest_rank_2
    FROM cleaned
    QUALIFY latest_rank_2 = 1
),
valid AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT
        id,
        country,
        city,
        rating,
        latest_rank,
        is_singapore,
        latest_rank_2,
        LEAST(latest_rank_2, is_singapore) least_latest_rank_2_is_singapore
    FROM ranked
    WHERE city IS NOT NULL
      AND rating < 3.5
),
with_windows AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        *,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY rating ASC NULLS LAST) rating_dense_rank,
        CUME_DIST() OVER (PARTITION BY country ORDER BY rating ASC) rating_cume_dist,
        LAST_VALUE(rating) IGNORE NULLS OVER (ORDER BY is_singapore ASC, id ASC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) last_known_rating
    FROM valid
),
deduped_suppliers AS (
    -- Keep one row per key (latest first)
    SELECT *
    FROM with_windows
    QUALIFY RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY city, country ORDER BY latest_rank ASC) = 1
)
-- Grouped metrics
SELECT
    CASE WHEN least_latest_rank_2_is_singapore >= 80 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END AS least_latest_rank_2_is_singapore_tier,
    CASE WHEN last_known_rating >= 3.5 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END AS last_known_rating_tier,
    PERCENTILE_APPROX(last_known_rating, 0.5) AS last_known_rating_p50,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN city = 'Bangkok' THEN 1 END) AS bangkok_count,
    AVG(rating_cume_dist) FILTER (WHERE country = 'JP') AS jp_avg_rating_cume_dist,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE country = 'SG') AS sg_rows,
    COUNT_IF(city = 'Tokyo') AS tokyo_events,
    COUNT(*) AS event_count
FROM deduped_suppliers
GROUP BY CASE WHEN least_latest_rank_2_is_singapore >= 80 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END, CASE WHEN last_known_rating >= 3.5 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
ORDER BY least_latest_rank_2_is_singapore_tier DESC NULLS FIRST;

from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("city").orderBy(F.col("rating").desc())
w2 = Window.partitionBy("city").orderBy(F.col("rating").desc(), "id")
w3 = Window.partitionBy("country").orderBy(F.col("rating").desc_nulls_last(), "id")
w4 = Window.orderBy(F.col("rating").asc_nulls_last())
w5 = Window.partitionBy("country").orderBy("rating")
w6 = Window.orderBy("is_singapore", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w7 = Window.partitionBy("city", "country").orderBy("latest_rank")

deduped = (
    df_suppliers
    .withColumn("rank_in_group", F.rank().over(w))
    .filter(F.col("rank_in_group") == 1)
)

latest = (
    deduped
    .withColumn("latest_rank", F.row_number().over(w2))
    .filter(F.col("latest_rank") == 1)
)

cleaned = (
    latest
    .filter(F.col("city").isNotNull())
    .select(
        "id",
        "country",
        "city",
        "rating",
        "latest_rank",
        F.when(F.col("city") == "Singapore", 1).otherwise(0).alias("is_singapore"),
    )
)

ranked = (
    cleaned
    .withColumn("latest_rank_2", F.row_number().over(w3))
    .filter(F.col("latest_rank_2") == 1)

    .select(
        "id",
        "country",
        "city",
        "rating",
        "latest_rank",
        "is_singapore",
        "latest_rank_2",
        F.least("latest_rank_2", "is_singapore").alias("least_latest_rank_2_is_singapore"),
    )
)

with_windows = (
    valid
    .select(
        "*",
        F.dense_rank().over(w4).alias("rating_dense_rank"),
        F.cume_dist().over(w5).alias("rating_cume_dist"),
        F.last("rating", ignorenulls=True).over(w6).alias("last_known_rating"),
    )
)

deduped_suppliers = (
    with_windows
    .withColumn("latest_rank_3", F.rank().over(w7))
    .filter(F.col("latest_rank_3") == 1)
    .drop("latest_rank_3")
)

result = (
    deduped_suppliers
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("least_latest_rank_2_is_singapore") >= 80, "LARGE").otherwise("SMALL").alias("least_latest_rank_2_is_singapore_tier"),
        F.when(F.col("last_known_rating") >= 3.5, "LARGE").otherwise("SMALL").alias("last_known_rating_tier"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.percentile_approx("last_known_rating", 0.5).alias("last_known_rating_p50"),
        F.count(F.when(F.col("city") == "Bangkok", 1)).alias("bangkok_count"),
        F.avg(F.when(F.col("country") == "JP", F.col("rating_cume_dist"))).alias("jp_avg_rating_cume_dist"),
        F.count(F.when(F.col("country") == "SG", 1)).alias("sg_rows"),
        F.count_if(F.col("city") == "Tokyo").alias("tokyo_events"),
        F.count("*").alias("event_count"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("event_count") > 1)
    .orderBy(F.col("least_latest_rank_2_is_singapore_tier").desc_nulls_first())

WITH lines AS (
    -- Unnest the array into one row per element
    SELECT
        id,
        service,
        host,
        log_ts,
        level,
        latency_ms,
        status_code,
        attr_key,
        attr_value
    FROM app_logs
    LATERAL VIEW OUTER EXPLODE(context) li AS attr_key, attr_value
),
parsed AS (
    -- Struct fields, map lookups and JSON extraction
    SELECT
        service,
        log_ts,
        latency_ms,
        attr_key,
        attr_value,
        CAST((status_code & 1) != 0 AS INT) AS flag_bit1,
        SHIFTRIGHT(status_code, 2) AS status_code_high
    FROM lines
),
valid AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT
        service,
        log_ts,
        latency_ms,
        attr_key,
        flag_bit1,
        CASE WHEN service IN ('auth', 'billing') THEN 'Group A' ELSE 'Other' END AS service_group,
        COALESCE(attr_key, 'UNKNOWN') AS resolved_attr_key
    FROM parsed
    WHERE log_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-06-01 06:00:00'
      AND latency_ms BETWEEN 1534 AND 1710
)
-- Aggregate with conditional metrics
SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('HOUR', log_ts) AS hour_window,
    AVG(flag_bit1) AS avg_flag_bit1,
    SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_SET(attr_key)) AS attr_key_list
FROM valid
GROUP BY hour_window
ORDER BY hour_window DESC;

    from app_logs

    select

    from lines
),
prev_events as (
    -- Previous event time per key
    select *, lag(log_ts) over (partition by attr_key order by log_ts, id, attr_key) as prev_log_ts
    from parsed
),
gaps as (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session
    select *, case when prev_log_ts is null or log_ts > prev_log_ts + interval 45 minutes then 1 else 0 end as session_start_flag
    from prev_events
),
sessionized as (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    select *, sum(session_start_flag) over (partition by attr_key order by log_ts, id, attr_key rows between unbounded preceding and current row) as session_no
    from gaps
),
gaps_2 as (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > interval)
    select *, case when lag(log_ts) over (partition by attr_key order by log_ts, id, attr_key) is null
                 or log_ts > lag(log_ts) over (partition by attr_key order by log_ts, id, attr_key) + interval '20' minute then 1 else 0 end as is_new_session
    from sessionized
),
islands as (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    select *, sum(is_new_session) over (partition by attr_key order by log_ts, id, attr_key rows between unbounded preceding and current row) as island_id
    from gaps_2
)
-- Window metrics over several different partitions
select
    id,
    host,
    log_ts,
    level,
    latency_ms,
    attr_key,
    v,
    flag_bit4,
    status_code_high,
    prev_log_ts,

    session_no,

    first_value(session_start_flag, true) over (partition by attr_key order by island_id, id, attr_key rows between unbounded preceding and current row) first_known_session_start_flag,
    avg(session_no) over w_ordered session_no_avg_3,
    ntile(4) over (partition by attr_key, level order by session_no, id, attr_key) session_no_bucket
from islands

    from payments

    from with_prev

    from with_gaps

    case when is_new_burst >= 1 then 'LARGE' else 'SMALL' end as is_new_burst_tier,

    count(*) as num_rows,
    approx_percentile(is_new_burst, array(0.25, 0.5, 0.75)) as is_new_burst_quartiles,
    stddev_samp(amount) as amount_stddev
from sessionized
group by case when burst_id >= 7 then 'PREMIUM' else 'STANDARD' end, case when is_new_burst >= 1 then 'LARGE' else 'SMALL' end

select case when o.status in ('CANCELLED', 'RETURNED') then 'group_a' else 'other' end as status_group, max(oi.quantity) as max_quantity, count(oi.quantity) as quantity_count
from order_items oi
inner join orders o on oi.order_id = o.id
left join products p on oi.product_id = p.id
group by case when o.status in ('CANCELLED', 'RETURNED') then 'group_a' else 'other' end
having max_quantity >= 5.7
order by max_quantity, status_group
limit 1;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

    df_order_items.alias("oi")
    .join(df_orders.alias("o"), F.col("oi.order_id") == F.col("o.id"), "inner")
    .join(df_products.alias("p"), F.col("oi.product_id") == F.col("p.id"), "left")
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("o.status").isin(["CANCELLED", "RETURNED"]), "group_a").otherwise("other").alias("status_group"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.max(F.col("oi.quantity")).alias("max_quantity"),
        F.count(F.col("oi.quantity")).alias("quantity_count"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("max_quantity") >= 5.7)
    .orderBy("max_quantity", "status_group")
    .limit(1)
)

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("service").orderBy(F.col("status_code_high").asc_nulls_last())
w2 = Window.partitionBy("service").orderBy("status_code_high")
w_part = Window.partitionBy("service").orderBy(F.col("status_code_high").desc_nulls_last())
w_recent = Window.partitionBy("service")

exploded = (
    df_app_logs
    .select(
        "id",
        "service",
        "log_ts",
        "latency_ms",
        "status_code",
        F.explode_outer("context").alias("attr_key", "attr_value"),
    )
)

unpacked = (
    exploded
    .select(
        "id",
        "service",
        "attr_value",
        (F.col("status_code").bitwiseAND(2) != 0).cast("int").alias("has_fault"),
        F.shiftright("status_code", 2).alias("status_code_high"),
    )
)

enriched = (
    unpacked
    .withColumn("status_code_high_dense_rank", F.dense_rank().over(w))
    .withColumn("status_code_high_rank", F.rank().over(w2))
)

scored = (
    enriched
    .withColumn("status_code_high_dense_rank_2", F.dense_rank().over(w_part))
    .withColumn("service_sum_status_code_high", F.sum("status_code_high").over(w_recent))
    .withColumn("status_code_high_percent_rank", F.percent_rank().over(w_part))
    .withColumn("service_sum_status_code_high_2", F.sum("status_code_high").over(w_recent))
    .withColumn("status_code_high_percent_rank_2", F.percent_rank().over(w2))
)

totals = (
    scored
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("status_code_high_percent_rank_2") >= 0.74, "HIGH").otherwise("LOW").alias("status_code_high_percent_rank_2_tier"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.count(F.when(F.col("service") == "billing", 1)).alias("billing_rows"),
        F.size(F.collect_set("service")).alias("num_services"),
        F.percentile_approx("has_fault", [0.25, 0.5, 0.75]).alias("has_fault_quartiles"),
        F.percentile_approx("status_code_high_dense_rank", 0.9).alias("status_code_high_dense_rank_p90"),
        F.countDistinct("service").alias("distinct_services"),
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("service") == "search", F.col("status_code_high"))).alias("search_total_status_code_high"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("billing_rows") >= 1)
)

result = (
    totals
    .select(
        "status_code_high_percent_rank_2_tier",
        "num_services",
        "status_code_high_dense_rank_p90",
        "search_total_status_code_high",
    )
    .orderBy(
        F.col("search_total_status_code_high").desc(),
        F.col("status_code_high_dense_rank_p90").desc(),
    )
)

with kept_keys as (
    select channel, promo_code
    from promotions
    intersect
    select channel, promo_code
    from promotions
    where promo_code in ('WELCOME5', 'BUNDLE', 'VIP')
),
reconciled as (
    select s.*
    from promotions s
    inner join kept_keys k on s.channel = k.channel and s.promo_code = k.promo_code
)
select
    date_trunc('week', ends_on) as week_start,
    case when discount_pct >= 0.34 then 'HIGH' else 'LOW' end as discount_pct_tier,
    channel,
    sort_array(collect_set(channel)) as channel_list,
    count(case when promo_code = 'WELCOME5' then 1 end) as welcome5_count,
    count(distinct promo_code) as distinct_promo_codes,
    stddev_samp(discount_pct) as discount_pct_stddev,
    grouping(date_trunc('week', ends_on)) as gid
from reconciled
group by rollup (date_trunc('week', ends_on), case when discount_pct >= 0.34 then 'HIGH' else 'LOW' end, channel);
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

kept_keys = (
    df_promotions
    .select("channel", "promo_code")
    .intersect(
        df_promotions
        .filter(F.col("promo_code").isin(["WELCOME5", "BUNDLE", "VIP"]))
        .select("channel", "promo_code")
    )
)

reconciled = (
    df_promotions
    .alias("s")
    .join(kept_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.channel") == F.col("k.channel")) & (F.col("s.promo_code") == F.col("k.promo_code")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

result = (
    reconciled
    .withColumn("week_start", F.date_trunc("week", "ends_on"))
    .withColumn("discount_pct_tier", F.when(F.col("discount_pct") >= 0.34, "HIGH").otherwise("LOW"))
    .rollup("week_start", "discount_pct_tier", "channel")
    .agg(
        F.sort_array(F.collect_set("channel")).alias("channel_list"),
        F.count(F.when(F.col("promo_code") == "WELCOME5", 1)).alias("welcome5_count"),
        F.countDistinct("promo_code").alias("distinct_promo_codes"),
        F.stddev_samp("discount_pct").alias("discount_pct_stddev"),
        F.grouping("week_start").alias("gid"),
    )
)

WITH flattened AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        service,
        host,
        log_ts,
        level,
        status_code,
        k,
        v
    FROM app_logs
    LATERAL VIEW OUTER EXPLODE(context) e AS k, v
),
unpacked AS (
    SELECT
        service,
        level,
        k,
        CAST((status_code & 1) != 0 AS INT) AS is_flagged,
        SHIFTRIGHT(status_code, 2) AS status_code_high
    FROM flattened
    WHERE k = 'trace'
),
with_windows AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        CUME_DIST() OVER (PARTITION BY k, service ORDER BY status_code_high) AS status_code_high_cume_dist,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY k ORDER BY is_flagged DESC NULLS FIRST) AS is_flagged_rank,
        PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY k, level ORDER BY is_flagged NULLS LAST) AS is_flagged_percent_rank
    FROM unpacked
),
with_windows_app_logs AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        MAX(is_flagged_percent_rank) OVER (PARTITION BY level) AS level_max_is_flagged_percent_rank,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY level ORDER BY status_code_high DESC NULLS LAST) AS status_code_high_rank,
        STDDEV_SAMP(is_flagged_rank) OVER (PARTITION BY k) AS k_stddev_samp_is_flagged_rank
    FROM with_windows
),
valid AS (
    SELECT
        service,
        k,
        is_flagged,
        status_code_high,
        level_max_is_flagged_percent_rank,
        k_stddev_samp_is_flagged_rank,
        k_stddev_samp_is_flagged_rank / NULLIF(status_code_high_cume_dist, 0) AS k_stddev_samp_is_flagged_rank_per_status_code_high_cume_dist
    FROM with_windows_app_logs
    WHERE k IS NOT NULL
),
filtered AS (
    SELECT
        k,
        is_flagged,
        k_stddev_samp_is_flagged_rank,
        INITCAP(TRIM(service)) AS service_title
    FROM valid
    WHERE k IN ('version', 'region', 'trace')
),
with_windows_app_logs_2 AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY k ORDER BY k_stddev_samp_is_flagged_rank NULLS FIRST) AS k_stddev_samp_is_flagged_rank_percent_rank,
        ROUND(k_stddev_samp_is_flagged_rank / SUM(k_stddev_samp_is_flagged_rank) OVER (PARTITION BY k), 4) AS k_stddev_samp_is_flagged_rank_share
    FROM filtered
)
SELECT
    is_flagged,
    service_title,
    k_stddev_samp_is_flagged_rank_share
FROM with_windows_app_logs_2;

flattened = (

    .select(
        "id",
        "service",
        "host",
        "log_ts",

        "status_code",
        F.explode_outer("context").alias("k", "v"),
    )
)

unpacked = (

    .filter(F.col("k") == "trace")
    .select(
        "service",
        "level",
        "k",
        (F.col("status_code").bitwiseAND(1) != 0).cast("int").alias("is_flagged"),
        F.shiftright("status_code", 2).alias("status_code_high"),
    )
)

with_windows = (
    unpacked
    .withColumn("status_code_high_cume_dist", F.cume_dist().over(w))
    .withColumn("is_flagged_rank", F.rank().over(w2))

)

with_windows_app_logs = (

    .withColumn("status_code_high_rank", F.rank().over(w5))
    .withColumn("k_stddev_samp_is_flagged_rank", F.stddev_samp("is_flagged_rank").over(w6))
)

valid = (

    .filter(F.col("k").isNotNull())
    .select(
        "service",
        "k",
        "is_flagged",
        "status_code_high",
        "level_max_is_flagged_percent_rank",
        "k_stddev_samp_is_flagged_rank",
        (F.col("k_stddev_samp_is_flagged_rank") / F.nullif("status_code_high_cume_dist", F.lit(0))).alias("k_stddev_samp_is_flagged_rank_per_status_code_high_cume_dist"),
    )
)

filtered = (
    valid
    .filter(F.col("k").isin(["version", "region", "trace"]))
    .select(
        "k",
        "is_flagged",

        F.initcap(F.trim("service")).alias("service_title"),
    )

with_windows_app_logs_2 = (

    .withColumn("k_stddev_samp_is_flagged_rank_percent_rank", F.percent_rank().over(w7))

)

sql:
WITH kept AS (
    SELECT s.*
    FROM suppliers s
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM products x
            WHERE x.supplier_id = s.id
              AND x.launch_date <= '2023-11-01'
        )
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM kept
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY city, country ORDER BY rating DESC NULLS FIRST, id) = 1
),
with_latest AS (
    SELECT s.*, latest.product_price
    FROM ranked s
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
            SELECT c.price AS product_price
            FROM products c
            WHERE c.supplier_id = s.id
            ORDER BY c.price DESC, c.id DESC
            LIMIT 1
        ) latest ON TRUE
)
SELECT
    id,
    supplier_name,
    country,
    rating
FROM with_latest
ORDER BY rating DESC NULLS FIRST, id
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("city", "country").orderBy(F.col("rating").desc_nulls_first(), "id")
w2 = Window.partitionBy(F.col("s.id")).orderBy(F.col("c.price").desc(), F.col("c.id").desc())

kept = (
    df_suppliers
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_products.alias("x"), (F.col("x.supplier_id") == F.col("s.id")) & (F.col("x.launch_date") <= "2023-11-01"), "left_anti")
)

ranked = (
    kept
    .withColumn("rn", F.row_number().over(w))
    .filter(F.col("rn") == 1)
    .drop("rn")
)

with_latest = (
    ranked
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_products.alias("c"), (F.col("c.supplier_id") == F.col("s.id")), "left")
    .withColumn("rn", F.row_number().over(w2))
    .filter(F.col("rn") == 1)
    .select("s.*", F.col("c.price").alias("product_price"))
)

result = (
    with_latest
    .select("id", "supplier_name", "country", "rating")
    .orderBy(F.col("rating").desc_nulls_first(), "id")
)

SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('QUARTER', paid_at) AS quarter_start,
    DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', paid_at) AS activity_month,
    DATE_TRUNC('WEEK', paid_at) AS week_start,
    PERCENTILE_APPROX(amount, ARRAY(0.25, 0.5, 0.75)) AS amount_quartiles,
    MIN(paid_at) AS started_at,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN method = 'bank_transfer' THEN 1 END) AS bank_transfer_count,
    GROUPING(DATE_TRUNC('QUARTER', paid_at)) AS grouping_id
FROM payments
GROUP BY ROLLUP (DATE_TRUNC('QUARTER', paid_at), DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', paid_at), DATE_TRUNC('WEEK', paid_at));
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

result = (
    df_payments
    .withColumn("quarter_start", F.date_trunc("QUARTER", "paid_at"))
    .withColumn("activity_month", F.date_trunc("MONTH", "paid_at"))
    .withColumn("week_start", F.date_trunc("WEEK", "paid_at"))
    .rollup("quarter_start", "activity_month", "week_start")
    .agg(
        F.percentile_approx("amount", [0.25, 0.5, 0.75]).alias("amount_quartiles"),
        F.min("paid_at").alias("started_at"),
        F.count(F.when(F.col("method") == "bank_transfer", 1)).alias("bank_transfer_count"),
        F.grouping("quarter_start").alias("grouping_id"),
    )
)

sql: WITH with_windows AS (SELECT *, NTILE(3) OVER (PARTITION BY segment ORDER BY credit_limit DESC, id) AS credit_limit_bucket, FIRST_VALUE(city) IGNORE NULLS OVER (PARTITION BY city ORDER BY credit_limit, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS first_known_city, MIN(age) OVER (PARTITION BY country, city) AS country_min_age FROM customers), cleaned AS (SELECT *, UPPER(country) AS country_upper, COALESCE(city, 'N/A') AS resolved_city FROM with_windows WHERE signup_date > DATE '2023-10-13' AND city IS NOT NULL), latest AS (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY country ORDER BY credit_limit DESC NULLS LAST, id) AS rn FROM cleaned QUALIFY rn = 1), latest_match AS (SELECT s.*, top1.started_at FROM latest s JOIN LATERAL (SELECT c.started_at FROM sessions c WHERE c.customer_id = s.id ORDER BY c.started_at DESC, c.id DESC LIMIT 1) top1 ON TRUE), pivoted AS (SELECT * FROM (SELECT segment, country, city, country_min_age FROM latest_match) src PIVOT (AVG(country_min_age) FOR city IN ('Singapore' AS singapore, 'Tokyo' AS tokyo, 'London' AS london))) SELECT segment, country, singapore, tokyo, london FROM pivoted ORDER BY tokyo DESC;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("segment").orderBy(F.col("credit_limit").desc(), "id")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("city").orderBy("credit_limit", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w3 = Window.partitionBy("country", "city")
w4 = Window.partitionBy("country").orderBy(F.col("credit_limit").desc_nulls_last(), "id")
w5 = Window.partitionBy(F.col("s.id")).orderBy(F.col("c.started_at").desc(), F.col("c.id").desc())

with_windows = (
    df_customers
    .withColumn("credit_limit_bucket", F.ntile(3).over(w))
    .withColumn("first_known_city", F.first("city", ignorenulls=True).over(w2))
    .withColumn("country_min_age", F.min("age").over(w3))
)

cleaned = (
    with_windows
    .filter((F.col("signup_date") > F.lit("2023-10-13").cast("date")) & F.col("city").isNotNull())
    .select(
        "*",
        F.upper("country").alias("country_upper"),
        F.coalesce("city", F.lit("N/A")).alias("resolved_city"),
    )
)

latest = (
    cleaned
    .withColumn("rn", F.row_number().over(w4))
    .filter(F.col("rn") == 1)
)

latest_match = (
    latest
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_sessions.alias("c"), (F.col("c.customer_id") == F.col("s.id")), "inner")
    .withColumn("rn_2", F.row_number().over(w5))
    .filter(F.col("rn_2") == 1)
    .select("s.*", F.col("c.started_at"))
)

pivoted = (
    latest_match
    .groupBy("segment", "country")
    .pivot("city", ["Singapore", "Tokyo", "London"])
    .agg(F.avg("country_min_age"))
    .select(
        "segment",
        "country",
        F.col("Singapore").alias("singapore"),
        F.col("Tokyo").alias("tokyo"),
        F.col("London").alias("london"),
    )
)

result = (
    pivoted
    .select("segment", "country", "singapore", "tokyo", "london")
    .orderBy(F.col("tokyo").desc())
)

sql:
SELECT
    MONTH(o.order_date) AS order_month,
    CASE WHEN o.shipping_fee >= 30 THEN 'high' WHEN o.shipping_fee >= 15 THEN 'mid' ELSE 'low' END AS shipping_fee_bucket,
    SUM(oi.unit_price) AS total_unit_price,
    ROUND(AVG(oi.unit_price), 2) AS avg_unit_price
FROM order_items oi
LEFT JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.id
GROUP BY MONTH(o.order_date), CASE WHEN o.shipping_fee >= 30 THEN 'high' WHEN o.shipping_fee >= 15 THEN 'mid' ELSE 'low' END
ORDER BY shipping_fee_bucket ASC;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

result = (
    df_order_items.alias("oi")
    .join(df_orders.alias("o"), F.col("oi.order_id") == F.col("o.id"), "left")
    .groupBy(
        F.month(F.col("o.order_date")).alias("order_month"),
        F.when(F.col("o.shipping_fee") >= 30, "high").when(F.col("o.shipping_fee") >= 15, "mid").otherwise("low").alias("shipping_fee_bucket"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.sum(F.col("oi.unit_price")).alias("total_unit_price"),
        F.round(F.avg(F.col("oi.unit_price")), 2).alias("avg_unit_price"),
    )
    .orderBy("shipping_fee_bucket")
)

sql: WITH matched_keys AS (SELECT account_type, status FROM accounts EXCEPT ALL SELECT account_type, status FROM accounts WHERE opened_date < '2024-12-01'), kept_rows AS (SELECT s.* FROM accounts s JOIN matched_keys k ON s.account_type = k.account_type AND s.status = k.status) SELECT customer_id, AVG(balance) FILTER (WHERE account_type = 'CHECKING') AS checking_avg_balance, STDDEV_SAMP(balance) AS balance_stddev, PERCENTILE_APPROX(balance, ARRAY(0.25, 0.5, 0.75)) AS balance_quartiles, PERCENTILE_APPROX(balance, 0.9) AS balance_p90, STDDEV_SAMP(balance) AS balance_stddev_2, STDDEV_SAMP(balance) AS balance_stddev_3 FROM kept_rows GROUP BY customer_id ORDER BY balance_stddev_2 DESC;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

matched_keys = (
    df_accounts
    .select("account_type", "status")
    .exceptAll(
        df_accounts
        .filter(F.col("opened_date") < "2024-12-01")
        .select("account_type", "status")
    )
)

kept_rows = (
    df_accounts
    .alias("s")
    .join(matched_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.account_type") == F.col("k.account_type")) & (F.col("s.status") == F.col("k.status")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

result = (
    kept_rows
    .groupBy("customer_id")
    .agg(
        F.avg(F.when(F.col("account_type") == "CHECKING", F.col("balance"))).alias("checking_avg_balance"),
        F.stddev_samp("balance").alias("balance_stddev"),
        F.percentile_approx("balance", [0.25, 0.5, 0.75]).alias("balance_quartiles"),
        F.percentile_approx("balance", 0.9).alias("balance_p90"),
        F.stddev_samp("balance").alias("balance_stddev_2"),
        F.stddev_samp("balance").alias("balance_stddev_3"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("balance_stddev_2").desc())
)

sql: SELECT CASE WHEN accounts.status IN ('OPEN', 'CLOSED') THEN 'group_a' ELSE 'other' END AS status_group, accounts.status, SUM(CASE WHEN transactions.txn_type = 'DEBIT' THEN transactions.amount ELSE 0 END) AS debit_amount FROM transactions INNER JOIN accounts ON transactions.account_id = accounts.id LEFT JOIN customers ON accounts.customer_id = customers.id WHERE accounts.balance BETWEEN 34000 AND 67000 GROUP BY CASE WHEN accounts.status IN ('OPEN', 'CLOSED') THEN 'group_a' ELSE 'other' END, accounts.status ORDER BY debit_amount
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

result = (
    df_transactions.alias("transactions")
    .join(df_accounts.alias("accounts"), F.col("transactions.account_id") == F.col("accounts.id"), "inner")
    .join(df_customers.alias("customers"), F.col("accounts.customer_id") == F.col("customers.id"), "left")
    .filter(F.col("accounts.balance").between(34000, 67000))
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("accounts.status").isin(["OPEN", "CLOSED"]), "group_a").otherwise("other").alias("status_group"),
        F.col("accounts.status"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("transactions.txn_type") == "DEBIT", F.col("transactions.amount")).otherwise(0)).alias("debit_amount"),
    )
    .orderBy("debit_amount")
)

sql:
WITH lines AS (
    -- Unnest the array into one row per element
    SELECT
        id,
        created_at,
        line.product_id,
        line.qty
    FROM carts
    LATERAL VIEW OUTER EXPLODE(items) e AS line
)
-- Grouped metrics
SELECT
    CASE WHEN qty >= 5 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END AS qty_tier,
    AVG(qty) AS avg_qty,
    COUNT(*) AS event_count,
    (UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MAX(created_at)) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MIN(created_at))) / 60 AS duration_min,
    (UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MAX(created_at)) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MIN(created_at))) / 60 AS duration_min_2,
    (UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MAX(created_at)) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MIN(created_at))) / 60 AS span_minutes,
    COUNT(DISTINCT id) AS distinct_ids
FROM lines
GROUP BY CASE WHEN qty >= 5 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

lines = (
    df_carts
    .withColumn("line", F.explode_outer("items"))
    .select("id", "created_at", F.col("line.product_id"), F.col("line.qty"))
)

result = (
    lines
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("qty") >= 5, "PREMIUM").otherwise("STANDARD").alias("qty_tier"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.avg("qty").alias("avg_qty"),
        F.count("*").alias("event_count"),
        ((F.unix_timestamp(F.max("created_at")) - F.unix_timestamp(F.min("created_at"))) / 60).alias("duration_min"),
        ((F.unix_timestamp(F.max("created_at")) - F.unix_timestamp(F.min("created_at"))) / 60).alias("duration_min_2"),
        ((F.unix_timestamp(F.max("created_at")) - F.unix_timestamp(F.min("created_at"))) / 60).alias("span_minutes"),
        F.countDistinct("id").alias("distinct_ids"),
    )
)

sql: with cleaned as (select *, round(quantity, 1) quantity_rounded from inventory where last_restock >= to_date('2024-04-20')) select date_trunc('week', last_restock) as week_start, case when quantity >= 206 then 'HIGH' else 'LOW' end as quantity_tier, round(avg(quantity), 2) as avg_quantity, percentile_approx(quantity_rounded, array(0.25, 0.5, 0.75)) as quantity_rounded_quartiles, min(quantity_rounded) as min_quantity_rounded, grouping(date_trunc('week', last_restock)) as grouping_level from cleaned group by grouping sets ((date_trunc('week', last_restock), case when quantity >= 206 then 'HIGH' else 'LOW' end), (date_trunc('week', last_restock))) having min(quantity_rounded) > 0;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

cleaned = (
    df_inventory
    .filter(F.col("last_restock") >= F.to_date(F.lit("2024-04-20")))
    .select("*", F.round("quantity", 1).alias("quantity_rounded"))
)

result = (
    cleaned
    .withColumn("week_start", F.date_trunc("week", "last_restock"))
    .withColumn("quantity_tier", F.when(F.col("quantity") >= 206, "HIGH").otherwise("LOW"))
    .groupingSets(
        [["week_start", "quantity_tier"], ["week_start"]],
        "week_start",
        "quantity_tier",
    )
    .agg(
        F.round(F.avg("quantity"), 2).alias("avg_quantity"),
        F.percentile_approx("quantity_rounded", [0.25, 0.5, 0.75]).alias("quantity_rounded_quartiles"),
        F.min("quantity_rounded").alias("min_quantity_rounded"),
        F.grouping("week_start").alias("grouping_level"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("min_quantity_rounded") > 0)
)

sql: with cleaned as (select *, case when status = 'ACTIVE' then 1 else 0 end as is_active from subscriptions where end_date > date '2023-12-20') select id, customer_id, plan, start_date, end_date, monthly_fee, status, is_active, percent_rank() over (partition by status, plan order by is_active desc nulls first) as is_active_percent_rank, lead(monthly_fee, 1) over (partition by customer_id order by monthly_fee asc, id asc) as next_monthly_fee, lead(is_active, 1) over (partition by customer_id, plan order by end_date asc, id asc) as next_is_active, lead(monthly_fee, 1) over w_grp as next_monthly_fee_2, first_value(monthly_fee, true) over w_ordered as first_known_monthly_fee from cleaned window w_grp as (partition by plan order by is_active asc, id asc), w_ordered as (partition by customer_id, plan order by monthly_fee asc, id asc rows between unbounded preceding and current row)
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("status", "plan").orderBy(F.col("is_active").desc_nulls_first())
w2 = Window.partitionBy("customer_id").orderBy("monthly_fee", "id")
w3 = Window.partitionBy("customer_id", "plan").orderBy("end_date", "id")
w_grp = Window.partitionBy("plan").orderBy("is_active", "id")
w_ordered = Window.partitionBy("customer_id", "plan").orderBy("monthly_fee", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)

cleaned = (
    df_subscriptions
    .filter(F.col("end_date") > F.lit("2023-12-20").cast("date"))
    .withColumn("is_active", F.when(F.col("status") == "ACTIVE", 1).otherwise(0))
)

result = (
    cleaned
    .withColumn("is_active_percent_rank", F.percent_rank().over(w))
    .withColumn("next_monthly_fee", F.lead("monthly_fee", 1).over(w2))
    .withColumn("next_is_active", F.lead("is_active", 1).over(w3))
    .withColumn("next_monthly_fee_2", F.lead("monthly_fee", 1).over(w_grp))
    .withColumn("first_known_monthly_fee", F.first("monthly_fee", ignorenulls=True).over(w_ordered))
)

sql: WITH gaps AS (SELECT *, CASE WHEN reading_ts - LAG(reading_ts) OVER (PARTITION BY device_code ORDER BY reading_ts, id) > INTERVAL 15 MINUTES THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_new_burst FROM device_readings), islands AS (SELECT *, SUM(is_new_burst) OVER (PARTITION BY device_code ORDER BY reading_ts, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS island_id FROM gaps) SELECT CASE WHEN temp_c >= 35.3 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END AS temp_c_tier, MAX(temp_c) AS max_temp_c, PERCENTILE_APPROX(pressure, 0.95) AS pressure_p95, SIZE(COLLECT_SET(device_code)) AS num_device_codes, COUNT(*) AS cnt, APPROX_PERCENTILE(temp_c, 0.9) AS temp_c_p90, SUM(island_id) FILTER (WHERE device_code = 'DV-03') AS dv_03_total_island_id FROM islands GROUP BY CASE WHEN temp_c >= 35.3 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END HAVING SUM(island_id) FILTER (WHERE device_code = 'DV-03') > 0 ORDER BY temp_c_p90 DESC;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("device_code").orderBy("reading_ts", "id")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("device_code").orderBy("reading_ts", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)

gaps = (
    df_device_readings
    .withColumn("is_new_burst", F.when(F.col("reading_ts") - F.lag("reading_ts").over(w) > F.expr("INTERVAL 15 MINUTES"), 1).otherwise(0))
)

islands = gaps.withColumn("island_id", F.sum("is_new_burst").over(w2))

result = (
    islands
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("temp_c") >= 35.3, "PREMIUM").otherwise("STANDARD").alias("temp_c_tier"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.max("temp_c").alias("max_temp_c"),
        F.percentile_approx("pressure", 0.95).alias("pressure_p95"),
        F.size(F.collect_set("device_code")).alias("num_device_codes"),
        F.count("*").alias("cnt"),
        F.percentile_approx("temp_c", 0.9).alias("temp_c_p90"),
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("device_code") == "DV-03", F.col("island_id"))).alias("dv_03_total_island_id"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("dv_03_total_island_id") > 0)
    .orderBy(F.col("temp_c_p90").desc())
)

with base as (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    select
        id,
        promo_code,
        discount_pct,
        date_format(starts_on, 'yyyy-MM') as starts_on_label
    from promotions
    where starts_on > date '2023-10-11'
      and channel is not null
      and month(starts_on) in (1, 3, 6)
),
deduped as (
    -- QUALIFY-style window filter
    select *, row_number() over (partition by promo_code order by discount_pct, id) as rn
    from base
    qualify rn = 1
),
latest as (
    -- Keep one row per key (latest first)
    select *
    from deduped
    qualify rank() over (partition by promo_code order by discount_pct desc) = 1
),
base_promotions as (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    select
        id,
        promo_code,
        discount_pct,
        starts_on_label,
        rn,
        floor(discount_pct) as discount_pct_whole,
        cast(discount_pct as int) as discount_pct_int
    from latest
    where discount_pct > 0.21
),
base_promotions_2 as (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    select *, upper(promo_code) as promo_code_upper
    from base_promotions
    where discount_pct >= 0.19
),
with_windows as (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    select
        *,
        sum(discount_pct_int) over (partition by promo_code order by discount_pct, id rows between unbounded preceding and current row) as running_discount_pct_int,
        row_number() over (partition by promo_code order by discount_pct_whole desc, id) as row_seq,
        lead(discount_pct_whole, 1) over (order by discount_pct_int, id) as next_discount_pct_whole

with exploded as (
    -- Unnest the array into one row per element
    select
        id,
        service,
        host,
        log_ts,
        level,
        status_code,
        key,
        value
    from app_logs
    lateral view outer explode(context) e as key, value
),
flattened_attrs as (
    -- Semi-structured parsing
    select
        service,
        host,
        log_ts,
        status_code,
        key,
        shiftright(status_code, 2) as status_code_high,
        cast((status_code & 1) != 0 as int) as flag_bit1
    from exploded
    where host in ('h2', 'h3', 'h4')
),
with_windows as (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    select
        service,
        host,
        log_ts,
        status_code,
        key,
        status_code_high,
        flag_bit1,
        count(flag_bit1) over w_recent as key_count_flag_bit1,
        round(status_code / sum(status_code) over (partition by host, key), 4) as status_code_share,
        stddev_samp(status_code_high) over w_recent as key_stddev_samp_status_code_high,
        count(status_code) over (order by cast(log_ts as bigint) range between 3600 preceding and current row) as status_code_count_1h
    from flattened_attrs
    window w_recent as (partition by key)
)

    service,
    host,
    log_ts,
    status_code,
    key,
    status_code_high,
    flag_bit1,
    key_count_flag_bit1,
    status_code_share,
    key_stddev_samp_status_code_high,
    status_code_count_1h,
    dense_rank() over (partition by key order by status_code_share desc nulls first) as status_code_share_dense_rank,
    count(status_code_share) over w_hist as service_count_status_code_share,
    count(status_code) over w_ordered as key_count_status_code,
    sum(status_code_high) over w_recent as status_code_high_sum_30m
from with_windows

    FROM valid
    WINDOW w_part AS (PARTITION BY status, store_id)
),

    -- Attach stores attributes
    SELECT
        a.*,
        p.store_name,
        p.city,
        p.region
    FROM scored a

        ON a.store_id = p.id
),
enriched AS (

        e.*,
        b.store_name AS store_store_name,
        b.city AS store_city,
        b.opened_date

        ON e.store_id = b.id
),
base AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults

        *,

),

)

        customer_id,
        plan,
        start_date,
        end_date,

        ADD_MONTHS(end_date, 6) AS end_date_plus_months

    -- Window metrics over several different partitions

        *,
        LEAD(monthly_fee, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id, plan ORDER BY start_date, id) AS next_monthly_fee,
        AVG(monthly_fee_int) OVER w_part AS monthly_fee_int_avg_6
    FROM valid
    WINDOW w_part AS (PARTITION BY customer_id, plan ORDER BY end_date, id ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)
),
base AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT
        *,
        CASE WHEN monthly_fee_int_avg_6 >= 81 THEN 'High' WHEN monthly_fee_int_avg_6 >= 14 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END AS monthly_fee_int_avg_6_tier,
        DATE_SUB(start_date, 8) AS start_date_minus_8d
    FROM scored
    WHERE start_date > TO_DATE('2023-10-07')
      AND customer_id IS NOT NULL
),
deduped AS (
    -- Keep one row per key (latest first)
    SELECT *
    FROM (
        SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY monthly_fee_int_avg_6 NULLS FIRST, id) AS rank_in_group
        FROM base
    ) ranked
    WHERE rank_in_group = 1
),
deduped_subscriptions AS (
    -- Keep one row per key (latest first)
    SELECT *
    FROM deduped
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY plan ORDER BY start_date, id) = 1
),
filtered AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        id,
        plan,
        end_date,
        monthly_fee,
        monthly_fee_int,
        end_date_plus_months,
        next_monthly_fee,
        monthly_fee_int_avg_6,
        monthly_fee_int_avg_6_tier,
        start_date_minus_8d,
        rank_in_group,
        monthly_fee_int_avg_6 + next_monthly_fee AS monthly_fee_int_avg_6_plus_next_monthly_fee,
        monthly_fee_int * monthly_fee AS monthly_fee_int_times_monthly_fee
    FROM deduped_subscriptions
    WHERE end_date >= DATE '2024-02-17'
      AND customer_id IS NOT NULL
      AND monthly_fee_int_avg_6 < 61

    monthly_fee_int_times_monthly_fee
FROM filtered

sql:
WITH exploded AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        plan,
        effective_from,
        currency,
        val
    FROM price_tiers
    LATERAL VIEW OUTER EXPLODE(discounts) li AS val
),
cleaned AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        plan,
        effective_from,
        currency,
        val,
        INITCAP(TRIM(plan)) AS plan_title
    FROM exploded
    WHERE currency NOT IN ('USD', 'EUR')
),
with_windows AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY currency ORDER BY val) AS val_dense_rank,
        CUME_DIST() OVER (ORDER BY val NULLS FIRST) AS val_cume_dist,
        PERCENT_RANK() OVER w_ordered AS val_percent_rank
    FROM cleaned
    WINDOW w_ordered AS (PARTITION BY currency ORDER BY val DESC)
),
base AS (
    SELECT *, CAST(val_dense_rank AS DOUBLE) AS val_dense_rank_num
    FROM with_windows
    WHERE val_cume_dist > 0.8
)
SELECT
    *,
    RANK() OVER w_hist AS val_rank,
    PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY currency ORDER BY val_cume_dist DESC NULLS LAST) AS val_cume_dist_percent_rank
FROM base
WINDOW w_hist AS (ORDER BY val NULLS FIRST);
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("currency").orderBy("val")
w2 = Window.orderBy(F.col("val").asc_nulls_first())
w_ordered = Window.partitionBy("currency").orderBy(F.col("val").desc())
w4 = Window.partitionBy("currency").orderBy(F.col("val_cume_dist").desc_nulls_last())

exploded = (
    df_price_tiers
    .select(
        "id",
        "plan",
        "effective_from",
        "currency",
        F.explode_outer("discounts").alias("val"),
    )
)

cleaned = (
    exploded
    .filter(~F.col("currency").isin(["USD", "EUR"]))
    .select(
        "id",
        "plan",
        "effective_from",
        "currency",
        "val",
        F.initcap(F.trim("plan")).alias("plan_title"),
    )
)

with_windows = (
    cleaned
    .withColumn("val_dense_rank", F.dense_rank().over(w))
    .withColumn("val_cume_dist", F.cume_dist().over(w2))
    .withColumn("val_percent_rank", F.percent_rank().over(w_ordered))
)

base = (
    with_windows
    .filter(F.col("val_cume_dist") > 0.8)
    .select("*", F.col("val_dense_rank").cast("double").alias("val_dense_rank_num"))
)

result = (
    base
    .select(
        "*",
        F.rank().over(w2).alias("val_rank"),
        F.percent_rank().over(w4).alias("val_cume_dist_percent_rank"),
    )
)

with filtered as (
    select
        id,
        channel,
        promo_code,
        starts_on,
        discount_pct,
        weekofyear(ends_on) as ends_on_weekofyear,
        coalesce(channel, 'N/A') as resolved_channel
    from promotions
    where channel is not null
)
select
    case when discount_pct >= 0.36 then 'LARGE' else 'SMALL' end as discount_pct_tier,
    promo_code,
    date_trunc('quarter', starts_on) as quarter_start,
    round(sum(discount_pct) / nullif(count(case when promo_code = 'WELCOME5' then 1 end), 0), 2) as discount_pct_per_welcome5,
    count_if(promo_code = 'SPRING10') as spring10_events,
    percentile_approx(discount_pct, array(0.25, 0.5, 0.75)) as discount_pct_quartiles,
    count(*) as cnt,
    round(avg(ends_on_weekofyear), 2) as avg_ends_on_weekofyear,
    sum(case when channel = 'web' then ends_on_weekofyear else 0 end) as web_ends_on_weekofyear
from filtered
group by 1, 2, 3
order by avg_ends_on_weekofyear desc;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

filtered = (
    df_promotions
    .filter(F.col("channel").isNotNull())
    .select(
        "id",
        "channel",
        "promo_code",
        "starts_on",
        "discount_pct",
        F.weekofyear("ends_on").alias("ends_on_weekofyear"),
        F.coalesce("channel", F.lit("N/A")).alias("resolved_channel"),
    )
)

result = (
    filtered
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("discount_pct") >= 0.36, "LARGE").otherwise("SMALL").alias("discount_pct_tier"),
        "promo_code",
        F.date_trunc("quarter", "starts_on").alias("quarter_start"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.round(F.sum("discount_pct") / F.nullif(F.count(F.when(F.col("promo_code") == "WELCOME5", 1)), F.lit(0)), 2).alias("discount_pct_per_welcome5"),
        F.count_if(F.col("promo_code") == "SPRING10").alias("spring10_events"),
        F.percentile_approx("discount_pct", [0.25, 0.5, 0.75]).alias("discount_pct_quartiles"),
        F.count("*").alias("cnt"),
        F.round(F.avg("ends_on_weekofyear"), 2).alias("avg_ends_on_weekofyear"),
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("channel") == "web", F.col("ends_on_weekofyear")).otherwise(0)).alias("web_ends_on_weekofyear"),
    )

WITH remaining_keys AS (
    -- Set intersection on keys
    SELECT dept_name, location
    FROM departments
    INTERSECT ALL
    SELECT dept_name, location
    FROM departments
    WHERE location <> 'New York'
),
verified AS (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    SELECT s.*
    FROM departments s
    INNER JOIN remaining_keys k ON s.dept_name = k.dept_name AND s.location = k.location
),
valid AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT
        *,
        CASE WHEN budget >= 3565000 THEN 'High' WHEN budget >= 1562000 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END AS budget_level,
        SUBSTRING(location, 1, 4) AS location_prefix,
        COALESCE(dept_name, 'UNKNOWN') AS dept_name_filled
    FROM verified
    WHERE location = 'Tokyo'
),
enriched AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        *,
        SUM(budget) OVER (PARTITION BY location, dept_name) AS location_sum_budget,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY dept_name, location ORDER BY budget ASC NULLS FIRST) AS budget_rank,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY location ORDER BY budget DESC NULLS LAST) AS budget_dense_rank
    FROM valid
)
SELECT
    id,
    dept_name,
    location,
    budget,
    location_prefix,
    dept_name_filled,
    budget_dense_rank
FROM enriched

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("location", "dept_name")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("dept_name", "location").orderBy(F.col("budget").asc_nulls_first())
w3 = Window.partitionBy("location").orderBy(F.col("budget").desc_nulls_last())

remaining_keys = (
    df_departments
    .select("dept_name", "location")
    .intersectAll(
        df_departments
        .filter(F.col("location") != "New York")
        .select("dept_name", "location")
    )
)

verified = (
    df_departments
    .alias("s")
    .join(remaining_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.dept_name") == F.col("k.dept_name")) & (F.col("s.location") == F.col("k.location")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

valid = (
    verified
    .filter(F.col("location") == "Tokyo")
    .select(
        "*",
        F.when(F.col("budget") >= 3565000, "High").when(F.col("budget") >= 1562000, "Medium").otherwise("Low").alias("budget_level"),
        F.substring("location", 1, 4).alias("location_prefix"),
        F.coalesce("dept_name", F.lit("UNKNOWN")).alias("dept_name_filled"),
    )
)

enriched = (
    valid
    .select(
        "*",
        F.sum("budget").over(w).alias("location_sum_budget"),
        F.rank().over(w2).alias("budget_rank"),
        F.dense_rank().over(w3).alias("budget_dense_rank"),
    )
)

result = (
    enriched
    .select(
        "id",
        "dept_name",
        "location",
        "budget",
        "location_prefix",
        "dept_name_filled",
        "budget_dense_rank",
    )
)

WITH lines AS (

    SELECT

    FROM carts

flattened AS (

    SELECT
        id,
        customer_id,
        created_at,
        tag
    FROM lines
    LATERAL VIEW OUTER EXPLODE(coupon_codes) x AS tag
),
valid AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT
        *,
        LOWER(tag) AS tag_lower,
        CASE WHEN tag IN ('SPRING10', 'VIP') THEN 'Priority' ELSE 'Other' END AS tag_group,
        COALESCE(tag, 'N/A') AS tag_filled
    FROM flattened
    WHERE created_at > DATE '2025-03-02'
      AND customer_id = 38
),
joined AS (
    -- Attach customers attributes
    SELECT
        src.*,
        d.credit_limit,
        d.city,
        d.segment
    FROM valid src
    LEFT JOIN customers d
        ON src.customer_id = d.id
),
joined_carts AS (
    -- Attach customers attributes
    SELECT
        a.*,
        p.country,
        p.age,
        p.segment AS customer_segment
    FROM joined a
    LEFT JOIN customers p
        ON a.customer_id = p.id
),
filtered AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT *, ROUND(age / credit_limit, 2) AS age_per_credit_limit
    FROM joined_carts
    WHERE created_at > TIMESTAMP '2025-03-01 15:00:00'
      AND city <> 'Tokyo'
)
-- Running and moving aggregates
SELECT
    id,
    customer_id,
    created_at,
    tag,
    tag_lower,
    tag_group,
    tag_filled,
    credit_limit,
    city,
    segment,
    country,
    age,
    customer_segment,
    age_per_credit_limit,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY customer_segment ORDER BY age_per_credit_limit DESC NULLS LAST) AS age_per_credit_limit_rank,
    ROUND(credit_limit / SUM(credit_limit) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id), 4) AS credit_limit_share,
    MIN(credit_limit) OVER w_hist AS customer_segment_min_credit_limit,
    CUME_DIST() OVER w_hist_2 AS credit_limit_cume_dist
FROM filtered
WINDOW w_hist AS (PARTITION BY customer_segment), w_hist_2 AS (ORDER BY credit_limit DESC);

w_hist = Window.partitionBy("customer_segment")

lines = (
    df_carts
    .select(
        "id",
        "customer_id",

joined = (

    .alias("src")
    .join(df_customers.alias("d"), F.col("src.customer_id") == F.col("d.id"), "left")

joined_carts = (

filtered = (
    joined_carts
    .filter((F.col("created_at") > F.lit("2025-03-01 15:00:00").cast("timestamp")) & (F.col("city") != "Tokyo"))

WITH base AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        id,
        store_name,
        city,
        region,
        opened_date,
        sqft,
        CAST(sqft AS STRING) AS sqft_num,
        ROUND(sqft, 0) AS sqft_rounded
    FROM stores
    WHERE opened_date > TO_DATE('2023-12-27')
),
scored AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        id,
        store_name,
        city,
        region,
        opened_date,
        sqft,
        sqft_num,
        sqft_rounded,
        CUME_DIST() OVER (PARTITION BY city ORDER BY sqft_rounded) AS sqft_rounded_cume_dist,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY opened_date DESC, id) AS seq_no
    FROM base
),
scored_stores AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        *,
        SUM(seq_no) OVER (ORDER BY opened_date, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_seq_no,
        CUME_DIST() OVER (PARTITION BY region ORDER BY sqft DESC NULLS FIRST) AS sqft_cume_dist,
        ROUND(seq_no / SUM(seq_no) OVER (PARTITION BY region), 4) AS seq_no_share,
        SUM(sqft) OVER (PARTITION BY city, region ORDER BY seq_no, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_sqft
    FROM scored
),
with_windows AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        *,
        FIRST_VALUE(running_seq_no) IGNORE NULLS OVER (PARTITION BY region ORDER BY sqft_rounded_cume_dist, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS first_known_running_seq_no,
        AVG(seq_no_share) OVER (PARTITION BY region ORDER BY opened_date, id ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS seq_no_share_avg_6
    FROM scored_stores
),
totals AS (
    -- Multi-level aggregation
    SELECT
        CASE WHEN sqft_rounded >= 89 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END AS sqft_rounded_tier,
        ROUND(SUM(seq_no) / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN region = 'West' THEN 1 END), 0), 2) AS seq_no_per_west,
        SUM(CASE WHEN region = 'North' THEN cumulative_sqft ELSE 0 END) AS north_cumulative_sqft,
        SUM(CASE WHEN region = 'East' THEN cumulative_sqft ELSE 0 END) AS east_cumulative_sqft,
        SUM(sqft_cume_dist) FILTER (WHERE city = 'Singapore') AS singapore_total_sqft_cume_dist,
        COUNT(*) AS cnt,
        GROUPING_ID() AS gid
    FROM with_windows
    GROUP BY CUBE (CASE WHEN sqft_rounded >= 89 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END)
)
SELECT seq_no_per_west, gid
FROM totals
ORDER BY seq_no_per_west DESC NULLS FIRST;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("city").orderBy("sqft_rounded")
w2 = Window.orderBy(F.col("opened_date").desc(), "id")
w3 = Window.orderBy("opened_date", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w4 = Window.partitionBy("region").orderBy(F.col("sqft").desc_nulls_first())
w5 = Window.partitionBy("region")
w6 = Window.partitionBy("city", "region").orderBy("seq_no", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w7 = Window.partitionBy("region").orderBy("sqft_rounded_cume_dist", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w8 = Window.partitionBy("region").orderBy("opened_date", "id").rowsBetween(-6, Window.currentRow)

base = (
    df_stores
    .filter(F.col("opened_date") > F.to_date(F.lit("2023-12-27")))
    .select(
        "id",
        "store_name",
        "city",
        "region",
        "opened_date",
        "sqft",
        F.col("sqft").cast("string").alias("sqft_num"),
        F.round("sqft", 0).alias("sqft_rounded"),
    )
)

scored = (
    base
    .select(
        "*",
        F.cume_dist().over(w).alias("sqft_rounded_cume_dist"),
        F.row_number().over(w2).alias("seq_no"),
    )
)

scored_stores = (
    scored
    .select(
        "*",
        F.sum("seq_no").over(w3).alias("running_seq_no"),
        F.cume_dist().over(w4).alias("sqft_cume_dist"),
        F.round((F.col("seq_no") / F.sum("seq_no").over(w5)), 4).alias("seq_no_share"),
        F.sum("sqft").over(w6).alias("cumulative_sqft"),
    )
)

with_windows = (
    scored_stores
    .select(
        "*",
        F.first("running_seq_no", ignorenulls=True).over(w7).alias("first_known_running_seq_no"),
        F.avg("seq_no_share").over(w8).alias("seq_no_share_avg_6"),
    )
)

totals = (
    with_windows
    .withColumn("sqft_rounded_tier", F.when(F.col("sqft_rounded") >= 89, "LARGE").otherwise("SMALL"))
    .cube("sqft_rounded_tier")
    .agg(

        F.sum(F.when(F.col("region") == "North", F.col("cumulative_sqft")).otherwise(0)).alias("north_cumulative_sqft"),

        F.grouping_id().alias("gid"),
    )
)

WITH ranked AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM payments
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY method ORDER BY paid_at, id) = 1
),
metrics AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        order_id,
        method,
        amount,
        paid_at,
        status,
        LAST_VALUE(method) IGNORE NULLS OVER (PARTITION BY order_id, method ORDER BY amount, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS last_known_method,
        SUM(amount) OVER w_hist AS running_amount,
        AVG(amount) OVER w_hist_2 AS amount_avg_6_prior,
        MIN(amount) OVER (PARTITION BY order_id) AS order_id_min_amount,
        COUNT(amount) OVER (PARTITION BY order_id, method ORDER BY CAST(paid_at AS BIGINT) RANGE BETWEEN 2592000 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS amount_count_30d
    FROM ranked
    WINDOW w_hist AS (PARTITION BY status ORDER BY paid_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), w_hist_2 AS (ORDER BY paid_at, id ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING)
),
with_dims AS (
    SELECT
        e.*,
        b.shipping_fee,
        b.channel,
        b.discount
    FROM metrics e
    LEFT JOIN orders b
        ON e.order_id = b.id
),
scored AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY amount DESC, id) AS seq_no,
        LAST_VALUE(order_id_min_amount, TRUE) OVER (PARTITION BY order_id ORDER BY discount, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS last_known_order_id_min_amount,
        LEAD(running_amount, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY channel ORDER BY order_id_min_amount, id) AS next_running_amount
    FROM with_dims
)
SELECT
    id,
    order_id,
    method,
    amount,
    status,
    last_known_method,
    running_amount,
    amount_avg_6_prior,
    channel,
    CASE WHEN channel RLIKE '^(partner|mobile)$' THEN 'GROUP_B' WHEN channel RLIKE '^(web|store)$' THEN 'PRIORITY' ELSE 'EXTENDED' END AS channel_zone
FROM scored
ORDER BY channel_zone DESC;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("method").orderBy("paid_at", "id")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("order_id", "method").orderBy("amount", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w_hist = Window.partitionBy("status").orderBy("paid_at", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w_hist_2 = Window.orderBy("paid_at", "id").rowsBetween(-6, -1)
w5 = Window.partitionBy("order_id")
w6 = Window.partitionBy("order_id", "method").orderBy(F.col("paid_at").cast("bigint")).rangeBetween(-2592000, Window.currentRow)
w7 = Window.orderBy(F.col("amount").desc(), "id")
w8 = Window.partitionBy("order_id").orderBy("discount", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w9 = Window.partitionBy("channel").orderBy("order_id_min_amount", "id")

ranked = (
    df_payments
    .withColumn("rn", F.row_number().over(w))
    .filter(F.col("rn") == 1)
    .drop("rn")
)

metrics = (
    ranked
    .withColumn("last_known_method", F.last("method", ignorenulls=True).over(w2))
    .withColumn("running_amount", F.sum("amount").over(w_hist))
    .withColumn("amount_avg_6_prior", F.avg("amount").over(w_hist_2))
    .withColumn("order_id_min_amount", F.min("amount").over(w5))
    .withColumn("amount_count_30d", F.count("amount").over(w6))
)

with_dims = (
    metrics
    .alias("e")
    .join(df_orders.alias("b"), F.col("e.order_id") == F.col("b.id"), "left")
    .select("e.*", F.col("b.shipping_fee"), F.col("b.channel"), F.col("b.discount"))
)

scored = (
    with_dims
    .withColumn("seq_no", F.row_number().over(w7))
    .withColumn("last_known_order_id_min_amount", F.last("order_id_min_amount", ignorenulls=True).over(w8))
    .withColumn("next_running_amount", F.lead("running_amount", 1).over(w9))
)

result = (
    scored
    .select(
        "id",
        "order_id",
        "method",
        "amount",
        "status",
        "last_known_method",
        "running_amount",
        "amount_avg_6_prior",
        "channel",
        F.when(F.col("channel").rlike("^(partner|mobile)$"), "GROUP_B").when(F.col("channel").rlike("^(web|store)$"), "PRIORITY").otherwise("EXTENDED").alias("channel_zone"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("channel_zone").desc())
)

WITH valid AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT
        *,
        CAST(is_remote AS INT) is_remote_flag,
        LENGTH(full_name) full_name_length
    FROM employees
    WHERE hire_date > TO_DATE('2023-05-31')
),
with_dims AS (
    -- Attach departments attributes
    SELECT
        a.*,
        d.budget,
        d.location,
        d.dept_name
    FROM valid a
    INNER JOIN departments d
        ON a.dept_id = d.id
),
cleaned AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT
        *,
        salary - is_remote_flag salary_minus_is_remote_flag,
        CONCAT(dept_name, '/', job_title) dept_name_job_title
    FROM with_dims
    WHERE hire_date BETWEEN '2023-10-01' AND '2025-03-01'
),
enriched AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        *,
        CUME_DIST() OVER (ORDER BY budget DESC NULLS FIRST) budget_cume_dist,
        AVG(salary) OVER (PARTITION BY dept_id, location) dept_id_avg_salary,
        LAG(is_remote_flag, 2) OVER (PARTITION BY job_title ORDER BY budget, id) prev_is_remote_flag
    FROM cleaned
),
kept_keys AS (
    -- Set intersection on keys
    SELECT manager_id, id
    FROM enriched
    INTERSECT ALL
    SELECT manager_id, id
    FROM employees
    WHERE email LIKE '%@startup.io'
),
verified AS (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    SELECT s.*
    FROM enriched s
    INNER JOIN kept_keys k ON s.manager_id = k.manager_id AND s.id = k.id
),
joined AS (
    -- Attach departments attributes
    SELECT s.*, b.dept_name AS department_dept_name
    FROM verified s
    LEFT JOIN departments b
        ON s.dept_id = b.id
),
enriched_employees AS (
    -- Attach departments attributes
    SELECT
        a.*,
        d.dept_name AS department_dept_name_2,
        d.budget AS department_budget,
        d.location AS department_location
    FROM joined a
    LEFT JOIN departments d
        ON a.dept_id = d.id
)
-- Grouped metrics
SELECT
    CASE WHEN prev_is_remote_flag >= 61 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END AS prev_is_remote_flag_tier,
    DATE_TRUNC('WEEK', hire_date) AS week_start,
    ROUND(AVG(salary), 2) AS avg_salary,
    SUM(CASE WHEN dept_name = 'Engineering' THEN salary_minus_is_remote_flag ELSE 0 END) AS engineering_salary_minus_is_remote_flag,
    SUM(CASE WHEN location = 'Berlin' THEN prev_is_remote_flag ELSE 0 END) AS berlin_prev_is_remote_flag,
    APPROX_PERCENTILE(salary_minus_is_remote_flag, ARRAY(0.25, 0.5, 0.75)) AS salary_minus_is_remote_flag_quartiles,
    GROUPING_ID() AS gid
FROM enriched_employees
GROUP BY CUBE (CASE WHEN prev_is_remote_flag >= 61 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END, DATE_TRUNC('WEEK', hire_date))
ORDER BY engineering_salary_minus_is_remote_flag DESC
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.orderBy(F.col("budget").desc_nulls_first())
w2 = Window.partitionBy("dept_id", "location")
w3 = Window.partitionBy("job_title").orderBy("budget", "id")

valid = (
    df_employees
    .filter(F.col("hire_date") > F.to_date(F.lit("2023-05-31")))
    .withColumn("is_remote_flag", F.col("is_remote").cast("int"))
    .withColumn("full_name_length", F.length("full_name"))
)

with_dims = (
    valid
    .alias("a")
    .join(df_departments.alias("d"), F.col("a.dept_id") == F.col("d.id"), "inner")
    .select("a.*", F.col("d.budget"), F.col("d.location"), F.col("d.dept_name"))
)

cleaned = (
    with_dims
    .filter(F.col("hire_date").between("2023-10-01", "2025-03-01"))
    .withColumn("salary_minus_is_remote_flag", (F.col("salary") - F.col("is_remote_flag")))
    .withColumn("dept_name_job_title", F.concat("dept_name", F.lit("/"), "job_title"))
)

enriched = (
    cleaned
    .select(
        "*",
        F.cume_dist().over(w).alias("budget_cume_dist"),
        F.avg("salary").over(w2).alias("dept_id_avg_salary"),
        F.lag("is_remote_flag", 2).over(w3).alias("prev_is_remote_flag"),
    )
)

kept_keys = (
    enriched
    .select("manager_id", "id")
    .intersectAll(
        df_employees
        .filter(F.col("email").like("%@startup.io"))
        .select("manager_id", "id")
    )
)

verified = (
    enriched
    .alias("s")
    .join(kept_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.manager_id") == F.col("k.manager_id")) & (F.col("s.id") == F.col("k.id")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

joined = (
    verified
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_departments.alias("b"), F.col("s.dept_id") == F.col("b.id"), "left")
    .select("s.*", F.col("b.dept_name").alias("department_dept_name"))
)

enriched_employees = (
    joined
    .alias("a")
    .join(df_departments.alias("d"), F.col("a.dept_id") == F.col("d.id"), "left")
    .select(
        "a.*",
        F.col("d.dept_name").alias("department_dept_name_2"),
        F.col("d.budget").alias("department_budget"),
        F.col("d.location").alias("department_location"),
    )
)

result = (
    enriched_employees
    .withColumn("prev_is_remote_flag_tier", F.when(F.col("prev_is_remote_flag") >= 61, "HIGH").otherwise("LOW"))
    .withColumn("week_start", F.date_trunc("WEEK", "hire_date"))
    .cube("prev_is_remote_flag_tier", "week_start")
    .agg(
        F.round(F.avg("salary"), 2).alias("avg_salary"),
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("dept_name") == "Engineering", F.col("salary_minus_is_remote_flag")).otherwise(0)).alias("engineering_salary_minus_is_remote_flag"),
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("location") == "Berlin", F.col("prev_is_remote_flag")).otherwise(0)).alias("berlin_prev_is_remote_flag"),
        F.percentile_approx("salary_minus_is_remote_flag", [0.25, 0.5, 0.75]).alias("salary_minus_is_remote_flag_quartiles"),

WITH filtered AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT
        id,
        supplier_name,
        city,
        SUBSTRING(supplier_name, 1, 3) AS supplier_name_prefix,
        CASE WHEN country IN ('US', 'UK') THEN 'Group A' ELSE 'Other' END AS country_group,
        COALESCE(city, 'OTHER') AS resolved_city
    FROM suppliers
    WHERE city IS NOT NULL
),
latest_match AS (
    -- Latest matching product per row (LATERAL ... LIMIT 1)
    SELECT
        s.*,
        top1.cost,
        top1.product_brand
    FROM filtered s
    JOIN LATERAL (
            SELECT c.cost, c.brand AS product_brand
            FROM products c
            WHERE c.supplier_id = s.id
            ORDER BY c.cost DESC, c.id DESC
            LIMIT 1
        ) top1 ON TRUE
),
remaining_keys AS (
    -- Set intersection on keys
    SELECT id
    FROM latest_match
    INTERSECT
    SELECT id
    FROM suppliers
    WHERE rating IS NOT NULL
),
reconciled AS (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    SELECT s.*
    FROM latest_match s
    JOIN remaining_keys k ON s.id = k.id
)
-- Aggregate with conditional metrics
SELECT
    city,
    PERCENTILE_APPROX(cost, ARRAY(0.25, 0.5, 0.75)) AS cost_quartiles,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN city = 'Bangkok' THEN 1 END) AS bangkok_count
FROM reconciled
GROUP BY city

        F.coalesce("city", F.lit("OTHER")).alias("resolved_city"),
    )

WITH flattened AS (
    -- Unnest the array into one row per element
    SELECT
        id,
        host,
        log_ts,
        level,
        latency_ms,
        status_code,
        k,
        attr_value
    FROM app_logs
    LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(context) x AS k, attr_value
),
scored AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        *,
        MAX(status_code) OVER (PARTITION BY host, level ORDER BY CAST(log_ts AS BIGINT) RANGE BETWEEN 1800 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS status_code_max_30m,
        CUME_DIST() OVER (PARTITION BY k ORDER BY status_code DESC) AS status_code_cume_dist,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY log_ts, id, k) AS event_seq
    FROM flattened
),
filtered AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT *, ROUND(status_code, 1) AS status_code_rounded
    FROM scored
    WHERE log_ts >= TO_DATE('2025-06-01')
),
base AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        id,
        host,
        log_ts,
        status_code,
        k,
        attr_value,
        status_code_max_30m,
        status_code_cume_dist,
        event_seq,
        CASE WHEN host = 'h1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_h1
    FROM filtered
    WHERE log_ts > TO_DATE('2025-06-01')
      AND k IS NOT NULL
),
with_windows AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        *,
        LAST_VALUE(k, TRUE) OVER (PARTITION BY host, k ORDER BY is_h1, id, k ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS last_known_k,
        AVG(status_code_max_30m) OVER (PARTITION BY host ORDER BY CAST(log_ts AS BIGINT) RANGE BETWEEN 900 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS status_code_max_30m_avg_15m,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY host ORDER BY is_h1 DESC) AS is_h1_rank,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY k ORDER BY status_code DESC, id, k) AS event_seq_2
    FROM base
),
daily AS (
    -- Multi-level aggregation
    SELECT
        CASE WHEN status_code >= 443 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END AS status_code_tier,
        CASE WHEN event_seq >= 8 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END AS event_seq_tier,
        (UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MAX(log_ts)) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MIN(log_ts))) / 60 AS span_minutes,
        COUNT(*) AS num_rows,
        SIZE(COLLECT_SET(k)) AS num_ks
    FROM with_windows
    GROUP BY CASE WHEN status_code >= 443 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END, CASE WHEN event_seq >= 8 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END
)
SELECT
    status_code_tier,
    event_seq_tier,
    num_rows,
    num_ks
FROM daily
ORDER BY num_rows NULLS FIRST;

WITH filtered AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT
        id,
        browser,
        started_at,
        country,
        LOWER(browser) AS browser_lower
    FROM sessions
    WHERE customer_id IS NOT NULL
),
latest AS (
    -- QUALIFY-style window filter
    SELECT *
    FROM filtered
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY country, browser ORDER BY started_at ASC NULLS LAST, id ASC) = 1
),
metrics AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        id,
        browser,
        started_at,
        country,
        browser_lower,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY browser ORDER BY started_at ASC, id ASC) AS event_seq,
        LAST_VALUE(country, TRUE) OVER (PARTITION BY browser, country ORDER BY started_at ASC, id ASC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS last_known_country,
        LAST_VALUE(country, TRUE) OVER (PARTITION BY browser, country ORDER BY started_at ASC, id ASC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS last_known_country_2,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY country ORDER BY started_at ASC, id ASC) AS row_seq,
        LAST_VALUE(country, TRUE) OVER (PARTITION BY browser ORDER BY started_at ASC, id ASC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS last_known_country_3
    FROM latest
),
with_latest AS (
    -- Latest matching web_event per row (LATERAL ... LIMIT 1)
    SELECT
        s.*,
        latest.web_event_page,
        latest.duration_sec
    FROM metrics s
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
            SELECT c.page AS web_event_page, c.duration_sec
            FROM web_events c
            WHERE c.session_id = s.id
              AND c.event_time <= s.started_at
            ORDER BY c.event_time DESC, c.id DESC
            LIMIT 1
        ) latest ON TRUE
),
scored AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        *,
        LEAD(row_seq, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY country ORDER BY started_at ASC, id ASC) AS next_row_seq,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY country ORDER BY duration_sec ASC, id ASC) AS seq_no
    FROM with_latest
),
flagged AS (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > interval)
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN started_at - LAG(started_at) OVER (PARTITION BY country ORDER BY started_at ASC, id ASC) > INTERVAL 60 DAYS THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_new_burst
    FROM scored
),
sessions_sessions AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(is_new_burst) OVER (PARTITION BY country ORDER BY started_at ASC, id ASC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS burst_id
    FROM flagged
),
with_prev AS (
    -- Previous event time per key
    SELECT *, LAG(started_at) OVER (PARTITION BY country ORDER BY started_at ASC, id ASC) AS prev_started_at
    FROM sessions_sessions
),
gaps AS (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN prev_started_at IS NULL OR started_at > prev_started_at + INTERVAL 30 DAYS THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS new_group_flag
    FROM with_prev
),
sessionized AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(new_group_flag) OVER (PARTITION BY country ORDER BY started_at ASC, id ASC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_no
    FROM gaps
)
-- Aggregate with conditional metrics
SELECT
    CASE WHEN event_seq >= 8 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END AS event_seq_tier,
    SUM(CASE WHEN browser = 'Chrome' THEN seq_no ELSE 0 END) AS chrome_seq_no,
    COUNT(DISTINCT browser) AS distinct_browsers,
    SIZE(COLLECT_SET(web_event_page)) AS num_web_event_pages,
    COUNT_IF(country = 'UK') AS uk_events,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN country = 'DE' THEN 1 END) AS de_count
FROM sessionized
GROUP BY 1

WITH exploded AS (
    -- Unnest the array into one row per element
    SELECT
        id,
        plan,
        currency,
        EXPLODE(tier_prices) AS tier_value
    FROM price_tiers
),
enriched AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        *,
        MIN(tier_value) OVER (PARTITION BY currency) AS currency_min_tier_value,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY tier_value DESC NULLS FIRST) AS tier_value_dense_rank,
        STDDEV_SAMP(tier_value) OVER w_recent AS plan_stddev_samp_tier_value,
        PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY plan ORDER BY tier_value NULLS LAST) AS tier_value_percent_rank
    FROM exploded
    WINDOW w_recent AS (PARTITION BY plan)
),
scored AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        id,
        plan,
        currency,
        tier_value,
        currency_min_tier_value,
        tier_value_dense_rank,
        plan_stddev_samp_tier_value,
        tier_value_percent_rank,
        PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY currency ORDER BY plan_stddev_samp_tier_value DESC NULLS FIRST) AS plan_stddev_samp_tier_value_percent_rank,
        CUME_DIST() OVER (PARTITION BY plan ORDER BY tier_value_percent_rank) AS tier_value_percent_rank_cume_dist,
        CUME_DIST() OVER (ORDER BY currency_min_tier_value NULLS LAST) AS currency_min_tier_value_cume_dist
    FROM enriched
),
cleaned AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN plan_stddev_samp_tier_value >= 87 THEN 'High' WHEN plan_stddev_samp_tier_value >= 21 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END AS plan_stddev_samp_tier_value_band
    FROM scored
    WHERE tier_value_dense_rank = 8
)
-- Aggregate with conditional metrics
SELECT
    CASE WHEN tier_value >= 74 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END AS tier_value_tier,
    CASE WHEN currency_min_tier_value >= 63 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END AS currency_min_tier_value_tier,
    SUM(tier_value_percent_rank) FILTER (WHERE plan = 'pro') AS pro_total_tier_value_percent_rank,
    AVG(plan_stddev_samp_tier_value) FILTER (WHERE currency = 'THB') AS thb_avg_plan_stddev_samp_tier_value,
    COUNT(DISTINCT plan) AS distinct_plans
FROM cleaned
GROUP BY CASE WHEN tier_value >= 74 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END, CASE WHEN currency_min_tier_value >= 63 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END;
