from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("currency")
w2 = Window.orderBy(F.col("tier_value").desc_nulls_first())
w_recent = Window.partitionBy("plan")
w4 = Window.partitionBy("plan").orderBy(F.col("tier_value").asc_nulls_last())
w5 = Window.partitionBy("currency").orderBy(F.col("plan_stddev_samp_tier_value").desc_nulls_first())
w6 = Window.partitionBy("plan").orderBy("tier_value_percent_rank")
w7 = Window.orderBy(F.col("currency_min_tier_value").asc_nulls_last())

exploded = (
    df_price_tiers
    .select("id", "plan", "currency", F.explode("tier_prices").alias("tier_value"))
)

enriched = (
    exploded
    .withColumn("currency_min_tier_value", F.min("tier_value").over(w))
    .withColumn("tier_value_dense_rank", F.dense_rank().over(w2))
    .withColumn("plan_stddev_samp_tier_value", F.stddev_samp("tier_value").over(w_recent))
    .withColumn("tier_value_percent_rank", F.percent_rank().over(w4))
)

scored = (
    enriched
    .select(
        "*",
        F.percent_rank().over(w5).alias("plan_stddev_samp_tier_value_percent_rank"),
        F.cume_dist().over(w6).alias("tier_value_percent_rank_cume_dist"),
        F.cume_dist().over(w7).alias("currency_min_tier_value_cume_dist"),
    )
)

cleaned = (
    scored
    .filter(F.col("tier_value_dense_rank") == 8)
    .withColumn("plan_stddev_samp_tier_value_band", F.when(F.col("plan_stddev_samp_tier_value") >= 87, "High").when(F.col("plan_stddev_samp_tier_value") >= 21, "Medium").otherwise("Low"))
)

result = (
    cleaned
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("tier_value") >= 74, "HIGH").otherwise("LOW").alias("tier_value_tier"),
        F.when(F.col("currency_min_tier_value") >= 63, "LARGE").otherwise("SMALL").alias("currency_min_tier_value_tier"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("plan") == "pro", F.col("tier_value_percent_rank"))).alias("pro_total_tier_value_percent_rank"),
        F.avg(F.when(F.col("currency") == "THB", F.col("plan_stddev_samp_tier_value"))).alias("thb_avg_plan_stddev_samp_tier_value"),
        F.countDistinct("plan").alias("distinct_plans"),
    )
)

WITH exploded AS (
    -- Unnest the array into one row per element
    SELECT
        id,
        service,
        latency_ms,
        k,
        v
    FROM app_logs
    LATERAL VIEW OUTER EXPLODE(context) x AS k, v
),
with_windows AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        id,
        service,
        latency_ms,
        k,
        v,
        ROUND(latency_ms / SUM(latency_ms) OVER (PARTITION BY k), 4) AS latency_ms_share,
        MIN(latency_ms) OVER (PARTITION BY service, k) AS service_min_latency_ms,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY k ORDER BY latency_ms DESC) AS latency_ms_rank,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY k, service ORDER BY latency_ms) AS latency_ms_dense_rank
    FROM exploded
),
kept_keys AS (
    -- Set difference on keys
    SELECT service, id
    FROM with_windows
    EXCEPT ALL
    SELECT service, id
    FROM app_logs
    WHERE log_ts < '2023-10-01'
),
verified AS (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    SELECT s.*
    FROM with_windows s
    INNER JOIN kept_keys k ON s.service = k.service AND s.id = k.id
),
metrics AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        *,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY service ORDER BY latency_ms_dense_rank DESC NULLS FIRST) AS latency_ms_dense_rank_dense_rank,
        CUME_DIST() OVER (ORDER BY latency_ms_rank DESC NULLS LAST) AS latency_ms_rank_cume_dist
    FROM verified
),
with_windows_app_logs AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        *,
        CUME_DIST() OVER w_ordered AS latency_ms_dense_rank_dense_rank_cume_dist,
        ROUND(service_min_latency_ms / SUM(service_min_latency_ms) OVER (PARTITION BY k, service), 4) AS service_min_latency_ms_share
    FROM metrics
    WINDOW w_ordered AS (ORDER BY latency_ms_dense_rank_dense_rank)
),
enriched AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        id,
        service,
        latency_ms,
        k,
        v,
        latency_ms_share,
        service_min_latency_ms,
        latency_ms_rank,
        latency_ms_dense_rank,
        latency_ms_dense_rank_dense_rank,
        latency_ms_rank_cume_dist,
        latency_ms_dense_rank_dense_rank_cume_dist,
        service_min_latency_ms_share,
        COUNT(latency_ms_dense_rank_dense_rank) OVER (PARTITION BY service, k) AS service_count_latency_ms_dense_rank_dense_rank,
        AVG(latency_ms_rank_cume_dist) OVER (PARTITION BY service) AS service_avg_latency_ms_rank_cume_dist
    FROM with_windows_app_logs
)
-- Native SQL PIVOT
SELECT *
FROM (
    SELECT
        service,
        k,
        service_min_latency_ms_share
    FROM enriched
) src
PIVOT (
    SUM(service_min_latency_ms_share) AS total
    FOR k IN ('region', 'trace')
);
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("k")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("service", "k")
w3 = Window.partitionBy("k").orderBy(F.col("latency_ms").desc())
w4 = Window.partitionBy("k", "service").orderBy("latency_ms")
w5 = Window.partitionBy("service").orderBy(F.col("latency_ms_dense_rank").desc_nulls_first())
w6 = Window.orderBy(F.col("latency_ms_rank").desc_nulls_last())
w_ordered = Window.orderBy("latency_ms_dense_rank_dense_rank")
w8 = Window.partitionBy("k", "service")
w9 = Window.partitionBy("service")

exploded = (
    df_app_logs
    .select("id", "service", "latency_ms", F.explode_outer("context").alias("k", "v"))
)

with_windows = (
    exploded
    .withColumn("latency_ms_share", F.round((F.col("latency_ms") / F.sum("latency_ms").over(w)), 4))
    .withColumn("service_min_latency_ms", F.min("latency_ms").over(w2))
    .withColumn("latency_ms_rank", F.rank().over(w3))
    .withColumn("latency_ms_dense_rank", F.dense_rank().over(w4))
)

kept_keys = (
    with_windows
    .select("service", "id")
    .exceptAll(
        df_app_logs
        .filter(F.col("log_ts") < "2023-10-01")
        .select("service", "id")
    )
)

verified = (
    with_windows
    .alias("s")
    .join(kept_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.service") == F.col("k.service")) & (F.col("s.id") == F.col("k.id")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

metrics = (
    verified
    .select(
        "*",
        F.dense_rank().over(w5).alias("latency_ms_dense_rank_dense_rank"),
        F.cume_dist().over(w6).alias("latency_ms_rank_cume_dist"),
    )
)

with_windows_app_logs = (
    metrics
    .select(
        "*",
        F.cume_dist().over(w_ordered).alias("latency_ms_dense_rank_dense_rank_cume_dist"),
        F.round((F.col("service_min_latency_ms") / F.sum("service_min_latency_ms").over(w8)), 4).alias("service_min_latency_ms_share"),
    )
)

enriched = (
    with_windows_app_logs
    .select(
        "*",
        F.count("latency_ms_dense_rank_dense_rank").over(w2).alias("service_count_latency_ms_dense_rank_dense_rank"),
        F.avg("latency_ms_rank_cume_dist").over(w9).alias("service_avg_latency_ms_rank_cume_dist"),
    )
)

result = (
    enriched
    .groupBy("service")
    .pivot("k", ["region", "trace"])
    .agg(F.sum("service_min_latency_ms_share").alias("total"))
)

with filtered as (
    select *, last_day(signup_date) as signup_date_month_end
    from customers
    where segment is not null
),
enriched as (
    select
        id,
        name,
        email,
        country,
        city,
        segment,
        signup_date,
        is_active,
        credit_limit,
        age,
        signup_date_month_end,
        corr(age, credit_limit) over (partition by city) as corr_age_credit_limit,
        lead(credit_limit, 1) over (order by signup_date, id) as next_credit_limit,
        max(age) over (partition by city, country) as city_max_age
    from filtered
),
kept as (
    select s.*
    from enriched s
    where not exists (
            select 1
            from sessions x
            where x.customer_id = s.id
              and x.customer_id in (14, 26)
        )
),
latest_match as (
    select
        s.*,
        latest.device,
        latest.session_browser
    from kept s
    left join lateral (
            select c.device, c.browser as session_browser
            from sessions c
            where c.customer_id = s.id
              and c.started_at <= s.signup_date
            order by c.started_at desc, c.id desc
            limit 1
        ) latest on true
)
select
    case when corr_age_credit_limit >= 0.58 then 'LARGE' else 'SMALL' end as corr_age_credit_limit_tier,
    case when age >= 56 then 'PREMIUM' else 'STANDARD' end as age_tier,
    segment,
    count(distinct id) as distinct_ids,
    count(case when session_browser = 'Chrome' then 1 end) as chrome_count
from latest_match
group by corr_age_credit_limit_tier, age_tier, segment
having distinct_ids >= 1
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("city")
w2 = Window.orderBy("signup_date", "id")
w3 = Window.partitionBy("city", "country")
w4 = Window.partitionBy(F.col("s.id")).orderBy(F.col("c.started_at").desc(), F.col("c.id").desc())

filtered = (
    df_customers
    .filter(F.col("segment").isNotNull())
    .withColumn("signup_date_month_end", F.last_day("signup_date"))
)

enriched = (
    filtered
    .select(
        "*",
        F.corr("age", "credit_limit").over(w).alias("corr_age_credit_limit"),
        F.lead("credit_limit", 1).over(w2).alias("next_credit_limit"),
        F.max("age").over(w3).alias("city_max_age"),
    )
)

kept = (
    enriched
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_sessions.alias("x"), (F.col("x.customer_id") == F.col("s.id")) & (F.col("x.customer_id").isin([14, 26])), "left_anti")
)

latest_match = (
    kept
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_sessions.alias("c"), (F.col("c.customer_id") == F.col("s.id")) & (F.col("c.started_at") <= F.col("s.signup_date")), "left")
    .withColumn("rn", F.row_number().over(w4))
    .filter(F.col("rn") == 1)
    .select("s.*", F.col("c.device"), F.col("c.browser").alias("session_browser"))
)

result = (
    latest_match
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("corr_age_credit_limit") >= 0.58, "LARGE").otherwise("SMALL").alias("corr_age_credit_limit_tier"),
        F.when(F.col("age") >= 56, "PREMIUM").otherwise("STANDARD").alias("age_tier"),
        "segment",
    )
    .agg(
        F.countDistinct("id").alias("distinct_ids"),
        F.count(F.when(F.col("session_browser") == "Chrome", 1)).alias("chrome_count"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("distinct_ids") >= 1)
)

WITH base AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT
        id,
        customer_id,
        store_id,
        order_date,
        status,
        channel,
        amount,
        ROUND(shipping_fee * 1.1, 2) AS adjusted_shipping_fee,
        INITCAP(TRIM(channel)) AS channel_title
    FROM orders
    WHERE status IN ('SHIPPED', 'RETURNED', 'COMPLETED')
),
latest_match AS (
    -- Latest matching order_item per row (LATERAL ... LIMIT 1)
    SELECT s.*, top1.order_item_unit_price
    FROM base s
    JOIN LATERAL (
            SELECT c.unit_price AS order_item_unit_price
            FROM order_items c
            WHERE c.order_id = s.id
            ORDER BY c.unit_price DESC, c.id DESC
            LIMIT 1
        ) top1 ON TRUE
),
filtered AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        id,
        store_id,
        order_date,
        status,
        channel,
        amount,
        adjusted_shipping_fee,
        channel_title,
        order_item_unit_price,
        CEIL(adjusted_shipping_fee) AS adjusted_shipping_fee_whole,
        COALESCE(channel, 'NONE') AS channel_clean
    FROM latest_match
    WHERE adjusted_shipping_fee <= 63
)
-- Native SQL UNPIVOT (wide to long)
SELECT *
FROM (
    SELECT
        id,
        store_id,
        adjusted_shipping_fee,
        amount,
        order_item_unit_price
    FROM filtered
) src
UNPIVOT (
    metric_value FOR metric IN (adjusted_shipping_fee AS ADJUSTED_SHIPPING_FEE, amount, order_item_unit_price AS ORDER_ITEM_UNIT_PRICE_VAL)
)

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy(F.col("s.id")).orderBy(F.col("c.unit_price").desc(), F.col("c.id").desc())

base = (
    df_orders
    .filter(F.col("status").isin(["SHIPPED", "RETURNED", "COMPLETED"]))
    .select(
        "id",
        "customer_id",
        "store_id",
        "order_date",
        "status",
        "channel",
        "amount",
        F.round((F.col("shipping_fee") * 1.1), 2).alias("adjusted_shipping_fee"),
        F.initcap(F.trim("channel")).alias("channel_title"),
    )
)

latest_match = (
    base
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_order_items.alias("c"), (F.col("c.order_id") == F.col("s.id")), "inner")
    .withColumn("rn", F.row_number().over(w))
    .filter(F.col("rn") == 1)
    .select("s.*", F.col("c.unit_price").alias("order_item_unit_price"))
)

filtered = (
    latest_match
    .filter(F.col("adjusted_shipping_fee") <= 63)
    .select(
        "id",
        "store_id",
        "order_date",
        "status",
        "channel",
        "amount",
        "adjusted_shipping_fee",
        "channel_title",
        "order_item_unit_price",
        F.ceil("adjusted_shipping_fee").alias("adjusted_shipping_fee_whole"),
        F.coalesce("channel", F.lit("NONE")).alias("channel_clean"),
    )
)

result = (
    filtered
    .select(
        "id",
        "store_id",
        F.col("adjusted_shipping_fee").alias("ADJUSTED_SHIPPING_FEE"),
        "amount",
        F.col("order_item_unit_price").alias("ORDER_ITEM_UNIT_PRICE_VAL"),
    )
    .unpivot(
        ["id", "store_id"],
        ["ADJUSTED_SHIPPING_FEE", "amount", "ORDER_ITEM_UNIT_PRICE_VAL"],
        "metric",
        "metric_value",
    )
    .filter(F.col("metric_value").isNotNull())
)

WITH cleaned AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT
        id,
        store_name,
        city,
        region,
        opened_date,
        sqft,
        DATE_FORMAT(opened_date, 'MMM yyyy') AS opened_date_label,
        TRIM(region) AS clean_region
    FROM stores
    WHERE opened_date >= DATE '2023-08-27'
      AND opened_date < '2024-06-18'
),
with_latest AS (
    -- Latest matching store_sale per row (LATERAL ... LIMIT 1)
    SELECT s.*, latest.revenue
    FROM cleaned s
    JOIN LATERAL (
            SELECT c.revenue
            FROM store_sales c
            WHERE c.store_id = s.id
            ORDER BY c.revenue DESC, c.id DESC
            LIMIT 1
        ) latest ON TRUE
),
metrics AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        *,
        CUME_DIST() OVER (PARTITION BY city ORDER BY sqft ASC NULLS LAST) AS sqft_cume_dist,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER w_part AS row_seq
    FROM with_latest
    WINDOW w_part AS (PARTITION BY city, region ORDER BY revenue ASC, id ASC)
),
deduped AS (
    -- Deduplicate with ROW_NUMBER
    SELECT *
    FROM (
        SELECT *, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY region, city ORDER BY sqft DESC) AS rn
        FROM metrics
    ) ranked
    WHERE rn = 1
),
with_windows AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        *,
        SUM(revenue) OVER (PARTITION BY region ORDER BY revenue ASC, id ASC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_revenue,
        LAG(sqft, 1, 0) OVER (PARTITION BY region ORDER BY sqft_cume_dist ASC, id ASC) AS prev_sqft,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY region ORDER BY sqft DESC, id ASC) AS event_seq,
        LEAD(sqft_cume_dist, 2, 0) OVER (ORDER BY rn ASC, id ASC) AS next_sqft_cume_dist,
        CUME_DIST() OVER (PARTITION BY city, region ORDER BY row_seq DESC) AS row_seq_cume_dist
    FROM deduped
),
metrics_stores AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        id,
        store_name,
        city,
        region,
        opened_date,
        sqft,
        opened_date_label,
        clean_region,
        revenue,
        sqft_cume_dist,
        row_seq,
        rn,
        running_revenue,
        prev_sqft,
        event_seq,
        next_sqft_cume_dist,
        row_seq_cume_dist,
        LAG(sqft_cume_dist, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY region ORDER BY sqft_cume_dist ASC, id ASC) AS prev_sqft_cume_dist,
        SUM(next_sqft_cume_dist) OVER (ORDER BY sqft_cume_dist ASC, id ASC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_next_sqft_cume_dist,
        SUM(sqft) OVER (ORDER BY running_revenue ASC, id ASC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_sqft,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY city ORDER BY rn DESC, id ASC) AS row_seq_2,
        STDDEV_SAMP(row_seq_cume_dist) OVER (PARTITION BY region) AS region_stddev_samp_row_seq_cume_dist
    FROM with_windows
),
eligible AS (
    -- Anti-join via a correlated subquery
    SELECT s.*
    FROM metrics_stores s
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM orders ch
            WHERE ch.store_id = s.id
              AND ch.order_date >= s.opened_date
        )
)
SELECT
    id,
    city,
    opened_date,
    sqft,
    opened_date_label,
    clean_region,
    revenue,
    row_seq,
    running_revenue
FROM eligible
ORDER BY opened_date DESC
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy(F.col("s.id")).orderBy(F.col("c.revenue").desc(), F.col("c.id").desc())
w2 = Window.partitionBy("city").orderBy(F.col("sqft").asc_nulls_last())
w_part = Window.partitionBy("city", "region").orderBy("revenue", "id")
w4 = Window.partitionBy("region", "city").orderBy(F.col("sqft").desc())
w5 = Window.partitionBy("region").orderBy("revenue", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w6 = Window.partitionBy("region").orderBy("sqft_cume_dist", "id")
w7 = Window.partitionBy("region").orderBy(F.col("sqft").desc(), "id")
w8 = Window.orderBy("rn", "id")
w9 = Window.partitionBy("city", "region").orderBy(F.col("row_seq").desc())
w10 = Window.orderBy("sqft_cume_dist", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w11 = Window.orderBy("running_revenue", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w12 = Window.partitionBy("city").orderBy(F.col("rn").desc(), "id")
w13 = Window.partitionBy("region")

cleaned = (
    df_stores
    .filter((F.col("opened_date") >= F.lit("2023-08-27").cast("date")) & (F.col("opened_date") < "2024-06-18"))
    .select(
        "id",
        "store_name",
        "city",
        "region",
        "opened_date",
        "sqft",
        F.date_format("opened_date", "MMM yyyy").alias("opened_date_label"),
        F.trim("region").alias("clean_region"),
    )
)

with_latest = (
    cleaned
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_store_sales.alias("c"), (F.col("c.store_id") == F.col("s.id")), "inner")
    .withColumn("rn", F.row_number().over(w))
    .filter(F.col("rn") == 1)
    .select("s.*", F.col("c.revenue"))
)

metrics = (
    with_latest
    .withColumn("sqft_cume_dist", F.cume_dist().over(w2))
    .withColumn("row_seq", F.row_number().over(w_part))
)

deduped = (
    metrics
    .withColumn("rn", F.rank().over(w4))
    .filter(F.col("rn") == 1)
)

with_windows = (
    deduped
    .select(
        "*",
        F.sum("revenue").over(w5).alias("running_revenue"),
        F.lag("sqft", 1, 0).over(w6).alias("prev_sqft"),
        F.row_number().over(w7).alias("event_seq"),
        F.lead("sqft_cume_dist", 2, 0).over(w8).alias("next_sqft_cume_dist"),
        F.cume_dist().over(w9).alias("row_seq_cume_dist"),
    )
)

metrics_stores = (
    with_windows
    .select(
        "*",
        F.lag("sqft_cume_dist", 1).over(w6).alias("prev_sqft_cume_dist"),
        F.sum("next_sqft_cume_dist").over(w10).alias("running_next_sqft_cume_dist"),
        F.sum("sqft").over(w11).alias("cumulative_sqft"),
        F.row_number().over(w12).alias("row_seq_2"),
        F.stddev_samp("row_seq_cume_dist").over(w13).alias("region_stddev_samp_row_seq_cume_dist"),
    )
)

eligible = (
    metrics_stores
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_orders.alias("ch"), (F.col("ch.store_id") == F.col("s.id")) & (F.col("ch.order_date") >= F.col("s.opened_date")), "left_anti")
)

result = (
    eligible
    .select(
        "id",
        "city",
        "opened_date",
        "sqft",
        "opened_date_label",
        "clean_region",
        "revenue",
        "row_seq",
        "running_revenue",
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("opened_date").desc())
)

sql:
with latest as (
    select *
    from sessions
    qualify row_number() over (partition by browser, country order by started_at desc nulls first, id) = 1
),
with_windows as (
    select
        id,
        customer_id,
        device,
        browser,
        started_at,
        country,
        row_number() over (partition by customer_id order by started_at desc, id) as event_seq,
        row_number() over (partition by device order by started_at, id) as seq_no,
        row_number() over (partition by browser order by started_at, id) as seq_no_2
    from latest
),
joined as (
    select e.*, b.city
    from with_windows e
    left join customers b
        on e.customer_id = b.id
),
with_gaps as (
    select *, case when started_at - lag(started_at) over (partition by customer_id order by started_at, id) > interval 90 days then 1 else 0 end as is_new_session
    from joined
),
sessions_sessions as (
    select *, sum(is_new_session) over (partition by customer_id order by started_at, id rows between unbounded preceding and current row) as island_id
    from with_gaps
)
select
    id,
    customer_id,
    device,
    browser,
    country,
    seq_no_2,
    is_new_session,
    island_id
from sessions_sessions
order by seq_no_2 desc, is_new_session;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("browser", "country").orderBy(F.col("started_at").desc_nulls_first(), "id")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("customer_id").orderBy(F.col("started_at").desc(), "id")
w3 = Window.partitionBy("device").orderBy("started_at", "id")
w4 = Window.partitionBy("browser").orderBy("started_at", "id")
w5 = Window.partitionBy("customer_id").orderBy("started_at", "id")
w6 = Window.partitionBy("customer_id").orderBy("started_at", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)

latest = (
    df_sessions
    .withColumn("rank_in_group", F.row_number().over(w))
    .filter(F.col("rank_in_group") == 1)
    .drop("rank_in_group")
)

with_windows = (
    latest
    .select(
        "*",
        F.row_number().over(w2).alias("event_seq"),
        F.row_number().over(w3).alias("seq_no"),
        F.row_number().over(w4).alias("seq_no_2"),
    )
)

joined = (
    with_windows
    .alias("e")
    .join(df_customers.alias("b"), F.col("e.customer_id") == F.col("b.id"), "left")
    .select("e.*", F.col("b.city"))
)

with_gaps = (
    joined
    .withColumn("is_new_session", F.when(F.col("started_at") - F.lag("started_at").over(w5) > F.expr("INTERVAL 90 DAYS"), 1).otherwise(0))
)

sessions_sessions = with_gaps.withColumn("island_id", F.sum("is_new_session").over(w6))

result = (
    sessions_sessions
    .select(
        "id",
        "customer_id",
        "device",
        "browser",
        "country",
        "seq_no_2",
        "is_new_session",
        "island_id",
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("seq_no_2").desc(), "is_new_session")
)

sql:
WITH valid AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        device_code,
        temp_c,
        humidity,
        pressure,
        status_bits,
        firmware,
        status_bits - pressure AS status_bits_minus_pressure
    FROM device_readings
    WHERE reading_ts > TO_DATE('2025-09-01')
      AND reading_ts >= '2024-12-01'
),
scored AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        device_code,
        temp_c,
        humidity,
        pressure,
        status_bits,
        firmware,
        status_bits_minus_pressure,
        NTILE(3) OVER (PARTITION BY device_code ORDER BY humidity DESC, id) AS humidity_bucket,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY device_code ORDER BY temp_c DESC, id) AS seq_no,
        CORR(status_bits, temp_c) OVER (PARTITION BY device_code) AS corr_status_bits_temp_c
    FROM valid
),
valid_device_readings AS (
    SELECT *, GREATEST(status_bits_minus_pressure, pressure) AS greatest_status_bits_minus_pressure_pressure
    FROM scored
    WHERE pressure <= 1008
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT *, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY device_code ORDER BY status_bits_minus_pressure DESC) AS row_num
    FROM valid_device_readings
    QUALIFY row_num = 1
),
ranked_device_readings AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM ranked
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY device_code ORDER BY humidity, id) = 1
)
SELECT
    device_code,
    seq_no,
    STDDEV_SAMP(status_bits) AS status_bits_stddev,
    ROUND(AVG(pressure), 2) AS avg_pressure,
    SUM(CASE WHEN device_code = 'DV-01' THEN pressure ELSE 0 END) AS dv_01_pressure,
    BIT_OR(status_bits) AS status_bits_bit_or,
    PERCENTILE_APPROX(humidity_bucket, 0.9) AS humidity_bucket_p90,
    SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_SET(device_code)) AS device_code_list
FROM ranked_device_readings
GROUP BY CUBE (device_code, seq_no)
ORDER BY dv_01_pressure NULLS LAST;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("device_code").orderBy(F.col("humidity").desc(), "id")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("device_code").orderBy(F.col("temp_c").desc(), "id")
w3 = Window.partitionBy("device_code")
w4 = Window.partitionBy("device_code").orderBy(F.col("status_bits_minus_pressure").desc())
w5 = Window.partitionBy("device_code").orderBy("humidity", "id")

valid = (
    df_device_readings
    .filter((F.col("reading_ts") > F.to_date(F.lit("2025-09-01"))) & (F.col("reading_ts") >= "2024-12-01"))
    .select(
        "id",
        "device_code",
        "temp_c",
        "humidity",
        "pressure",
        "status_bits",
        "firmware",
        (F.col("status_bits") - F.col("pressure")).alias("status_bits_minus_pressure"),
    )
)

scored = (
    valid
    .withColumn("humidity_bucket", F.ntile(3).over(w))
    .withColumn("seq_no", F.row_number().over(w2))
    .withColumn("corr_status_bits_temp_c", F.corr("status_bits", "temp_c").over(w3))
)

valid_device_readings = (
    scored
    .filter(F.col("pressure") <= 1008)
    .select(
        "*",
        F.greatest("status_bits_minus_pressure", "pressure").alias("greatest_status_bits_minus_pressure_pressure"),
    )
)

ranked = (
    valid_device_readings
    .withColumn("row_num", F.rank().over(w4))
    .filter(F.col("row_num") == 1)
)

ranked_device_readings = (
    ranked
    .withColumn("rank_in_group", F.row_number().over(w5))
    .filter(F.col("rank_in_group") == 1)
    .drop("rank_in_group")
)

result = (
    ranked_device_readings
    .cube("device_code", "seq_no")
    .agg(
        F.stddev_samp("status_bits").alias("status_bits_stddev"),
        F.round(F.avg("pressure"), 2).alias("avg_pressure"),
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("device_code") == "DV-01", F.col("pressure")).otherwise(0)).alias("dv_01_pressure"),
        F.bit_or("status_bits").alias("status_bits_bit_or"),
        F.percentile_approx("humidity_bucket", 0.9).alias("humidity_bucket_p90"),
        F.sort_array(F.collect_set("device_code")).alias("device_code_list"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("dv_01_pressure").asc_nulls_last())
)

WITH valid AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN quantity >= 195 THEN 'High' WHEN quantity >= 80 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END quantity_band
    FROM inventory
    WHERE product_id IN (4, 5, 7, 8)
),
cleaned AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT
        *,
        ADD_MONTHS(last_restock, 1) last_restock_plus_months,
        CASE WHEN quantity >= 193 THEN 'High' WHEN quantity >= 76 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END quantity_band_2
    FROM valid
    WHERE last_restock > TO_DATE('2023-12-05')
),
enriched AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        *,
        LAST_VALUE(quantity, TRUE) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY last_restock_plus_months ASC, id ASC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) last_known_quantity,
        LAG(quantity, 1) OVER (ORDER BY last_restock_plus_months ASC, id ASC) prev_quantity,
        LAST_VALUE(quantity, TRUE) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY last_restock_plus_months ASC, id ASC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) last_known_quantity_2,
        AVG(quantity) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY last_restock_plus_months ASC, id ASC ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) quantity_avg_6
    FROM cleaned
),
enriched_inventory AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        id,
        store_id,
        product_id,
        quantity,
        last_restock,
        quantity_band,
        last_restock_plus_months,
        quantity_band_2,
        last_known_quantity,
        prev_quantity,
        last_known_quantity_2,
        quantity_avg_6,
        AVG(quantity) OVER (PARTITION BY store_id, product_id ORDER BY last_known_quantity ASC, id ASC ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) quantity_avg_3,
        LEAD(last_known_quantity, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY last_known_quantity ASC, id ASC) next_last_known_quantity,
        FIRST_VALUE(last_known_quantity_2) IGNORE NULLS OVER (PARTITION BY store_id ORDER BY quantity ASC, id ASC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) first_known_last_known_quantity_2,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY store_id, product_id ORDER BY last_known_quantity_2 ASC, id ASC) seq_no
    FROM enriched
)
SELECT
    id,
    store_id,
    last_restock,

WITH enriched AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        *,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ends_on DESC, id) AS seq_no,
        FIRST_VALUE(channel) IGNORE NULLS OVER (PARTITION BY channel ORDER BY starts_on, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS first_known_channel,
        MIN(discount_pct) OVER (PARTITION BY channel) AS channel_min_discount_pct
    FROM promotions
),
base AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT
        id,
        channel,
        promo_code,
        starts_on,
        ends_on,
        discount_pct,
        seq_no,
        channel_min_discount_pct,
        ROUND(discount_pct, 0) AS discount_pct_rounded,
        DATE_FORMAT(ends_on, 'yyyy-MM-dd') AS ends_on_label
    FROM enriched
    WHERE channel IS NOT NULL
),
matched_keys AS (
    -- Set difference on keys
    SELECT id, channel
    FROM base
    EXCEPT
    SELECT id, channel
    FROM promotions
    WHERE promo_code = 'SPRING10'
),
reconciled AS (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    SELECT s.*
    FROM base s
    INNER JOIN matched_keys k ON s.id = k.id AND s.channel = k.channel
),
with_window AS (
    -- Non-equi join on a validity window
    SELECT
        a.*,
        pr.id AS promo_id,
        pr.promo_code AS promotion_promo_code,
        pr.discount_pct AS promotion_discount_pct
    FROM reconciled a
    LEFT JOIN promotions pr
        ON a.channel <=> pr.channel
       AND a.ends_on >= pr.starts_on
       AND a.ends_on < pr.ends_on + INTERVAL 14 DAYS
),
matched AS (
    -- Non-equi join on a validity window
    SELECT
        s.*,
        pr.id AS promo_id_2,
        pr.promo_code AS promotion_promo_code_2,
        pr.discount_pct AS promotion_discount_pct_2
    FROM with_window s
    LEFT JOIN promotions pr
        ON COALESCE(s.channel, 'web') = pr.channel
       AND s.starts_on BETWEEN pr.starts_on AND pr.ends_on
),
metrics AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        *,
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY promo_id DESC NULLS FIRST) AS promo_id_rank,
        STDDEV_SAMP(seq_no) OVER (PARTITION BY promotion_promo_code_2) AS promotion_promo_code_2_stddev_samp_seq_no,
        CUME_DIST() OVER (ORDER BY discount_pct_rounded DESC NULLS FIRST) AS discount_pct_rounded_cume_dist,
        ROUND(promotion_discount_pct / SUM(promotion_discount_pct) OVER (PARTITION BY promotion_promo_code_2), 4) AS promotion_discount_pct_share
    FROM matched
),
with_window_promotions AS (
    -- Non-equi join on a validity window
    SELECT
        src.*,
        pr.id AS promo_id_3,
        pr.promo_code AS promotion_promo_code_3,
        pr.discount_pct AS promotion_discount_pct_3
    FROM metrics src
    INNER JOIN promotions pr
        ON src.channel = pr.channel
       AND src.ends_on >= pr.starts_on
       AND src.ends_on <= DATE_ADD(pr.ends_on, 10)
)
-- Native SQL UNPIVOT (wide to long)
SELECT *
FROM (
    SELECT
        promo_code,
        promotion_discount_pct,
        promotion_discount_pct_2,
        discount_pct_rounded,
        promotion_discount_pct_share
    FROM with_window_promotions
) src
UNPIVOT (
    value FOR metric_name IN (promotion_discount_pct AS PROMOTION_DISCOUNT_PCT, promotion_discount_pct_2, discount_pct_rounded, promotion_discount_pct_share AS PROMOTION_DISCOUNT_PCT_SHARE_VAL)
)

        F.col("pr.discount_pct").alias("promotion_discount_pct_2"),

metrics = (

    .withColumn("discount_pct_rounded_cume_dist", F.cume_dist().over(w6))
    .withColumn("promotion_discount_pct_share", F.round((F.col("promotion_discount_pct") / F.sum("promotion_discount_pct").over(w5)), 4))

with_window_promotions = (

    .select(
        "src.*",
        F.col("pr.id").alias("promo_id_3"),
        F.col("pr.promo_code").alias("promotion_promo_code_3"),
        F.col("pr.discount_pct").alias("promotion_discount_pct_3"),
    )
)

result = (
    with_window_promotions
    .select(
        "promo_code",
        F.col("promotion_discount_pct").alias("PROMOTION_DISCOUNT_PCT"),
        "promotion_discount_pct_2",
        "discount_pct_rounded",
        F.col("promotion_discount_pct_share").alias("PROMOTION_DISCOUNT_PCT_SHARE_VAL"),
    )
    .unpivot(
        ["promo_code"],
        ["PROMOTION_DISCOUNT_PCT", "promotion_discount_pct_2", "discount_pct_rounded", "PROMOTION_DISCOUNT_PCT_SHARE_VAL"],
        "metric_name",
        "value",
    )
    .filter(F.col("value").isNotNull())
)

with flattened as (
    -- Unnest the array into one row per element
    select
        id,
        service,
        log_ts,
        k,
        v
    from app_logs
    lateral view outer explode(context) t as k, v
),
valid as (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    select *, length(service) as service_length
    from flattened
    where k is not null
      and service = 'search'
),
base as (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    select *, case when service in ('search', 'auth') then 'Core' else 'Other' end as service_group
    from valid
    where k = 'trace'
),
remaining_keys as (
    -- Set difference on keys
    select id, service
    from base
    except distinct
    select id, service
    from app_logs
    where log_ts >= '2024-05-01'
),
verified as (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    select s.*
    from base s
    join remaining_keys k on s.id = k.id and s.service = k.service
)
-- Window metrics over several different partitions
select
    id,
    service,
    log_ts,
    k,
    v,
    service_length,
    service_group,
    max(service_length) over (partition by k, service order by cast(log_ts as bigint) range between 900 preceding and current row) as service_length_max_15m,
    count(service_length) over (partition by service order by cast(log_ts as bigint) range between 1800 preceding and current row) as service_length_count_30m
from verified;

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("k", "service").orderBy(F.col("log_ts").cast("bigint")).rangeBetween(-900, Window.currentRow)
w2 = Window.partitionBy("service").orderBy(F.col("log_ts").cast("bigint")).rangeBetween(-1800, Window.currentRow)

flattened = (
    df_app_logs
    .select("id", "service", "log_ts", F.explode_outer("context").alias("k", "v"))
)

valid = (
    flattened
    .filter(F.col("k").isNotNull() & (F.col("service") == "search"))
    .select("*", F.length("service").alias("service_length"))
)

base = (
    valid
    .filter(F.col("k") == "trace")
    .withColumn("service_group", F.when(F.col("service").isin(["search", "auth"]), "Core").otherwise("Other"))
)

remaining_keys = (
    base
    .select("id", "service")
    .subtract(
        df_app_logs
        .filter(F.col("log_ts") >= "2024-05-01")
        .select("id", "service")
    )
)

verified = (
    base
    .alias("s")
    .join(remaining_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.id") == F.col("k.id")) & (F.col("s.service") == F.col("k.service")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

result = (
    verified
    .withColumn("service_length_max_15m", F.max("service_length").over(w))
    .withColumn("service_length_count_30m", F.count("service_length").over(w2))
)

WITH base AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT *, COALESCE(dept_name, 'N/A') AS dept_name_filled
    FROM departments
    WHERE dept_name = 'HR'
),
metrics AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        *,
        AVG(budget) OVER (PARTITION BY dept_name, location ORDER BY budget, id ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS budget_avg_3_prior,
        ROUND(budget / SUM(budget) OVER (PARTITION BY dept_name), 4) AS budget_share,
        FIRST_VALUE(location, TRUE) OVER (PARTITION BY dept_name ORDER BY budget, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS first_known_location
    FROM base
),
base_departments AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT
        *,
        budget - budget_share AS budget_minus_budget_share,
        LEAST(budget_share, budget) AS least_budget_share_budget
    FROM metrics
    WHERE budget <= 2405000
),
with_latest AS (
    -- Latest matching employee per row (LATERAL ... LIMIT 1)
    SELECT s.*, top1.job_title
    FROM base_departments s
    JOIN LATERAL (
            SELECT c.job_title
            FROM employees c
            WHERE c.dept_id = s.id
            ORDER BY c.salary DESC, c.id DESC
            LIMIT 1
        ) top1 ON TRUE
)
-- Multi-level aggregation
SELECT
    CASE WHEN least_budget_share_budget >= 90 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END AS least_budget_share_budget_tier,
    COUNT(DISTINCT job_title) AS distinct_job_titles,
    SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_SET(dept_name)) AS dept_name_list,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN dept_name = 'Marketing' THEN 1 END) AS marketing_count
FROM with_latest
GROUP BY 1;

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("dept_name", "location").orderBy("budget", "id").rowsBetween(-3, -1)
w2 = Window.partitionBy("dept_name")
w3 = Window.partitionBy("dept_name").orderBy("budget", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w4 = Window.partitionBy(F.col("s.id")).orderBy(F.col("c.salary").desc(), F.col("c.id").desc())

base = (
    df_departments
    .filter(F.col("dept_name") == "HR")
    .select("*", F.coalesce("dept_name", F.lit("N/A")).alias("dept_name_filled"))
)

metrics = (
    base
    .withColumn("budget_avg_3_prior", F.avg("budget").over(w))
    .withColumn("budget_share", F.round((F.col("budget") / F.sum("budget").over(w2)), 4))
    .withColumn("first_known_location", F.first("location", ignorenulls=True).over(w3))
)

base_departments = (
    metrics
    .filter(F.col("budget") <= 2405000)
    .withColumn("budget_minus_budget_share", (F.col("budget") - F.col("budget_share")))
    .withColumn("least_budget_share_budget", F.least("budget_share", "budget"))
)

with_latest = (
    base_departments
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_employees.alias("c"), (F.col("c.dept_id") == F.col("s.id")), "inner")
    .withColumn("rn", F.row_number().over(w4))
    .filter(F.col("rn") == 1)
    .select("s.*", F.col("c.job_title"))
)

result = (
    with_latest
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("least_budget_share_budget") >= 90, "HIGH").otherwise("LOW").alias("least_budget_share_budget_tier"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.countDistinct("job_title").alias("distinct_job_titles"),
        F.sort_array(F.collect_set("dept_name")).alias("dept_name_list"),
        F.count(F.when(F.col("dept_name") == "Marketing", 1)).alias("marketing_count"),
    )
)

with ranked as (
    -- Keep one row per key (latest first)
    select *
    from (
        select *, row_number() over (partition by product_id order by quantity desc, id) as row_num
        from inventory
    ) t
    where row_num = 1
),
enriched as (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    select
        *,
        avg(quantity) over (partition by product_id, store_id order by quantity, id rows between 6 preceding and 1 preceding) as quantity_avg_6_prior,
        lead(quantity, 1) over w_hist as next_quantity,
        row_number() over (order by last_restock, id) as row_seq,
        avg(quantity) over (partition by store_id order by row_num, id rows between 6 preceding and current row) as quantity_avg_6,
        count(quantity) over w_running as store_id_count_quantity
    from ranked
    window w_hist as (partition by store_id order by row_num, id), w_running as (partition by store_id)
),
with_dims as (
    -- Attach products attributes
    select
        e.*,
        p.launch_date,
        p.brand
    from enriched e
    join products p
        on e.product_id = p.id
)
select
    s.id,
    s.store_id,
    s.row_num,
    s.quantity_avg_6_prior,
    s.next_quantity,
    s.row_seq,
    s.quantity_avg_6,
    s.store_id_count_quantity,
    s.launch_date,
    (select sum(x.revenue) from store_sales x where x.store_id = s.store_id) as sum_store_sale_revenue
from with_dims s
order by quantity_avg_6 desc nulls last;

WITH metrics AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        *,
        SUM(quantity) OVER w_grp AS running_quantity,
        AVG(unit_price) OVER w_part AS unit_price_avg_5_prior
    FROM order_items
    WINDOW w_grp AS (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY unit_price, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), w_part AS (ORDER BY quantity, id ROWS BETWEEN 5 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING)
),
deduped AS (
    -- Deduplicate with ROW_NUMBER
    SELECT *
    FROM (
        SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY order_id ORDER BY unit_price_avg_5_prior DESC NULLS FIRST, id) AS latest_rank
        FROM metrics
    ) ranked
    WHERE latest_rank = 1
),
joined AS (
    -- Attach orders attributes
    SELECT
        src.*,
        p.order_date,
        p.amount
    FROM deduped src
    LEFT JOIN orders p
        ON src.order_id = p.id
),
ranked AS (
    -- Deduplicate with ROW_NUMBER
    SELECT *
    FROM joined
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY order_id ORDER BY latest_rank DESC, id) = 1
),
enriched AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        *,
        FIRST_VALUE(unit_price_avg_5_prior, TRUE) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY unit_price, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS first_known_unit_price_avg_5_prior,
        SUM(amount) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY amount, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_amount
    FROM ranked
),
summary AS (
    -- Grouped metrics
    SELECT
        product_id,
        CASE WHEN cumulative_amount >= 6870 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END AS cumulative_amount_tier,
        AVG(quantity) AS avg_quantity,
        BIT_AND(quantity) AS quantity_bit_and,
        MIN(quantity) AS min_quantity
    FROM enriched
    GROUP BY product_id, cumulative_amount_tier
)
SELECT
    s.product_id,
    s.cumulative_amount_tier,
    s.avg_quantity,
    s.quantity_bit_and,
    s.min_quantity,
    (SELECT SUM(o2.quantity) FROM order_items o2 WHERE o2.product_id = s.product_id) AS sum_order_item_quantity
FROM summary s
ORDER BY avg_quantity;

WITH cleaned AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT
        id,
        order_id,
        carrier,
        shipped_date,
        delivered_date,
        status,
        ADD_MONTHS(shipped_date, 6) AS shipped_date_plus_months,
        COALESCE(carrier, 'N/A') AS carrier_clean
    FROM shipments
    WHERE delivered_date >= TO_DATE('2023-04-19')
      AND order_id IS NOT NULL
      AND order_id = 8
),
with_windows AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        *,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY status ORDER BY shipped_date_plus_months ASC, id ASC) AS row_seq,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY status ORDER BY shipped_date ASC, id ASC) AS event_seq
    FROM cleaned
),
kept_keys AS (
    -- Set difference on keys
    SELECT carrier
    FROM with_windows
    EXCEPT DISTINCT
    SELECT carrier
    FROM shipments
    WHERE order_id IN (1, 14)
),
kept_rows AS (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    SELECT s.*
    FROM with_windows s
    JOIN kept_keys k ON s.carrier = k.carrier
),
joined AS (
    -- Attach orders attributes
    SELECT a.*, p.order_date
    FROM kept_rows a
    LEFT JOIN orders p
        ON a.order_id = p.id
),
with_dims AS (
    -- Attach orders attributes
    SELECT
        s.*,
        p.order_date AS order_order_date,
        p.discount
    FROM joined s
    JOIN orders p
        ON s.order_id = p.id
)
-- Multi-level aggregation
SELECT
    CASE WHEN row_seq >= 8 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END AS row_seq_tier,
    ROUND(AVG(row_seq), 2) AS avg_row_seq,
    SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_SET(status)) AS status_list,
    PERCENTILE_APPROX(discount, 0.5) AS discount_p50,
    MAX(event_seq) FILTER (WHERE status = 'IN_TRANSIT') AS in_transit_max_event_seq
FROM with_dims
GROUP BY row_seq_tier
HAVING avg_row_seq >= 0;

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("status").orderBy("shipped_date_plus_months", "id")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("status").orderBy("shipped_date", "id")

cleaned = (
    df_shipments
    .filter((F.col("delivered_date") >= F.to_date(F.lit("2023-04-19"))) & F.col("order_id").isNotNull() & (F.col("order_id") == 8))
    .select(
        "id",
        "order_id",
        "carrier",
        "shipped_date",
        "delivered_date",
        "status",
        F.add_months("shipped_date", 6).alias("shipped_date_plus_months"),
        F.coalesce("carrier", F.lit("N/A")).alias("carrier_clean"),
    )
)

with_windows = (
    cleaned
    .select(
        "*",
        F.row_number().over(w).alias("row_seq"),
        F.row_number().over(w2).alias("event_seq"),
    )
)

kept_keys = (
    with_windows
    .select("carrier")
    .subtract(
        df_shipments
        .filter(F.col("order_id").isin([1, 14]))
        .select("carrier")
    )
)

kept_rows = (
    with_windows
    .alias("s")
    .join(kept_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.carrier") == F.col("k.carrier")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

joined = (
    kept_rows
    .alias("a")
    .join(df_orders.alias("p"), F.col("a.order_id") == F.col("p.id"), "left")
    .select("a.*", F.col("p.order_date"))
)

with_dims = (
    joined
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_orders.alias("p"), F.col("s.order_id") == F.col("p.id"), "inner")
    .select("s.*", F.col("p.order_date").alias("order_order_date"), F.col("p.discount"))
)

result = (
    with_dims
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("row_seq") >= 8, "HIGH").otherwise("LOW").alias("row_seq_tier"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.round(F.avg("row_seq"), 2).alias("avg_row_seq"),
        F.sort_array(F.collect_set("status")).alias("status_list"),
        F.percentile_approx("discount", 0.5).alias("discount_p50"),
        F.max(F.when(F.col("status") == "IN_TRANSIT", F.col("event_seq"))).alias("in_transit_max_event_seq"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("avg_row_seq") >= 0)
)

WITH valid AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        device_code,
        reading_ts,
        temp_c,
        humidity,
        pressure,
        status_bits,
        firmware,
        SUBSTRING(firmware, 1, 2) AS firmware_prefix
    FROM device_readings
    WHERE humidity > 60
),
metrics AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        SUM(humidity) OVER w_ordered AS running_humidity,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY temp_c DESC, id) AS row_seq,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY temp_c DESC) AS temp_c_dense_rank,
        NTILE(10) OVER (PARTITION BY device_code ORDER BY temp_c, id) AS temp_c_bucket
    FROM valid
    WINDOW w_ordered AS (ORDER BY temp_c, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)
),
metrics_device_readings AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        SUM(temp_c_bucket) OVER (PARTITION BY device_code ORDER BY CAST(reading_ts AS BIGINT) RANGE BETWEEN 3600 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS temp_c_bucket_sum_1h,
        AVG(humidity) OVER (PARTITION BY device_code ORDER BY status_bits, id ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS humidity_avg_2_prior,
        NTILE(3) OVER (PARTITION BY device_code ORDER BY temp_c DESC, id) AS temp_c_bucket_2,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY device_code ORDER BY humidity DESC NULLS LAST) AS humidity_rank,
        SUM(temp_c) OVER (PARTITION BY device_code ORDER BY reading_ts, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_temp_c
    FROM metrics
),
scored AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        device_code,
        reading_ts,
        temp_c,
        humidity,
        pressure,
        status_bits,
        firmware,
        firmware_prefix,
        running_humidity,
        row_seq,
        temp_c_dense_rank,
        temp_c_bucket,
        temp_c_bucket_sum_1h,
        humidity_avg_2_prior,
        temp_c_bucket_2,
        humidity_rank,
        cumulative_temp_c,
        LEAD(row_seq, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY device_code ORDER BY running_humidity, id) AS next_row_seq,
        MAX(status_bits) OVER (ORDER BY CAST(reading_ts AS BIGINT) RANGE BETWEEN 900 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS status_bits_max_15m
    FROM metrics_device_readings
)
SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('HOUR', reading_ts) AS hour_window,
    SUM(CASE WHEN device_code = 'DV-04' THEN humidity ELSE 0 END) AS dv_04_humidity,
    COUNT(DISTINCT id) AS distinct_ids,
    SUM(CASE WHEN device_code = 'DV-01' THEN temp_c_bucket_2 ELSE 0 END) AS dv_01_temp_c_bucket_2,
    MIN(reading_ts) AS started_at,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE device_code = 'DV-04') AS dv_04_rows
FROM scored
GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('HOUR', reading_ts)
ORDER BY dv_04_rows DESC

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w_ordered = Window.orderBy("temp_c", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w2 = Window.orderBy(F.col("temp_c").desc(), "id")
w3 = Window.orderBy(F.col("temp_c").desc())
w4 = Window.partitionBy("device_code").orderBy("temp_c", "id")
w5 = Window.partitionBy("device_code").orderBy(F.col("reading_ts").cast("bigint")).rangeBetween(-3600, Window.currentRow)
w6 = Window.partitionBy("device_code").orderBy("status_bits", "id").rowsBetween(-2, -1)
w7 = Window.partitionBy("device_code").orderBy(F.col("temp_c").desc(), "id")
w8 = Window.partitionBy("device_code").orderBy(F.col("humidity").desc_nulls_last())
w9 = Window.partitionBy("device_code").orderBy("reading_ts", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w10 = Window.partitionBy("device_code").orderBy("running_humidity", "id")
w11 = Window.orderBy(F.col("reading_ts").cast("bigint")).rangeBetween(-900, Window.currentRow)

valid = (
    df_device_readings
    .filter(F.col("humidity") > 60)
    .select(
        "id",
        "device_code",
        "reading_ts",
        "temp_c",
        "humidity",
        "pressure",
        "status_bits",
        "firmware",
        F.substring("firmware", 1, 2).alias("firmware_prefix"),
    )
)

metrics = (
    valid
    .withColumn("running_humidity", F.sum("humidity").over(w_ordered))
    .withColumn("row_seq", F.row_number().over(w2))
    .withColumn("temp_c_dense_rank", F.dense_rank().over(w3))
    .withColumn("temp_c_bucket", F.ntile(10).over(w4))
)

metrics_device_readings = (
    metrics
    .select(
        "*",
        F.sum("temp_c_bucket").over(w5).alias("temp_c_bucket_sum_1h"),
        F.avg("humidity").over(w6).alias("humidity_avg_2_prior"),
        F.ntile(3).over(w7).alias("temp_c_bucket_2"),
        F.rank().over(w8).alias("humidity_rank"),
        F.sum("temp_c").over(w9).alias("cumulative_temp_c"),
    )
)

scored = (
    metrics_device_readings
    .withColumn("next_row_seq", F.lead("row_seq", 1).over(w10))
    .withColumn("status_bits_max_15m", F.max("status_bits").over(w11))
)

result = (
    scored
    .groupBy(F.date_trunc("HOUR", "reading_ts").alias("hour_window"))
    .agg(
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("device_code") == "DV-04", F.col("humidity")).otherwise(0)).alias("dv_04_humidity"),
        F.countDistinct("id").alias("distinct_ids"),
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("device_code") == "DV-01", F.col("temp_c_bucket_2")).otherwise(0)).alias("dv_01_temp_c_bucket_2"),
        F.min("reading_ts").alias("started_at"),
        F.count(F.when(F.col("device_code") == "DV-04", 1)).alias("dv_04_rows"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("dv_04_rows").desc())
)

with valid as (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    select
        id,
        store_name,
        region,
        opened_date,
        sqft,
        length(store_name) as store_name_length,
        coalesce(region, 'UNKNOWN') as region_filled
    from stores
    where region is not null
),
enriched as (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    select
        id,
        store_name,
        region,
        opened_date,
        sqft,
        store_name_length,
        region_filled,
        last_value(sqft, true) over (partition by region order by sqft, id rows between unbounded preceding and current row) as last_known_sqft,
        cume_dist() over (partition by region order by store_name_length) as store_name_length_cume_dist,
        row_number() over (partition by region order by sqft, id) as seq_no,
        avg(store_name_length) over (partition by region order by opened_date, id rows between 5 preceding and current row) as store_name_length_avg_5,
        lag(store_name_length, 2) over (partition by region order by sqft, id) as prev_store_name_length
    from valid
),
metrics as (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    select
        *,
        row_number() over (partition by region order by store_name_length, id) as seq_no_2,
        row_number() over w_grp as event_seq,
        stddev_samp(store_name_length_avg_5) over (partition by region) as region_stddev_samp_store_name_length_avg_5
    from enriched
    window w_grp as (partition by region order by store_name_length_avg_5, id)
),
base as (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    select *, seq_no / nullif(store_name_length_avg_5, 0) as seq_no_per_store_name_length_avg_5
    from metrics
    where region is not null
      and seq_no_2 is not null
),
totals as (
    -- Aggregate with conditional metrics
    select
        date_trunc('year', opened_date) as year_start,
        case when seq_no_2 >= 9 then 'PREMIUM' else 'STANDARD' end as seq_no_2_tier,
        approx_percentile(region_stddev_samp_store_name_length_avg_5, array(0.25, 0.5, 0.75)) as region_stddev_samp_store_name_length_avg_5_quartiles,
        count(*) as cnt,
        bit_and(sqft) as sqft_bit_and,
        bit_and(sqft) as sqft_bit_and_2,
        round(sum(sqft) / nullif(count(case when region = 'North' then 1 end), 0), 2) as sqft_per_north
    from base
    group by date_trunc('year', opened_date), case when seq_no_2 >= 9 then 'PREMIUM' else 'STANDARD' end
    having sqft_bit_and_2 >= 1
)
select
    year_start,
    seq_no_2_tier,
    region_stddev_samp_store_name_length_avg_5_quartiles,
    sqft_bit_and,
    sqft_bit_and_2,
    sqft_per_north
from totals
order by sqft_bit_and desc;

w = Window.partitionBy("region").orderBy("sqft", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)

w3 = Window.partitionBy("region").orderBy("sqft", "id")
w4 = Window.partitionBy("region").orderBy("opened_date", "id").rowsBetween(-5, Window.currentRow)
w5 = Window.partitionBy("region").orderBy("store_name_length", "id")
w_grp = Window.partitionBy("region").orderBy("store_name_length_avg_5", "id")
w7 = Window.partitionBy("region")

valid = (
    df_stores
    .filter(F.col("region").isNotNull())
    .select(
        "id",
        "store_name",
        "region",
        "opened_date",
        "sqft",
        F.length("store_name").alias("store_name_length"),
        F.coalesce("region", F.lit("UNKNOWN")).alias("region_filled"),
    )
)

enriched = (
    valid
    .withColumn("last_known_sqft", F.last("sqft", ignorenulls=True).over(w))
    .withColumn("store_name_length_cume_dist", F.cume_dist().over(w2))
    .withColumn("seq_no", F.row_number().over(w3))

    .withColumn("prev_store_name_length", F.lag("store_name_length", 2).over(w3))
)

metrics = (
    enriched
    .select(
        "*",
        F.row_number().over(w5).alias("seq_no_2"),
        F.row_number().over(w_grp).alias("event_seq"),
        F.stddev_samp("store_name_length_avg_5").over(w7).alias("region_stddev_samp_store_name_length_avg_5"),
    )

    )
)

totals = (

    .groupBy(

WITH cleaned AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT
        id,
        session_id,
        event_type,
        page,
        duration_sec,
        CASE WHEN page IN ('/checkout', '/product') THEN 'Tier 1' ELSE 'Other' END AS page_group
    FROM web_events
    WHERE event_time >= TIMESTAMP '2023-12-28 17:00:00'
      AND page IS NOT NULL
      AND duration_sec BETWEEN 136 AND 430
),
enriched AS (
    -- Attach sessions attributes
    SELECT
        a.*,
        p.device,
        p.country
    FROM cleaned a
    LEFT JOIN sessions p
        ON a.session_id = p.id
),
with_windows AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        *,
        NTILE(3) OVER (PARTITION BY session_id, page ORDER BY duration_sec DESC, id) AS duration_sec_bucket,
        FIRST_VALUE(page, TRUE) OVER (PARTITION BY event_type ORDER BY duration_sec, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS first_known_page
    FROM enriched
),
kept_keys AS (
    -- Set intersection on keys
    SELECT id
    FROM with_windows
    INTERSECT
    SELECT id
    FROM web_events
    WHERE duration_sec IS NULL
),
verified AS (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    SELECT s.*
    FROM with_windows s
    INNER JOIN kept_keys k ON s.id = k.id
),
summary AS (
    -- Grouped metrics
    SELECT
        CASE WHEN duration_sec >= 449 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END AS duration_sec_tier,
        CASE WHEN duration_sec_bucket >= 7 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END AS duration_sec_bucket_tier,
        SUM(CASE WHEN device = 'mobile' THEN duration_sec ELSE 0 END) AS mobile_duration_sec,
        AVG(duration_sec_bucket) AS avg_duration_sec_bucket,
        ROUND(AVG(duration_sec), 2) AS avg_duration_sec,
        COUNT(*) AS row_count,
        SIZE(COLLECT_SET(device)) AS num_devices,
        APPROX_PERCENTILE(duration_sec_bucket, ARRAY(0.25, 0.5, 0.75)) AS duration_sec_bucket_quartiles
    FROM verified
    GROUP BY CASE WHEN duration_sec >= 449 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END, CASE WHEN duration_sec_bucket >= 7 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END
    HAVING num_devices > 1
)
SELECT
    duration_sec_tier,
    duration_sec_bucket_tier,
    avg_duration_sec_bucket,
    avg_duration_sec,
    row_count
FROM summary
ORDER BY avg_duration_sec DESC NULLS LAST, avg_duration_sec_bucket;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("session_id", "page").orderBy(F.col("duration_sec").desc(), "id")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("event_type").orderBy("duration_sec", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)

cleaned = (
    df_web_events
    .filter((F.col("event_time") >= F.lit("2023-12-28 17:00:00").cast("timestamp")) & F.col("page").isNotNull() & F.col("duration_sec").between(136, 430))
    .select(
        "id",
        "session_id",
        "event_type",
        "page",
        "duration_sec",
        F.when(F.col("page").isin(["/checkout", "/product"]), "Tier 1").otherwise("Other").alias("page_group"),
    )
)

enriched = (
    cleaned
    .alias("a")
    .join(df_sessions.alias("p"), F.col("a.session_id") == F.col("p.id"), "left")
    .select("a.*", F.col("p.device"), F.col("p.country"))
)

with_windows = (
    enriched
    .withColumn("duration_sec_bucket", F.ntile(3).over(w))
    .withColumn("first_known_page", F.first("page", ignorenulls=True).over(w2))
)

kept_keys = (
    with_windows
    .select("id")
    .intersect(
        df_web_events
        .filter(F.col("duration_sec").isNull())
        .select("id")
    )
)

verified = (
    with_windows
    .alias("s")
    .join(kept_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.id") == F.col("k.id")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

summary = (
    verified
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("duration_sec") >= 449, "LARGE").otherwise("SMALL").alias("duration_sec_tier"),
        F.when(F.col("duration_sec_bucket") >= 7, "LARGE").otherwise("SMALL").alias("duration_sec_bucket_tier"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("device") == "mobile", F.col("duration_sec")).otherwise(0)).alias("mobile_duration_sec"),
        F.avg("duration_sec_bucket").alias("avg_duration_sec_bucket"),
        F.round(F.avg("duration_sec"), 2).alias("avg_duration_sec"),
        F.count("*").alias("row_count"),
        F.size(F.collect_set("device")).alias("num_devices"),
        F.percentile_approx("duration_sec_bucket", [0.25, 0.5, 0.75]).alias("duration_sec_bucket_quartiles"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("num_devices") > 1)
)

result = (
    summary
    .select(
        "duration_sec_tier",
        "duration_sec_bucket_tier",
        "avg_duration_sec_bucket",
        "avg_duration_sec",
        "row_count",
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("avg_duration_sec").desc_nulls_last(), "avg_duration_sec_bucket")
)

WITH cleaned AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT
        id,
        order_id,
        carrier,
        shipped_date,
        delivered_date,
        DATE_TRUNC('WEEK', shipped_date) AS shipped_date_period,
        COALESCE(carrier, 'NONE') AS resolved_carrier
    FROM shipments
    WHERE shipped_date >= TO_DATE('2023-10-15')
      AND carrier IN ('Flash', 'UPS', 'DHL')
),
enriched AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        *,
        FIRST_VALUE(carrier, TRUE) OVER w_ordered AS first_known_carrier,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY carrier ORDER BY delivered_date, id) AS event_seq,
        LAST_VALUE(carrier) IGNORE NULLS OVER w_recent AS last_known_carrier
    FROM cleaned
    WINDOW w_ordered AS (PARTITION BY carrier, order_id ORDER BY delivered_date, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), w_recent AS (PARTITION BY order_id, carrier ORDER BY shipped_date, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)
),
enriched_shipments AS (
    -- Attach orders attributes
    SELECT
        src.*,
        b.amount,
        b.status,
        b.discount
    FROM enriched src
    LEFT JOIN orders b
        ON src.order_id = b.id
),
cleaned_shipments AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        id,
        order_id,
        carrier,
        shipped_date,
        shipped_date_period,
        first_known_carrier,
        event_seq,
        amount,
        status,
        discount,
        INITCAP(TRIM(carrier)) AS carrier_title
    FROM enriched_shipments
    WHERE order_id IS NOT NULL
)
-- Multi-level aggregation
SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('QUARTER', shipped_date) AS quarter_start,
    CASE WHEN event_seq >= 8 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END AS event_seq_tier,
    COUNT(*) AS event_count,
    ROUND(AVG(amount), 2) AS avg_amount,
    SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'CANCELLED' THEN event_seq ELSE 0 END) AS cancelled_event_seq
FROM cleaned_shipments
GROUP BY 1, 2;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w_ordered = Window.partitionBy("carrier", "order_id").orderBy("delivered_date", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w2 = Window.partitionBy("carrier").orderBy("delivered_date", "id")
w_recent = Window.partitionBy("order_id", "carrier").orderBy("shipped_date", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)

cleaned = (
    df_shipments
    .filter((F.col("shipped_date") >= F.to_date(F.lit("2023-10-15"))) & F.col("carrier").isin(["Flash", "UPS", "DHL"]))
    .select(
        "id",
        "order_id",
        "carrier",
        "shipped_date",
        "delivered_date",
        F.date_trunc("WEEK", "shipped_date").alias("shipped_date_period"),
        F.coalesce("carrier", F.lit("NONE")).alias("resolved_carrier"),
    )
)

enriched = (
    cleaned
    .withColumn("first_known_carrier", F.first("carrier", ignorenulls=True).over(w_ordered))
    .withColumn("event_seq", F.row_number().over(w2))
    .withColumn("last_known_carrier", F.last("carrier", ignorenulls=True).over(w_recent))
)

enriched_shipments = (
    enriched
    .alias("src")
    .join(df_orders.alias("b"), F.col("src.order_id") == F.col("b.id"), "left")
    .select("src.*", F.col("b.amount"), F.col("b.status"), F.col("b.discount"))
)

cleaned_shipments = (
    enriched_shipments
    .filter(F.col("order_id").isNotNull())
    .select(
        "id",
        "order_id",
        "carrier",
        "shipped_date",
        "shipped_date_period",
        "first_known_carrier",
        "event_seq",
        "amount",
        "status",
        "discount",
        F.initcap(F.trim("carrier")).alias("carrier_title"),
    )
)

result = (
    cleaned_shipments
    .groupBy(
        F.date_trunc("QUARTER", "shipped_date").alias("quarter_start"),
        F.when(F.col("event_seq") >= 8, "HIGH").otherwise("LOW").alias("event_seq_tier"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.count("*").alias("event_count"),
        F.round(F.avg("amount"), 2).alias("avg_amount"),
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("status") == "CANCELLED", F.col("event_seq")).otherwise(0)).alias("cancelled_event_seq"),
    )
)

WITH filtered AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT
        id,
        txn_type,
        amount,
        txn_time,
        merchant,
        is_flagged,
        CAST(txn_time AS DATE) AS txn_time_day,
        FLOOR(amount) AS amount_whole
    FROM transactions
    WHERE txn_time > TIMESTAMP '2023-10-25 04:00:00'
      AND txn_type = 'CREDIT'
),
gaps AS (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > interval)
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN txn_time - LAG(txn_time) OVER (PARTITION BY merchant ORDER BY txn_time, id) > INTERVAL '14' DAY THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS new_group_flag
    FROM filtered
),
sessionized AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(new_group_flag) OVER (PARTITION BY merchant ORDER BY txn_time, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_no
    FROM gaps
),
scored AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        *,
        AVG(amount_whole) OVER (PARTITION BY merchant ORDER BY txn_time, id ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS amount_whole_avg_6_prior,
        ROUND(amount / SUM(amount) OVER (PARTITION BY txn_type, merchant), 4) AS amount_share,
        NTILE(10) OVER (PARTITION BY txn_type ORDER BY new_group_flag, id) AS new_group_flag_bucket
    FROM sessionized
),
cleaned AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT
        *,
        QUARTER(txn_time) AS txn_time_quarter,
        ADD_MONTHS(txn_time_day, 3) AS txn_time_day_plus_months,
        COALESCE(merchant, 'N/A') AS merchant_clean
    FROM scored
    WHERE merchant IS NOT NULL
),
metrics AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        *,
        NTILE(10) OVER (PARTITION BY txn_type ORDER BY amount DESC, id) AS amount_bucket,
        AVG(txn_time_quarter) OVER (PARTITION BY txn_type ORDER BY CAST(txn_time AS BIGINT) RANGE BETWEEN 7776000 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS txn_time_quarter_avg_90d,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY txn_type, merchant ORDER BY new_group_flag_bucket, id) AS seq_no,
        SUM(amount_share) OVER (PARTITION BY txn_type, merchant ORDER BY amount, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_amount_share
    FROM cleaned
),
latest AS (
    -- QUALIFY-style window filter
    SELECT *
    FROM metrics
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY txn_type ORDER BY txn_time_quarter_avg_90d NULLS LAST, id) = 1
)
-- Native SQL PIVOT
SELECT *
FROM (
    SELECT
        merchant,
        txn_type,
        amount
    FROM latest
) src
PIVOT (
    MAX(amount) AS value_sum,
    COUNT(1) AS cnt
    FOR txn_type IN ('FEE' AS fee, 'CREDIT' AS credit, 'REFUND' AS refund)
);

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("merchant").orderBy("txn_time", "id")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("merchant").orderBy("txn_time", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w3 = Window.partitionBy("merchant").orderBy("txn_time", "id").rowsBetween(-6, -1)
w4 = Window.partitionBy("txn_type", "merchant")
w5 = Window.partitionBy("txn_type").orderBy("new_group_flag", "id")
w6 = Window.partitionBy("txn_type").orderBy(F.col("amount").desc(), "id")
w7 = Window.partitionBy("txn_type").orderBy(F.col("txn_time").cast("bigint")).rangeBetween(-7776000, Window.currentRow)
w8 = Window.partitionBy("txn_type", "merchant").orderBy("new_group_flag_bucket", "id")
w9 = Window.partitionBy("txn_type", "merchant").orderBy("amount", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w10 = Window.partitionBy("txn_type").orderBy(F.col("txn_time_quarter_avg_90d").asc_nulls_last(), "id")

filtered = (
    df_transactions
    .filter((F.col("txn_time") > F.lit("2023-10-25 04:00:00").cast("timestamp")) & (F.col("txn_type") == "CREDIT"))
    .select(
        "id",
        "txn_type",
        "amount",
        "txn_time",
        "merchant",
        "is_flagged",
        F.col("txn_time").cast("date").alias("txn_time_day"),
        F.floor("amount").alias("amount_whole"),
    )
)

gaps = (
    filtered
    .withColumn("new_group_flag", F.when(F.col("txn_time") - F.lag("txn_time").over(w) > F.expr("INTERVAL 14 DAYS"), 1).otherwise(0))
)

sessionized = gaps.withColumn("session_no", F.sum("new_group_flag").over(w2))

scored = (
    sessionized
    .select(
        "*",
        F.avg("amount_whole").over(w3).alias("amount_whole_avg_6_prior"),
        F.round((F.col("amount") / F.sum("amount").over(w4)), 4).alias("amount_share"),
        F.ntile(10).over(w5).alias("new_group_flag_bucket"),
    )
)

cleaned = (
    scored
    .filter(F.col("merchant").isNotNull())
    .select(
        "*",
        F.quarter("txn_time").alias("txn_time_quarter"),
        F.add_months("txn_time_day", 3).alias("txn_time_day_plus_months"),
        F.coalesce("merchant", F.lit("N/A")).alias("merchant_clean"),
    )
)

metrics = (
    cleaned
    .withColumn("amount_bucket", F.ntile(10).over(w6))
    .withColumn("txn_time_quarter_avg_90d", F.avg("txn_time_quarter").over(w7))
    .withColumn("seq_no", F.row_number().over(w8))
    .withColumn("running_amount_share", F.sum("amount_share").over(w9))
)

latest = (
    metrics
    .withColumn("dedup_rank", F.row_number().over(w10))
    .filter(F.col("dedup_rank") == 1)
    .drop("dedup_rank")
)

result = (
    latest
    .groupBy("merchant")
    .pivot("txn_type", ["FEE", "CREDIT", "REFUND"])
    .agg(F.max("amount").alias("value_sum"), F.count(F.lit(1)).alias("cnt"))
    .select(
        "merchant",
        F.col("FEE_value_sum").alias("fee_value_sum"),
        F.col("FEE_cnt").alias("fee_cnt"),
        F.col("CREDIT_value_sum").alias("credit_value_sum"),
        F.col("CREDIT_cnt").alias("credit_cnt"),
        F.col("REFUND_value_sum").alias("refund_value_sum"),
        F.col("REFUND_cnt").alias("refund_cnt"),
    )
)

WITH flattened_attrs AS (
    -- Higher-order array functions
    SELECT
        id,
        effective_from,
        currency,
        tier_prices,
        ELEMENT_AT(tier_prices, 1) AS entry_price,
        TRANSFORM(tier_prices, (p, i) -> ROUND(p * tier_limits[i], 2)) AS tier_revenue_caps,
        ZIP_WITH(tier_prices, discounts, (p, d) -> ROUND(p * (1 - d), 2)) AS net_prices,
        AGGREGATE(tier_prices, 0.0D, (acc, p) -> acc + p, acc -> ROUND(acc / SIZE(tier_prices), 2)) AS avg_tier_price
    FROM price_tiers
)
-- Grouped metrics
SELECT
    CASE WHEN entry_price >= 35 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END AS entry_price_tier,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE currency = 'THB') AS thb_rows,
    SIZE(COLLECT_SET(currency)) AS num_currencies,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE currency = 'USD') AS usd_rows,
    GROUPING_ID() AS grouping_level
FROM flattened_attrs
GROUP BY ROLLUP (CASE WHEN entry_price >= 35 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END);

    FROM transactions
),
sessions_transactions AS (

    FROM flagged
),
valid AS (

    FROM sessions_transactions
    WHERE txn_time >= DATE '2024-02-23'
),

    FROM valid
    QUALIFY latest_rank = 1
),
with_windows AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        SUM(session_id) OVER (PARTITION BY txn_type, account_id ORDER BY amount, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_session_id,
        SUM(amount_per_session_id) OVER (PARTITION BY merchant ORDER BY CAST(txn_time AS BIGINT) RANGE BETWEEN 2592000 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS amount_per_session_id_sum_30d
    FROM deduped
)
SELECT
    s.id,
    s.account_id,
    s.txn_type,
    s.amount,
    s.merchant,
    s.is_flagged,
    s.is_new_burst,
    s.session_id,
    s.amount_per_session_id,
    CASE WHEN merchant RLIKE '^(Grab|7-Eleven)$' THEN 'GROUP_A' ELSE 'GROUP_B' END AS merchant_zone,
    (SELECT MIN(t2.amount) FROM transactions t2 WHERE t2.account_id = s.account_id) AS min_transaction_amount
FROM with_windows s;

WITH lines AS (
    -- Unnest the array into one row per element
    SELECT
        id,
        service,
        latency_ms,
        status_code,
        k,
        attr_value
    FROM app_logs
    LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(context) e AS k, attr_value
),
flattened_attrs AS (
    -- Struct fields, map lookups and JSON extraction
    SELECT
        id,
        status_code,
        k,
        SHIFTRIGHT(status_code, 2) AS status_code_high,
        CAST((status_code & 2) != 0 AS INT) AS is_flagged
    FROM lines
    WHERE status_code BETWEEN 393 AND 413
),
enriched AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        *,
        NTILE(3) OVER (PARTITION BY k ORDER BY is_flagged, id, k) AS is_flagged_bucket,
        LAG(status_code_high, 1) OVER (ORDER BY is_flagged, id, k) AS prev_status_code_high,
        CUME_DIST() OVER (ORDER BY status_code_high) AS status_code_high_cume_dist,
        ROUND(status_code / SUM(status_code) OVER (PARTITION BY k), 4) AS status_code_share
    FROM flattened_attrs
),
with_windows AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        id,
        status_code,
        k,
        status_code_high,
        is_flagged,
        is_flagged_bucket,
        prev_status_code_high,
        status_code_high_cume_dist,
        status_code_share,
        SUM(is_flagged) OVER w_ordered AS cumulative_is_flagged,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY k ORDER BY is_flagged, id, k) AS event_seq
    FROM enriched
    WINDOW w_ordered AS (PARTITION BY k ORDER BY is_flagged_bucket, id, k ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)
),
totals AS (
    -- Aggregate with conditional metrics
    SELECT
        k,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN k = 'version' THEN 1 END) AS version_count,
        SUM(status_code) FILTER (WHERE k = 'version') AS version_total_status_code
    FROM with_windows
    GROUP BY k
)
SELECT
    k,
    version_count,
    version_total_status_code
FROM totals
ORDER BY k DESC NULLS LAST, version_count
LIMIT 5;

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("k").orderBy("is_flagged", "id", "k")
w2 = Window.orderBy("is_flagged", "id", "k")
w3 = Window.orderBy("status_code_high")
w4 = Window.partitionBy("k")
w_ordered = Window.partitionBy("k").orderBy("is_flagged_bucket", "id", "k").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)

lines = (
    df_app_logs
    .select(
        "id",
        "service",
        "latency_ms",
        "status_code",
        F.explode("context").alias("k", "attr_value"),
    )
)

flattened_attrs = (
    lines
    .filter(F.col("status_code").between(393, 413))
    .select(
        "id",
        "status_code",
        "k",
        F.shiftright("status_code", 2).alias("status_code_high"),
        (F.col("status_code").bitwiseAND(2) != 0).cast("int").alias("is_flagged"),
    )
)

enriched = (
    flattened_attrs
    .select(
        "*",
        F.ntile(3).over(w).alias("is_flagged_bucket"),
        F.lag("status_code_high", 1).over(w2).alias("prev_status_code_high"),
        F.cume_dist().over(w3).alias("status_code_high_cume_dist"),
        F.round((F.col("status_code") / F.sum("status_code").over(w4)), 4).alias("status_code_share"),
    )
)

with_windows = (
    enriched
    .select(
        "*",
        F.sum("is_flagged").over(w_ordered).alias("cumulative_is_flagged"),
        F.row_number().over(w).alias("event_seq"),
    )
)

totals = (
    with_windows
    .groupBy("k")
    .agg(
        F.count(F.when(F.col("k") == "version", 1)).alias("version_count"),
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("k") == "version", F.col("status_code"))).alias("version_total_status_code"),
    )
)

result = (
    totals
    .select("k", "version_count", "version_total_status_code")
    .orderBy(F.col("k").desc_nulls_last(), "version_count")
