WITH latest AS (
    -- Keep one row per key (latest first)
    SELECT *
    FROM shipments
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY status, order_id ORDER BY cost, id) = 1
),
enriched AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        *,
        NTILE(3) OVER (PARTITION BY status, order_id ORDER BY cost, id) cost_bucket,
        LAST_VALUE(cost, TRUE) OVER (PARTITION BY carrier, status ORDER BY cost, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) last_known_cost
    FROM latest
),
enriched_shipments AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        *,
        NTILE(5) OVER (PARTITION BY order_id ORDER BY last_known_cost, id) last_known_cost_bucket,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY shipped_date, id) row_seq,
        SUM(cost) OVER (PARTITION BY order_id ORDER BY cost_bucket, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) cumulative_cost,
        LEAD(cost_bucket, 1) OVER (ORDER BY cost_bucket, id) next_cost_bucket,
        NTILE(3) OVER (PARTITION BY status ORDER BY cost_bucket DESC, id) cost_bucket_bucket
    FROM enriched
),
valid AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT
        id,
        order_id,
        carrier,
        shipped_date,
        delivered_date,
        cost,
        status,
        cost_bucket,
        last_known_cost,
        last_known_cost_bucket,
        cumulative_cost,
        next_cost_bucket,
        cost * cost_bucket cost_times_cost_bucket,
        COALESCE(carrier, 'NONE') carrier_clean
    FROM enriched_shipments
    WHERE cost > 69
)
SELECT
    id,
    order_id,
    carrier,
    shipped_date,
    delivered_date,
    cost_bucket,
    last_known_cost,
    last_known_cost_bucket,
    cumulative_cost
FROM valid
ORDER BY id DESC;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("status", "order_id").orderBy("cost", "id")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("carrier", "status").orderBy("cost", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w3 = Window.partitionBy("order_id").orderBy("last_known_cost", "id")
w4 = Window.orderBy("shipped_date", "id")
w5 = Window.partitionBy("order_id").orderBy("cost_bucket", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w6 = Window.orderBy("cost_bucket", "id")
w7 = Window.partitionBy("status").orderBy(F.col("cost_bucket").desc(), "id")

latest = (
    df_shipments
    .withColumn("dedup_rank", F.row_number().over(w))
    .filter(F.col("dedup_rank") == 1)
    .drop("dedup_rank")
)

enriched = (
    latest
    .withColumn("cost_bucket", F.ntile(3).over(w))
    .withColumn("last_known_cost", F.last("cost", ignorenulls=True).over(w2))
)

enriched_shipments = (
    enriched
    .withColumn("last_known_cost_bucket", F.ntile(5).over(w3))
    .withColumn("row_seq", F.row_number().over(w4))
    .withColumn("cumulative_cost", F.sum("cost").over(w5))
    .withColumn("next_cost_bucket", F.lead("cost_bucket", 1).over(w6))
    .withColumn("cost_bucket_bucket", F.ntile(3).over(w7))
)

valid = (
    enriched_shipments
    .filter(F.col("cost") > 69)
    .select(
        "id",
        "order_id",
        "carrier",
        "shipped_date",
        "delivered_date",
        "cost",
        "status",
        "cost_bucket",
        "last_known_cost",
        "last_known_cost_bucket",
        "cumulative_cost",
        "next_cost_bucket",
        (F.col("cost") * F.col("cost_bucket")).alias("cost_times_cost_bucket"),
        F.coalesce("carrier", F.lit("NONE")).alias("carrier_clean"),
    )
)

result = (
    valid
    .select(
        "id",
        "order_id",
        "carrier",
        "shipped_date",
        "delivered_date",
        "cost_bucket",
        "last_known_cost",
        "last_known_cost_bucket",
        "cumulative_cost",
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("id").desc())
)

WITH not_flagged AS (
    SELECT s.*
    FROM suppliers s
    WHERE EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM products ch
            WHERE ch.supplier_id = s.id
              AND ch.brand NOT IN ('Acme', 'Globex')
        )
),
with_latest AS (
    SELECT
        s.*,
        top1.stock_qty,
        top1.product_price
    FROM not_flagged s
    JOIN LATERAL (
            SELECT c.stock_qty, c.price AS product_price
            FROM products c
            WHERE c.supplier_id = s.id
            ORDER BY c.price DESC, c.id DESC
            LIMIT 1
        ) top1 ON TRUE
),
enriched AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        supplier_name,
        country,
        city,
        rating,
        stock_qty,
        product_price,
        SUM(product_price) OVER (PARTITION BY city ORDER BY product_price, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_product_price,
        MAX(stock_qty) OVER (PARTITION BY country) AS country_max_stock_qty,
        FIRST_VALUE(city, TRUE) OVER (ORDER BY rating, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS first_known_city
    FROM with_latest
)
SELECT
    id,
    city,
    product_price,
    cumulative_product_price,
    country_max_stock_qty
FROM enriched;

from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy(F.col("s.id")).orderBy(F.col("c.price").desc(), F.col("c.id").desc())
w2 = Window.partitionBy("city").orderBy("product_price", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w3 = Window.partitionBy("country")
w4 = Window.orderBy("rating", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)

not_flagged = (
    df_suppliers
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_products.alias("ch"), (F.col("ch.supplier_id") == F.col("s.id")) & (~F.col("ch.brand").isin(["Acme", "Globex"])), "left_semi")
)

    .alias("s")
    .join(df_products.alias("c"), (F.col("c.supplier_id") == F.col("s.id")), "inner")
    .withColumn("rn", F.row_number().over(w))
    .filter(F.col("rn") == 1)
    .select("s.*", F.col("c.stock_qty"), F.col("c.price").alias("product_price"))
)

enriched = (
    with_latest
    .withColumn("cumulative_product_price", F.sum("product_price").over(w2))
    .withColumn("country_max_stock_qty", F.max("stock_qty").over(w3))

)

result = (

        "city",
        "product_price",
        "cumulative_product_price",

with matched_keys as (
    -- Set intersection on keys
    select id, product_id
    from order_items
    intersect
    select id, product_id
    from order_items
    where unit_price > 130
),
kept_rows as (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    select s.*
    from order_items s
    inner join matched_keys k on s.id = k.id and s.product_id = k.product_id
),
enriched as (
    -- Attach orders attributes
    select e.*, o.shipping_fee
    from kept_rows e
    left join orders o
        on e.order_id = o.id
),
enriched_order_items as (
    -- Attach products attributes
    select
        a.*,
        d.brand,
        d.category
    from enriched a
    left join products d
        on a.product_id = d.id
),
filtered as (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    select
        *,
        round(quantity * 1.1, 2) as adjusted_quantity,
        coalesce(brand, 'UNKNOWN') as brand_clean
    from enriched_order_items
    where product_id is not null
),
matched_keys_2 as (
    -- Set difference on keys
    select product_id, order_id
    from filtered
    except
    select product_id, order_id
    from order_items
    where unit_price between 230 and 340
),
kept_rows_order_items as (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    select s.*
    from filtered s
    inner join matched_keys_2 k on s.product_id = k.product_id and s.order_id = k.order_id
),
joined as (
    -- Attach orders attributes
    select
        a.*,
        b.status,
        b.amount
    from kept_rows_order_items a
    left join orders b
        on a.order_id = b.id
)
-- Aggregate with conditional metrics
select
    case when adjusted_quantity >= 62 then 'PREMIUM' else 'STANDARD' end as adjusted_quantity_tier,
    brand,
    stddev_samp(quantity) as quantity_stddev,
    sum(case when category = 'Fashion' then unit_price else 0 end) as fashion_unit_price,
    sum(quantity) filter (where status = 'SHIPPED') as shipped_total_quantity,
    round(sum(shipping_fee) / nullif(count(case when brand = 'Stark' then 1 end), 0), 2) as shipping_fee_per_stark,
    sum(shipping_fee) as total_shipping_fee,
    grouping_id() as gid
from joined
group by rollup (case when adjusted_quantity >= 62 then 'PREMIUM' else 'STANDARD' end, brand)
order by brand

from pyspark.sql import functions as F

matched_keys = (
    df_order_items
    .select("id", "product_id")
    .intersect(
        df_order_items
        .filter(F.col("unit_price") > 130)
        .select("id", "product_id")
    )
)

kept_rows = (
    df_order_items
    .alias("s")
    .join(matched_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.id") == F.col("k.id")) & (F.col("s.product_id") == F.col("k.product_id")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

enriched = (
    kept_rows
    .alias("e")
    .join(df_orders.alias("o"), F.col("e.order_id") == F.col("o.id"), "left")
    .select("e.*", F.col("o.shipping_fee"))
)

enriched_order_items = (
    enriched
    .alias("a")
    .join(df_products.alias("d"), F.col("a.product_id") == F.col("d.id"), "left")
    .select("a.*", F.col("d.brand"), F.col("d.category"))
)

filtered = (
    enriched_order_items
    .filter(F.col("product_id").isNotNull())
    .select(
        "*",
        F.round((F.col("quantity") * 1.1), 2).alias("adjusted_quantity"),
        F.coalesce("brand", F.lit("UNKNOWN")).alias("brand_clean"),
    )
)

matched_keys_2 = (
    filtered
    .select("product_id", "order_id")
    .subtract(
        df_order_items
        .filter(F.col("unit_price").between(230, 340))
        .select("product_id", "order_id")
    )
)

kept_rows_order_items = (
    filtered
    .alias("s")
    .join(matched_keys_2.alias("k"), (F.col("s.product_id") == F.col("k.product_id")) & (F.col("s.order_id") == F.col("k.order_id")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

joined = (
    kept_rows_order_items
    .alias("a")
    .join(df_orders.alias("b"), F.col("a.order_id") == F.col("b.id"), "left")
    .select("a.*", F.col("b.status"), F.col("b.amount"))
)

result = (
    joined
    .withColumn("adjusted_quantity_tier", F.when(F.col("adjusted_quantity") >= 62, "PREMIUM").otherwise("STANDARD"))
    .rollup("adjusted_quantity_tier", "brand")
    .agg(
        F.stddev_samp("quantity").alias("quantity_stddev"),
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("category") == "Fashion", F.col("unit_price")).otherwise(0)).alias("fashion_unit_price"),
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("status") == "SHIPPED", F.col("quantity"))).alias("shipped_total_quantity"),
        F.round(F.sum("shipping_fee") / F.nullif(F.count(F.when(F.col("brand") == "Stark", 1)), F.lit(0)), 2).alias("shipping_fee_per_stark"),
        F.sum("shipping_fee").alias("total_shipping_fee"),
        F.grouping_id().alias("gid"),
    )
    .orderBy("brand")
)

WITH prev_events AS (
    SELECT *, LAG(started_at) OVER (PARTITION BY browser ORDER BY started_at ASC, id ASC) AS prev_started_at
    FROM sessions
),
gaps AS (
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN prev_started_at IS NULL OR started_at > prev_started_at + INTERVAL '90' DAY THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS session_start_flag
    FROM prev_events
),
sessions_sessions AS (
    SELECT *, SUM(session_start_flag) OVER (PARTITION BY browser ORDER BY started_at ASC, id ASC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS burst_id
    FROM gaps
)
SELECT
    CASE WHEN session_start_flag >= 1 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END AS session_start_flag_tier,
    ROUND(AVG(session_start_flag), 2) AS avg_session_start_flag,
    APPROX_PERCENTILE(session_start_flag, 0.95) AS session_start_flag_p95,
    MAX(session_start_flag) AS max_session_start_flag,
    COUNT_IF(device = 'tablet') AS tablet_events,
    SIZE(COLLECT_SET(device)) AS num_devices
FROM sessions_sessions
GROUP BY CASE WHEN session_start_flag >= 1 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END;

WITH ranked AS (
    -- Deduplicate with ROW_NUMBER
    SELECT *
    FROM accounts
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY status ORDER BY balance DESC NULLS FIRST, id) = 1
),
base AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT *, LAST_DAY(opened_date) AS opened_date_month_end
    FROM ranked
    WHERE status IN ('CLOSED', 'OPEN')
),
with_dims AS (
    -- Attach customers attributes
    SELECT
        src.*,
        d.country,
        d.credit_limit,
        d.name
    FROM base src
    JOIN customers d
        ON src.customer_id = d.id
),
base_accounts AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT
        *,
        credit_limit + balance AS credit_limit_plus_balance,
        ADD_MONTHS(opened_date, 12) AS opened_date_plus_months
    FROM with_dims
    WHERE country IS NOT NULL
      AND balance >= 58000
),
kept AS (
    -- Anti-join via a correlated subquery
    SELECT s.*
    FROM base_accounts s
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM transactions ch
            WHERE ch.account_id = s.id
              AND ch.merchant = 'Grab'
        )
),
matched_keys AS (
    -- Set difference on keys
    SELECT customer_id
    FROM kept
    EXCEPT ALL
    SELECT customer_id
    FROM accounts
    WHERE customer_id IS NULL
),
verified AS (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    SELECT s.*
    FROM kept s
    JOIN matched_keys k ON s.customer_id = k.customer_id
)
-- Grouped metrics
SELECT
    CASE WHEN credit_limit_plus_balance >= 81 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END AS credit_limit_plus_balance_tier,
    DATE_TRUNC('WEEK', opened_date_month_end) AS week_start,
    ROUND(AVG(credit_limit), 2) AS avg_credit_limit,
    AVG(credit_limit) FILTER (WHERE country = 'SG') AS sg_avg_credit_limit,
    MIN(credit_limit_plus_balance) AS min_credit_limit_plus_balance,
    GROUPING_ID() AS grouping_level
FROM verified
GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((CASE WHEN credit_limit_plus_balance >= 81 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END, DATE_TRUNC('WEEK', opened_date_month_end)), (CASE WHEN credit_limit_plus_balance >= 81 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END))
ORDER BY credit_limit_plus_balance_tier

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("status").orderBy(F.col("balance").desc_nulls_first(), "id")

ranked = (
    df_accounts
    .withColumn("dedup_rank", F.row_number().over(w))
    .filter(F.col("dedup_rank") == 1)
    .drop("dedup_rank")
)

base = (
    ranked
    .filter(F.col("status").isin(["CLOSED", "OPEN"]))
    .withColumn("opened_date_month_end", F.last_day("opened_date"))
)

with_dims = (
    base
    .alias("src")
    .join(df_customers.alias("d"), F.col("src.customer_id") == F.col("d.id"), "inner")
    .select("src.*", F.col("d.country"), F.col("d.credit_limit"), F.col("d.name"))
)

base_accounts = (
    with_dims
    .filter(F.col("country").isNotNull() & (F.col("balance") >= 58000))
    .select(
        "*",
        (F.col("credit_limit") + F.col("balance")).alias("credit_limit_plus_balance"),
        F.add_months("opened_date", 12).alias("opened_date_plus_months"),
    )
)

kept = (
    base_accounts
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_transactions.alias("ch"), (F.col("ch.account_id") == F.col("s.id")) & (F.col("ch.merchant") == "Grab"), "left_anti")
)

matched_keys = (
    kept
    .select("customer_id")
    .exceptAll(
        df_accounts
        .filter(F.col("customer_id").isNull())
        .select("customer_id")
    )
)

verified = (
    kept
    .alias("s")
    .join(matched_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.customer_id") == F.col("k.customer_id")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

result = (
    verified
    .withColumn("credit_limit_plus_balance_tier", F.when(F.col("credit_limit_plus_balance") >= 81, "HIGH").otherwise("LOW"))
    .withColumn("week_start", F.date_trunc("WEEK", "opened_date_month_end"))
    .groupingSets(
        [["credit_limit_plus_balance_tier", "week_start"], ["credit_limit_plus_balance_tier"]],
        "credit_limit_plus_balance_tier",
        "week_start",
    )
    .agg(
        F.round(F.avg("credit_limit"), 2).alias("avg_credit_limit"),
        F.avg(F.when(F.col("country") == "SG", F.col("credit_limit"))).alias("sg_avg_credit_limit"),
        F.min("credit_limit_plus_balance").alias("min_credit_limit_plus_balance"),
        F.grouping_id().alias("grouping_level"),
    )
    .orderBy("credit_limit_plus_balance_tier")
)

        SUM(duration_sec) OVER (PARTITION BY session_id, event_type ORDER BY duration_sec, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) running_duration_sec,

    FROM filtered

WITH filtered AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        id,
        session_id,
        event_type,
        duration_sec,
        ROUND(duration_sec * 1.1, 2) AS duration_sec_adjusted,
        COALESCE(page, 'OTHER') AS resolved_page
    FROM web_events
    WHERE session_id IN (2, 8, 32)
),
enriched AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        *,
        MAX(duration_sec) OVER (PARTITION BY event_type) AS event_type_max_duration_sec,
        LEAD(duration_sec, 2) OVER (PARTITION BY session_id ORDER BY duration_sec, id) AS next_duration_sec
    FROM filtered
),
deduped AS (
    -- Deduplicate with ROW_NUMBER
    SELECT *
    FROM enriched
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY session_id ORDER BY duration_sec_adjusted DESC, id) = 1
),
deduped_web_events AS (
    -- Deduplicate with ROW_NUMBER
    SELECT *
    FROM (
        SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY session_id ORDER BY duration_sec DESC, id) AS latest_rank
        FROM deduped
    ) x
    WHERE latest_rank = 1
),
ranked AS (
    -- Keep one row per key (latest first)
    SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY event_type ORDER BY duration_sec_adjusted NULLS FIRST, id) AS dedup_rank
    FROM deduped_web_events
    QUALIFY dedup_rank = 1
),
scored AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        id,
        session_id,
        event_type,
        duration_sec,
        duration_sec_adjusted,
        resolved_page,
        event_type_max_duration_sec,
        next_duration_sec,
        latest_rank,
        dedup_rank,
        SUM(duration_sec) OVER (PARTITION BY session_id) AS session_id_sum_duration_sec,
        MIN(duration_sec) OVER (PARTITION BY session_id) AS session_id_min_duration_sec
    FROM ranked
),
remaining_keys AS (
    -- Set difference on keys
    SELECT session_id
    FROM scored
    EXCEPT ALL
    SELECT session_id
    FROM web_events
    WHERE event_type = 'search'
),
kept_rows AS (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    SELECT s.*
    FROM scored s
    JOIN remaining_keys k ON s.session_id = k.session_id
),
summary AS (
    -- Aggregate with conditional metrics
    SELECT
        CASE WHEN session_id_min_duration_sec >= 441 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END AS session_id_min_duration_sec_tier,
        SUM(CASE WHEN event_type = 'purchase' THEN duration_sec_adjusted ELSE 0 END) AS purchase_duration_sec_adjusted,
        COUNT(DISTINCT id) AS distinct_ids,
        SUM(CASE WHEN event_type = 'purchase' THEN duration_sec ELSE 0 END) AS purchase_duration_sec,
        PERCENTILE_APPROX(duration_sec_adjusted, ARRAY(0.25, 0.5, 0.75)) AS duration_sec_adjusted_quartiles
    FROM kept_rows
    GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT
    session_id_min_duration_sec_tier,
    purchase_duration_sec_adjusted,
    distinct_ids,
    purchase_duration_sec,
    duration_sec_adjusted_quartiles
FROM summary
ORDER BY purchase_duration_sec;

        F.round((F.col("duration_sec") * 1.1), 2).alias("duration_sec_adjusted"),
        F.coalesce("page", F.lit("OTHER")).alias("resolved_page"),
    )
)

enriched = (
    filtered
    .withColumn("event_type_max_duration_sec", F.max("duration_sec").over(w))
    .withColumn("next_duration_sec", F.lead("duration_sec", 2).over(w2))
)

deduped = (
    enriched
    .withColumn("row_num", F.row_number().over(w3))
    .filter(F.col("row_num") == 1)
    .drop("row_num")
)

deduped_web_events = (
    deduped
    .withColumn("latest_rank", F.row_number().over(w4))
    .filter(F.col("latest_rank") == 1)
)

ranked = (
    deduped_web_events
    .withColumn("dedup_rank", F.row_number().over(w5))
    .filter(F.col("dedup_rank") == 1)
)

scored = (
    ranked
    .select(
        "*",
        F.sum("duration_sec").over(w6).alias("session_id_sum_duration_sec"),
        F.min("duration_sec").over(w6).alias("session_id_min_duration_sec"),
    )
)

remaining_keys = (
    scored
    .select("session_id")
    .exceptAll(
        df_web_events
        .filter(F.col("event_type") == "search")
        .select("session_id")
    )
)

kept_rows = (
    scored
    .alias("s")
    .join(remaining_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.session_id") == F.col("k.session_id")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

summary = (
    kept_rows
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("session_id_min_duration_sec") >= 441, "HIGH").otherwise("LOW").alias("session_id_min_duration_sec_tier"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("event_type") == "purchase", F.col("duration_sec_adjusted")).otherwise(0)).alias("purchase_duration_sec_adjusted"),
        F.countDistinct("id").alias("distinct_ids"),
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("event_type") == "purchase", F.col("duration_sec")).otherwise(0)).alias("purchase_duration_sec"),
        F.percentile_approx("duration_sec_adjusted", [0.25, 0.5, 0.75]).alias("duration_sec_adjusted_quartiles"),
    )
)

result = (
    summary
    .select(
        "session_id_min_duration_sec_tier",
        "purchase_duration_sec_adjusted",
        "distinct_ids",
        "purchase_duration_sec",
        "duration_sec_adjusted_quartiles",
    )
    .orderBy("purchase_duration_sec")
)

sql: SELECT CASE WHEN s.sqft >= 13463 THEN 'high' WHEN s.sqft >= 6366 THEN 'mid' ELSE 'low' END AS sqft_bucket, ROUND(AVG(o.amount), 2) AS avg_amount FROM orders o LEFT OUTER JOIN stores s ON o.store_id = s.id RIGHT OUTER JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.id GROUP BY CASE WHEN s.sqft >= 13463 THEN 'high' WHEN s.sqft >= 6366 THEN 'mid' ELSE 'low' END ORDER BY sqft_bucket;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

)

WITH valid AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT *, CONCAT_WS(',', city, region) AS city_region_key
    FROM stores
    WHERE opened_date > DATE '2024-01-20'
),
deduped AS (
    -- QUALIFY-style window filter
    SELECT *
    FROM (
        SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY city ORDER BY opened_date DESC, id ASC) AS latest_rank
        FROM valid
    ) ranked
    WHERE latest_rank = 1
),
remaining_keys AS (
    -- Set difference on keys
    SELECT id
    FROM deduped
    EXCEPT ALL
    SELECT id
    FROM stores
    WHERE opened_date > '2023-11-01'
),
kept_rows AS (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    SELECT s.*
    FROM deduped s
    INNER JOIN remaining_keys k ON s.id = k.id
),
metrics AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        *,
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY sqft ASC) AS sqft_rank,
        MIN(sqft) OVER (PARTITION BY city) AS city_min_sqft,
        ROUND(sqft / SUM(sqft) OVER (PARTITION BY region), 4) AS sqft_share,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY sqft DESC) AS sqft_dense_rank
    FROM kept_rows
),
remaining_keys_2 AS (
    -- Set difference on keys
    SELECT id, city
    FROM metrics
    EXCEPT
    SELECT id, city
    FROM stores
    WHERE region IN ('North', 'West')
),
verified AS (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    SELECT s.*
    FROM metrics s
    INNER JOIN remaining_keys_2 k ON s.id = k.id AND s.city = k.city
),
with_windows AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        *,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY city_min_sqft DESC) AS city_min_sqft_dense_rank,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY region ORDER BY sqft DESC) AS sqft_dense_rank_2,
        MAX(sqft_dense_rank) OVER (PARTITION BY city) AS city_max_sqft_dense_rank
    FROM verified
)
-- Grouped metrics
SELECT
    CASE WHEN city_max_sqft_dense_rank >= 7 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END AS city_max_sqft_dense_rank_tier,
    COUNT(*) AS row_count,
    ROUND(AVG(sqft), 2) AS avg_sqft,
    COUNT(*) AS row_count_2,
    COUNT(DISTINCT city) AS distinct_cities
FROM with_windows
GROUP BY ROLLUP (CASE WHEN city_max_sqft_dense_rank >= 7 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END);

valid = (
    df_stores
    .filter(F.col("opened_date") > F.lit("2024-01-20").cast("date"))
    .withColumn("city_region_key", F.concat_ws(",", "city", "region"))
)

deduped = (
    valid
    .withColumn("latest_rank", F.row_number().over(w))
    .filter(F.col("latest_rank") == 1)
)

remaining_keys = (
    deduped
    .select("id")
    .exceptAll(
        df_stores
        .filter(F.col("opened_date") > "2023-11-01")
        .select("id")
    )
)

    .alias("s")
    .join(remaining_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.id") == F.col("k.id")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

    .withColumn("city_min_sqft", F.min("sqft").over(w3))

    )
)

verified = (
    metrics
    .alias("s")
    .join(remaining_keys_2.alias("k"), (F.col("s.id") == F.col("k.id")) & (F.col("s.city") == F.col("k.city")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

with_windows = (

    .select(

WITH scored AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        id,
        channel,
        promo_code,
        starts_on,
        ends_on,
        discount_pct,
        PERCENT_RANK() OVER w_recent AS discount_pct_percent_rank,
        ROUND(discount_pct / SUM(discount_pct) OVER (PARTITION BY channel, promo_code), 4) AS discount_pct_share
    FROM promotions
    WINDOW w_recent AS (PARTITION BY promo_code ORDER BY discount_pct DESC)
),
scored_promotions AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        *,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY discount_pct_share DESC, id) AS row_seq,
        FIRST_VALUE(discount_pct_share, TRUE) OVER (ORDER BY discount_pct_percent_rank, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS first_known_discount_pct_share,
        MAX(discount_pct) OVER (PARTITION BY promo_code) AS promo_code_max_discount_pct,
        NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY discount_pct DESC, id) AS discount_pct_bucket,
        LAST_VALUE(channel) IGNORE NULLS OVER (PARTITION BY promo_code ORDER BY discount_pct_percent_rank, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS last_known_channel
    FROM scored
),
with_window AS (
    -- Non-equi join on a validity window
    SELECT
        s.*,
        pr.id AS promo_id,
        pr.promo_code AS promotion_promo_code,
        pr.discount_pct AS promotion_discount_pct
    FROM scored_promotions s
    INNER JOIN promotions pr
        ON s.channel = pr.channel
       AND s.ends_on >= pr.starts_on
       AND s.ends_on < pr.ends_on + INTERVAL 14 DAYS
)
SELECT
    id,
    starts_on,
    ends_on,
    discount_pct_percent_rank,
    discount_pct_share,
    row_seq,
    promo_code_max_discount_pct,
    discount_pct_bucket,
    promo_id
FROM with_window

WITH base AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT
        id,
        product_name,
        category,
        brand,
        price,
        cost,
        tags,
        CASE WHEN category IN ('Fashion', 'Home') THEN 'Tier 1' ELSE 'Other' END AS category_group,
        COALESCE(brand, 'NONE') AS resolved_brand
    FROM products
    WHERE launch_date >= DATE '2024-01-30'
      AND supplier_id IN (1, 5, 38)
),
enriched AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        *,
        LEAD(cost, 1) OVER w_hist AS next_cost,
        FIRST_VALUE(brand) IGNORE NULLS OVER (ORDER BY price, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS first_known_brand,
        LAST_VALUE(cost, TRUE) OVER (ORDER BY cost, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS last_known_cost,
        NTILE(10) OVER (ORDER BY cost DESC, id) AS cost_bucket,
        SUM(price) OVER (PARTITION BY brand ORDER BY price, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_price
    FROM base
    WINDOW w_hist AS (PARTITION BY category, brand ORDER BY price, id)
),
scored AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        *,
        NTILE(10) OVER (PARTITION BY brand ORDER BY running_price, id) AS running_price_bucket,
        SUM(last_known_cost) OVER w_running AS cumulative_last_known_cost
    FROM enriched
    WINDOW w_running AS (PARTITION BY brand ORDER BY price, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)
),
eligible AS (
    -- Anti-join via a correlated subquery
    SELECT s.*
    FROM scored s
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM inventory x
            WHERE x.product_id = s.id
              AND x.last_restock BETWEEN '2023-07-01' AND '2024-08-01'
        )
),
kept_keys AS (
    -- Set difference on keys
    SELECT brand
    FROM eligible
    EXCEPT ALL
    SELECT brand
    FROM products
    WHERE supplier_id = 13
),
reconciled AS (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    SELECT s.*
    FROM eligible s
    INNER JOIN kept_keys k ON s.brand = k.brand
),
scored_products AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        *,
        ROUND(cost / SUM(cost) OVER (PARTITION BY category, brand), 4) AS cost_share,
        PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY cumulative_last_known_cost DESC) AS cumulative_last_known_cost_percent_rank,
        CUME_DIST() OVER (PARTITION BY category ORDER BY next_cost DESC NULLS LAST) AS next_cost_cume_dist,
        SUM(running_price_bucket) OVER (PARTITION BY brand, category) AS brand_sum_running_price_bucket,
        ROUND(cost / SUM(cost) OVER (PARTITION BY brand), 4) AS cost_share_2
    FROM reconciled
)
SELECT
    product_name,
    category,
    brand,
    price,
    cost,
    category_group,
    next_cost,
    first_known_brand,
    last_known_cost
FROM scored_products
ORDER BY cost DESC;

WITH lines AS (

    SELECT
        id,
        service,
        host,
        level,
        k,
        attr_value
    FROM app_logs
    LATERAL VIEW OUTER EXPLODE(context) e AS k, attr_value

valid AS (

    SELECT
        *,
        CASE WHEN k = 'region' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_region,
        LOWER(k) AS k_lower
    FROM lines
    WHERE k IS NOT NULL
),
metrics AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        *,
        CUME_DIST() OVER (ORDER BY is_region NULLS LAST) AS is_region_cume_dist,
        STDDEV_SAMP(is_region) OVER (PARTITION BY level, host) AS level_stddev_samp_is_region,
        STDDEV_SAMP(is_region) OVER (PARTITION BY k) AS k_stddev_samp_is_region,
        PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY is_region DESC NULLS LAST) AS is_region_percent_rank
    FROM valid
),
base AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT
        id,
        host,
        level,
        k,
        attr_value,
        is_region,
        k_lower,
        is_region_cume_dist,
        level_stddev_samp_is_region,
        k_stddev_samp_is_region,
        is_region_percent_rank,
        LEAST(k_stddev_samp_is_region, level_stddev_samp_is_region) AS least_k_stddev_samp_is_region_level_stddev_samp_is_region,
        COALESCE(k, 'DIRECT') AS resolved_k
    FROM metrics
    WHERE k IS NOT NULL
),
with_windows AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        *,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER w_ordered AS k_stddev_samp_is_region_dense_rank,
        PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY host, k ORDER BY is_region_cume_dist) AS is_region_cume_dist_percent_rank,
        MIN(is_region) OVER (PARTITION BY host, level) AS host_min_is_region
    FROM base
    WINDOW w_ordered AS (PARTITION BY k ORDER BY k_stddev_samp_is_region DESC NULLS LAST)
),
base_app_logs AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT
        *,
        is_region_cume_dist + k_stddev_samp_is_region_dense_rank AS is_region_cume_dist_plus_k_stddev_samp_is_region_dense_rank,
        COALESCE(k, 'NONE') AS resolved_k_2
    FROM with_windows
    WHERE k IS NOT NULL
      AND level_stddev_samp_is_region IS NOT NULL
),
remaining_keys AS (
    -- Set difference on keys
    SELECT level, host
    FROM base_app_logs
    EXCEPT
    SELECT level, host
    FROM app_logs
    WHERE status_code < 276
),
verified AS (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    SELECT s.*
    FROM base_app_logs s
    INNER JOIN remaining_keys k ON s.level = k.level AND s.host = k.host
)
-- Native SQL PIVOT
SELECT *
FROM (
    SELECT
        level,
        k,
        is_region_cume_dist_percent_rank
    FROM verified
) src
PIVOT (
    MAX(is_region_cume_dist_percent_rank)
    FOR k IN ('trace', 'region')

        "is_region_cume_dist",
        "level_stddev_samp_is_region",
        "k_stddev_samp_is_region",
        "is_region_percent_rank",
        F.least("k_stddev_samp_is_region", "level_stddev_samp_is_region").alias("least_k_stddev_samp_is_region_level_stddev_samp_is_region"),
        F.coalesce("k", F.lit("DIRECT")).alias("resolved_k"),
    )
)

with_windows = (
    base
    .select(
        "*",
        F.dense_rank().over(w_ordered).alias("k_stddev_samp_is_region_dense_rank"),
        F.percent_rank().over(w6).alias("is_region_cume_dist_percent_rank"),
        F.min("is_region").over(w7).alias("host_min_is_region"),
    )
)

    with_windows
    .filter(F.col("k").isNotNull() & F.col("level_stddev_samp_is_region").isNotNull())

)

    .select("level", "host")
    .subtract(

    .select("s.*")
)

result = (
    verified
    .groupBy("level")
    .pivot("k", ["trace", "region"])
    .agg(F.max("is_region_cume_dist_percent_rank"))
)

sql:
WITH remaining_keys AS (
    -- Set intersection on keys
    SELECT customer_id
    FROM sessions
    INTERSECT ALL
    SELECT customer_id
    FROM sessions
    WHERE TO_DATE(started_at) >= '2025-06-01'
),
kept_rows AS (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    SELECT s.*
    FROM sessions s
    INNER JOIN remaining_keys k ON s.customer_id = k.customer_id
),
kept AS (
    -- Semi-join via a correlated subquery
    SELECT s.*
    FROM kept_rows s
    WHERE EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM web_events c
            WHERE c.session_id = s.id
              AND c.event_type IN ('search', 'click', 'page_view')
        )
),
enriched AS (
    -- Attach customers attributes
    SELECT
        src.*,
        b.segment,
        b.name,
        b.email
    FROM kept src
    LEFT JOIN customers b
        ON src.customer_id = b.id
),
with_dims AS (
    -- Attach customers attributes
    SELECT e.*, d.email AS customer_email
    FROM enriched e
    LEFT JOIN customers d
        ON e.customer_id = d.id
),
eligible AS (
    -- Anti-join via a correlated subquery
    SELECT s.*
    FROM with_dims s
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM web_events c
            WHERE c.session_id = s.id
              AND c.event_time < s.started_at
        )
)
-- Aggregate with conditional metrics
SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', started_at) AS activity_month,
    (UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MAX(started_at)) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MIN(started_at))) / 60 AS duration_min,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN segment = 'Corporate' THEN 1 END) AS corporate_count,
    MIN(started_at) AS started_at,
    MIN(started_at) AS first_seen,
    COUNT_IF(segment = 'SMB') AS smb_events,
    COUNT(*) AS cnt
FROM eligible
GROUP BY 1
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

remaining_keys = (
    df_sessions
    .select("customer_id")
    .intersectAll(
        df_sessions
        .filter(F.to_date("started_at") >= "2025-06-01")
        .select("customer_id")
    )
)

kept_rows = (
    df_sessions
    .alias("s")
    .join(remaining_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.customer_id") == F.col("k.customer_id")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

kept = (
    kept_rows
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_web_events.alias("c"), (F.col("c.session_id") == F.col("s.id")) & (F.col("c.event_type").isin(["search", "click", "page_view"])), "left_semi")
)

enriched = (
    kept
    .alias("src")
    .join(df_customers.alias("b"), F.col("src.customer_id") == F.col("b.id"), "left")
    .select("src.*", F.col("b.segment"), F.col("b.name"), F.col("b.email"))
)

with_dims = (
    enriched
    .alias("e")
    .join(df_customers.alias("d"), F.col("e.customer_id") == F.col("d.id"), "left")
    .select("e.*", F.col("d.email").alias("customer_email"))
)

eligible = (
    with_dims
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_web_events.alias("c"), (F.col("c.session_id") == F.col("s.id")) & (F.col("c.event_time") < F.col("s.started_at")), "left_anti")
)

result = (
    eligible
    .groupBy(F.date_trunc("MONTH", "started_at").alias("activity_month"))
    .agg(
        ((F.unix_timestamp(F.max("started_at")) - F.unix_timestamp(F.min("started_at"))) / 60).alias("duration_min"),
        F.count(F.when(F.col("segment") == "Corporate", 1)).alias("corporate_count"),
        F.min("started_at").alias("started_at"),
        F.min("started_at").alias("first_seen"),
        F.count_if(F.col("segment") == "SMB").alias("smb_events"),
        F.count("*").alias("cnt"),
    )
)

with exploded as (
    -- Unnest the array into one row per element
    select
        id,
        customer_id,
        created_at,
        tag
    from carts
    lateral view outer explode(coupon_codes) x as tag
),
enriched as (
    -- Attach customers attributes
    select
        e.*,
        p.segment,
        p.age
    from exploded e
    left join customers p
        on e.customer_id = p.id
),
metrics as (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    select
        *,
        sum(age) over (order by cast(created_at as bigint) range between 3600 preceding and current row) as age_sum_1h,
        dense_rank() over w_recent as age_dense_rank,
        avg(age) over w_ordered as customer_id_avg_age,
        round(age / sum(age) over (partition by segment), 4) as age_share,
        count(age) over (order by cast(created_at as bigint) range between 1800 preceding and current row) as age_count_30m
    from enriched
    window w_recent as (partition by customer_id, tag order by age desc nulls last), w_ordered as (partition by customer_id)
),
joined as (
    -- Attach customers attributes
    select e.*, p.city
    from metrics e
    left join customers p
        on e.customer_id = p.id
),
with_windows as (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    select
        *,
        round(customer_id_avg_age / sum(customer_id_avg_age) over (partition by city), 4) as customer_id_avg_age_share,
        rank() over w_recent as customer_id_avg_age_rank,
        max(age_count_30m) over w_hist as customer_id_max_age_count_30m,
        max(age_count_30m) over w_running as age_count_30m_max_2h,
        percent_rank() over w_grp as age_share_percent_rank
    from joined
    window w_recent as (partition by customer_id, tag order by customer_id_avg_age nulls first), w_hist as (partition by customer_id), w_running as (order by cast(created_at as bigint) range between 7200 preceding and current row), w_grp as (partition by city, segment order by age_share nulls first)
),
remaining_keys as (
    -- Set intersection on keys
    select id, customer_id
    from with_windows
    intersect
    select id, customer_id
    from carts
    where hour(created_at) between 9 and 14
),
kept_rows as (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    select s.*
    from with_windows s
    inner join remaining_keys k on s.id = k.id and s.customer_id = k.customer_id
),
by_type as (
    -- Native SQL PIVOT
    select *
    from (
        select
            tag,
            customer_id,
            segment,
            customer_id_avg_age
        from kept_rows
    ) src
    pivot (
        sum(customer_id_avg_age) as amount
        for segment in ('SMB', 'Consumer')
    )
)
select
    tag,
    customer_id,
    SMB,
    Consumer,
    case when tag rlike '^(VIP|WELCOME5)$' then 'GROUP_A' when tag rlike '^(SPRING10|BUNDLE)$' then 'PRIORITY' else 'OTHER_ZONE' end as tag_zone
from by_type

w = Window.orderBy(F.col("created_at").cast("bigint")).rangeBetween(-3600, Window.currentRow)
w_recent = Window.partitionBy("customer_id", "tag").orderBy(F.col("age").desc_nulls_last())
w_ordered = Window.partitionBy("customer_id")
w4 = Window.partitionBy("segment")

w_running = Window.orderBy(F.col("created_at").cast("bigint")).rangeBetween(-7200, Window.currentRow)
w_grp = Window.partitionBy("city", "segment").orderBy(F.col("age_share").asc_nulls_first())

exploded = (
    df_carts
    .select(
        "id",
        "customer_id",
        "created_at",
        F.explode_outer("coupon_codes").alias("tag"),
    )
)

enriched = (
    exploded
    .alias("e")
    .join(df_customers.alias("p"), F.col("e.customer_id") == F.col("p.id"), "left")
    .select("e.*", F.col("p.segment"), F.col("p.age"))
)

metrics = (
    enriched
    .select(
        "*",
        F.sum("age").over(w).alias("age_sum_1h"),
        F.dense_rank().over(w_recent).alias("age_dense_rank"),
        F.avg("age").over(w_ordered).alias("customer_id_avg_age"),
        F.round((F.col("age") / F.sum("age").over(w4)), 4).alias("age_share"),
        F.count("age").over(w5).alias("age_count_30m"),
    )
)

joined = (
    metrics
    .alias("e")
    .join(df_customers.alias("p"), F.col("e.customer_id") == F.col("p.id"), "left")
    .select("e.*", F.col("p.city"))
)

with_windows = (
    joined
    .withColumn("customer_id_avg_age_share", F.round((F.col("customer_id_avg_age") / F.sum("customer_id_avg_age").over(w6)), 4))
    .withColumn("customer_id_avg_age_rank", F.rank().over(w7))
    .withColumn("customer_id_max_age_count_30m", F.max("age_count_30m").over(w_ordered))
    .withColumn("age_count_30m_max_2h", F.max("age_count_30m").over(w_running))
    .withColumn("age_share_percent_rank", F.percent_rank().over(w_grp))
)

remaining_keys = (
    with_windows
    .select("id", "customer_id")
    .intersect(
        df_carts
        .filter(F.hour("created_at").between(9, 14))
        .select("id", "customer_id")
    )
)

kept_rows = (
    with_windows
    .alias("s")
    .join(remaining_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.id") == F.col("k.id")) & (F.col("s.customer_id") == F.col("k.customer_id")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

by_type = (
    kept_rows
    .groupBy("tag", "customer_id")
    .pivot("segment", ["SMB", "Consumer"])
    .agg(F.sum("customer_id_avg_age").alias("amount"))
)

result = (
    by_type
    .select(
        "tag",
        "customer_id",
        "SMB",
        "Consumer",
        F.when(F.col("tag").rlike("^(VIP|WELCOME5)$"), "GROUP_A").when(F.col("tag").rlike("^(SPRING10|BUNDLE)$"), "PRIORITY").otherwise("OTHER_ZONE").alias("tag_zone"),
    )
)

WITH remaining_keys AS (
    SELECT customer_id, channel
    FROM orders
    EXCEPT
    SELECT customer_id, channel
    FROM orders
    WHERE customer_id IN (11, 28, 33)
),
reconciled AS (
    SELECT s.*
    FROM orders s
    INNER JOIN remaining_keys k ON s.customer_id = k.customer_id AND s.channel = k.channel
),
with_windows AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        CORR(shipping_fee, discount) OVER (PARTITION BY store_id, status) AS corr_shipping_fee_discount,
        CORR(shipping_fee, discount) OVER (PARTITION BY channel) AS corr_shipping_fee_discount_2,
        COUNT(discount) OVER (PARTITION BY status) AS status_count_discount,
        STDDEV_SAMP(amount) OVER (PARTITION BY status) AS status_stddev_samp_amount
    FROM reconciled
),
with_windows_orders AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        CORR(discount, amount) OVER w_recent AS corr_discount_amount,
        SUM(corr_shipping_fee_discount) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id) AS customer_id_sum_corr_shipping_fee_discount,
        STDDEV_SAMP(corr_shipping_fee_discount_2) OVER w_recent AS status_stddev_samp_corr_shipping_fee_discount_2,
        CORR(shipping_fee, amount) OVER w_running AS corr_shipping_fee_amount
    FROM with_windows
    WINDOW w_recent AS (PARTITION BY status), w_running AS (PARTITION BY status, customer_id)
),
enriched AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        MAX(corr_shipping_fee_discount) OVER (PARTITION BY status) AS status_max_corr_shipping_fee_discount,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY corr_shipping_fee_discount_2 DESC NULLS LAST) AS corr_shipping_fee_discount_2_dense_rank,
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY amount DESC) AS amount_rank
    FROM with_windows_orders
),
enriched_orders AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        COUNT(corr_shipping_fee_discount_2_dense_rank) OVER (PARTITION BY store_id, status) AS store_id_count_corr_shipping_fee_discount_2_dense_rank,
        PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY status_stddev_samp_corr_shipping_fee_discount_2 DESC NULLS FIRST) AS status_stddev_samp_corr_shipping_fee_discount_2_percent_rank,
        CUME_DIST() OVER (PARTITION BY store_id ORDER BY shipping_fee NULLS LAST) AS shipping_fee_cume_dist
    FROM enriched
),
daily AS (
    SELECT
        CASE WHEN corr_shipping_fee_discount_2 >= 0.22 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END AS corr_shipping_fee_discount_2_tier,
        CASE WHEN store_id_count_corr_shipping_fee_discount_2_dense_rank >= 16 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END AS store_id_count_corr_shipping_fee_discount_2_dense_rank_tier,
        customer_id,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE channel = 'partner') AS partner_rows,
        AVG(status_count_discount) AS avg_status_count_discount,
        ROUND(SUM(corr_discount_amount) / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN channel = 'mobile' THEN 1 END), 0), 2) AS corr_discount_amount_per_mobile
    FROM enriched_orders
    GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((CASE WHEN corr_shipping_fee_discount_2 >= 0.22 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END, CASE WHEN store_id_count_corr_shipping_fee_discount_2_dense_rank >= 16 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END, customer_id), (CASE WHEN corr_shipping_fee_discount_2 >= 0.22 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END, CASE WHEN store_id_count_corr_shipping_fee_discount_2_dense_rank >= 16 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END), ())
    HAVING COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE channel = 'partner') > 1
)
SELECT
    corr_shipping_fee_discount_2_tier,
    store_id_count_corr_shipping_fee_discount_2_dense_rank_tier,
    customer_id,
    avg_status_count_discount,
    corr_discount_amount_per_mobile
FROM daily
ORDER BY corr_shipping_fee_discount_2_tier DESC NULLS FIRST
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("store_id", "status")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("channel")
w3 = Window.partitionBy("status")
w4 = Window.partitionBy("customer_id")
w_running = Window.partitionBy("status", "customer_id")
w6 = Window.orderBy(F.col("corr_shipping_fee_discount_2").desc_nulls_last())
w7 = Window.orderBy(F.col("amount").desc())
w8 = Window.orderBy(F.col("status_stddev_samp_corr_shipping_fee_discount_2").desc_nulls_first())
w9 = Window.partitionBy("store_id").orderBy(F.col("shipping_fee").asc_nulls_last())

remaining_keys = (
    df_orders
    .select("customer_id", "channel")
    .subtract(
        df_orders
        .filter(F.col("customer_id").isin([11, 28, 33]))
        .select("customer_id", "channel")
    )
)

reconciled = (
    df_orders
    .alias("s")
    .join(remaining_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.customer_id") == F.col("k.customer_id")) & (F.col("s.channel") == F.col("k.channel")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

with_windows = (
    reconciled
    .withColumn("corr_shipping_fee_discount", F.corr("shipping_fee", "discount").over(w))
    .withColumn("corr_shipping_fee_discount_2", F.corr("shipping_fee", "discount").over(w2))
    .withColumn("status_count_discount", F.count("discount").over(w3))
    .withColumn("status_stddev_samp_amount", F.stddev_samp("amount").over(w3))
)

with_windows_orders = (
    with_windows
    .select(
        "*",
        F.corr("discount", "amount").over(w3).alias("corr_discount_amount"),
        F.sum("corr_shipping_fee_discount").over(w4).alias("customer_id_sum_corr_shipping_fee_discount"),
        F.stddev_samp("corr_shipping_fee_discount_2").over(w3).alias("status_stddev_samp_corr_shipping_fee_discount_2"),
        F.corr("shipping_fee", "amount").over(w_running).alias("corr_shipping_fee_amount"),
    )
)

enriched = (
    with_windows_orders
    .withColumn("status_max_corr_shipping_fee_discount", F.max("corr_shipping_fee_discount").over(w3))
    .withColumn("corr_shipping_fee_discount_2_dense_rank", F.dense_rank().over(w6))
    .withColumn("amount_rank", F.rank().over(w7))
)

enriched_orders = (
    enriched
    .withColumn("store_id_count_corr_shipping_fee_discount_2_dense_rank", F.count("corr_shipping_fee_discount_2_dense_rank").over(w))
    .withColumn("status_stddev_samp_corr_shipping_fee_discount_2_percent_rank", F.percent_rank().over(w8))
    .withColumn("shipping_fee_cume_dist", F.cume_dist().over(w9))
)

daily = (
    enriched_orders
    .withColumn("corr_shipping_fee_discount_2_tier", F.when(F.col("corr_shipping_fee_discount_2") >= 0.22, "HIGH").otherwise("LOW"))
    .withColumn("store_id_count_corr_shipping_fee_discount_2_dense_rank_tier", F.when(F.col("store_id_count_corr_shipping_fee_discount_2_dense_rank") >= 16, "LARGE").otherwise("SMALL"))
    .groupingSets(
        [["corr_shipping_fee_discount_2_tier", "store_id_count_corr_shipping_fee_discount_2_dense_rank_tier", "customer_id"], ["corr_shipping_fee_discount_2_tier", "store_id_count_corr_shipping_fee_discount_2_dense_rank_tier"], []],
        "corr_shipping_fee_discount_2_tier",
        "store_id_count_corr_shipping_fee_discount_2_dense_rank_tier",
        "customer_id",
    )
    .agg(
        F.count(F.when(F.col("channel") == "partner", 1)).alias("partner_rows"),
        F.avg("status_count_discount").alias("avg_status_count_discount"),
        F.round(F.sum("corr_discount_amount") / F.nullif(F.count(F.when(F.col("channel") == "mobile", 1)), F.lit(0)), 2).alias("corr_discount_amount_per_mobile"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("partner_rows") > 1)
)

result = (
    daily
    .select(
        "corr_shipping_fee_discount_2_tier",
        "store_id_count_corr_shipping_fee_discount_2_dense_rank_tier",
        "customer_id",
        "avg_status_count_discount",
        "corr_discount_amount_per_mobile",
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("corr_shipping_fee_discount_2_tier").desc_nulls_first())
)

WITH lines AS (
    -- Unnest the array into one row per element
    SELECT
        id,
        service,
        level,
        latency_ms,
        k,
        attr_value
    FROM app_logs
    LATERAL VIEW OUTER EXPLODE(context) t AS k, attr_value
),
enriched AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        *,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY k ORDER BY latency_ms DESC NULLS LAST) AS latency_ms_rank,
        MAX(latency_ms) OVER (PARTITION BY k, service) AS k_max_latency_ms
    FROM lines
),
cleaned AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        id,
        service,
        level,
        latency_ms,
        k,
        latency_ms_rank,
        k_max_latency_ms,
        CASE WHEN latency_ms >= 2667 THEN 'High' WHEN latency_ms >= 864 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END AS latency_ms_level,
        COALESCE(k, 'DIRECT') AS k_filled
    FROM enriched
    WHERE level <> 'ERROR'
),
cleaned_app_logs AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT
        *,
        TRIM(service) AS clean_service,
        UPPER(k) AS k_upper,
        COALESCE(k, 'NONE') AS k_filled_2
    FROM cleaned
    WHERE k IS NOT NULL
),
with_windows AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        *,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY level ORDER BY k_max_latency_ms DESC NULLS LAST) AS k_max_latency_ms_rank,
        RANK() OVER w_part AS k_max_latency_ms_rank_2,
        CUME_DIST() OVER (PARTITION BY service ORDER BY latency_ms_rank DESC NULLS FIRST) AS latency_ms_rank_cume_dist,
        ROUND(latency_ms / SUM(latency_ms) OVER (PARTITION BY service), 4) AS latency_ms_share,
        ROUND(k_max_latency_ms / SUM(k_max_latency_ms) OVER (PARTITION BY level), 4) AS k_max_latency_ms_share
    FROM cleaned_app_logs
    WINDOW w_part AS (ORDER BY k_max_latency_ms DESC NULLS LAST)
),
matched_keys AS (
    -- Set difference on keys
    SELECT service
    FROM with_windows
    EXCEPT ALL
    SELECT service
    FROM app_logs
    WHERE status_code >= 327
),
verified AS (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    SELECT s.*
    FROM with_windows s
    JOIN matched_keys k ON s.service = k.service
)
-- Ranking and gap features
SELECT
    *,
    CUME_DIST() OVER w_recent AS latency_ms_share_cume_dist,
    STDDEV_SAMP(latency_ms_share) OVER (PARTITION BY level, k) AS level_stddev_samp_latency_ms_share,
    PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY latency_ms_rank DESC NULLS FIRST) AS latency_ms_rank_percent_rank,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY level ORDER BY latency_ms_share ASC NULLS LAST) AS latency_ms_share_dense_rank,
    CUME_DIST() OVER (ORDER BY latency_ms_rank_cume_dist DESC NULLS FIRST) AS latency_ms_rank_cume_dist_cume_dist
FROM verified
WINDOW w_recent AS (ORDER BY latency_ms_share ASC NULLS LAST);
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("k").orderBy(F.col("latency_ms").desc_nulls_last())
w2 = Window.partitionBy("k", "service")
w3 = Window.partitionBy("level").orderBy(F.col("k_max_latency_ms").desc_nulls_last())
w_part = Window.orderBy(F.col("k_max_latency_ms").desc_nulls_last())
w5 = Window.partitionBy("service").orderBy(F.col("latency_ms_rank").desc_nulls_first())
w6 = Window.partitionBy("service")
w7 = Window.partitionBy("level")
w_recent = Window.orderBy(F.col("latency_ms_share").asc_nulls_last())
w9 = Window.partitionBy("level", "k")
w10 = Window.orderBy(F.col("latency_ms_rank").desc_nulls_first())
w11 = Window.partitionBy("level").orderBy(F.col("latency_ms_share").asc_nulls_last())
w12 = Window.orderBy(F.col("latency_ms_rank_cume_dist").desc_nulls_first())

lines = (
    df_app_logs
    .select(
        "id",
        "service",
        "level",
        "latency_ms",
        F.explode_outer("context").alias("k", "attr_value"),
    )
)

enriched = (
    lines
    .select(
        "*",
        F.rank().over(w).alias("latency_ms_rank"),
        F.max("latency_ms").over(w2).alias("k_max_latency_ms"),
    )
)

cleaned = (
    enriched
    .filter(F.col("level") != "ERROR")
    .select(
        "id",
        "service",
        "level",
        "latency_ms",
        "k",
        "latency_ms_rank",
        "k_max_latency_ms",
        F.when(F.col("latency_ms") >= 2667, "High").when(F.col("latency_ms") >= 864, "Medium").otherwise("Low").alias("latency_ms_level"),
        F.coalesce("k", F.lit("DIRECT")).alias("k_filled"),
    )
)

cleaned_app_logs = (
    cleaned
    .filter(F.col("k").isNotNull())
    .select(
        "*",
        F.trim("service").alias("clean_service"),
        F.upper("k").alias("k_upper"),
        F.coalesce("k", F.lit("NONE")).alias("k_filled_2"),
    )
)

with_windows = (
    cleaned_app_logs
    .select(
        "*",
        F.rank().over(w3).alias("k_max_latency_ms_rank"),
        F.rank().over(w_part).alias("k_max_latency_ms_rank_2"),
        F.cume_dist().over(w5).alias("latency_ms_rank_cume_dist"),
        F.round((F.col("latency_ms") / F.sum("latency_ms").over(w6)), 4).alias("latency_ms_share"),
        F.round((F.col("k_max_latency_ms") / F.sum("k_max_latency_ms").over(w7)), 4).alias("k_max_latency_ms_share"),
    )
)

matched_keys = (
    with_windows
    .select("service")
    .exceptAll(
        df_app_logs
        .filter(F.col("status_code") >= 327)
        .select("service")
    )
)

verified = (
    with_windows
    .alias("s")
    .join(matched_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.service") == F.col("k.service")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

result = (
    verified
    .withColumn("latency_ms_share_cume_dist", F.cume_dist().over(w_recent))
    .withColumn("level_stddev_samp_latency_ms_share", F.stddev_samp("latency_ms_share").over(w9))
    .withColumn("latency_ms_rank_percent_rank", F.percent_rank().over(w10))
    .withColumn("latency_ms_share_dense_rank", F.dense_rank().over(w11))
    .withColumn("latency_ms_rank_cume_dist_cume_dist", F.cume_dist().over(w12))
)

with with_prev as (
    -- Previous event time per key
    select *, lag(started_at) over (partition by country order by started_at, id) as prev_started_at
    from sessions
),
with_gaps as (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session
    select *, case when prev_started_at is null or started_at > prev_started_at + interval '90' day then 1 else 0 end as new_group_flag
    from with_prev
),
islands as (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    select *, sum(new_group_flag) over (partition by country order by started_at, id rows between unbounded preceding and current row) as session_id
    from with_gaps
)
select
    s.id,
    s.customer_id,
    s.browser,
    s.started_at,
    s.country,
    s.prev_started_at,
    s.new_group_flag,
    s.session_id,
    (select sum(t2.discount) from orders t2 where t2.customer_id = s.customer_id) as sum_order_discount
from islands s;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("country").orderBy("started_at", "id")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("country").orderBy("started_at", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
discount_by_customer_id = df_orders.groupBy("customer_id").agg(F.sum("discount").alias("sum_order_discount"))

with_prev = df_sessions.withColumn("prev_started_at", F.lag("started_at").over(w))

with_gaps = (
    with_prev
    .withColumn("new_group_flag", F.when(F.col("prev_started_at").isNull() | (F.col("started_at") > F.col("prev_started_at") + F.expr("INTERVAL 90 DAYS")), 1).otherwise(0))
)

islands = with_gaps.withColumn("session_id", F.sum("new_group_flag").over(w2))

result = (
    islands
    .join(discount_by_customer_id, on="customer_id", how="left")
    .select(
        "id",
        "customer_id",
        "browser",
        "started_at",
        "country",
        "prev_started_at",
        "new_group_flag",
        "session_id",
        F.col("sum_order_discount"),

sql: WITH prev_events AS (SELECT *, LAG(event_time) OVER (PARTITION BY page ORDER BY event_time, id) AS prev_event_time FROM web_events), gaps AS (SELECT *, CASE WHEN prev_event_time IS NULL OR event_time > prev_event_time + INTERVAL '30' DAY THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS new_group_flag FROM prev_events), sessions_web_events AS (SELECT *, SUM(new_group_flag) OVER (PARTITION BY page ORDER BY event_time, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_no FROM gaps) SELECT s.id, s.session_id, s.event_type, s.new_group_flag, s.session_no, (SELECT MAX(t2.duration_sec) FROM web_events t2 WHERE t2.session_id = s.session_id) AS max_web_event_duration_sec FROM sessions_web_events s ORDER BY event_type;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("page").orderBy("event_time", "id")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("page").orderBy("event_time", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
duration_sec_by_session_id = df_web_events.groupBy("session_id").agg(F.max("duration_sec").alias("max_web_event_duration_sec"))

prev_events = df_web_events.withColumn("prev_event_time", F.lag("event_time").over(w))

gaps = (
    prev_events
    .withColumn("new_group_flag", F.when(F.col("prev_event_time").isNull() | (F.col("event_time") > F.col("prev_event_time") + F.expr("INTERVAL 30 DAYS")), 1).otherwise(0))
)

sessions_web_events = gaps.withColumn("session_no", F.sum("new_group_flag").over(w2))

result = (
    sessions_web_events
    .join(duration_sec_by_session_id, on="session_id", how="left")
    .select(
        "id",
        "session_id",
        "event_type",
        "new_group_flag",
        "session_no",

    )
    .orderBy("event_type")

with filtered as (
    select
        *,
        date_trunc('month', ends_on) as ends_on_period,
        trim(channel) as clean_channel
    from promotions
    where starts_on > '2023-03-01'
),
matched as (
    select
        e.*,
        pr.id as promo_id,
        pr.promo_code as promotion_promo_code,
        pr.discount_pct as promotion_discount_pct
    from filtered e
    join promotions pr
        on e.channel = pr.channel
       and e.starts_on >= pr.starts_on
       and e.starts_on <= date_add(pr.ends_on, 3)
),
deduped as (
    select *, row_number() over (partition by channel, promotion_promo_code order by discount_pct desc, id, promo_id) as row_num
    from matched
    qualify row_num = 1
),
with_window as (
    select
        src.*,
        pr.id as promo_id_2,
        pr.promo_code as promotion_promo_code_2,
        pr.discount_pct as promotion_discount_pct_2
    from deduped src
    left join promotions pr
        on src.channel <=> pr.channel
       and src.starts_on >= pr.starts_on
       and src.starts_on <= date_add(pr.ends_on, 10)
),
ranked as (
    select *
    from (
        select *, row_number() over (partition by promo_code order by promotion_discount_pct_2 nulls last, id, promo_id, promo_id_2) as row_num_2
        from with_window
    ) t
    where row_num_2 = 1
),
base as (
    select
        id,
        channel,
        starts_on,
        ends_on,
        discount_pct,
        clean_channel,
        promo_id,
        promotion_promo_code,
        promotion_discount_pct,
        row_num,
        promo_id_2,
        promotion_promo_code_2,
        promotion_discount_pct_2,
        row_num_2,
        coalesce(promo_id_2, 0) as promo_id_2_filled,
        coalesce(channel, 'OTHER') as channel_filled
    from ranked
    where ends_on > date '2023-06-29'
),
matched_promotions as (
    select
        s.*,
        pr.id as promo_id_3,
        pr.promo_code,
        pr.discount_pct as promotion_discount_pct_3
    from base s
    join promotions pr
        on s.channel = pr.channel
       and s.ends_on >= pr.starts_on
       and s.ends_on <= date_add(pr.ends_on, 3)
),
grouped as (
    select
        date_trunc('quarter', ends_on) as quarter_start,
        count(*) as cnt,
        count(case when promotion_promo_code = 'WELCOME5' then 1 end) as welcome5_count
    from matched_promotions
    group by quarter_start
    having welcome5_count >= 1
)
select quarter_start, welcome5_count
from grouped
order by welcome5_count desc nulls last;

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("channel", "promotion_promo_code").orderBy(F.col("discount_pct").desc(), "id", "promo_id")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("promo_code").orderBy(F.col("promotion_discount_pct_2").asc_nulls_last(), "id", "promo_id", "promo_id_2")

filtered = (
    df_promotions
    .filter(F.col("starts_on") > "2023-03-01")
    .select(
        "*",
        F.date_trunc("month", "ends_on").alias("ends_on_period"),
        F.trim("channel").alias("clean_channel"),
    )
)

matched = (
    filtered
    .alias("e")
    .join(df_promotions.alias("pr"), (F.col("e.channel") == F.col("pr.channel")) & (F.col("e.starts_on") >= F.col("pr.starts_on")) & (F.col("e.starts_on") <= F.date_add(F.col("pr.ends_on"), 3)), "inner")
    .select(
        "e.*",
        F.col("pr.id").alias("promo_id"),
        F.col("pr.promo_code").alias("promotion_promo_code"),
        F.col("pr.discount_pct").alias("promotion_discount_pct"),
    )
)

deduped = (
    matched
    .withColumn("row_num", F.row_number().over(w))
    .filter(F.col("row_num") == 1)
)

with_window = (
    deduped
    .alias("src")
    .join(df_promotions.alias("pr"), (F.col("src.channel").eqNullSafe(F.col("pr.channel"))) & (F.col("src.starts_on") >= F.col("pr.starts_on")) & (F.col("src.starts_on") <= F.date_add(F.col("pr.ends_on"), 10)), "left")
    .select(
        "src.*",
        F.col("pr.id").alias("promo_id_2"),
        F.col("pr.promo_code").alias("promotion_promo_code_2"),
        F.col("pr.discount_pct").alias("promotion_discount_pct_2"),
    )
)

ranked = (
    with_window
    .withColumn("row_num_2", F.row_number().over(w2))
    .filter(F.col("row_num_2") == 1)
)

base = (
    ranked
    .filter(F.col("ends_on") > F.lit("2023-06-29").cast("date"))
    .select(
        "id",
        "channel",
        "starts_on",
        "ends_on",
        "discount_pct",
        "clean_channel",
        "promo_id",
        "promotion_promo_code",
        "promotion_discount_pct",
        "row_num",
        "promo_id_2",
        "promotion_promo_code_2",
        "promotion_discount_pct_2",
        "row_num_2",
        F.coalesce("promo_id_2", F.lit(0)).alias("promo_id_2_filled"),
        F.coalesce("channel", F.lit("OTHER")).alias("channel_filled"),
    )
)

matched_promotions = (
    base
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_promotions.alias("pr"), (F.col("s.channel") == F.col("pr.channel")) & (F.col("s.ends_on") >= F.col("pr.starts_on")) & (F.col("s.ends_on") <= F.date_add(F.col("pr.ends_on"), 3)), "inner")
    .select(
        "s.*",
        F.col("pr.id").alias("promo_id_3"),
        F.col("pr.promo_code"),
        F.col("pr.discount_pct").alias("promotion_discount_pct_3"),
    )
)

grouped = (
    matched_promotions
    .groupBy(F.date_trunc("quarter", "ends_on").alias("quarter_start"))
    .agg(
        F.count("*").alias("cnt"),
        F.count(F.when(F.col("promotion_promo_code") == "WELCOME5", 1)).alias("welcome5_count"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("welcome5_count") >= 1)
)

result = (
    grouped
    .select("quarter_start", "welcome5_count")
    .orderBy(F.col("welcome5_count").desc_nulls_last())
)

sql: WITH flattened_attrs AS (SELECT id, plan, effective_from, currency, tier_limits, tier_prices, discounts, ARRAY_MIN(tier_prices) AS lowest_price, SLICE(tier_limits, 1, 2) AS first_two_limits FROM price_tiers WHERE plan <> 'basic') SELECT currency, APPROX_PERCENTILE(lowest_price, ARRAY(0.25, 0.5, 0.75)) AS lowest_price_quartiles, ROUND(SUM(lowest_price) / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN plan = 'pro' THEN 1 END), 0), 2) AS lowest_price_per_pro, SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_SET(plan)) AS plan_list, SUM(CASE WHEN currency = 'USD' THEN lowest_price ELSE 0 END) AS usd_lowest_price, PERCENTILE_APPROX(lowest_price, 0.5) AS lowest_price_p50, SUM(lowest_price) AS total_lowest_price FROM flattened_attrs GROUP BY 1 HAVING PERCENTILE_APPROX(lowest_price, 0.5) > 0 ORDER BY total_lowest_price DESC
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

flattened_attrs = (
    df_price_tiers
    .filter(F.col("plan") != "basic")
    .select(
        "id",
        "plan",
        "effective_from",
        "currency",
        "tier_limits",
        "tier_prices",
        "discounts",
        F.array_min("tier_prices").alias("lowest_price"),
        F.slice("tier_limits", 1, 2).alias("first_two_limits"),
    )
)

result = (
    flattened_attrs
    .groupBy("currency")
    .agg(
        F.percentile_approx("lowest_price", [0.25, 0.5, 0.75]).alias("lowest_price_quartiles"),
        F.round(F.sum("lowest_price") / F.nullif(F.count(F.when(F.col("plan") == "pro", 1)), F.lit(0)), 2).alias("lowest_price_per_pro"),
        F.sort_array(F.collect_set("plan")).alias("plan_list"),
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("currency") == "USD", F.col("lowest_price")).otherwise(0)).alias("usd_lowest_price"),
        F.percentile_approx("lowest_price", 0.5).alias("lowest_price_p50"),
        F.sum("lowest_price").alias("total_lowest_price"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("lowest_price_p50") > 0)
    .orderBy(F.col("total_lowest_price").desc())
)

WITH valid AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT *, DAY(reading_ts) AS reading_ts_day
    FROM device_readings
    WHERE reading_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-09-01 05:00:00'
)
-- Ranking and gap features
SELECT
    *,
    AVG(reading_ts_day) OVER (PARTITION BY device_code ORDER BY CAST(reading_ts AS BIGINT) RANGE BETWEEN 3600 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS reading_ts_day_avg_1h,
    FIRST_VALUE(temp_c, TRUE) OVER (PARTITION BY device_code ORDER BY status_bits, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS first_known_temp_c
FROM valid;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("device_code").orderBy(F.col("reading_ts").cast("bigint")).rangeBetween(-3600, Window.currentRow)
w2 = Window.partitionBy("device_code").orderBy("status_bits", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)

valid = (
    df_device_readings
    .filter(F.col("reading_ts") >= F.lit("2025-09-01 05:00:00").cast("timestamp"))
    .select("*", F.dayofmonth("reading_ts").alias("reading_ts_day"))
)

result = (
    valid
    .select(
        "*",
        F.avg("reading_ts_day").over(w).alias("reading_ts_day_avg_1h"),
        F.first("temp_c", ignorenulls=True).over(w2).alias("first_known_temp_c"),
    )
)

sql:
WITH base AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        product_id,
        last_restock,
        DATE_TRUNC('WEEK', last_restock) AS last_restock_period,
        ADD_MONTHS(last_restock, 6) AS last_restock_plus_months
    FROM inventory
    WHERE last_restock < '2025-08-01'
),
scored AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER w_grp AS event_seq,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY last_restock DESC, id) AS row_seq,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY last_restock_plus_months, id) AS event_seq_2,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER w_grp_2 AS event_seq_3
    FROM base
    WINDOW w_grp AS (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY last_restock_period, id), w_grp_2 AS (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY last_restock, id)
),
with_windows AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        product_id,
        last_restock,
        last_restock_period,
        last_restock_plus_months,
        event_seq,
        row_seq,
        event_seq_2,
        event_seq_3,
        CUME_DIST() OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY event_seq_3 DESC NULLS FIRST) AS event_seq_3_cume_dist,
        SUM(event_seq_3) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY event_seq_2, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_event_seq_3,
        COUNT(event_seq_3) OVER (ORDER BY CAST(last_restock_period AS BIGINT) RANGE BETWEEN 7776000 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS event_seq_3_count_90d
    FROM scored
),
with_windows_inventory AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        FIRST_VALUE(event_seq_3_count_90d) IGNORE NULLS OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY last_restock_plus_months, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS first_known_event_seq_3_count_90d,
        SUM(event_seq) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY CAST(last_restock_period AS BIGINT) RANGE BETWEEN 604800 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS event_seq_sum_7d,
        SUM(running_event_seq_3) OVER w_running AS cumulative_running_event_seq_3,
        MAX(event_seq_3_cume_dist) OVER w_recent AS event_seq_3_cume_dist_max_30d,
        NTILE(10) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY row_seq, id) AS row_seq_bucket
    FROM with_windows
    WINDOW w_running AS (ORDER BY row_seq, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), w_recent AS (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY CAST(last_restock_period AS BIGINT) RANGE BETWEEN 2592000 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)
)
SELECT
    id,
    product_id,
    last_restock,
    last_restock_period,
    last_restock_plus_months,
    event_seq,
    event_seq_2,
    event_seq_3,
    event_seq_3_cume_dist
FROM with_windows_inventory
ORDER BY event_seq_2 DESC;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w_grp = Window.partitionBy("product_id").orderBy("last_restock_period", "id")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("product_id").orderBy(F.col("last_restock").desc(), "id")
w3 = Window.partitionBy("product_id").orderBy("last_restock_plus_months", "id")
w_grp_2 = Window.partitionBy("product_id").orderBy("last_restock", "id")
w5 = Window.partitionBy("product_id").orderBy(F.col("event_seq_3").desc_nulls_first())
w6 = Window.partitionBy("product_id").orderBy("event_seq_2", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w7 = Window.orderBy(F.col("last_restock_period").cast("bigint")).rangeBetween(-7776000, Window.currentRow)
w8 = Window.partitionBy("product_id").orderBy("last_restock_plus_months", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w9 = Window.partitionBy("product_id").orderBy(F.col("last_restock_period").cast("bigint")).rangeBetween(-604800, Window.currentRow)
w_running = Window.orderBy("row_seq", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w_recent = Window.partitionBy("product_id").orderBy(F.col("last_restock_period").cast("bigint")).rangeBetween(-2592000, Window.currentRow)
w12 = Window.partitionBy("product_id").orderBy("row_seq", "id")

base = (
    df_inventory
    .filter(F.col("last_restock") < "2025-08-01")
    .select(
        "id",
        "product_id",
        "last_restock",
        F.date_trunc("WEEK", "last_restock").alias("last_restock_period"),
        F.add_months("last_restock", 6).alias("last_restock_plus_months"),
    )
)

scored = (
    base
    .withColumn("event_seq", F.row_number().over(w_grp))
    .withColumn("row_seq", F.row_number().over(w2))
    .withColumn("event_seq_2", F.row_number().over(w3))
    .withColumn("event_seq_3", F.row_number().over(w_grp_2))
)

with_windows = (
    scored
    .withColumn("event_seq_3_cume_dist", F.cume_dist().over(w5))
    .withColumn("running_event_seq_3", F.sum("event_seq_3").over(w6))
    .withColumn("event_seq_3_count_90d", F.count("event_seq_3").over(w7))
)

with_windows_inventory = (
    with_windows
    .select(
        "*",
        F.first("event_seq_3_count_90d", ignorenulls=True).over(w8).alias("first_known_event_seq_3_count_90d"),
        F.sum("event_seq").over(w9).alias("event_seq_sum_7d"),
        F.sum("running_event_seq_3").over(w_running).alias("cumulative_running_event_seq_3"),
        F.max("event_seq_3_cume_dist").over(w_recent).alias("event_seq_3_cume_dist_max_30d"),
        F.ntile(10).over(w12).alias("row_seq_bucket"),
    )
)

result = (
    with_windows_inventory
    .select(
        "id",
        "product_id",
        "last_restock",
        "last_restock_period",
        "last_restock_plus_months",
        "event_seq",
        "event_seq_2",
        "event_seq_3",
        "event_seq_3_cume_dist",
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("event_seq_2").desc())
)

WITH with_windows AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        AVG(monthly_fee) OVER (PARTITION BY status ORDER BY start_date ASC, id ASC ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS monthly_fee_avg_2,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY plan ORDER BY monthly_fee DESC NULLS LAST) AS monthly_fee_dense_rank,
        AVG(monthly_fee) OVER (PARTITION BY status ORDER BY start_date ASC, id ASC ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS monthly_fee_avg_3_prior,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY start_date ASC, id ASC) AS seq_no,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY monthly_fee ASC) AS monthly_fee_rank
    FROM subscriptions
)

WITH cleaned AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        *,
        INITCAP(TRIM(browser)) browser_title,
        LENGTH(browser) browser_length
    FROM sessions
    WHERE started_at >= TO_TIMESTAMP('2023-09-30 11:00:00')
      AND customer_id IS NOT NULL
),
gaps AS (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > interval)
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN LAG(started_at) OVER (PARTITION BY browser ORDER BY started_at, id) IS NULL
                 OR started_at > LAG(started_at) OVER (PARTITION BY browser ORDER BY started_at, id) + INTERVAL 7 DAYS THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS session_start_flag
    FROM cleaned
),
islands AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(session_start_flag) OVER (PARTITION BY browser ORDER BY started_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_no
    FROM gaps
)
-- Aggregate with conditional metrics
SELECT
    CASE WHEN browser_length >= 67 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END AS browser_length_tier,
    customer_id,
    CASE WHEN session_start_flag >= 1 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END AS session_start_flag_tier,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE browser = 'Firefox') AS firefox_rows,
    COUNT_IF(country = 'SG') AS sg_events,
    SUM(session_no) FILTER (WHERE country = 'US') AS us_total_session_no,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY CASE WHEN browser_length >= 67 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END ORDER BY SUM(session_no) FILTER (WHERE country = 'US') DESC) AS us_total_session_no_rank
FROM islands
GROUP BY browser_length_tier, customer_id, session_start_flag_tier
HAVING SUM(session_no) FILTER (WHERE country = 'US') < 0
ORDER BY session_start_flag_tier DESC;

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("browser").orderBy("started_at", "id")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("browser").orderBy("started_at", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w3 = Window.partitionBy("browser_length_tier").orderBy(F.col("us_total_session_no").desc())

cleaned = (
    df_sessions
    .filter((F.col("started_at") >= F.to_timestamp(F.lit("2023-09-30 11:00:00"))) & F.col("customer_id").isNotNull())
    .select(
        "*",
        F.initcap(F.trim("browser")).alias("browser_title"),
        F.length("browser").alias("browser_length"),
    )
)

gaps = (
    cleaned
    .withColumn("session_start_flag", F.when(F.lag("started_at").over(w).isNull() | (F.col("started_at") > F.lag("started_at").over(w) + F.expr("INTERVAL 7 DAYS")), 1).otherwise(0))
)

islands = gaps.withColumn("session_no", F.sum("session_start_flag").over(w2))

result = (
    islands
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("browser_length") >= 67, "HIGH").otherwise("LOW").alias("browser_length_tier"),
        "customer_id",
        F.when(F.col("session_start_flag") >= 1, "HIGH").otherwise("LOW").alias("session_start_flag_tier"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.count(F.when(F.col("browser") == "Firefox", 1)).alias("firefox_rows"),
        F.count_if(F.col("country") == "SG").alias("sg_events"),
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("country") == "US", F.col("session_no"))).alias("us_total_session_no"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("us_total_session_no") < 0)
    .withColumn("us_total_session_no_rank", F.rank().over(w3))
    .orderBy(F.col("session_start_flag_tier").desc())
)

with filtered as (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    select
        id,
        device_code,
        reading_ts,
        temp_c,
        humidity,
        pressure,
        status_bits,
        firmware,
        concat_ws(',', firmware, device_code) as firmware_device_code_key,
        day(reading_ts) as reading_ts_day
    from device_readings
    where reading_ts >= date '2025-09-01'
),
gaps as (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > interval)
    select *, case when lag(reading_ts) over (partition by device_code order by reading_ts, id) is null
                 or reading_ts > lag(reading_ts) over (partition by device_code order by reading_ts, id) + interval 45 minutes then 1 else 0 end as new_group_flag
    from filtered
),
sessionized as (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    select *, sum(new_group_flag) over (partition by device_code order by reading_ts, id rows between unbounded preceding and current row) as session_id
    from gaps
),
metrics as (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    select
        *,
        row_number() over (order by status_bits, id) as event_seq,
        avg(status_bits) over (order by status_bits, id rows between 3 preceding and 1 preceding) as status_bits_avg_3_prior,
        count(temp_c) over (partition by device_code order by cast(reading_ts as bigint) range between 900 preceding and current row) as temp_c_count_15m,
        ntile(4) over (partition by device_code order by pressure, id) as pressure_bucket,
        row_number() over (partition by device_code order by reading_ts_day, id) as seq_no
    from sessionized
)
-- Native SQL UNPIVOT (wide to long)
select *
from (
    select
        id,
        device_code,
        pressure,
        temp_c,
        humidity
    from metrics
) src
unpivot (
    metric_value for measure in (pressure, temp_c, humidity)
);
