from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("device_code").orderBy("reading_ts", "id")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("device_code").orderBy("reading_ts", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w3 = Window.orderBy("status_bits", "id")
w4 = Window.orderBy("status_bits", "id").rowsBetween(-3, -1)
w5 = Window.partitionBy("device_code").orderBy(F.col("reading_ts").cast("bigint")).rangeBetween(-900, Window.currentRow)
w6 = Window.partitionBy("device_code").orderBy("pressure", "id")
w7 = Window.partitionBy("device_code").orderBy("reading_ts_day", "id")

filtered = (
    df_device_readings
    .filter(F.col("reading_ts") >= F.lit("2025-09-01").cast("date"))
    .select(
        "id",
        "device_code",
        "reading_ts",
        "temp_c",
        "humidity",
        "pressure",
        "status_bits",
        "firmware",
        F.concat_ws(",", "firmware", "device_code").alias("firmware_device_code_key"),
        F.dayofmonth("reading_ts").alias("reading_ts_day"),
    )
)

gaps = (
    filtered
    .withColumn("new_group_flag", F.when(F.lag("reading_ts").over(w).isNull() | (F.col("reading_ts") > F.lag("reading_ts").over(w) + F.expr("INTERVAL 45 MINUTES")), 1).otherwise(0))
)

sessionized = gaps.withColumn("session_id", F.sum("new_group_flag").over(w2))

metrics = (
    sessionized
    .select(
        "*",
        F.row_number().over(w3).alias("event_seq"),
        F.avg("status_bits").over(w4).alias("status_bits_avg_3_prior"),
        F.count("temp_c").over(w5).alias("temp_c_count_15m"),
        F.ntile(4).over(w6).alias("pressure_bucket"),
        F.row_number().over(w7).alias("seq_no"),
    )
)

    .select("id", "device_code", "pressure", "temp_c", "humidity")
    .unpivot(

        ["pressure", "temp_c", "humidity"],
        "measure",
        "metric_value",
    )
    .filter(F.col("metric_value").isNotNull())
)

with base as (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    select
        id,
        name,
        email,
        country,
        city,
        segment,
        is_active,
        credit_limit,
        age,
        concat(country, ' ', name) as country_name,
        concat(segment, ' ', city) as segment_city,
        coalesce(segment, 'N/A') as segment_clean
    from customers
    where signup_date > date '2023-08-02'
),
matched_keys as (
    -- Set intersection on keys
    select segment
    from base
    intersect all
    select segment
    from customers
    where segment = 'Consumer'
),
verified as (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    select s.*
    from base s
    inner join matched_keys k on s.segment = k.segment
),
metrics as (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    select
        id,
        name,
        email,
        country,
        city,
        segment,
        is_active,
        credit_limit,
        age,
        country_name,
        segment_city,
        segment_clean,
        corr(credit_limit, age) over (partition by segment) as corr_credit_limit_age,
        round(credit_limit / sum(credit_limit) over (partition by country, segment), 4) as credit_limit_share,
        percent_rank() over (partition by country order by age nulls first) as age_percent_rank,
        max(age) over (partition by segment) as segment_max_age,
        percent_rank() over (order by age desc nulls last) as age_percent_rank_2
    from verified
),
metrics_customers as (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    select
        *,
        count(credit_limit_share) over (partition by segment) as segment_count_credit_limit_share,
        percent_rank() over w_ordered as age_percent_rank_percent_rank,
        count(age_percent_rank) over (partition by country) as country_count_age_percent_rank
    from metrics
    window w_ordered as (partition by city, country order by age_percent_rank desc nulls first)
),
metrics_customers_2 as (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    select
        *,
        percent_rank() over (partition by city order by credit_limit_share nulls first) as credit_limit_share_percent_rank,
        min(segment_count_credit_limit_share) over (partition by city, segment) as city_min_segment_count_credit_limit_share
    from metrics_customers
)
-- Multi-level aggregation
select
    segment,
    percentile_approx(country_count_age_percent_rank, array(0.25, 0.5, 0.75)) as country_count_age_percent_rank_quartiles,
    round(sum(corr_credit_limit_age) / nullif(count(case when segment = 'Corporate' then 1 end), 0), 2) as corr_credit_limit_age_per_corporate,
    sum(credit_limit_share_percent_rank) as total_credit_limit_share_percent_rank,
    approx_percentile(city_min_segment_count_credit_limit_share, 0.5) as city_min_segment_count_credit_limit_share_p50
from metrics_customers_2
group by segment;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("segment")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("country", "segment")
w3 = Window.partitionBy("country").orderBy(F.col("age").asc_nulls_first())
w4 = Window.orderBy(F.col("age").desc_nulls_last())
w_ordered = Window.partitionBy("city", "country").orderBy(F.col("age_percent_rank").desc_nulls_first())
w6 = Window.partitionBy("country")
w7 = Window.partitionBy("city").orderBy(F.col("credit_limit_share").asc_nulls_first())
w8 = Window.partitionBy("city", "segment")

base = (
    df_customers
    .filter(F.col("signup_date") > F.lit("2023-08-02").cast("date"))
    .select(
        "id",
        "name",
        "email",
        "country",
        "city",
        "segment",
        "is_active",
        "credit_limit",
        "age",
        F.concat("country", F.lit(" "), "name").alias("country_name"),
        F.concat("segment", F.lit(" "), "city").alias("segment_city"),
        F.coalesce("segment", F.lit("N/A")).alias("segment_clean"),
    )
)

matched_keys = (
    base
    .select("segment")
    .intersectAll(
        df_customers
        .filter(F.col("segment") == "Consumer")
        .select("segment")
    )
)

verified = (
    base
    .alias("s")
    .join(matched_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.segment") == F.col("k.segment")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

metrics = (
    verified
    .select(
        "*",
        F.corr("credit_limit", "age").over(w).alias("corr_credit_limit_age"),
        F.round((F.col("credit_limit") / F.sum("credit_limit").over(w2)), 4).alias("credit_limit_share"),
        F.percent_rank().over(w3).alias("age_percent_rank"),
        F.max("age").over(w).alias("segment_max_age"),
        F.percent_rank().over(w4).alias("age_percent_rank_2"),
    )
)

metrics_customers = (
    metrics
    .withColumn("segment_count_credit_limit_share", F.count("credit_limit_share").over(w))
    .withColumn("age_percent_rank_percent_rank", F.percent_rank().over(w_ordered))
    .withColumn("country_count_age_percent_rank", F.count("age_percent_rank").over(w6))
)

metrics_customers_2 = (
    metrics_customers
    .withColumn("credit_limit_share_percent_rank", F.percent_rank().over(w7))
    .withColumn("city_min_segment_count_credit_limit_share", F.min("segment_count_credit_limit_share").over(w8))
)

result = (
    metrics_customers_2
    .groupBy("segment")
    .agg(
        F.percentile_approx("country_count_age_percent_rank", [0.25, 0.5, 0.75]).alias("country_count_age_percent_rank_quartiles"),
        F.round(F.sum("corr_credit_limit_age") / F.nullif(F.count(F.when(F.col("segment") == "Corporate", 1)), F.lit(0)), 2).alias("corr_credit_limit_age_per_corporate"),
        F.sum("credit_limit_share_percent_rank").alias("total_credit_limit_share_percent_rank"),
        F.percentile_approx("city_min_segment_count_credit_limit_share", 0.5).alias("city_min_segment_count_credit_limit_share_p50"),
    )
)

WITH cleaned AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        customer_id,
        plan,
        end_date,
        monthly_fee,
        status,
        CASE WHEN plan = 'standard' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_standard
    FROM subscriptions
    WHERE start_date > DATE '2023-12-16'
),
with_windows AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        SUM(is_standard) OVER (ORDER BY is_standard ASC, id ASC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_is_standard,
        SUM(monthly_fee) OVER (PARTITION BY status ORDER BY end_date ASC, id ASC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_monthly_fee
    FROM cleaned
),
scored AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        AVG(cumulative_is_standard) OVER (PARTITION BY status ORDER BY end_date ASC, id ASC ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS cumulative_is_standard_avg_6_prior,
        LEAD(monthly_fee, 2, 0) OVER (PARTITION BY status ORDER BY running_monthly_fee ASC, id ASC) AS next_monthly_fee,
        LAG(monthly_fee, 1, 0) OVER (ORDER BY running_monthly_fee ASC, id ASC) AS prev_monthly_fee,
        LEAD(running_monthly_fee, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY plan ORDER BY is_standard ASC, id ASC) AS next_running_monthly_fee,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY status ORDER BY end_date DESC, id ASC) AS event_seq
    FROM with_windows
),
deduped AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM (
        SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY plan ORDER BY monthly_fee ASC NULLS FIRST, id ASC) AS dedup_rank
        FROM scored
    ) t
    WHERE dedup_rank = 1
),
kept_keys AS (
    SELECT customer_id, id
    FROM deduped
    EXCEPT DISTINCT
    SELECT customer_id, id
    FROM subscriptions
    WHERE customer_id IN (11, 13, 16, 37)
),
kept_rows AS (
    SELECT s.*
    FROM deduped s
    INNER JOIN kept_keys k ON s.customer_id = k.customer_id AND s.id = k.id
),
with_windows_subscriptions AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        customer_id,
        plan,
        end_date,
        monthly_fee,
        status,
        is_standard,
        cumulative_is_standard,
        running_monthly_fee,
        cumulative_is_standard_avg_6_prior,
        next_monthly_fee,
        prev_monthly_fee,
        next_running_monthly_fee,
        event_seq,
        dedup_rank,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY plan ORDER BY cumulative_is_standard DESC NULLS LAST) AS cumulative_is_standard_rank,
        CUME_DIST() OVER (ORDER BY next_running_monthly_fee ASC NULLS FIRST) AS next_running_monthly_fee_cume_dist
    FROM kept_rows
)
SELECT *
FROM (
    SELECT
        plan,
        next_monthly_fee,
        prev_monthly_fee
    FROM with_windows_subscriptions
) src
UNPIVOT INCLUDE NULLS (
    value FOR metric IN (next_monthly_fee AS NEXT_MONTHLY_FEE_VAL, prev_monthly_fee AS PREV_MONTHLY_FEE_VAL)
)

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.orderBy("is_standard", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w2 = Window.partitionBy("status").orderBy("end_date", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w3 = Window.partitionBy("status").orderBy("end_date", "id").rowsBetween(-6, -1)
w4 = Window.partitionBy("status").orderBy("running_monthly_fee", "id")
w5 = Window.orderBy("running_monthly_fee", "id")
w6 = Window.partitionBy("plan").orderBy("is_standard", "id")
w7 = Window.partitionBy("status").orderBy(F.col("end_date").desc(), "id")
w8 = Window.partitionBy("plan").orderBy(F.col("monthly_fee").asc_nulls_first(), "id")
w9 = Window.partitionBy("plan").orderBy(F.col("cumulative_is_standard").desc_nulls_last())
w10 = Window.orderBy(F.col("next_running_monthly_fee").asc_nulls_first())

cleaned = (
    df_subscriptions
    .filter(F.col("start_date") > F.lit("2023-12-16").cast("date"))
    .select(
        "id",
        "customer_id",
        "plan",
        "end_date",
        "monthly_fee",
        "status",
        F.when(F.col("plan") == "standard", 1).otherwise(0).alias("is_standard"),
    )
)

with_windows = (
    cleaned
    .withColumn("cumulative_is_standard", F.sum("is_standard").over(w))
    .withColumn("running_monthly_fee", F.sum("monthly_fee").over(w2))
)

scored = (
    with_windows
    .select(
        "*",
        F.avg("cumulative_is_standard").over(w3).alias("cumulative_is_standard_avg_6_prior"),
        F.lead("monthly_fee", 2, 0).over(w4).alias("next_monthly_fee"),
        F.lag("monthly_fee", 1, 0).over(w5).alias("prev_monthly_fee"),
        F.lead("running_monthly_fee", 1).over(w6).alias("next_running_monthly_fee"),
        F.row_number().over(w7).alias("event_seq"),
    )
)

deduped = (
    scored
    .withColumn("dedup_rank", F.row_number().over(w8))
    .filter(F.col("dedup_rank") == 1)
)

kept_keys = (
    deduped
    .select("customer_id", "id")
    .subtract(
        df_subscriptions
        .filter(F.col("customer_id").isin([11, 13, 16, 37]))
        .select("customer_id", "id")
    )
)

kept_rows = (
    deduped
    .alias("s")
    .join(kept_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.customer_id") == F.col("k.customer_id")) & (F.col("s.id") == F.col("k.id")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

with_windows_subscriptions = (
    kept_rows
    .select(
        "*",
        F.rank().over(w9).alias("cumulative_is_standard_rank"),
        F.cume_dist().over(w10).alias("next_running_monthly_fee_cume_dist"),
    )
)

result = (
    with_windows_subscriptions
    .select(
        "plan",
        F.col("next_monthly_fee").alias("NEXT_MONTHLY_FEE_VAL"),
        F.col("prev_monthly_fee").alias("PREV_MONTHLY_FEE_VAL"),
    )
    .unpivot(
        ["plan"],
        ["NEXT_MONTHLY_FEE_VAL", "PREV_MONTHLY_FEE_VAL"],
        "metric",
        "value",
    )
)

WITH base AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT *, ROUND(cost * 1.07, 2) AS cost_adjusted
    FROM shipments
    WHERE order_id IS NULL
),
valid AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT *, DATE_TRUNC('week', delivered_date) AS delivered_date_period
    FROM base
    WHERE delivered_date >= DATE '2023-06-11'
      AND order_id IS NOT NULL
      AND carrier IN ('DHL', 'Flash')
),
with_windows AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        id,
        order_id,
        carrier,
        shipped_date,
        delivered_date,
        cost,
        status,
        cost_adjusted,
        delivered_date_period,
        AVG(cost) OVER (ORDER BY shipped_date, id ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS cost_avg_2_prior,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY status ORDER BY shipped_date, id) AS seq_no
    FROM valid
)
-- Grouped metrics
SELECT
    CASE WHEN cost_adjusted >= 78 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END AS cost_adjusted_tier,
    seq_no,
    CASE WHEN cost_avg_2_prior >= 79 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END AS cost_avg_2_prior_tier,
    ROUND(AVG(cost_adjusted), 2) AS avg_cost_adjusted,
    COUNT_IF(status = 'LOST') AS lost_events
FROM with_windows
GROUP BY CASE WHEN cost_adjusted >= 78 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END, seq_no, CASE WHEN cost_avg_2_prior >= 79 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END
ORDER BY cost_avg_2_prior_tier;

from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.orderBy("shipped_date", "id").rowsBetween(-2, -1)
w2 = Window.partitionBy("status").orderBy("shipped_date", "id")

base = (
    df_shipments
    .filter(F.col("order_id").isNull())
    .select("*", F.round((F.col("cost") * 1.07), 2).alias("cost_adjusted"))
)

valid = (
    base
    .filter((F.col("delivered_date") >= F.lit("2023-06-11").cast("date")) & F.col("order_id").isNotNull() & F.col("carrier").isin(["DHL", "Flash"]))
    .select("*", F.date_trunc("week", "delivered_date").alias("delivered_date_period"))
)

with_windows = (
    valid
    .select(
        "*",
        F.avg("cost").over(w).alias("cost_avg_2_prior"),
        F.row_number().over(w2).alias("seq_no"),
    )
)

result = (
    with_windows
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("cost_adjusted") >= 78, "PREMIUM").otherwise("STANDARD").alias("cost_adjusted_tier"),
        "seq_no",
        F.when(F.col("cost_avg_2_prior") >= 79, "LARGE").otherwise("SMALL").alias("cost_avg_2_prior_tier"),
    )

    )
    .orderBy("cost_avg_2_prior_tier")
)

WITH filtered AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        *,
        CASE WHEN carrier IN ('Flash', 'FedEx') THEN 'Tier 1' ELSE 'Other' END carrier_group,
        COALESCE(carrier, 'NONE') resolved_carrier
    FROM shipments
    WHERE delivered_date > TO_DATE('2024-01-11')
),
joined AS (
    -- Attach orders attributes
    SELECT
        src.*,
        o.shipping_fee,
        o.discount,
        o.channel
    FROM filtered src
    JOIN orders o
        ON src.order_id = o.id
),
with_dims AS (
    -- Attach orders attributes
    SELECT src.*, b.shipping_fee AS order_shipping_fee
    FROM joined src
    JOIN orders b
        ON src.order_id = b.id
),
scored AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        *,
        LAG(order_shipping_fee, 2) OVER w_ordered prev_order_shipping_fee,
        SUM(shipping_fee) OVER w_recent cumulative_shipping_fee
    FROM with_dims
    WINDOW w_ordered AS (PARTITION BY carrier ORDER BY shipping_fee, id), w_recent AS (PARTITION BY status ORDER BY cost, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)
),
metrics AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        id,
        order_id,
        carrier,
        shipped_date,
        delivered_date,
        cost,
        status,
        carrier_group,
        resolved_carrier,
        shipping_fee,
        discount,
        channel,
        order_shipping_fee,
        prev_order_shipping_fee,
        cumulative_shipping_fee,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY carrier, order_id ORDER BY shipping_fee) shipping_fee_dense_rank,
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY order_shipping_fee DESC NULLS FIRST) order_shipping_fee_rank
    FROM scored
),
enriched AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        *,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY channel ORDER BY delivered_date, id) event_seq,
        NTILE(10) OVER (PARTITION BY status ORDER BY cumulative_shipping_fee DESC, id) cumulative_shipping_fee_bucket
    FROM metrics
)
-- Window metrics over several different partitions
SELECT
    *,
    MAX(order_shipping_fee) OVER (PARTITION BY channel, order_id) channel_max_order_shipping_fee,
    AVG(cumulative_shipping_fee) OVER (PARTITION BY status, order_id ORDER BY shipped_date, id ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) cumulative_shipping_fee_avg_3_prior,
    COUNT(cost) OVER (PARTITION BY carrier) carrier_count_cost
FROM enriched;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w_ordered = Window.partitionBy("carrier").orderBy("shipping_fee", "id")
w_recent = Window.partitionBy("status").orderBy("cost", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w3 = Window.partitionBy("carrier", "order_id").orderBy("shipping_fee")
w4 = Window.orderBy(F.col("order_shipping_fee").desc_nulls_first())
w5 = Window.partitionBy("channel").orderBy("delivered_date", "id")
w6 = Window.partitionBy("status").orderBy(F.col("cumulative_shipping_fee").desc(), "id")
w7 = Window.partitionBy("channel", "order_id")
w8 = Window.partitionBy("status", "order_id").orderBy("shipped_date", "id").rowsBetween(-3, -1)
w9 = Window.partitionBy("carrier")

filtered = (
    df_shipments
    .filter(F.col("delivered_date") > F.to_date(F.lit("2024-01-11")))
    .select(
        "*",
        F.when(F.col("carrier").isin(["Flash", "FedEx"]), "Tier 1").otherwise("Other").alias("carrier_group"),
        F.coalesce("carrier", F.lit("NONE")).alias("resolved_carrier"),
    )
)

joined = (
    filtered
    .alias("src")
    .join(df_orders.alias("o"), F.col("src.order_id") == F.col("o.id"), "inner")
    .select("src.*", F.col("o.shipping_fee"), F.col("o.discount"), F.col("o.channel"))
)

with_dims = (
    joined
    .alias("src")
    .join(df_orders.alias("b"), F.col("src.order_id") == F.col("b.id"), "inner")
    .select("src.*", F.col("b.shipping_fee").alias("order_shipping_fee"))
)

scored = (
    with_dims
    .select(
        "*",
        F.lag("order_shipping_fee", 2).over(w_ordered).alias("prev_order_shipping_fee"),
        F.sum("shipping_fee").over(w_recent).alias("cumulative_shipping_fee"),
    )
)

metrics = (
    scored
    .withColumn("shipping_fee_dense_rank", F.dense_rank().over(w3))
    .withColumn("order_shipping_fee_rank", F.rank().over(w4))
)

enriched = (
    metrics
    .withColumn("event_seq", F.row_number().over(w5))
    .withColumn("cumulative_shipping_fee_bucket", F.ntile(10).over(w6))
)

result = (
    enriched
    .withColumn("channel_max_order_shipping_fee", F.max("order_shipping_fee").over(w7))
    .withColumn("cumulative_shipping_fee_avg_3_prior", F.avg("cumulative_shipping_fee").over(w8))
    .withColumn("carrier_count_cost", F.count("cost").over(w9))
)

sql:
WITH valid AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        id,
        plan,
        start_date,
        end_date,
        monthly_fee,
        status,
        CASE WHEN status = 'ACTIVE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_active
    FROM subscriptions
    WHERE end_date >= TO_DATE('2023-05-11')
      AND status IN ('CANCELLED', 'PAUSED', 'EXPIRED')
),
valid_subscriptions AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT *, ADD_MONTHS(start_date, 3) AS start_date_plus_months
    FROM valid
    WHERE end_date > DATE '2023-10-15'
),
scored AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        *,
        FIRST_VALUE(monthly_fee, TRUE) OVER (PARTITION BY status, plan ORDER BY start_date_plus_months, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS first_known_monthly_fee,
        PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY status ORDER BY is_active DESC) AS is_active_percent_rank,
        SUM(is_active) OVER (PARTITION BY status) AS status_sum_is_active
    FROM valid_subscriptions
),
ranked AS (
    -- Deduplicate with ROW_NUMBER
    SELECT *
    FROM (
        SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY status ORDER BY first_known_monthly_fee DESC NULLS FIRST, id) AS rn
        FROM scored
    ) t
    WHERE rn = 1
)
-- Aggregate with conditional metrics
SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('QUARTER', start_date_plus_months) AS quarter_start,
    CASE WHEN status_sum_is_active >= 428 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END AS status_sum_is_active_tier,
    DATE_TRUNC('WEEK', start_date) AS week_start,
    ROUND(AVG(is_active_percent_rank), 2) AS avg_is_active_percent_rank,
    ROUND(SUM(monthly_fee) / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'PAUSED' THEN 1 END), 0), 2) AS monthly_fee_per_paused,
    COUNT(DISTINCT id) AS distinct_ids,
    COUNT(DISTINCT id) AS distinct_ids_2,
    AVG(first_known_monthly_fee) FILTER (WHERE status = 'CANCELLED') AS cancelled_avg_first_known_monthly_fee
FROM ranked
GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((DATE_TRUNC('QUARTER', start_date_plus_months), CASE WHEN status_sum_is_active >= 428 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END, DATE_TRUNC('WEEK', start_date)), (DATE_TRUNC('QUARTER', start_date_plus_months), CASE WHEN status_sum_is_active >= 428 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END), ())
ORDER BY status_sum_is_active_tier;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("status", "plan").orderBy("start_date_plus_months", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w2 = Window.partitionBy("status").orderBy(F.col("is_active").desc())
w3 = Window.partitionBy("status")
w4 = Window.partitionBy("status").orderBy(F.col("first_known_monthly_fee").desc_nulls_first(), "id")

valid = (
    df_subscriptions
    .filter((F.col("end_date") >= F.to_date(F.lit("2023-05-11"))) & F.col("status").isin(["CANCELLED", "PAUSED", "EXPIRED"]))
    .select(
        "id",
        "plan",
        "start_date",
        "end_date",
        "monthly_fee",
        "status",
        F.when(F.col("status") == "ACTIVE", 1).otherwise(0).alias("is_active"),
    )
)

valid_subscriptions = (
    valid
    .filter(F.col("end_date") > F.lit("2023-10-15").cast("date"))
    .withColumn("start_date_plus_months", F.add_months("start_date", 3))
)

scored = (
    valid_subscriptions
    .select(
        "*",
        F.first("monthly_fee", ignorenulls=True).over(w).alias("first_known_monthly_fee"),
        F.percent_rank().over(w2).alias("is_active_percent_rank"),
        F.sum("is_active").over(w3).alias("status_sum_is_active"),
    )
)

ranked = (
    scored
    .withColumn("rn", F.row_number().over(w4))
    .filter(F.col("rn") == 1)
)

result = (
    ranked
    .withColumn("quarter_start", F.date_trunc("QUARTER", "start_date_plus_months"))
    .withColumn("status_sum_is_active_tier", F.when(F.col("status_sum_is_active") >= 428, "LARGE").otherwise("SMALL"))
    .withColumn("week_start", F.date_trunc("WEEK", "start_date"))
    .groupingSets(
        [["quarter_start", "status_sum_is_active_tier", "week_start"], ["quarter_start", "status_sum_is_active_tier"], []],
        "quarter_start",
        "status_sum_is_active_tier",
        "week_start",
    )
    .agg(
        F.round(F.avg("is_active_percent_rank"), 2).alias("avg_is_active_percent_rank"),
        F.round(F.sum("monthly_fee") / F.nullif(F.count(F.when(F.col("status") == "PAUSED", 1)), F.lit(0)), 2).alias("monthly_fee_per_paused"),
        F.countDistinct("id").alias("distinct_ids"),
        F.countDistinct("id").alias("distinct_ids_2"),
        F.avg(F.when(F.col("status") == "CANCELLED", F.col("first_known_monthly_fee"))).alias("cancelled_avg_first_known_monthly_fee"),
    )
    .orderBy("status_sum_is_active_tier")
)

WITH valid AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT
        *,
        TRIM(city) AS clean_city,
        ROUND(rating * 1.15, 2) AS adjusted_rating,
        COALESCE(city, 'OTHER') AS city_filled
    FROM suppliers
    WHERE city IS NOT NULL
),
base AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT
        id,
        supplier_name,
        country,
        city,
        rating,
        city_filled,
        TRIM(city) AS clean_city_2,
        REPLACE(supplier_name, ' ', '-') AS supplier_name_slug,
        COALESCE(city, 'NONE') AS resolved_city
    FROM valid
    WHERE rating > 2.7
),
with_windows AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        *,
        LAST_VALUE(city) IGNORE NULLS OVER (PARTITION BY country ORDER BY rating, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS last_known_city,
        AVG(rating) OVER (ORDER BY rating, id ROWS BETWEEN 5 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS rating_avg_5
    FROM base
),
metrics AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        id,
        supplier_name,
        country,
        city,
        rating,
        city_filled,
        clean_city_2,
        supplier_name_slug,
        resolved_city,
        last_known_city,
        rating_avg_5,
        AVG(rating_avg_5) OVER (PARTITION BY country) AS country_avg_rating_avg_5,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY city ORDER BY rating, id) AS seq_no
    FROM with_windows
),
daily AS (
    -- Aggregate with conditional metrics
    SELECT
        CASE WHEN rating_avg_5 >= 3 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END AS rating_avg_5_tier,
        seq_no,
        COUNT(*) AS num_rows,
        PERCENTILE_APPROX(rating, ARRAY(0.25, 0.5, 0.75)) AS rating_quartiles,
        ROUND(AVG(seq_no), 2) AS avg_seq_no
    FROM metrics
    GROUP BY CASE WHEN rating_avg_5 >= 3 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END, seq_no
    HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
)
SELECT
    rating_avg_5_tier,
    seq_no,
    num_rows,
    rating_quartiles,
    avg_seq_no
FROM daily
ORDER BY avg_seq_no DESC NULLS FIRST

with base as (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    select
        *,
        cast(rating as int) as rating_int,
        replace(supplier_name, ' ', '-') as supplier_name_slug,
        coalesce(city, 'NONE') as resolved_city
    from suppliers
    where supplier_name like '%Parts%'
),
latest as (
    -- Deduplicate with ROW_NUMBER
    select *
    from (
        select *, row_number() over (partition by city order by rating nulls last, id) as rn
        from base
    ) t
    where rn = 1
),
kept_keys as (
    -- Set difference on keys
    select id, country
    from latest
    except
    select id, country
    from suppliers
    where rating < 3.6
),
verified as (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    select s.*
    from latest s
    join kept_keys k on s.id = k.id and s.country = k.country
),
cleaned as (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    select
        *,
        concat(city, ' ', supplier_name) as city_supplier_name,
        round(rating_int / rating, 2) as rating_int_per_rating
    from verified
    where supplier_name is not null
),
filtered as (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    select *, round(rn * 0.85, 2) as rn_adjusted
    from cleaned
    where rating between 2.3 and 4.2
),
filtered_suppliers as (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    select *, rn_adjusted - rating as rn_adjusted_minus_rating
    from filtered
    where supplier_name is not null
)
select
    id,
    supplier_name,
    country,
    rating_int,
    supplier_name_slug,
    resolved_city,
    rn,
    city_supplier_name,
    rating_int_per_rating
from filtered_suppliers
order by id desc, rn;

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("city").orderBy(F.col("rating").asc_nulls_last(), "id")

base = (
    df_suppliers
    .filter(F.col("supplier_name").like("%Parts%"))
    .select(
        "*",
        F.col("rating").cast("int").alias("rating_int"),
        F.regexp_replace("supplier_name", " ", "-").alias("supplier_name_slug"),
        F.coalesce("city", F.lit("NONE")).alias("resolved_city"),
    )
)

latest = (
    base
    .withColumn("rn", F.row_number().over(w))
    .filter(F.col("rn") == 1)
)

kept_keys = (
    latest
    .select("id", "country")
    .subtract(
        df_suppliers
        .filter(F.col("rating") < 3.6)
        .select("id", "country")
    )
)

verified = (
    latest
    .alias("s")
    .join(kept_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.id") == F.col("k.id")) & (F.col("s.country") == F.col("k.country")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

cleaned = (
    verified
    .filter(F.col("supplier_name").isNotNull())
    .withColumn("city_supplier_name", F.concat("city", F.lit(" "), "supplier_name"))
    .withColumn("rating_int_per_rating", F.round((F.col("rating_int") / F.col("rating")), 2))
)

filtered = (
    cleaned
    .filter(F.col("rating").between(2.3, 4.2))
    .select("*", F.round((F.col("rn") * 0.85), 2).alias("rn_adjusted"))
)

filtered_suppliers = (
    filtered
    .filter(F.col("supplier_name").isNotNull())
    .select(
        "*",
        (F.col("rn_adjusted") - F.col("rating")).alias("rn_adjusted_minus_rating"),
    )
)

result = (
    filtered_suppliers
    .select(
        "id",
        "supplier_name",
        "country",
        "rating_int",
        "supplier_name_slug",
        "resolved_city",
        "rn",
        "city_supplier_name",
        "rating_int_per_rating",
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("id").desc(), "rn")
)

WITH filtered AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        id,
        store_name,
        city,
        region,
        opened_date,
        sqft,
        SUBSTRING(store_name, 1, 4) AS store_name_prefix,
        COALESCE(region, 'N/A') AS region_filled
    FROM stores
    WHERE sqft > 8430
),
enriched AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        *,
        AVG(sqft) OVER (PARTITION BY region ORDER BY opened_date, id ROWS BETWEEN 5 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS sqft_avg_5_prior,
        NTILE(4) OVER (PARTITION BY region ORDER BY sqft DESC, id) AS sqft_bucket,
        AVG(sqft) OVER (PARTITION BY city, region ORDER BY opened_date, id ROWS BETWEEN 5 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS sqft_avg_5_prior_2,
        LEAD(sqft, 2) OVER (PARTITION BY city, region ORDER BY opened_date, id) AS next_sqft,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY sqft, id) AS row_seq
    FROM filtered
),
ranked AS (
    -- Deduplicate with ROW_NUMBER
    SELECT *
    FROM enriched
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY city ORDER BY next_sqft NULLS FIRST, id) = 1
)
SELECT
    id,
    store_name,
    city,
    opened_date,
    sqft,
    store_name_prefix,
    region_filled,
    sqft_avg_5_prior,
    sqft_avg_5_prior_2,
    CASE WHEN city RLIKE '^(Bangkok|New York)$' THEN 'GROUP_B' WHEN city RLIKE '^(Chiang Mai|Singapore)$' THEN 'OTHER_ZONE' ELSE 'CORE' END AS city_zone
FROM ranked
ORDER BY city DESC;

from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("region").orderBy("opened_date", "id").rowsBetween(-5, -1)

w3 = Window.partitionBy("city", "region").orderBy("opened_date", "id").rowsBetween(-5, -1)

w5 = Window.orderBy("sqft", "id")
w6 = Window.partitionBy("city").orderBy(F.col("next_sqft").asc_nulls_first(), "id")

    df_stores

        "store_name",
        "city",
        "region",
        "opened_date",
        "sqft",
        F.substring("store_name", 1, 4).alias("store_name_prefix"),
        F.coalesce("region", F.lit("N/A")).alias("region_filled"),
    )
)

    filtered
    .withColumn("sqft_avg_5_prior", F.avg("sqft").over(w))

)

WITH filtered AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT
        *,
        CASE WHEN rating >= 4.4 THEN 'High' WHEN rating >= 1.6 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END rating_band,
        COALESCE(city, 'DIRECT') city_clean
    FROM suppliers
    WHERE city = 'Tokyo'
),
with_latest AS (
    -- Latest matching product per row (LATERAL ... LIMIT 1)
    SELECT s.*, x.launch_date
    FROM filtered s
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
            SELECT c.launch_date
            FROM products c
            WHERE c.supplier_id = s.id
            ORDER BY c.price DESC, c.id DESC
            LIMIT 1
        ) x ON TRUE
),
base AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        *,
        ROUND(rating, 2) rating_rounded,
        DATE_ADD(launch_date, 19) launch_date_plus_19d,
        COALESCE(city, 'UNKNOWN') city_clean_2
    FROM with_latest
    WHERE city IN ('Chiang Mai', 'Singapore')
),
remaining_keys AS (
    -- Set intersection on keys
    SELECT country
    FROM base
    INTERSECT
    SELECT country
    FROM suppliers
    WHERE country = 'UK'
),
reconciled AS (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    SELECT s.*
    FROM base s
    INNER JOIN remaining_keys k ON s.country = k.country
)
SELECT
    supplier_name,
    city,
    rating,
    rating_band,
    city_clean,
    launch_date,
    launch_date_plus_19d,
    city_clean_2
FROM reconciled
ORDER BY launch_date_plus_19d

    .withColumn("rating_band", F.when(F.col("rating") >= 4.4, "High").when(F.col("rating") >= 1.6, "Medium").otherwise("Low"))
    .withColumn("city_clean", F.coalesce("city", F.lit("DIRECT")))
)

with_latest = (
    filtered
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_products.alias("c"), (F.col("c.supplier_id") == F.col("s.id")), "left")
    .withColumn("rn", F.row_number().over(w))
    .filter(F.col("rn") == 1)
    .select("s.*", F.col("c.launch_date"))
)

base = (
    with_latest
    .filter(F.col("city").isin(["Chiang Mai", "Singapore"]))

    .join(remaining_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.country") == F.col("k.country")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

result = (

    .select(
        "supplier_name",

WITH base AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        *,
        CASE WHEN device = 'desktop' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_desktop,
        CASE WHEN browser IN ('Safari', 'Edge') THEN 'Tier 1' ELSE 'Other' END AS browser_group,
        COALESCE(browser, 'UNKNOWN') AS browser_filled
    FROM sessions
    WHERE started_at > DATE '2024-03-24'
      AND browser IS NOT NULL
),
scored AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        id,
        customer_id,
        device,
        browser,
        started_at,
        country,
        is_desktop,
        browser_group,
        browser_filled,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY started_at DESC, id) AS seq_no,
        LAG(is_desktop, 2) OVER (PARTITION BY device ORDER BY started_at, id) AS prev_is_desktop,
        NTILE(10) OVER (PARTITION BY country, device ORDER BY is_desktop DESC, id) AS is_desktop_bucket
    FROM base
),
eligible AS (
    -- Anti-join via a correlated subquery
    SELECT s.*
    FROM scored s
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM web_events ch
            WHERE ch.session_id = s.id
              AND ch.event_time < s.started_at
        )
),
totals AS (
    -- Multi-level aggregation
    SELECT
        CASE WHEN prev_is_desktop >= 69 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END AS prev_is_desktop_tier,
        COUNT_IF(device = 'mobile') AS mobile_events,
        AVG(seq_no) AS avg_seq_no,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE browser = 'Firefox') AS firefox_rows,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN country = 'DE' THEN 1 END) AS de_count,
        COUNT_IF(browser = 'Firefox') AS firefox_events
    FROM eligible
    GROUP BY CASE WHEN prev_is_desktop >= 69 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END
)
SELECT
    prev_is_desktop_tier,
    mobile_events,
    avg_seq_no,
    firefox_rows,
    de_count,
    firefox_events
FROM totals
ORDER BY prev_is_desktop_tier
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("customer_id").orderBy(F.col("started_at").desc(), "id")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("device").orderBy("started_at", "id")
w3 = Window.partitionBy("country", "device").orderBy(F.col("is_desktop").desc(), "id")

base = (
    df_sessions
    .filter((F.col("started_at") > F.lit("2024-03-24").cast("date")) & F.col("browser").isNotNull())
    .withColumn("is_desktop", F.when(F.col("device") == "desktop", 1).otherwise(0))
    .withColumn("browser_group", F.when(F.col("browser").isin(["Safari", "Edge"]), "Tier 1").otherwise("Other"))
    .withColumn("browser_filled", F.coalesce("browser", F.lit("UNKNOWN")))
)

scored = (
    base
    .withColumn("seq_no", F.row_number().over(w))
    .withColumn("prev_is_desktop", F.lag("is_desktop", 2).over(w2))
    .withColumn("is_desktop_bucket", F.ntile(10).over(w3))
)

eligible = (
    scored
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_web_events.alias("ch"), (F.col("ch.session_id") == F.col("s.id")) & (F.col("ch.event_time") < F.col("s.started_at")), "left_anti")
)

totals = (
    eligible
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("prev_is_desktop") >= 69, "HIGH").otherwise("LOW").alias("prev_is_desktop_tier"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.count_if(F.col("device") == "mobile").alias("mobile_events"),
        F.avg("seq_no").alias("avg_seq_no"),
        F.count(F.when(F.col("browser") == "Firefox", 1)).alias("firefox_rows"),
        F.count(F.when(F.col("country") == "DE", 1)).alias("de_count"),
        F.count_if(F.col("browser") == "Firefox").alias("firefox_events"),
    )
)

result = (
    totals
    .select(
        "prev_is_desktop_tier",
        "mobile_events",
        "avg_seq_no",
        "firefox_rows",
        "de_count",
        "firefox_events",
    )
    .orderBy("prev_is_desktop_tier")
)

WITH cleaned AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT
        id,
        store_name,
        city,
        opened_date,
        sqft,
        LOWER(store_name) AS store_name_lower
    FROM stores
    WHERE opened_date > DATE '2023-07-05'
      AND region IS NOT NULL
),
eligible AS (
    -- Semi-join via a correlated subquery
    SELECT s.*
    FROM cleaned s
    WHERE EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM orders c
            WHERE c.store_id = s.id
              AND c.order_date < s.opened_date
        )
),
with_windows AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        id,
        store_name,
        city,
        opened_date,
        sqft,
        store_name_lower,
        NTILE(4) OVER (PARTITION BY city ORDER BY sqft DESC, id) AS sqft_bucket,
        AVG(sqft) OVER (PARTITION BY city ORDER BY opened_date, id ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS sqft_avg_2
    FROM eligible
)
-- Grouped metrics
SELECT
    city,
    AVG(sqft_bucket) AS avg_sqft_bucket,
    ROUND(AVG(sqft_avg_2), 2) AS avg_sqft_avg_2,
    STDDEV_SAMP(sqft) AS sqft_stddev
FROM with_windows
GROUP BY city
ORDER BY avg_sqft_avg_2 DESC NULLS LAST

    from device_readings

      and device_code in ('DV-02', 'DV-04', 'DV-03')

gaps as (

    from cleaned
),
islands as (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number

    from gaps
)
-- Aggregate with conditional metrics
select
    case when island_id >= 7 then 'LARGE' else 'SMALL' end as island_id_tier,
    corr(temp_c, pressure) as corr_temp_c_pressure,
    count(distinct id) as distinct_ids,
    count_if(device_code = 'DV-02') as dv_02_events,
    size(collect_set(device_code)) as num_device_codes
from islands
group by 1
order by island_id_tier nulls last;

    FROM departments
    WHERE dept_name IN ('Marketing', 'Finance', 'Legal')

        location,
        budget,
        dept_name_prefix,

    FROM kept_rows_departments
    WHERE dept_name IS NOT NULL
      AND budget_rounded BETWEEN 45 AND 48

    WHERE budget >= 2949000

cleaned = (

)

kept_keys = (

    .exceptAll(

)

)

discount_pct_tier, case when subscription_id >= 10 then 'LARGE' else 'SMALL' end as subscription_id_tier, channel, percentile_approx(row_seq, 0.95) as row_seq_p95, size(collect_set(promo_code)) as num_promo_codes, count(case when plan = 'basic' then 1 end) as basic_count from attributed group by grouping sets ((case when discount_pct >= 0.34 then 'PREMIUM' else 'STANDARD' end, case when subscription_id >= 10 then 'LARGE' else 'SMALL' end, channel), (case when discount_pct >= 0.34 then 'PREMIUM' else 'STANDARD' end, case when subscription_id >= 10 then 'LARGE' else 'SMALL' end), (case when discount_pct >= 0.34 then 'PREMIUM' else 'STANDARD' end), ());
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy(F.col("s.id")).orderBy(F.col("c.amount").desc(), F.col("c.id").desc())
w2 = Window.partitionBy("promo_code", "channel").orderBy("order_date", "id", "promo_id")
w3 = Window.partitionBy("store_id").orderBy("discount", "id", "promo_id")

base = (
    df_orders
    .filter(F.col("order_date") > F.lit("2023-06-14").cast("date"))
    .select(
        "id",
        "customer_id",
        "store_id",
        "order_date",
        "channel",
        "amount",
        "discount",
        "shipping_fee",
        F.datediff(F.current_date(), "order_date").alias("days_since_order_date"),
    )
)

valid = (
    base
    .filter(~F.col("channel").isin(["store", "partner"]))
    .withColumn("order_date_period", F.date_trunc("month", "order_date"))
)

not_flagged = (
    valid
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_order_items.alias("c"), (F.col("c.order_id") == F.col("s.id")) & (F.col("c.unit_price") < 220), "left_anti")
)

latest_match = (
    not_flagged
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_payments.alias("c"), (F.col("c.order_id") == F.col("s.id")), "inner")
    .withColumn("rn", F.row_number().over(w))
    .filter(F.col("rn") == 1)
    .select(
        "s.*",
        F.col("c.amount").alias("payment_amount"),
        F.col("c.status").alias("payment_status"),
    )
)

with_window = (
    latest_match
    .alias("e")
    .join(df_promotions.alias("pr"), (F.coalesce(F.col("e.channel"), F.lit("store")) == F.col("pr.channel")) & (F.col("e.order_date") >= F.col("pr.starts_on")) & (F.col("e.order_date") <= F.date_add(F.col("pr.ends_on"), 10)), "left")
    .select(
        "e.*",
        F.col("pr.id").alias("promo_id"),
        F.col("pr.promo_code"),
        F.col("pr.discount_pct"),
    )
)

metrics = (
    with_window
    .withColumn("row_seq", F.row_number().over(w2))
    .withColumn("next_discount_pct", F.lead("discount_pct", 2).over(w3))
)

attributed = (
    metrics
    .alias("a")
    .join(df_subscriptions.alias("sub"), (F.col("a.customer_id") == F.col("sub.customer_id")) & (F.col("a.order_date_period") >= F.col("sub.start_date")) & (F.col("a.order_date_period") < F.col("sub.end_date") + F.expr("INTERVAL 7 DAYS")), "left")
    .select(
        "a.*",
        F.col("sub.id").alias("subscription_id"),
        F.col("sub.plan"),
        F.col("sub.monthly_fee"),
    )
)

result = (
    attributed
    .withColumn("discount_pct_tier", F.when(F.col("discount_pct") >= 0.34, "PREMIUM").otherwise("STANDARD"))
    .withColumn("subscription_id_tier", F.when(F.col("subscription_id") >= 10, "LARGE").otherwise("SMALL"))
    .groupingSets(
        [["discount_pct_tier", "subscription_id_tier", "channel"], ["discount_pct_tier", "subscription_id_tier"], ["discount_pct_tier"], []],
        "discount_pct_tier",
        "subscription_id_tier",
        "channel",
    )
    .agg(
        F.percentile_approx("row_seq", 0.95).alias("row_seq_p95"),
        F.size(F.collect_set("promo_code")).alias("num_promo_codes"),
        F.count(F.when(F.col("plan") == "basic", 1)).alias("basic_count"),
    )
)

WITH flattened AS (
    -- Unnest the array into one row per element
    SELECT
        id,
        plan,
        currency,
        EXPLODE(tier_prices) AS tier_value
    FROM price_tiers
),
metrics AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        *,
        CUME_DIST() OVER w_grp AS tier_value_cume_dist,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY tier_value NULLS FIRST) AS tier_value_dense_rank
    FROM flattened
    WINDOW w_grp AS (PARTITION BY plan ORDER BY tier_value DESC NULLS LAST)
),
filtered AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT
        id,
        plan,
        currency,
        tier_value_cume_dist,
        tier_value_dense_rank,
        CASE WHEN currency IN ('USD', 'EUR') THEN 'Core' ELSE 'Other' END AS currency_group,
        CAST(tier_value_dense_rank AS DOUBLE) AS tier_value_dense_rank_num
    FROM metrics
    WHERE currency IN ('THB', 'EUR', 'USD')
),
cleaned AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT *, COALESCE(tier_value_dense_rank_num, 0) AS tier_value_dense_rank_num_filled
    FROM filtered
    WHERE tier_value_dense_rank_num < 65
)
-- Window metrics over several different partitions
SELECT
    *,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY tier_value_dense_rank_num DESC) AS tier_value_dense_rank_num_rank,
    CUME_DIST() OVER (ORDER BY tier_value_dense_rank_num_filled DESC NULLS LAST) AS tier_value_dense_rank_num_filled_cume_dist,
    MIN(tier_value_dense_rank_num) OVER (PARTITION BY currency) AS currency_min_tier_value_dense_rank_num,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY tier_value_cume_dist DESC NULLS FIRST) AS tier_value_cume_dist_dense_rank
FROM cleaned

from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w_grp = Window.partitionBy("plan").orderBy(F.col("tier_value").desc_nulls_last())
w2 = Window.orderBy(F.col("tier_value").asc_nulls_first())
w3 = Window.orderBy(F.col("tier_value_dense_rank_num").desc())
w4 = Window.orderBy(F.col("tier_value_dense_rank_num_filled").desc_nulls_last())
w5 = Window.partitionBy("currency")
w6 = Window.orderBy(F.col("tier_value_cume_dist").desc_nulls_first())

    df_price_tiers
    .select("id", "plan", "currency", F.explode("tier_prices").alias("tier_value"))
)

metrics = (
    flattened
    .withColumn("tier_value_cume_dist", F.cume_dist().over(w_grp))
    .withColumn("tier_value_dense_rank", F.dense_rank().over(w2))
)

filtered = (
    metrics
    .filter(F.col("currency").isin(["THB", "EUR", "USD"]))
    .select(
        "id",
        "plan",
        "currency",
        "tier_value_cume_dist",
        "tier_value_dense_rank",

    )
)

    .filter(F.col("tier_value_dense_rank_num") < 65)

)

WITH valid AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT *, INITCAP(TRIM(carrier)) AS carrier_title
    FROM shipments
    WHERE shipped_date > TO_DATE('2023-03-05')
),
cleaned AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT *, CONCAT_WS(',', status, carrier) AS status_carrier_key
    FROM valid
    WHERE shipped_date > DATE '2023-05-24'
),
enriched AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        *,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY carrier ORDER BY shipped_date DESC, id) AS row_seq,
        ROUND(cost / SUM(cost) OVER (PARTITION BY order_id), 4) AS cost_share,
        LEAD(cost, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY carrier ORDER BY shipped_date, id) AS next_cost
    FROM cleaned
)
-- Aggregate with conditional metrics
SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('QUARTER', delivered_date) AS quarter_start,
    ROUND(SUM(cost) / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN carrier = 'DHL' THEN 1 END), 0), 2) AS cost_per_dhl,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN carrier = 'FedEx' THEN 1 END) AS fedex_count
FROM enriched
GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('QUARTER', delivered_date)
HAVING fedex_count >= 1
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("carrier").orderBy(F.col("shipped_date").desc(), "id")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("order_id")
w3 = Window.partitionBy("carrier").orderBy("shipped_date", "id")

valid = (
    df_shipments
    .filter(F.col("shipped_date") > F.to_date(F.lit("2023-03-05")))
    .select("*", F.initcap(F.trim("carrier")).alias("carrier_title"))
)

cleaned = (
    valid
    .filter(F.col("shipped_date") > F.lit("2023-05-24").cast("date"))
    .withColumn("status_carrier_key", F.concat_ws(",", "status", "carrier"))
)

enriched = (
    cleaned
    .withColumn("row_seq", F.row_number().over(w))
    .withColumn("cost_share", F.round((F.col("cost") / F.sum("cost").over(w2)), 4))
    .withColumn("next_cost", F.lead("cost", 1).over(w3))
)

result = (
    enriched
    .groupBy(F.date_trunc("QUARTER", "delivered_date").alias("quarter_start"))
    .agg(
        F.round(F.sum("cost") / F.nullif(F.count(F.when(F.col("carrier") == "DHL", 1)), F.lit(0)), 2).alias("cost_per_dhl"),
        F.count(F.when(F.col("carrier") == "FedEx", 1)).alias("fedex_count"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("fedex_count") >= 1)
)

sql: WITH base AS (SELECT * FROM shipments WHERE carrier = 'Flash' AND (carrier <> 'DHL' OR cost >= 27)), summary AS (SELECT status, CASE WHEN carrier IN ('Flash', 'DHL') THEN 'tier_1' ELSE 'other' END carrier_group, MAX(cost) max_cost, SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_SET(carrier)) carrier_list FROM base GROUP BY status, CASE WHEN carrier IN ('Flash', 'DHL') THEN 'tier_1' ELSE 'other' END) SELECT * FROM summary ORDER BY status, max_cost DESC;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

base = (
    df_shipments
    .filter((F.col("carrier") == "Flash") & ((F.col("carrier") != "DHL") | (F.col("cost") >= 27)))
)

summary = (
    base
    .groupBy(
        "status",
        F.when(F.col("carrier").isin(["Flash", "DHL"]), "tier_1").otherwise("other").alias("carrier_group"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.max("cost").alias("max_cost"),
        F.sort_array(F.collect_set("carrier")).alias("carrier_list"),
    )
)

result = summary.orderBy("status", F.col("max_cost").desc())

        promo_code,
        starts_on,
        ends_on,
        discount_pct,
        DATE_FORMAT(starts_on, 'yyyy-MM-dd') starts_on_label

      AND ends_on <= '2025-08-08'

sql: WITH enriched AS (SELECT s.*, p.country, p.device, p.browser FROM web_events s INNER JOIN sessions p ON s.session_id = p.id), joined AS (SELECT src.*, p.device AS session_device, p.country AS session_country, p.browser AS session_browser FROM enriched src INNER JOIN sessions p ON src.session_id = p.id), latest AS (SELECT *, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY session_device, browser ORDER BY event_time DESC NULLS LAST) AS rn FROM joined QUALIFY rn = 1) SELECT event_type, CASE WHEN duration_sec >= 495 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END AS duration_sec_tier, MIN(duration_sec) AS min_duration_sec, (UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MAX(event_time)) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MIN(event_time))) / 60 AS duration_min FROM latest GROUP BY event_type, duration_sec_tier HAVING min_duration_sec > 0 ORDER BY event_type DESC;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("session_device", "browser").orderBy(F.col("event_time").desc_nulls_last())

enriched = (
    df_web_events
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_sessions.alias("p"), F.col("s.session_id") == F.col("p.id"), "inner")
    .select("s.*", F.col("p.country"), F.col("p.device"), F.col("p.browser"))
)

joined = (

        F.col("p.country").alias("session_country"),
        F.col("p.browser").alias("session_browser"),
    )
)

latest = (
    joined
    .withColumn("rn", F.rank().over(w))
    .filter(F.col("rn") == 1)
)

result = (
    latest
    .groupBy(
        "event_type",
        F.when(F.col("duration_sec") >= 495, "PREMIUM").otherwise("STANDARD").alias("duration_sec_tier"),

    .orderBy(F.col("event_type").desc())
)

code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

    df_orders

    .join(df_subscriptions.alias("sub"), (F.col("s.customer_id") == F.col("sub.customer_id")) & F.col("s.order_date").between(F.col("sub.start_date"), F.col("sub.end_date")), "inner")

with valid as (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    select
        *,
        substring(country, 1, 3) as country_prefix,
        ceil(rating) as rating_whole,
        coalesce(city, 'UNKNOWN') as city_clean
    from suppliers
    where supplier_name like '%Tokyo%'
),
ranked as (
    -- QUALIFY-style window filter
    select *
    from valid
    qualify row_number() over (partition by country order by rating_whole, id) = 1
),
scored as (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    select
        *,
        avg(rating_whole) over (partition by city, country order by rating, id rows between 3 preceding and current row) as rating_whole_avg_3,
        avg(rating) over (partition by country order by rating_whole, id rows between 3 preceding and current row) as rating_avg_3,
        avg(rating_whole) over (partition by city order by rating, id rows between 5 preceding and current row) as rating_whole_avg_5
    from ranked
)
select
    id,
    country,
    rating_whole_avg_3,
    rating_whole_avg_5
from scored

w2 = Window.partitionBy("city", "country").orderBy("rating", "id").rowsBetween(-3, Window.currentRow)
w3 = Window.partitionBy("country").orderBy("rating_whole", "id").rowsBetween(-3, Window.currentRow)

    .select(

WITH valid AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT
        id,
        full_name,
        email,
        dept_id,
        manager_id,
        job_title,
        salary,
        hire_date,
        is_remote,
        level,
        REGEXP_EXTRACT(email, '@(.+)$', 1) AS email_domain
    FROM employees
    WHERE hire_date > '2023-03-01'
),
deduped AS (
    -- Keep one row per key (latest first)
    SELECT *
    FROM (
        SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY level ORDER BY salary DESC, id) AS latest_rank
        FROM valid
    ) ranked
    WHERE latest_rank = 1
),
enriched AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        *,
        LEAD(salary, 1) OVER w_recent AS next_salary,
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY salary DESC) AS salary_rank
    FROM deduped
    WINDOW w_recent AS (PARTITION BY job_title, level ORDER BY latest_rank, id)
),
with_dims AS (
    -- Attach departments attributes
    SELECT
        s.*,
        b.dept_name,
        b.budget,
        b.location
    FROM enriched s
    LEFT JOIN departments b
        ON s.dept_id = b.id
),
with_windows AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        id,
        full_name,
        email,
        dept_id,
        manager_id,
        job_title,
        salary,
        hire_date,
        is_remote,
        level,
        email_domain,
        latest_rank,
        next_salary,
        salary_rank,
        dept_name,
        budget,
        location,
        NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY salary DESC, id) AS salary_bucket,
        FIRST_VALUE(budget, TRUE) OVER (PARTITION BY dept_id ORDER BY hire_date, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS first_known_budget,
        ROUND(budget / SUM(budget) OVER (PARTITION BY job_title), 4) AS budget_share,
        SUM(budget) OVER (ORDER BY latest_rank, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_budget
    FROM with_dims
)
-- Native SQL UNPIVOT (wide to long)
SELECT *
FROM (
    SELECT
        id,
        location,
        next_salary,
        budget_share
    FROM with_windows
) src
UNPIVOT (
    val FOR measure IN (next_salary, budget_share AS BUDGET_SHARE_VAL)

with flattened as (
    -- Unnest the array into one row per element
    select
        id,
        service,
        log_ts,
        level,
        latency_ms,
        attr_key,
        v
    from app_logs
    lateral view outer explode(context) e as attr_key, v
),
metrics as (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    select
        *,
        percent_rank() over (partition by attr_key order by latency_ms desc) as latency_ms_percent_rank,
        sum(latency_ms) over (order by cast(log_ts as bigint) asc range between 3600 preceding and current row) as latency_ms_sum_1h,
        count(latency_ms) over (order by cast(log_ts as bigint) asc range between 3600 preceding and current row) as latency_ms_count_1h
    from flattened
),
metrics_app_logs as (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    select
        *,
        avg(latency_ms) over w_ordered as latency_ms_avg_30m,
        dense_rank() over (order by latency_ms_count_1h desc nulls last) as latency_ms_count_1h_dense_rank,
        max(latency_ms) over w_running as latency_ms_max_2h
    from metrics
    window w_ordered as (order by cast(log_ts as bigint) asc range between 1800 preceding and current row), w_running as (partition by service order by cast(log_ts as bigint) asc range between 7200 preceding and current row)
),
kept_keys as (
    -- Set intersection on keys
    select service, id
    from metrics_app_logs
    intersect all
    select service, id
    from app_logs
    where status_code <= 317
),
reconciled as (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    select s.*
    from metrics_app_logs s
    inner join kept_keys k on s.service = k.service and s.id = k.id
),
filtered as (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    select *, datediff(current_date(), log_ts) as days_since_log_ts
    from reconciled
    where log_ts >= timestamp '2025-06-01 14:00:00'
      and attr_key is not null
),
enriched as (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    select
        *,
        round(latency_ms / sum(latency_ms) over (partition by service), 4) as latency_ms_share,
        avg(days_since_log_ts) over (partition by attr_key) as attr_key_avg_days_since_log_ts
    from filtered
),
valid as (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    select
        id,
        service,
        level,
        v,
        latency_ms_percent_rank,
        latency_ms_sum_1h,
        latency_ms_count_1h,
        latency_ms_avg_30m,
        latency_ms_count_1h_dense_rank,
        latency_ms_max_2h,
        latency_ms_share,
        attr_key_avg_days_since_log_ts,
        round(latency_ms / latency_ms_count_1h_dense_rank, 2) as latency_ms_per_latency_ms_count_1h_dense_rank
    from enriched
    where log_ts >= timestamp '2025-06-01 10:00:00'
)
-- Grouped metrics
select
    service,
    case when latency_ms_max_2h >= 2072 then 'HIGH' else 'LOW' end as latency_ms_max_2h_tier,
    case when latency_ms_avg_30m >= 2004 then 'HIGH' else 'LOW' end as latency_ms_avg_30m_tier,
    avg(latency_ms_per_latency_ms_count_1h_dense_rank) filter (where level = 'WARN') as warn_avg_latency_ms_per_latency_ms_count_1h_dense_rank,
    size(collect_set(level)) as num_levels,
    round(avg(latency_ms_percent_rank), 2) as avg_latency_ms_percent_rank,
    sum(latency_ms_avg_30m) as total_latency_ms_avg_30m
from valid
group by grouping sets ((service, case when latency_ms_max_2h >= 2072 then 'HIGH' else 'LOW' end, case when latency_ms_avg_30m >= 2004 then 'HIGH' else 'LOW' end), (service, case when latency_ms_max_2h >= 2072 then 'HIGH' else 'LOW' end))
order by latency_ms_avg_30m_tier asc nulls first;

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("attr_key").orderBy(F.col("latency_ms").desc())
w2 = Window.orderBy(F.col("log_ts").cast("bigint")).rangeBetween(-3600, Window.currentRow)
w_ordered = Window.orderBy(F.col("log_ts").cast("bigint")).rangeBetween(-1800, Window.currentRow)
w4 = Window.orderBy(F.col("latency_ms_count_1h").desc_nulls_last())
w_running = Window.partitionBy("service").orderBy(F.col("log_ts").cast("bigint")).rangeBetween(-7200, Window.currentRow)
w6 = Window.partitionBy("service")
w7 = Window.partitionBy("attr_key")

flattened = (
    df_app_logs
    .select(
        "id",
        "service",
        "log_ts",
        "level",
        "latency_ms",
        F.explode_outer("context").alias("attr_key", "v"),
    )
)

metrics = (
    flattened
    .withColumn("latency_ms_percent_rank", F.percent_rank().over(w))
    .withColumn("latency_ms_sum_1h", F.sum("latency_ms").over(w2))
    .withColumn("latency_ms_count_1h", F.count("latency_ms").over(w2))
)

metrics_app_logs = (
    metrics
    .withColumn("latency_ms_avg_30m", F.avg("latency_ms").over(w_ordered))
    .withColumn("latency_ms_count_1h_dense_rank", F.dense_rank().over(w4))
    .withColumn("latency_ms_max_2h", F.max("latency_ms").over(w_running))
)

kept_keys = (
    metrics_app_logs
    .select("service", "id")
    .intersectAll(
        df_app_logs
        .filter(F.col("status_code") <= 317)
        .select("service", "id")
    )
)

reconciled = (
    metrics_app_logs
    .alias("s")
    .join(kept_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.service") == F.col("k.service")) & (F.col("s.id") == F.col("k.id")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

filtered = (
    reconciled
    .filter((F.col("log_ts") >= F.lit("2025-06-01 14:00:00").cast("timestamp")) & F.col("attr_key").isNotNull())
    .select("*", F.datediff(F.current_date(), "log_ts").alias("days_since_log_ts"))
)

enriched = (
    filtered
    .withColumn("latency_ms_share", F.round((F.col("latency_ms") / F.sum("latency_ms").over(w6)), 4))
    .withColumn("attr_key_avg_days_since_log_ts", F.avg("days_since_log_ts").over(w7))
)

valid = (
    enriched
    .filter(F.col("log_ts") >= F.lit("2025-06-01 10:00:00").cast("timestamp"))
    .select(
        "id",
        "service",
        "level",
        "v",
        "latency_ms_percent_rank",
        "latency_ms_sum_1h",
        "latency_ms_count_1h",
        "latency_ms_avg_30m",
        "latency_ms_count_1h_dense_rank",
        "latency_ms_max_2h",
        "latency_ms_share",
        "attr_key_avg_days_since_log_ts",
        F.round((F.col("latency_ms") / F.col("latency_ms_count_1h_dense_rank")), 2).alias("latency_ms_per_latency_ms_count_1h_dense_rank"),
    )
)

result = (
    valid
    .withColumn("latency_ms_max_2h_tier", F.when(F.col("latency_ms_max_2h") >= 2072, "HIGH").otherwise("LOW"))
    .withColumn("latency_ms_avg_30m_tier", F.when(F.col("latency_ms_avg_30m") >= 2004, "HIGH").otherwise("LOW"))
    .groupingSets(
        [["service", "latency_ms_max_2h_tier", "latency_ms_avg_30m_tier"], ["service", "latency_ms_max_2h_tier"]],
        "service",
        "latency_ms_max_2h_tier",
        "latency_ms_avg_30m_tier",
    )
    .agg(
        F.avg(F.when(F.col("level") == "WARN", F.col("latency_ms_per_latency_ms_count_1h_dense_rank"))).alias("warn_avg_latency_ms_per_latency_ms_count_1h_dense_rank"),
        F.size(F.collect_set("level")).alias("num_levels"),
        F.round(F.avg("latency_ms_percent_rank"), 2).alias("avg_latency_ms_percent_rank"),
        F.sum("latency_ms_avg_30m").alias("total_latency_ms_avg_30m"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("latency_ms_avg_30m_tier").asc_nulls_first())
)

WITH valid AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        store_id,
        product_id,
        sale_date,
        units,
        revenue,
        ROUND(units * 0.85, 2) AS units_adjusted,
        COALESCE(units, 0) AS units_filled
    FROM store_sales

),
valid_store_sales AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        store_id,
        product_id,
        units,
        units_adjusted,
        units_filled,
        ROUND(units_adjusted * 0.85, 2) AS units_adjusted_scaled,
        CEIL(units_filled) AS units_filled_whole
    FROM valid
    WHERE sale_date >= DATE '2023-05-02'
      AND store_id IN (1, 4)
),
kept_keys AS (
    SELECT product_id
    FROM valid_store_sales
    INTERSECT ALL
    SELECT product_id
    FROM store_sales
    WHERE revenue <= 4000
),
reconciled AS (
    SELECT s.*
    FROM valid_store_sales s
    JOIN kept_keys k ON s.product_id = k.product_id
),
kept_keys_2 AS (
    SELECT product_id, id
    FROM reconciled
    EXCEPT
    SELECT product_id, id
    FROM store_sales
    WHERE sale_date < '2023-08-09'
),
kept_rows AS (
    SELECT s.*
    FROM reconciled s
    JOIN kept_keys_2 k ON s.product_id = k.product_id AND s.id = k.id
)
SELECT
    product_id,
    units_filled,
    units_adjusted_scaled,
    units_filled_whole
FROM kept_rows

WITH filtered AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT
        *,
        UPPER(status) AS status_upper,
        COALESCE(status, 'DIRECT') AS resolved_status
    FROM accounts
    WHERE opened_date >= TO_DATE('2024-03-23')
      AND customer_id IS NOT NULL
      AND account_type IN ('SAVINGS', 'CREDIT')
),
metrics AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        *,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY account_type ORDER BY balance NULLS LAST) AS balance_dense_rank,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY account_type ORDER BY balance DESC NULLS LAST) AS balance_rank,
        AVG(balance) OVER w_running AS balance_avg_2_prior,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER w_grp AS event_seq
    FROM filtered
    WINDOW w_running AS (ORDER BY opened_date, id ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING), w_grp AS (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY opened_date DESC, id)
),
with_windows AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        id,
        customer_id,
        account_type,
        balance,
        opened_date,
        status,
        status_upper,
        resolved_status,
        balance_dense_rank,
        balance_rank,
        balance_avg_2_prior,
        event_seq,
        SUM(event_seq) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY event_seq, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_event_seq,
        AVG(balance_avg_2_prior) OVER (ORDER BY balance_dense_rank, id ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS balance_avg_2_prior_avg_6,
        LAST_VALUE(event_seq, TRUE) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY balance_rank, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS last_known_event_seq
    FROM metrics
),
latest_match AS (
    -- Latest matching transaction per row (LATERAL ... LIMIT 1)
    SELECT s.*, latest.transaction_txn_time
    FROM with_windows s
    JOIN LATERAL (
            SELECT c.txn_time AS transaction_txn_time
            FROM transactions c
            WHERE c.account_id = s.id
            ORDER BY c.txn_time DESC, c.id DESC
            LIMIT 1
        ) latest ON TRUE
),
latest_match_accounts AS (
    -- Latest matching transaction per row (LATERAL ... LIMIT 1)
    SELECT
        s.*,
        x.txn_time,
        x.transaction_txn_type
    FROM latest_match s
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
            SELECT c.txn_time, c.txn_type AS transaction_txn_type
            FROM transactions c
            WHERE c.account_id = s.id
              AND c.txn_time <= s.opened_date
            ORDER BY c.txn_time DESC, c.id DESC
            LIMIT 1
        ) x ON TRUE
)
-- Aggregate with conditional metrics
SELECT
    CASE WHEN balance_dense_rank >= 7 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END AS balance_dense_rank_tier,
    DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', opened_date) AS activity_month,
    CASE WHEN balance_avg_2_prior_avg_6 >= 69199 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END AS balance_avg_2_prior_avg_6_tier,
    ROUND(AVG(event_seq), 2) AS avg_event_seq,
    ROUND(AVG(balance_avg_2_prior_avg_6), 2) AS avg_balance_avg_2_prior_avg_6,
    GROUPING_ID() AS grouping_level
FROM latest_match_accounts
GROUP BY ROLLUP (CASE WHEN balance_dense_rank >= 7 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END, DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', opened_date), CASE WHEN balance_avg_2_prior_avg_6 >= 69199 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END);
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("account_type").orderBy(F.col("balance").asc_nulls_last())
w2 = Window.partitionBy("account_type").orderBy(F.col("balance").desc_nulls_last())
w_running = Window.orderBy("opened_date", "id").rowsBetween(-2, -1)
w_grp = Window.partitionBy("customer_id").orderBy(F.col("opened_date").desc(), "id")
w5 = Window.partitionBy("customer_id").orderBy("event_seq", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w6 = Window.orderBy("balance_dense_rank", "id").rowsBetween(-6, Window.currentRow)
w7 = Window.partitionBy("customer_id").orderBy("balance_rank", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w8 = Window.partitionBy(F.col("s.id")).orderBy(F.col("c.txn_time").desc(), F.col("c.id").desc())

filtered = (
    df_accounts
    .filter((F.col("opened_date") >= F.to_date(F.lit("2024-03-23"))) & F.col("customer_id").isNotNull() & F.col("account_type").isin(["SAVINGS", "CREDIT"]))
    .select(
        "*",
        F.upper("status").alias("status_upper"),
        F.coalesce("status", F.lit("DIRECT")).alias("resolved_status"),
    )
)

metrics = (
    filtered
    .select(
        "*",
        F.dense_rank().over(w).alias("balance_dense_rank"),
        F.rank().over(w2).alias("balance_rank"),
        F.avg("balance").over(w_running).alias("balance_avg_2_prior"),
        F.row_number().over(w_grp).alias("event_seq"),
    )
)

with_windows = (
    metrics
    .withColumn("running_event_seq", F.sum("event_seq").over(w5))
    .withColumn("balance_avg_2_prior_avg_6", F.avg("balance_avg_2_prior").over(w6))
    .withColumn("last_known_event_seq", F.last("event_seq", ignorenulls=True).over(w7))
)

latest_match = (
    with_windows
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_transactions.alias("c"), (F.col("c.account_id") == F.col("s.id")), "inner")
    .withColumn("rn", F.row_number().over(w8))
    .filter(F.col("rn") == 1)
    .select("s.*", F.col("c.txn_time").alias("transaction_txn_time"))
)

latest_match_accounts = (
    latest_match
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_transactions.alias("c"), (F.col("c.account_id") == F.col("s.id")) & (F.col("c.txn_time") <= F.col("s.opened_date")), "left")
    .withColumn("rn", F.row_number().over(w8))
    .filter(F.col("rn") == 1)
    .select(
        "s.*",
        F.col("c.txn_time"),
        F.col("c.txn_type").alias("transaction_txn_type"),
    )
)

result = (
    latest_match_accounts
    .withColumn("balance_dense_rank_tier", F.when(F.col("balance_dense_rank") >= 7, "PREMIUM").otherwise("STANDARD"))
    .withColumn("activity_month", F.date_trunc("MONTH", "opened_date"))
    .withColumn("balance_avg_2_prior_avg_6_tier", F.when(F.col("balance_avg_2_prior_avg_6") >= 69199, "PREMIUM").otherwise("STANDARD"))
    .rollup(
        "balance_dense_rank_tier",
        "activity_month",
        "balance_avg_2_prior_avg_6_tier",
    )
    .agg(
        F.round(F.avg("event_seq"), 2).alias("avg_event_seq"),
        F.round(F.avg("balance_avg_2_prior_avg_6"), 2).alias("avg_balance_avg_2_prior_avg_6"),
        F.grouping_id().alias("grouping_level"),
    )
)

WITH base AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT
        id,
        customer_id,
        device,
        browser,
        started_at,
        country,
        CASE WHEN country = 'JP' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_jp
    FROM sessions
    WHERE customer_id IN (10, 12, 34, 40)
),
matched AS (
    -- Non-equi join on a validity window
    SELECT
        a.*,
        sub.id AS subscription_id,
        sub.plan,
        sub.monthly_fee
    FROM base a
    LEFT JOIN subscriptions sub
        ON a.customer_id = sub.customer_id
       AND a.started_at >= sub.start_date
       AND a.started_at < sub.end_date + INTERVAL 14 DAYS
),
not_flagged AS (
    -- Semi-join via a correlated subquery
    SELECT s.*
    FROM matched s
    WHERE EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM web_events x
            WHERE x.session_id = s.id
              AND x.event_time <= s.started_at
        )
),
latest AS (
    -- Keep one row per key (latest first)
    SELECT *
    FROM (
        SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id, browser ORDER BY subscription_id DESC, id ASC, subscription_id ASC) AS rn
        FROM not_flagged
    ) x
    WHERE rn = 1
)
SELECT
    id,
    customer_id,
    started_at,
    country,
    subscription_id,
    plan,
    monthly_fee,
    rn
FROM latest

WITH filtered AS (

            FROM subscriptions c

              AND c.start_date <= s.signup_date_month_end
            ORDER BY c.start_date DESC, c.id DESC

)

SELECT

sql: select quarter(s.opened_date) as opened_quarter, round((100 * sum(case when o.channel = 'store' then 1 else 0 end)) / count(*), 1) as pct_store from orders o inner join stores s on o.store_id = s.id where o.amount > 730 group by quarter(s.opened_date) having pct_store > 63 order by opened_quarter, pct_store desc limit 50
code:

    df_orders.alias("o")
    .join(df_stores.alias("s"), F.col("o.store_id") == F.col("s.id"), "inner")
    .filter(F.col("o.amount") > 730)
    .groupBy(F.quarter(F.col("s.opened_date")).alias("opened_quarter"))

    .filter(F.col("pct_store") > 63)
    .orderBy("opened_quarter", F.col("pct_store").desc())
    .limit(50)
)

WITH metrics AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        id,
        order_id,
        carrier,
        shipped_date,
        delivered_date,
        cost,
        status,
        NTILE(5) OVER w_ordered AS cost_bucket,
        NTILE(10) OVER w_ordered AS cost_bucket_2,
        NTILE(3) OVER w_recent AS cost_bucket_3
    FROM shipments
    WINDOW w_ordered AS (PARTITION BY order_id ORDER BY cost DESC, id), w_recent AS (PARTITION BY carrier, order_id ORDER BY cost, id)
),
with_windows AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        *,
        CUME_DIST() OVER (ORDER BY cost DESC NULLS FIRST) AS cost_cume_dist,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY status ORDER BY cost_bucket_2, id) AS event_seq,
        LAST_VALUE(cost_bucket) IGNORE NULLS OVER w_recent AS last_known_cost_bucket
    FROM metrics
    WINDOW w_recent AS (PARTITION BY order_id ORDER BY cost_bucket_3, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)
),
with_dims AS (
    -- Attach orders attributes
    SELECT
        a.*,
        b.order_date,
        b.shipping_fee
    FROM with_windows a
    JOIN orders b
        ON a.order_id = b.id
),
metrics_shipments AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        id,
        order_id,
        carrier,
        shipped_date,
        delivered_date,
        cost,
        status,
        cost_bucket,
        cost_bucket_2,
        cost_bucket_3,
        cost_cume_dist,
        event_seq,
        last_known_cost_bucket,
        order_date,
        shipping_fee,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY status ORDER BY cost_cume_dist, id) AS row_seq,
        CUME_DIST() OVER (PARTITION BY carrier ORDER BY event_seq DESC) AS event_seq_cume_dist
    FROM with_dims
),
joined AS (
    -- Attach orders attributes
    SELECT
        s.*,
        b.amount,
        b.discount
    FROM metrics_shipments s
    JOIN orders b
        ON s.order_id = b.id
),
enriched AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        *,
        AVG(event_seq) OVER (PARTITION BY carrier, status ORDER BY discount, id ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS event_seq_avg_3_prior,
        LEAD(event_seq_cume_dist, 1, 0) OVER w_recent AS next_event_seq_cume_dist
    FROM joined
    WINDOW w_recent AS (PARTITION BY carrier ORDER BY order_date, id)
),
enriched_shipments AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        *,
        ROUND(event_seq_avg_3_prior / SUM(event_seq_avg_3_prior) OVER (PARTITION BY carrier), 4) AS event_seq_avg_3_prior_share,
        AVG(discount) OVER (ORDER BY event_seq, id ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS discount_avg_6,
        AVG(event_seq_cume_dist) OVER (PARTITION BY status ORDER BY event_seq_cume_dist, id ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS event_seq_cume_dist_avg_2_prior,
        FIRST_VALUE(next_event_seq_cume_dist) IGNORE NULLS OVER (PARTITION BY status ORDER BY event_seq, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS first_known_next_event_seq_cume_dist,
        ROUND(event_seq / SUM(event_seq) OVER (PARTITION BY carrier), 4) AS event_seq_share
    FROM enriched
)
SELECT
    id,
    carrier,
    shipped_date,
    delivered_date,
    cost,
    status,
    cost_bucket,
    cost_bucket_3,
    event_seq
FROM enriched_shipments
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w_ordered = Window.partitionBy("order_id").orderBy(F.col("cost").desc(), "id")
w_recent = Window.partitionBy("carrier", "order_id").orderBy("cost", "id")
w3 = Window.orderBy(F.col("cost").desc_nulls_first())
w4 = Window.partitionBy("status").orderBy("cost_bucket_2", "id")
w5 = Window.partitionBy("order_id").orderBy("cost_bucket_3", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w6 = Window.partitionBy("status").orderBy("cost_cume_dist", "id")
w7 = Window.partitionBy("carrier").orderBy(F.col("event_seq").desc())
w8 = Window.partitionBy("carrier", "status").orderBy("discount", "id").rowsBetween(-3, -1)
w9 = Window.partitionBy("carrier").orderBy("order_date", "id")
w10 = Window.partitionBy("carrier")
w11 = Window.orderBy("event_seq", "id").rowsBetween(-6, Window.currentRow)
w12 = Window.partitionBy("status").orderBy("event_seq_cume_dist", "id").rowsBetween(-2, -1)
w13 = Window.partitionBy("status").orderBy("event_seq", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)

metrics = (
    df_shipments
    .select(
        "*",
        F.ntile(5).over(w_ordered).alias("cost_bucket"),
        F.ntile(10).over(w_ordered).alias("cost_bucket_2"),
        F.ntile(3).over(w_recent).alias("cost_bucket_3"),
    )
)

with_windows = (
    metrics
    .withColumn("cost_cume_dist", F.cume_dist().over(w3))
    .withColumn("event_seq", F.row_number().over(w4))
    .withColumn("last_known_cost_bucket", F.last("cost_bucket", ignorenulls=True).over(w5))
)

with_dims = (
    with_windows
    .alias("a")
    .join(df_orders.alias("b"), F.col("a.order_id") == F.col("b.id"), "inner")
    .select("a.*", F.col("b.order_date"), F.col("b.shipping_fee"))
)

metrics_shipments = (
    with_dims
    .withColumn("row_seq", F.row_number().over(w6))
    .withColumn("event_seq_cume_dist", F.cume_dist().over(w7))
)

joined = (
    metrics_shipments
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_orders.alias("b"), F.col("s.order_id") == F.col("b.id"), "inner")
    .select("s.*", F.col("b.amount"), F.col("b.discount"))
)

enriched = (
    joined
    .withColumn("event_seq_avg_3_prior", F.avg("event_seq").over(w8))
    .withColumn("next_event_seq_cume_dist", F.lead("event_seq_cume_dist", 1, 0).over(w9))
)

enriched_shipments = (
    enriched
    .select(
        "*",
        F.round((F.col("event_seq_avg_3_prior") / F.sum("event_seq_avg_3_prior").over(w10)), 4).alias("event_seq_avg_3_prior_share"),
        F.avg("discount").over(w11).alias("discount_avg_6"),
        F.avg("event_seq_cume_dist").over(w12).alias("event_seq_cume_dist_avg_2_prior"),
        F.first("next_event_seq_cume_dist", ignorenulls=True).over(w13).alias("first_known_next_event_seq_cume_dist"),
        F.round((F.col("event_seq") / F.sum("event_seq").over(w10)), 4).alias("event_seq_share"),
    )
)

result = (
    enriched_shipments
    .select(
        "id",
        "carrier",
        "shipped_date",
        "delivered_date",
        "cost",
        "status",
        "cost_bucket",
        "cost_bucket_3",
        "event_seq",
    )
)
