WITH filtered AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT
        id,
        account_id,
        txn_type,
        amount,
        HOUR(txn_time) AS txn_time_hour
    FROM transactions
    WHERE merchant IS NOT NULL
      AND txn_type IN ('REFUND', 'DEBIT', 'CREDIT')
),
enriched AS (
    -- Attach accounts attributes
    SELECT
        a.*,
        b.opened_date,
        b.status,
        b.balance
    FROM filtered a
    INNER JOIN accounts b
        ON a.account_id = b.id
),
kept_keys AS (
    -- Set difference on keys
    SELECT txn_type
    FROM enriched
    EXCEPT
    SELECT txn_type
    FROM transactions
    WHERE is_flagged = TRUE
),
verified AS (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    SELECT s.*
    FROM enriched s
    INNER JOIN kept_keys k ON s.txn_type = k.txn_type
),
scored AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        *,
        STDDEV_SAMP(txn_time_hour) OVER (PARTITION BY account_id) AS account_id_stddev_samp_txn_time_hour,
        AVG(amount) OVER (PARTITION BY txn_type, status) AS txn_type_avg_amount,
        MAX(amount) OVER (PARTITION BY txn_type, account_id) AS txn_type_max_amount,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY account_id, txn_type ORDER BY txn_time_hour NULLS FIRST) AS txn_time_hour_dense_rank
    FROM verified
),
enriched_transactions AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        *,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY account_id ORDER BY txn_time_hour DESC NULLS FIRST) AS txn_time_hour_rank,
        COUNT(txn_time_hour_dense_rank) OVER (PARTITION BY txn_type) AS txn_type_count_txn_time_hour_dense_rank
    FROM scored
),
enriched_transactions_2 AS (
    -- Attach accounts attributes
    SELECT
        s.*,
        b.account_type,
        b.status AS account_status
    FROM enriched_transactions s
    INNER JOIN accounts b
        ON s.account_id = b.id
)
-- Ranking and gap features
SELECT
    *,
    COUNT(txn_time_hour_rank) OVER w_ordered AS account_type_count_txn_time_hour_rank,
    MIN(account_id_stddev_samp_txn_time_hour) OVER (PARTITION BY status) AS status_min_account_id_stddev_samp_txn_time_hour,
    MIN(txn_time_hour) OVER (PARTITION BY account_status) AS account_status_min_txn_time_hour,
    MAX(txn_type_avg_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY txn_type) AS txn_type_max_txn_type_avg_amount
FROM enriched_transactions_2
WINDOW w_ordered AS (PARTITION BY account_type)
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("account_id")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("txn_type", "status")
w3 = Window.partitionBy("txn_type", "account_id")
w4 = Window.partitionBy("account_id", "txn_type").orderBy(F.col("txn_time_hour").asc_nulls_first())
w5 = Window.partitionBy("account_id").orderBy(F.col("txn_time_hour").desc_nulls_first())
w6 = Window.partitionBy("txn_type")
w_ordered = Window.partitionBy("account_type")
w8 = Window.partitionBy("status")
w9 = Window.partitionBy("account_status")

filtered = (
    df_transactions
    .filter(F.col("merchant").isNotNull() & F.col("txn_type").isin(["REFUND", "DEBIT", "CREDIT"]))
    .select(
        "id",
        "account_id",
        "txn_type",
        "amount",
        F.hour("txn_time").alias("txn_time_hour"),
    )
)

enriched = (
    filtered
    .alias("a")
    .join(df_accounts.alias("b"), F.col("a.account_id") == F.col("b.id"), "inner")
    .select("a.*", F.col("b.opened_date"), F.col("b.status"), F.col("b.balance"))
)

kept_keys = (
    enriched
    .select("txn_type")
    .subtract(
        df_transactions
        .filter(F.col("is_flagged"))
        .select("txn_type")
    )
)

verified = (
    enriched
    .alias("s")
    .join(kept_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.txn_type") == F.col("k.txn_type")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

scored = (
    verified
    .withColumn("account_id_stddev_samp_txn_time_hour", F.stddev_samp("txn_time_hour").over(w))
    .withColumn("txn_type_avg_amount", F.avg("amount").over(w2))
    .withColumn("txn_type_max_amount", F.max("amount").over(w3))
    .withColumn("txn_time_hour_dense_rank", F.dense_rank().over(w4))
)

enriched_transactions = (
    scored
    .withColumn("txn_time_hour_rank", F.rank().over(w5))
    .withColumn("txn_type_count_txn_time_hour_dense_rank", F.count("txn_time_hour_dense_rank").over(w6))
)

enriched_transactions_2 = (
    enriched_transactions
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_accounts.alias("b"), F.col("s.account_id") == F.col("b.id"), "inner")
    .select("s.*", F.col("b.account_type"), F.col("b.status").alias("account_status"))
)

result = (
    enriched_transactions_2
    .select(
        "*",
        F.count("txn_time_hour_rank").over(w_ordered).alias("account_type_count_txn_time_hour_rank"),
        F.min("account_id_stddev_samp_txn_time_hour").over(w8).alias("status_min_account_id_stddev_samp_txn_time_hour"),
        F.min("txn_time_hour").over(w9).alias("account_status_min_txn_time_hour"),
        F.max("txn_type_avg_amount").over(w6).alias("txn_type_max_txn_type_avg_amount"),
    )
)

with with_dims as (
    select
        src.*,
        p.dept_name,
        p.budget
    from employees src
    inner join departments p
        on src.dept_id = p.id
),
with_dims_employees as (
    select
        e.*,
        p.budget as department_budget,
        p.location
    from with_dims e
    left join departments p
        on e.dept_id = p.id
),
metrics as (
    select
        *,
        avg(salary) over (partition by manager_id order by department_budget, id rows between 3 preceding and current row) as salary_avg_3,
        row_number() over (partition by manager_id order by hire_date, id) as event_seq,
        percent_rank() over (partition by manager_id order by department_budget nulls last) as department_budget_percent_rank,
        count(salary) over (partition by dept_name) as dept_name_count_salary
    from with_dims_employees
)
select
    date_trunc('quarter', hire_date) as quarter_start,
    case when department_budget_percent_rank >= 0.68 then 'PREMIUM' else 'STANDARD' end as department_budget_percent_rank_tier,
    size(collect_set(location)) as num_locations,
    count_if(location = 'London') as london_events,
    count(distinct dept_name) as distinct_dept_names,
    approx_percentile(budget, 0.5) as budget_p50,
    round(sum(dept_name_count_salary) / nullif(count(case when location = 'Bangkok' then 1 end), 0), 2) as dept_name_count_salary_per_bangkok,
    rank() over (partition by date_trunc('quarter', hire_date) order by count_if(location = 'London') desc) as london_events_rank
from metrics
group by date_trunc('quarter', hire_date), case when department_budget_percent_rank >= 0.68 then 'PREMIUM' else 'STANDARD' end
order by distinct_dept_names;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("manager_id").orderBy("department_budget", "id").rowsBetween(-3, Window.currentRow)
w2 = Window.partitionBy("manager_id").orderBy("hire_date", "id")
w3 = Window.partitionBy("manager_id").orderBy(F.col("department_budget").asc_nulls_last())
w4 = Window.partitionBy("dept_name")
w5 = Window.partitionBy("quarter_start").orderBy(F.col("london_events").desc())

with_dims = (
    df_employees
    .alias("src")
    .join(df_departments.alias("p"), F.col("src.dept_id") == F.col("p.id"), "inner")
    .select("src.*", F.col("p.dept_name"), F.col("p.budget"))
)

with_dims_employees = (
    with_dims
    .alias("e")
    .join(df_departments.alias("p"), F.col("e.dept_id") == F.col("p.id"), "left")
    .select("e.*", F.col("p.budget").alias("department_budget"), F.col("p.location"))
)

metrics = (
    with_dims_employees
    .withColumn("salary_avg_3", F.avg("salary").over(w))
    .withColumn("event_seq", F.row_number().over(w2))
    .withColumn("department_budget_percent_rank", F.percent_rank().over(w3))
    .withColumn("dept_name_count_salary", F.count("salary").over(w4))
)

result = (
    metrics
    .groupBy(
        F.date_trunc("quarter", "hire_date").alias("quarter_start"),
        F.when(F.col("department_budget_percent_rank") >= 0.68, "PREMIUM").otherwise("STANDARD").alias("department_budget_percent_rank_tier"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.size(F.collect_set("location")).alias("num_locations"),
        F.count_if(F.col("location") == "London").alias("london_events"),
        F.countDistinct("dept_name").alias("distinct_dept_names"),
        F.percentile_approx("budget", 0.5).alias("budget_p50"),
        F.round(F.sum("dept_name_count_salary") / F.nullif(F.count(F.when(F.col("location") == "Bangkok", 1)), F.lit(0)), 2).alias("dept_name_count_salary_per_bangkok"),
    )
    .withColumn("london_events_rank", F.rank().over(w5))
    .orderBy("distinct_dept_names")
)

from store_sales
inner join products on store_sales.product_id = products.id
right outer join stores on store_sales.store_id = stores.id

result = (
    df_store_sales.alias("store_sales")
    .join(df_products.alias("products"), F.col("store_sales.product_id") == F.col("products.id"), "inner")

    )
    .filter(F.col("avg_revenue") > 45)
)

sql: WITH lines AS (SELECT id, service, host, log_ts, level, status_code, attr_key, attr_value FROM app_logs LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(context) t AS attr_key, attr_value), base AS (SELECT *, UPPER(attr_key) attr_key_upper, COALESCE(attr_key, 'OTHER') resolved_attr_key FROM lines WHERE attr_key IS NOT NULL), enriched AS (SELECT id, service, host, log_ts, level, status_code, attr_key, attr_value, attr_key_upper, resolved_attr_key, LAG(status_code, 2, 0) OVER (PARTITION BY level ORDER BY log_ts ASC, id ASC, attr_key ASC) prev_status_code, LAST_VALUE(attr_key) IGNORE NULLS OVER w_hist last_known_attr_key, RANK() OVER w_grp status_code_rank FROM base WINDOW w_hist AS (PARTITION BY attr_key ORDER BY log_ts ASC, id ASC, attr_key ASC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), w_grp AS (PARTITION BY host ORDER BY status_code ASC)) SELECT id, service, host, log_ts, level, attr_key, attr_key_upper, prev_status_code, last_known_attr_key FROM enriched;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("level").orderBy("log_ts", "id", "attr_key")
w_hist = Window.partitionBy("attr_key").orderBy("log_ts", "id", "attr_key").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w_grp = Window.partitionBy("host").orderBy("status_code")

lines = (
    df_app_logs
    .select(
        "id",
        "service",
        "host",
        "log_ts",
        "level",
        "status_code",
        F.explode("context").alias("attr_key", "attr_value"),
    )
)

base = (
    lines
    .filter(F.col("attr_key").isNotNull())
    .withColumn("attr_key_upper", F.upper("attr_key"))
    .withColumn("resolved_attr_key", F.coalesce("attr_key", F.lit("OTHER")))
)

enriched = (
    base
    .select(
        "*",
        F.lag("status_code", 2, 0).over(w).alias("prev_status_code"),
        F.last("attr_key", ignorenulls=True).over(w_hist).alias("last_known_attr_key"),
        F.rank().over(w_grp).alias("status_code_rank"),
    )
)

result = (
    enriched
    .select(
        "id",
        "service",
        "host",
        "log_ts",
        "level",
        "attr_key",
        "attr_key_upper",
        "prev_status_code",
        "last_known_attr_key",
    )
)

    -- Keep recent, valid rows

        NTILE(5) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY shipping_fee DESC, id) AS shipping_fee_bucket,
        LAST_VALUE(shipping_fee) IGNORE NULLS OVER (PARTITION BY channel ORDER BY last_known_shipping_fee, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS last_known_shipping_fee_3,

),

        a.*,
        pr.id AS promo_id_2,
        pr.promo_code AS promotion_promo_code,
        pr.discount_pct AS promotion_discount_pct

WITH filtered AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT *, CONCAT(country, ', ', device) AS country_device
    FROM sessions
    WHERE started_at >= TIMESTAMP '2023-06-28 11:00:00'
      AND device IN ('tablet', 'desktop', 'mobile')
),
scored AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        id,
        customer_id,
        device,
        browser,
        started_at,
        country,
        country_device,
        LAST_VALUE(browser, TRUE) OVER (ORDER BY started_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS last_known_browser,
        LAST_VALUE(country, TRUE) OVER (PARTITION BY device ORDER BY started_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS last_known_country,
        LAST_VALUE(browser, TRUE) OVER (PARTITION BY browser ORDER BY started_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS last_known_browser_2
    FROM filtered
),
with_gaps AS (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > interval)
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN started_at - LAG(started_at) OVER (PARTITION BY browser ORDER BY started_at, id) > INTERVAL '14' DAY THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS session_start_flag
    FROM scored
),
islands AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(session_start_flag) OVER (PARTITION BY browser ORDER BY started_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS burst_id
    FROM with_gaps
)
-- Aggregate with conditional metrics
SELECT
    CASE WHEN session_start_flag >= 1 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END AS session_start_flag_tier,
    COUNT(*) AS row_count,
    PERCENTILE_APPROX(burst_id, 0.95) AS burst_id_p95
FROM islands
GROUP BY CASE WHEN session_start_flag >= 1 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END
HAVING burst_id_p95 >= 0;

WITH valid AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT
        id,
        session_id,
        event_type,
        event_time,
        duration_sec,
        CAST(duration_sec AS DOUBLE) AS duration_sec_num
    FROM web_events
    WHERE page IS NOT NULL
),
latest AS (
    -- Keep one row per key (latest first)
    SELECT *
    FROM (
        SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY session_id ORDER BY duration_sec DESC, id ASC) AS rn
        FROM valid
    ) x
    WHERE rn = 1
),
latest_web_events AS (
    -- QUALIFY-style window filter
    SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY session_id ORDER BY duration_sec DESC, id ASC) AS latest_rank
    FROM latest
    QUALIFY latest_rank = 1
)
-- Native SQL PIVOT
SELECT *
FROM (
    SELECT
        session_id,
        event_type,
        duration_sec_num
    FROM latest_web_events
) src
PIVOT (
    MAX(duration_sec_num) AS total,
    COUNT(1) AS cnt
    FOR event_type IN ('search', 'click')
);

        id,
        carrier,
        shipped_date,
        delivered_date,
        status,
        carrier_filled,
        order_status,
        amount,
        CASE WHEN cost >= 95 THEN 'High' WHEN cost >= 18 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END cost_band,

        COALESCE(carrier, 'DIRECT') resolved_carrier
    FROM joined

deduped AS (

        FROM base

),
enriched AS (
    SELECT
        *,

WITH gaps AS (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > interval)
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN LAG(reading_ts) OVER (PARTITION BY device_code ORDER BY reading_ts, id) IS NULL
                 OR reading_ts > LAG(reading_ts) OVER (PARTITION BY device_code ORDER BY reading_ts, id) + INTERVAL 30 MINUTES THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_new_session
    FROM device_readings
),
islands AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(is_new_session) OVER (PARTITION BY device_code ORDER BY reading_ts, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS burst_id
    FROM gaps
)
-- Grouped metrics
SELECT
    device_code,
    DATE_TRUNC('HOUR', reading_ts) AS hour_window,
    COUNT_IF(device_code = 'DV-02') AS dv_02_events,
    (UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MAX(reading_ts)) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MIN(reading_ts))) / 60 AS duration_min,
    COUNT(DISTINCT id) AS distinct_ids,
    AVG(humidity) AS avg_humidity,
    GROUPING(device_code) AS grouping_level
FROM islands
GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((device_code, DATE_TRUNC('HOUR', reading_ts)), (device_code), ())
ORDER BY hour_window NULLS LAST;

)

WITH metrics AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        *,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY start_date DESC, id) AS event_seq,
        LAST_VALUE(monthly_fee) IGNORE NULLS OVER w_running AS last_known_monthly_fee,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER w_recent AS monthly_fee_dense_rank,
        LAG(monthly_fee, 1, 0) OVER w_running_2 AS prev_monthly_fee
    FROM subscriptions
    WINDOW w_running AS (PARTITION BY status ORDER BY start_date, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), w_recent AS (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY monthly_fee DESC NULLS FIRST), w_running_2 AS (PARTITION BY plan, customer_id ORDER BY start_date, id)
),
attributed AS (
    -- Non-equi join on a validity window
    SELECT
        a.*,
        sub.id AS subscription_id,
        sub.plan AS subscription_plan,
        sub.monthly_fee AS subscription_monthly_fee
    FROM metrics a
    LEFT JOIN subscriptions sub
        ON a.customer_id = sub.customer_id
       AND a.end_date >= sub.start_date
       AND a.end_date < sub.end_date + INTERVAL '30' DAY
),
kept_keys AS (
    -- Set difference on keys
    SELECT plan, id
    FROM attributed
    EXCEPT DISTINCT
    SELECT plan, id
    FROM subscriptions
    WHERE plan <> 'basic'
),
kept_rows AS (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    SELECT s.*
    FROM attributed s
    JOIN kept_keys k ON s.plan = k.plan AND s.id = k.id
)
SELECT
    s.id,
    s.customer_id,
    s.start_date,
    s.end_date,
    s.status,
    s.event_seq,
    s.last_known_monthly_fee,
    s.prev_monthly_fee,
    s.subscription_id,
    CASE WHEN status RLIKE '^(PAUSED|ACTIVE)$' THEN 'OTHER_ZONE' ELSE 'CORE' END AS status_zone,
    (SELECT MAX(a2.balance) FROM accounts a2 WHERE a2.customer_id = s.customer_id) AS max_account_balance
FROM kept_rows s
ORDER BY max_account_balance NULLS LAST, end_date

w = Window.partitionBy("customer_id").orderBy(F.col("start_date").desc(), "id")
w_running = Window.partitionBy("status").orderBy("start_date", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w_recent = Window.partitionBy("customer_id").orderBy(F.col("monthly_fee").desc_nulls_first())
w_running_2 = Window.partitionBy("plan", "customer_id").orderBy("start_date", "id")
balance_by_customer_id = df_accounts.groupBy("customer_id").agg(F.max("balance").alias("max_account_balance"))

metrics = (
    df_subscriptions
    .select(
        "*",
        F.row_number().over(w).alias("event_seq"),
        F.last("monthly_fee", ignorenulls=True).over(w_running).alias("last_known_monthly_fee"),
        F.dense_rank().over(w_recent).alias("monthly_fee_dense_rank"),
        F.lag("monthly_fee", 1, 0).over(w_running_2).alias("prev_monthly_fee"),
    )
)

attributed = (
    metrics
    .alias("a")
    .join(df_subscriptions.alias("sub"), (F.col("a.customer_id") == F.col("sub.customer_id")) & (F.col("a.end_date") >= F.col("sub.start_date")) & (F.col("a.end_date") < F.col("sub.end_date") + F.expr("INTERVAL 30 DAYS")), "left")
    .select(
        "a.*",
        F.col("sub.id").alias("subscription_id"),
        F.col("sub.plan").alias("subscription_plan"),
        F.col("sub.monthly_fee").alias("subscription_monthly_fee"),
    )
)

kept_keys = (
    attributed
    .select("plan", "id")
    .subtract(
        df_subscriptions
        .filter(F.col("plan") != "basic")
        .select("plan", "id")
    )
)

kept_rows = (
    attributed
    .alias("s")
    .join(kept_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.plan") == F.col("k.plan")) & (F.col("s.id") == F.col("k.id")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

result = (
    kept_rows
    .join(balance_by_customer_id, on="customer_id", how="left")
    .select(
        "id",
        "customer_id",
        "start_date",
        "end_date",
        "status",
        "event_seq",
        "last_known_monthly_fee",
        "prev_monthly_fee",
        "subscription_id",
        F.when(F.col("status").rlike("^(PAUSED|ACTIVE)$"), "OTHER_ZONE").otherwise("CORE").alias("status_zone"),
        F.col("max_account_balance"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("max_account_balance").asc_nulls_last(), "end_date")
)

WITH cleaned AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        name,
        email,
        city,
        segment,
        signup_date,
        is_active,
        credit_limit,
        age,
        TRIM(city) AS clean_city
    FROM customers
    WHERE signup_date >= TO_DATE('2023-03-28')
      AND segment IS NOT NULL
      AND age >= 31
),
latest AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM cleaned
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY segment, city ORDER BY signup_date DESC, id ASC) = 1
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM (
        SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY city, segment ORDER BY age DESC, id ASC) AS row_num
        FROM latest
    ) x
    WHERE row_num = 1
),
not_flagged AS (
    SELECT s.*
    FROM ranked s
    WHERE EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM sessions x
            WHERE x.customer_id = s.id
              AND x.browser = 'Safari'
        )
),
enriched AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        name,
        email,
        city,
        segment,
        signup_date,
        is_active,
        credit_limit,
        age,
        clean_city,
        row_num,
        NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY credit_limit ASC, id ASC) AS credit_limit_bucket,
        MAX(age) OVER (PARTITION BY city) AS city_max_age,
        FIRST_VALUE(city, TRUE) OVER (ORDER BY credit_limit ASC, id ASC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS first_known_city,
        CORR(age, credit_limit) OVER (PARTITION BY city) AS corr_age_credit_limit
    FROM not_flagged
),
scored AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        name,
        email,
        city,
        segment,
        signup_date,
        is_active,
        credit_limit,
        age,
        clean_city,
        row_num,
        credit_limit_bucket,
        city_max_age,
        first_known_city,
        corr_age_credit_limit,
        SUM(age) OVER (PARTITION BY segment) AS segment_sum_age,
        LEAD(city_max_age, 1) OVER w_running AS next_city_max_age,
        NTILE(5) OVER (PARTITION BY segment, city ORDER BY age ASC, id ASC) AS age_bucket
    FROM enriched
    WINDOW w_running AS (ORDER BY corr_age_credit_limit ASC, id ASC)
)
SELECT *
FROM (
    SELECT
        segment,
        city,
        age_bucket
    FROM scored
) src
PIVOT (
    AVG(age_bucket) AS value_sum
    FOR city IN ('Tokyo' AS tokyo, 'Chiang Mai' AS chiang_mai, 'New York' AS new_york)
);

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("segment", "city").orderBy(F.col("signup_date").desc(), "id")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("city", "segment").orderBy(F.col("age").desc(), "id")
w3 = Window.orderBy("credit_limit", "id")
w4 = Window.partitionBy("city")
w5 = Window.orderBy("credit_limit", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w6 = Window.partitionBy("segment")
w_running = Window.orderBy("corr_age_credit_limit", "id")
w8 = Window.partitionBy("segment", "city").orderBy("age", "id")

cleaned = (
    df_customers
    .filter((F.col("signup_date") >= F.to_date(F.lit("2023-03-28"))) & F.col("segment").isNotNull() & (F.col("age") >= 31))
    .select(
        "id",
        "name",
        "email",
        "city",
        "segment",
        "signup_date",
        "is_active",
        "credit_limit",
        "age",
        F.trim("city").alias("clean_city"),
    )
)

latest = (
    cleaned
    .withColumn("row_num", F.row_number().over(w))
    .filter(F.col("row_num") == 1)
    .drop("row_num")
)

ranked = (
    latest
    .withColumn("row_num", F.row_number().over(w2))
    .filter(F.col("row_num") == 1)
)

not_flagged = (
    ranked
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_sessions.alias("x"), (F.col("x.customer_id") == F.col("s.id")) & (F.col("x.browser") == "Safari"), "left_semi")
)

enriched = (
    not_flagged
    .withColumn("credit_limit_bucket", F.ntile(4).over(w3))
    .withColumn("city_max_age", F.max("age").over(w4))
    .withColumn("first_known_city", F.first("city", ignorenulls=True).over(w5))
    .withColumn("corr_age_credit_limit", F.corr("age", "credit_limit").over(w4))
)

scored = (
    enriched
    .withColumn("segment_sum_age", F.sum("age").over(w6))
    .withColumn("next_city_max_age", F.lead("city_max_age", 1).over(w_running))
    .withColumn("age_bucket", F.ntile(5).over(w8))
)

result = (
    scored
    .groupBy("segment")
    .pivot("city", ["Tokyo", "Chiang Mai", "New York"])
    .agg(F.avg("age_bucket").alias("value_sum"))
    .select(
        "segment",
        F.col("Tokyo").alias("tokyo"),
        F.col("Chiang Mai").alias("chiang_mai"),
        F.col("New York").alias("new_york"),
    )
)

WITH base AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        *,
        ADD_MONTHS(launch_date, 3) AS launch_date_plus_months,
        COALESCE(brand, 'NONE') AS resolved_brand
    FROM products
    WHERE launch_date > DATE '2023-05-16'
      AND supplier_id IS NOT NULL
),
deduped AS (
    -- Keep one row per key (latest first)
    SELECT *
    FROM (
        SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY supplier_id ORDER BY launch_date DESC NULLS LAST, id) AS dedup_rank
        FROM base
    ) ranked
    WHERE dedup_rank = 1
),
filtered AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT
        id,
        product_name,
        category,
        price,
        stock_qty,
        launch_date,
        tags,
        dedup_rank,
        CAST(cost AS INT) AS cost_int,
        COALESCE(brand, 'UNKNOWN') AS brand_filled
    FROM deduped
    WHERE supplier_id IS NOT NULL
),
metrics AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        id,
        product_name,
        category,
        price,
        stock_qty,
        launch_date,
        tags,
        dedup_rank,
        cost_int,
        brand_filled,
        NTILE(3) OVER (PARTITION BY category ORDER BY cost_int, id) AS cost_int_bucket,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER w_grp AS stock_qty_dense_rank,
        CUME_DIST() OVER (PARTITION BY category ORDER BY stock_qty DESC) AS stock_qty_cume_dist
    FROM filtered
    WINDOW w_grp AS (PARTITION BY category ORDER BY stock_qty NULLS FIRST)
)
-- Grouped metrics
SELECT
    category,
    DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', launch_date) AS year_start,
    SIZE(COLLECT_SET(category)) AS num_categories,
    PERCENTILE_APPROX(stock_qty, 0.9) AS stock_qty_p90,
    COUNT(*) AS event_count
FROM metrics
GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((category, DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', launch_date)), (category), ());

w = Window.partitionBy("supplier_id").orderBy(F.col("launch_date").desc_nulls_last(), "id")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("category").orderBy("cost_int", "id")
w_grp = Window.partitionBy("category").orderBy(F.col("stock_qty").asc_nulls_first())

    .withColumn("launch_date_plus_months", F.add_months("launch_date", 3))
    .withColumn("resolved_brand", F.coalesce("brand", F.lit("NONE")))
)

deduped = (
    base
    .withColumn("dedup_rank", F.row_number().over(w))
    .filter(F.col("dedup_rank") == 1)
)

filtered = (
    deduped
    .filter(F.col("supplier_id").isNotNull())
    .select(
        "id",
        "product_name",
        "category",
        "price",
        "stock_qty",
        "launch_date",

        "dedup_rank",

        F.coalesce("brand", F.lit("UNKNOWN")).alias("brand_filled"),
    )

metrics = (
    filtered
    .withColumn("cost_int_bucket", F.ntile(3).over(w2))
    .withColumn("stock_qty_dense_rank", F.dense_rank().over(w_grp))
    .withColumn("stock_qty_cume_dist", F.cume_dist().over(w4))
)

        "category",

    )
    .agg(
        F.size(F.collect_set("category")).alias("num_categories"),
        F.percentile_approx("stock_qty", 0.9).alias("stock_qty_p90"),

WITH flattened AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        host,
        log_ts,
        latency_ms,
        status_code,
        k,
        attr_value
    FROM app_logs
    LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(context) t AS k, attr_value
),
kept_keys AS (
    SELECT id, host
    FROM flattened
    INTERSECT
    SELECT id, host
    FROM app_logs
    WHERE latency_ms != 1744
),
kept_rows AS (
    SELECT s.*
    FROM flattened s
    INNER JOIN kept_keys k ON s.id = k.id AND s.host = k.host
),
scored AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        ROUND(status_code / SUM(status_code) OVER (PARTITION BY host), 4) AS status_code_share,
        MAX(status_code) OVER (PARTITION BY k, host) AS k_max_status_code,
        CORR(status_code, latency_ms) OVER (PARTITION BY host) AS corr_status_code_latency_ms,
        ROUND(status_code / SUM(status_code) OVER (PARTITION BY host), 4) AS status_code_share_2
    FROM kept_rows
),
scored_app_logs AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        AVG(k_max_status_code) OVER (PARTITION BY k ORDER BY CAST(log_ts AS BIGINT) ASC RANGE BETWEEN 7200 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS k_max_status_code_avg_2h,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY host ORDER BY status_code_share_2 DESC NULLS FIRST) AS status_code_share_2_dense_rank
    FROM scored
),
base AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        SUBSTRING(host, 1, 2) AS host_prefix,
        COALESCE(k, 'N/A') AS resolved_k
    FROM scored_app_logs
    WHERE status_code_share_2_dense_rank BETWEEN 5 AND 6
)
SELECT
    CASE WHEN k_max_status_code >= 467 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END AS k_max_status_code_tier,
    (UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MAX(log_ts)) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MIN(log_ts))) / 60 AS span_minutes,
    SUM(CASE WHEN host = 'h2' THEN k_max_status_code ELSE 0 END) AS h2_k_max_status_code
FROM base
GROUP BY ROLLUP (CASE WHEN k_max_status_code >= 467 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END)
HAVING span_minutes >= 0
ORDER BY h2_k_max_status_code DESC;

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("host")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("k", "host")
w3 = Window.partitionBy("k").orderBy(F.col("log_ts").cast("bigint")).rangeBetween(-7200, Window.currentRow)
w4 = Window.partitionBy("host").orderBy(F.col("status_code_share_2").desc_nulls_first())

flattened = (
    df_app_logs
    .select(
        "id",
        "host",
        "log_ts",
        "latency_ms",
        "status_code",
        F.explode("context").alias("k", "attr_value"),
    )
)

kept_keys = (
    flattened
    .select("id", "host")
    .intersect(
        df_app_logs
        .filter(F.col("latency_ms") != 1744)
        .select("id", "host")
    )
)

kept_rows = (
    flattened
    .alias("s")
    .join(kept_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.id") == F.col("k.id")) & (F.col("s.host") == F.col("k.host")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

scored = (
    kept_rows
    .withColumn("status_code_share", F.round((F.col("status_code") / F.sum("status_code").over(w)), 4))
    .withColumn("k_max_status_code", F.max("status_code").over(w2))
    .withColumn("corr_status_code_latency_ms", F.corr("status_code", "latency_ms").over(w))
    .withColumn("status_code_share_2", F.round((F.col("status_code") / F.sum("status_code").over(w)), 4))
)

scored_app_logs = (
    scored
    .withColumn("k_max_status_code_avg_2h", F.avg("k_max_status_code").over(w3))
    .withColumn("status_code_share_2_dense_rank", F.dense_rank().over(w4))
)

base = (
    scored_app_logs
    .filter(F.col("status_code_share_2_dense_rank").between(5, 6))
    .select(
        "*",
        F.substring("host", 1, 2).alias("host_prefix"),
        F.coalesce("k", F.lit("N/A")).alias("resolved_k"),
    )
)

result = (
    base
    .rollup(
        F.when(F.col("k_max_status_code") >= 467, "HIGH").otherwise("LOW").alias("k_max_status_code_tier"),
    )
    .agg(
        ((F.unix_timestamp(F.max("log_ts")) - F.unix_timestamp(F.min("log_ts"))) / 60).alias("span_minutes"),
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("host") == "h2", F.col("k_max_status_code")).otherwise(0)).alias("h2_k_max_status_code"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("span_minutes") >= 0)
    .orderBy(F.col("h2_k_max_status_code").desc())
)

WITH scored AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        *,
        FIRST_VALUE(channel, TRUE) OVER w_ordered AS first_known_channel,
        PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY discount_pct) AS discount_pct_percent_rank
    FROM promotions
    WINDOW w_ordered AS (PARTITION BY channel ORDER BY discount_pct, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)
),
ranked AS (
    -- Deduplicate with ROW_NUMBER
    SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY channel, promo_code ORDER BY discount_pct_percent_rank DESC NULLS FIRST, id) AS dedup_rank
    FROM scored
    QUALIFY dedup_rank = 1
),
kept_keys AS (
    -- Set difference on keys
    SELECT id, promo_code
    FROM ranked
    EXCEPT DISTINCT
    SELECT id, promo_code
    FROM promotions
    WHERE promo_code NOT IN ('WELCOME5', 'BUNDLE', 'VIP')
),
reconciled AS (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    SELECT s.*
    FROM ranked s
    INNER JOIN kept_keys k ON s.id = k.id AND s.promo_code = k.promo_code
),
matched AS (
    -- Non-equi join on a validity window
    SELECT
        s.*,
        pr.id AS promo_id,
        pr.promo_code AS promotion_promo_code,
        pr.discount_pct AS promotion_discount_pct
    FROM reconciled s
    LEFT JOIN promotions pr
        ON COALESCE(s.channel, 'web') = pr.channel
       AND s.ends_on >= pr.starts_on
       AND s.ends_on < pr.ends_on + INTERVAL 14 DAYS
)
-- Aggregate with conditional metrics
SELECT
    CASE WHEN promo_id >= 11 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END AS promo_id_tier,
    CASE WHEN discount_pct >= 0.28 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END AS discount_pct_tier,
    MAX(discount_pct) AS max_discount_pct,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN promotion_promo_code = 'BUNDLE' THEN 1 END) AS bundle_count,
    PERCENTILE_APPROX(promotion_discount_pct, 0.5) AS promotion_discount_pct_p50
FROM matched
GROUP BY CASE WHEN promo_id >= 11 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END, CASE WHEN discount_pct >= 0.28 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END
ORDER BY promo_id_tier;

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w_ordered = Window.partitionBy("channel").orderBy("discount_pct", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w2 = Window.orderBy("discount_pct")
w3 = Window.partitionBy("channel", "promo_code").orderBy(F.col("discount_pct_percent_rank").desc_nulls_first(), "id")

scored = (
    df_promotions
    .select(
        "*",
        F.first("channel", ignorenulls=True).over(w_ordered).alias("first_known_channel"),
        F.percent_rank().over(w2).alias("discount_pct_percent_rank"),
    )
)

ranked = (
    scored
    .withColumn("dedup_rank", F.row_number().over(w3))
    .filter(F.col("dedup_rank") == 1)
)

kept_keys = (
    ranked
    .select("id", "promo_code")
    .subtract(
        df_promotions
        .filter(~F.col("promo_code").isin(["WELCOME5", "BUNDLE", "VIP"]))
        .select("id", "promo_code")
    )
)

reconciled = (
    ranked
    .alias("s")
    .join(kept_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.id") == F.col("k.id")) & (F.col("s.promo_code") == F.col("k.promo_code")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

matched = (
    reconciled
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_promotions.alias("pr"), (F.coalesce(F.col("s.channel"), F.lit("web")) == F.col("pr.channel")) & (F.col("s.ends_on") >= F.col("pr.starts_on")) & (F.col("s.ends_on") < F.col("pr.ends_on") + F.expr("INTERVAL 14 DAYS")), "left")
    .select(
        "s.*",
        F.col("pr.id").alias("promo_id"),
        F.col("pr.promo_code").alias("promotion_promo_code"),
        F.col("pr.discount_pct").alias("promotion_discount_pct"),
    )
)

result = (
    matched
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("promo_id") >= 11, "HIGH").otherwise("LOW").alias("promo_id_tier"),
        F.when(F.col("discount_pct") >= 0.28, "PREMIUM").otherwise("STANDARD").alias("discount_pct_tier"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.max("discount_pct").alias("max_discount_pct"),
        F.count(F.when(F.col("promotion_promo_code") == "BUNDLE", 1)).alias("bundle_count"),
        F.percentile_approx("promotion_discount_pct", 0.5).alias("promotion_discount_pct_p50"),
    )
    .orderBy("promo_id_tier")
)

w7 = Window.partitionBy("status").orderBy("paid_at", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)

    .filter(F.col("status").isin(["REFUNDED", "FAILED"]))

        "order_id",

        F.coalesce("method", F.lit("OTHER")).alias("method_filled"),
    )
)

scored = (
    base
    .withColumn("amount_scaled_bucket", F.ntile(5).over(w))

)

    .withColumn("latest_rank", F.rank().over(w5))

        "status",
        "amount_whole",

        "amount_scaled_avg_6",
        "latest_rank",

        (F.col("amount") * F.col("amount_whole")).alias("amount_times_amount_whole"),
        F.coalesce("method", F.lit("OTHER")).alias("resolved_method"),
    )
)

prev_events = base_payments.withColumn("prev_paid_at", F.lag("paid_at").over(w6))

flagged = (

        F.col("d.channel"),
        F.col("d.discount"),
    )

result = (

    .join(amount_by_order_id, on="order_id", how="left")

        "paid_at",

with base as (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    select
        *,
        lower(carrier) as carrier_lower,
        case when carrier in ('DHL', 'Flash') then 'Tier 1' else 'Other' end as carrier_group
    from shipments
    where delivered_date > to_date('2023-06-17')
      and carrier is not null
),
enriched as (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    select
        id,
        order_id,
        carrier,
        shipped_date,
        delivered_date,
        cost,
        status,
        carrier_lower,
        carrier_group,
        first_value(cost, true) over (partition by order_id order by shipped_date, id rows between unbounded preceding and current row) as first_known_cost,
        lag(cost, 2) over (partition by status order by shipped_date, id) as prev_cost,
        sum(cost) over (partition by order_id, status) as order_id_sum_cost
    from base
),
metrics as (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    select
        *,
        dense_rank() over (partition by status, order_id order by cost desc nulls first) as cost_dense_rank,
        row_number() over (partition by carrier order by first_known_cost, id) as row_seq,
        sum(prev_cost) over (partition by order_id order by cost, id rows between unbounded preceding and current row) as cumulative_prev_cost,
        sum(prev_cost) over (partition by carrier order by order_id_sum_cost, id rows between unbounded preceding and current row) as cumulative_prev_cost_2,
        sum(prev_cost) over (partition by status order by first_known_cost, id rows between unbounded preceding and current row) as cumulative_prev_cost_3
    from enriched
),
valid as (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    select
        id,
        order_id,
        shipped_date,
        delivered_date,
        status,
        carrier_lower,
        carrier_group,
        first_known_cost,
        prev_cost,
        order_id_sum_cost,
        cost_dense_rank,
        row_seq,
        cumulative_prev_cost,
        cumulative_prev_cost_3,
        cast(cumulative_prev_cost as double) as cumulative_prev_cost_num,
        greatest(cumulative_prev_cost_2, first_known_cost) as greatest_cumulative_prev_cost_2_first_known_cost,
        coalesce(carrier, 'UNKNOWN') as resolved_carrier

)

        status,
        first_known_cost
    from valid

pivot (
    avg(first_known_cost) as total

WITH base AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT
        id,
        quantity,
        unit_price,
        ROUND(quantity / unit_price, 2) AS line_total
    FROM order_items
    WHERE quantity <> 4
),
with_windows AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        *,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY quantity, id) AS seq_no,
        NTILE(10) OVER (ORDER BY line_total DESC, id) AS line_total_bucket
    FROM base
),
metrics AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        id,
        quantity,
        unit_price,
        line_total,
        seq_no,
        line_total_bucket,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY seq_no NULLS LAST) AS seq_no_dense_rank,
        CUME_DIST() OVER (ORDER BY line_total DESC NULLS FIRST) AS line_total_cume_dist
    FROM with_windows
),
metrics_order_items AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        *,
        FIRST_VALUE(unit_price) IGNORE NULLS OVER (ORDER BY seq_no_dense_rank, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS first_known_unit_price,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY quantity DESC NULLS LAST) AS quantity_dense_rank,
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY unit_price DESC) AS unit_price_rank
    FROM metrics
),
valid AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT
        id,
        quantity,
        unit_price,
        line_total,
        line_total_bucket,
        seq_no_dense_rank,
        line_total_cume_dist,
        quantity_dense_rank,
        unit_price_rank,
        quantity_dense_rank + quantity AS quantity_dense_rank_plus_quantity
    FROM metrics_order_items
    WHERE unit_price_rank BETWEEN 4 AND 5
),
daily AS (
    -- Aggregate with conditional metrics
    SELECT
        CASE WHEN seq_no_dense_rank >= 7 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END AS seq_no_dense_rank_tier,
        BIT_AND(quantity) AS quantity_bit_and,
        ROUND(AVG(quantity), 2) AS avg_quantity,
        COUNT(*) AS cnt
    FROM valid
    GROUP BY CASE WHEN seq_no_dense_rank >= 7 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END
)
SELECT seq_no_dense_rank_tier, quantity_bit_and
FROM daily
ORDER BY seq_no_dense_rank_tier DESC NULLS LAST

WITH base AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT *, ROUND(unit_price, 0) AS unit_price_rounded
    FROM order_items
    WHERE product_id IS NOT NULL
),
scored AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        *,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY unit_price DESC, id) AS event_seq,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY unit_price_rounded, id) AS seq_no,
        LEAD(quantity, 1, 0) OVER (ORDER BY unit_price_rounded, id) AS next_quantity,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY unit_price DESC, id) AS row_seq,
        SUM(unit_price_rounded) OVER (ORDER BY quantity, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_unit_price_rounded
    FROM base
),
latest AS (
    -- QUALIFY-style window filter
    SELECT *
    FROM scored
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY product_id, order_id ORDER BY cumulative_unit_price_rounded DESC NULLS FIRST, id) = 1
),
enriched AS (
    -- Attach orders attributes
    SELECT
        e.*,
        d.channel,
        d.discount,
        d.amount
    FROM latest e
    LEFT JOIN orders d
        ON e.order_id = d.id
),
metrics AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        id,
        order_id,
        product_id,
        quantity,
        unit_price,
        unit_price_rounded,
        event_seq,
        seq_no,
        next_quantity,
        row_seq,
        cumulative_unit_price_rounded,
        channel,
        discount,
        amount,
        AVG(amount) OVER (PARTITION BY order_id) AS order_id_avg_amount,
        FIRST_VALUE(unit_price_rounded, TRUE) OVER (PARTITION BY order_id ORDER BY unit_price_rounded, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS first_known_unit_price_rounded,
        SUM(event_seq) OVER (PARTITION BY order_id, channel ORDER BY next_quantity, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_event_seq
    FROM enriched
),
with_dims AS (
    -- Attach orders attributes
    SELECT
        src.*,
        d.order_date,
        d.discount AS order_discount,
        d.status
    FROM metrics src
    LEFT JOIN orders d
        ON src.order_id = d.id
),
with_dims_order_items AS (
    -- Attach orders attributes
    SELECT
        src.*,
        b.order_date AS order_order_date,
        b.discount AS order_discount_2
    FROM with_dims src
    LEFT JOIN orders b
        ON src.order_id = b.id
)
-- Grouped metrics
SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', order_date) AS year_start,
    SUM(unit_price) AS total_unit_price,
    PERCENTILE_APPROX(amount, ARRAY(0.25, 0.5, 0.75)) AS amount_quartiles,
    COUNT(DISTINCT id) AS distinct_ids
FROM with_dims_order_items
GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', order_date)
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.orderBy(F.col("unit_price").desc(), "id")
w2 = Window.orderBy("unit_price_rounded", "id")
w3 = Window.partitionBy("product_id").orderBy(F.col("unit_price").desc(), "id")
w4 = Window.orderBy("quantity", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w5 = Window.partitionBy("product_id", "order_id").orderBy(F.col("cumulative_unit_price_rounded").desc_nulls_first(), "id")
w6 = Window.partitionBy("order_id")
w7 = Window.partitionBy("order_id").orderBy("unit_price_rounded", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w8 = Window.partitionBy("order_id", "channel").orderBy("next_quantity", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)

base = (
    df_order_items
    .filter(F.col("product_id").isNotNull())
    .withColumn("unit_price_rounded", F.round("unit_price", 0))
)

scored = (
    base
    .select(
        "*",
        F.row_number().over(w).alias("event_seq"),
        F.row_number().over(w2).alias("seq_no"),
        F.lead("quantity", 1, 0).over(w2).alias("next_quantity"),
        F.row_number().over(w3).alias("row_seq"),
        F.sum("unit_price_rounded").over(w4).alias("cumulative_unit_price_rounded"),
    )
)

latest = (
    scored
    .withColumn("row_num", F.row_number().over(w5))
    .filter(F.col("row_num") == 1)
    .drop("row_num")
)

enriched = (
    latest
    .alias("e")
    .join(df_orders.alias("d"), F.col("e.order_id") == F.col("d.id"), "left")
    .select("e.*", F.col("d.channel"), F.col("d.discount"), F.col("d.amount"))
)

metrics = (
    enriched
    .withColumn("order_id_avg_amount", F.avg("amount").over(w6))
    .withColumn("first_known_unit_price_rounded", F.first("unit_price_rounded", ignorenulls=True).over(w7))
    .withColumn("running_event_seq", F.sum("event_seq").over(w8))
)

with_dims = (
    metrics
    .alias("src")
    .join(df_orders.alias("d"), F.col("src.order_id") == F.col("d.id"), "left")
    .select(
        "src.*",
        F.col("d.order_date"),
        F.col("d.discount").alias("order_discount"),
        F.col("d.status"),
    )
)

with_dims_order_items = (
    with_dims
    .alias("src")
    .join(df_orders.alias("b"), F.col("src.order_id") == F.col("b.id"), "left")
    .select(
        "src.*",
        F.col("b.order_date").alias("order_order_date"),
        F.col("b.discount").alias("order_discount_2"),
    )
)

result = (
    with_dims_order_items
    .groupBy(F.date_trunc("YEAR", "order_date").alias("year_start"))
    .agg(
        F.sum("unit_price").alias("total_unit_price"),
        F.percentile_approx("amount", [0.25, 0.5, 0.75]).alias("amount_quartiles"),
        F.countDistinct("id").alias("distinct_ids"),
    )
)

WITH remaining_keys AS (
    -- Set difference on keys
    SELECT order_id, status
    FROM payments
    EXCEPT DISTINCT
    SELECT order_id, status
    FROM payments
    WHERE order_id IN (8, 11, 15, 30)
),
verified AS (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    SELECT s.*
    FROM payments s
    JOIN remaining_keys k ON s.order_id = k.order_id AND s.status = k.status
)
-- Aggregate with conditional metrics
SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', paid_at) AS year_start,
    (UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MAX(paid_at)) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MIN(paid_at))) / 60 AS duration_min,
    PERCENTILE_APPROX(amount, 0.5) AS amount_p50
FROM verified
GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', paid_at)
HAVING PERCENTILE_APPROX(amount, 0.5) > 0
ORDER BY duration_min DESC NULLS FIRST;

remaining_keys = (
    df_payments
    .select("order_id", "status")
    .subtract(
        df_payments
        .filter(F.col("order_id").isin([8, 11, 15, 30]))
        .select("order_id", "status")
    )
)

verified = (
    df_payments
    .alias("s")
    .join(remaining_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.order_id") == F.col("k.order_id")) & (F.col("s.status") == F.col("k.status")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

result = (
    verified
    .groupBy(F.date_trunc("YEAR", "paid_at").alias("year_start"))
    .agg(
        ((F.unix_timestamp(F.max("paid_at")) - F.unix_timestamp(F.min("paid_at"))) / 60).alias("duration_min"),

    SELECT *
    FROM web_events
    WHERE page IS NOT NULL
),
DurationSecBucketSummary AS (
    SELECT CASE WHEN duration_sec >= 488 THEN 'high' WHEN duration_sec >= 157 THEN 'mid' ELSE 'low' END AS duration_sec_bucket, COUNT(CASE WHEN page = '/cart' THEN 1 END) AS cart_count
    FROM Src
    GROUP BY CASE WHEN duration_sec >= 488 THEN 'high' WHEN duration_sec >= 157 THEN 'mid' ELSE 'low' END
)
SELECT *
FROM DurationSecBucketSummary
WHERE cart_count > 3
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

src = df_web_events.filter(F.col("page").isNotNull())

duration_sec_bucket_summary = (
    src
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("duration_sec") >= 488, "high").when(F.col("duration_sec") >= 157, "mid").otherwise("low").alias("duration_sec_bucket"),
    )
    .agg(F.count(F.when(F.col("page") == "/cart", 1)).alias("cart_count"))
)

result = duration_sec_bucket_summary.filter(F.col("cart_count") > 3)

code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

cleaned = (
    df_products
    .filter((F.col("launch_date") > F.lit("2023-09-01").cast("date")) & F.col("supplier_id").isNotNull() & F.array_contains("tags", "new"))
    .select(
        "id",
        "brand",
        "cost",
        "stock_qty",
        "launch_date",
        "tags",

WITH base AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        started_at,
        country,
        SUBSTRING(country, 1, 3) AS country_prefix,
        COALESCE(browser, 'N/A') AS resolved_browser
    FROM sessions
    WHERE customer_id IS NOT NULL
),
with_gaps AS (
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN LAG(started_at) OVER (PARTITION BY country ORDER BY started_at, id) IS NULL
                 OR started_at > LAG(started_at) OVER (PARTITION BY country ORDER BY started_at, id) + INTERVAL '60' DAY THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_new_session
    FROM base
),
sessionized AS (
    SELECT *, SUM(is_new_session) OVER (PARTITION BY country ORDER BY started_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_id
    FROM with_gaps
)
SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('QUARTER', started_at) AS quarter_start,
    CASE WHEN session_id >= 8 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END AS session_id_tier,
    DATE_TRUNC('WEEK', started_at) AS week_start,
    SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_SET(country)) AS country_list,
    COUNT(DISTINCT country) AS distinct_countries,
    (UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MAX(started_at)) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MIN(started_at))) / 60 AS duration_min,
    APPROX_PERCENTILE(session_id, 0.5) AS session_id_p50,
    COUNT(DISTINCT country) AS distinct_countries_2,
    GROUPING_ID() AS grouping_level
FROM sessionized
GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((DATE_TRUNC('QUARTER', started_at), CASE WHEN session_id >= 8 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END, DATE_TRUNC('WEEK', started_at)), (DATE_TRUNC('QUARTER', started_at), CASE WHEN session_id >= 8 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END), ())
ORDER BY session_id_tier DESC NULLS LAST
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("country").orderBy("started_at", "id")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("country").orderBy("started_at", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)

base = (
    df_sessions
    .filter(F.col("customer_id").isNotNull())
    .select(
        "id",
        "started_at",
        "country",
        F.substring("country", 1, 3).alias("country_prefix"),
        F.coalesce("browser", F.lit("N/A")).alias("resolved_browser"),
    )
)

with_gaps = (
    base
    .withColumn("is_new_session", F.when(F.lag("started_at").over(w).isNull() | (F.col("started_at") > F.lag("started_at").over(w) + F.expr("INTERVAL 60 DAYS")), 1).otherwise(0))
)

sessionized = with_gaps.withColumn("session_id", F.sum("is_new_session").over(w2))

result = (
    sessionized
    .withColumn("quarter_start", F.date_trunc("QUARTER", "started_at"))
    .withColumn("session_id_tier", F.when(F.col("session_id") >= 8, "LARGE").otherwise("SMALL"))
    .withColumn("week_start", F.date_trunc("WEEK", "started_at"))
    .groupingSets(
        [["quarter_start", "session_id_tier", "week_start"], ["quarter_start", "session_id_tier"], []],
        "quarter_start",
        "session_id_tier",
        "week_start",
    )
    .agg(
        F.sort_array(F.collect_set("country")).alias("country_list"),
        F.countDistinct("country").alias("distinct_countries"),
        ((F.unix_timestamp(F.max("started_at")) - F.unix_timestamp(F.min("started_at"))) / 60).alias("duration_min"),
        F.percentile_approx("session_id", 0.5).alias("session_id_p50"),
        F.countDistinct("country").alias("distinct_countries_2"),
        F.grouping_id().alias("grouping_level"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("session_id_tier").desc_nulls_last())
)

with base as (
    select
        *,
        lower(status) as status_lower,
        add_months(start_date, 1) as start_date_plus_months
    from subscriptions
    where start_date >= date '2024-01-07'
      and start_date > '2024-10-01'
),
with_dims as (
    select
        s.*,
        b.city,
        b.country
    from base s
    left join customers b
        on s.customer_id = b.id
),
deduped as (
    select *
    from (
        select *, row_number() over (partition by plan, country order by end_date, id) as rank_in_group
        from with_dims
    ) x
    where rank_in_group = 1
),
base_subscriptions as (
    select
        id,
        customer_id,
        start_date,
        end_date,
        monthly_fee,
        status_lower,
        start_date_plus_months,
        country,
        date_sub(end_date, 5) as end_date_minus_5d
    from deduped
    where end_date > date '2023-05-09'
      and status in ('EXPIRED', 'CANCELLED')
),
with_dims_subscriptions as (
    select
        e.*,
        b.country as customer_country,
        b.name
    from base_subscriptions e
    left join customers b
        on e.customer_id = b.id
)
select
    s.id,
    s.customer_id,
    s.start_date,
    s.monthly_fee,
    s.status_lower,
    s.start_date_plus_months,
    s.customer_country,
    case when customer_country rlike '^(US|DE)$' then 'GROUP_A' else 'CORE' end as customer_country_zone,
    (select max(a2.balance) from accounts a2 where a2.customer_id = s.customer_id) as max_account_balance
from with_dims_subscriptions s
order by start_date desc nulls first;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("plan", "country").orderBy("end_date", "id")
balance_by_customer_id = df_accounts.groupBy("customer_id").agg(F.max("balance").alias("max_account_balance"))

base = (
    df_subscriptions
    .filter((F.col("start_date") >= F.lit("2024-01-07").cast("date")) & (F.col("start_date") > "2024-10-01"))
    .withColumn("status_lower", F.lower("status"))
    .withColumn("start_date_plus_months", F.add_months("start_date", 1))
)

with_dims = (
    base
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_customers.alias("b"), F.col("s.customer_id") == F.col("b.id"), "left")
    .select("s.*", F.col("b.city"), F.col("b.country"))
)

deduped = (
    with_dims
    .withColumn("rank_in_group", F.row_number().over(w))
    .filter(F.col("rank_in_group") == 1)
)

base_subscriptions = (
    deduped
    .filter((F.col("end_date") > F.lit("2023-05-09").cast("date")) & F.col("status").isin(["EXPIRED", "CANCELLED"]))
    .select(
        "id",
        "customer_id",
        "start_date",
        "end_date",
        "monthly_fee",
        "status_lower",
        "start_date_plus_months",
        "country",
        F.date_sub("end_date", 5).alias("end_date_minus_5d"),
    )
)

with_dims_subscriptions = (
    base_subscriptions
    .alias("e")
    .join(df_customers.alias("b"), F.col("e.customer_id") == F.col("b.id"), "left")
    .select("e.*", F.col("b.country").alias("customer_country"), F.col("b.name"))
)

result = (
    with_dims_subscriptions
    .join(balance_by_customer_id, on="customer_id", how="left")
    .select(
        "id",
        "customer_id",
        "start_date",
        "monthly_fee",
        "status_lower",
        "start_date_plus_months",
        "customer_country",
        F.when(F.col("customer_country").rlike("^(US|DE)$"), "GROUP_A").otherwise("CORE").alias("customer_country_zone"),
        F.col("max_account_balance"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("start_date").desc_nulls_first())
)

WITH joined AS (
    -- Attach orders attributes
    SELECT src.*, b.channel
    FROM shipments src
    INNER JOIN orders b
        ON src.order_id = b.id
),
deduped AS (
    -- Keep one row per key (latest first)
    SELECT *
    FROM joined
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY order_id ORDER BY delivered_date DESC, id) = 1
),
with_window AS (
    -- Non-equi join on a validity window
    SELECT
        s.*,
        pr.id AS promo_id,
        pr.promo_code,
        pr.discount_pct
    FROM deduped s
    LEFT JOIN promotions pr
        ON s.channel <=> pr.channel
       AND s.shipped_date >= pr.starts_on
       AND s.shipped_date < pr.ends_on + INTERVAL '14' DAY
),
with_window_shipments AS (
    -- Non-equi join on a validity window
    SELECT
        s.*,
        pr.id AS promo_id_2,
        pr.promo_code AS promotion_promo_code,
        pr.discount_pct AS promotion_discount_pct
    FROM with_window s
    INNER JOIN promotions pr
        ON s.channel <=> pr.channel
       AND s.shipped_date BETWEEN pr.starts_on AND pr.ends_on
)
-- Aggregate with conditional metrics
SELECT
    CASE WHEN promo_id_2 >= 11 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END AS promo_id_2_tier,
    PERCENTILE_APPROX(promotion_discount_pct, ARRAY(0.25, 0.5, 0.75)) AS promotion_discount_pct_quartiles,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN channel = 'mobile' THEN 1 END) AS mobile_count,
    ROUND(SUM(promotion_discount_pct) / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'DELIVERED' THEN 1 END), 0), 2) AS promotion_discount_pct_per_delivered,
    SUM(promotion_discount_pct) FILTER (WHERE promo_code = 'SPRING10') AS spring10_total_promotion_discount_pct
FROM with_window_shipments
GROUP BY CUBE (CASE WHEN promo_id_2 >= 11 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END)
ORDER BY spring10_total_promotion_discount_pct NULLS LAST
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("order_id").orderBy(F.col("delivered_date").desc(), "id")

joined = (
    df_shipments
    .alias("src")
    .join(df_orders.alias("b"), F.col("src.order_id") == F.col("b.id"), "inner")
    .select("src.*", F.col("b.channel"))
)

deduped = (
    joined
    .withColumn("rank_in_group", F.row_number().over(w))
    .filter(F.col("rank_in_group") == 1)
    .drop("rank_in_group")
)

with_window = (
    deduped
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_promotions.alias("pr"), (F.col("s.channel").eqNullSafe(F.col("pr.channel"))) & (F.col("s.shipped_date") >= F.col("pr.starts_on")) & (F.col("s.shipped_date") < F.col("pr.ends_on") + F.expr("INTERVAL 14 DAYS")), "left")
    .select(
        "s.*",
        F.col("pr.id").alias("promo_id"),
        F.col("pr.promo_code"),
        F.col("pr.discount_pct"),
    )
)

with_window_shipments = (
    with_window
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_promotions.alias("pr"), (F.col("s.channel").eqNullSafe(F.col("pr.channel"))) & F.col("s.shipped_date").between(F.col("pr.starts_on"), F.col("pr.ends_on")), "inner")
    .select(
        "s.*",
        F.col("pr.id").alias("promo_id_2"),
        F.col("pr.promo_code").alias("promotion_promo_code"),
        F.col("pr.discount_pct").alias("promotion_discount_pct"),
    )
)

result = (
    with_window_shipments
    .cube(
        F.when(F.col("promo_id_2") >= 11, "HIGH").otherwise("LOW").alias("promo_id_2_tier"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.percentile_approx("promotion_discount_pct", [0.25, 0.5, 0.75]).alias("promotion_discount_pct_quartiles"),
        F.count(F.when(F.col("channel") == "mobile", 1)).alias("mobile_count"),
        F.round(F.sum("promotion_discount_pct") / F.nullif(F.count(F.when(F.col("status") == "DELIVERED", 1)), F.lit(0)), 2).alias("promotion_discount_pct_per_delivered"),
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("promo_code") == "SPRING10", F.col("promotion_discount_pct"))).alias("spring10_total_promotion_discount_pct"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("spring10_total_promotion_discount_pct").asc_nulls_last())
)

WITH enriched AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        *,
        AVG(balance) OVER w_recent AS balance_avg_2_prior,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER w_recent_2 AS row_seq,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY status ORDER BY balance NULLS FIRST) AS balance_rank,
        FIRST_VALUE(status) IGNORE NULLS OVER (PARTITION BY account_type ORDER BY balance, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS first_known_status,
        NTILE(3) OVER (PARTITION BY account_type, status ORDER BY balance, id) AS balance_bucket
    FROM accounts
    WINDOW w_recent AS (ORDER BY balance, id ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING), w_recent_2 AS (PARTITION BY status, customer_id ORDER BY balance, id)
),
not_flagged AS (
    -- Anti-join via a correlated subquery
    SELECT s.*
    FROM enriched s
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM transactions c

from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w_recent = Window.orderBy("balance", "id").rowsBetween(-2, -1)
w_recent_2 = Window.partitionBy("status", "customer_id").orderBy("balance", "id")
w3 = Window.partitionBy("status").orderBy(F.col("balance").asc_nulls_first())
w4 = Window.partitionBy("account_type").orderBy("balance", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w5 = Window.partitionBy("account_type", "status").orderBy("balance", "id")

enriched = (
    df_accounts
    .select(
        "*",
        F.avg("balance").over(w_recent).alias("balance_avg_2_prior"),
        F.row_number().over(w_recent_2).alias("row_seq"),
        F.rank().over(w3).alias("balance_rank"),

        F.ntile(3).over(w5).alias("balance_bucket"),
    )
)

    .alias("s")
    .join(df_transactions.alias("c"), (F.col("c.account_id") == F.col("s.id")) & (F.col("c.txn_type") == "DEBIT"), "left_anti")
)

    .select("account_type", "customer_id")

    )
)

    .alias("s")
    .join(remaining_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.account_type") == F.col("k.account_type")) & (F.col("s.customer_id") == F.col("k.customer_id")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

with exploded as (
    select
        id,
        service,
        host,
        log_ts,
        level,
        status_code,
        key,
        v
    from app_logs
    lateral view explode(context) t as key, v
),
with_gaps as (
    select *, case when log_ts - lag(log_ts) over (partition by host order by log_ts, id, key) > interval 1 hour then 1 else 0 end as session_start_flag
    from exploded
),
sessionized as (
    select *, sum(session_start_flag) over (partition by host order by log_ts, id, key rows between unbounded preceding and current row) as island_id
    from with_gaps
),
with_windows as (
    select
        id,
        service,
        host,
        log_ts,
        level,
        status_code,
        key,
        v,
        session_start_flag,
        island_id,
        first_value(key, true) over (partition by level order by island_id, id, key rows between unbounded preceding and current row) as first_known_key,
        ntile(4) over (partition by level, key order by session_start_flag desc, id, key) as session_start_flag_bucket,
        lead(status_code, 1, 0) over (partition by service, level order by session_start_flag, id, key) as next_status_code,
        percent_rank() over (partition by level order by island_id) as island_id_percent_rank
    from sessionized
),
ranked as (
    select *
    from (
        select *, row_number() over (partition by host, service order by session_start_flag_bucket, id, key) as rank_in_group
        from with_windows
    ) ranked
    where rank_in_group = 1
),
daily as (
    select
        date_trunc('hour', log_ts) as hour_window,
        count(case when level = 'DEBUG' then 1 end) as debug_count,
        avg(status_code) filter (where host = 'h4') as h4_avg_status_code,
        avg(session_start_flag) filter (where key = 'trace') as trace_avg_session_start_flag,
        min(island_id_percent_rank) as min_island_id_percent_rank,
        count(case when level = 'DEBUG' then 1 end) as debug_count_2
    from ranked
    group by date_trunc('hour', log_ts)
)
select
    hour_window,
    h4_avg_status_code,
    trace_avg_session_start_flag,
    min_island_id_percent_rank
from daily

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("host").orderBy("log_ts", "id", "key")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("host").orderBy("log_ts", "id", "key").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w3 = Window.partitionBy("level").orderBy("island_id", "id", "key").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w4 = Window.partitionBy("level", "key").orderBy(F.col("session_start_flag").desc(), "id", "key")
w5 = Window.partitionBy("service", "level").orderBy("session_start_flag", "id", "key")
w6 = Window.partitionBy("level").orderBy("island_id")
w7 = Window.partitionBy("host", "service").orderBy("session_start_flag_bucket", "id", "key")

exploded = (
    df_app_logs
    .select(
        "id",
        "service",
        "host",
        "log_ts",
        "level",
        "status_code",
        F.explode("context").alias("key", "v"),
    )
)

with_gaps = (
    exploded
    .withColumn("session_start_flag", F.when(F.col("log_ts") - F.lag("log_ts").over(w) > F.expr("INTERVAL 1 HOUR"), 1).otherwise(0))
)

sessionized = with_gaps.withColumn("island_id", F.sum("session_start_flag").over(w2))

with_windows = (
    sessionized
    .withColumn("first_known_key", F.first("key", ignorenulls=True).over(w3))
    .withColumn("session_start_flag_bucket", F.ntile(4).over(w4))
    .withColumn("next_status_code", F.lead("status_code", 1, 0).over(w5))
    .withColumn("island_id_percent_rank", F.percent_rank().over(w6))
)

ranked = (
    with_windows
    .withColumn("rank_in_group", F.row_number().over(w7))
    .filter(F.col("rank_in_group") == 1)
)

daily = (
    ranked
    .groupBy(F.date_trunc("hour", "log_ts").alias("hour_window"))
    .agg(
        F.count(F.when(F.col("level") == "DEBUG", 1)).alias("debug_count"),
        F.avg(F.when(F.col("host") == "h4", F.col("status_code"))).alias("h4_avg_status_code"),
        F.avg(F.when(F.col("key") == "trace", F.col("session_start_flag"))).alias("trace_avg_session_start_flag"),
        F.min("island_id_percent_rank").alias("min_island_id_percent_rank"),
        F.count(F.when(F.col("level") == "DEBUG", 1)).alias("debug_count_2"),
    )
)

result = (
    daily
    .select(
        "hour_window",
        "h4_avg_status_code",
        "trace_avg_session_start_flag",
        "min_island_id_percent_rank",
    )
)

    select *, row_number() over (partition by channel order by discount_pct nulls first, id, promo_id) as rank_in_group
    from with_window
    qualify rank_in_group = 1
)

    case when adjusted_discount_pct >= 89 then 'HIGH' else 'LOW' end as adjusted_discount_pct_tier,
    channel,
    min(discount_pct) as min_discount_pct,

    FROM enriched
    QUALIFY row_num = 1
),
filtered AS (

    FROM deduped
    WHERE channel = 'store'

WITH valid AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT *, UPPER(device_code) AS device_code_upper
    FROM device_readings
    WHERE reading_ts > TIMESTAMP '2025-09-01 03:00:00'
),
deduped AS (
    -- QUALIFY-style window filter
    SELECT *
    FROM valid
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY device_code ORDER BY reading_ts, id) = 1
),
flagged AS (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > interval)
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN reading_ts - LAG(reading_ts) OVER (PARTITION BY device_code ORDER BY reading_ts, id) > INTERVAL '1' HOUR THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_new_burst
    FROM deduped
),
islands AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(is_new_burst) OVER (PARTITION BY device_code ORDER BY reading_ts, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_id
    FROM flagged
),
deduped_device_readings AS (
    -- QUALIFY-style window filter
    SELECT *
    FROM (
        SELECT *, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY device_code ORDER BY session_id DESC) AS rn
        FROM islands
    ) x
    WHERE rn = 1
)
-- Native SQL UNPIVOT (wide to long)
SELECT *
FROM (
    SELECT
        id,
        device_code,
        humidity,
        temp_c,
        pressure
    FROM deduped_device_readings
) src
UNPIVOT INCLUDE NULLS (
    val FOR kpi IN (humidity, temp_c AS TEMP_C, pressure)
);

WITH valid AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        LEAST(shipping_fee, amount) AS least_shipping_fee_amount,
        CASE WHEN status = 'CANCELLED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_cancelled
    FROM orders
    WHERE shipping_fee > 22
),
latest_match AS (
    SELECT s.*, top1.order_item_unit_price
    FROM valid s
    JOIN LATERAL (
            SELECT c.unit_price AS order_item_unit_price
            FROM order_items c
            WHERE c.order_id = s.id
            ORDER BY c.quantity DESC, c.id DESC
            LIMIT 1
        ) top1 ON TRUE
),
latest AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM latest_match
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY least_shipping_fee_amount DESC NULLS LAST, id) = 1
),
matched AS (
    SELECT
        src.*,
        pr.id AS promo_id,
        pr.promo_code,
        pr.discount_pct
    FROM latest src
    JOIN promotions pr
        ON src.channel <=> pr.channel
       AND src.order_date >= pr.starts_on
       AND src.order_date < pr.ends_on + INTERVAL 7 DAYS
),
totals AS (
    SELECT
        promo_code,
        PERCENTILE_APPROX(least_shipping_fee_amount, 0.5) AS least_shipping_fee_amount_p50,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE channel = 'partner') AS partner_rows,
        APPROX_PERCENTILE(discount_pct, ARRAY(0.25, 0.5, 0.75)) AS discount_pct_quartiles,
        SIZE(COLLECT_SET(promo_code)) AS num_promo_codes
    FROM matched
    GROUP BY promo_code
)
SELECT
    promo_code,
    partner_rows,
    num_promo_codes,
    CASE WHEN promo_code RLIKE '^(SPRING10|VIP)$' THEN 'PRIORITY' ELSE 'EXTENDED' END AS promo_code_zone
FROM totals

with filtered as (

    select
        *,
        coalesce(monthly_fee, 0) as monthly_fee_filled,
        substring(status, 1, 2) as status_prefix
    from subscriptions
    where end_date >= date '2024-03-01'
      and customer_id is not null
      and plan in ('basic', 'standard', 'enterprise')
),
with_windows as (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    select
        id,
        customer_id,
        plan,
        start_date,
        end_date,
        monthly_fee,
        status,
        monthly_fee_filled,
        status_prefix,
        rank() over (order by monthly_fee nulls last) as monthly_fee_rank,
        sum(monthly_fee_filled) over (order by start_date, id rows between unbounded preceding and current row) as running_monthly_fee_filled,
        min(monthly_fee) over (partition by plan, customer_id) as plan_min_monthly_fee
    from filtered
),
enriched as (
    -- Ranking and gap features

sql:
WITH filtered AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT
        id,
        customer_id,
        store_id,
        status,
        channel,
        amount,
        shipping_fee,
        discount / NULLIF(shipping_fee, 0) AS discount_per_shipping_fee,
        COALESCE(channel, 'NONE') AS channel_clean
    FROM orders
    WHERE customer_id IS NOT NULL
),
matched_keys AS (
    -- Set difference on keys
    SELECT store_id, id
    FROM filtered
    EXCEPT DISTINCT
    SELECT store_id, id
    FROM orders
    WHERE channel IS NULL
),
kept_rows AS (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    SELECT s.*
    FROM filtered s
    INNER JOIN matched_keys k ON s.store_id = k.store_id AND s.id = k.id
),
with_windows AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        id,
        customer_id,
        store_id,
        status,
        channel,
        amount,
        shipping_fee,
        discount_per_shipping_fee,
        channel_clean,
        MIN(discount_per_shipping_fee) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id) AS customer_id_min_discount_per_shipping_fee,
        CORR(shipping_fee, amount) OVER (PARTITION BY store_id, customer_id) AS corr_shipping_fee_amount,
        AVG(shipping_fee) OVER w_hist AS channel_avg_shipping_fee,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY store_id ORDER BY shipping_fee DESC NULLS FIRST) AS shipping_fee_dense_rank,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER w_running AS discount_per_shipping_fee_dense_rank
    FROM kept_rows
    WINDOW w_hist AS (PARTITION BY channel), w_running AS (PARTITION BY channel, store_id ORDER BY discount_per_shipping_fee DESC NULLS LAST)
),
enriched AS (
    -- Attach stores attributes
    SELECT
        e.*,
        d.opened_date,
        d.sqft
    FROM with_windows e
    LEFT JOIN stores d
        ON e.store_id = d.id
)
-- Aggregate with conditional metrics
SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', opened_date) AS year_start,
    ROUND(AVG(discount_per_shipping_fee_dense_rank), 2) AS avg_discount_per_shipping_fee_dense_rank,
    SUM(CASE WHEN channel = 'partner' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS partner_amount,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'SHIPPED') AS shipped_rows,
    MAX(shipping_fee) AS max_shipping_fee
FROM enriched
GROUP BY year_start
ORDER BY max_shipping_fee DESC;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("customer_id")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("store_id", "customer_id")
w_hist = Window.partitionBy("channel")
w4 = Window.partitionBy("store_id").orderBy(F.col("shipping_fee").desc_nulls_first())
w_running = Window.partitionBy("channel", "store_id").orderBy(F.col("discount_per_shipping_fee").desc_nulls_last())

filtered = (
    df_orders
    .filter(F.col("customer_id").isNotNull())
    .select(
        "id",
        "customer_id",
        "store_id",
        "status",
        "channel",
        "amount",
        "shipping_fee",
        (F.col("discount") / F.nullif("shipping_fee", F.lit(0))).alias("discount_per_shipping_fee"),
        F.coalesce("channel", F.lit("NONE")).alias("channel_clean"),
    )
)

matched_keys = (
    filtered
    .select("store_id", "id")
    .subtract(
        df_orders
        .filter(F.col("channel").isNull())
        .select("store_id", "id")
    )
)

kept_rows = (
    filtered
    .alias("s")
    .join(matched_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.store_id") == F.col("k.store_id")) & (F.col("s.id") == F.col("k.id")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

with_windows = (
    kept_rows
    .withColumn("customer_id_min_discount_per_shipping_fee", F.min("discount_per_shipping_fee").over(w))
    .withColumn("corr_shipping_fee_amount", F.corr("shipping_fee", "amount").over(w2))
    .withColumn("channel_avg_shipping_fee", F.avg("shipping_fee").over(w_hist))
    .withColumn("shipping_fee_dense_rank", F.dense_rank().over(w4))
    .withColumn("discount_per_shipping_fee_dense_rank", F.dense_rank().over(w_running))
)

enriched = (
    with_windows
    .alias("e")
    .join(df_stores.alias("d"), F.col("e.store_id") == F.col("d.id"), "left")
    .select("e.*", F.col("d.opened_date"), F.col("d.sqft"))
)

result = (
    enriched
    .groupBy(F.date_trunc("YEAR", "opened_date").alias("year_start"))
    .agg(
        F.round(F.avg("discount_per_shipping_fee_dense_rank"), 2).alias("avg_discount_per_shipping_fee_dense_rank"),
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("channel") == "partner", F.col("amount")).otherwise(0)).alias("partner_amount"),
        F.count(F.when(F.col("status") == "SHIPPED", 1)).alias("shipped_rows"),
        F.max("shipping_fee").alias("max_shipping_fee"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("max_shipping_fee").desc())
)

WITH filtered AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT *, INITCAP(TRIM(location)) AS location_title
    FROM departments
    WHERE dept_name IS NOT NULL
),
kept AS (
    -- Semi-join via a correlated subquery
    SELECT s.*
    FROM filtered s
    WHERE EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM employees c
            WHERE c.dept_id = s.id
              AND YEAR(c.hire_date) >= 2025
        )
),
with_latest AS (
    -- Latest matching employee per row (LATERAL ... LIMIT 1)
    SELECT
        s.*,
        x.salary,
        x.level
    FROM kept s
    JOIN LATERAL (
            SELECT c.salary, c.level
            FROM employees c
            WHERE c.dept_id = s.id
            ORDER BY c.salary DESC, c.id DESC
            LIMIT 1
        ) x ON TRUE
)
-- Multi-level aggregation
SELECT
    level,
    CASE WHEN salary >= 152000 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END AS salary_tier,
    SUM(budget) FILTER (WHERE location = 'Chiang Mai') AS chiang_mai_total_budget,
    COUNT_IF(dept_name = 'Finance') AS finance_events,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY level ORDER BY COUNT_IF(dept_name = 'Finance') DESC) AS finance_events_rank
FROM with_latest
GROUP BY level, salary_tier
ORDER BY finance_events DESC NULLS FIRST;

enriched as (

        s.store_name
    from joined e
    left join stores s
        on e.store_id = s.id

    sort_array(collect_set(channel)) as channel_list,
    round(sum(discount) / nullif(count(case when country = 'DE' then 1 end), 0), 2) as discount_per_de,
    count_if(region = 'North') as north_events
from enriched

with deduped as (
    -- Keep one row per key (latest first)
    select *
    from order_items
    qualify row_number() over (partition by product_id order by quantity desc, id asc) = 1
),
valid as (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    select *, unit_price + quantity line_total
    from deduped
    where product_id is not null
),
joined as (
    -- Attach orders attributes
    select
        e.*,
        p.order_date,
        p.discount,
        p.amount
    from valid e
    join orders p
        on e.order_id = p.id
),
metrics as (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    select
        *,
        avg(quantity) over (order by quantity asc, id asc rows between 3 preceding and 1 preceding) quantity_avg_3_prior,
        last_value(quantity, true) over (partition by product_id, order_id order by order_date asc, id asc rows between unbounded preceding and current row) last_known_quantity,
        lead(line_total, 1, 0) over (partition by product_id order by discount asc, id asc) next_line_total
    from joined
),
with_windows as (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    select
        *,
        ntile(4) over (order by quantity_avg_3_prior asc, id asc) quantity_avg_3_prior_bucket,
        ntile(4) over (order by quantity desc, id asc) quantity_bucket,
        row_number() over (partition by order_id order by next_line_total desc, id asc) event_seq,
        row_number() over (partition by order_id order by quantity asc, id asc) row_seq
    from metrics
),
enriched as (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    select
        *,
        first_value(quantity_avg_3_prior, true) over (order by quantity_avg_3_prior_bucket asc, id asc rows between unbounded preceding and current row) first_known_quantity_avg_3_prior,
        first_value(quantity_avg_3_prior, true) over (partition by order_id order by unit_price asc, id asc rows between unbounded preceding and current row) first_known_quantity_avg_3_prior_2
    from with_windows
)
select
    id,
    order_id,
    product_id,
    line_total,
    discount,
    amount,
    last_known_quantity,
    next_line_total,
    quantity_avg_3_prior_bucket
from enriched
order by order_id desc;

        s.supplier_name AS supplier_supplier_name
    FROM joined e
    LEFT JOIN suppliers s
        ON e.supplier_id = s.id
),
metrics AS (

        *,

        LAG(rating, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY supplier_country ORDER BY launch_date, id) AS prev_rating,

    FROM enriched
)
-- Grouped metrics

    supplier_id,
    CASE WHEN rating >= 4.1 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END AS rating_tier,

    SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_SET(country)) AS country_list,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE supplier_country = 'SG') AS sg_rows
FROM metrics
