WITH eligible AS (
    -- Anti-join via a correlated subquery
    SELECT s.*
    FROM suppliers s
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM products c
            WHERE c.supplier_id = s.id
              AND c.launch_date < '2024-04-01'
        )
),
scored AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        *,
        LAG(rating, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY city ORDER BY rating, id) AS prev_rating,
        CUME_DIST() OVER (PARTITION BY city, country ORDER BY rating NULLS LAST) AS rating_cume_dist
    FROM eligible
),
latest_match AS (
    -- Latest matching product per row (LATERAL ... LIMIT 1)
    SELECT s.*, latest.stock_qty
    FROM scored s
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
            SELECT c.stock_qty
            FROM products c
            WHERE c.supplier_id = s.id
            ORDER BY c.cost DESC, c.id DESC
            LIMIT 1
        ) latest ON TRUE
)
-- Grouped metrics
SELECT
    country,
    APPROX_PERCENTILE(rating_cume_dist, 0.5) AS rating_cume_dist_p50,
    COUNT_IF(country = 'SG') AS sg_events,
    SUM(CASE WHEN city = 'Tokyo' THEN stock_qty ELSE 0 END) AS tokyo_stock_qty
FROM latest_match
GROUP BY country

WITH latest AS (
    -- QUALIFY-style window filter
    SELECT *
    FROM suppliers
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY country, city ORDER BY rating, id) = 1
),
with_windows AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        id,
        supplier_name,
        country,
        city,
        rating,
        FIRST_VALUE(rating) IGNORE NULLS OVER (ORDER BY rating, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS first_known_rating,
        LAG(rating, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY country ORDER BY rating, id) AS prev_rating,
        LEAD(rating, 1, 0) OVER (PARTITION BY city ORDER BY rating, id) AS next_rating
    FROM latest
),
with_windows_suppliers AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        *,
        AVG(rating) OVER (ORDER BY rating, id ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS rating_avg_3,
        AVG(rating) OVER (ORDER BY prev_rating, id ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS rating_avg_6
    FROM with_windows
),
with_last AS (
    -- Latest matching product per row (LATERAL ... LIMIT 1)
    SELECT
        s.*,
        latest.product_price,
        latest.product_brand
    FROM with_windows_suppliers s
    JOIN LATERAL (
            SELECT c.price AS product_price, c.brand AS product_brand
            FROM products c
            WHERE c.supplier_id = s.id
            ORDER BY c.launch_date DESC, c.id DESC
            LIMIT 1
        ) latest ON TRUE
),
deduped AS (
    -- QUALIFY-style window filter
    SELECT *
    FROM (
        SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY city ORDER BY next_rating DESC, id) AS rank_in_group
        FROM with_last
    ) t
    WHERE rank_in_group = 1
),
scored AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        *,
        AVG(next_rating) OVER (PARTITION BY city ORDER BY rating_avg_3, id ROWS BETWEEN 5 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS next_rating_avg_5,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY product_brand ORDER BY next_rating DESC, id) AS row_seq,
        LAG(rating_avg_3, 1, 0) OVER (PARTITION BY product_brand ORDER BY rank_in_group, id) AS prev_rating_avg_3,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY product_brand ORDER BY first_known_rating DESC, id) AS event_seq,
        SUM(next_rating) OVER (ORDER BY rating_avg_3, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_next_rating
    FROM deduped
),
eligible AS (
    -- Anti-join via a correlated subquery
    SELECT s.*
    FROM scored s
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM products c
            WHERE c.supplier_id = s.id
              AND c.brand NOT IN ('Globex', 'Umbrella', 'Acme')
        )
),
grouped AS (
    -- Grouped metrics
    SELECT
        country,
        CASE WHEN rating_avg_6 >= 4 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END AS rating_avg_6_tier,
        SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_SET(country)) AS country_list,
        APPROX_PERCENTILE(first_known_rating, ARRAY(0.25, 0.5, 0.75)) AS first_known_rating_quartiles,
        COUNT(*) AS cnt
    FROM eligible
    GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT
    country,
    rating_avg_6_tier,
    first_known_rating_quartiles
FROM grouped

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("country", "city").orderBy("rating", "id")
w2 = Window.orderBy("rating", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w3 = Window.partitionBy("country").orderBy("rating", "id")
w4 = Window.partitionBy("city").orderBy("rating", "id")
w5 = Window.orderBy("rating", "id").rowsBetween(-3, Window.currentRow)
w6 = Window.orderBy("prev_rating", "id").rowsBetween(-6, Window.currentRow)
w7 = Window.partitionBy(F.col("s.id")).orderBy(F.col("c.launch_date").desc(), F.col("c.id").desc())
w8 = Window.partitionBy("city").orderBy(F.col("next_rating").desc(), "id")
w9 = Window.partitionBy("city").orderBy("rating_avg_3", "id").rowsBetween(-5, Window.currentRow)
w10 = Window.partitionBy("product_brand").orderBy(F.col("next_rating").desc(), "id")
w11 = Window.partitionBy("product_brand").orderBy("rank_in_group", "id")
w12 = Window.partitionBy("product_brand").orderBy(F.col("first_known_rating").desc(), "id")
w13 = Window.orderBy("rating_avg_3", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)

latest = (
    df_suppliers
    .withColumn("dedup_rank", F.row_number().over(w))
    .filter(F.col("dedup_rank") == 1)
    .drop("dedup_rank")
)

with_windows = (
    latest
    .select(
        "*",
        F.first("rating", ignorenulls=True).over(w2).alias("first_known_rating"),
        F.lag("rating", 1).over(w3).alias("prev_rating"),
        F.lead("rating", 1, 0).over(w4).alias("next_rating"),
    )
)

with_windows_suppliers = (
    with_windows
    .withColumn("rating_avg_3", F.avg("rating").over(w5))
    .withColumn("rating_avg_6", F.avg("rating").over(w6))
)

with_last = (
    with_windows_suppliers
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_products.alias("c"), (F.col("c.supplier_id") == F.col("s.id")), "inner")
    .withColumn("rn", F.row_number().over(w7))
    .filter(F.col("rn") == 1)
    .select(
        "s.*",
        F.col("c.price").alias("product_price"),
        F.col("c.brand").alias("product_brand"),
    )
)

deduped = (
    with_last
    .withColumn("rank_in_group", F.row_number().over(w8))
    .filter(F.col("rank_in_group") == 1)
)

scored = (
    deduped
    .select(
        "*",
        F.avg("next_rating").over(w9).alias("next_rating_avg_5"),
        F.row_number().over(w10).alias("row_seq"),
        F.lag("rating_avg_3", 1, 0).over(w11).alias("prev_rating_avg_3"),
        F.row_number().over(w12).alias("event_seq"),
        F.sum("next_rating").over(w13).alias("running_next_rating"),
    )
)

eligible = (
    scored
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_products.alias("c"), (F.col("c.supplier_id") == F.col("s.id")) & (~F.col("c.brand").isin(["Globex", "Umbrella", "Acme"])), "left_anti")
)

grouped = (
    eligible
    .groupBy(
        "country",
        F.when(F.col("rating_avg_6") >= 4, "LARGE").otherwise("SMALL").alias("rating_avg_6_tier"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.sort_array(F.collect_set("country")).alias("country_list"),
        F.percentile_approx("first_known_rating", [0.25, 0.5, 0.75]).alias("first_known_rating_quartiles"),
        F.count("*").alias("cnt"),
    )
)

result = grouped.select("country", "rating_avg_6_tier", "first_known_rating_quartiles")

WITH cleaned AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        full_name,
        email,
        dept_id,
        manager_id,
        job_title,
        salary,
        COALESCE(level, 'Unknown') AS level_filled,
        ROUND(salary * 0.85, 2) AS salary_scaled,
        COALESCE(job_title, 'NONE') AS resolved_job_title
    FROM employees
    WHERE hire_date >= DATE '2023-04-23'
      AND level IS NOT NULL
),
matched_keys AS (
    SELECT manager_id
    FROM cleaned
    EXCEPT ALL
    SELECT manager_id
    FROM employees
    WHERE salary >= 144000
),
verified AS (
    SELECT s.*
    FROM cleaned s
    INNER JOIN matched_keys k ON s.manager_id = k.manager_id
),
with_dims AS (
    SELECT
        src.*,
        b.level,
        b.full_name AS employee_full_name,
        b.job_title AS employee_job_title
    FROM verified src
    LEFT JOIN employees b
        ON src.manager_id = b.id
),
valid AS (
    SELECT
        full_name,
        email,
        manager_id,
        job_title,
        level_filled,
        salary_scaled,
        level,
        employee_full_name,
        employee_job_title,
        CASE WHEN salary_scaled >= 68 THEN 'High' WHEN salary_scaled >= 11 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END AS salary_scaled_level,
        COALESCE(level, 'OTHER') AS resolved_level
    FROM with_dims
    WHERE level IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
    s.full_name,
    s.email,
    s.manager_id,
    s.job_title,
    s.salary_scaled,
    s.level,
    s.employee_full_name,
    s.employee_job_title,
    s.salary_scaled_level,
    CASE WHEN job_title RLIKE '^(Designer|Director)$' THEN 'EXTENDED' WHEN job_title RLIKE '^(Engineer|Analyst)$' THEN 'OTHER_ZONE' ELSE 'CORE' END AS job_title_zone,
    (SELECT MIN(t2.salary) FROM employees t2 WHERE t2.manager_id = s.manager_id) AS min_employee_salary
FROM valid s
ORDER BY employee_job_title NULLS FIRST, job_title DESC

WITH exploded AS (
    -- Unnest the array into one row per element
    SELECT
        id,
        customer_id,
        created_at,
        key,
        attr_value
    FROM carts
    LATERAL VIEW OUTER EXPLODE(attributes) x AS key, attr_value
),
valid AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT *, MONTH(created_at) AS created_at_month
    FROM exploded
    WHERE created_at >= TIMESTAMP '2025-03-01 14:00:00'
      AND key IS NOT NULL
),
filtered AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        *,
        LOWER(key) AS key_lower,
        DATEDIFF(CURRENT_DATE(), created_at) AS days_since_created_at
    FROM valid
    WHERE customer_id = 17
),
base AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT
        id,
        created_at,
        key,
        attr_value,
        created_at_month,
        key_lower,
        days_since_created_at,
        DATEDIFF(CURRENT_DATE(), created_at) AS days_since_created_at_2,
        COALESCE(key, 'NONE') AS key_filled
    FROM filtered
    WHERE created_at > DATE '2025-03-02'
      AND key IS NOT NULL
),
valid_carts AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT
        *,
        ROUND(days_since_created_at_2 * 1.07, 2) AS days_since_created_at_2_scaled,
        COALESCE(key, 'DIRECT') AS resolved_key
    FROM base
    WHERE created_at > TIMESTAMP '2025-03-01 12:00:00'
      AND key IS NOT NULL
)
-- Multi-level aggregation
SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('HOUR', created_at) AS hour_window,
    ROUND(AVG(days_since_created_at), 2) AS avg_days_since_created_at,
    COUNT(DISTINCT key) AS distinct_keys,
    SUM(created_at_month) FILTER (WHERE key = 'weight_kg') AS weight_kg_total_created_at_month,
    GROUPING_ID() AS gid
FROM valid_carts
GROUP BY ROLLUP (DATE_TRUNC('HOUR', created_at))
HAVING avg_days_since_created_at < 0

WITH valid AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT
        id,
        device,
        started_at,
        country,
        DATE_TRUNC('month', started_at) AS started_at_period
    FROM sessions
    WHERE customer_id IS NOT NULL
)
-- Ranking and gap features
SELECT
    *,
    FIRST_VALUE(country) IGNORE NULLS OVER (PARTITION BY device ORDER BY started_at ASC, id ASC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS first_known_country,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY device, country ORDER BY started_at DESC, id ASC) AS event_seq,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY device, country ORDER BY started_at_period ASC, id ASC) AS event_seq_2
FROM valid
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("device").orderBy("started_at", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w2 = Window.partitionBy("device", "country").orderBy(F.col("started_at").desc(), "id")
w3 = Window.partitionBy("device", "country").orderBy("started_at_period", "id")

valid = (
    df_sessions
    .filter(F.col("customer_id").isNotNull())
    .select(
        "id",
        "device",
        "started_at",
        "country",
        F.date_trunc("month", "started_at").alias("started_at_period"),
    )
)

result = (
    valid
    .withColumn("first_known_country", F.first("country", ignorenulls=True).over(w))
    .withColumn("event_seq", F.row_number().over(w2))
    .withColumn("event_seq_2", F.row_number().over(w3))
)

WITH lines AS (
    -- Unnest the array into one row per element
    SELECT
        id,
        customer_id,
        created_at,
        coupon_codes,
        k,
        value
    FROM carts
    LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(attributes) t AS k, value
),
flattened AS (
    -- Unnest the array into one row per element
    SELECT
        id,
        customer_id,
        created_at,
        k,
        element
    FROM lines
    LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(coupon_codes) e AS element
),
matched_keys AS (
    -- Set intersection on keys
    SELECT id, customer_id
    FROM flattened
    INTERSECT
    SELECT id, customer_id
    FROM carts
    WHERE customer_id IN (19, 38)
),
kept_rows AS (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    SELECT s.*
    FROM flattened s
    INNER JOIN matched_keys k ON s.id = k.id AND s.customer_id = k.customer_id
)
SELECT
    s.customer_id,
    s.created_at,
    s.k,
    s.element,
    CASE WHEN element RLIKE '^(VIP|BUNDLE)$' THEN 'CORE' ELSE 'GROUP_A' END AS element_zone,
    (SELECT MIN(a2.balance) FROM accounts a2 WHERE a2.customer_id = s.customer_id) AS min_account_balance

WITH gaps AS (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > interval)
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN reading_ts - LAG(reading_ts) OVER (PARTITION BY device_code ORDER BY reading_ts, id) > INTERVAL 1 HOUR THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS session_start_flag
    FROM device_readings
),
sessionized AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(session_start_flag) OVER (PARTITION BY device_code ORDER BY reading_ts, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS burst_id
    FROM gaps
),
with_windows AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        id,
        device_code,
        reading_ts,
        temp_c,
        humidity,
        pressure,
        status_bits,
        firmware,
        session_start_flag,
        burst_id,
        MIN(status_bits) OVER (PARTITION BY device_code) AS device_code_min_status_bits,
        MAX(session_start_flag) OVER (PARTITION BY device_code ORDER BY CAST(reading_ts AS BIGINT) RANGE BETWEEN 1800 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_start_flag_max_30m,
        AVG(status_bits) OVER (PARTITION BY device_code ORDER BY humidity, id ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS status_bits_avg_6,
        SUM(pressure) OVER (ORDER BY status_bits, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_pressure,
        MAX(burst_id) OVER (ORDER BY CAST(reading_ts AS BIGINT) RANGE BETWEEN 1800 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS burst_id_max_30m
    FROM sessionized
),
with_gaps AS (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > interval)
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN LAG(reading_ts) OVER (PARTITION BY device_code ORDER BY reading_ts, id) IS NULL
                 OR reading_ts > LAG(reading_ts) OVER (PARTITION BY device_code ORDER BY reading_ts, id) + INTERVAL '30' MINUTE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_new_session
    FROM with_windows
),
islands AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(is_new_session) OVER (PARTITION BY device_code ORDER BY reading_ts, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS island_id
    FROM with_gaps
),
by_type AS (
    -- Native SQL PIVOT
    SELECT *
    FROM (
        SELECT
            firmware,
            device_code,
            temp_c
        FROM islands
    ) src
    PIVOT (
        AVG(temp_c) AS amount
        FOR device_code IN ('DV-03' AS dv_03, 'DV-02' AS dv_02)
    )
)
SELECT
    firmware,
    dv_03,
    dv_02
FROM by_type
ORDER BY dv_02 DESC, firmware

from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("device_code").orderBy("reading_ts", "id")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("device_code").orderBy("reading_ts", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w3 = Window.partitionBy("device_code")
w4 = Window.partitionBy("device_code").orderBy(F.col("reading_ts").cast("bigint")).rangeBetween(-1800, Window.currentRow)
w5 = Window.partitionBy("device_code").orderBy("humidity", "id").rowsBetween(-6, Window.currentRow)
w6 = Window.orderBy("status_bits", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w7 = Window.orderBy(F.col("reading_ts").cast("bigint")).rangeBetween(-1800, Window.currentRow)

gaps = (
    df_device_readings
    .withColumn("session_start_flag", F.when(F.col("reading_ts") - F.lag("reading_ts").over(w) > F.expr("INTERVAL 1 HOUR"), 1).otherwise(0))
)

sessionized = gaps.withColumn("burst_id", F.sum("session_start_flag").over(w2))

with_windows = (
    sessionized
    .select(
        "*",
        F.min("status_bits").over(w3).alias("device_code_min_status_bits"),
        F.max("session_start_flag").over(w4).alias("session_start_flag_max_30m"),

    )
)

with_gaps = (
    with_windows
    .withColumn("is_new_session", F.when(F.lag("reading_ts").over(w).isNull() | (F.col("reading_ts") > F.lag("reading_ts").over(w) + F.expr("INTERVAL 30 MINUTES")), 1).otherwise(0))
)

islands = with_gaps.withColumn("island_id", F.sum("is_new_session").over(w2))

by_type = (

    .select("firmware", F.col("DV-03").alias("dv_03"), F.col("DV-02").alias("dv_02"))

result = (

    .select("firmware", "dv_03", "dv_02")
    .orderBy(F.col("dv_02").desc(), "firmware")

WITH cleaned AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT
        *,
        CONCAT_WS('-', dept_name, location) AS dept_name_location_key,
        INITCAP(TRIM(dept_name)) AS dept_name_title,
        COALESCE(dept_name, 'OTHER') AS resolved_dept_name
    FROM departments
    WHERE dept_name IS NOT NULL
      AND location NOT IN ('Tokyo', 'Bangkok', 'Singapore')
),
base AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT
        id,
        dept_name,
        location,
        dept_name_title,
        CASE WHEN budget >= 4358000 THEN 'High' WHEN budget >= 940000 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END AS budget_tier
    FROM cleaned
    WHERE dept_name NOT IN ('Legal', 'Sales')
),
not_flagged AS (
    -- Semi-join via a correlated subquery
    SELECT s.*
    FROM base s
    WHERE EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM employees ch
            WHERE ch.dept_id = s.id
              AND ch.manager_id IN (13, 19, 39)
        )
),
not_flagged_departments AS (
    -- Semi-join via a correlated subquery
    SELECT s.*
    FROM not_flagged s
    WHERE EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM employees x
            WHERE x.dept_id = s.id
              AND x.dept_id IN (7, 14, 17, 29)
        )
),
filtered AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT *, LOWER(dept_name) AS dept_name_lower
    FROM not_flagged_departments
    WHERE location IN ('Bangkok', 'London')
),
stats AS (
    -- Multi-level aggregation
    SELECT
        location,
        SIZE(COLLECT_SET(location)) AS num_locations,
        COUNT(*) AS row_count,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN location = 'London' THEN 1 END) AS london_count,
        COUNT(*) AS row_count_2
    FROM filtered
    GROUP BY location
    HAVING COUNT(CASE WHEN location = 'London' THEN 1 END) < 1
)
SELECT
    location,
    row_count,
    london_count,
    CASE WHEN location RLIKE '^(London|Singapore)$' THEN 'OTHER_ZONE' ELSE 'GROUP_A' END AS location_zone
FROM stats
ORDER BY row_count NULLS LAST, london_count

cleaned = (

    .filter(F.col("dept_name").isNotNull() & ~F.col("location").isin(["Tokyo", "Bangkok", "Singapore"]))
    .withColumn("dept_name_location_key", F.concat_ws("-", "dept_name", "location"))
    .withColumn("dept_name_title", F.initcap(F.trim("dept_name")))
    .withColumn("resolved_dept_name", F.coalesce("dept_name", F.lit("OTHER")))
)

base = (
    cleaned
    .filter(~F.col("dept_name").isin(["Legal", "Sales"]))
    .select(
        "id",
        "dept_name",
        "location",
        "dept_name_title",
        F.when(F.col("budget") >= 4358000, "High").when(F.col("budget") >= 940000, "Medium").otherwise("Low").alias("budget_tier"),

not_flagged = (

    select
        id,
        log_ts,
        status_code,
        key,
        value
    from app_logs
    lateral view outer explode(context) e as key, value
),
scored as (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    select
        *,
        percent_rank() over (partition by key order by status_code) status_code_percent_rank,
        round(status_code / sum(status_code) over (partition by key), 4) status_code_share,
        max(status_code) over (partition by key order by cast(log_ts as bigint) range between 7200 preceding and current row) status_code_max_2h,
        rank() over (partition by key order by status_code desc) status_code_rank,
        cume_dist() over (order by status_code desc) status_code_cume_dist
    from lines
),
scored_app_logs as (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    select
        *,
        avg(status_code_percent_rank) over (partition by key order by cast(log_ts as bigint) range between 1800 preceding and current row) status_code_percent_rank_avg_30m,
        percent_rank() over (partition by key order by status_code_percent_rank nulls first) status_code_percent_rank_percent_rank,
        percent_rank() over (order by status_code_cume_dist nulls last) status_code_cume_dist_percent_rank
    from scored
)
-- Running and moving aggregates
select
    *,
    percent_rank() over w_running status_code_cume_dist_percent_rank_2,
    round(status_code_rank / sum(status_code_rank) over (partition by key), 4) status_code_rank_share,
    max(status_code_cume_dist_percent_rank) over w_recent status_code_cume_dist_percent_rank_max_2h,
    sum(status_code_share) over w_recent status_code_share_sum_2h
from scored_app_logs
window w_running as (partition by key order by status_code_cume_dist desc nulls last), w_recent as (order by cast(log_ts as bigint) range between 7200 preceding and current row);

WITH base AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT *, quantity * unit_price AS line_total
    FROM order_items
    WHERE product_id IS NOT NULL
),
base_order_items AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT
        id,
        product_id,
        quantity,
        unit_price,
        line_total + quantity AS line_total_plus_quantity
    FROM base
    WHERE product_id IS NOT NULL
),
with_windows AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        id,
        product_id,
        quantity,
        unit_price,
        line_total_plus_quantity,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY line_total_plus_quantity ASC, id ASC) AS row_seq,
        SUM(quantity) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY line_total_plus_quantity ASC, id ASC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_quantity,
        NTILE(3) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY line_total_plus_quantity ASC, id ASC) AS line_total_plus_quantity_bucket
    FROM base_order_items
),
base_order_items_2 AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT
        id,
        product_id,
        quantity,
        row_seq,
        cumulative_quantity,
        LEAST(quantity, row_seq) AS least_quantity_row_seq,
        ROUND(unit_price / line_total_plus_quantity_bucket, 2) AS unit_price_per_line_total_plus_quantity_bucket
    FROM with_windows
    WHERE product_id IS NOT NULL
)
-- Ranking and gap features
SELECT
    *,
    AVG(row_seq) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY row_seq ASC, id ASC ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS row_seq_avg_6,
    SUM(cumulative_quantity) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY unit_price_per_line_total_plus_quantity_bucket ASC, id ASC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_cumulative_quantity,
    PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY least_quantity_row_seq ASC NULLS LAST) AS least_quantity_row_seq_percent_rank
FROM base_order_items_2
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.orderBy("line_total_plus_quantity", "id")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("product_id").orderBy("line_total_plus_quantity", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w3 = Window.partitionBy("product_id").orderBy("line_total_plus_quantity", "id")
w4 = Window.partitionBy("product_id").orderBy("row_seq", "id").rowsBetween(-6, Window.currentRow)
w5 = Window.partitionBy("product_id").orderBy("unit_price_per_line_total_plus_quantity_bucket", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w6 = Window.partitionBy("product_id").orderBy(F.col("least_quantity_row_seq").asc_nulls_last())

base = (
    df_order_items
    .filter(F.col("product_id").isNotNull())
    .select("*", (F.col("quantity") * F.col("unit_price")).alias("line_total"))
)

base_order_items = (
    base
    .filter(F.col("product_id").isNotNull())
    .select(
        "id",
        "product_id",
        "quantity",
        "unit_price",
        (F.col("line_total") + F.col("quantity")).alias("line_total_plus_quantity"),
    )
)

with_windows = (
    base_order_items
    .withColumn("row_seq", F.row_number().over(w))
    .withColumn("cumulative_quantity", F.sum("quantity").over(w2))
    .withColumn("line_total_plus_quantity_bucket", F.ntile(3).over(w3))
)

base_order_items_2 = (
    with_windows
    .filter(F.col("product_id").isNotNull())
    .select(
        "id",
        "product_id",
        "quantity",
        "row_seq",
        "cumulative_quantity",
        F.least("quantity", "row_seq").alias("least_quantity_row_seq"),
        F.round((F.col("unit_price") / F.col("line_total_plus_quantity_bucket")), 2).alias("unit_price_per_line_total_plus_quantity_bucket"),
    )
)

result = (
    base_order_items_2
    .select(
        "*",
        F.avg("row_seq").over(w4).alias("row_seq_avg_6"),
        F.sum("cumulative_quantity").over(w5).alias("cumulative_cumulative_quantity"),
        F.percent_rank().over(w6).alias("least_quantity_row_seq_percent_rank"),
    )
)

WITH exploded AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        currency,
        val
    FROM price_tiers
    LATERAL VIEW OUTER EXPLODE(tier_limits) t AS val
),
with_windows AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY currency ORDER BY val) AS val_dense_rank,
        AVG(val) OVER (PARTITION BY currency) AS currency_avg_val,
        CUME_DIST() OVER (PARTITION BY currency ORDER BY val DESC NULLS FIRST) AS val_cume_dist
    FROM exploded
),
valid AS (
    SELECT *, currency_avg_val / NULLIF(val_cume_dist, 0) AS currency_avg_val_per_val_cume_dist
    FROM with_windows
    WHERE val_dense_rank <> 6
)
SELECT
    id,
    currency,
    val,
    val_dense_rank,
    currency_avg_val,
    val_cume_dist,
    currency_avg_val_per_val_cume_dist,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY currency_avg_val DESC NULLS FIRST) AS currency_avg_val_dense_rank,
    PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY currency ORDER BY val_cume_dist DESC) AS val_cume_dist_percent_rank
FROM valid;

from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("currency").orderBy("val")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("currency")
w3 = Window.partitionBy("currency").orderBy(F.col("val").desc_nulls_first())
w4 = Window.orderBy(F.col("currency_avg_val").desc_nulls_first())
w5 = Window.partitionBy("currency").orderBy(F.col("val_cume_dist").desc())

exploded = df_price_tiers.select("id", "currency", F.explode_outer("tier_limits").alias("val"))

with_windows = (
    exploded
    .select(
        "*",
        F.dense_rank().over(w).alias("val_dense_rank"),
        F.avg("val").over(w2).alias("currency_avg_val"),
        F.cume_dist().over(w3).alias("val_cume_dist"),
    )
)

valid = (
    with_windows
    .filter(F.col("val_dense_rank") != 6)
    .withColumn("currency_avg_val_per_val_cume_dist", (F.col("currency_avg_val") / F.nullif("val_cume_dist", F.lit(0))))
)

result = (
    valid
    .withColumn("currency_avg_val_dense_rank", F.dense_rank().over(w4))
    .withColumn("val_cume_dist_percent_rank", F.percent_rank().over(w5))
)

sql: WITH exploded AS (SELECT id, code FROM carts LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(coupon_codes) e AS code), cleaned AS (SELECT *, SUBSTRING(code, 1, 2) AS code_prefix, CASE WHEN code = 'WELCOME5' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_welcome5 FROM exploded WHERE code = 'WELCOME5'), enriched AS (SELECT *, MIN(is_welcome5) OVER (PARTITION BY code) AS code_min_is_welcome5, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY is_welcome5 DESC NULLS FIRST) AS is_welcome5_rank FROM cleaned), filtered AS (SELECT *, INITCAP(TRIM(code)) AS code_title, COALESCE(code, 'N/A') AS code_clean FROM enriched WHERE code = 'WELCOME5') SELECT id, code, code_prefix, is_welcome5, code_min_is_welcome5, is_welcome5_rank, code_title, code_clean FROM filtered ORDER BY is_welcome5_rank DESC NULLS FIRST

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("code")
w2 = Window.orderBy(F.col("is_welcome5").desc_nulls_first())

exploded = df_carts.select("id", F.explode("coupon_codes").alias("code"))

cleaned = (
    exploded
    .filter(F.col("code") == "WELCOME5")
    .select(
        "*",
        F.substring("code", 1, 2).alias("code_prefix"),
        F.when(F.col("code") == "WELCOME5", 1).otherwise(0).alias("is_welcome5"),
    )
)

enriched = (
    cleaned
    .select(
        "*",
        F.min("is_welcome5").over(w).alias("code_min_is_welcome5"),
        F.rank().over(w2).alias("is_welcome5_rank"),
    )
)

filtered = (
    enriched
    .filter(F.col("code") == "WELCOME5")
    .withColumn("code_title", F.initcap(F.trim("code")))
    .withColumn("code_clean", F.coalesce("code", F.lit("N/A")))
)

result = (
    filtered
    .select(
        "id",
        "code",
        "code_prefix",
        "is_welcome5",
        "code_min_is_welcome5",
        "is_welcome5_rank",
        "code_title",
        "code_clean",
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("is_welcome5_rank").desc_nulls_first())
)

WITH valid AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        id,
        product_id,
        quantity,
        unit_price,
        CASE WHEN unit_price >= 380 THEN 'High' WHEN unit_price >= 200 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END AS unit_price_level
    FROM order_items
    WHERE product_id IS NULL
)
-- Aggregate with conditional metrics
SELECT
    product_id,
    CASE WHEN unit_price >= 370 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END AS unit_price_tier,
    STDDEV_SAMP(unit_price) AS unit_price_stddev,
    COUNT(DISTINCT id) AS distinct_ids,
    APPROX_PERCENTILE(unit_price, 0.5) AS unit_price_p50
FROM valid
GROUP BY 1, 2
HAVING unit_price_p50 < 0
ORDER BY unit_price_p50 DESC
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

valid = (
    df_order_items
    .filter(F.col("product_id").isNull())
    .select(
        "id",
        "product_id",
        "quantity",
        "unit_price",
        F.when(F.col("unit_price") >= 380, "High").when(F.col("unit_price") >= 200, "Medium").otherwise("Low").alias("unit_price_level"),
    )
)

result = (
    valid
    .groupBy(
        "product_id",
        F.when(F.col("unit_price") >= 370, "LARGE").otherwise("SMALL").alias("unit_price_tier"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.stddev_samp("unit_price").alias("unit_price_stddev"),
        F.countDistinct("id").alias("distinct_ids"),
        F.percentile_approx("unit_price", 0.5).alias("unit_price_p50"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("unit_price_p50") < 0)
    .orderBy(F.col("unit_price_p50").desc())
)

WITH base AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT *, CONCAT(dept_name, ', ', location) AS dept_name_location
    FROM departments
    WHERE location IS NOT NULL
),
with_last AS (
    -- Latest matching employee per row (LATERAL ... LIMIT 1)
    SELECT
        s.*,
        top1.hire_date,
        top1.employee_salary
    FROM base s
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
            SELECT c.hire_date, c.salary AS employee_salary
            FROM employees c
            WHERE c.dept_id = s.id
            ORDER BY c.hire_date DESC, c.id DESC
            LIMIT 1
        ) top1 ON TRUE
),
deduped AS (
    -- Deduplicate with ROW_NUMBER
    SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY dept_name ORDER BY employee_salary DESC NULLS FIRST, id) AS latest_rank
    FROM with_last
    QUALIFY latest_rank = 1
),
deduped_departments AS (
    -- Keep one row per key (latest first)
    SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY dept_name, location ORDER BY employee_salary DESC, id) AS rank_in_group
    FROM deduped
    QUALIFY rank_in_group = 1
)
-- Native SQL PIVOT
SELECT *
FROM (
    SELECT
        dept_name,
        location,
        employee_salary
    FROM deduped_departments
) src
PIVOT (
    MAX(employee_salary) AS total,
    COUNT(1) AS cnt
    FOR location IN ('Chiang Mai' AS chiang_mai, 'Tokyo' AS tokyo, 'New York' AS new_york)
);
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy(F.col("s.id")).orderBy(F.col("c.hire_date").desc(), F.col("c.id").desc())
w2 = Window.partitionBy("dept_name").orderBy(F.col("employee_salary").desc_nulls_first(), "id")
w3 = Window.partitionBy("dept_name", "location").orderBy(F.col("employee_salary").desc(), "id")

base = (
    df_departments
    .filter(F.col("location").isNotNull())
    .withColumn("dept_name_location", F.concat("dept_name", F.lit(", "), "location"))
)

with_last = (
    base
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_employees.alias("c"), (F.col("c.dept_id") == F.col("s.id")), "left")
    .withColumn("rn", F.row_number().over(w))
    .filter(F.col("rn") == 1)
    .select("s.*", F.col("c.hire_date"), F.col("c.salary").alias("employee_salary"))
)

deduped = (
    with_last
    .withColumn("latest_rank", F.row_number().over(w2))
    .filter(F.col("latest_rank") == 1)
)

deduped_departments = (
    deduped
    .withColumn("rank_in_group", F.row_number().over(w3))
    .filter(F.col("rank_in_group") == 1)
)

result = (
    deduped_departments
    .groupBy("dept_name")
    .pivot("location", ["Chiang Mai", "Tokyo", "New York"])
    .agg(F.max("employee_salary").alias("total"), F.count(F.lit(1)).alias("cnt"))
    .select(
        "dept_name",
        F.col("Chiang Mai_total").alias("chiang_mai_total"),
        F.col("Chiang Mai_cnt").alias("chiang_mai_cnt"),
        F.col("Tokyo_total").alias("tokyo_total"),
        F.col("Tokyo_cnt").alias("tokyo_cnt"),
        F.col("New York_total").alias("new_york_total"),
        F.col("New York_cnt").alias("new_york_cnt"),
    )
)

WITH filtered AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        DATE_TRUNC('year', last_restock) AS last_restock_period,
        DATE_FORMAT(last_restock, 'yyyy-MM-dd') AS last_restock_label
    FROM inventory
    WHERE last_restock >= DATE '2024-04-01'
),
gaps AS (
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN LAG(last_restock_period) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY last_restock_period, id) IS NULL
                 OR last_restock_period > LAG(last_restock_period) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY last_restock_period, id) + INTERVAL '7' DAY THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_new_burst
    FROM filtered
),
sessionized AS (
    SELECT *, SUM(is_new_burst) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY last_restock_period, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS burst_id
    FROM gaps
),
scored AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        NTILE(4) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id, store_id ORDER BY is_new_burst, id) AS is_new_burst_bucket,
        CUME_DIST() OVER w_running AS is_new_burst_cume_dist
    FROM sessionized
    WINDOW w_running AS (ORDER BY is_new_burst DESC NULLS LAST)
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM scored
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY store_id ORDER BY burst_id, id) = 1
),
deduped AS (
    SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY store_id ORDER BY is_new_burst_bucket NULLS FIRST, id) AS rn
    FROM ranked
    QUALIFY rn = 1
),
metrics AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        AVG(is_new_burst) OVER (PARTITION BY store_id ORDER BY CAST(last_restock_period AS BIGINT) RANGE BETWEEN 604800 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS is_new_burst_avg_7d,
        SUM(quantity) OVER (PARTITION BY store_id ORDER BY is_new_burst, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_quantity,
        SUM(burst_id) OVER (PARTITION BY store_id ORDER BY last_restock, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_burst_id,
        SUM(is_new_burst_bucket) OVER (ORDER BY burst_id, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_is_new_burst_bucket
    FROM deduped
)
SELECT
    running_burst_id,
    CASE WHEN cumulative_quantity >= 1123 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END AS cumulative_quantity_tier,
    COUNT(*) AS cnt,
    AVG(cumulative_is_new_burst_bucket) AS avg_cumulative_is_new_burst_bucket,
    PERCENTILE_APPROX(running_burst_id, 0.95) AS running_burst_id_p95,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY running_burst_id ORDER BY AVG(cumulative_is_new_burst_bucket) DESC) AS avg_cumulative_is_new_burst_bucket_dense_rank
FROM metrics
GROUP BY running_burst_id, CASE WHEN cumulative_quantity >= 1123 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END
ORDER BY cumulative_quantity_tier DESC NULLS LAST
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("product_id").orderBy("last_restock_period", "id")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("product_id").orderBy("last_restock_period", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w3 = Window.partitionBy("product_id", "store_id").orderBy("is_new_burst", "id")
w_running = Window.orderBy(F.col("is_new_burst").desc_nulls_last())
w5 = Window.partitionBy("store_id").orderBy("burst_id", "id")
w6 = Window.partitionBy("store_id").orderBy(F.col("is_new_burst_bucket").asc_nulls_first(), "id")
w7 = Window.partitionBy("store_id").orderBy(F.col("last_restock_period").cast("bigint")).rangeBetween(-604800, Window.currentRow)
w8 = Window.partitionBy("store_id").orderBy("is_new_burst", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w9 = Window.partitionBy("store_id").orderBy("last_restock", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w10 = Window.orderBy("burst_id", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w11 = Window.partitionBy("running_burst_id").orderBy(F.col("avg_cumulative_is_new_burst_bucket").desc())

filtered = (
    df_inventory
    .filter(F.col("last_restock") >= F.lit("2024-04-01").cast("date"))
    .select(
        "*",
        F.date_trunc("year", "last_restock").alias("last_restock_period"),
        F.date_format("last_restock", "yyyy-MM-dd").alias("last_restock_label"),
    )
)

gaps = (
    filtered
    .withColumn("is_new_burst", F.when(F.lag("last_restock_period").over(w).isNull() | (F.col("last_restock_period") > F.lag("last_restock_period").over(w) + F.expr("INTERVAL 7 DAYS")), 1).otherwise(0))
)

sessionized = gaps.withColumn("burst_id", F.sum("is_new_burst").over(w2))

scored = (
    sessionized
    .select(
        "*",
        F.ntile(4).over(w3).alias("is_new_burst_bucket"),
        F.cume_dist().over(w_running).alias("is_new_burst_cume_dist"),
    )
)

ranked = (
    scored
    .withColumn("rank_in_group", F.row_number().over(w5))
    .filter(F.col("rank_in_group") == 1)
    .drop("rank_in_group")
)

deduped = (
    ranked
    .withColumn("rn", F.row_number().over(w6))
    .filter(F.col("rn") == 1)
)

metrics = (
    deduped
    .select(
        "*",
        F.avg("is_new_burst").over(w7).alias("is_new_burst_avg_7d"),
        F.sum("quantity").over(w8).alias("cumulative_quantity"),
        F.sum("burst_id").over(w9).alias("running_burst_id"),
        F.sum("is_new_burst_bucket").over(w10).alias("cumulative_is_new_burst_bucket"),
    )
)

result = (
    metrics

WITH filtered AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        *,
        ROUND(quantity, 1) AS quantity_rounded,
        unit_price - quantity AS line_total
    FROM order_items
    WHERE product_id IS NOT NULL
      AND unit_price > 220
),
metrics AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        id,
        order_id,
        product_id,
        quantity,
        unit_price,
        quantity_rounded,
        line_total,
        SUM(unit_price) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY line_total, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_unit_price,
        NTILE(3) OVER (PARTITION BY order_id ORDER BY quantity_rounded, id) AS quantity_rounded_bucket
    FROM filtered
),
latest AS (
    -- Keep one row per key (latest first)
    SELECT *
    FROM metrics
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY quantity_rounded DESC, id) = 1
)
-- Native SQL UNPIVOT (wide to long)
SELECT *
FROM (
    SELECT
        id,
        product_id,
        line_total,
        unit_price,
        quantity_rounded
    FROM latest
) src
UNPIVOT (
    reading FOR metric IN (line_total AS LINE_TOTAL_VAL, unit_price AS UNIT_PRICE, quantity_rounded)
);

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("product_id").orderBy("line_total", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w2 = Window.partitionBy("order_id").orderBy("quantity_rounded", "id")
w3 = Window.partitionBy("product_id").orderBy(F.col("quantity_rounded").desc(), "id")

filtered = (
    df_order_items
    .filter(F.col("product_id").isNotNull() & (F.col("unit_price") > 220))
    .withColumn("quantity_rounded", F.round("quantity", 1))
    .withColumn("line_total", (F.col("unit_price") - F.col("quantity")))
)

metrics = (
    filtered
    .withColumn("cumulative_unit_price", F.sum("unit_price").over(w))
    .withColumn("quantity_rounded_bucket", F.ntile(3).over(w2))
)

latest = (
    metrics
    .withColumn("latest_rank", F.row_number().over(w3))
    .filter(F.col("latest_rank") == 1)
    .drop("latest_rank")
)

result = (
    latest
    .select(
        "id",
        "product_id",
        F.col("line_total").alias("LINE_TOTAL_VAL"),
        F.col("unit_price").alias("UNIT_PRICE"),
        "quantity_rounded",
    )
    .unpivot(
        ["id", "product_id"],
        ["LINE_TOTAL_VAL", "UNIT_PRICE", "quantity_rounded"],
        "metric",
        "reading",
    )
    .filter(F.col("reading").isNotNull())
)

sql:
WITH deduped AS (
    -- Deduplicate with ROW_NUMBER
    SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY end_date NULLS LAST, id) AS rank_in_group
    FROM subscriptions
    QUALIFY rank_in_group = 1
),
matched AS (
    -- Non-equi join on a validity window
    SELECT
        e.*,
        sub.id AS subscription_id,
        sub.plan AS subscription_plan,
        sub.monthly_fee AS subscription_monthly_fee
    FROM deduped e
    LEFT JOIN subscriptions sub
        ON e.customer_id = sub.customer_id
       AND e.start_date >= sub.start_date
       AND e.start_date < sub.end_date + INTERVAL 7 DAYS
),
joined AS (
    -- Attach customers attributes
    SELECT
        a.*,
        d.country,
        d.signup_date
    FROM matched a
    LEFT JOIN customers d
        ON a.customer_id = d.id
),
enriched AS (
    -- Attach customers attributes
    SELECT a.*, c.email
    FROM joined a
    LEFT JOIN customers c
        ON a.customer_id = c.id
)
-- Grouped metrics
SELECT
    CASE WHEN monthly_fee >= 214 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END AS monthly_fee_tier,
    DATE_TRUNC('QUARTER', end_date) AS quarter_start,
    SUM(subscription_monthly_fee) AS total_subscription_monthly_fee,
    ROUND(SUM(monthly_fee) / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN subscription_plan = 'standard' THEN 1 END), 0), 2) AS monthly_fee_per_standard,
    ROUND(SUM(subscription_id) / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN subscription_plan = 'basic' THEN 1 END), 0), 2) AS subscription_id_per_basic,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'EXPIRED') AS expired_rows,
    COUNT_IF(plan = 'basic') AS basic_events,
    APPROX_PERCENTILE(monthly_fee, 0.95) AS monthly_fee_p95
FROM enriched
GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((CASE WHEN monthly_fee >= 214 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END, DATE_TRUNC('QUARTER', end_date)), (CASE WHEN monthly_fee >= 214 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END), ())
HAVING COUNT_IF(plan = 'basic') < 1
ORDER BY subscription_id_per_basic DESC
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("customer_id").orderBy(F.col("end_date").asc_nulls_last(), "id")

deduped = (
    df_subscriptions
    .withColumn("rank_in_group", F.row_number().over(w))
    .filter(F.col("rank_in_group") == 1)
)

matched = (
    deduped
    .alias("e")
    .join(df_subscriptions.alias("sub"), (F.col("e.customer_id") == F.col("sub.customer_id")) & (F.col("e.start_date") >= F.col("sub.start_date")) & (F.col("e.start_date") < F.col("sub.end_date") + F.expr("INTERVAL 7 DAYS")), "left")
    .select(
        "e.*",
        F.col("sub.id").alias("subscription_id"),
        F.col("sub.plan").alias("subscription_plan"),
        F.col("sub.monthly_fee").alias("subscription_monthly_fee"),
    )
)

joined = (
    matched
    .alias("a")
    .join(df_customers.alias("d"), F.col("a.customer_id") == F.col("d.id"), "left")
    .select("a.*", F.col("d.country"), F.col("d.signup_date"))
)

enriched = (
    joined
    .alias("a")
    .join(df_customers.alias("c"), F.col("a.customer_id") == F.col("c.id"), "left")
    .select("a.*", F.col("c.email"))
)

result = (
    enriched
    .withColumn("monthly_fee_tier", F.when(F.col("monthly_fee") >= 214, "HIGH").otherwise("LOW"))
    .withColumn("quarter_start", F.date_trunc("QUARTER", "end_date"))
    .groupingSets(
        [["monthly_fee_tier", "quarter_start"], ["monthly_fee_tier"], []],
        "monthly_fee_tier",
        "quarter_start",
    )
    .agg(
        F.sum("subscription_monthly_fee").alias("total_subscription_monthly_fee"),
        F.round(F.sum("monthly_fee") / F.nullif(F.count(F.when(F.col("subscription_plan") == "standard", 1)), F.lit(0)), 2).alias("monthly_fee_per_standard"),
        F.round(F.sum("subscription_id") / F.nullif(F.count(F.when(F.col("subscription_plan") == "basic", 1)), F.lit(0)), 2).alias("subscription_id_per_basic"),
        F.count(F.when(F.col("status") == "EXPIRED", 1)).alias("expired_rows"),
        F.count_if(F.col("plan") == "basic").alias("basic_events"),
        F.percentile_approx("monthly_fee", 0.95).alias("monthly_fee_p95"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("basic_events") < 1)
    .orderBy(F.col("subscription_id_per_basic").desc())
)

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("dept_name", "location").orderBy(F.col("budget").asc_nulls_last())
w2 = Window.partitionBy("dept_name")
w3 = Window.partitionBy("location")
w4 = Window.orderBy(F.col("budget").desc())
w_grp = Window.orderBy(F.col("budget_rank").asc_nulls_last())

kept_keys = (
    df_departments
    .select("location")
    .subtract(
        df_departments
        .filter(F.col("location").isin(["Tokyo", "Berlin", "Chiang Mai"]))
        .select("location")
    )
)

kept_rows = (
    df_departments
    .alias("s")
    .join(kept_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.location") == F.col("k.location")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

with_windows = (
    kept_rows
    .select(
        "*",
        F.rank().over(w).alias("budget_rank"),
        F.round((F.col("budget") / F.sum("budget").over(w2)), 4).alias("budget_share"),
        F.round((F.col("budget") / F.sum("budget").over(w3)), 4).alias("budget_share_2"),
        F.max("budget").over(w2).alias("dept_name_max_budget"),
    )
)

base = (
    with_windows
    .filter(F.col("location").isNotNull())
    .select(
        "id",
        "budget",
        "budget_rank",
        "budget_share",
        "budget_share_2",
        "dept_name_max_budget",
        F.col("budget").cast("int").alias("budget_int"),
        F.substring("location", 1, 3).alias("location_prefix"),
    )
)

with_windows_departments = (
    base
    .select(
        "*",
        F.percent_rank().over(w4).alias("budget_percent_rank"),
        F.percent_rank().over(w_grp).alias("budget_rank_percent_rank"),
    )
)

result = (
    with_windows_departments
    .cube(
        F.when(F.col("budget_share_2") >= 0.61, "PREMIUM").otherwise("STANDARD").alias("budget_share_2_tier"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.percentile_approx("budget_share_2", [0.25, 0.5, 0.75]).alias("budget_share_2_quartiles"),
        F.countDistinct("id").alias("distinct_ids"),
        F.count("*").alias("cnt"),
        F.percentile_approx("dept_name_max_budget", 0.5).alias("dept_name_max_budget_p50"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("budget_share_2_tier").desc_nulls_last())
)

sql:
WITH with_last AS (
    -- Latest matching inventory per row (LATERAL ... LIMIT 1)
    SELECT
        s.*,
        latest.quantity,
        latest.last_restock
    FROM stores s
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
            SELECT c.quantity, c.last_restock
            FROM inventory c
            WHERE c.store_id = s.id
            ORDER BY c.last_restock DESC, c.id DESC
            LIMIT 1
        ) latest ON TRUE
)
-- Multi-level aggregation
SELECT
    region,
    SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_SET(city)) AS city_list,
    SUM(CASE WHEN city = 'London' THEN quantity ELSE 0 END) AS london_quantity,
    SIZE(COLLECT_SET(city)) AS num_cities
FROM with_last
GROUP BY region
ORDER BY region;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy(F.col("s.id")).orderBy(F.col("c.last_restock").desc(), F.col("c.id").desc())

with_last = (
    df_stores
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_inventory.alias("c"), (F.col("c.store_id") == F.col("s.id")), "left")
    .withColumn("rn", F.row_number().over(w))
    .filter(F.col("rn") == 1)
    .select("s.*", F.col("c.quantity"), F.col("c.last_restock"))
)

result = (
    with_last
    .groupBy("region")
    .agg(
        F.sort_array(F.collect_set("city")).alias("city_list"),
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("city") == "London", F.col("quantity")).otherwise(0)).alias("london_quantity"),
        F.size(F.collect_set("city")).alias("num_cities"),
    )
    .orderBy("region")
)

sql:
WITH base AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        customer_id,
        monthly_fee,
        status,
        WEEKOFYEAR(end_date) AS end_date_weekofyear
    FROM subscriptions
    WHERE customer_id IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
    *,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY status, customer_id ORDER BY monthly_fee DESC, id) AS seq_no,
    AVG(end_date_weekofyear) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id, status ORDER BY monthly_fee, id ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS end_date_weekofyear_avg_2,
    AVG(monthly_fee) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY end_date_weekofyear, id ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS monthly_fee_avg_6
FROM base;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("status", "customer_id").orderBy(F.col("monthly_fee").desc(), "id")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("customer_id", "status").orderBy("monthly_fee", "id").rowsBetween(-2, Window.currentRow)
w3 = Window.partitionBy("customer_id").orderBy("end_date_weekofyear", "id").rowsBetween(-6, Window.currentRow)

base = (
    df_subscriptions
    .filter(F.col("customer_id").isNotNull())
    .select(
        "id",
        "customer_id",
        "monthly_fee",
        "status",
        F.weekofyear("end_date").alias("end_date_weekofyear"),
    )
)

result = (
    base
    .select(
        "*",
        F.row_number().over(w).alias("seq_no"),
        F.avg("end_date_weekofyear").over(w2).alias("end_date_weekofyear_avg_2"),
        F.avg("monthly_fee").over(w3).alias("monthly_fee_avg_6"),
    )
)

sql: WITH cleaned AS (SELECT *, LEAST(age, credit_limit) AS least_age_credit_limit, INITCAP(TRIM(country)) AS country_title FROM customers WHERE signup_date >= TO_DATE('2023-09-09') AND city = 'Chiang Mai') SELECT id, name, email, country, city, segment, signup_date, is_active, credit_limit, age, least_age_credit_limit, country_title, ROUND(age / SUM(age) OVER (PARTITION BY city), 4) AS age_share, CORR(age, credit_limit) OVER (PARTITION BY segment) AS corr_age_credit_limit, ROUND(credit_limit / SUM(credit_limit) OVER (PARTITION BY city, country), 4) AS credit_limit_share, LEAD(age, 1) OVER w_ordered AS next_age FROM cleaned WINDOW w_ordered AS (PARTITION BY country ORDER BY age, id);
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("city")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("segment")
w3 = Window.partitionBy("city", "country")
w_ordered = Window.partitionBy("country").orderBy("age", "id")

cleaned = (
    df_customers
    .filter((F.col("signup_date") >= F.to_date(F.lit("2023-09-09"))) & (F.col("city") == "Chiang Mai"))
    .withColumn("least_age_credit_limit", F.least("age", "credit_limit"))
    .withColumn("country_title", F.initcap(F.trim("country")))
)

result = (
    cleaned
    .withColumn("age_share", F.round((F.col("age") / F.sum("age").over(w)), 4))
    .withColumn("corr_age_credit_limit", F.corr("age", "credit_limit").over(w2))
    .withColumn("credit_limit_share", F.round((F.col("credit_limit") / F.sum("credit_limit").over(w3)), 4))
    .withColumn("next_age", F.lead("age", 1).over(w_ordered))
)

sql: WITH filtered AS (SELECT *, quantity + unit_price AS line_total FROM order_items WHERE product_id IS NOT NULL) SELECT order_id, BIT_OR(quantity) AS quantity_bit_or, COUNT(*) AS row_count, APPROX_PERCENTILE(unit_price, ARRAY(0.25, 0.5, 0.75)) AS unit_price_quartiles, APPROX_PERCENTILE(line_total, 0.5) AS line_total_p50, APPROX_PERCENTILE(unit_price, ARRAY(0.25, 0.5, 0.75)) AS unit_price_quartiles_2 FROM filtered GROUP BY order_id ORDER BY order_id NULLS LAST

sql: SELECT id, txn_type, amount, merchant, LAST_VALUE(merchant) OVER (PARTITION BY txn_type ORDER BY amount DESC, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS last_merchant, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY txn_type ORDER BY amount) AS rnk FROM transactions WHERE merchant = 'Grab';

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("txn_type").orderBy(F.col("amount").desc(), "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.unboundedFollowing)

    df_transactions
    .filter(F.col("merchant") == "Grab")
    .select(
        "id",
        "txn_type",
        "amount",
        "merchant",
        F.last("merchant").over(w).alias("last_merchant"),
        F.rank().over(w2).alias("rnk"),

WITH base AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT *, ROUND(quantity, 0) AS quantity_rounded
    FROM order_items
    WHERE product_id IS NOT NULL
),
scored AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        *,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER w_hist AS event_seq,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY order_id ORDER BY unit_price DESC, id) AS event_seq_2,
        FIRST_VALUE(quantity_rounded) IGNORE NULLS OVER (ORDER BY quantity_rounded, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS first_known_quantity_rounded,
        SUM(quantity_rounded) OVER (PARTITION BY order_id, product_id ORDER BY quantity, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_quantity_rounded
    FROM base
    WINDOW w_hist AS (ORDER BY quantity DESC, id)
),
enriched AS (
    -- Attach orders attributes
    SELECT a.*, b.order_date
    FROM scored a
    LEFT JOIN orders b
        ON a.order_id = b.id
),
with_dims AS (
    -- Attach orders attributes
    SELECT e.*, o.amount
    FROM enriched e
    LEFT JOIN orders o
        ON e.order_id = o.id
),
matched_keys AS (
    -- Set intersection on keys
    SELECT id
    FROM with_dims
    INTERSECT ALL
    SELECT id
    FROM order_items
    WHERE unit_price > 330
),
kept_rows AS (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    SELECT s.*
    FROM with_dims s
    JOIN matched_keys k ON s.id = k.id
),
matched_keys_2 AS (
    -- Set difference on keys
    SELECT id, product_id
    FROM kept_rows
    EXCEPT
    SELECT id, product_id
    FROM order_items
    WHERE unit_price <= 240
),
reconciled AS (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    SELECT s.*
    FROM kept_rows s
    JOIN matched_keys_2 k ON s.id = k.id AND s.product_id = k.product_id
),
grouped AS (
    -- Aggregate with conditional metrics
    SELECT
        product_id,
        CASE WHEN event_seq_2 >= 7 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END AS event_seq_2_tier,
        BIT_AND(quantity) AS quantity_bit_and,
        MIN(event_seq) AS min_event_seq,
        COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS distinct_order_ids,
        MIN(first_known_quantity_rounded) AS min_first_known_quantity_rounded,
        COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS distinct_order_ids_2
    FROM reconciled
    GROUP BY product_id, event_seq_2_tier
)
SELECT
    product_id,
    event_seq_2_tier,
    min_event_seq,
    min_first_known_quantity_rounded
FROM grouped;

from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w_hist = Window.orderBy(F.col("quantity").desc(), "id")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("order_id").orderBy(F.col("unit_price").desc(), "id")
w3 = Window.orderBy("quantity_rounded", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w4 = Window.partitionBy("order_id", "product_id").orderBy("quantity", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)

base = (
    df_order_items
    .filter(F.col("product_id").isNotNull())
    .withColumn("quantity_rounded", F.round("quantity", 0))
)

scored = (
    base
    .select(
        "*",
        F.row_number().over(w_hist).alias("event_seq"),
        F.row_number().over(w2).alias("event_seq_2"),
        F.first("quantity_rounded", ignorenulls=True).over(w3).alias("first_known_quantity_rounded"),
        F.sum("quantity_rounded").over(w4).alias("cumulative_quantity_rounded"),
    )
)

enriched = (
    scored
    .alias("a")
    .join(df_orders.alias("b"), F.col("a.order_id") == F.col("b.id"), "left")
    .select("a.*", F.col("b.order_date"))
)

with_dims = (
    enriched
    .alias("e")
    .join(df_orders.alias("o"), F.col("e.order_id") == F.col("o.id"), "left")
    .select("e.*", F.col("o.amount"))
)

matched_keys = (
    with_dims
    .select("id")
    .intersectAll(
        df_order_items
        .filter(F.col("unit_price") > 330)
        .select("id")
    )
)

kept_rows = (
    with_dims
    .alias("s")
    .join(matched_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.id") == F.col("k.id")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

matched_keys_2 = (
    kept_rows
    .select("id", "product_id")
    .subtract(
        df_order_items
        .filter(F.col("unit_price") <= 240)
        .select("id", "product_id")
    )
)

reconciled = (
    kept_rows
    .alias("s")
    .join(matched_keys_2.alias("k"), (F.col("s.id") == F.col("k.id")) & (F.col("s.product_id") == F.col("k.product_id")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

grouped = (
    reconciled
    .groupBy(
        "product_id",
        F.when(F.col("event_seq_2") >= 7, "PREMIUM").otherwise("STANDARD").alias("event_seq_2_tier"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.bit_and("quantity").alias("quantity_bit_and"),
        F.min("event_seq").alias("min_event_seq"),
        F.countDistinct("order_id").alias("distinct_order_ids"),
        F.min("first_known_quantity_rounded").alias("min_first_known_quantity_rounded"),
        F.countDistinct("order_id").alias("distinct_order_ids_2"),
    )
)

result = (
    grouped
    .select(
        "product_id",
        "event_seq_2_tier",
        "min_event_seq",
        "min_first_known_quantity_rounded",
    )
)

WITH filtered AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT *, ROUND(amount, 1) amount_rounded
    FROM payments
    WHERE paid_at > DATE '2023-12-01'
),
enriched AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        *,
        AVG(amount_rounded) OVER (PARTITION BY status, order_id) status_avg_amount_rounded,
        AVG(amount_rounded) OVER (PARTITION BY order_id, method ORDER BY amount, id ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) amount_rounded_avg_2,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY order_id, status ORDER BY paid_at, id) row_seq,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY status ORDER BY paid_at, id) seq_no
    FROM filtered
),
scored AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        *,
        ROUND(amount / SUM(amount) OVER (PARTITION BY method), 4) amount_share,
        SUM(status_avg_amount_rounded) OVER (PARTITION BY method ORDER BY amount, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) running_status_avg_amount_rounded,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY method ORDER BY row_seq DESC, id) row_seq_2
    FROM enriched
)
-- Multi-level aggregation
SELECT
    CASE WHEN status_avg_amount_rounded >= 75 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END AS status_avg_amount_rounded_tier,
    COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS distinct_order_ids,
    MIN(paid_at) AS first_paid_at,
    PERCENTILE_APPROX(amount_share, 0.95) AS amount_share_p95,
    MIN(amount_rounded_avg_2) AS min_amount_rounded_avg_2,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'REFUNDED' THEN 1 END) AS refunded_count
FROM scored
GROUP BY status_avg_amount_rounded_tier
ORDER BY status_avg_amount_rounded_tier DESC

from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("status", "order_id")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("order_id", "method").orderBy("amount", "id").rowsBetween(-2, Window.currentRow)
w3 = Window.partitionBy("order_id", "status").orderBy("paid_at", "id")
w4 = Window.partitionBy("status").orderBy("paid_at", "id")
w5 = Window.partitionBy("method")
w6 = Window.partitionBy("method").orderBy("amount", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w7 = Window.partitionBy("method").orderBy(F.col("row_seq").desc(), "id")

filtered = (
    df_payments
    .filter(F.col("paid_at") > F.lit("2023-12-01").cast("date"))
    .select("*", F.round("amount", 1).alias("amount_rounded"))
)

enriched = (
    filtered
    .withColumn("status_avg_amount_rounded", F.avg("amount_rounded").over(w))
    .withColumn("amount_rounded_avg_2", F.avg("amount_rounded").over(w2))
    .withColumn("row_seq", F.row_number().over(w3))
    .withColumn("seq_no", F.row_number().over(w4))
)

scored = (
    enriched
    .select(
        "*",
        F.round((F.col("amount") / F.sum("amount").over(w5)), 4).alias("amount_share"),
        F.sum("status_avg_amount_rounded").over(w6).alias("running_status_avg_amount_rounded"),
        F.row_number().over(w7).alias("row_seq_2"),
    )
)

result = (
    scored
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("status_avg_amount_rounded") >= 75, "PREMIUM").otherwise("STANDARD").alias("status_avg_amount_rounded_tier"),
    )

        F.countDistinct("order_id").alias("distinct_order_ids"),

        F.count(F.when(F.col("status") == "REFUNDED", 1)).alias("refunded_count"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("status_avg_amount_rounded_tier").desc())
)

WITH lines AS (
    -- Unnest the array into one row per element
    SELECT
        id,
        attr_key,
        v
    FROM carts
    LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(attributes) t AS attr_key, v
),
base AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT *, TRIM(attr_key) AS clean_attr_key
    FROM lines
    WHERE attr_key = 'utm_source'
),
cleaned AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT *, SUBSTRING(attr_key, 1, 2) AS attr_key_prefix
    FROM base
    WHERE attr_key IS NOT NULL
),
valid AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT
        *,
        TRIM(attr_key) AS clean_attr_key_2,
        TRIM(attr_key) AS clean_attr_key_3
    FROM cleaned
    WHERE attr_key IS NOT NULL
),
valid_carts AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        id,
        attr_key,
        attr_key_prefix,
        CASE WHEN attr_key IN ('weight_kg', 'utm_source') THEN 'Group A' ELSE 'Other' END AS attr_key_group
    FROM valid
    WHERE attr_key IS NOT NULL
      AND attr_key = 'weight_kg'
),
valid_carts_2 AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        *,
        TRIM(attr_key) AS clean_attr_key,
        INITCAP(TRIM(attr_key)) AS attr_key_title,
        COALESCE(attr_key, 'UNKNOWN') AS attr_key_filled
    FROM valid_carts
    WHERE attr_key IS NOT NULL
),
base_carts AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT
        id,
        attr_key,
        attr_key_group,
        clean_attr_key,
        attr_key_filled,
        TRIM(attr_key) AS clean_attr_key_2,
        COALESCE(attr_key, 'NONE') AS attr_key_clean
    FROM valid_carts_2
    WHERE attr_key IS NOT NULL
      AND attr_key != 'utm_source'
),
stats AS (
    -- Multi-level aggregation
    SELECT
        attr_key,
        COUNT(DISTINCT attr_key) AS distinct_attr_keys,
        SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_SET(attr_key)) AS attr_key_list,
        SIZE(COLLECT_SET(attr_key)) AS num_attr_keys,
        SIZE(COLLECT_SET(attr_key)) AS num_attr_keys_2,
        GROUPING(attr_key) AS grouping_id
    FROM base_carts
    GROUP BY ROLLUP (attr_key)
)
SELECT
    attr_key,
    distinct_attr_keys,
    attr_key_list,
    grouping_id
FROM stats
ORDER BY attr_key;

        CUME_DIST() OVER (ORDER BY tier_value) AS tier_value_cume_dist_2
    FROM flattened

with_windows AS (

        id,

        tier_value_cume_dist,
        tier_value_cume_dist_2,

        CUME_DIST() OVER (ORDER BY tier_value DESC) AS tier_value_cume_dist_3,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY tier_value_rank DESC NULLS LAST) AS tier_value_rank_dense_rank
    FROM scored

        *,

        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY tier_value_rank_dense_rank NULLS LAST) AS tier_value_rank_dense_rank_rank,
        CUME_DIST() OVER (ORDER BY tier_value_cume_dist_2 DESC NULLS FIRST) AS tier_value_cume_dist_2_cume_dist

    CASE WHEN tier_value_rank_dense_rank >= 6 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END AS tier_value_rank_dense_rank_tier,
    COUNT(DISTINCT id) AS distinct_ids,
    ROUND(AVG(tier_value_cume_dist_filled), 2) AS avg_tier_value_cume_dist_filled,
    ROUND(AVG(tier_value_cume_dist_2), 2) AS avg_tier_value_cume_dist_2
FROM valid
GROUP BY tier_value_cume_dist_filled_tier, tier_value_rank_dense_rank_tier

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w_recent = Window.orderBy(F.col("tier_value").desc_nulls_first())
w2 = Window.orderBy(F.col("tier_value").asc_nulls_last())
w3 = Window.orderBy("tier_value")
w4 = Window.orderBy(F.col("tier_value_cume_dist").desc())
w5 = Window.orderBy(F.col("tier_value").desc())
w6 = Window.orderBy(F.col("tier_value_rank").desc_nulls_last())
w7 = Window.orderBy(F.col("tier_value_cume_dist_cume_dist").desc_nulls_first())
w8 = Window.orderBy(F.col("tier_value_rank_dense_rank").asc_nulls_last())
w9 = Window.orderBy(F.col("tier_value_cume_dist_2").desc_nulls_first())

flattened = df_price_tiers.select("id", F.explode("discounts").alias("tier_value"))

scored = (
    flattened
    .withColumn("tier_value_rank", F.rank().over(w_recent))
    .withColumn("tier_value_cume_dist", F.cume_dist().over(w2))
    .withColumn("tier_value_cume_dist_2", F.cume_dist().over(w3))
)

with_windows = (
    scored
    .withColumn("tier_value_cume_dist_cume_dist", F.cume_dist().over(w4))
    .withColumn("tier_value_cume_dist_3", F.cume_dist().over(w5))
    .withColumn("tier_value_rank_dense_rank", F.dense_rank().over(w6))
)

enriched = (
    with_windows
    .withColumn("tier_value_cume_dist_cume_dist_2", F.cume_dist().over(w4))
    .withColumn("tier_value_cume_dist_cume_dist_dense_rank", F.dense_rank().over(w7))
)

with_windows_price_tiers = (
    enriched
    .withColumn("tier_value_rank_percent_rank", F.percent_rank().over(w6))
    .withColumn("tier_value_rank_dense_rank_rank", F.rank().over(w8))
    .withColumn("tier_value_cume_dist_2_cume_dist", F.cume_dist().over(w9))
)

filtered = (
    with_windows_price_tiers
    .filter(F.col("tier_value_cume_dist_cume_dist_dense_rank") <= 4)
    .select(
        "id",
        "tier_value",
        "tier_value_rank",
        "tier_value_cume_dist",
        "tier_value_cume_dist_2",
        "tier_value_cume_dist_3",
        "tier_value_rank_dense_rank",
        "tier_value_cume_dist_cume_dist_2",
        "tier_value_rank_percent_rank",
        "tier_value_rank_dense_rank_rank",
        (F.col("tier_value_cume_dist_2") - F.col("tier_value_cume_dist_cume_dist_dense_rank")).alias("tier_value_cume_dist_2_minus_tier_value_cume_dist_cume_dist_dense_rank"),
    )
)

valid = (
    filtered
    .filter(F.col("tier_value_cume_dist_2").between(0.23, 0.49))
    .select(
        "id",
        "tier_value",
        "tier_value_rank",
        "tier_value_cume_dist",
        "tier_value_cume_dist_2",
        "tier_value_cume_dist_3",
        "tier_value_rank_dense_rank",
        "tier_value_cume_dist_cume_dist_2",
        F.coalesce("tier_value_cume_dist", F.lit(0)).alias("tier_value_cume_dist_filled"),
        (F.col("tier_value_cume_dist_2_minus_tier_value_cume_dist_cume_dist_dense_rank") / F.nullif("tier_value_cume_dist_cume_dist_2", F.lit(0))).alias("tier_value_cume_dist_2_minus_tier_value_cume_dist_cume_dist_dense_rank_per_tier_value_cume_dist_cume_dist_2"),
    )
)

result = (
    valid
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("tier_value_cume_dist_filled") >= 81, "PREMIUM").otherwise("STANDARD").alias("tier_value_cume_dist_filled_tier"),
        F.when(F.col("tier_value_rank_dense_rank") >= 6, "HIGH").otherwise("LOW").alias("tier_value_rank_dense_rank_tier"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.countDistinct("id").alias("distinct_ids"),
        F.round(F.avg("tier_value_cume_dist_filled"), 2).alias("avg_tier_value_cume_dist_filled"),
        F.round(F.avg("tier_value_cume_dist_2"), 2).alias("avg_tier_value_cume_dist_2"),
    )
    .orderBy("tier_value_rank_dense_rank_tier")
)

WITH filtered AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT
        *,
        DATEDIFF(CURRENT_DATE(), signup_date) AS days_since_signup_date,
        COALESCE(city, 'N/A') AS resolved_city
    FROM customers
    WHERE signup_date >= DATE '2023-09-28'
      AND country IN ('UK', 'JP')
),
valid AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        id,
        name,
        email,
        country,
        city,
        signup_date,
        is_active,
        credit_limit,
        resolved_city,
        CASE WHEN credit_limit >= 15100 THEN 'High' WHEN credit_limit >= 4300 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END AS credit_limit_band,
        FLOOR(days_since_signup_date) AS days_since_signup_date_whole
    FROM filtered
    WHERE signup_date >= DATE '2023-11-16'
      AND segment IS NOT NULL
),
eligible AS (
    -- Semi-join via a correlated subquery
    SELECT s.*
    FROM valid s
    WHERE EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM subscriptions x
            WHERE x.customer_id = s.id
              AND x.end_date BETWEEN '2023-08-02' AND '2024-10-01'
        )
),
filtered_customers AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN days_since_signup_date_whole >= 74 THEN 'High' WHEN days_since_signup_date_whole >= 22 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END AS days_since_signup_date_whole_band
    FROM eligible
    WHERE signup_date >= DATE '2023-03-24'
      AND city IS NOT NULL
),
enriched AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        *,
        PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY city ORDER BY days_since_signup_date_whole) AS days_since_signup_date_whole_percent_rank,
        SUM(days_since_signup_date_whole) OVER (PARTITION BY country, city ORDER BY signup_date, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_days_since_signup_date_whole,
        NTILE(10) OVER w_running AS days_since_signup_date_whole_bucket,
        NTILE(5) OVER w_grp AS days_since_signup_date_whole_bucket_2
    FROM filtered_customers
    WINDOW w_running AS (ORDER BY days_since_signup_date_whole DESC, id), w_grp AS (PARTITION BY city ORDER BY days_since_signup_date_whole DESC, id)
)
SELECT
    id,
    name,
    email,
    country,
    city,
    is_active,
    credit_limit,
    days_since_signup_date_whole,
    days_since_signup_date_whole_percent_rank
FROM enriched
ORDER BY id DESC NULLS FIRST, country;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("city").orderBy("days_since_signup_date_whole")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("country", "city").orderBy("signup_date", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w_running = Window.orderBy(F.col("days_since_signup_date_whole").desc(), "id")
w_grp = Window.partitionBy("city").orderBy(F.col("days_since_signup_date_whole").desc(), "id")

filtered = (
    df_customers
    .filter((F.col("signup_date") >= F.lit("2023-09-28").cast("date")) & F.col("country").isin(["UK", "JP"]))
    .select(
        "*",
        F.datediff(F.current_date(), "signup_date").alias("days_since_signup_date"),
        F.coalesce("city", F.lit("N/A")).alias("resolved_city"),
    )
)

valid = (
    filtered
    .filter((F.col("signup_date") >= F.lit("2023-11-16").cast("date")) & F.col("segment").isNotNull())
    .select(
        "id",
        "name",
        "email",
        "country",
        "city",
        "signup_date",
        "is_active",
        "credit_limit",
        "resolved_city",
        F.when(F.col("credit_limit") >= 15100, "High").when(F.col("credit_limit") >= 4300, "Medium").otherwise("Low").alias("credit_limit_band"),
        F.floor("days_since_signup_date").alias("days_since_signup_date_whole"),
    )
)

eligible = (
    valid
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_subscriptions.alias("x"), (F.col("x.customer_id") == F.col("s.id")) & (F.col("x.end_date").between("2023-08-02", "2024-10-01")), "left_semi")
)

filtered_customers = (
    eligible
    .filter((F.col("signup_date") >= F.lit("2023-03-24").cast("date")) & F.col("city").isNotNull())
    .select(
        "*",
        F.when(F.col("days_since_signup_date_whole") >= 74, "High").when(F.col("days_since_signup_date_whole") >= 22, "Medium").otherwise("Low").alias("days_since_signup_date_whole_band"),
    )
)

enriched = (
    filtered_customers
    .withColumn("days_since_signup_date_whole_percent_rank", F.percent_rank().over(w))
    .withColumn("running_days_since_signup_date_whole", F.sum("days_since_signup_date_whole").over(w2))
    .withColumn("days_since_signup_date_whole_bucket", F.ntile(10).over(w_running))
    .withColumn("days_since_signup_date_whole_bucket_2", F.ntile(5).over(w_grp))
)

result = (
    enriched
    .select(
        "id",
        "name",
        "email",
        "country",
        "city",
        "is_active",
        "credit_limit",
        "days_since_signup_date_whole",
        "days_since_signup_date_whole_percent_rank",
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("id").desc_nulls_first(), "country")
)

WITH deduped AS (
    SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY txn_type ORDER BY amount DESC NULLS LAST, id) AS rn
    FROM transactions
    QUALIFY rn = 1
),
cleaned AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        account_id,
        txn_time,
        merchant,
        is_flagged,
        SUBSTRING(merchant, 1, 3) AS merchant_prefix,
        COALESCE(merchant, 'DIRECT') AS merchant_filled
    FROM deduped
    WHERE merchant = 'Grab'
),
deduped_transactions AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM cleaned
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY merchant ORDER BY txn_time NULLS FIRST, id) = 1
),
metrics AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY merchant, account_id ORDER BY txn_time, id) AS row_seq,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER w_part AS seq_no,
        FIRST_VALUE(merchant, TRUE) OVER (PARTITION BY merchant ORDER BY txn_time, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS first_known_merchant
    FROM deduped_transactions
    WINDOW w_part AS (PARTITION BY merchant ORDER BY txn_time, id)
),
remaining_keys AS (
    SELECT account_id
    FROM metrics
    INTERSECT
    SELECT account_id
    FROM transactions
    WHERE is_flagged = FALSE
),
verified AS (
    SELECT s.*
    FROM metrics s
    INNER JOIN remaining_keys k ON s.account_id = k.account_id
),
filtered AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        account_id,
        merchant,
        is_flagged,
        merchant_prefix,
        row_seq,
        first_known_merchant,
        COALESCE(seq_no, 0) AS seq_no_filled
    FROM verified
    WHERE account_id IN (1, 13, 16)
),
base AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        merchant,
        is_flagged,
        merchant_prefix,
        first_known_merchant,
        seq_no_filled,
        CASE WHEN merchant IN ('Lazada', 'Amazon') THEN 'Priority' ELSE 'Other' END AS merchant_group
    FROM filtered
    WHERE row_seq BETWEEN 6 AND 7
)
SELECT
    merchant,
    CASE WHEN seq_no_filled >= 84 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END AS seq_no_filled_tier,
    PERCENTILE_APPROX(seq_no_filled, ARRAY(0.25, 0.5, 0.75)) AS seq_no_filled_quartiles,
    SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_SET(merchant)) AS merchant_list,
    ROUND(AVG(seq_no_filled), 2) AS avg_seq_no_filled,
    COUNT_IF(merchant = 'Starbucks') AS starbucks_events
FROM base
GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((merchant, CASE WHEN seq_no_filled >= 84 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END), (merchant), ())
HAVING avg_seq_no_filled > 0
ORDER BY merchant;

            SELECT 1
            FROM order_items x
            WHERE x.product_id = s.id
              AND x.product_id IS NOT NULL
        )
),

),

        top1.inventory_last_restock,
        top1.quantity
    FROM with_windows s
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
            SELECT c.last_restock AS inventory_last_restock, c.quantity
            FROM inventory c
            WHERE c.product_id = s.id
            ORDER BY c.quantity DESC, c.id DESC
            LIMIT 1

        d.rating AS supplier_rating,
        d.city AS supplier_city
    FROM metrics s
    INNER JOIN suppliers d
        ON s.supplier_id = d.id
)

sql:
WITH ranked AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM shipments
    QUALIFY RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY status ORDER BY shipped_date DESC NULLS FIRST) = 1
),
latest AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM ranked
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY carrier ORDER BY shipped_date DESC, id) = 1
),
base AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', shipped_date) shipped_date_period,
        COALESCE(carrier, 'OTHER') carrier_filled
    FROM latest
    WHERE delivered_date > TO_DATE('2024-04-05')
      AND order_id IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
    *,
    NTILE(4) OVER (PARTITION BY order_id ORDER BY cost, id) cost_bucket,
    PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY order_id ORDER BY cost DESC NULLS LAST) cost_percent_rank,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY carrier ORDER BY cost) cost_dense_rank,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY cost DESC) cost_dense_rank_2
FROM base
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("status").orderBy(F.col("shipped_date").desc_nulls_first())
w2 = Window.partitionBy("carrier").orderBy(F.col("shipped_date").desc(), "id")
w3 = Window.partitionBy("order_id").orderBy("cost", "id")
w4 = Window.partitionBy("order_id").orderBy(F.col("cost").desc_nulls_last())
w5 = Window.partitionBy("carrier").orderBy("cost")
w6 = Window.orderBy(F.col("cost").desc())

ranked = (
    df_shipments
    .withColumn("rank_in_group", F.rank().over(w))
    .filter(F.col("rank_in_group") == 1)
    .drop("rank_in_group")
)

latest = (
    ranked
    .withColumn("dedup_rank", F.row_number().over(w2))
    .filter(F.col("dedup_rank") == 1)
    .drop("dedup_rank")
)

base = (
    latest
    .filter((F.col("delivered_date") > F.to_date(F.lit("2024-04-05"))) & F.col("order_id").isNotNull())
    .select(
        "*",
        F.date_trunc("MONTH", "shipped_date").alias("shipped_date_period"),
        F.coalesce("carrier", F.lit("OTHER")).alias("carrier_filled"),
    )
)

result = (
    base
    .withColumn("cost_bucket", F.ntile(4).over(w3))
    .withColumn("cost_percent_rank", F.percent_rank().over(w4))
    .withColumn("cost_dense_rank", F.dense_rank().over(w5))
    .withColumn("cost_dense_rank_2", F.dense_rank().over(w6))
)

with cleaned as (
