        id,
        order_id,
        method,
        date_trunc('year', paid_at) as paid_at_period
    from payments
    where paid_at >= timestamp '2023-10-07 20:00:00'
      and method is not null
)
select
    date_trunc('week', paid_at_period) as week_start,
    (unix_timestamp(max(paid_at_period)) - unix_timestamp(min(paid_at_period))) / 60 as span_minutes,
    count(*) as cnt,
    size(collect_set(method)) as num_methods,
    count_if(method = 'cash') as cash_events,
    count_if(method = 'cash') as cash_events_2
from cleaned
group by week_start
order by cash_events_2;

    .select(
        "id",
        "order_id",
        "method",
        F.date_trunc("year", "paid_at").alias("paid_at_period"),
    )
)

        F.count_if(F.col("method") == "cash").alias("cash_events"),

with base as (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    select *, substring(browser, 1, 3) as browser_prefix
    from sessions
    where started_at > date '2024-01-30'
      and customer_id = 16
),
with_windows as (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    select
        *,
        row_number() over (partition by country, browser order by started_at desc, id) as event_seq,
        row_number() over (partition by country, browser order by started_at, id) as event_seq_2
    from base
),
latest as (
    -- Deduplicate with ROW_NUMBER
    select *
    from (
        select *, row_number() over (partition by device order by event_seq, id) as latest_rank
        from with_windows
    ) ranked
    where latest_rank = 1
),
with_windows_sessions as (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    select
        *,
        round(event_seq / sum(event_seq) over (partition by country), 4) as event_seq_share,
        lead(event_seq, 2) over (partition by device, country order by event_seq, id) as next_event_seq,
        avg(event_seq) over (partition by browser order by event_seq_2, id rows between 3 preceding and 1 preceding) as event_seq_avg_3_prior
    from latest
),
latest_match as (
    -- Latest matching web_event per row (LATERAL ... LIMIT 1)
    select
        s.*,
        top1.web_event_event_type,
        top1.web_event_page
    from with_windows_sessions s
    left join lateral (
            select c.event_type as web_event_event_type, c.page as web_event_page
            from web_events c
            where c.session_id = s.id
            order by c.duration_sec desc, c.id desc
            limit 1
        ) top1 on true
),
enriched as (
    -- Attach customers attributes
    select
        a.*,
        p.credit_limit,
        p.signup_date
    from latest_match a
    join customers p
        on a.customer_id = p.id
)
select
    s.id,
    s.customer_id,
    s.device,
    s.browser,
    s.started_at,
    s.browser_prefix,
    s.event_seq_2,
    s.event_seq_share,
    s.next_event_seq,
    (select avg(o2.discount) from orders o2 where o2.customer_id = s.customer_id) as avg_order_discount
from enriched s
order by avg_order_discount, event_seq_2 desc
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("country", "browser").orderBy(F.col("started_at").desc(), "id")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("country", "browser").orderBy("started_at", "id")
w3 = Window.partitionBy("device").orderBy("event_seq", "id")
w4 = Window.partitionBy("country")
w5 = Window.partitionBy("device", "country").orderBy("event_seq", "id")
w6 = Window.partitionBy("browser").orderBy("event_seq_2", "id").rowsBetween(-3, -1)
w7 = Window.partitionBy(F.col("s.id")).orderBy(F.col("c.duration_sec").desc(), F.col("c.id").desc())
discount_by_customer_id = df_orders.groupBy("customer_id").agg(F.avg("discount").alias("avg_order_discount"))

base = (
    df_sessions
    .filter((F.col("started_at") > F.lit("2024-01-30").cast("date")) & (F.col("customer_id") == 16))
    .withColumn("browser_prefix", F.substring("browser", 1, 3))
)

with_windows = (
    base
    .select(
        "*",
        F.row_number().over(w).alias("event_seq"),
        F.row_number().over(w2).alias("event_seq_2"),
    )
)

latest = (
    with_windows
    .withColumn("latest_rank", F.row_number().over(w3))
    .filter(F.col("latest_rank") == 1)
)

with_windows_sessions = (
    latest
    .withColumn("event_seq_share", F.round((F.col("event_seq") / F.sum("event_seq").over(w4)), 4))
    .withColumn("next_event_seq", F.lead("event_seq", 2).over(w5))
    .withColumn("event_seq_avg_3_prior", F.avg("event_seq").over(w6))
)

latest_match = (
    with_windows_sessions
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_web_events.alias("c"), (F.col("c.session_id") == F.col("s.id")), "left")
    .withColumn("rn", F.row_number().over(w7))
    .filter(F.col("rn") == 1)
    .select(
        "s.*",
        F.col("c.event_type").alias("web_event_event_type"),
        F.col("c.page").alias("web_event_page"),
    )
)

enriched = (
    latest_match
    .alias("a")
    .join(df_customers.alias("p"), F.col("a.customer_id") == F.col("p.id"), "inner")
    .select("a.*", F.col("p.credit_limit"), F.col("p.signup_date"))
)

result = (
    enriched
    .join(discount_by_customer_id, on="customer_id", how="left")
    .select(
        "id",
        "customer_id",
        "device",
        "browser",
        "started_at",
        "browser_prefix",
        "event_seq_2",
        "event_seq_share",
        "next_event_seq",
        F.col("avg_order_discount"),
    )
    .orderBy("avg_order_discount", F.col("event_seq_2").desc())
)

WITH cleaned AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT
        id,
        channel,
        promo_code,
        ends_on,
        discount_pct,
        CONCAT_WS(',', promo_code, channel) AS promo_code_channel_key,
        COALESCE(channel, 'NONE') AS channel_clean
    FROM promotions
    WHERE ends_on > DATE '2023-06-30'
      AND channel IS NOT NULL
),
matched AS (
    -- Non-equi join on a validity window
    SELECT
        e.*,
        pr.id AS promo_id,
        pr.promo_code AS promotion_promo_code,
        pr.discount_pct AS promotion_discount_pct
    FROM cleaned e
    JOIN promotions pr
        ON COALESCE(e.channel, 'store') = pr.channel
       AND e.ends_on BETWEEN pr.starts_on AND pr.ends_on
),
with_window AS (
    -- Non-equi join on a validity window
    SELECT
        src.*,
        pr.id AS promo_id_2,
        pr.promo_code AS promotion_promo_code_2,
        pr.discount_pct AS promotion_discount_pct_2
    FROM matched src
    JOIN promotions pr
        ON src.channel = pr.channel
       AND src.ends_on BETWEEN pr.starts_on AND pr.ends_on
),
matched_promotions AS (
    -- Non-equi join on a validity window
    SELECT
        src.*,
        pr.id AS promo_id_3,
        pr.promo_code AS promotion_promo_code_3,
        pr.discount_pct AS promotion_discount_pct_3
    FROM with_window src
    LEFT JOIN promotions pr
        ON src.channel <=> pr.channel
       AND src.ends_on >= pr.starts_on
       AND src.ends_on < pr.ends_on + INTERVAL 14 DAYS
),
grouped AS (
    -- Grouped metrics
    SELECT
        channel,
        SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_SET(channel)) AS channel_list,
        COUNT_IF(channel = 'mobile') AS mobile_events,
        ROUND(AVG(promotion_discount_pct_2), 2) AS avg_promotion_discount_pct_2,
        COUNT(*) AS row_count,
        COUNT(DISTINCT channel) AS distinct_channels
    FROM matched_promotions
    GROUP BY channel
)
SELECT
    channel,
    channel_list,
    mobile_events,
    avg_promotion_discount_pct_2,
    row_count,
    CASE WHEN channel RLIKE '^(web|store)$' THEN 'OTHER_ZONE' ELSE 'EXTENDED' END AS channel_zone
FROM grouped
ORDER BY avg_promotion_discount_pct_2 NULLS LAST, mobile_events;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

cleaned = (
    df_promotions
    .filter((F.col("ends_on") > F.lit("2023-06-30").cast("date")) & F.col("channel").isNotNull())
    .select(
        "id",
        "channel",
        "promo_code",
        "ends_on",
        "discount_pct",
        F.concat_ws(",", "promo_code", "channel").alias("promo_code_channel_key"),
        F.coalesce("channel", F.lit("NONE")).alias("channel_clean"),
    )
)

matched = (
    cleaned
    .alias("e")
    .join(df_promotions.alias("pr"), (F.coalesce(F.col("e.channel"), F.lit("store")) == F.col("pr.channel")) & F.col("e.ends_on").between(F.col("pr.starts_on"), F.col("pr.ends_on")), "inner")
    .select(
        "e.*",
        F.col("pr.id").alias("promo_id"),
        F.col("pr.promo_code").alias("promotion_promo_code"),
        F.col("pr.discount_pct").alias("promotion_discount_pct"),
    )
)

with_window = (
    matched
    .alias("src")
    .join(df_promotions.alias("pr"), (F.col("src.channel") == F.col("pr.channel")) & F.col("src.ends_on").between(F.col("pr.starts_on"), F.col("pr.ends_on")), "inner")
    .select(
        "src.*",
        F.col("pr.id").alias("promo_id_2"),
        F.col("pr.promo_code").alias("promotion_promo_code_2"),
        F.col("pr.discount_pct").alias("promotion_discount_pct_2"),
    )
)

matched_promotions = (
    with_window
    .alias("src")
    .join(df_promotions.alias("pr"), (F.col("src.channel").eqNullSafe(F.col("pr.channel"))) & (F.col("src.ends_on") >= F.col("pr.starts_on")) & (F.col("src.ends_on") < F.col("pr.ends_on") + F.expr("INTERVAL 14 DAYS")), "left")
    .select(
        "src.*",
        F.col("pr.id").alias("promo_id_3"),
        F.col("pr.promo_code").alias("promotion_promo_code_3"),
        F.col("pr.discount_pct").alias("promotion_discount_pct_3"),
    )
)

grouped = (
    matched_promotions
    .groupBy("channel")
    .agg(
        F.sort_array(F.collect_set("channel")).alias("channel_list"),
        F.count_if(F.col("channel") == "mobile").alias("mobile_events"),
        F.round(F.avg("promotion_discount_pct_2"), 2).alias("avg_promotion_discount_pct_2"),
        F.count("*").alias("row_count"),
        F.countDistinct("channel").alias("distinct_channels"),
    )
)

result = (
    grouped
    .select(
        "channel",
        "channel_list",
        "mobile_events",
        "avg_promotion_discount_pct_2",
        "row_count",
        F.when(F.col("channel").rlike("^(web|store)$"), "OTHER_ZONE").otherwise("EXTENDED").alias("channel_zone"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("avg_promotion_discount_pct_2").asc_nulls_last(), "mobile_events")
)

WITH filtered AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        CAST(age AS DOUBLE) AS age_num,
        COALESCE(city, 'N/A') AS city_filled
    FROM customers
    WHERE signup_date >= TO_DATE('2023-08-17')
      AND segment = 'Corporate'
),
scored AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER w_part AS age_num_dense_rank,
        LEAD(age_num, 1) OVER w_part_2 AS next_age_num,
        ROUND(age / SUM(age) OVER (PARTITION BY segment), 4) AS age_share,
        SUM(age_num) OVER (PARTITION BY segment, country ORDER BY signup_date, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_age_num
    FROM filtered
    WINDOW w_part AS (PARTITION BY city ORDER BY age_num), w_part_2 AS (PARTITION BY segment ORDER BY signup_date, id)
),
scored_customers AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        STDDEV_SAMP(age_num_dense_rank) OVER (PARTITION BY country) AS country_stddev_samp_age_num_dense_rank,
        NTILE(5) OVER w_recent AS age_num_dense_rank_bucket,
        FIRST_VALUE(segment) IGNORE NULLS OVER w_running AS first_known_segment
    FROM scored
    WINDOW w_recent AS (ORDER BY age_num_dense_rank, id), w_running AS (PARTITION BY country ORDER BY signup_date, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)
),
enriched AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        LAG(age_num_dense_rank, 2, 0) OVER (PARTITION BY segment ORDER BY age_num_dense_rank, id) AS prev_age_num_dense_rank,
        ROUND(country_stddev_samp_age_num_dense_rank / SUM(country_stddev_samp_age_num_dense_rank) OVER (PARTITION BY segment), 4) AS country_stddev_samp_age_num_dense_rank_share,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY city, segment ORDER BY credit_limit DESC, id) AS event_seq,
        FIRST_VALUE(age_num_dense_rank) IGNORE NULLS OVER (PARTITION BY city ORDER BY signup_date, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS first_known_age_num_dense_rank
    FROM scored_customers
)
SELECT
    CASE WHEN credit_limit >= 12500 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END AS credit_limit_tier,
    ROUND(SUM(age_num_dense_rank_bucket) / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN segment = 'SMB' THEN 1 END), 0), 2) AS age_num_dense_rank_bucket_per_smb,
    SUM(CASE WHEN country = 'TH' THEN age_num_dense_rank ELSE 0 END) AS th_age_num_dense_rank,
    COUNT(*) AS event_count
FROM enriched
GROUP BY credit_limit_tier
HAVING th_age_num_dense_rank > 0
ORDER BY credit_limit_tier;

),

with flattened as (
    -- Unnest the array into one row per element
    select
        id,
        host,
        level,
        latency_ms,
        status_code,
        k,
        value
    from app_logs
    lateral view explode(context) e as k, value
),
flattened_attrs as (
    -- Struct fields, map lookups and JSON extraction
    select
        id,
        host,
        k,
        shiftright(status_code, 2) as status_code_high,
        cast((status_code & 8) != 0 as int) as is_flagged
    from flattened
),
matched_keys as (
    -- Set difference on keys
    select id, host
    from flattened_attrs
    except distinct
    select id, host
    from app_logs
    where latency_ms is not null
),
verified as (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    select s.*
    from flattened_attrs s
    inner join matched_keys k on s.id = k.id and s.host = k.host
),
scored as (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    select
        id,
        host,
        k,
        status_code_high,
        is_flagged,
        cume_dist() over (partition by host order by status_code_high asc nulls last) as status_code_high_cume_dist,
        cume_dist() over (order by status_code_high desc) as status_code_high_cume_dist_2,
        cume_dist() over (partition by k order by is_flagged asc nulls first) as is_flagged_cume_dist
    from verified
),
enriched as (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    select
        *,
        percent_rank() over (partition by k, host order by is_flagged desc nulls first) as is_flagged_percent_rank,
        sum(status_code_high_cume_dist_2) over (partition by host) as host_sum_status_code_high_cume_dist_2
    from scored
),
cleaned as (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    select
        *,
        case when is_flagged >= 1 then 'High' when is_flagged >= 0 then 'Medium' else 'Low' end as is_flagged_tier,
        coalesce(k, 'NONE') as k_filled
    from enriched
    where k is not null
),
scored_app_logs as (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    select
        *,
        count(is_flagged_percent_rank) over (partition by k, host) as k_count_is_flagged_percent_rank,
        rank() over (order by status_code_high_cume_dist_2 asc nulls last) as status_code_high_cume_dist_2_rank,
        cume_dist() over (order by is_flagged_cume_dist asc nulls first) as is_flagged_cume_dist_cume_dist,
        sum(is_flagged_percent_rank) over (partition by host) as host_sum_is_flagged_percent_rank,
        min(is_flagged_cume_dist) over (partition by host) as host_min_is_flagged_cume_dist
    from cleaned
),
stats as (
    -- Grouped metrics
    select
        case when k_count_is_flagged_percent_rank >= 16 then 'PREMIUM' else 'STANDARD' end as k_count_is_flagged_percent_rank_tier,
        count(*) as event_count,
        percentile_approx(host_min_is_flagged_cume_dist, array(0.25, 0.5, 0.75)) as host_min_is_flagged_cume_dist_quartiles,
        sum(status_code_high) filter (where host = 'h2') as h2_total_status_code_high
    from scored_app_logs
    group by 1
    having event_count > 1
)
select
    k_count_is_flagged_percent_rank_tier,
    event_count,
    host_min_is_flagged_cume_dist_quartiles
from stats
order by event_count desc, k_count_is_flagged_percent_rank_tier asc

w = Window.partitionBy("host").orderBy(F.col("status_code_high").asc_nulls_last())

w3 = Window.partitionBy("k").orderBy(F.col("is_flagged").asc_nulls_first())

w5 = Window.partitionBy("host")
w6 = Window.partitionBy("k", "host")
w7 = Window.orderBy(F.col("status_code_high_cume_dist_2").asc_nulls_last())

flattened = (
    df_app_logs
    .select(
        "id",
        "host",
        "level",
        "latency_ms",
        "status_code",
        F.explode("context").alias("k", "value"),
    )
)

flattened_attrs = (
    flattened
    .select(
        "id",
        "host",
        "k",
        F.shiftright("status_code", 2).alias("status_code_high"),
        (F.col("status_code").bitwiseAND(8) != 0).cast("int").alias("is_flagged"),
    )
)

matched_keys = (
    flattened_attrs
    .select("id", "host")
    .subtract(
        df_app_logs
        .filter(F.col("latency_ms").isNotNull())
        .select("id", "host")
    )
)

verified = (
    flattened_attrs
    .alias("s")
    .join(matched_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.id") == F.col("k.id")) & (F.col("s.host") == F.col("k.host")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

scored = (
    verified
    .select(
        "*",
        F.cume_dist().over(w).alias("status_code_high_cume_dist"),
        F.cume_dist().over(w2).alias("status_code_high_cume_dist_2"),
        F.cume_dist().over(w3).alias("is_flagged_cume_dist"),
    )
)

enriched = (
    scored
    .select(
        "*",
        F.percent_rank().over(w4).alias("is_flagged_percent_rank"),
        F.sum("status_code_high_cume_dist_2").over(w5).alias("host_sum_status_code_high_cume_dist_2"),
    )
)

    enriched
    .filter(F.col("k").isNotNull())
    .withColumn("is_flagged_tier", F.when(F.col("is_flagged") >= 1, "High").when(F.col("is_flagged") >= 0, "Medium").otherwise("Low"))
    .withColumn("k_filled", F.coalesce("k", F.lit("NONE")))
)

scored_app_logs = (
    cleaned
    .withColumn("k_count_is_flagged_percent_rank", F.count("is_flagged_percent_rank").over(w6))
    .withColumn("status_code_high_cume_dist_2_rank", F.rank().over(w7))
    .withColumn("is_flagged_cume_dist_cume_dist", F.cume_dist().over(w8))
    .withColumn("host_sum_is_flagged_percent_rank", F.sum("is_flagged_percent_rank").over(w5))
    .withColumn("host_min_is_flagged_cume_dist", F.min("is_flagged_cume_dist").over(w5))
)

stats = (
    scored_app_logs
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("k_count_is_flagged_percent_rank") >= 16, "PREMIUM").otherwise("STANDARD").alias("k_count_is_flagged_percent_rank_tier"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.count("*").alias("event_count"),
        F.percentile_approx("host_min_is_flagged_cume_dist", [0.25, 0.5, 0.75]).alias("host_min_is_flagged_cume_dist_quartiles"),
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("host") == "h2", F.col("status_code_high"))).alias("h2_total_status_code_high"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("event_count") > 1)
)

result = (
    stats
    .select(
        "k_count_is_flagged_percent_rank_tier",
        "event_count",
        "host_min_is_flagged_cume_dist_quartiles",
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("event_count").desc(), "k_count_is_flagged_percent_rank_tier")
)

WITH valid AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        id,
        full_name,
        email,
        dept_id,
        manager_id,
        job_title,
        hire_date,
        is_remote,
        TRIM(level) AS clean_level
    FROM employees
    WHERE hire_date >= DATE '2024-01-25'
      AND job_title IS NOT NULL
      AND full_name LIKE 'Ali%'
),
scored AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        *,
        FIRST_VALUE(job_title, TRUE) OVER (PARTITION BY job_title, manager_id ORDER BY hire_date, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS first_known_job_title,
        LAST_VALUE(job_title, TRUE) OVER (PARTITION BY job_title ORDER BY hire_date, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS last_known_job_title,
        LAST_VALUE(job_title, TRUE) OVER (PARTITION BY manager_id ORDER BY hire_date, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS last_known_job_title_2
    FROM valid
),
joined AS (
    -- Attach employees attributes
    SELECT
        s.*,
        e.email AS employee_email,
        e.full_name AS employee_full_name,
        e.level
    FROM scored s
    LEFT JOIN employees e
        ON s.manager_id = e.id
)
SELECT
    id,
    dept_id,
    job_title,
    hire_date,
    is_remote,
    last_known_job_title_2,
    employee_email,
    employee_full_name,
    level,
    CASE WHEN level RLIKE '^(L1|L2)$' THEN 'GROUP_B' WHEN level RLIKE '^(L3|L4)$' THEN 'EXTENDED' ELSE 'CORE' END AS level_zone
FROM joined
ORDER BY job_title DESC NULLS FIRST;

WITH valid AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT *, LOWER(country) AS country_lower
    FROM suppliers
    WHERE city IS NOT NULL
),
with_latest AS (
    -- Latest matching product per row (LATERAL ... LIMIT 1)
    SELECT
        s.*,
        latest.product_brand,
        latest.category
    FROM valid s
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
            SELECT c.brand AS product_brand, c.category
            FROM products c
            WHERE c.supplier_id = s.id
            ORDER BY c.cost DESC, c.id DESC
            LIMIT 1
        ) latest ON TRUE
),
not_flagged AS (
    -- Anti-join via a correlated subquery
    SELECT s.*
    FROM with_latest s
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM products x
            WHERE x.supplier_id = s.id
              AND x.launch_date BETWEEN '2023-09-01' AND '2023-11-09'
        )
),
not_flagged_suppliers AS (
    -- Anti-join via a correlated subquery
    SELECT s.*
    FROM not_flagged s
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM products c
            WHERE c.supplier_id = s.id
              AND c.supplier_id IN (4, 22, 33)
        )
)
-- Aggregate with conditional metrics
SELECT
    CASE WHEN rating >= 4.2 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END AS rating_tier,
    country,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN country = 'SG' THEN 1 END) AS sg_count,
    STDDEV_SAMP(rating) AS rating_stddev,
    MIN(rating) AS min_rating,
    SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_SET(category)) AS category_list,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE city = 'Tokyo') AS tokyo_rows,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE category = 'Fashion') AS fashion_rows,
    PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY CASE WHEN rating >= 4.2 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END ORDER BY COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE category = 'Fashion') DESC) AS fashion_rows_percent_rank
FROM not_flagged_suppliers
GROUP BY rating_tier, country;

    FROM cleaned_customers
    WHERE credit_limit BETWEEN 5100 AND 7900
),
valid AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT
        *,
        age + credit_limit age_plus_credit_limit,
        ROUND(segment_length / age, 2) segment_length_per_age
    FROM base
    WHERE segment_length_per_credit_limit IS NOT NULL
)
-- Native SQL UNPIVOT (wide to long)
SELECT *
FROM (
    SELECT
        id,
        segment,
        segment_length_per_credit_limit,
        age_plus_credit_limit,
        credit_limit
    FROM valid
) src
UNPIVOT INCLUDE NULLS (
    val FOR metric_name IN (segment_length_per_credit_limit, age_plus_credit_limit, credit_limit)
)

WITH cleaned AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT *, discount * shipping_fee AS discount_times_shipping_fee
    FROM orders
    WHERE customer_id IS NOT NULL
      AND store_id IS NOT NULL
),
metrics AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        *,
        SUM(discount) OVER w_part AS status_sum_discount,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY status ORDER BY amount DESC NULLS FIRST) AS amount_dense_rank,
        MIN(discount) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id) AS customer_id_min_discount,
        LEAD(amount, 1) OVER (ORDER BY amount, id) AS next_amount,
        LEAD(shipping_fee, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY status, store_id ORDER BY discount_times_shipping_fee, id) AS next_shipping_fee
    FROM cleaned
    WINDOW w_part AS (PARTITION BY status)
),
not_flagged AS (
    -- Anti-join via a correlated subquery
    SELECT s.*
    FROM metrics s
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM shipments ch
            WHERE ch.order_id = s.id
              AND ch.carrier = 'Kerry'
        )
),
not_flagged_orders AS (
    -- Semi-join via a correlated subquery
    SELECT s.*
    FROM not_flagged s
    WHERE EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM order_items c
            WHERE c.order_id = s.id
              AND c.quantity BETWEEN 4 AND 7
        )
),
eligible AS (
    -- Anti-join via a correlated subquery
    SELECT s.*
    FROM not_flagged_orders s
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM shipments ch
            WHERE ch.order_id = s.id
              AND ch.shipped_date >= s.order_date
        )
),
summary AS (
    -- Aggregate with conditional metrics
    SELECT
        DATE_TRUNC('WEEK', order_date) AS week_start,
        AVG(discount_times_shipping_fee) FILTER (WHERE status = 'RETURNED') AS returned_avg_discount_times_shipping_fee,
        ROUND(SUM(customer_id_min_discount) / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN channel = 'web' THEN 1 END), 0), 2) AS customer_id_min_discount_per_web,
        SIZE(COLLECT_SET(status)) AS num_status
    FROM eligible
    GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('WEEK', order_date)
    HAVING returned_avg_discount_times_shipping_fee >= 0
)
SELECT week_start, num_status
FROM summary
ORDER BY week_start DESC, num_status;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w_part = Window.partitionBy("status")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("status").orderBy(F.col("amount").desc_nulls_first())
w3 = Window.partitionBy("customer_id")
w4 = Window.orderBy("amount", "id")
w5 = Window.partitionBy("status", "store_id").orderBy("discount_times_shipping_fee", "id")

cleaned = (
    df_orders
    .filter(F.col("customer_id").isNotNull() & F.col("store_id").isNotNull())
    .withColumn("discount_times_shipping_fee", (F.col("discount") * F.col("shipping_fee")))
)

metrics = (
    cleaned
    .withColumn("status_sum_discount", F.sum("discount").over(w_part))
    .withColumn("amount_dense_rank", F.dense_rank().over(w2))
    .withColumn("customer_id_min_discount", F.min("discount").over(w3))
    .withColumn("next_amount", F.lead("amount", 1).over(w4))
    .withColumn("next_shipping_fee", F.lead("shipping_fee", 1).over(w5))
)

not_flagged = (
    metrics
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_shipments.alias("ch"), (F.col("ch.order_id") == F.col("s.id")) & (F.col("ch.carrier") == "Kerry"), "left_anti")
)

not_flagged_orders = (
    not_flagged
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_order_items.alias("c"), (F.col("c.order_id") == F.col("s.id")) & (F.col("c.quantity").between(4, 7)), "left_semi")
)

eligible = (
    not_flagged_orders
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_shipments.alias("ch"), (F.col("ch.order_id") == F.col("s.id")) & (F.col("ch.shipped_date") >= F.col("s.order_date")), "left_anti")
)

summary = (
    eligible
    .groupBy(F.date_trunc("WEEK", "order_date").alias("week_start"))
    .agg(
        F.avg(F.when(F.col("status") == "RETURNED", F.col("discount_times_shipping_fee"))).alias("returned_avg_discount_times_shipping_fee"),
        F.round(F.sum("customer_id_min_discount") / F.nullif(F.count(F.when(F.col("channel") == "web", 1)), F.lit(0)), 2).alias("customer_id_min_discount_per_web"),
        F.size(F.collect_set("status")).alias("num_status"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("returned_avg_discount_times_shipping_fee") >= 0)
)

result = (
    summary
    .select("week_start", "num_status")
    .orderBy(F.col("week_start").desc(), "num_status")
)

WITH cleaned AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT
        *,
        units * revenue AS revenue_per_unit,
        DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', sale_date) AS sale_date_period
    FROM store_sales
    WHERE sale_date >= TO_DATE('2023-07-18')
      AND sale_date BETWEEN '2024-10-23' AND '2024-12-01'
),
with_windows AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        *,
        LAST_VALUE(revenue_per_unit, TRUE) OVER (ORDER BY sale_date ASC, id ASC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS last_known_revenue_per_unit,
        SUM(revenue_per_unit) OVER (ORDER BY revenue ASC, id ASC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_revenue_per_unit,
        LEAD(units, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY sale_date_period ASC, id ASC) AS next_units
    FROM cleaned
),
with_windows_store_sales AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        id,
        store_id,
        product_id,
        sale_date,
        units,
        revenue,
        revenue_per_unit,
        sale_date_period,
        last_known_revenue_per_unit,
        cumulative_revenue_per_unit,
        next_units,
        AVG(revenue) OVER (PARTITION BY store_id ORDER BY sale_date_period ASC, id ASC ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS revenue_avg_3_prior,
        LAST_VALUE(last_known_revenue_per_unit, TRUE) OVER (PARTITION BY store_id ORDER BY revenue_per_unit ASC, id ASC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS last_known_last_known_revenue_per_unit,
        AVG(revenue_per_unit) OVER (PARTITION BY store_id, product_id ORDER BY last_known_revenue_per_unit ASC, id ASC ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS revenue_per_unit_avg_3,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY store_id ORDER BY last_known_revenue_per_unit DESC, id ASC) AS event_seq,
        AVG(cumulative_revenue_per_unit) OVER w_ordered AS cumulative_revenue_per_unit_avg_5_prior
    FROM with_windows
    WINDOW w_ordered AS (PARTITION BY store_id ORDER BY sale_date_period ASC, id ASC ROWS BETWEEN 5 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING)
)
SELECT
    s.id,
    s.store_id,
    s.product_id,
    s.sale_date,
    s.units,
    s.revenue,
    s.revenue_per_unit,
    s.sale_date_period,
    s.cumulative_revenue_per_unit,
    (SELECT MIN(x.quantity) FROM inventory x WHERE x.product_id = s.product_id) AS min_inventory_quantity
FROM with_windows_store_sales s
ORDER BY cumulative_revenue_per_unit DESC NULLS FIRST, sale_date_period ASC;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.orderBy("sale_date", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w2 = Window.orderBy("revenue", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w3 = Window.partitionBy("product_id").orderBy("sale_date_period", "id")
w4 = Window.partitionBy("store_id").orderBy("sale_date_period", "id").rowsBetween(-3, -1)
w5 = Window.partitionBy("store_id").orderBy("revenue_per_unit", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w6 = Window.partitionBy("store_id", "product_id").orderBy("last_known_revenue_per_unit", "id").rowsBetween(-3, Window.currentRow)
w7 = Window.partitionBy("store_id").orderBy(F.col("last_known_revenue_per_unit").desc(), "id")
w_ordered = Window.partitionBy("store_id").orderBy("sale_date_period", "id").rowsBetween(-5, -1)
quantity_by_product_id = df_inventory.groupBy("product_id").agg(F.min("quantity").alias("min_inventory_quantity"))

cleaned = (
    df_store_sales
    .filter((F.col("sale_date") >= F.to_date(F.lit("2023-07-18"))) & F.col("sale_date").between("2024-10-23", "2024-12-01"))
    .select(
        "*",
        (F.col("units") * F.col("revenue")).alias("revenue_per_unit"),
        F.date_trunc("YEAR", "sale_date").alias("sale_date_period"),
    )
)

with_windows = (
    cleaned
    .withColumn("last_known_revenue_per_unit", F.last("revenue_per_unit", ignorenulls=True).over(w))
    .withColumn("cumulative_revenue_per_unit", F.sum("revenue_per_unit").over(w2))
    .withColumn("next_units", F.lead("units", 1).over(w3))
)

with_windows_store_sales = (
    with_windows
    .select(
        "*",
        F.avg("revenue").over(w4).alias("revenue_avg_3_prior"),
        F.last("last_known_revenue_per_unit", ignorenulls=True).over(w5).alias("last_known_last_known_revenue_per_unit"),
        F.avg("revenue_per_unit").over(w6).alias("revenue_per_unit_avg_3"),
        F.row_number().over(w7).alias("event_seq"),
        F.avg("cumulative_revenue_per_unit").over(w_ordered).alias("cumulative_revenue_per_unit_avg_5_prior"),
    )
)

result = (
    with_windows_store_sales
    .join(quantity_by_product_id, on="product_id", how="left")
    .select(
        "id",
        "store_id",
        "product_id",
        "sale_date",
        "units",
        "revenue",
        "revenue_per_unit",
        "sale_date_period",
        "cumulative_revenue_per_unit",
        F.col("min_inventory_quantity"),
    )
    .orderBy(
        F.col("cumulative_revenue_per_unit").desc_nulls_first(),
        "sale_date_period",
    )
)

WITH valid AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT
        *,
        CASE WHEN city = 'Bangkok' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_bangkok,
        TRIM(store_name) AS clean_store_name
    FROM stores
    WHERE region IS NOT NULL
      AND city = 'Berlin'
),
ranked AS (
    -- Deduplicate with ROW_NUMBER
    SELECT *
    FROM (
        SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY city ORDER BY opened_date DESC NULLS FIRST, id) AS dedup_rank
        FROM valid
    ) ranked
    WHERE dedup_rank = 1
),
eligible AS (
    -- Anti-join via a correlated subquery
    SELECT s.*
    FROM ranked s
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM store_sales ch
            WHERE ch.store_id = s.id
              AND ch.sale_date BETWEEN '2023-11-01' AND '2024-05-01'
        )
),
latest AS (
    -- Keep one row per key (latest first)
    SELECT *
    FROM eligible
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY city, region ORDER BY is_bangkok DESC, id) = 1
),
deduped AS (
    -- Deduplicate with ROW_NUMBER
    SELECT *
    FROM (
        SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY city, region ORDER BY opened_date, id) AS latest_rank
        FROM latest
    ) ranked
    WHERE latest_rank = 1
),
kept_keys AS (
    -- Set difference on keys
    SELECT city, region
    FROM deduped
    EXCEPT DISTINCT
    SELECT city, region
    FROM stores
    WHERE store_name NOT LIKE 'D%'
),
verified AS (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    SELECT s.*
    FROM deduped s
    JOIN kept_keys k ON s.city = k.city AND s.region = k.region
)
SELECT
    id,
    store_name,
    city,
    region,
    is_bangkok,
    clean_store_name,
    dedup_rank,
    latest_rank
FROM verified
ORDER BY id NULLS LAST;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("city").orderBy(F.col("opened_date").desc_nulls_first(), "id")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("city", "region").orderBy(F.col("is_bangkok").desc(), "id")
w3 = Window.partitionBy("city", "region").orderBy("opened_date", "id")

valid = (
    df_stores
    .filter(F.col("region").isNotNull() & (F.col("city") == "Berlin"))
    .withColumn("is_bangkok", F.when(F.col("city") == "Bangkok", 1).otherwise(0))
    .withColumn("clean_store_name", F.trim("store_name"))
)

ranked = (
    valid
    .withColumn("dedup_rank", F.row_number().over(w))
    .filter(F.col("dedup_rank") == 1)
)

eligible = (
    ranked
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_store_sales.alias("ch"), (F.col("ch.store_id") == F.col("s.id")) & (F.col("ch.sale_date").between("2023-11-01", "2024-05-01")), "left_anti")
)

latest = (
    eligible
    .withColumn("latest_rank", F.row_number().over(w2))
    .filter(F.col("latest_rank") == 1)
    .drop("latest_rank")
)

deduped = (
    latest
    .withColumn("latest_rank", F.row_number().over(w3))
    .filter(F.col("latest_rank") == 1)
)

kept_keys = (
    deduped
    .select("city", "region")
    .subtract(
        df_stores
        .filter(~F.col("store_name").like("D%"))
        .select("city", "region")
    )
)

verified = (
    deduped
    .alias("s")
    .join(kept_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.city") == F.col("k.city")) & (F.col("s.region") == F.col("k.region")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

result = (
    verified
    .select(
        "id",
        "store_name",
        "city",
        "region",
        "is_bangkok",
        "clean_store_name",
        "dedup_rank",
        "latest_rank",
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("id").asc_nulls_last())
)

    FROM sessions

            FROM web_events c

        device,
        started_at,
        country,
        seq_no,
        duration_sec,
        event_type,

        LOWER(event_type) event_type_lower
    FROM with_last
    WHERE started_at > TIMESTAMP '2023-09-05 07:00:00'
      AND event_type IS NOT NULL
),
enriched_sessions AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        COUNT(duration_sec) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id, device) customer_id_count_duration_sec,
        SUM(duration_sec) OVER (PARTITION BY event_type ORDER BY duration_sec_rounded ASC, id ASC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) running_duration_sec,
        SUM(duration_sec) OVER (PARTITION BY country ORDER BY duration_sec ASC, id ASC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) running_duration_sec_2
    FROM filtered
),
summary AS (
    SELECT
        customer_id,
        MAX(running_duration_sec_2) FILTER (WHERE device = 'mobile') AS mobile_max_running_duration_sec_2,
        SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_SET(event_type)) AS event_type_list,
        APPROX_PERCENTILE(duration_sec, 0.5) AS duration_sec_p50,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE device = 'mobile') AS mobile_rows,
        SIZE(COLLECT_SET(event_type)) AS num_event_types
    FROM enriched_sessions
    GROUP BY customer_id
    HAVING COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE device = 'mobile') > 1
)
SELECT
    customer_id,
    mobile_max_running_duration_sec_2,
    event_type_list,
    duration_sec_p50,
    mobile_rows
FROM summary

    lateral view outer explode(tier_limits) li as element

    from flattened

    from valid

    select

        currency,
        element,
        plan_length,
        currency_group,
        element * plan_length as element_times_plan_length
    from base
    where currency in ('THB', 'USD', 'EUR')
),
stats as (
    -- Grouped metrics
    select
        currency,
        case when element >= 74 then 'LARGE' else 'SMALL' end as element_tier,
        max(plan_length) filter (where currency = 'USD') as usd_max_plan_length,
        approx_percentile(element, 0.95) as element_p95,
        count(distinct currency) as distinct_currencies
    from base_price_tiers
    group by rollup (currency, case when element >= 74 then 'LARGE' else 'SMALL' end)
)
select
    element_tier,
    usd_max_plan_length,
    element_p95
from stats
order by usd_max_plan_length nulls first, element_tier;

WITH lines AS (

    FROM carts
    LATERAL VIEW OUTER EXPLODE(attributes) x AS attr_key, value

flattened AS (

    FROM lines
    LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(coupon_codes) t AS value_2
),
valid AS (

        *,
        LENGTH(value_2) AS value_2_length,
        COALESCE(value_2, 'DIRECT') AS value_2_filled
    FROM flattened
    WHERE value_2 IS NOT NULL
)
-- Multi-level aggregation
SELECT
    CASE WHEN value_2_length >= 78 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END AS value_2_length_tier,
    customer_id,
    SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_SET(value_2)) AS value_2_list,
    SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_SET(value_2)) AS value_2_list_2,
    ROUND(SUM(value_2_length) / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN value_2 = 'WELCOME5' THEN 1 END), 0), 2) AS value_2_length_per_welcome5,
    ROUND(SUM(value_2_length) / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN value_2 = 'VIP' THEN 1 END), 0), 2) AS value_2_length_per_vip

WITH cleaned AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT *, quantity - unit_price AS line_total
    FROM order_items
    WHERE order_id IN (19, 21, 37)
),
with_windows AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        *,
        NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY unit_price, id) AS unit_price_bucket,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY order_id, product_id ORDER BY quantity, id) AS seq_no
    FROM cleaned
),
enriched AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        *,
        RANK() OVER w_hist AS seq_no_rank,
        PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY order_id ORDER BY unit_price_bucket NULLS FIRST) AS unit_price_bucket_percent_rank,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY order_id ORDER BY unit_price_bucket DESC, id) AS seq_no_2,
        SUM(unit_price_bucket) OVER (ORDER BY unit_price, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_unit_price_bucket,
        AVG(unit_price_bucket) OVER w_ordered AS unit_price_bucket_avg_6_prior
    FROM with_windows
    WINDOW w_hist AS (PARTITION BY order_id ORDER BY seq_no DESC), w_ordered AS (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY line_total, id ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING)
),
deduped AS (
    -- Deduplicate with ROW_NUMBER
    SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY order_id, product_id ORDER BY unit_price, id) AS rn
    FROM enriched
    QUALIFY rn = 1
)
-- Ranking and gap features
SELECT
    *,
    NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY running_unit_price_bucket, id) AS running_unit_price_bucket_bucket,
    SUM(seq_no_2) OVER (ORDER BY seq_no_2, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_seq_no_2,
    CORR(quantity, unit_price) OVER (PARTITION BY order_id) AS corr_quantity_unit_price
FROM deduped;

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.orderBy("unit_price", "id")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("order_id", "product_id").orderBy("quantity", "id")
w_hist = Window.partitionBy("order_id").orderBy(F.col("seq_no").desc())
w4 = Window.partitionBy("order_id").orderBy(F.col("unit_price_bucket").asc_nulls_first())
w5 = Window.partitionBy("order_id").orderBy(F.col("unit_price_bucket").desc(), "id")
w6 = Window.orderBy("unit_price", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w_ordered = Window.partitionBy("product_id").orderBy("line_total", "id").rowsBetween(-6, -1)
w8 = Window.partitionBy("order_id", "product_id").orderBy("unit_price", "id")
w9 = Window.orderBy("running_unit_price_bucket", "id")
w10 = Window.orderBy("seq_no_2", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w11 = Window.partitionBy("order_id")

cleaned = (
    df_order_items
    .filter(F.col("order_id").isin([19, 21, 37]))
    .select("*", (F.col("quantity") - F.col("unit_price")).alias("line_total"))
)

with_windows = (
    cleaned
    .select(
        "*",
        F.ntile(4).over(w).alias("unit_price_bucket"),
        F.row_number().over(w2).alias("seq_no"),
    )
)

enriched = (
    with_windows
    .withColumn("seq_no_rank", F.rank().over(w_hist))
    .withColumn("unit_price_bucket_percent_rank", F.percent_rank().over(w4))
    .withColumn("seq_no_2", F.row_number().over(w5))
    .withColumn("running_unit_price_bucket", F.sum("unit_price_bucket").over(w6))
    .withColumn("unit_price_bucket_avg_6_prior", F.avg("unit_price_bucket").over(w_ordered))
)

deduped = (
    enriched
    .withColumn("rn", F.row_number().over(w8))
    .filter(F.col("rn") == 1)
)

result = (
    deduped
    .withColumn("running_unit_price_bucket_bucket", F.ntile(4).over(w9))
    .withColumn("running_seq_no_2", F.sum("seq_no_2").over(w10))
    .withColumn("corr_quantity_unit_price", F.corr("quantity", "unit_price").over(w11))
)

WITH cleaned AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        id,
        name,
        email,
        country,
        city,
        segment,
        age,
        CASE WHEN is_active THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS is_active_label,
        COALESCE(segment, 'UNKNOWN') AS segment_filled
    FROM customers
    WHERE signup_date > TO_DATE('2023-06-05')
      AND country IN ('UK', 'DE', 'JP')
),
matched_keys AS (
    -- Set difference on keys
    SELECT city, country
    FROM cleaned
    EXCEPT
    SELECT city, country
    FROM customers
    WHERE age > 35
),
verified AS (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    SELECT s.*
    FROM cleaned s
    JOIN matched_keys k ON s.city = k.city AND s.country = k.country
),
cleaned_customers AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT
        name,
        email,
        country,
        city,
        segment,
        age,
        is_active_label,
        segment_filled,
        CONCAT(segment, '/', country) AS segment_country,
        COALESCE(city, 'NONE') AS city_filled
    FROM verified
    WHERE city IS NOT NULL
),
valid AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        name,
        email,
        city,
        segment,
        age,
        is_active_label,
        segment_filled,
        city_filled,
        TRIM(country) AS clean_country,
        CEIL(age) AS age_whole
    FROM cleaned_customers
    WHERE segment IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
    name,
    city,
    age,
    is_active_label,
    segment_filled,
    city_filled,
    clean_country,
    age_whole,
    CASE WHEN city RLIKE '^(Chiang Mai|Berlin)$' THEN 'CORE' ELSE 'OTHER_ZONE' END AS city_zone
FROM valid
ORDER BY age_whole NULLS FIRST;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

cleaned = (
    df_customers
    .filter((F.col("signup_date") > F.to_date(F.lit("2023-06-05"))) & F.col("country").isin(["UK", "DE", "JP"]))
    .select(
        "id",
        "name",
        "email",
        "country",
        "city",
        "segment",
        "age",
        F.when(F.col("is_active"), "Yes").otherwise("No").alias("is_active_label"),
        F.coalesce("segment", F.lit("UNKNOWN")).alias("segment_filled"),
    )
)

matched_keys = (
    cleaned
    .select("city", "country")
    .subtract(
        df_customers
        .filter(F.col("age") > 35)
        .select("city", "country")
    )
)

verified = (
    cleaned
    .alias("s")
    .join(matched_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.city") == F.col("k.city")) & (F.col("s.country") == F.col("k.country")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

cleaned_customers = (
    verified
    .filter(F.col("city").isNotNull())
    .select(
        "name",
        "email",
        "country",
        "city",
        "segment",
        "age",
        "is_active_label",
        "segment_filled",
        F.concat("segment", F.lit("/"), "country").alias("segment_country"),
        F.coalesce("city", F.lit("NONE")).alias("city_filled"),
    )
)

valid = (
    cleaned_customers
    .filter(F.col("segment").isNotNull())
    .select(
        "name",
        "email",
        "city",
        "segment",
        "age",
        "is_active_label",
        "segment_filled",
        "city_filled",
        F.trim("country").alias("clean_country"),
        F.ceil("age").alias("age_whole"),
    )
)

result = (
    valid
    .select(
        "name",
        "city",
        "age",
        "is_active_label",
        "segment_filled",
        "city_filled",
        "clean_country",
        "age_whole",
        F.when(F.col("city").rlike("^(Chiang Mai|Berlin)$"), "CORE").otherwise("OTHER_ZONE").alias("city_zone"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("age_whole").asc_nulls_first())
)

WITH unpacked AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        tier_prices,
        TRANSFORM(tier_prices, (p, i) -> ROUND(p * tier_limits[i], 2)) AS tier_revenue_caps,
        ARRAY_MIN(tier_prices) AS lowest_price,
        AGGREGATE(tier_prices, CAST(0 AS DOUBLE), (acc, p) -> acc + p, acc -> ROUND(acc / SIZE(tier_prices), 2)) AS avg_tier_price,
        ZIP_WITH(tier_prices, discounts, (p, d) -> ROUND(p * (1 - d), 2)) AS net_prices
    FROM price_tiers
)
SELECT
    CASE WHEN avg_tier_price >= 27 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END AS avg_tier_price_tier,
    CASE WHEN lowest_price >= 30 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END AS lowest_price_tier,
    ROUND(AVG(avg_tier_price), 2) AS avg_avg_tier_price,
    MIN(lowest_price) AS min_lowest_price,
    APPROX_PERCENTILE(avg_tier_price, 0.9) AS avg_tier_price_p90,
    MAX(lowest_price) AS max_lowest_price,
    PERCENTILE_APPROX(avg_tier_price, 0.9) AS avg_tier_price_p90_2,
    MAX(avg_tier_price) AS max_avg_tier_price,
    PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY CASE WHEN avg_tier_price >= 27 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END ORDER BY APPROX_PERCENTILE(avg_tier_price, 0.9) DESC) AS avg_tier_price_p90_percent_rank
FROM unpacked
GROUP BY avg_tier_price_tier, lowest_price_tier
HAVING min_lowest_price >= 0;

        F.array_min("tier_prices").alias("lowest_price"),
        F.aggregate("tier_prices", F.lit(0.0), lambda acc, p: acc + p, lambda acc: F.round(acc / F.size("tier_prices"), 2)).alias("avg_tier_price"),

FROM with_windows

with valid as (
    select
        *,
        case when status = 'OPEN' then 1 else 0 end as is_open,
        coalesce(status, 'UNKNOWN') as resolved_status
    from accounts
    where opened_date > date '2024-04-25'
),
base as (
    select
        *,
        round(is_open * 1.15, 2) as adjusted_is_open,
        cast(is_open as string) as is_open_num
    from valid
    where opened_date >= to_date('2023-08-14')
),
with_last as (
    select
        s.*,
        top1.txn_time,
        top1.transaction_txn_type
    from base s
    left join lateral (
            select c.txn_time, c.txn_type as transaction_txn_type
            from transactions c
            where c.account_id = s.id
            order by c.amount desc, c.id desc
            limit 1
        ) top1 on true
),
not_flagged as (
    select s.*
    from with_last s
    where not exists (
            select 1
            from transactions x
            where x.account_id = s.id
              and x.txn_time <= s.txn_time
        )
),
scored as (
    select
        *,
        avg(balance) over (partition by transaction_txn_type order by cast(txn_time as bigint) range between 604800 preceding and current row) as balance_avg_7d,
        ntile(3) over (partition by customer_id, status order by balance desc, id) as balance_bucket,
        avg(is_open) over w_running as is_open_avg_7d,
        lead(balance, 1) over (partition by customer_id, transaction_txn_type order by txn_time, id) as next_balance,
        cume_dist() over w_recent as is_open_cume_dist
    from not_flagged
    window w_running as (partition by customer_id order by cast(txn_time as bigint) range between 604800 preceding and current row), w_recent as (partition by customer_id order by is_open desc nulls first)
),
with_gaps as (
    select *, case when lag(txn_time) over (partition by customer_id order by txn_time, id) is null
                 or txn_time > lag(txn_time) over (partition by customer_id order by txn_time, id) + interval '90' day then 1 else 0 end as is_new_burst
    from scored
),
sessionized as (
    select *, sum(is_new_burst) over (partition by customer_id order by txn_time, id rows between unbounded preceding and current row) as island_id
    from with_gaps
),
scored_accounts as (
    select
        id,
        customer_id,
        account_type,
        balance,
        opened_date,
        status,
        is_open,
        resolved_status,
        adjusted_is_open,
        is_open_num,
        txn_time,
        transaction_txn_type,
        balance_avg_7d,
        balance_bucket,
        is_open_avg_7d,
        next_balance,
        is_open_cume_dist,
        is_new_burst,
        island_id,
        cume_dist() over (partition by customer_id order by is_open_avg_7d nulls last) as is_open_avg_7d_cume_dist,
        stddev_samp(is_open_cume_dist) over (partition by customer_id) as customer_id_stddev_samp_is_open_cume_dist,
        row_number() over (partition by account_type order by island_id desc, id) as row_seq,
        lead(is_open_avg_7d, 2) over (partition by transaction_txn_type order by is_open, id) as next_is_open_avg_7d
    from sessionized
)
select
    *,
    avg(balance_bucket) over (partition by transaction_txn_type order by next_is_open_avg_7d, id rows between 2 preceding and 1 preceding) as balance_bucket_avg_2_prior,
    ntile(5) over (partition by status, account_type order by is_open desc, id) as is_open_bucket,
    lead(next_balance, 1) over (partition by customer_id order by balance_bucket, id) as next_next_balance
from scored_accounts;

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy(F.col("s.id")).orderBy(F.col("c.amount").desc(), F.col("c.id").desc())
w2 = Window.partitionBy("transaction_txn_type").orderBy(F.col("txn_time").cast("bigint")).rangeBetween(-604800, Window.currentRow)
w3 = Window.partitionBy("customer_id", "status").orderBy(F.col("balance").desc(), "id")
w_running = Window.partitionBy("customer_id").orderBy(F.col("txn_time").cast("bigint")).rangeBetween(-604800, Window.currentRow)
w5 = Window.partitionBy("customer_id", "transaction_txn_type").orderBy("txn_time", "id")
w_recent = Window.partitionBy("customer_id").orderBy(F.col("is_open").desc_nulls_first())
w7 = Window.partitionBy("customer_id").orderBy("txn_time", "id")
w8 = Window.partitionBy("customer_id").orderBy("txn_time", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w9 = Window.partitionBy("customer_id").orderBy(F.col("is_open_avg_7d").asc_nulls_last())
w10 = Window.partitionBy("customer_id")
w11 = Window.partitionBy("account_type").orderBy(F.col("island_id").desc(), "id")
w12 = Window.partitionBy("transaction_txn_type").orderBy("is_open", "id")
w13 = Window.partitionBy("transaction_txn_type").orderBy("next_is_open_avg_7d", "id").rowsBetween(-2, -1)
w14 = Window.partitionBy("status", "account_type").orderBy(F.col("is_open").desc(), "id")
w15 = Window.partitionBy("customer_id").orderBy("balance_bucket", "id")

valid = (
    df_accounts
    .filter(F.col("opened_date") > F.lit("2024-04-25").cast("date"))
    .withColumn("is_open", F.when(F.col("status") == "OPEN", 1).otherwise(0))
    .withColumn("resolved_status", F.coalesce("status", F.lit("UNKNOWN")))
)

base = (
    valid
    .filter(F.col("opened_date") >= F.to_date(F.lit("2023-08-14")))
    .select(
        "*",
        F.round((F.col("is_open") * 1.15), 2).alias("adjusted_is_open"),
        F.col("is_open").cast("string").alias("is_open_num"),
    )
)

with_last = (
    base
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_transactions.alias("c"), (F.col("c.account_id") == F.col("s.id")), "left")
    .withColumn("rn", F.row_number().over(w))
    .filter(F.col("rn") == 1)
    .select(
        "s.*",
        F.col("c.txn_time"),
        F.col("c.txn_type").alias("transaction_txn_type"),
    )
)

not_flagged = (
    with_last
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_transactions.alias("x"), (F.col("x.account_id") == F.col("s.id")) & (F.col("x.txn_time") <= F.col("s.txn_time")), "left_anti")
)

scored = (
    not_flagged
    .select(
        "*",
        F.avg("balance").over(w2).alias("balance_avg_7d"),
        F.ntile(3).over(w3).alias("balance_bucket"),
        F.avg("is_open").over(w_running).alias("is_open_avg_7d"),
        F.lead("balance", 1).over(w5).alias("next_balance"),
        F.cume_dist().over(w_recent).alias("is_open_cume_dist"),
    )
)

with_gaps = (
    scored
    .withColumn("is_new_burst", F.when(F.lag("txn_time").over(w7).isNull() | (F.col("txn_time") > F.lag("txn_time").over(w7) + F.expr("INTERVAL 90 DAYS")), 1).otherwise(0))
)

sessionized = with_gaps.withColumn("island_id", F.sum("is_new_burst").over(w8))

scored_accounts = (

WITH base AS (

    SELECT
        *,
        TRIM(dept_name) AS clean_dept_name,
        SUBSTRING(dept_name, 1, 3) AS dept_name_prefix
    FROM departments
    WHERE location IN ('Singapore', 'New York', 'Tokyo')

metrics AS (

    SELECT
        *,
        PERCENT_RANK() OVER w_grp AS budget_percent_rank,
        ROUND(budget / SUM(budget) OVER (PARTITION BY dept_name, location), 4) AS budget_share
    FROM base
    WINDOW w_grp AS (PARTITION BY location, dept_name ORDER BY budget DESC)
),
with_windows AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        *,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY dept_name ORDER BY budget, id) AS row_seq,
        CUME_DIST() OVER (ORDER BY budget_percent_rank) AS budget_percent_rank_cume_dist,
        NTILE(3) OVER (PARTITION BY location ORDER BY budget DESC, id) AS budget_bucket,
        NTILE(3) OVER (PARTITION BY location, dept_name ORDER BY budget_percent_rank DESC, id) AS budget_percent_rank_bucket,
        CUME_DIST() OVER (ORDER BY budget_percent_rank DESC NULLS FIRST) AS budget_percent_rank_cume_dist_2
    FROM metrics
),
valid AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        *,
        budget_share - budget_percent_rank_bucket AS budget_share_minus_budget_percent_rank_bucket,
        budget_percent_rank_cume_dist_2 - budget_bucket AS budget_percent_rank_cume_dist_2_minus_budget_bucket
    FROM with_windows
    WHERE dept_name IS NOT NULL
),
not_flagged AS (
    -- Anti-join via a correlated subquery
    SELECT s.*
    FROM valid s
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM employees x
            WHERE x.dept_id = s.id
              AND x.level = 'L4'
        )
),
deduped AS (
    -- QUALIFY-style window filter
    SELECT *
    FROM (
        SELECT *, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY dept_name, location ORDER BY budget_percent_rank_bucket DESC) AS latest_rank
        FROM not_flagged
    ) x
    WHERE latest_rank = 1
)

SELECT
    location,

FROM deduped

WITH base AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        id,
        order_id,
        method,
        status,
        ROUND(amount, 2) AS amount_rounded
    FROM payments
    WHERE order_id IN (7, 12, 13, 28)
),
base_payments AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT
        *,
        LENGTH(method) AS method_length,
        COALESCE(method, 'N/A') AS method_filled
    FROM base
    WHERE method IS NOT NULL
      AND method IS NOT NULL
),
enriched AS (
    -- Attach orders attributes
    SELECT s.*, o.amount
    FROM base_payments s
    INNER JOIN orders o
        ON s.order_id = o.id
)
-- Grouped metrics
SELECT
    CASE WHEN method_length >= 62 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END AS method_length_tier,
    order_id,
    SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_SET(status)) AS status_list,
    COUNT(*) AS event_count,
    ROUND(AVG(amount_rounded), 2) AS avg_amount_rounded,
    APPROX_PERCENTILE(amount, 0.5) AS amount_p50
FROM enriched
GROUP BY method_length_tier, order_id
ORDER BY avg_amount_rounded
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

base = (
    df_payments
    .filter(F.col("order_id").isin([7, 12, 13, 28]))

        "method",
        "status",
        F.round("amount", 2).alias("amount_rounded"),
    )

base_payments = (
    base
    .filter(F.col("method").isNotNull() & F.col("method").isNotNull())
    .select(
        "*",
        F.length("method").alias("method_length"),
        F.coalesce("method", F.lit("N/A")).alias("method_filled"),
    )
)

enriched = (
    base_payments
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_orders.alias("o"), F.col("s.order_id") == F.col("o.id"), "inner")
    .select("s.*", F.col("o.amount"))
)

result = (
    enriched
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("method_length") >= 62, "PREMIUM").otherwise("STANDARD").alias("method_length_tier"),
        "order_id",
    )
    .agg(
        F.sort_array(F.collect_set("status")).alias("status_list"),
        F.count("*").alias("event_count"),
        F.round(F.avg("amount_rounded"), 2).alias("avg_amount_rounded"),

sql:
WITH filtered AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        *,
        LENGTH(method) AS method_length,
        CASE WHEN method IN ('paypal', 'card') THEN 'Priority' ELSE 'Other' END AS method_group
    FROM payments
    WHERE order_id IS NOT NULL
),
with_gaps AS (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > interval)
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN paid_at - LAG(paid_at) OVER (PARTITION BY method ORDER BY paid_at, id) > INTERVAL '30' DAY THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_new_session
    FROM filtered
),
sessionized AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(is_new_session) OVER (PARTITION BY method ORDER BY paid_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_no
    FROM with_gaps
)
-- Aggregate with conditional metrics
SELECT
    CASE WHEN is_new_session >= 1 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END AS is_new_session_tier,
    method,
    DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', paid_at) AS year_start,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'FAILED' THEN 1 END) AS failed_count,
    COUNT(*) AS cnt,
    COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS distinct_order_ids,
    PERCENTILE_APPROX(amount, 0.95) AS amount_p95
FROM sessionized
GROUP BY ROLLUP (CASE WHEN is_new_session >= 1 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END, method, DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', paid_at))
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("method").orderBy("paid_at", "id")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("method").orderBy("paid_at", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)

filtered = (
    df_payments
    .filter(F.col("order_id").isNotNull())
    .withColumn("method_length", F.length("method"))
    .withColumn("method_group", F.when(F.col("method").isin(["paypal", "card"]), "Priority").otherwise("Other"))
)

with_gaps = (
    filtered
    .withColumn("is_new_session", F.when(F.col("paid_at") - F.lag("paid_at").over(w) > F.expr("INTERVAL 30 DAYS"), 1).otherwise(0))
)

sessionized = with_gaps.withColumn("session_no", F.sum("is_new_session").over(w2))

result = (
    sessionized
    .rollup(
        F.when(F.col("is_new_session") >= 1, "LARGE").otherwise("SMALL").alias("is_new_session_tier"),
        "method",
        F.date_trunc("YEAR", "paid_at").alias("year_start"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.count(F.when(F.col("status") == "FAILED", 1)).alias("failed_count"),
        F.count("*").alias("cnt"),
        F.countDistinct("order_id").alias("distinct_order_ids"),
        F.percentile_approx("amount", 0.95).alias("amount_p95"),
    )
)

WITH exploded AS (
    -- Unnest the array into one row per element
    SELECT
        id,
        effective_from,
        currency,
        val
    FROM price_tiers
    LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(discounts) li AS val
),
metrics AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        *,
        PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY currency ORDER BY val DESC) AS val_percent_rank,
        PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY val NULLS FIRST) AS val_percent_rank_2,
        AVG(val) OVER (PARTITION BY currency) AS currency_avg_val,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY currency ORDER BY val DESC) AS val_rank
    FROM exploded
),
cleaned AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT
        id,
        effective_from,
        currency,
        val_percent_rank,
        val_percent_rank_2,
        val_rank,
        GREATEST(currency_avg_val, val_rank) AS greatest_currency_avg_val_val_rank,
        DATEDIFF(CURRENT_DATE(), effective_from) AS days_since_effective_from
    FROM metrics
    WHERE effective_from >= TO_DATE('2024-10-15')
      AND currency_avg_val >= 50
)
-- Grouped metrics
SELECT
    currency,
    COUNT_IF(currency = 'THB') AS thb_events,
    COUNT_IF(currency = 'USD') AS usd_events,
    COUNT(*) AS cnt,
    SUM(greatest_currency_avg_val_val_rank) FILTER (WHERE currency = 'THB') AS thb_total_greatest_currency_avg_val_val_rank
FROM cleaned
GROUP BY currency;

    df_price_tiers
    .select("id", "effective_from", "currency", F.explode("discounts").alias("val"))
)

metrics = (
    exploded
    .withColumn("val_percent_rank", F.percent_rank().over(w))
    .withColumn("val_percent_rank_2", F.percent_rank().over(w2))
    .withColumn("currency_avg_val", F.avg("val").over(w3))
    .withColumn("val_rank", F.rank().over(w))
)

cleaned = (
    metrics
    .filter((F.col("effective_from") >= F.to_date(F.lit("2024-10-15"))) & (F.col("currency_avg_val") >= 50))
    .select(
        "id",
        "effective_from",
        "currency",
        "val_percent_rank",
        "val_percent_rank_2",
        "val_rank",
        F.greatest("currency_avg_val", "val_rank").alias("greatest_currency_avg_val_val_rank"),
        F.datediff(F.current_date(), "effective_from").alias("days_since_effective_from"),
    )
)

result = (
    cleaned
    .groupBy("currency")
    .agg(
        F.count_if(F.col("currency") == "THB").alias("thb_events"),
        F.count_if(F.col("currency") == "USD").alias("usd_events"),
        F.count("*").alias("cnt"),
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("currency") == "THB", F.col("greatest_currency_avg_val_val_rank"))).alias("thb_total_greatest_currency_avg_val_val_rank"),
    )
)

        dept_id,

),
deduped as (
    -- Keep one row per key (latest first)

    from deduped

        AVG(cost) OVER (PARTITION BY order_id ORDER BY cost, id ROWS BETWEEN 5 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) cost_avg_5,
        SUM(discount) OVER (PARTITION BY order_id ORDER BY shipped_date, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) running_discount,
        SUM(discount) OVER (PARTITION BY channel, status ORDER BY discount, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) running_discount_2
    FROM enriched
),
deduped AS (
    SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY channel, carrier ORDER BY cost_avg_5, id) AS latest_rank
    FROM metrics
    QUALIFY latest_rank = 1
)
SELECT *
FROM (
    SELECT
        id,
        status,
        cost,
        discount,
        prev_discount
    FROM deduped
) src
UNPIVOT (
    metric_value FOR metric IN (cost AS COST, discount, prev_discount AS PREV_DISCOUNT_VAL)
);

WITH metrics AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        id,
        customer_id,
        plan,
        start_date,
        end_date,
        monthly_fee,
        status,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY monthly_fee DESC NULLS FIRST) AS monthly_fee_dense_rank,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY plan ORDER BY monthly_fee DESC NULLS FIRST) AS monthly_fee_rank
    FROM subscriptions
),
enriched AS (
    -- Attach customers attributes
    SELECT s.*, p.age
    FROM metrics s
    LEFT JOIN customers p
        ON s.customer_id = p.id
),
latest AS (
    -- QUALIFY-style window filter
    SELECT *
    FROM (
        SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY status ORDER BY monthly_fee_dense_rank DESC, id) AS latest_rank
        FROM enriched
    ) x
    WHERE latest_rank = 1
)
-- Aggregate with conditional metrics
SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('QUARTER', end_date) AS quarter_start,
    MAX(monthly_fee_dense_rank) FILTER (WHERE status = 'PAUSED') AS paused_max_monthly_fee_dense_rank,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'ACTIVE' THEN 1 END) AS active_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'ACTIVE' THEN monthly_fee_dense_rank ELSE 0 END) AS active_monthly_fee_dense_rank,
    SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'PAUSED' THEN age ELSE 0 END) AS paused_age,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN plan = 'basic' THEN 1 END) AS basic_count
FROM latest
GROUP BY CUBE (DATE_TRUNC('QUARTER', end_date))

WITH cleaned AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT
        *,
        ADD_MONTHS(signup_date, 3) AS signup_date_plus_months,
        CASE WHEN credit_limit >= 14500 THEN 'High' WHEN credit_limit >= 5300 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END AS credit_limit_level
    FROM customers
    WHERE signup_date > TO_DATE('2023-03-27')
),
not_flagged AS (
    -- Anti-join via a correlated subquery
    SELECT s.*
    FROM cleaned s
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM subscriptions ch
            WHERE ch.customer_id = s.id
              AND ch.end_date >= s.signup_date_plus_months
        )
),
latest AS (
    -- QUALIFY-style window filter
    SELECT *
    FROM (
        SELECT *, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY city ORDER BY credit_limit DESC) AS latest_rank
        FROM not_flagged
    ) t
    WHERE latest_rank = 1
),
totals AS (
    -- Multi-level aggregation
    SELECT
        CASE WHEN credit_limit >= 13500 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END AS credit_limit_tier,
        DATE_TRUNC('QUARTER', signup_date) AS quarter_start,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN city = 'Chiang Mai' THEN 1 END) AS chiang_mai_count,
        SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_SET(city)) AS city_list,
        ROUND(AVG(age), 2) AS avg_age
    FROM latest
    GROUP BY CUBE (CASE WHEN credit_limit >= 13500 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END, DATE_TRUNC('QUARTER', signup_date))
)
SELECT chiang_mai_count, city_list
FROM totals
ORDER BY chiang_mai_count DESC NULLS LAST;

from pyspark.sql.window import Window

cleaned = (
    df_customers
    .filter(F.col("signup_date") > F.to_date(F.lit("2023-03-27")))
    .select(
        "*",
        F.add_months("signup_date", 3).alias("signup_date_plus_months"),
        F.when(F.col("credit_limit") >= 14500, "High").when(F.col("credit_limit") >= 5300, "Medium").otherwise("Low").alias("credit_limit_level"),
    )

not_flagged = (
    cleaned
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_subscriptions.alias("ch"), (F.col("ch.customer_id") == F.col("s.id")) & (F.col("ch.end_date") >= F.col("s.signup_date_plus_months")), "left_anti")
)

latest = (
    not_flagged
    .withColumn("latest_rank", F.rank().over(w))
    .filter(F.col("latest_rank") == 1)
)

totals = (
    latest
    .cube(
        F.when(F.col("credit_limit") >= 13500, "HIGH").otherwise("LOW").alias("credit_limit_tier"),
        F.date_trunc("QUARTER", "signup_date").alias("quarter_start"),

        F.round(F.avg("age"), 2).alias("avg_age"),
    )
)

result = (
    totals
    .select("chiang_mai_count", "city_list")
    .orderBy(F.col("chiang_mai_count").desc_nulls_last())
)

verified AS (

    FROM verified

),
with_dims AS (

    FROM with_windows e
    LEFT JOIN suppliers d
        ON e.supplier_id = d.id
),
cleaned AS (

    FROM with_dims

),
daily AS (

)

filtered AS (

cleaned AS (

    SELECT

    FROM filtered

),

WITH not_flagged AS (
    -- Anti-join via a correlated subquery
    SELECT s.*
    FROM stores s
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM inventory x
            WHERE x.store_id = s.id
              AND x.last_restock <= s.opened_date
        )
),
scored AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        *,
        MIN(sqft) OVER (PARTITION BY region) region_min_sqft,
        CUME_DIST() OVER w_hist sqft_cume_dist,
        SUM(sqft) OVER (ORDER BY opened_date, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) running_sqft
    FROM not_flagged
    WINDOW w_hist AS (PARTITION BY city ORDER BY sqft DESC)
),
ranked AS (
    -- Keep one row per key (latest first)
    SELECT *
    FROM scored
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY region ORDER BY region_min_sqft DESC, id) = 1
),
metrics AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        id,
        store_name,
        city,
        region,
        opened_date,
        sqft,
        region_min_sqft,
        sqft_cume_dist,
        running_sqft,
        LEAD(sqft, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY city ORDER BY region_min_sqft, id) next_sqft,
        SUM(region_min_sqft) OVER (PARTITION BY region ORDER BY sqft, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) cumulative_region_min_sqft,
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY sqft_cume_dist DESC) sqft_cume_dist_rank
    FROM ranked
),
with_last AS (
    -- Latest matching order per row (LATERAL ... LIMIT 1)
    SELECT
        s.*,
        x.order_amount,
        x.discount
    FROM metrics s
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
            SELECT c.amount AS order_amount, c.discount
            FROM orders c
            WHERE c.store_id = s.id
            ORDER BY c.amount DESC, c.id DESC
            LIMIT 1
        ) x ON TRUE
),
grouped AS (
    -- Multi-level aggregation
    SELECT
        region,
        APPROX_PERCENTILE(sqft_cume_dist_rank, 0.5) AS sqft_cume_dist_rank_p50,
        SUM(sqft) AS total_sqft,
        SIZE(COLLECT_SET(region)) AS num_regions,
        ROUND(SUM(sqft_cume_dist) / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN city = 'London' THEN 1 END), 0), 2) AS sqft_cume_dist_per_london,
        COUNT(*) AS num_rows,
        COUNT(*) AS row_count
    FROM with_last
    GROUP BY region
)
SELECT
    region,
    total_sqft,
    num_regions,
    sqft_cume_dist_per_london,
    num_rows,
    row_count
FROM grouped
ORDER BY num_rows DESC;

WITH with_windows AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        *,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY job_title ORDER BY salary) AS salary_dense_rank,
        FIRST_VALUE(level, TRUE) OVER (PARTITION BY job_title, level ORDER BY salary, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS first_known_level,
        ROUND(salary / SUM(salary) OVER (PARTITION BY job_title), 4) AS salary_share,
        AVG(salary) OVER w_ordered AS salary_avg_5_prior
    FROM employees
    WINDOW w_ordered AS (PARTITION BY job_title ORDER BY salary, id ROWS BETWEEN 5 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING)
),
latest AS (
    -- Keep one row per key (latest first)
    SELECT *
    FROM (
        SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY dept_id ORDER BY hire_date DESC NULLS LAST, id) AS row_num
        FROM with_windows
    ) ranked
    WHERE row_num = 1
),
filtered AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT *, ADD_MONTHS(hire_date, 12) AS hire_date_plus_months
    FROM latest
    WHERE hire_date >= TO_DATE('2024-03-25')
),
joined AS (
    -- Attach departments attributes
    SELECT
        a.*,
        d.dept_name,
        d.budget
    FROM filtered a
    INNER JOIN departments d
        ON a.dept_id = d.id
),
with_dims AS (
    -- Attach departments attributes
    SELECT
        a.*,
        b.budget AS department_budget,
        b.dept_name AS department_dept_name
    FROM joined a
    LEFT JOIN departments b
        ON a.dept_id = b.id
),
deduped AS (
    -- Keep one row per key (latest first)
    SELECT *
    FROM (
        SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY dept_name ORDER BY salary, id) AS rn
        FROM with_dims
    ) ranked
    WHERE rn = 1
),
matched_keys AS (
    -- Set intersection on keys
    SELECT dept_id
    FROM deduped
    INTERSECT ALL
    SELECT dept_id
    FROM employees
    WHERE dept_id = 21
),
kept_rows AS (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    SELECT s.*
    FROM deduped s
    INNER JOIN matched_keys k ON s.dept_id = k.dept_id
)
-- Grouped metrics
SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('WEEK', hire_date_plus_months) AS week_start,
    dept_id,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE dept_name = 'Marketing') AS marketing_rows,
    COUNT(DISTINCT id) AS distinct_ids,
    ROUND(SUM(salary_share) / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN dept_name = 'Sales' THEN 1 END), 0), 2) AS salary_share_per_sales,
    COUNT(*) AS cnt,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE department_dept_name = 'Sales') AS sales_rows,
    MAX(salary) FILTER (WHERE job_title = 'Analyst') AS analyst_max_salary
FROM kept_rows
GROUP BY CUBE (DATE_TRUNC('WEEK', hire_date_plus_months), dept_id)
HAVING distinct_ids > 1
ORDER BY analyst_max_salary DESC NULLS LAST;

WITH lines AS (
    -- Unnest the array into one row per element
    SELECT
        id,
        currency,
        EXPLODE_OUTER(discounts) AS element
    FROM price_tiers
),
filtered AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT *, ROUND(element * 100, 2) AS element_adjusted
    FROM lines
    WHERE currency IN ('THB', 'USD')
),
cleaned AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN currency = 'USD' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_usd
    FROM filtered
    WHERE currency = 'THB'
)
-- Running and moving aggregates
SELECT
    *,
    PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY is_usd NULLS LAST) AS is_usd_percent_rank,
    CUME_DIST() OVER (PARTITION BY currency ORDER BY is_usd NULLS FIRST) AS is_usd_cume_dist,
    MIN(is_usd) OVER w_running AS currency_min_is_usd,
    MIN(element_adjusted) OVER w_running AS currency_min_element_adjusted
FROM cleaned
WINDOW w_running AS (PARTITION BY currency);
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.orderBy(F.col("is_usd").asc_nulls_last())
w2 = Window.partitionBy("currency").orderBy(F.col("is_usd").asc_nulls_first())
w_running = Window.partitionBy("currency")

lines = (
    df_price_tiers
    .select("id", "currency", F.explode_outer("discounts").alias("element"))
)

filtered = (
    lines
    .filter(F.col("currency").isin(["THB", "USD"]))
    .withColumn("element_adjusted", F.round((F.col("element") * 100), 2))
)

cleaned = (
    filtered
    .filter(F.col("currency") == "THB")
    .withColumn("is_usd", F.when(F.col("currency") == "USD", 1).otherwise(0))
)

result = (
    cleaned
    .select(
        "*",
        F.percent_rank().over(w).alias("is_usd_percent_rank"),
        F.cume_dist().over(w2).alias("is_usd_cume_dist"),
        F.min("is_usd").over(w_running).alias("currency_min_is_usd"),
        F.min("element_adjusted").over(w_running).alias("currency_min_element_adjusted"),
    )
)

WITH valid AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        store_name,
        city,
        region,
        sqft,
        LENGTH(store_name) AS store_name_length,
        LAST_DAY(opened_date) AS opened_date_month_end,
        COALESCE(region, 'UNKNOWN') AS region_filled
    FROM stores
    WHERE LENGTH(store_name) > 12
)
SELECT
    id,
    store_name,
    city,
    region,
    sqft,
    store_name_length,
    opened_date_month_end,
    region_filled,
    LEAD(sqft, 2) OVER w_part AS next_sqft,
    SUM(sqft) OVER w_part_2 AS cumulative_sqft,
    LAG(store_name_length, 1) OVER (ORDER BY opened_date_month_end, id) AS prev_store_name_length,
    AVG(store_name_length) OVER (PARTITION BY region ORDER BY store_name_length, id ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS store_name_length_avg_3
FROM valid
WINDOW w_part AS (PARTITION BY region ORDER BY sqft, id), w_part_2 AS (PARTITION BY region ORDER BY sqft, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW);
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w_part = Window.partitionBy("region").orderBy("sqft", "id")
w_part_2 = Window.partitionBy("region").orderBy("sqft", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w3 = Window.orderBy("opened_date_month_end", "id")
w4 = Window.partitionBy("region").orderBy("store_name_length", "id").rowsBetween(-3, Window.currentRow)

valid = (
    df_stores
    .filter(F.length("store_name") > 12)
    .select(
        "id",
        "store_name",
        "city",
        "region",
        "sqft",
        F.length("store_name").alias("store_name_length"),
        F.last_day("opened_date").alias("opened_date_month_end"),
        F.coalesce("region", F.lit("UNKNOWN")).alias("region_filled"),
    )
)

result = (
    valid
    .select(
        "*",
        F.lead("sqft", 2).over(w_part).alias("next_sqft"),
        F.sum("sqft").over(w_part_2).alias("cumulative_sqft"),
        F.lag("store_name_length", 1).over(w3).alias("prev_store_name_length"),
        F.avg("store_name_length").over(w4).alias("store_name_length_avg_3"),
    )
)
